job.title: Head of Social
job.description:
Who are we? 

143 Studios is an award-winning media production company headquartered in Boston, MA focused on creating, producing, and publishing first-of-its-kind audio and visual content that inspires and empowers millions of people globally. We are the team behind the Golden Globe-nominated show The Mel Robbins Podcast, which is #1 most-followed show on Apple Podcasts. We’re also the same team behind The Let Them Theory, a cultural phenomenon with almost 10 million copies sold, six #1 Audible Originals, and professional development education for many of the largest companies in the world. Every day, our work reaches more than 40 million online followers around the world.

About the Role

143 Studios is looking for a Head of Social to lead the next evolution of how Mel Robbins shows up across social media.

With more than 40 million followers across platforms, social is one of the most important ways people discover and connect with Mel’s work. We’re looking for someone who can bring together big creative thinking, deep platform expertise, and strong operational leadership to build a social presence that feels distinctive, relevant, and constantly evolving.

You’ll lead the teams responsible for social content and operations, while partnering closely with the Community team to connect social strategy with the conversations, insights, and relationships happening across Mel’s audience.

What You’ll Be Doing

Set the Vision for Social

  • Define and lead the social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and other emerging platforms.
  • Guide social creators in turning podcast episodes, brand initiatives, and cultural moments into compelling social content.
  • Identify emerging trends, formats, and audience behaviors that create opportunities for growth and experimentation.

Build a Social Operation That Moves

  • Oversee the planning, creation, packaging, approval, and publishing of social content across platforms.
  • Build clear workflows, ownership, and operating rhythms across the social organization.
  • Partner with Production and Content to plan social assets earlier in the creative and production process.

Turn Performance Into Smarter Content

  • Use analytics to inform content strategy, creative decisions, platform priorities, and experimentation.
  • Share audience insights and performance trends with leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Continuously test and optimize formats, packaging, cadence, and distribution strategies.

Lead the Team & Connect the Organization

  • Establish clear roles, expectations, and accountability across the social team.
  • Partner closely with Community, Content, Production, Marketing, and Brand Partnerships to integrate social strategy across the organization.
  • Work with the Community team to ensure audience feedback and insights help inform social strategy and content decisions.
  • Build a culture that balances creativity, experimentation, collaboration, and strong execution.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in social media, digital content, or audience development, including experience leading teams.
  • Proven experience developing social strategy for a major creator, personality, media company, publisher, or consumer brand.
  • Deep understanding of major social platforms, algorithms, audience behavior, and emerging trends.
  • Demonstrated success growing and engaging large audiences through creative and platform strategy.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with an analytical, data-informed approach.
  • Experience building social workflows, systems, and high-performing teams.
  • Strong communicator who thrives in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.
  • Solutions-driven, collaborative, curious, and able to move quickly without ego.

To Apply

Send us your resume and a brief cover letter sharing why you are the perfect fit for this role. 

Benefits & Perks

Mission-Driven Work That Matters

Your work will inspire millions. Every piece of content is crafted to create impact, spark change, and uplift people around the world.

Fun and Energizing Hybrid Culture

Whether remote or in-person, our collaborative, creative, and low-ego culture is designed to bring out your best work.

Growth-Oriented Environment

We’re a team of self-starters committed to leveling up — with regular feedback, bold goals, and space to learn by doing.

Exciting Team Activities

From virtual brainstorms to surprise challenges and offsite meetups, we make time to connect, play, and celebrate wins together.

401(k) Available

Plan for your future with access to a 401(k) retirement savings plan to support your long-term financial well-being.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Take care of yourself with comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance — because your well-being matters.

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Senior Business & Legal Affairs Coordinator is responsible for documenting and recordkeeping agreements between ASCAP and its Members, along with other related tasks. This includes communicating with both internal and external stakeholders regarding the various time-sensitive aspects of Member agreements, Member transactions, or other sensitive and/or legal topics.

The ideal Senior Coordinator will be organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable using various platforms such as Microsoft Office Suite, Docusign, Salesforce, and other internal software. The Senior Coordinator must also leverage strong written and verbal communication skills when connecting with ASCAP Members and their professional representatives, which may include business managers, lawyers, and publisher representatives.

The Senior Coordinator will also work closely with other members of the department as needed to ensure that the goals of the Business and Legal Affairs team are consistently met. The role reports to the SVP, Membership and Business & Legal Affairs in the Business & Legal Affairs department. This is a hybrid position with a 3 day per week in-office requirement based out of the ASCAP New York Office.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Manage both the creation of and approval process for payment authorization forms.
  • Collect and verify all necessary documents and exhibits to finalize agreements.
  • Authenticate all payment information for any new payees.
  • Keep thorough records regarding all agreements, but also other high-value member documents that may be retained by BALA, Membership Creative, Distribution and Royalty departments.
  • Respond to requests from the Marketing and Events team with summaries of relevant information for members/attendees.
  • Review and confirm membership, catalog, and/or royalty information in response to urgent, legal, or otherwise sensitive requests.
  • Communicate directly with Members, their representatives, and various ASCAP staff to address complex performing rights issues, providing direct assistance and facilitating internal handoffs when appropriate.
  • Process attorney requests and implement any instructions relating to disputes or other issues such as submitting stop-payments or compiling related background data, when necessary.
  • Coordinate interdepartmental responses pertaining to issues regarding Member legal transactions (i.e., Royalty, Distribution, Repertory, Global Member Services, etc.).
  • Complete additional administrative or filing responsibilities, as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and strong academic background required.
  • 3+ years of experience with a law firm, in-house legal department, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in Word and Excel (incl. pivot tables) and general comfort with numbers.
  • Extraordinary work ethic with the ability to follow detailed instructions.
  • Ability to think analytically, work independently, and take direction well.
  • Comfortable handling time-sensitive matters in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and discretion.
  • Superb written and oral communication skills.
  • Track record of success in a highly detail-oriented environment.
  • Analytical problem solver with a highly organized approach.
  • Experience working with legal agreements and contracts.
  • Familiarity with the music publishing business is a plus.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $60,000 to $72,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

  • Responsible for exceeding sales budget and collection of sold accounts.
  • Maintain account lists while soliciting new business.
  • Prepare promotional plans, sales literature, and advertising proposals.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with clients by providing top quality service.
  • Investigate and resolve customer problems.
  • Communicate with other departments to assure quality service in placing orders and arranging promotional events.
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and client remotes.
  • Performs all other tasks perceived, assigned, and/or required that contribute to the smooth running of the department and to the achievement of departmental and station goals.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

 

  • Proven success in selling Digital media, SEM/SEO/OTT/Mobile/Email/Video, Event/sponsorship sales, and Audio.
  • Proficient in Google Analytics, Google Ads (SEM), Facebook Ads
  • Ability to develop new business and manage sales with a proven track record of exceeding goals.
  • Thorough understanding of advertising and marketing including digital, audio, and interactive.
  • A creative mind to put together unique campaigns focused on solving client needs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills – you’re someone who identifies a problem as an opportunity to develop business.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Programs including Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint, CRM-SalesForce.
  • A positive attitude and a desire to continuously grow your income.
  • A valid driver's license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and if the position requires use of applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Job Title: Account Executive

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business through consistent prospecting, networking, referrals, email, phone calls and face-to-face meetings - minimum of 100 outreach per week
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, marketing leaders and decision-makers
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand a client's business, challenges, goals and target audience
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions based on each client's needs
  • Sell across Audacy's portfolio, including broadcast, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and other marketing solutions
  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting and presentation through closing and campaign execution and retainment 
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual sales goals
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and actively look for opportunities to grow existing accounts
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and become a trusted marketing partner to your clients
  • Stay current on industry trends, consumer behavior and new advertising opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with sales management, marketing, programming, digital and other internal teams to deliver successful campaigns
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

Required:

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager role is responsible for quarterbacking the post-sale process once a campaign has been sold, as well as helping strategize what we’re going to market with from a pre-sale perspective. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. You will have a knack for communicating efficiently and effectively under pressure to both internally & externally, and the detail orientation skills to ensure that the client’s needs are met.

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Quarterback internal strategy calls to ensure we’re providing our best recommendations.
  • Lead conversations with internal creative and execution teams to ensure client expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Provide “white glove” client service to advertisers through great communication and properly setting expectations.
  • Quarterback Internal & External pre-sale/post-sale Kickoff Calls
  • Work with Marketing to create in-depth detailed wrap reports, calling out prominent metrics to keep the client satisfied
  • Work closely with the Campaign Management team to ensure that we’re delivering well, or optimizing with the goal of delivering in full.
  • Manage all post-sale correspondence with the client and creative stakeholders.
  • Monitor and convey recording timelines and manage expectations for closed campaigns.
  • Present campaign performance reports including delivery, optimizations, insights, and program recommendations including mid-campaign and wrap reports
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on your client, and track anything that could result in risk
  • Work with planning on re-allocations while being cognizant of what the client is and is not interested in.
  • Communicate effectively with Podcast Partner Management to manage custom facets of campaigns and ensure we’re keeping to timeline.
  • Vet & monitor the podcast vetting portal to ensure we have approvals to run in shows at the point of sale

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2 years working with a media company, digital agency, or integrated media sales position, preferably in a client-facing capacity.
  • Basic understanding of digital advertising strategy and measurement is preferred.
  • Problem solver and solution-oriented thinker with great organizational skills.
  • Public speaking skills and ability to lead a room
  • Skilled at interpreting data to properly position sellback metrics.
  • A background working with and leading communication with internal teams
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented work environment
  • Exceptional communication and writing skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Overview:

The Attribution and Data Services team plays a critical role within Audacy’s revenue team by providing measurement and insights to demonstrate the impact of advertising campaigns to our clients. We are an enthusiastic and dynamic team focused on guiding business decisions through accurate, relevant, and timely data, analytics and insights. The team is highly entrepreneurial, and is working fast and smart to solve challenges within the fast-growing Audio space in new and innovative ways.

The team is growing and we are seeking an Analyst of Client Solutions who will be responsible for the execution of our Digital Attribution suite of products. Audacy offers a portfolio of attribution solutions to meet client needs, which include traditional pixel-based digital measurement, innovative solutions for podcast measurement, foot-traffic attribution, and brand lift studies. Analysts on our team are responsible for supporting execution of these campaigns to meet our clients’ needs.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Experience working with Digital Media in either a Planning, Campaign Management or Operations role is required.
  • Partner closely with our sales teams and vendors to design, implement and deliver advertising campaign measurement projects
  • Work with the Digital Ad Operations Team to properly structure ad campaigns for measurement and implement tracking pixels.
  • Support local sales teams and their clients on tag implementation on the clients’ own websites, typically using Google Tag Manager
  • Help with analyzing and interpreting campaign performance reports – craft a story from the data to help non-technical stake-holders understand and have confidence in the result
  • Scope out measurement and research projects, and manage our vendor relationships to ensure productive business partnerships
  • Create scalable, innovative approaches to managing and analyzing campaign performance data to solve challenging business problems
  • Keep abreast of current analytics trends, especially those pertaining to attribution. Introduce and help vet innovative techniques and vendors that will give Audacy a competitive advantage
  • Perform other related duties as required or assigned that contribute to the effectiveness of the department and to accomplish strategic goals and objectives.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or Digital Marketing
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Adobe, or other digital tracking technologies
  • 1-3 years of related work experience
  • Strong analytical mind and curiosity. Is skilled at digging into data to assess results and key takeaways to leverage for continuous optimization.
  • Strong analytical competencies such as ability to formulate an analytical problem; QC data and results; summarize key findings/insights; make actionable recommendations
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, strong attention to detail and can skillfully manage several complex projects with multiple moving parts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Effective listener.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills. Strong personal integrity
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture

Primary duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Daily translation needed: Spanish/English for Spanish station, El Zol
  • Coordinate with Sales, Programming, and third-party partners on prize and promotion details

  • Collaborate with Sales and Programming Departments on promotion ideation for client and brand initiatives

  • Attend sales meetings, client meetings and station meetings, as needed

  • First-rate organizational skills are a must to succeed in this position
  • Experience working in fast paced environment able to juggle multiple projects simultaneously 
  • Demonstrated oral and written communication skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and multi-task
  • Experience using Google Workspace, Microsoft® Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • Knowledge of promotion software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting), Audience (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and PromoSuite (promotion management software) Vcreative

job.title: Digital Account Executive
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Senior Vice President of Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-time

 

Pay Transparency: $65,000 to $75,000 base salary

 

Location(s): Roseville, California 

 

Work Arrangement: On-site

 

 

The anticipated starting base salary range for California based individuals expressing interest in this position is $65,000 to $75,000, plus uncapped commission. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

The Opportunity: 

 

Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace?

Audacy is looking for a driven Digital Account Executive to accelerate growth and make an immediate impact. This is more than a sales job—it's an opportunity to build your own book of business, sell industry-leading digital marketing solutions, and earn without limits.

 

If you're competitive, entrepreneurial, and motivated by uncapped income potential, we'll give you the platform, products, and support to win big.

 

Who We Are: Industry Digital Leader with Best In Class Technology

 

At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition. You'll collaborate with local businesses, regional brands, and national advertisers to create customized marketing strategies using cutting-edge digital solutions.

 

Our multi-platform ecosystem combines the scale of premium audio with the precision of digital targeting, giving you access to:

  • Digital Streaming Audio
  • Podcast Advertising & Host-Endorsed Content
  • Amazon DSP & Programmatic Advertising
  • Connected TV (CTV) & OTT Video / Live Sports
  • Display & Native Advertising
  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
  •   Search Engine Optimization (SEO) / AIO (AI Optimization)
  • Social Media Advertising
  • First-Party Audience Targeting & Data Solutions
  • Attribution & Performance Measurement Tools

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Hunt New Business: Relentlessly prospect, uncover opportunities, and win new clients through strategic outreach, networking, and relationship-building.
  • Build a Pipeline That Produces: Consistently generate qualified opportunities and maintain a healthy pipeline to exceed revenue goals.
  • Own the Close: Take control of the entire sales process, from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Compete to Win: Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where results are recognized and rewarded.
  • Sell Industry-Leading Solutions: Help businesses grow with best-in-class digital marketing solutions.
  • Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand client goals, uncover challenges, and deliver strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Outwork the Competition: Stay ahead of market trends, identify emerging opportunities, and bring fresh ideas to every client conversation.

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

 

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

Qualifications

More About You:

  • Proven Sales Success: 4+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience with a track record of winning new business and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Hunter Mentality: You thrive on prospecting, opening doors, and building a pipeline from the ground up.
  • Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of digital advertising solutions, including programmatic, search, social, video, and audience targeting.
  • Strategic & Consultative Approach: You uncover client challenges, develop customized solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Executive Presence: Confident presenting to business owners, marketing leaders, and C-suite decision-makers while simplifying complex digital strategies.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable using campaign metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROI, ROAS, and conversion rates to guide recommendations and prove performance.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills that drive long-term partnerships.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Salesforce, Google Workspace, and digital marketing platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.
  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated, accountable, and driven to succeed in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

About Us

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. Learn more at www.audacyinc.com and join the conversation on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Ready to own the conversation in the fastest-growing sector of media?

Audacy isn’t just a media company; we are the voice of millions. As the premier destination for trusted local news, massive sports culture, favorite music, and chart-topping premium podcasts, we connect brands with hyper-engaged audiences in the moments that matter.

If you know how to win digital business, thrive on building relationships, and want to unlock bigger opportunities by combining your network with Audacy’s national reach and hyper-local targeting capabilities, this is your next big move.

  • A Strategic Thinker: You don’t just sell spots and dots; you sell business outcomes and ROI.
  • Culturally Plugged In: You love the media landscape, follow podcast trends, and know what brands need to say to stay relevant.
  • Chicago Rooted, Nationally Minded: You know the local market like the back of your hand, but you have the grit to pitch major national accounts.

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: Competitive base salary + an aggressive, uncapped commission structure built for high-performers.
  • The Ultimate Toolkit: Sell across the Audacy App, live events, streaming audio, and a massive roster of premium, chart-topping podcasts.
  • Vibrant Chicago Culture: Work from a dynamic, creative environment with perks, client entertainment opportunities, and major market activations.

Overview

Department: Digital

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

This is the ideal role for a high caliber-marketing professional with significant success in digital campaign management who is looking to join a growing, fast-paced business. As a Digital Campaign Manager, you will be responsible for managing the successful implementation of campaign activities for several assigned markets. This role is focused on post sales fulfillment, working with a variety of teams to gather assets and launch campaigns across a wide range of platforms including display, email, social media, SEM, SEO and more. Responsibilities also include optimizing marketing campaigns, monitoring performance data to ensure campaigns are running properly, and communicating the results to clients on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Accountable for ownership of the post-sale process, ensuring full and complete delivery of all digital campaigns, including but not limited to order entry, fulfillment, optimization, and reporting.
  • Account Management: You will work with sales teams and digital clients to support their needs and communicate client expectations to the fulfillment and trafficking teams.
  • Project Management: Ability to work in a fast paced environment, handling several campaigns and markets at one time while tracking timelines/due dates for campaign deliverables, launches and/or revisions.
  • Continuity with Production: Ensure all digital campaigns are moving through the fulfillment process between teams while meeting necessary timelines for client orders.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure they are hitting the agreed upon goals during their flights. Adjust as appropriate. Alert appropriate parties of any anticipated problems and be prepared with suggested solutions.
  • Assist with ongoing and month end campaign/order reconciliation to verify delivery against monthly billing amount.
  • Maintain working knowledge of digital inventory: Achieve a thorough understanding of our internal systems so as to effectively and efficiently respond to internal and external requests in a timely fashion.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or campaign end, prepare performance reporting for digital campaigns and provide results to the client with the Account Executive.
  • Stakeholder Communication: As this role will support several assigned markets; clear, professional and efficient communication is imperative between stakeholders (sales team and fulfillment teams) to ensure client campaign execution and performance meets or exceeds standards.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum two years experience working with digital marketing campaigns
  • Minimum two years experience working in a sales environment
  • Ability to multi task efficiently in a organized, logical, process-oriented manner
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients 
  • Demonstrates ability to successfully collaborate with various team across the company
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and is able to prioritize accordingly
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions in regards to various responsibilities

Job Title: Digital Content Producer

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: Senior Digital Content Lead

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Buffalo, NY

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

  Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $16.00/hr - $20.00/hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Manage daily (M-F) live video stream
  • Leverage over-the-air content into short and long-form podcast clips and VOD content
  • Use creative headline copy and tagging concepts to help build customized user experiences to drive downloads and “superfans” (consistent users)
  • Produce and publish “Best of” episodes by compiling the top segments from the show each week
  • Work with central digital and local-market staff on workflow for optimizing top content clips (e.g. isolating exclusive interviews)
  • Help activate around breaking news by quickly getting reaction content onto user platforms
  • Partner with local staff to maximize Audacy’s ‘chaptering’ experience
  • Contributing topics and ideas for the show

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of audio production/editing experience
  • Proficient with Adobe Audition and video editing software
  • Experience with content management systems preferred
  • Experience with VMIX, OBS, and/ or Tricaster preferred
  • Sports knowledge, including current and historical figures and storylines
  • Strong writing and editorial skills and the ability to drive engagement for both local and national audiences
  • Strong news judgment, including the ability to make real-time judgments and react independently around breaking/viral audio

Job Title: Digital Sales Manager

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP of Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Los Angeles

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

The anticipated starting salary range for CA  individuals expressing interest in this position is $125,000 to $150,000  plus bonus. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy has an exciting digital division focused on providing local and regional businesses best-in-class solutions designed to help them aggressively compete across the web.  Candidates for the Digital Sales Manager must have sales experience in the digital space and be able to step in and drive the company's revenue.  The candidate must be able to demonstrate a strong understanding and history of new business development, lead generation, pipeline management and management of teams.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Participate on sales calls with their team of Audacy Account Executives
  • Personally consult local and regional businesses to understand their needs and aspirations so that tailored solutions can be designed, implemented and executed.
  • Execute an overall business plan and sales strategy that ensures attainment of digital revenue goals.
  • Continuous training of Audacy sales process, products, operations and the Audacy sales story.
  • Provide feedback to the internal Digital Agency regarding opportunities to improve the overall product offering and general positioning of the company’s product suite.
  • On-going consultation with sold clients regarding the performance of their purchased campaigns.
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures and business ethics codes.
  • Responsible for achieving market digital sales goals.
  • Educate sales managers and account executives on digital tools and opportunities.
  • Hire and manage dedicated digital sales staff to sell digital properties.
  • Create digital programs for client presentations. 
  • Develop innovative solutions to meet clients’ digital marketing needs.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

  • 4+ years of media-related experience selling digital platforms and previous sales management experience are a must.
  • Subject matter expertise in digital marketing tactics (SEM, SEO, Display/Video, Social, Audio/Podcasts) and attribution measurement.
  • Familiarity with prevailing internet technologies like streaming media, DSP, ad tagging, agentic search, CRM, podcasting, blogging, PMax, RSS, etc., means you speak our language.
  • Developing and conducting training sessions for our team of sellers.
  • Excellent organizational skills, the ability to effortlessly multi-task, and a knack for meeting deadlines are essential.
  • You're proficient in Google Workspace (Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides) and can craft polished, impactful sales presentations that wow clients.
  • Your excellent presentation skills are matched by strong written and oral communication skills.
  • A 4-year degree is preferred, but your experience speaks volumes.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Sales Specialist

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Digital Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Austin, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Digital Sales Specialist to spearhead revenue growth through the strategic adoption of our comprehensive digital portfolio. This is a consultative sales support role with client-facing interaction. The role is designed for a candidate with technical and strategic digital knowledge who does not just help sell "products," rather moves our sales team to create comprehensive multi-channel digital strategies tailored to a client’s business objectives.

 

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital landscape — customizing campaigns that bridge top-of-funnel awareness tactics (such as OTT and Digital Audio) with high-intent, bottom-of-funnel conversion tactics (such as Search), including conversion tracking best practices. You will act as a strategic advisor to both our internal local sales team and our valuable clients.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with account executives to identify and generate digital sales opportunities.
  • Collect and analyze digital marketing performance data, including client-specific metrics and consumer behavior trends.
  • Conduct needs analysis and present strategic recommendations to clients through in-person and virtual meetings.
  • Develop and present customized digital advertising solutions—including Search, OTT/Video, Display, Digital Audio, and Social Media—to deliver impactful client results.
  • Monitor and optimize active campaigns by analyzing performance metrics to improve efficiency and results.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to both internal sales teams and clients, fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Strategic thinking, a flexible mindset, and problem solving skills are critical to success in this role. 
  • Maintain an active role in consistently driving digital revenue growth through sales activity.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bilingual preferred.
  • 2+ years sales related experience preferred.
  • 2+ years digital marketing experience preferred.
  • College Degree preferred but not required.
  • Proven success in building client marketing campaigns by utilizing digital platforms (Search, Social, Display, Video, and Audio).
  • Thorough understanding of digital advertising, multi-channel strategies, and customer-centric success metrics.
  • A creative, flexible mindset in creating custom multi-channel campaigns focused on solving client stated needs.
  • Strong problem solving skills - you’re someone who identifies a problem as an opportunity to develop business.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office Suite (specifically Excel and PowerPoint for data visualization). 
  • Must be self-motivated, self-disciplined, have a positive attitude and be an effective communicator.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Overview

Job Title: Director of SalesDepartment: SalesReporting To: SVP SalesEmployment Type: Full-TimeLocation: ChicagoWork Arrangement: On Site

 

Audacy Chicago is looking for a passionate and inspirational leader to join the Sales Management Team. This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished Sales Manager or Senior Account Executive who has management aspirations to move to the next level in a top market!

 

In this role, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate colleagues and with a high-achieving culture, committed to delivering results, marketing excellence and unwavering customer service. Best of all, you’ll receive best-in-class training, incentives and benefits from Audacy, a scaled, multi-platform audio content and entertainment organization with the country’s best radio broadcasting group. We are industry leaders in broadcasting, podcasting, digital, live experiences, and more!

 

The anticipated starting salary range for Illinois individuals expressing interest in this position is $250,000 - $290,000. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

The DOS will help influence the revenue growth of our highly influential radio and digital assets by increasing existing business and converting new business. You will also be responsible for pushing our over the air sales, podcast, streaming, digital, social, events and OTT sales forward.

  • Strong background in Strategic Account Management
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as Sales Manager, or Senior Account Executive with proven success in media, digital or multi-platform environment

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): St. Louis, M.O

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. Learn more at www.audacyinc.com and join the conversation on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Job Title: Integrated Sales Planner 

Department: Corporate, Ad Sales Marketing

Reporting To: Director; Regional Media Strategy & Integrated Sales Planning

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced media professional for a key role in a pre-sales department. The primary responsibilities of this role will be to provide strategic planning, pricing and inventory management. This position also provides support for sales teams incorporating all digital media tactics Audacy has to offer. The Audacy portfolio consists of streaming, podcast, social, video, OTT, search, display and more.

This role will work hand-in-hand with Audacy's Account Executives in designated markets to understand customer objectives and design programs that deliver results. Integrated Sales Planners are pillars to success; acting as internal and external product experts for all of our digital solutions.

Candidates should be proficient in strategy, media planning, and understand how to price media elements that maximize value and profit for the business’s needs while achieving the customer’s budget requirements. This role requires someone who can seamlessly interact cross-departmentally and with sellers and customers. This is a hybrid position however the ideal candidate would be based in the Eastern time zone.

  • Build strategic media plans to develop best-in-class campaigns leveraging any/all of Audacy's digital advertising portfolio.

  • Achieve a thorough understanding of internal systems so as to effectively and efficiently respond to sales requests in a timely fashion.

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Manager of Legal Operations & Strategic Projects to serve as the lead for strategic projects and manage workflows and documents across our legal department. This role will serve as the central driver for all legal department initiatives and projects, while maintaining a high standard for document organization, retrieval, and life-cycle contract management.

 

The ideal candidate brings a strong project management background (preferably within the legal and/or broadcast media landscape). You will keep key transactions and departmental projects running seamlessly, while maintaining effective contract management, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and driving strategic legal initiatives to support overall organizational growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Lead legal operations and  department initiatives and manage and execute legal department projects.
  • Lead project management for multi-faceted transactions (e.g., M&A and financings), including efficiently organizing complex contracts into virtual data rooms for internal and external stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional due diligence streams and responses to counterparty diligence requests, building and maintaining project management tools and trackers to monitor diligence requests and pre- and post-closing matters; maintaining closing conditions checklists, tracking corporate approvals (board resolutions, shareholder consents), overseeing legal document execution and escrow mechanics, securing third party consents, managing closing exchanges, and compiling closing binders. 
  • Function as the primary driver and manager of strategic projects at the request of attorneys and other internal business partners ensuring clear communication of tasks and setting and meeting deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert on document and storage management, contract retrieval, leveraging a strong understanding of contracts and key terms in order to accurately organize, classify, and audit documents for internal searchability. 
  • Manage administration of contract-related resources and collaboration tools, including but not limited to iManage, DocMinder, and physical files and related licenses.  
  • Draft agreements and notices using templates, as well as disclosure schedules for M&A transactions, in each case with attorney oversight.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

More About You:

Required & Preferred:

  • 5+ years of experience working directly with broadcast media and/or entertainment contracts (including talent agreements, vendor agreements, and transactional agreements such as purchase agreements) with a strong grasp of standard deal mechanics and terminology. 
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex transactions and projects, and building or maintaining contract databases and virtual data rooms for transactions and audits. 
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate, analyze, and synthesize disparate information gathered from cross-functional teams such as Finance, HR, IT, and Programming.
  • BA/BS from an accredited college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proficient in the Google, Microsoft, and Adobe suites, including building and maintaining project trackers.
  • Ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously and operate with limited supervision in a fast-paced, high-volume workplace.
  • Ability to work well with others in a collaborative environment. 
  • Exceptional initiative, judgment, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, analytical skills, and problem-solving ability.
  • High degree of discretion, professionalism, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Prior personnel management experience preferred.

Jess Dutra is leaving Baltimore and returning to the West Coast to be closer to family. So we’re looking for someone to join The Kramer Show to continue building our on-air and social media dominance.

A natural content creator who understands how to drive ratings, views, and engagement

Are comfortable being an open book and sharing everything about your life

Understand that content ideas come from anywhere and will actively bring ideas every day

Spend a lot of time on IG, TikTok, FB, and YouTube; and can create edit and post content effortlessly

Want to join a dominant morning show where you can learn, grow, and flourish

Are ready to make a life in the Baltimore area and central Maryland

The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist (Pipeline Posting)
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Dallas, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

job.title: National Digital Account Executive
job.description:
Overview

Looking for the country’s best collection of leading radio brands and premium, original broadcast, podcast, and digital content? It’s all here at Audacy. We’re a leading multi-platform audio content and entertainment company, and we’re unapologetic champions of audio – everywhere, on every device. The Enterprise Sales Team is a corporate sales team that partners with major national clients to develop, manage and grow revenue placed across our various Audacy platforms on a national scale.This team will consistently communicate Audacy’s full scope of marketing capabilities with frequent updates on new offerings and opportunities across all platforms.  We are industry experts on ad products and solutions, incorporating our vast portfolio of podcasts, events, digital, sports, music content and more! We are expanding our team! This is a high-velocity sales role requiring industry expertise, relationships and a proven ability for closing deals, and leading a team to exceed revenue targets.

The goal is to develop new dollars for Audacy and generate significant lift on existing business with the major Media Holding Companies. The anticipated starting salary range for NY, California, or Illinois based individuals expressing interest in this position is $125,000 - $150,000 plus eligible bonuses.

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick,vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

 

What You'll Do:

  • Responsible for meeting quarterly revenue targets, achieved by selling OTA, Podcasts, Audacy Digital, and Live Events to National Brands and Agencies. 
  • Create holistic solutions that position the Audacy brand across all platforms to create the most impact for the advertiser.
  • Own agency contact mapping, business reviews, education plans, and communication across US Agency/HCStructure and develop a strategic US Holding Company narrative to drive growth and adoption of Audacy's portfolio of solutions in the context of our holding company partnerships
  • Identify Holding Company initiatives and areas of focus that align with Audacy solutions to drive scalable innovation, data activation, insights, research and audio engagement
  • Be the primary liaison, internal advocate and thought leader representing Audacy with a specific focus on key C-Level relationships, in partnership with US sales leadership
  • With experience in understanding the value of audience data, both for brands and content creators, this role will be responsible for sourcing their own new business
  • Collaborate with the Data and Analytics team to inform new capabilities needed based on market feedback as well as to roll-out new features as they become available.
  • Report on revenue trends, spending patterns and new clients specific to our partner and report to global/regional/local sales.
  • Proactively identify realignment / corrective measures as needed
  • Plan, negotiate and close complex deals involving top level decision makers both within advertiser and agency organizations – meeting/ exceeding quarterly goals

Qualifications

More About You:

  • A min of 5 years of Brand Advertising, Media Planning and/or Brand development experience leading businesses or accounts  

  • Personal network in place with Senior Agency & Brand contacts across multiple agency groups 

  • Experience developing and executing multi-platform solutions across key business categories (podcast experience a plus)

  • Significant proven successful experience working in or with media & creative agencies

  • Proven track record of successfully growing revenue through the development of strategic relationships

  • Success opening new accounts and driving revenue growth across a broad spectrum of client categories

  • Strong understanding of performance based marketing & data driven sales with the ability to translate technical ideas into simple terms for stakeholders

  • Experience in working for matrix organizations work collaboratively to drive deliverable timelines from key internal cross-functional stakeholders

  • Passion for developing high-impact presentations and leading training programs for large audiences

  • Responsibility for creation and delivery of US holding company quarterly and annual business reviews 

  • Strong negotiation skills with proven success in closing business

  • Proven success in a highly dynamic, rapidly changing environment

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Part Time News Anchor

 

Department: News

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Hartford, CT

 

 Work Arrangement: On-site

 

Job Description:

 

WTIC Newstalk 1080 (Connecticut’s number one radio news operation) is looking for an experienced, energetic, enthusiastic and creative team player for an Part Time News Anchor/Writer position.

Extensive experience is not necessary, but this is not a training position. This position requires: anchoring top and bottom hour newscasts, operating the audio board, writing stories and updating our website.

Applicants must be good writers, have the ability to deliver news with an edge, quickly and concisely; have some experience with audio boards, an understanding of digital editing, good judgment, the ability to handle several tasks at a time, be a self-starter and possess a commitment to local news.

Must be 110% reliable and have a strong sense of responsibility.

There is no set shift for this position.

We are looking for someone with a real commitment to local news!!!

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

 

What You'll Do:

 

  • Anchor over the course of multiple hours on WTIC NewsTalk 1080 - including running a board
  • Conceptualize, pitch, produce and record news segments * Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news content inclusive of providing live coverage when breaking news occurs
  • Interview news makers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories 
  • Use social media - including but not limited to Facebook, Twitter and Instagram - during the course of your shift to connect with listeners, promote upcoming stories and interviews, and to highlight station content
  • Contribute content - including but not limited to audio, video and written format - to WTIC.com
  • Develop and research potential news stories
  • Protect the station’s FCC license
  • Other duties as required by management

 

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

 

  • You must be dependable, self-motivated and agreeable to a flexible work schedule, which may include early mornings, evenings, overnights and/or weekends.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, and candidates must be able to take a detail oriented approach to work while meeting tight deadlines.
  • You must have experience anchoring and writing news.
  • Experience in the Hartford market is a plus

KYW Newsradio, Philadelphia’s leading multimedia newsroom, is seeking an experienced, dynamic broadcast journalist to be a news anchor on a part-time basis. A qualified candidate must be news-savvy, full of fresh and relatable story ideas, willing to jump into the anchor chair at a moment’s notice, and available to work all dayparts, weekends, and holidays. She or he must be practiced and comfortable with conversational, compelling broadcast news writing and delivery. The ability to expertly ad-lib when the situation warrants is crucial.
