Overview

Job Title: On Air Host

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Houston is searching for an interactive, innovative, 3rd voice to add to its award winning morning show, Payne and Pendergast. This personality must be able to contribute daily to a live and local show by bringing engaging content, entertaining sports and lifestyle conversations, and outside the box ideas to connect with the Houston audience both on air and via digital platforms. Strong communication skills, an understanding of all relevant social media platforms, and a full, honest investment in Houston sports are vital for this position. This is a live and local position that requires the personality to be based in the Houston area. Previous on-air experience in a medium to large market is ideal, but not necessary --- most importantly, this position will require a talent with a proven ability to draw in and relate to a passionate and diverse audience.  

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

This position will also include, but not require or guarantee, additional opportunities and considerations for corporate podcasts, paid sales endorsements, and promotional appearances.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Create original content and develop daily conversations
  • Engage with audience on air, online and in person 
  • Collaborate with other hosts for preparation on a daily basis, develop original content for conversations, and lead the conversation in certain segments of each day’s show
  • Keep up with local and national sports stories, pop culture references, and general lifestyle topics
  • Respectfully and responsibly uphold the standards of our brand partnership with the Houston Texans both on-air and on social media
  • Protect the station’s FCC license in all on-air and digital programming
  • Participate in and develop original content for digital and social media platforms
  • Collaborate with Brand Manager and other employees to develop show benchmarks and participate in station-wide events and promotions

  • Make appearances to promote the station, show, and sponsors.
  • Travel to station and brand events and broadcasts when required, some of which include: Super Bowl Radio Row, the Army/Navy game, Houston Texans Training Camp, Houston Astros Spring Training, etc.
  • Ensure that promotions and contests are executed properly
  • Other duties as required by management

Required & Preferred:

  • 5+ years On Air experience preferred
  • Knowledge of the Houston market preferred
  • Solid audio collection skills and working knowledge of studio audio equipment, including digital systems such as Sound Forge, Audition, & Wide Orbit.
  • Proficiency in social media/digital content creation
  • Willingness and availability to make scheduled appearances for sales and promotional purposes
  • A coachable attitude… this position requires someone who is willing to work at their craft in order to be a valuable part of a winning team

job.title: Promotions Assistant
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Promotions Assistant

Department: Promotions

Reporting To: Promotions Director

Employment Type: Part-Time

Location(s): Denver

Work Arrangement: On-Site/Activation

 

Overview:

Audacy is looking for ambitious, energetic, and outgoing individuals to join our Promotions team! Are you interested in breaking into the broadcast industry? Audacy radio stations are hiring Promotion Representatives to help execute on-site activations at local venues and other events. Must be a "people person" that has a flexible schedule, is available nights and weekends, and is highly motivated, responsible, and friendly. Must be able to lift and carry equipment.

 

Stations You’ll Represent: Audacy Denver is home of Alice 105.9, KS 107.5, 99.5 The Mountain, Front Range 103.1 Country 103.1 & The BET 1430AM

 

The anticipated starting hourly rate for Denver-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $19.29/Hr..

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

  This is an evergreen posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a roster of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application.  

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Our Promotions team is responsible for spreading the word and passion for our stations and brands to the masses by taking to the street! You will assist with everything from in-office support such as preparing and executing on-air, online, and on-site contests, contacting winners, processing winner paperwork, andmore, to working live events, appearances, and remote broadcasts assisting with setup, teardown, on-site activations, audio/video equipment, driving station vehicles, and more!

We are looking for energetic, dependable, passionate, flexible team members who use sound judgement and have an outgoing personality that are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn, work hard, and have fun doing it!

If you love music, sports, entertainment, culture, and you have a knack for "figuring it" and "getting it done", we have a team ready to enhance and improve your skills while providing an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced industry.

The Promotions team is responsible for the following, including but not limited to:

● Execute on-site promotional events and coordinate/manage clients and listeners on-site.● Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required.

● Set up and run audio and other types of equipment during an event.● Hang banners and other staging elements at events.● Record events (ex. photos, videos, and audio) for purposes such as social media platforms and recap of the event.● Responsible for fulfilling winner release forms and other waivers when needed for an event.● Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles in a clean and neat manner● Check email; attend mandatory meetings on time; be able to work weekends, holidays, and blackout dates (specified by Promotions Director/Manager).● Must be available to work Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays● May need to work with little notice.● Work in a fast paced and upbeat environment

 

Qualifications

 

Required & Preferred:

 

Required:

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location(s): Los Angeles

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $18.42/Hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Los Angeles is looking for high energy individuals to join our team. This is a part-time, flex schedule position with a great organization that allows you to get your foot in the door in a fast-paced media company!

 

The Promotions Assistant position here in Los Angeles is unlike any other – this market allows the opportunity for a multitude of desired skill sets including in-field marketing, event production, live broadcast assistance, photography, videography, editing, social media coordination, office assistance and more. You may assist with the execution of station activations, set up and promote the station at the events, capture onsite content, and work with client sponsors. You regularly interact with our passionate listeners to create a positive station image, give away merchandise and execute station activations. 

You are the face of the station!

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Support in-field marketing and event production, assisting with the execution of station activations and live broadcasts.
  • Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required, ensuring all staging elements like banners are displayed effectively.
  • Capture and edit onsite content through photography and videography to promote events on social media.
  • Coordinate social media content to enhance the station’s visibility and engagement during events.
  • Engage with listeners and client sponsors on-site to build a positive station image, distribute merchandise, and foster memorable event experiences.
  • Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles, ensuring they are clean, organized, and ready for each event.
  • Provide office assistance as needed, supporting the promotions team with administrative and logistical tasks.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 0 to 2 years experience; must be 21 years of age or older.
  • High School Diploma or GED, preferred. 
  • Previous experience in event promotions, marketing, or customer service is preferred but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage with listeners and create a positive, energetic atmosphere at events.
  • Basic skills in photography, videography, and content editing for social media are a plus.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) and ability to assist in coordinating event content.
  • Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed for events.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional demeanor, positive attitude and team player! Comfortable working with clients, listeners, and station staff to represent the brand positively.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Overview

Job Title: Promotions Assistant 

 

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting To: Promotions Director

 

Employment Type:    Part-Time

 

Location(s):  Richmond, VA

Work Arrangement: On-Site/Activation

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Richmond is looking for ambitious, energetic, and outgoing individuals to join our Promotions team! 

 

This is a part-time, flex schedule position with a great organization that allows you to get your foot in the door in a fast-paced, industry-leading, media company. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team position is unlike any other – this market allows the opportunity to both showcase and enhance a multitude of desired skill sets including in-field marketing, event production, live broadcast assistance, photography, videography, editing, social media coordination, office assistance and more. You'll be the face, heart, and soul of four powerful brands serving at the forefront of listener interactions, concerts, sport and lifestyle events, and much more.

 

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for Richmond-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $15.00/Hr..

 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

 

What You'll Do:

 

Our Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for spreading the word and passion for our stations and brands to the masses by taking to the street! You will assist with everything from in-office support such as preparing and executing on-air, online, and on-site contests, contacting winners, processing winner paperwork, and more, to working live events, appearances, and remote broadcasts assisting with setup, teardown, on-site activations, audio/video equipment, driving station vehicles, and more! We are looking for energetic, dependable, flexible team members who use sound judgment and have an outgoing personality that are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn, work hard, and have fun doing it! If you love music, sports, entertainment, culture, and you have a knack for "figuring it" and "getting it done", we have a team ready to enhance and improve your skills while providing an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced industry. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for the following, including but not limited to: 

  • Execute on-site promotional events and coordinate/manage clients and listeners on-site.
  • Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required.
  • Set up and run audio and other types of equipment during an event.
  • Hang banners and other staging elements at events.
  • Record events (ex. photos, videos, and audio) for purposes such as social media platforms and

recap of the event.

  • Responsible for fulfilling winner release forms and other waivers when needed for an event.
  • Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles in a clean and neat manner;
  • Check email daily; attend mandatory meetings on time; be able to work weekends, holidays, and

blackout dates (specified by Promotions Director/Manager).

  • Must be available to work Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays
  • May need to work with little notice.
  • Must be 18 or older.

 

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

 

Required:

  • A positive attitude, and willingness to be a team player.
  • A valid driver's license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance is required.
  • Ability to drive company vehicles to and from events.
  • Ability to lift and/or carry equipment.
  • Professional appearance and punctuality.
  • Reliable and dependable mode of transportation.
  • High School Diploma or GED.

 

Preferred:

 

  • Experience using Google Workspaces (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, etc.) is a plus
  • Knowledge of promotions software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting),
  • Aptivada (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and PromoSuite (promotion management software) a plus.
  • Experience working with the general public is preferred.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs and/or ladders; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk, hear or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Promotions Manager

 

Audacy is seeking an organized, detail oriented and outgoing professional to support our Marketing and Promotions team in event management, promotions, and integrated marketing in the Central Region, with a focus on Chicago. Events include entertainment, music, sports, lifestyle and spoken word formats.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

Marketing and Promotions:

  • Act as lead Marketing and Promotions Contacts for Chicago Stations.
  • Execution of contesting for stations in Chicago on air, online, via text and on site.
  • Manage prizing and winner fulfillment process
  • Write and post online material terms for station contests, and manage station promotions
  • Work with Regional Marketing Directors and corporate legal department to ensure contest and department compliance including but not limited to posting contest rules, material terms, maintaining contest files, and promotional agreements within company policy
  • Coordinate with Sales, Programming, and third-party partners on prize and promotion details
  • Listener relations, such as answering emails, phone calls, following up with winners for prize fulfillment, and collecting/processing necessary paperwork
  • Work closely with Regional Marketing Directors and Brand Managers to ensure stations positioning/branding is reflected in all marketing, imaging, promotions & digital media
  • Manage social media copy, & graphic design for Promotional Opportunities on all stations in Chicago as needed
  • Assist with recaps for corporate promotional initiatives for Chicago
  • Attend major station events 
  • Act as liaison and lead between promotional partners and vendors
  • Other marketing/promotional dept. duties as assigned

 

Sales Marketing Support:

  • Attend sales and/or promotion meetings as well as other station meetings as needed

 

More About You:

 

Skills/Attributes

  • First-rate organizational skills are a must to succeed in this position
  • Demonstrated oral and written communication skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and multi-task
  • Experience using Microsoft® Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • Experience in Event Management in sports, entertainment, lifestyle or news formats
  •  Knowledge of promotion software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting),Audience (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and SPARC (promotion management software)
  • Occasional night or weekend work

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • Five years' experience executing marketing/promotions campaigns, event management, and activation
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or Communications preferred and/or equivalent experience and training

Job Title: Promotions Tech

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting to: Regional Promotions Director

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Location(s): Buffalo, NY

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site (Office and Remote Locations)

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Buffalo seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:
  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Qualifications:
  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

 

 

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.title: Regional Digital Account Executive
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Regional Digital Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting to: Regional Vice President

 

Employment Type: Full Time

 

Locations:   Philadelphia, PA

 

Work Arrangement:  Onsite/Hybrid

 

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a dynamic Regional Digital Account Executive to drive revenue growth through the strategic sale and implementation of our comprehensive digital portfolio. This consultative role is for a digital professional with a proven track record in revenue generation, who can act as a trusted media partner to help businesses achieve their marketing objectives and revenue goals. You will architect complete digital ecosystems for high-value clients and collaborate with local and regional decision makers.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

 

  • Business Development/Digital Solutions: Proactively prospect and develop new business by using our full suite of advertising and marketing assets, focusing on digital solutions.
  • Be a Client Catalyst: Dive deep into local, regional, and national businesses' goals, crafting digital solutions that drive their success through customized, full-funnel marketing campaigns incorporating Search, OTT/Video, Display, Digital Audio, and Social Media.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Close business and maintain advertiser relationships, partnering with our operations team to ensure campaigns exceed client expectations.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide exceptional customer service and continuously build your knowledge of industry trends, opportunities, and innovations while adhering to all company policies, procedures and ethics codes.

Qualifications

Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).

Overview

Job Title: Search Engine Marketing Account Manager

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: SEM Product Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Any of Audacy's 48 markets

 

Work Arrangement: Remote

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $55,000.00/Yr. - $65,000/Yr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Overview:

 

The Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager, reporting to the SEM Product Manager, is an integral member of Audacy’s centralized Revenue Operations Search team. This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

 

This position is eligible for remote work in any of Audacy’s 48 markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Use forecasting and research tools to provide sales teams with accurate estimates of campaign potential for prospective clients
  • Build and launch Google Ads campaigns, including campaign structures, keyword strategies, ad copy, targeting, budgets and supporting assets
  • Complete required pre-launch and post-launch quality checks to ensure campaigns are accurate and aligned with approved strategies
  • Proactively monitor and optimize campaigns using performance data, industry standards and established Audacy SEM best practices

Overview

 

Job Title: Social Media Producer/ Graphic Designer

 

Department: Digital 

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location: Las Vegas, NV

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

 

Tired of the LA hustle? Thinking about moving to Las Vegas? You'll be in good company—plenty of Californians have already made the move. If you're looking for a fresh start and a great career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!  

We are seeking a creative, high-energy, and multi-talented Social Media Producer & Graphic Designer to join our media team. This dual-focused role is perfect for a digital storyteller who can seamlessly blend community management with striking visual design.

In this role, you will be the creative force behind five of our distinct radio station brands, driving audience engagement through dynamic social content (video, graphics and written content). Additionally, you will serve as the go-to visual designer for our digital sales team, crafting high-impact marketing collateral, client pitch decks, and digital advertisements that drive revenue.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

Social Media Producer & Content Creation (Approx. 60%)

  • Multi-Account Management: Oversee, curate, and maintain the daily social media presence across multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, etc.) for five unique radio station brands.
  • Content Production: Concept, shoot, edit, and publish high-performing multimedia content, with a heavy emphasis on short-form video (Reels, TikToks), on-air talent features, station events, and pop-culture trends.
  • Brand Voice & Engagement: Maintain the distinct personality and voice of each station while actively engaging with followers, listeners, and influencers to build community.
  • Analytics & Growth: Track performance metrics across all platforms, adjusting strategies based on data to optimize reach, engagement, and follower growth.

Graphic Design & Sales Support (Approx. 40%)

  • Digital Sales Collateral: Partner with the digital sales team to design compelling media kits, client pitch decks, and sponsorship presentations.
  • Ad & Event Creative: Create eye-catching digital display ads, website banners, concert/event flyers, and promotional graphics for station clients and internal marketing campaigns.
  • Brand Consistency: Ensure all visual assets comply with individual station brand guidelines while pushing the creative envelope.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Experience: 2–4 years of professional experience managing social media accounts and designing assets, preferably within a media, entertainment, or agency environment.
  • Design Tools: Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro/After Effects) and/or Canva.
  • Video Savvy: Strong mobile video shooting and editing skills (using CapCut, Premiere, or in-app tools) tailored for Reels and TikTok.
  • Chameleon-Like Creativity: Ability to switch gears quickly between a New/Talk station’s informational aesthetic, a pop station’s high-energy vibe, and a polished corporate sales deck.
  • Organization: Exceptional time-management skills to juggle the demands of 5 distinct social brands alongside incoming sales team requests.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.  
  • Generator testing, fueling and supervision of Generator maintenance.
  • UPS testing and supervision of maintenance.
  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years broadcast engineering experience.
  • Associate’s degree in electronics preferred.
  • IT networking skills preferred.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to provide support 24/7 in case of equipment failure; available to work various hours/days, including weekends and holidays.
  • FCC General Class License or SBE Certifications are a plus.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.
  • Strong verbal and writing communications skills.

Overview

Job Title: Strategic Finance & FP&A Manager

Department: Corporate Finance 

Reporting To: Senior Vice President, Strategic Finance and FP&A 

Employment Type: Full-Time 

Location: Hybrid in New York City 

 

The anticipated salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $120,000.00/Yr. - $130,000.00/Yr. and is bonus eligible.

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Role Overview:

Audacy is seeking a high-performing Manager, Strategic Finance & FP&A to drive the financial planning and operational analysis for our Podcasting division while providing corporate finance support at the total-company level.

This role partners closely with the SVP of Strategic Finance, providing hands-on execution support across both podcasting business partnering and corporate finance deliverables. You will bridge the gap between financial analysis and business strategy—translating operational metrics into actionable insights for podcast leadership while supporting enterprise-level executive reporting.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Podcasting Business Partnering & Operational FP&A:

  • Executive Business Partnering: Act as a trusted financial partner to Podcasting leadership, Content Development, and Sales Ops, translating operational drivers into financial strategies to maximize division profitability.
  • Business Unit Reporting: Lead the monthly reporting package for the Podcasting division, delivering variance analysis, KPI performance tracking, and operational commentary to podcast leadership. 
  • P&L & Forecast Ownership: Lead monthly rolling forecasting, annual budgeting, and financial performance tracking for the podcasting business unit.
  • Deal Strategy & Commercial Support: Model investment ROI and commercial deal structures for new talent acquisitions, show renewals, and strategic content partnerships.
  • Monetization & Yield Optimization: Partner with ad sales and operations to track yield, inventory utilization, CPM trends, and cost-to-serve dynamics.
  • Financial Operations Oversight: Oversee high-level show financial workflows, ensuring seamless alignment between content operations, vendor invoice processing, and creator payout compliance.

 

Total-Company Strategic Finance:

  • Senior Leadership, Executive & Board Packages: Support preparation of monthly executive reporting packs and quarterly operating reviews; assist in building Board of Directors (BOD) presentation materials.
  • Enterprise Long-Range Planning: Support multi-year 3-statement modeling and the company's long-range planning process.
  • Ad-Hoc Strategic Analysis: Support ad-hoc financial analysis for executive decision-making, including partnership evaluations and cost-efficiency initiatives (with occasional exposure to M&A or strategic transaction analysis as needed).
  • Process & Tool Modernization: Partner across departments to simplify financial consolidation, automate reporting workflows, and enhance business intelligence tools.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting.
  • Industry Exposure: Exposure to Digital Media, Podcasting, Audio, Entertainment, or Advertising Technology preferred, but not required.
  • Business Partnering: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with cross-functional partners outside of finance (Sales, Content, Product, Ops).
  • Financial Modeling: Strong 3-statement modeling skills, scenario planning, and commercial deal evaluation.
  • Executive Communication: Ability to package complex quantitative data into clean visual slides and summaries for executive review.
  • Systems & Tools: Proficiency with core financial tools (advanced Excel required; working experience with NetSuite or Tableau is a plus).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

job.title: Associate Director, Event Production
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Live transforms award-winning journalism into dynamic live events—offering editorial experiences that spark smart conversations across politics, business, technology, health, and more. We are hiring an Associate Director of Production to manage the technical execution, budget management, and vendor oversight for in-person and virtual events, helping scale Axios Live into its next phase of editorial and experiential growth.

Why It Matters: This isn’t just about running events—it’s about making them work flawlessly. You will serve as the technical lead for some of Axios’s most visible moments, from live-streamed policy interviews to international stage productions. As a strategic and hands-on executor, you'll ensure each event reflects Axios's high standards for editorial integrity, production value, and audience experience.

The details:

Technical Execution & Production Oversight

  • Manage the technical production of Axios Live events, including A/V systems, staging, lighting, livestreaming, video playback, and on-site recording for our large-scale event productions.
  • Serve as stage manager and show-caller, managing real-time production cues, backstage operations, and talent movement
  • Oversee A/V production vendors, including sourcing, scoping, budgeting, contracting, and on-site management
  • Coordinate site-specific tech builds, rehearsals, and contingency plans for both in-person and virtual platforms (e.g. Zoom, Vimeo, custom integrations)

Manage post-production editing workflows, including rapid content clipping in Adobe Premiere Pro and video asset delivery to marketing/editorial teams

Production & Budget Management

  • Own end-to-end production timelines, task tracking, and staffing schedules for simultaneous events
  • Manage event production budgets at the line-item level—tracking vendor estimates, spend actuals, and reconciliations with minimal supervision
  • Negotiate cost-effective solutions with vendors while ensuring Axios’s production standards are met or exceeded

Maintain internal tools and documentation for production planning, budget tracking, vendor database and show files (e.g. run-of-show, call sheets, tech specs)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Collaborate with editorial, creative, and design teams to bring branded experiences to life across Axios IP and custom event formats
  • Act as a technical advisor to internal stakeholders on what’s possible (or not), offering solutions grounded in experience and vendor capabilities
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to associates and freelance contractors, helping build a strong, technically savvy team culture

Support new production innovation by identifying technical opportunities to improve quality, reduce risk, or scale event offerings

What You’ll Bring: You are a technical producer with creative instincts, leadership skills, and a command of live event dynamics. You have:

  • 5–7 years of experience in high-volume event production, including technical design, A/V execution, and budget management
  • Deep understanding of A/V production workflows, including livestreaming, broadcast systems, LED, comms, rigging, and event safety
  • Demonstrated success managing production budgets line by line, including vendor estimates, POs, and invoice reconciliation
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with A/V and production vendors, including onsite teams
  • High proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects and Photoshop is a plus. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior executives and high-profile participants
  • Ability to manage fast paced, quick communication work flows with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience managing open-press or public-facing events under tight timelines
  • Calm, adaptable, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • Familiarity with project management software (e.g. Wrike, Airtable) is a plus
  • Willingness to travel regularly and work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when required

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $98,000 - $130,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

job.title: Director of Editorial, Axios Live
job.description:
1 big thing: The Director of Editorial, Axios Live will oversee editorial content, event framing, and strategic list building for Axios Live programming, leading a small team to ensure Axios’ editorial standards, Smart Brevity style, and journalistic integrity are upheld across all public-facing materials, roundtable discussions, and editorial products, including recap articles. 

Why it matters: As Axios Live expands across live convenings and executive roundtables, this role serves as the crucial editorial compass. You will be a high-caliber editorial leader and manager who applies sharp news judgment to shape timely event concepts, curate high-level editorial rooms, take an active role in real-time coverage of Axios’ biggest live event moments, and deliver post-event recaps that read as sharp journalism.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after convenings in business, policy, and technology. Reporting to the Head of Editorial Live, the Editorial Director will ensure that our events portfolio reflects our editorial standards, diverse points of view, and help Axios stay at the forefront of news.

In this role, you will:

  • Oversee the drafting, editing, and approval of public-facing live event materials, including event concepts, registration pages, Axios webpages, social coverage, and post-event recap articles using Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Oversee the curation and tiering of editorial participants for Axios Roundtables. Ensure tables feature balanced, expert perspectives across sectors while maintaining editorial control over seating charts and participant mix.
  • Lead, coach, and manage a small, high-performing team of editorial writers and coordinators; set clear priorities, assign events, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Manage coverage assignments and collaboration with the newsroom around covering some of Axios Live’s biggest stages including our Summit and House products. 
  • Own day-of editorial coverage for assigned live events, serving as the primary liaison to reporters and the newsroom, coordinating quick-turn coverage, leading live social reporting, and writing post-event recaps.
  • Work in close alignment with the Head of Editorial Live, newsroom SMEs/reporters, events operations, pre-sale, sales, and client leads to ensure seamless event execution and brand alignment.
  • Manage real-time editorial flow during live events, brief moderators, ensure all event materials are easily/immediately accessible for breaking news moments, and resolve and be the lead voice of editorial judgement for live editorial issues on the ground.
  • Guide the team in utilizing approved AI tools and custom GPTs to streamline initial research, concept brainstorming, and list discovery while rigorously enforcing accuracy and Smart Brevity standards.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, possess exceptional news judgment, and bring the following skills:

  • 6–8+ years of journalism, editorial editing, live-event content creation, or public policy/media experience, ideally within a fast-paced newsroom or live news setting.
  • Proven people management experience, with a track record of coaching editorial team members and reviewing high-volume written deliverables under tight deadlines.
  • Sharp editorial and news judgment, with a deep understanding of policy, business, and tech trends, alongside a strong command of Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Demonstrated expertise in room curation and list strategy, with an understanding of how to build senior, balanced executive tables (C-suite, policymakers, operators, subject-matter experts).
  • Experience navigating commercial/client partnerships while maintaining editorial independence, neutrality, and journalistic red lines.
  • Exceptional writing, line-editing, and copy-editing skills, with the ability to develop sharp, audience-facing event concepts and language, distill complex ideas into clear editorial framing, and produce concise, high-value recap articles.
  • High operational rigor to manage overlapping deadlines across event concept pipelines, guest lists, seating charts, and post-event publications.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and editing tools, balancing efficiency with journalistic verification.
  • Ability to travel for major Axios Live events and activations as needed.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $110,000 - $130,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match

job.title: Director, Editorial Booking
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Director of Editorial Booking to lead editorial booking for Axios Live’s most high-profile events.

Why it matters: Axios Live stages are where leaders come to make news. Reporting to the Managing Editor of Axios Live, the Director, Editorial Booking will serve as a senior editorial representative working alongside the Managing Editor to book top-tier newsmakers, move quickly in breaking news moments, and ensure every conversation meets Axios’ editorial standards.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after platforms for newsmakers. We’re looking for a seasoned editorial leader to own booking strategy for events that represent Axios to today’s key influencers, and lead editorial booking across Smart Brevity programming around the world. This role plays a critical leadership function across Axios Live programming and will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor the associate director, setting clear expectations, workflows, and performance standards across Axios Live programming.
  • Collaborate with the managing director on editorial booking strategy for Axios Live’s portfolio of annual summits and franchise events, including flagship properties such as the Future of Health Summit.
  • Serve as a key talent manager across Axios Live, building trusted relationships with both external newsmakers and Axios newsroom talent to strengthen bookings, cultivate on-stage talent, and ensure reporters and leaders are thoughtfully deployed across live programming.
  • Work on editorial booking for Axios House and other Axios Live products at major global tentpoles, including Climate Week/UNGA, and other similar high-profile moments.
  • Secure senior newsmakers — including CEOs, elected officials, administration leaders, and global decision-makers — while delegating and guiding bookings across the team.
  • Serve as a liaison between Axios Live, the Axios newsroom, and Axios leadership to align booking priorities and programming strategy.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment in fast-moving news environments, including making real-time decisions to pivot talent, framing, or programming in response to breaking news.
  • Ensure Axios Live programming meets Axios’ editorial standards, reflects diverse and compelling perspectives, and maintains editorial independence.
  • Oversee editorial preparation for live events, including interview prep, run-of-show development, scripts, stage cues, and briefing materials.
  • Guide collaboration on event language and marketing materials, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and Smart Brevity principles across platforms.
  • Provide guidance to senior newsroom leadership during live events, ensuring the team is coordinated, materials are accessible, and programming remains responsive to news developments.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with principals, chiefs of staff, communications teams, and senior influencers to support both immediate bookings and long-term Axios Live growth
  • Travel regularly to Axios Live events across the U.S. and internationally, providing on-site editorial leadership and supporting programming execution at major summits, franchise events, and global tentpoles.
  • Leverage AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency across research, booking, and production workflows, and to help scale best practices across the booking team.

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for a senior editorial leader who brings sound judgment, strong relationships, and a collaborative management style. Ideal candidates will have: 

  • 5+ years of editorial booking or media experience, with demonstrated experience leading or mentoring other bookers or producers.
  • A proven track record of owning booking strategy for large-scale editorial events, including recurring summits or franchise programming.
  • Experience booking and working with high-profile leaders, including senior executives, policymakers, and global influencers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear editorial guidance and feedback.
  • Deep knowledge of the news cycle and emerging trends across politics, business, and technology.
  • Experience building full show programs, from concept through execution.
  • Strong organizational and people-management skills, with the ability to balance coaching, delegation, and execution.
  • Familiarity with Axios’ Smart Brevity style and editorial values.
  • Bonus points for experience or established networks in:
  • Health care and life sciences
  • Energy, climate, or sustainability
  • Defense, national security, or geopolitics
  • Media, technology, or communications
  • Background in media, Capitol Hill, government, or political campaigns is a plus.

This is a highly visible growth role focused on scaling Axios’s flagship national newsletters while helping build and validate a new SME audience acquisition strategy.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who pairs strong product-engineering fundamentals with modern AI-native development practices to build and scale the systems and experiences that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver clear, trustworthy, and informative news to millions of readers every day. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll build the interfaces, services, APIs, and data flows behind our audience-facing products and publishing tools. 

AI has become a core part of how we build software. You’ll use coding agents and other AI tools throughout the development lifecycle—from understanding problems and exploring solutions through implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operation. You’ll remain accountable for the architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes of everything you ship.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll deliver high-quality, reliable product features across Axios’ frontend and backend systems, using modern agentic development practices to accelerate delivery and ensuring performance and stability across our publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • End-to-end feature development: Own features across the frontend, APIs, business logic, data layer, testing, and production systems. Turn product problems into clear technical plans and reviewable units of work, using AI agents thoughtfully across research, prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Frontend development: Create accessible, responsive, and maintainable interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Backend and API development: Build production services and APIs that support Axios’ products and publishing workflows, and create clear contracts that can be understood and used reliably by people, applications, and AI-powered tools.
  • AI-enabled product development: Identify opportunities where models, agents, retrieval, or intelligent automation can create meaningful value for readers or internal teams. Build those capabilities with clear user controls, measurable behavior, appropriate guardrails, and an understanding of when conventional software is the better solution.
  • Quality and reliability: Write automated tests, improve performance, and contribute to logging, metrics, tracing, security, and operational reliability.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product, design, quality engineering, and other developers to clarify requirements, explain tradeoffs, and deliver effectively. Participate in code reviews, pairing, onboarding, and mentorship.
  • Product and technical improvement: Understand how technical work supports readers, editorial workflows, and business goals.Improve existing systems through thoughtful refactoring, sound technical decisions, and practical experimentation with emerging engineering approaches.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about user experience, reliability, scalability, and maintainable code—and who has moved beyond occasional AI assistance to using agents as a substantive part of their engineering practice. You should have:

  • Experience: 2-5+ years of professional software development experience, with production experience in frontend, backend, or full-stack development and the ability to contribute across the stack.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria, provide relevant context, break work into appropriately scoped tasks, decide what to delegate, and guide an agent when its initial approach is incomplete or incorrect.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions against the actual system, identify security and maintainability risks, and recognize when an agent-produced solution is plausible but wrong. You understand that AI increases the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js or a comparable modern framework.
  • Backend development: Experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems primarily use Go and Python, and you should be comfortable working in or learning either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with unit and integration testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and common web security practices.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to own scoped work, make sound tradeoffs, navigate ambiguity, and connect technical decisions to product and business goals. You can evaluate when an AI-assisted or AI-enabled approach creates real leverage and when a straightforward deterministic solution is more appropriate.
  • Communication: Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about rapidly changing models, tools, and development practices, paired with an evidence-based approach to evaluating them. You share what works, identify what does not, and help the team improve its practices over time.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Production experience with Go or Python.
  • Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, generated clients, or service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, orchestration, or CI/CD.
  • Experience with caching, background jobs, queues, or asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Experience operating production systems with observability, performance optimization or benchmarking, or accessibility testing.

What success looks like:

  • Valuable, accelerated delivery: You ship useful features from concept through production and use AI to shorten research, implementation, and feedback cycles without creating avoidable rework.
  • Sound AI leverage: You delegate meaningful work to agents, give them the context and constraints needed to succeed, and verify their output before it reaches users. You know when AI adds value and when it introduces unnecessary complexity.
  • Quality and reliability: Your work is maintainable, well-tested, secure, accessible, observable, and dependable.
  • Product impact: You make technical decisions that support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals.
  • Team and system improvement: You contribute to a stronger team through collaboration, code reviews, pairing, mentorship, and thoughtful improvements to existing systems. You leave behind better documentation, tests, context, tools, and development patterns that make future work easier for both people and agents.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $130,000 - $165,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer—a senior, hands-on individual contributor—to lead architecture and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams using strong product-engineering and AI-native practices.

Why it matters: Axios delivers clear, trustworthy news to millions of readers. You’ll be anchored to a product area while shaping full-stack systems and technical direction across multiple teams and connected systems. This is not a people-management role.

AI is core to how we build. You’ll use coding agents throughout implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operations while remaining accountable for architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes. Staff impact comes from sustained scope, judgment, and results—not tool use alone.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, engineers, and leaders to shape plans, align dependencies, resolve ambiguity, build resilient systems, and help others make better technical decisions.

Responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll lead reliable product and platform work across Axios’ frontend and backend systems. You’ll remain hands-on while driving multi-quarter initiatives, improving technical coherence, and using agentic practices to accelerate delivery. Key responsibilities include:

  • Cross-team technical leadership: Lead mission-critical or high-risk initiatives spanning teams and connected systems. Frame problems, align ownership and dependencies, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive production adoption.
  • Architecture and design: Own architecture for a product area and scalable boundaries across frontend, APIs, data, and production systems. Lead design reviews and establish standards within your sphere of influence.
  • Hands-on system ownership: Own the technical direction and long-term evolution of key systems while writing and reviewing code, prototyping, debugging, leading migrations, and operating services in production.
  • AI-enabled product and engineering: Identify where models, agents, retrieval, or automation create value. Build reusable capabilities with measurable behavior, guardrails, and judgment about when conventional software is better.
  • Quality, reliability, and incident leadership: Improve testing, performance, observability, security, and operational readiness. Anticipate systemic risks, address technical debt, and help lead resolution and learning during critical production issues.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers across teams, spread systems thinking and design patterns, and build alignment through proposals, reviews, and influence without authority.
  • Product and technical strategy: Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape the product-area roadmap, align dependencies, and connect technical investment to reader, editorial, and business outcomes.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a staff-level engineer with sustained multi-team impact, deep expertise in a relevant domain, broad systems thinking, and a commitment to user experience, reliability, scalability, maintainable code, and effective AI-enabled practice. You should have:

  • Experience: Typically 7+ years in professional software development, or equivalent sustained Staff-level impact, including leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear strategies, specifications, and acceptance criteria; provide context; scope complex work; decide what to delegate; and redirect incomplete or incorrect approaches.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions, identify security, scalability, and maintainability risks, and catch plausible but wrong solutions. You understand that AI raises the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Hands-on experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js, plus judgment to guide frontend architecture across teams.
  • Backend development: Hands-on experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems use Go and Python, and you should be able to shape reliable service boundaries and work effectively in or learn either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and web security practices, plus the ability to raise standards across teams.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify high-leverage problems, align teams, make sound tradeoffs, and connect decisions to product and business goals—including when AI is not the right tool.
  • Communication: Ability to build alignment through clear proposals and reasoning, communicate risks and tradeoffs across functions, and drive clarity during disagreement.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about changing models, tools, and practices, paired with an evidence-based approach. You share useful patterns, identify what fails, and make others more effective.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Led a multi-team architecture, platform, migration, or modernization initiative from problem framing through production adoption.
  • Owned critical systems through incidents, scaling challenges, and long-term architectural evolution.
  • Drove adoption of technical standards, reusable tools, or platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Mentored experienced engineers and helped improve technical judgment beyond your immediate team.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Production experience with Go or Python and distributed systems using gRPC, cloud infrastructure, containers, queues, CI/CD, or similar technologies.

What success looks like:

  • Cross-team delivery: You drive multi-quarter initiatives from problem framing through production adoption, aligning dependencies and ownership to produce durable outcomes.
  • Engineering leverage: Teams deliver more effectively because of the standards, tools, architecture, documentation, and context you create. You establish safe, repeatable AI patterns where they add value.
  • System health: Key systems become more reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and easier to change. You reduce systemic risk and improve incident prevention and response.
  • Product-area impact: Your decisions support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals within the teams and systems you influence.
  • Organizational technical leadership: Engineers across teams make better decisions through your mentorship, proposals, reviews, and example. You remain a hands-on IC who multiplies others’ effectiveness.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $165,000 - $215,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency.
