Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-10-12 11:59 PM

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you’ll have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You’ll have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We’re an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant, and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy, high-performing teams. When you join our mission, you’re not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country. We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms; this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.


This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why This Role Matters

 

You will be a core member of our software development team. Working closely with product managers and developers, your mission is to champion product quality from day one by embedding a shift-left testing strategy.

 

Rather than testing only at the end of the release pipeline, you will collaborate from the initial requirements and design phases to prevent defects, establish clear acceptance criteria and help shape our test architecture. You will drive comprehensive testing strategies — spanning automated, exploratory and regression testing — to ensure smooth, frequent and reliable releases while advancing adherence to quality standards and industry best practices.

 

Our team is responsible for the OHdio ecosystem, Radio-Canada’s flagship French-language audio platform. By joining this cross-platform initiative (covering iOS and Android mobile apps, web, connected car systems like CarPlay and Android Auto, and smart devices), you will directly impact the daily listening experience of hundreds of thousands of users. From live radio streams and original podcasts to audiobooks and curated playlists, you will ensure continuous stability, high performance and top-tier quality for a premier digital product.

 

Our Evolving Quality Culture

 

The OHdio team is actively transitioning to an integrated quality engineering culture. You won't be stepping into a rigid, pre-established framework; you will play a hands-on role in building it. You will help drive our shift-left practices, structure our automated testing stack (Playwright, Appium, TestRail) and define the engineering standards that will guide our team for years to come. If you want to make a lasting impact on how we build and ship digital products, this role is for you.


Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Actively participate in design sessions to identify acceptance criteria, edge cases, risks and functional ambiguities before development begins.
  • Act as a quality gatekeeper to ensure features meet all readiness criteria before entering the development workflow.
  • Draft and maintain structured test cases (BDD/steps) in TestRail, prioritizing them as the product evolves.
  • Define feature-level test strategies alongside developers, determining the appropriate test types (unit, integration, snapshot, E2E, manual) across each layer.
  • Identify and prepare necessary test data for validation.
  • Collaborate with developers during sprints to clarify acceptance criteria and resolve ambiguous technical behaviours.
  • Perform incremental validations throughout the sprint to catch defects early.
  • Document defects with clear, reproducible steps so developers can act on them immediately without back-and-forth.
  • Help build, expand and maintain our automated test suite in collaboration with developers.
  • Actively participate in the release management process.
  • Track and analyze quality KPIs (defect discovery stages, reopen rates, automation coverage, etc.) to drive data-informed retrospectives.
  • Share best practices with other QAAs to maintain consistent approaches across projects.
  • Empower all team members to work autonomously and take ownership of quality.

 

What You Bring

  • College diploma or university degree, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working on complex web and mobile application development projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with shift-left QA practices (e.g., drafting acceptance criteria and test cases prior to development).
  • Deep understanding of application life cycles across iOS, Android and web environments.
  • Solid grasp of test pyramid concepts (unit, integration, snapshot, E2E, smoke and regression testing).
  • Experience writing BDD test scenarios (Gherkin syntax) in TestRail.
  • Proficiency with API testing and payload validation tools (Postman, Playwright API or equivalent).
  • Ability to interpret CI/CD build results and diagnose pipeline failures.
  • Experience conducting structured exploratory testing.
  • Confidence in making data-driven go/no-go release decisions.
  • Strong collaborative approach when working alongside developers and product owners.
  • A proactive mindset with a knack for asking the right questions to resolve ambiguities before they turn into defects.
  • High attention to detail and self-direction skills.
  • Experience working within Agile environments.
  • Fluency in French (required).
  • Working knowledge of spoken and written English an asset.
  • Experience with mobile E2E automation frameworks (Appium, Detox or equivalent) an asset.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools (Copilot, MCP TestRail, agentic AI) an asset.
  • Proficiency with browser diagnostic tools (Chrome DevTools) an asset.
  • Understanding of digital accessibility standards (A11Y) an asset.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting role but a long-term opportunity with competitive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

This is a one-year temporary position.


Your Role


We are seeking a Resource Specialist to join our team at the new Radio-Canada newsroom in Alberta.


In this role, you will plan and organize the technical resources required for content production, ensuring full alignment with programming schedules and operational requirements. Your primary goal will be to ensure that all resources are used efficiently and cost-effectively.


You will forecast, select, organize and assign the personnel, facilities and equipment needed to produce programs or program segments. This includes managing logistical planning across pre-production, production and post-production phases while meeting cross-platform formatting and delivery requirements. Although general direction will be provided, this role requires strong independent judgment and initiative. You will juggle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced production environment, delivering under tight deadlines across digital, radio and television. As a key player in all live and taped broadcasts, you will rely on tact and diplomacy to reconcile stakeholder demands.


Key Tasks:

  • Collaborate with senior managers, producers, department heads and technical producers on short- and long-term production planning, actively participating in planning meetings and addressing special requests.
  • Leverage specialized knowledge and experience to recommend cost-saving measures and operational efficiencies.
  • Address resource conflicts to ensure all productions have the required facilities, equipment and support services.
  • Maintain oversight of all production activities and recommend corrective action to accommodate timeline changes or new production needs.
  • Ensure broadcasts meet technical quality standards — including audio and video levels — and rectify quality issues promptly.
  • Co-ordinate with other departments (such as Productions and Engineering) to maintain seamless operations and quickly resolve technical issues.
  • Respond to operational emergencies, including equipment failures or signal disruptions, taking appropriate action to minimize downtime and restore normal operations.
  • Train team members on operating procedures and best practices for broadcast systems and equipment.
  • Verify that the gathering and ingestion of audio and video assets strictly adhere to Radio-Canada standards and workflows.
  • Co-ordinate and facilitate the sharing of audio and video assets across internal teams and platforms, including CBC.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.


What You Bring:

  • College diploma in radio and television production, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Relevant experience demonstrating a thorough understanding of TV, radio and digital production workflows.
  • Familiarity with ScheduLINK and iNews software is an asset.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools.
  • Working knowledge of radio studios and booths, as well as TV studios and control rooms.
  • Knowledge of audio and video feed systems (NGCN, satellite, Dejero) is an asset.
  • Strong leadership abilities, the capacity to work independently, excellent organizational and operational planning skills, and a high degree of self-motivation and initiative.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a track record of helping develop innovative procedures to deliver responsive, collaborative support.
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure and tight deadlines, both independently and within a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships with diverse internal teams and clients, tailoring service to production needs and expectations while seeking cost savings and optimizing staff and equipment usage.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously, responding to the needs of clients and colleagues in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Experience creating and updating records within operational databases.
  • Strong service orientation.
  • Fluency in French required.
  • Fluency in English is an asset.
  • Deep knowledge of Radio-Canada programming across all platforms (TV, radio, digital).

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation's technologies and infrastructure, enabling the creation and continued delivery of quality content across all platforms. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people, and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology—not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines and operational needs.

 

The Opportunity

 

Are you passionate about technology transformation, evolving operating models and shaping new ways of working from concept through to adoption? In this key role, you will serve as a strategic technology transformation adviser to leaders and teams, helping diagnose challenges, define and structure change initiatives, and drive operational implementation and adoption across the organization.

 

Reporting to the Director of the Operational Excellence Office within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I), you will join the team leading the Daily Content initiative in Innovation & Delivery. You will be joining us at a pivotal moment as CBC/Radio-Canada undergoes a major overhaul to modernize its content creation platforms. This transformation goes beyond software and tools — it redefines how production platforms are designed, delivered and used within an organizational model focused on product management, agile at scale, and continuous value creation.

 

In this role, you will combine a strategic consulting mindset with hands-on execution across all stages of the transformation. You will analyze complex issues, challenge established ways of working and provide actionable recommendations while actively driving their implementation by designing and producing the strategies, plans, frameworks, tools and other deliverables needed to execute and adopt the transformation.

 

Key areas of focus include transitioning to a product management model, modernizing collaboration with partners and contributors, and driving user adoption of new production tools. You will help define, structure and roll out the transformation and change management strategies required across all levels of the organization.

 

You will also play a central role in bringing together and aligning diverse teams and stakeholders across CBC/Radio-Canada around a shared vision and common goals. Your ability to grasp and navigate a complex organizational ecosystem, balance operational constraints and competing priorities, and exert influence without direct authority will be essential to align perspectives, build consensus, streamline decision-making and remove roadblocks.

 

Working alongside key stakeholders, you will support the organization in preparing for and implementing changes — including by developing and rolling out effective engagement and communications strategies — and by preparing and supporting end users in tandem with our Learning & Development partners.

 

You will work closely with operational and strategic leaders, as well as with the Daily Content Director, to structure challenges, shape recommendations and guide the evolution of work practices and production tools.

 

As a member of T&I’s Operational Excellence Office, you will help ensure alignment, practical execution and long-term adoption of the transformation by continuously refining our approaches based on results, key insights and frontline needs. Beyond the Daily Content initiative, you will also help build the Office’s methods, practices and capabilities as well as nurture a transformation community of practice across CBC/Radio-Canada to share lessons learned and scale high-impact practices.

 

This position can be based in Toronto or Montreal, with occasional travel required.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise leaders and teams on defining and implementing technology transformations, engaging early in the life cycle to analyze needs, diagnose challenges, identify required changes and deliver recommendations aligned with the organization's vision and goals.
  • Guide departments and divisions in evolving their operating models and ways of working, advising on process design, governance, roles and responsibilities, and team collaboration structures.
  • Develop approaches, frameworks and tools to structure and implement transformation — including simple, scalable and reusable interaction models and practical guides — with a focus on change management, Lean, SAFe and Scrum methodologies.
  • Design and execute change management and adoption strategies and plans, incorporating impact assessments, organizational readiness, risk mitigation and stakeholder support.
  • Define and lead engagement, communication and capacity-building strategies — including user training and the preparation of delivery teams and change agents — in partnership with Learning & Development.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, resistance and operational roadblocks that could hinder transformation and adoption.
  • Define and track metrics to measure the progress, adoption and effectiveness of new ways of working, using data and insights to continuously refine strategies.
  • Actively participate in key transformation forums and events, including strategic and alignment meetings, sprint reviews, program demos and quarterly planning sessions.

 

What You Bring

  • Undergraduate degree in business administration, technology or a field relevant to organizational transformation (or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Seven to 10 years' experience leading large-scale technology transformations, including evolving technology operating models, processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and ways of working within complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven track record as a strategic transformation adviser, with strong skills in analyzing and diagnosing complex issues, challenging current practices, formulating actionable recommendations and guiding execution.
  • Solid understanding of product management models and agile practices at scale, with hands-on experience applying them to tech transformations. Expertise in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), Scrum or other scaled agile frameworks required.
  • Experience with Lean and iterative transformation approaches, alongside the ability to adapt strategies and solutions based on key insights, data and frontline needs.
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end change management and adoption, including impact analysis, stakeholder engagement, strategic communications and capability building.
  • Knowledge of media production, broadcasting workflows and related technologies (e.g., audio/video editing, publishing, distribution, graphics generation) a major asset.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics (including labour relations), manage resistance, resolve conflict and build trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with sharp business acumen and the ability to synthesize complex challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, guide and engage leaders and teams without direct authority.
  • Exceptional facilitation and active listening skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, plain language.
  • Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) required.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role

At CBC/Radio-Canada, the Technology & Infrastructure Rapid Innovation Pod is an agile, cross-functional unit dedicated to accelerating the co-development of emerging technologies. Our mission is to explore technology pathways critical to our strategic goals and drive knowledge sharing across flagship projects.

As a Senior Analyst, you are the technical engine of our Innovation Pod. Your primary focus is validating new concepts through active experimentation — building test beds, running thorough evaluations, developing prototypes and conducting proofs of concept (PoCs). Working directly with emerging technologies, you will configure lab environments and document findings with precision. Your analytical rigour provides the critical insights needed to validate or disprove technical hypotheses, ensuring both speed and excellence for our innovation initiatives.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Execution, Prototyping and Test Beds

  • Technology Deployment: Configure test beds, deploy hardware and software, and evaluate emerging cloud technologies to assess their impact on live and near-live production environments.
  • Experimentation: Lead PoCs, lab trials and technical demonstrations while capturing performance metrics.
  • Automation and Scripting: Prepare, code and document test scripts, lab configurations and deployment guidelines for prototype systems.
  • Collaborative Design: Actively contribute to researching and architecting practical, innovative solutions for complex technical challenges.

Data Analysis, Reporting and Agile Tracking

  • Hypothesis Validation: Meticulously record test results, isolate bugs and develop workarounds to rapidly validate or rule out technical hypotheses.
  • Experimentation Velocity: Track technical milestones across test sprints, identify deviations or blockers against sprint goals and report them promptly.

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Meet regularly with colleagues, system designers and project leads to review technical requirements, present experimental data and explore potential solutions.
  • Technology Handoffs: Support transition and implementation phases by providing direct technical guidance to delivery and operations teams.
  • Knowledge Base Maintenance: Maintain clear technical documentation (Confluence, wikis) to inform future architecture standards and operational best practices across the organization.

Minimum Requirements

  • University degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field.
  • One to three years of hands-on technical experience in software development, system administration or systems integration within an R&D or lab environment.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: Proven ability to quickly master emerging tech stacks, software architectures and development tools.
  • Collaborative Skills: Proven ability to work within cross-functional teams and explain complex technical concepts.

Preferred Qualifications (Assets)

  • Experience with DevOps practices and modern systems administration.
  • Solid background in structured testing and validation methodologies.
  • Practical experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong interest in technical innovation within the media, audiovisual production and creative tech sectors.
  • Active contributions to open-source projects or technical communities of practice.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Your Role

 

The Data Governance Analyst operationalizes and drives the adoption of the enterprise data governance framework across the organization. This role acts as a critical bridge between the central Data Governance Office, domain-level data teams, and business stakeholders. The Analyst ensures that policies, data quality programs, and tooling (such as the enterprise data catalog) are seamless to adopt, clearly understood, and effectively tracked from the operational level up to executive council briefings.

 

Main Responsibilities:

  • Framework & Tool Deployment: Support the rollout of the enterprise data governance program, including frameworks, policies, and the implementation of the enterprise data catalog.
  • Manage the activities and artifacts (deliverables, documentations, reports) of the enterprise data governance office.
  • Drive the communication and adoption of data governance roles framework across domains, coordinate the activities of cross-domain working groups and communities of practice as needed.
  • Guiding and supporting data officers, stewards, and custodians by providing practical tools, templates, and guidance. Focus on designing user-friendly processes that make data compliance easier for teams to adopt.
  • Cross-Domain Facilitation: Manage regular communications and touchpoints with distributed business unit data teams to drive framework adoption, monitor progress, and ensure organizational consistency.
  • Roadmap & Milestone Tracking: Partner with data domains to communicate, track, and support the prioritization of data governance milestones within their respective roadmaps and planning cycles.
  • Organize and facilitate meetings, workshops, and working groups; take ownership of documenting, communicating, and tracking post-meeting action items to completion.
  • Stakeholder Education: Serve as an internal data governance advocate. Simplify complex data compliance, metadata, and role-and-responsibility concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain up-to-date repository of data governance documentation, standards, and best practices to ensure a single source of truth for the organization.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and BI teams to develop and maintain automated data governance dashboards and metrics, tracking overall program progress and compliance.
  • Support the planning, delivery, and reporting of data quality initiatives, including the definition of quality scores and the formal tracking of data quality issues.
  • Develop, synthesize, and deliver clear presentation materials and briefings for executive discussions, stakeholder communications, cross-domain data committees.

 

Qualifications, Experience and Skills:

 

Education:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, engineering, computer science, or quantitative discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, management or analytics functions.

 

Experience (relevant to the role):

  • Experience in program development and using data governance tools and platforms such as Collibra, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of data management concepts, processes, and tools (e.g., Collibra, JIRA, Confluence), with familiarity in SQL and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Versatility and adaptability to handle diverse tasks.
  • Effective communication and documentation abilities.
  • Dashboard, reporting and data visualization tool experience an asset (eg: PowerBI, Tableau).
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business and technology teams.
  • Experience coordinating with data vendors is a plus.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship‑management skills, including the ability to prepare materials, brief senior leaders, and drive collaboration across diverse internal teams.

CBC Olympics has built a reputation for “best in class” content and sport production.  We’ve identified the need for a temporary Senior Analyst position (working title Unit Production Manager) reporting to the Senior Director - Sports. 

Responsible for the production & financial management of features & branded content produced for the LA28 Olympics and Paralympics.  Responsibilities include planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and overseeing all production logistics.  Collaborates with National and International Organizing Sports Committees to ensure efficient content production.

In this role they will work directly with the CBC Sports Executive Producers and Unit Production Managers for each CBC Sports component.

  • Coordinates and oversees all aspects of pre-production, post production and production including all remote location and logistics.

CBC P.E.I. is looking for a video journalist with a focus on video aimed at a live and on-demand audience.

You help our audience make sense of the day. You are flexible and adaptable to the rapidly changing media landscape. You will help guide our video strategy, which places a strong emphasis on using video to reach and engage younger, diverse audiences.

job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is looking for a Full-Time Engineer for our North Dallas (Sherman-McKinney, TX) market. The ideal candidate has basic knowledge of, or is willing to learn about, radio broadcast technical systems and equipment to ensure reliable, high-quality audio transmission for our three radio stations - 97.5 KLAK, 93.1 KMKT, and 102.5 KMAD-FM. The ideal candidate works well under pressure, creates solutions, and is a resourceful, diligent, engaged, and creative problem-solver, with not just a “can-do” but a “will-do” attitude. While we seek someone well-versed in, or willingness to learn, broadcast engineering, a candidate’s interpersonal and communication skills, as well as business and personal integrity, are just as important as technical ability.

Responsibilities

for this position include: Compliance with FCC regulations and station policies regarding broadcast standards. Maintenance of safety protocols in all engineering practices. Chief Operator (EAS, Maintenance, and Transmitter Readings log management & review). Regular inspection and maintenance of broadcast equipment, including a mix of solid-state and high-power tube transmitters, audio consoles, studio gear, audio automation systems, remote broadcast systems, and other related equipment. Perform hands-on routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all technical systems. Monitor audio quality and signal strength during radio broadcasts and be able to quickly troubleshoot issues, as needed. Under the direction of Corporate IT, complete all necessary procedures and paperwork relating to the market’s computer system and be the local eyes and hands for remote IT Help Desk support. Oversee the installation of new equipment and technologies, including the planning and implementation of upgrades to existing systems. Work with the Director of Engineering and market Operations Manager to manage capital projects and implement corporate initiatives. Maintain minimal downtime of broadcast, audio and computer systems, including emergency repairs, but also planning and advocating for any necessary improvements to all systems. Provide technical support and expertise, as needed, to other departments in planning and executing initiatives. Clear, professional, and productive communication with employees who do not have technical or programming backgrounds, as well as subcontractors and vendors. Develop clear instructions relating to simple tasks for non-technical employees to understand and perform. Maintain an accurate equipment inventory, maintenance logs, and technical schematics. This includes the preparation of reports relating to asset additions/disposals and technical issues and solutions. Requirements of this position include the following: A minimum of 1-3 years audio engineering, Radio/TV broadcast engineering and/or IT experience. Knowledge of FCC Regulations. Availability to travel to multiple market locations and transmitter sites. Familiarity with, or willingness to learn about, broadcast automation and centralized audio routing systems. Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, computer networks, STL systems, RF & landline, including analog, digital, and IP. A flexible self-manager with the ability to prioritize tasks and shift priorities as needed. This position requires a fully insured personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license. The candidate is required to provide a safe driving record covering the past three years. Must be able to develop collaborative and productive relationships with market employees, so market staff can help troubleshoot effectively when the engineer is off-site. On call availability for transmitter, studio, and remote broadcast technical issues, remote alarm calls, emergencies, and be proactive about coverage when unavailable. ​

Preferred Qualifications

Military or Post-Secondary electronics training. SBE Certification.

Experience

with Axia LiveWire routing. Demonstrated Project Management skills.​

Connoisseur Media is seeking an experienced, driven, and strategic General Sales Manager to lead our sales organization in the Bay Area. This role is responsible for maximizing revenue growth across our broadcast and digital platforms while developing a high-performing sales culture built on collaboration, accountability, innovation, and results. The General Sales Manager will lead, coach, and motivate a team of Account Executives, partner closely with market leadership and fellow sales managers, and drive both new business development and existing account growth. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a passion for developing talent, creating winning sales strategies, and delivering exceptional results for clients and the company. Essential

Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth Work as a collaborative partner with fellow sales managers to create and maintain a "One Team" culture across the organization. Lead, empower, and motivate a team of local sellers to maximize revenue from broadcast, digital, event, and integrated marketing solutions. Drive opportunities that generate both new business and incremental revenue growth from existing clients. Hold the sales team accountable for leveraging the company's superior media assets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Maintain visibility in the marketplace and build strong client relationships that positively impact revenue growth and client retention. Stay informed on market conditions, competitive activity, and all returning and non-returning business. Coaching, Training & Team Development Conduct weekly one-on-one meetings with direct reports and enforce the consistent use of ShareBuilders and other sales performance tools. Accompany Account Executives on sales calls to provide coaching, training, and professional development. Coach Account Executives on Strategic Account Management planning, focusing on revenue growth, account prioritization, and annual budget implementation. Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and sales excellence. Co-build a strong talent bench by recruiting, hiring, and developing top sales talent in the market. Sales Operations & Forecasting Provide accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline management for direct reports. Approve sales orders and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Monitor sales activity and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and growth. Create, update, and maintain sales presentations, marketing materials, and sales collateral. Sales Meetings & Team Alignment Prepare for and co-lead weekly sales meetings. Source and approve leads across the San Francisco, San Jose, and Far East Bay sales teams. Work with the team to ensure effective utilization of all sales tools and resources, including ZoomInfo, Futuri, AdMall, Waymark Video, Marketron, Tapscan, Miller Kaplan, Media Monitors, and other company-approved platforms. Communicate market intelligence, sales strategies, best practices, and performance expectations to the team. Events & Cross-Department Collaboration Attend and actively participate in weekly Promotions Meetings. Manage and oversee annual on-air and on-site station events, ensuring successful execution and revenue opportunities. Collaborate with programming, promotions, digital, and market leadership teams to maximize integrated sales opportunities and client success.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of

education

and experience. Minimum of 5 years of media sales leadership experience, preferably in radio, digital media, or integrated marketing solutions. Exceptional coaching, leadership, and team-building skills. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.

Connoisseur Media - Fredericksburg, VA is on the hunt for a vibrant, engaging, and creative Part-Time On-Air Personality to join the team at 93.3 WFLS - Today's New Country. We’re looking for someone who can light up the mic every time, someone with personality, passion, and a genuine connection to the Fredericksburg community. The ideal candidate brings energy, authenticity, and creativity to every shift, delivering a show that’s both entertaining and relevant. This role requires the ability to work as needed, but specifically mid-days during the week. Availability to work nights and weekends as needed is a plus. If you love music, live and breathe local radio, and know how to make listeners feel like part of the conversation, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

Deliver topical, engaging, and entertaining breaks that fit the 93.3 WFLS brand. Saturday Afternoons from 3 PM to 7 PM and as needed for fill-in. Approximately 4-10 hours a week. Represent the station at events, remotes, and promotional appearances. Collaborate with programming, promotions, and digital teams to create compelling on-air and social media content. Operate studio and remote broadcast equipment with confidence and professionalism. Requirements: Needs on-air experience. Strong communication and social skills — both on-air and off. Ability to deliver a content-rich, listener-focused show. Working knowledge of audio editing, WideOrbit, and social media platforms. Knowledge of FCC rules and broadcast standards. High school diploma or equivalent. Valid driver’s license and reliable, insured vehicle. Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and additional shifts as needed.

job.title: On-Air Personality/Music Director
job.description:
Do you live and breathe Country music? Are you passionate about creating compelling radio that connects with listeners and keeps them coming back for more? Connoisseur Media's 103.1 The Wolf (WWWF) is searching nationwide for a talented, dynamic, and creative On-Air Personality / Music Director to join our team on Long Island at New York City's Country station. We're looking for someone who brings personality, authenticity, warmth, and energy to every break. The ideal candidate understands the power of great storytelling, knows how to create memorable moments, and can craft hooks and teases that keep listeners engaged. This person thrives both on-air and in the community, building meaningful connections with listeners, clients, artists, and partners. In addition to on-air responsibilities, this role will serve as the station's Music Director, helping shape the sound of 103.1 The Wolf through music scheduling, industry relationships, and strategic collaboration with programming leadership. For the right candidate, this position offers a clear path to expanded leadership

responsibilities

and the opportunity to grow into an Assistant Program Director (APD) role. If you're passionate about Country radio, have a strong understanding of the format, and are ready to compete and win in the nation's largest media market, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

On-Air & Content Creation Host a compelling, entertaining, and listener-focused on-air show that reflects the station's brand and personality. Create topical, engaging, and relatable content that resonates with Country music fans. Develop strong hooks, teases, and storytelling moments that drive listening occasions. Interact with listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and station events. Produce creative digital, social, and video content that extends the station's brand beyond the airwaves. Voice-track shifts as needed and contribute content across multiple platforms. Music Director

Responsibilities

Manage and maintain music scheduling and reporting functions. Build and maintain strong relationships with record labels, artist representatives, promoters, and industry partners. Evaluate new music and provide strategic recommendations to programming leadership. Coordinate artist visits, interviews, and promotional opportunities. Attend industry events and stay informed on Country music trends and audience preferences. Collaborate with programming leadership to help shape the station's music strategy and sound. Community & Station Engagement Represent 103.1 The Wolf at station appearances, remotes, concerts, community events, and client functions. Serve as a visible ambassador for the station throughout Long Island and the New York market. Build relationships with listeners, advertisers, community organizations, and business partners. Participate in promotions, sponsorship activations, and special programming initiatives. Leadership & Collaboration Work closely with programming, promotions, sales, and digital teams to maximize audience engagement and revenue opportunities. Assist with coaching, content development, and programming initiatives as assigned. Take on additional programming

responsibilities

with the potential for advancement into an Assistant Program Director role. What We're Looking For Prior on-air radio

experience

required, preferably in the Country format. Music Director

experience

strongly preferred. Passion for Country music and deep knowledge of the format, artists, and industry trends. Strong relationships within the Country music community, including artists, management, labels, and promoters. Exceptional communication skills both on-air and in person. Proven ability to create compelling, listener-focused content with a strong local connection. Strong social media presence and ability to create engaging digital content. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Knowledge of FCC regulations and broadcast compliance requirements.

Experience

with Adobe Audition, VoxPro, RCS Zetta, Selector, MusicMaster, or similar broadcast systems preferred. Valid driver's license and reliable, insured transportation. Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and promotional events as needed.

Connoisseur invests in people who invest in themselves and offers employees a competitive package of health and welfare benefits. Comprehensive

This position plays a key role in creating memorable experiences for our listeners and partners. We’re seeking an awesome, personable, tech-savvy individual who isn’t afraid to strike up a conversation, engage a crowd, and represent Connoisseur Media with confidence and creativity. Someone who is reliable, punctual, friendly, and who thrives in a team setting. You should be comfortable taking direction, talking with the public, and handling a fast-paced workload. We are looking for a Programmatic Specialist to be part of our Connrex Digital team, who strives to help our sales teams execute digital marketing solutions for local SMBs and agencies. Description: The Programmatic Specialist works closely with our sellers and Programmatic Specialist Managers on the execution of all digital advertising campaign types, including social media management, targeted display, connected TV/OTT, email marketing, website design, streaming audio/video, and search. The Programmatic Specialist serves as a liaison to all internal stakeholders, including account management, sales, product, design, and DSP’s, as it relates to executing digital campaigns. You’ll have the opportunity to build strong internal relationships, assist in creating new methods and solutions for resolving challenges, and assist our Programmatic Specialist Managers, account managers, and sellers in delivering on the best practices of digital marketing execution and analytics. Document customer goals, track work completed, and provide updates on the process to customers and sales colleagues Analyze and interpret customer campaign reports/dashboards and deliver key findings to customers to ensure alignment with campaign expectations. QA on contract/billing as required to identify errors and inconsistencies in contracts and campaign details. Detail-oriented with the ability to work independently, and demonstrate excellent analytical problem-solving/technical troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate professionally with management and staff at all levels.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred, but not required. Self-driven problem solver, able to adapt in a rapidly changing, high-energy environment.

in some combination of the following: digital marketing campaign management, media planning, campaign optimization, digital marketing analytics, account management, and customer support. An understanding of HTML, JavaScript, and WordPress CMS is a plus. Base knowledge of CRM/Help Desk platforms.

Represent KGNC 97.9 (KGNC-FM), 100.9 The Eagle (KXGL-FM), 102.9 The Rattler (KVWE-FM), and NewsTalk 710 & 97.5 KGNC (KGNC-AM) at concerts, festivals, live broadcasts, sporting events, and community appearances while also helping keep our stations sounding their best behind the scenes. No two days are the same! One day you could be hosting games and giveaways at a concert, and the next you could be running a live sports broadcast or operating the control board during a live show. If you're outgoing, love working with people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for radio and live entertainment, we'd love to meet you!

Represent our stations at live broadcasts, concerts, festivals, sporting events, and community events. Set up and tear down promotional equipment, including tents, banners, sound systems, tables, and displays. Engage listeners through contests, prize wheels, games, giveaways, and on-site promotions. Monitor automation systems, transmitters, and studio equipment to ensure smooth broadcasts. Maintain broadcast logs and accurately report discrepancies. Valid driver's license and current auto insurance. Must be able to drive a company vehicle. Must be at least 18 years old (21+ preferred for events where alcohol is served).

Previous

experience

in radio, promotions, live events, sports broadcasting, or media.

operating radio automation systems such as Marketron or similar software. Familiarity with FCC rules and EAS requirements.

with social media platforms, WordPress, or digital content creation. Passion for music, sports, entertainment, and connecting with the local community. You will help ensure campaigns launch smoothly, deliver against client KPIs, and generate renewal and incremental revenue opportunities.

• 2–5+ years of experience in digital advertising (inside sales, digital strategy, and/or ad operations), ideally supporting national accounts and/or the agency buying community.

• Knowledge of the digital advertising landscape, including ad serving, brand safety, viewability, measurement pixels, and common third-party verification (e.g., IAS, MOAT, DV).

• Experience with digital platforms and programmatic concepts (DSPs, SSPs, DMPs) and understanding of video, display, and mobile assets.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort presenting recommendations to clients/agencies and collaborating across internal teams.

• Aptitude for analytics: ability to interpret performance results, identify optimization opportunities, and translate data into actionable insights and next steps.

• Strong ownership, interpersonal skills, and stakeholder management across Sales, Ad Operations, Programmatic, Revenue Management, and Product.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, client-focused environment; highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

About the Role

The Senior Publicist plays a leadership role on Corus' Lifestyle PR team, helping drive awareness, engagement, and audience growth for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and each network’s portfolio of original and acquired programming and talent.

Reporting to the Publicity Manager, with the support of a Publicist and a Publicity Coordinator, the Senior Publicist is responsible for developing and executing integrated publicity campaigns that generate impactful earned media coverage, social conversation, and influencer engagement across platforms. This role leads strategic communications plans for priority series and initiatives, manages talent and media relationships, oversees publicity events and activations, and collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to support business objectives.

The Senior Publicist also provides day-to-day leadership and mentorship to the Publicist and Publicity Coordinator while contributing to broader team and departmental initiatives.

Does mouth-watering food content stop your scroll? Are you constantly saving home reno reveals and luxury home tours? Perhaps historical documentaries send you down a rabbit hole for hours. If your algorithm knows you this well, maybe it's time we did too.

You will contribute by:

• Lead strategic publicity campaigns for priority Lifestyle brands and series, developing creative communications plans that support audience growth, brand awareness, and corporate objectives.

• Develop and execute earned media, influencer, talent, and event strategies for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and their programming portfolios.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with entertainment, lifestyle, news, trade, and digital media outlets, as well as influencers and content creators across Canada.

• Manage media outreach and pitching efforts, securing high-impact coverage opportunities across broadcast, print, online, podcast, and social platforms.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with network talent, production partners, distributors, independent producers, and unit publicists to maximize promotional opportunities.

• Lead talent-related publicity initiatives, including media training support, interview opportunities, appearances, press tours, and promotional events.

• Develop, write, edit, and approve publicity materials, including press releases, media alerts, key messaging documents, biographies, press kits, show descriptions, briefing materials, presentations, and reports.

• Analyze media performance and campaign effectiveness, providing strategic recommendations and reporting on earned media and influencer results.

• Lead the planning and execution of publicity events, red carpets, press junkets, screenings, influencer activations, media experiences, and special events.

• Manage photography and promotional assets, including oversight of photo shoots, approvals, distribution, and organization of media materials.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Social Media, Programming, Creative Services, Research, Streaming, Sales, and Production teams to ensure integrated campaign execution.

• Identify innovative publicity opportunities and emerging media trends to keep Corus brands culturally relevant and top of conversation.

• Provide guidance, mentorship, and daily support to the Publicity Coordinator, helping develop their skills and career growth.

• Contribute to broader departmental initiatives and special projects as required.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Undergraduate degree or diploma in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field.

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in publicity, media relations, communications, or entertainment marketing, preferably within the broadcasting, media, or entertainment industries.

• Proven ability to develop and execute strategic communications plans that support business objectives and generate measurable results.

• Exceptional written, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.

• Strong media relations experience with an established network of contacts across Canadian lifestyle, entertainment, news, and trade media.

• Demonstrated success securing meaningful earned media coverage and developing innovative publicity campaigns.

• Experience managing influencer relations and creator partnerships.

• Strong understanding of talent relations and experience supporting talent-facing publicity initiatives.

• Experience planning and executing events, media experiences, launches, screenings, and press tours.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Highly collaborative with exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience mentoring or supervising junior team members is considered an asset.

• Strong understanding of social media, digital content trends, and the evolving media landscape.

• Interest in and understanding of the Canadian broadcasting, media, and entertainment industries.

• Strong technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office and platforms such as Cision, Benchmark, MRP, WordPress, Meltwater, Canva, or similar tools.

Work Status: Full-Time

About the Role:

As a key member of Corus Entertainment’s Legal, Regulatory and Governance department, you will lead the resolution of complex and confidential respect, safety and violence in the workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies. You will be responsible for conducting timely, unbiased and fair investigations or engaging in other forms of resolution, including conciliation. You will also lead complaint intake, case documentation and management, and provide regular status reporting, including annual reporting under the Canada Labour Code. You will join a talented and collegial team that works closely with business partners and will report directly to the Director, Legal Counsel, Employment and Investigations.

• Conducting timely and confidential workplace investigations in areas including discrimination, workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, and violence.

• Conducting interviews, gathering and analyzing evidence, assessing credibility, and writing formal investigative reports with findings.

• Providing recommendations in accordance with established legal practices, policies and any applicable collective agreement.

• Acting as a conciliator to facilitate the process for parties that elect this resolution.

• Supporting the development and interpretation of policies and delivering training.

• Conducting the intake of investigation files, case management and post-investigative reporting and tasks.

• Conducting regular reporting on workplace complaints, investigations and other resolution avenues.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Minimum of three (3) years of related work experience managing and resolving workplace complaints and conducting complex workplace investigations, including experience in facilitating alternative dispute resolution.

• Demonstrated experience facilitating the management and resolution of workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies.

• Experience documenting investigative findings and writing reports that are clear, concise, complete, and provides analysis of the evidence considered in reaching conclusions.

• Demonstrated awareness, understanding and experience identifying and addressing discrimination and harassment, including racism and systemic and intersectional forms of discrimination.

• Ability to effectively manage multiple investigations, identify risks, react to changing situations and manage multiple priorities in a timely and judicious manner.

• You are an innovator, always looking to develop and improve your approach and that of the team, in line with legislative changes and industry best practice.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment yet independently on assigned files.

• Excellent writing and analysis skills.

• Able to handle confidential information in a mature and professional manner.

• Strong ability to multi-task and respond effectively to changing priorities and demands.

• Develop trust and rapport and influence partners and business leaders.

• Exemplifies Corus’ values and foster an inclusive and respectful working environment.

• Excellent project management, prioritization and planning skills.

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law. 

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Athens Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

The Activation Specialist for Athens Radio reports directly to the Promotions & Activations Manager and represents the radio stations as a Brand Ambassador at events and on social media, as well as assisting the promotions team in the office by preparing for events, fulfilling contests and prizing, and utilizing other skills to create content across departments.

 

This role is an entry-level, part-time position, with the opportunity to potentially shadow current CMG employees and assist in videography, graphic design, social media, marketing, promotions, event planning, and sales and programming.

 

Exceptional communication skills and an energetic personality are a requirement. This role will require working nights, weekends and holidays regularly, as well as the ability to lift 50 pounds.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engaging with the public at events ranging from client locations to major festivals and concerts, which may require high levels of energy for several hours
  • Show up professionally on-site at events, in the office and on social media
  • Represent each radio station in the cluster through knowledge of, and passion for, the brands
  • Set up and break down of station sound and promotional equipment (tents, banners, speakers, audio PA system) at station events
  • Create and post engaging content, photos and video on station social media
  • Assist with organization and maintenance of station vehicles and promotional equipment
  • Compose accurate and detailed event recaps for management
  • Effectively communicate with listeners via email, phone and in-person
  • Assist in various departments throughout the station as needed, including but not limited to digital content, programming, sales, and engineering

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Able to multi-task in a high-speed environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills including grammar, spelling and the ability to tailor copywriting to each stations’ brand voice
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and holidays throughout the year
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • College coursework in marketing, public relations, digital media, preferred
  • Videography, event coordination, customer service and/or social media skills preferred

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Broadcast Technology Engineer is responsible for the design, installation, support, and continuous improvement of critical broadcast, production, newsroom, master control, RF, IP, and media technology systems. This role serves as a senior technical resource for integrating traditional broadcast infrastructure with IT, network, automation, cloud, and file-based media workflows. The position helps ensure reliable on-air operations, resilient content delivery, secure technology practices, efficient workflows, and strong collaboration across Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, vendors, and corporate technology teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain, support, and improve master control systems, including playout servers, automation, ingest, transcoding, content delivery, file transfer, monitoring, and interfaces with traffic and scheduling platforms.
  • Support newsroom and production technology workflows, including NRCS platforms, media asset management, shared storage, editing environments, graphics, encoding, streaming, and digital publishing integrations.
  • Provide senior-level support for production control room and studio systems, including production automation, routing, control interfaces, video/audio systems, timing, intercom, graphics, monitoring, and related operational workflows.
  • Partner with IT and network teams to support broadcast network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, ACLs, IP transport, streaming, connectivity, and system interoperability across broadcast and enterprise environments.
  • Lead troubleshooting and incident response for on-air, production, and distribution issues; document root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up steps to improve reliability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Maintain system security and operational readiness through software, firmware, and operating system updates; access control coordination; vulnerability remediation support; backup validation; disaster recovery planning; and compliance with corporate IT and broadcast technology standards.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation, drawings, signal-flow diagrams, system inventories, configuration notes, standard operating procedures, and version records.
  • Collaborate with end users, vendors, Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, and corporate technology teams to design, test, and implement workflow improvements that support reliable content creation, distribution, and live operations.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and technical staff by sharing standards, troubleshooting methods, documentation practices, and operational best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of progressive experience supporting broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, master control, newsroom systems, RF, or related IT/media workflows.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, file-based workflows, IP networking, streaming, encoding/transcoding, shared storage, media asset management, automation, and content delivery systems.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast platforms such as automation, playout, NRCS, editing, graphics, media storage, transcode, streaming, monitoring, and live production systems.
  • Knowledge of FCC requirements, EAS, RF systems, transmitter operations, technical compliance, and applicable broadcast industry standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under time-sensitive, live-broadcast conditions while communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating software, firmware, operating system updates, access controls, backups, documentation, and change-management practices in a mission-critical technology environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, support planned and unplanned work, participate in project execution, and remain effective in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Proficiency with standard productivity tools, technical documentation tools, remote support methods, and common operating systems used in broadcast and media environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred qualifications include experience with cloud or hybrid media workflows, IP-based video transport, automation scripting, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery planning, vendor management, mentoring, and platforms such as Avid, Telestream, Ross, Grass Valley, Harmonic, LiveU, or similar broadcast/media systems.

They thrive in fast-moving news environments, know how to identify high-impact stories, and can quickly adapt coverage strategies based on audience trends and performance data.

 

This is a hands-on, on-site role within the Content Center. Digital Content Center Producers collaborate closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom leadership to ensure KIRO 7 is first, fastest, and most accurate online while continuously expanding our digital audience and strengthening our position as Western Washington's leading local news source.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor local and national news, field calls and tips, listen to police and emergency scanners, and track developing stories through public records and court systems.
  • Communicate and coordinate with newsroom staff and sources as stories develop.
  • Write, edit, and publish content across digital platforms including KIRO7.com, the mobile app, OTT, social media channels, and push alerts.
  • Develop and execute SEO strategies that improve search visibility, audience growth, and long-term content performance.
  • Optimize headlines, story structure, metadata, and distribution plans using SEO and audience insights.
  • Use analytics platforms including Chartbeat, Tableau, Google Trends, and social analytics tools to inform content decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Ensure daily content production and audience engagement goals are met.
  • Stream breaking news, major coverage events, and live newscasts.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment during breaking news and high-volume coverage situations.
  • Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, and referral traffic through search, social, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate with newsroom teams to integrate digital storytelling into broadcast workflows and strengthen cross-platform coordination.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven ability to manage breaking news and make sound editorial decisions in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, headline writing, and copy-editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, digital content strategy, and engagement best practices.
  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO, analytics platforms, CMS workflows, live streaming, and social publishing tools.
  • Experience using audience data and performance metrics to shape editorial decisions and drive measurable growth.
  • Deep understanding of AP Style, media law, and ethical journalism standards.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as news demands; this is an essential on-site role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a digital newsroom, audience development, or digital content strategy role.
  • Demonstrated success increasing website traffic, search rankings, audience engagement, or social growth through data-driven content decisions.
  • Experience managing SEO initiatives and developing strategies that improve organic search performance.
  • Experience coaching or leading newsroom staff on digital best practices, audience growth, and content optimization.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Trends, Chartbeat, Tableau, and other audience intelligence platforms.
  • Leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

 

The wage scale for this position is $24.75 per hour to $35.21 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for Full-Time roles include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Full-time hourly employees are eligible to earn up to 176 hours of PTO inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Part-time employees will receive one hour of paid sick leave for every 40 hours worked. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays & two (2) floating holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law

job.description:
