  • Demonstrated ability to quickly build positive team relationships.

Job Title

Associate Content Creator - PEOPLE

Job Description

I. Job Summary | Major goals and objectives.

The Associate Content Creator brings original, exclusive and creative videos to life, from idea to execution. They participate in every step of the creative process, from pitching, booking, filming, editing and delivering final assets to be programmed on PEOPLE’s social channels and app. They are responsible for creative ideas and working with celebrity talent. This person should have an obsession with social media and pop culture, a strong understanding of the type of content users want to consume on the platform, and a desire to make people swipe and share. They will also produce “article treatment” videos during breaking news situations and be responsible for monitoring, pitching and creating videos from red carpet events.

The Associate Content Creator will be the first eyes the social video team has on the news each day, so they will pitch, create and deliver newsworthy videos and cuts of exclusive PEOPLE interviews. They will assist the Senior Content Creator with pre-productions on major PEOPLE shoots, coming up with questions for talent and pitching fun, scroll-stopping social concepts. They must be able to shoot social-first videos and have solid video editing skills. They will also attend red carpet events to produce, film, edit and post compelling video content. 

This role will require industry experience and the ability to join meetings and assist with guidance of other team members.

• Proven success in building and growing audiences for media sites and digital brands

job.description:
Job Title

Associate Director, Brand Partnerships

Job Description

About The Team | Media & Entertainment 

People Inc.'s Media & Entertainment team partners with leading studios, streamers, networks and entertainment brands to connect their biggest releases, franchises and cultural moments with audiences across our portfolio. In addition to the breadth of People Inc.’s premium brands, the team is anchored by PEOPLE and Entertainment Weekly - industry-defining brands that are the most trusted voices in Hollywood. We bring premium editorial environments, audience intelligence, custom content, social, experiential, digital and print solutions to build 360 partnerships that drive impact for our partners.

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

People Inc. is looking for a relationship-driven, entrepreneurial Associate Director, Brand Partnerships with a strong work ethic to join our Los Angeles-based Media & Entertainment team and help grow some of our most important partnerships. This is a hybrid role based in Los Angeles, with 3 days per week in office. In this role, you’ll focus on business development, building deep category expertise to forge new partnerships and grow existing business.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Effectively represent the entire People Inc. portfolio to our Financial Services client and agency partners

  • Establish a high profile presence across your accounts

  • Demonstrate high energy and enthusiasm for our products, our sales proposition, and our customers.

  • Grow ad revenue from an identified list of existing Media & Entertainment brand advertisers and prospects

  • Build a robust pipeline of opportunities to exceed your revenue goals

  • Develop deep customer knowledge through research and face to face meetings

  • Continuously grow your M&E category knowledge and the audiences M&E advertisers serve

  • Create winning account plans focused on the largest opportunities and execute plans through effective written, virtual, and in-person communication

  • Meet (and entertain) regularly with client and agency decision makers – 7 meetings per week standard – continually growing your network and building client relationships that lead to growing ad revenue

  • Share customer knowledge and effectively collaborate internally to build media programs that sell

  • Effectively forecast, track and report revenue contribution and performance with our internal tools.

  • Responsible for maintaining and showing growth on a book of business $2M+

Hybrid 3x a week- (LA) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  • 35% — Client & Agency Relationship Building:  Develop strong, trusted relationships with key client and agency stakeholders through regular meetings, entertainment, proactive outreach and thoughtful follow-up. Build a high-profile presence across assigned accounts and continually expand the network of decision-makers and influencers.

  • 25% — Revenue Growth & Opportunity Management:  Drive revenue across assigned accounts by identifying new opportunities, responding to RFPs, developing compelling proposals and closing business. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports both near-term goals and long-term account growth.

  • 20% — Pipeline, Forecasting & Account Management: Own the day-to-day management of the business, including maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast reporting, tracking deal progress, identifying risks and upside to management, and ensuring clear next steps across all active opportunities.

  • 10% — Internal Collaboration & Leadership Communication: Partner closely with Marketing, Account Strategy, Research, Studio and other internal teams to develop winning programs. Communicate key client insights, business updates, risks and opportunities clearly and proactively to leadership.

  • 10% — Strategic Account Development: Build and execute account plans for priority partners, develop deep knowledge of client businesses and entertainment slates, and proactively identify ways to grow existing relationships beyond individual campaigns.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor's degree preferred in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising or a related field, and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 2-3 years of digital media sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of success in breaking accounts, growing revenue, and closing opportunities at a high rate

  • Relationships within M&E categories strongly preferred

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Positive, high-energy, collaborative, and driven by excellence

  • Teachable, curious, and eager to learn and grow

  • Strong work ethic with a high degree of ownership and follow-through

  • Natural relationship builder with strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Resourceful self-starter who asks great questions, uncovers client needs, and embraces coaching

  • High degree of integrity and business ethics

People Inc. is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Marketing to help shape how our company and portfolio of essential brands show up in the advertising marketplace. Job Title

Associate Director, Research & Insights

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is looking for an Associate Director of Research & Insights to lead our research strategy for our Beauty, Style, & Entertainment verticals  (Core endemic portfolio: People, Entertainment Weekly, Instyle, Byrdie). Our high-quality content is aimed at helping people make decisions, find inspiration, and take action. And our first-party data is at the heart of informing everything we do--and not just on our beauty, style, & entertainment sites, but across powerful brands in home, food & beverage, tech, travel, family, and health (including powerhouses like Better Homes and Gardens, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, and AllRecipes).
 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York)

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

Across our brands and platforms People Inc.'s content engages, informs and entertains over 175 million U.S. consumers each month. Our team helps Beauty, Style and Entertainment brands understand and connect with these consumers, using data to surface insights that inform content, media and advertising strategies.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

Team Enablement (60%)

Develop and maintain systems that enable our current analysts/category experts to continue to provide best in class service and insights to our stakeholders while also ensuring their growth and professional development. Responsibilities include:

  • People Management 

    • Advise and mentor analysts in both day-to-day work and project management - requires understanding and knowledge of media sales/strategic advertising process, broader industry landscape (B/S/E categories and media in general), and tools and resources for audience and content positioning (including but not limited to MRI-Simmons, comScore, social media measurement tools, 1P resources, Print/Magazine resources, etc.).

    • Personnel administration | Includes but is not limited to process management. time off management, identifying and flagging challenges, escalating development opportunities, etc.)

    • Personnel development | Partner with Senior Director for opportunities for development as well as career path growth within the team and support your team in achieving those goals

    • Task Management | Manage analyst workflows, monitor capacity, & ensure deliverables are timely and meet the strategic objectives of our stakeholders.

  • Systems and processes |  refining and maintenance (project trackers, dashboards, report macros, external calendars, etc.)

Individual Contributor (40%)

  • Collateral Creation & Curation | Work with the Senior Director in the development and regular updating of collateral. Examples include category one-sheets and on-the-shelf go-to-market (GTM) materials, for both B/S/E Sales and Marketing teams and all other corporate divisions (Print, Enterprise, PR, Commerce, Content, etc.)

  • Insights & Analytics | Support and coverage for RFPs and day-to-day ad hoc requests when analyst bandwidth is stretched and/or PTO coverage. This means direct use of our toolkit (of 1st and 3rd party solutions) to deliver insights and strategic recommendation.

    • Expertise in working with large data sets to synthesize information and draw out key insights

    • Expertise in using multiple sources of data and information (whether syndicated, quantitative, qualitative, secondary, etc.) to guide business decisions

College degree required

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience, minimum 3 years of management experience

  • Experience directly supporting an Ad Sales and Marketing team(s) 

  • Experience managing and mentoring analyst teams of three or more

  • Understand the digital advertising landscape, products, and trends that are important to industry media buyers

  • Strong interest in engaging with and understanding key audiences, topics, trends, and events to tie market and world events to audience insights and present a point of view that is appropriate for and in context with the these industries

  • A true self-starter who provides proactive ideas, understands organizational goals, and moves initiatives forward - with a proven track record of leading projects from start to finish and delivering business value

  • An excellent communicator with outstanding research storytelling skills which allow you to draw out key insights, and can tailor compelling and engaging messages for different audiences 

  • A strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Solid grasp of media math, statistics, digital engagement metrics, and research methodologies

Nice to Have 

  • Direct Beauty, Style and/or Entertainment category experience

  • Passion for Pop Culture

job.title: Cloud Platform Engineering Intern
job.description:
Job Title

Cloud Platform Engineering Intern

Job Description

About People Inc:
People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

* This People Inc. Canada internship is scheduled to end in May 2027.

job.title: Commercial Counsel
job.description:
Job Title

Commercial Counsel

Job Description

About The Position:

The Commercial Counsel is a key member of People Inc's Legal team, serving as a trusted legal advisor to the business and leading the review, negotiation, and implementation of the company's commercial contracting processes. This role partners closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Finance, Procurement, and executive leadership to support strategic initiatives while balancing legal risk with business objectives.

The Commercial Counsel is responsible for negotiating complex commercial agreements, developing scalable contracting processes, and providing practical, business-oriented legal guidance that accelerates deal execution and enables growth. Success in this role requires exceptional legal judgment, commercial acumen, strong negotiation skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to translate complex legal issues into practical business solutions.

In-office Expectations - NYC Location: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely up to two days per week.

About The Team:

The Legal team partners across the organization to protect the company's brands, intellectual property, employees, customers, and business while enabling growth through practical legal advice and strategic risk management.

About The Position’s Contributions:

60%  

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial agreements, including customer, vendor, technology, SaaS, software licensing, advertising, partnership, procurement, consulting, confidentiality, data processing, and professional services agreements.

15%

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve scalable contracting processes, templates, negotiation playbooks, training materials, and legal operations to increase efficiency, consistency, and speed.

15%

  • Support strategic initiatives, product launches, partnerships, emerging technologies, and new business models by identifying legal risks and recommending practical solutions that balance legal requirements with business objectives.

5%

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Procurement, Finance, and other business leaders to provide practical legal guidance that supports revenue growth while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.

5%

  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting commercial transactions, intellectual property, privacy, AI, digital advertising, and technology, and advise internal stakeholders on business implications.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school.

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar (New York preferred).

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience practicing commercial, corporate, technology, media, intellectual property, or business law at a nationally recognized law firm and/or in-house legal department.

  • Significant experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements.

  • Demonstrated interest in advising cross-functional business teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated interest in supporting technology, digital media, publishing, advertising, SaaS, or consumer businesses.

  • Demonstrated interest in intellectual property transactions, privacy, AI, product counseling, or data licensing.

  • Experience developing legal operations, contract management processes, and contracting playbooks.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Deep knowledge of commercial contracting principles, contract negotiation, and risk allocation.

  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed organization and adapt to changing needs.

  • Experience negotiating technology, SaaS, licensing, advertising, marketing, procurement, consulting, data processing, and professional services agreements.

  • Strong understanding of intellectual property law and commercial transactions.

  • Exceptional legal judgment with the ability to provide practical, business-focused advice that balances legal risk with business objectives.

  • Strong negotiation, drafting, issue-spotting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to clearly communicate complex legal concepts or issues to the Law Department as well as non-lawyers and executive leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Procurement, Finance, and executive leadership.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and negotiate numerous agreements simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • High ethical standards, sound judgment, attention to detail, and unquestioned integrity.

D/Cipher is seeking a strategic storyteller and marketing communications leader who can transform complex AdTech and digital media concepts into compelling narratives that drive awareness, credibility, and business growth.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales, content, communications, and brand, helping shape how D/Cipher is represented across materials and touchpoints.

Job Title

Director, Conversion Strategy

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

People Inc is seeking a Director of Conversion Strategy, to lead conversion strategy across PEOPLE onsite and in-app marketing. The Director will determine how Martech platforms fit into the acquisition roadmap for newsletter, app, subscriptions, and paid memberships.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Audience Conversion, this role is responsible for driving audience conversion across the customer journey—from converting anonymous site visitors to known users, to increasing paid subscriber acquisition through strategic upsell initiatives. This role owns the onsite conversion strategy, user journey optimization, and performance across subscription products, leveraging marketing technology platforms and data-driven experimentation to maximize revenue and audience growth.

Working cross-functionally with Email, Product, App, Data, and Editorial teams, the Director develops and oversees experiences that guide users from onsite engagement, to newsletter acquisition and/or in-app activation and ultimately to paid subscription.

This role will oversee the Campaign Manager of Conversion.

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week - (New York City) 

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance to our main office in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three times per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

This role is part of our centralized Growth and Audience Relationship team, responsible for growing direct relationships between our brands and consumers, operating People Inc. brands' newsletter, notification, lifecycle and onsite marketing programs and delivering best in class experiences to millions of subscribers.

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  • Own the conversion strategy across the customer journey. Develop and optimize user journeys from onsite experiences through in-app engagement, creating seamless pathways that increase activation and subscription conversion. Responsible for:

    • Newsletter list growth

    • Upsell from free-app users into paid subscribers.

    • Gating strategy

  • Develop strategy for moving users from free to paid experiences:

  • Define how marketing technology platforms, like Piano and Digioh, support and enable the customer acquisition roadmap across newsletters, app, and paid subscriptions. 

  • Develop audience segmentation strategies to determine the right offer for the right user at the right time and how those should be implemented. 

  • Own the onsite experimentation roadmap, including A/B testing, gating, and user journeys.

  • Monitor, analyze, and continuously optimize conversion performance across channels

  • Establish KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure funnel performance and subscription growth.

  • 10+ years of experience in marketing, growth strategy, conversion optimization, subscription marketing, or customer acquisition.

  • Strong understanding of onsite marketing strategies and best practices, free-to-paid conversion journeys, ad gating strategies

job.title: Director, Data Science
job.description:
Job Title

Director, Data Science

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is America’s largest print and digital publisher, reaching tens of millions of readers every day. We’re hiring a Director of Data Science to lead customer intelligence and personalization for our entertainment brands, helping shape products and experiences that inform, engage, and inspire our audiences.

In this role, you’ll build a deeper understanding of our customers across product engagement, marketing response, and lifecycle behavior. You’ll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Editorial teams to turn data into actionable insights that drive growth, while working with Data Operations and Engineering to ensure our models, measurement systems, and insights can scale effectively.

You’ll apply statistical modeling and machine learning to product and marketing challenges across customer segmentation, acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value, with a particular focus on mobile app experiences. You’ll own models and analyses that support personalization, automated marketing, attribution, experimentation, and lifecycle optimization across apps, newsletters, and other customer touchpoints, translating complex audience behavior into clear recommendations and measurable business impact.

Schedule Requirements:

In-office Expectations:

This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office periodically for team meetings, etc.)

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

People Inc. is the largest premium publisher in the world. Every day, tens of millions of people come to us for help and inspiration. Our library of hundreds of thousands of articles helps our users understand how to deal with day-to-day challenges. You will work with a team of data scientists, collaborating with cross-functional groups to leverage this incredible dataset to understand both our content and our users' needs. This knowledge will be used to identify and build out new products that leverage the behavioral information within our extensive data.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

  • Lead and grow a data science team to develop predictive models that estimate customer lifetime value using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.

  • Analyze and understand customer interactions across app, web, social media, and email touchpoints to identify and optimize engagement opportunities.

  • Own product funnel and engagement analysis, including onboarding completion, feature adoption, feature stickiness, and session behavior, as distinct from marketing-funnel metrics such as acquisition and retention.

  • Leverage data-driven insights to build customer segmentation models, identifying high-value users and informing content and product recommendations.

  • Partner with Product and Editorial teams to translate user understanding into differentiated experiences across the app, newsletters, and other customer interactions, feeding insights directly into the product development cycle. This includes the sizing of opportunities and assessment of product success.

  • Design online A/B testing experiments to measure the impact of product changes, personalization, and full-funnel marketing interventions.

  • Ensure effective collaboration between data science teams and other departments.

  • Advocate for resources and tools to advance data capabilities.

  • Align data initiatives with company objectives.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: 

PhD or advanced degree in Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in data science and machine learning with a strong focus in the area of customer behavior, product analytics, and marketing-focused problems.

  • 5+ years of experience leading a team of data scientists.

  • Ability to lead product and funnel analytics on web and mobile platforms with a focus on providing actionable insights, not just data outputs.

  • Solid foundation in causal inference, survival analysis, and time series analysis, especially as applied to marketing and customer behavior.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and model development.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code/Codex and how they can be used reliably (and where they fail) in a data science workflow.

  • Strong strategic and operational capabilities.

  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to non-technical marketing and business stakeholders.

  • Drives adoption of new data science methods and technologies to continually expand what the product can do.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Experience with large-scale search and recommendation systems in media, e-commerce, or advertising space.

  • Experience working with large-scale analytics platforms (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Exposure to reinforcement learning or bandit approaches for personalization or offer optimization.

  • Advanced experimentation techniques, including multivariate testing, factorial designs, and CUPED.

  • Experience with Bayesian statistical methods for inference and decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Experience with forecasting models and advanced lifecycle or retention modeling.

  • Applied NLP experience for content classification, semantic search, or audience understanding.

  • Track record of leading end-to-end data science projects from problem framing through deployment and impact measurement.

  • Confidence and pride in representing Data Science as a strategic partner to Marketing and other business teams.

job.description:
Job Title

Director, Executive Compensation

Job Description

The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.  Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company.

The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

Equity Program Administration

  • Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures.

  • Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports.

  • Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. 

  • Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets.

  • Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.

  • Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups.

  • Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity.

  • Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

  • Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal.

Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance

  • Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings.

  • Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure.

  • Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings.

General Compensation & Projects

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to HR and  Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year.

  • Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy.

  • Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets.

  • Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion.

  • Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives.

  • Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: A forward-thinking mindset with a willingness to explore AI tools, automated workflows, and emerging technologies to streamline compensation processes and maximize efficiency. 

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0-5%

Job Title

Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations

Job Description

About The Position: 

The Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations provides high-level administrative and governance support to the Deputy General Counsel and legal leadership team, focusing on board management and corporate governance. As the central liaison for the Board of Directors, this role ensures seamless communication and meticulous preparation of materials for executive meetings. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who handles competing demands with exceptional judgment, strict confidentiality, and high integrity. 

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team: 

The People Inc. legal team operates as a trusted strategic partner across the enterprise, safeguarding the company’s assets, reputation, and compliance standards. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented, and high-performing team that values integrity, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement. This role interacts closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and external stakeholders, representing the legal department with professionalism and poise. 

About The Position’s Contributions: 

75% Board of Directors & Corporate Governance Support: 

  •  Manage logistics for Board and Committee meetings, including scheduling, facilities, and virtual arrangements.

  • Prepare and distribute confidential Board materials, agendas, and presentations per established timelines. 

  •  Maintain the Board portal to ensure secure and timely document updates.

  • Coordinate the collection of reports and presentations from executive leadership for Board books. 

  •  Track Board action items, resolutions, and follow-up requests to ensure timely completion.    

  • Maintain official corporate records, including minutes, resolutions, and governance documentation. 

  • Assist with governance initiatives, such as calendars, director onboarding, and shareholder meetings. 

  • Oversee the execution and retention of resolutions, written consents, and executive certifications.       

10% Operational Excellence: 

  •  Identify opportunities to improve administrative and operational processes that increase efficiency within the Legal department.   

  • Build collaborative relationships across Legal, Human Resources, Finance, Executive Leadership, and other business functions. 

  • Anticipate business needs and proactively recommend solutions that enhance executive effectiveness and department operations.    

10% Executive Admin Support to Deputy General Counsel, Head of Corporate Legal Affairs & Litigation: 

  • Provide comprehensive executive support to the Deputy  General Counsel (calendar, travel, expenses, and communications)

  • Facilitate legal operations (meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support). 

5% Executive and Legal Team Support Back-Up: 

  • Serve as back-up coverage during the Executive Legal Assistant's absence to provide comprehensive executive support to the SVP and General Counsel as needed including: calendar, travel, expenses, and communications, meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support. 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: 

Education: 

  •  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.  

Experience: 

  •  5+ years of executive administrative or paralegal experience supporting C-suite executives, preferably within a Legal department.    

  • Experience supporting a Chief Legal Officer, General Counsel, Corporate Secretary, or Board of Directors strongly preferred. 

  • Experience handling highly confidential legal, employment, corporate governance, or executive information. 

  • Experience coordinating Board of Directors meetings and preparing Board materials preferred. 

  • Experience working in a publicly traded company or highly regulated environment is a plus.    

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: 

  •  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Zoom, and Google Workspace ( Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Slides.   

  • Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential, proprietary, and sensitive information with absolute discretion. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion. 

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface confidently with C-suite executives and board members. 

  • High level of organizational skill with a proven ability to prioritize heavy workloads, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate executive needs.

  • Ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization, including executive leadership and Board members. 

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining flexibility in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.    

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0% – 5% (Occasional travel may be required for off-site board meetings).

job.description:
Job Title

Growth & Content Strategy Manager, Commerce News & Deals

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Growth & Content Strategy Manager will help drive audience and revenue growth across People Inc.’s portfolio of commerce brands through search and audience strategy, performance analysis, experimentation, automation, and scaled insights.

Reporting to the Director of Growth & Content Strategy for Commerce News & Deals, this role works alongside peer strategy managers and partners closely with editorial teams to identify opportunities, understand performance, and turn audience and commerce signals into actionable content strategies.

Commerce News & Deals operates in a rapidly changing audience ecosystem across Google Search, Google Discover, Apple News, social platforms, and other discovery channels. Success in this role requires SEO fundamentals, sharp analytical thinking, strong communication and presentation skills, and the ability to develop scalable systems and content strategies that help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York City) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions

Growth Strategy & Audience Insights

  • Partner with Commerce News & Deals editorial teams, newsletter and platform experts to identify opportunities that grow audience, engagement, and commerce revenue across each respective environment.

  • Review performance across organic search, Google Discover, Apple News, social platforms, and other key audience channels and provide actionable analysis.

  • Study search demand surrounding consumer trends, and identify opportunities around product launches, sales events, tentpoles, seasonal moments, trending products, brands, and celebrities.

  • Own and create recurring analyses, dashboards, and reporting that help teams understand performance and make better decisions.

  • Build and improve automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Google Apps Script, APIs, webhooks, Airtable, Google Sheets, and internal platforms.

  • Automate recurring data collection, reporting, monitoring, and distribution processes. Maintain, document, and monitor reporting for quality assurance. 

  • Connect data across systems to improve visibility into audience, content, and affiliate performance.

Experimentation & Performance Learning

  • Develop and execute tests to better understand audience behavior, content formats, titles, page features, and other performance drivers.

  • Conduct retrospectives around tentpoles, algorithm changes, audience shifts, and major initiatives.

  • Evaluate the impact of Growth recommendations and use those learnings to improve future strategies and systems.

  • Communicate technical and analytical findings clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of SEO and data expertise.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience in SEO, audience development, growth strategy, digital publishing, commerce, or a related field.

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to independently move projects from idea through execution and measurement.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling stories and actionable recommendations for a range of stakeholders. 

  • Experience building polished presentations in Google Slides is strongly preferred.

  • Good understanding of SEO fundamentals, search intent, trending events, and generally how content is discovered across algorithmically driven platforms SERP behavior, content strategy, and audience acquisition.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience working in Excel and/or Google Sheets with large datasets from multiple sources.

  • Experience with SEO and audience tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Looker, Ahrefs, STAT, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.

  • Basic familiarity with workflow automation tools such as n8n, ChatGPT, Google Apps Scripts. Entry level knowledge of APIs, JSON, SQL, Python, JavaScript, and web crawling.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools, analytical approaches, and ways of working.

  • Experience with commerce publishing, affiliate marketing, Amazon Associates, Amazon Onsite Associates, Skimlinks, or retailer platforms is a plus.

job.description:
Job Title

GSOC Coordinator

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced GSOC Coordinator to serve as a trusted operational resource within the Global Security Operations Center. This position performs the full range of GSOC operator duties while also supporting advanced enterprise security work involving intelligence, investigations, travel security, executive protection, and crisis management.

Reporting to the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence, the Coordinator operates security systems, manages incidents and communications, conducts research and assessments, and supports sensitive security matters requiring sound judgment, discretion, strong writing, and independent decision-making.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.

About The Position’s Contributions:

GSOC and Site Security Operations

  • Operate the GSOC and continuously monitor alarms, CCTV, access control, life-safety systems, and other enterprise security technologies.

  • Receive, assess, document, and coordinate the response to security incidents, emergencies, system alerts, and requests for assistance.

  • Dispatch security personnel, maintain communications with field operations, and ensure timely escalation to Security Management and appropriate business partners.

  • Prepare and distribute mass notifications, emergency communications, incident updates, and other enterprise security messages when authorized.

  • Support access-control administration, video review, incident documentation, daily logs, shift turnover, and security-system troubleshooting.

Intelligence and Investigative Support

  • Conduct open-source intelligence research, social media monitoring, threat-actor research, and other authorized intelligence collection in support of active security matters.

  • Assist with threat assessments, workplace violence concerns, criminal and administrative investigations, background research, and investigative case support.

  • Support executive and brand threat monitoring by identifying, documenting, and escalating information that may indicate risk to employees, executives, offices, events, or company operations.

  • Produce clear, accurate, and timely incident reports, intelligence summaries, investigative memoranda, and executive-ready briefing materials.

Travel, Executive, and Crisis Support

  • Monitor employee and executive travel, assess destination and geopolitical risk, and support traveler accountability during incidents or emergencies.

  • Provide operational and intelligence support for executive travel, protective operations, corporate events, and other elevated-risk activities.

  • Monitor global incidents, severe weather, civil unrest, geopolitical developments, and other events that could affect company personnel or operations.

  • Support crisis activations through situational awareness, communications, incident tracking, escalation, and preparation of situation reports.

Program and Operational Support

  • Work closely with Security Operations personnel to coordinate field response, information sharing, and operational support during incidents and special events.

  • Support the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence with program documentation, procedures, audits, metrics, training materials, and special projects.

  • Handle sensitive company, employee, investigative, and executive information with discretion and in accordance with established protocols.

  • Maintain a professional, service-oriented approach when assisting employees, executives, visitors, law enforcement, vendors, and business partners.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, intelligence studies, security management, emergency management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in law enforcement, intelligence, investigations, corporate security, military service, emergency management, or a related public safety field.

  • Demonstrated experience with investigations, intelligence research, threat assessments, analytical research, or other complex security work beyond routine monitoring and dispatch.

  • Ability to independently operate a command center environment, manage competing priorities, assess incomplete information, and make timely, defensible decisions.

  • Excellent written communication and report-writing skills, including the ability to organize complex information into concise operational or executive summaries.

  • Strong judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and ability to handle sensitive or confidential information.

  • Working knowledge of CCTV, access control, alarm monitoring, incident management, mass notification, and common GSOC or physical security technologies.

  • Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and the ability to learn investigative, intelligence, travel-monitoring, and security-system platforms.

  • Ability to successfully complete required pre-employment screening and obtain required certifications after hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior law enforcement experience, particularly in investigations, intelligence, detective operations, emergency response, or command-center functions.

  • Experience in a GSOC, Security Operations Center, Emergency Operations Center, Fusion Center, intelligence unit, investigative unit, or comparable environment.

  • Experience with OSINT, social media research, threat management, travel security, executive protection support, or crisis monitoring.

  • Relevant certifications such as APP, CPP, PSP, PCI, First Aid, CPR, AED, or similar credentials.

job.title: GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization
job.description:
Job Title

GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization

Job Description

About The Position :

The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution.

As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine.

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team:

The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution.

About The Position’s Contributions:

35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory

  • Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible.

  • Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog.

35% GTM Program Management & Training

  • Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks.

  • Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it.

30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis

  • On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 4–7 years of experience in ad product operations, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, digital media project management, product marketing, commercial operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing cross-functional product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting revenue organizations within digital advertising, media, ad tech, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Relationship Building & Empathy: High emotional intelligence with a proven track record of earning trust across diverse commercial teams. Exceptional ability to act as a supportive, empathetic partner to quota-carrying sellers.

  • Program & Project Management: Highly organized with the disciplined capability to manage multiple moving parts of a launch simultaneously, enforce deadlines, and keep diverse stakeholders communicating effectively.

  • Product Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, ad tech, and sales lifecycles. Ability to quickly master technical ad product configurations and explain them simply to non-technical teams.

  • Data Curiosity: A natural inclination to look at sales spreadsheets, ask probing questions about revenue performance, and translate numbers into actionable insights for catalog optimization.

job.title: Manager, Data Operations
job.description:
Job Title

Manager, Data Operations

Job Description

About The Position:

The Manager, Data Operations leads the design, reliability, and day-to-day execution of the company's core data pipelines and analytics infrastructure while directly managing a team of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management accountability, ensuring that data systems are scalable, trusted, well-documented, and aligned with business priorities. The role is responsible for setting technical direction, prioritizing team work-streams, developing talent, and ensuring cross-functional alignment across Analytics, Product, and Technology. This is both a strategic leadership role and a hands-on operational steward for the company's data platform.

In-office Expectations: Hybrid NYC. This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 3 days per week.

About The Position's Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

30%

Data Engineering & Pipeline Operations

•    Own the design, reliability, and scalability of ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines

•    Ensure ELT/ETL processes run with high uptime and strong data quality

•    Guide orchestration, monitoring, and performance optimization

•    Reduce operational fragility by promoting shared patterns and automation

30%

Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling

•    Oversee development and maintenance of clean, tested, well-documented data models (e.g., dbt)

•    Define standards for modeling and semantic consistency

•    Ensure downstream BI and analytics consumers have trusted, well-structured datasets

20%

Governance, Quality & Trust

•    Establish clear metric definitions and semantic models

•    Partner with Governance and Security teams on lineage, metadata, and access controls

•    Reduce metric inconsistencies and reporting ambiguity

•    Ensure compliance with privacy and security standards

20%

Business Partnership & Communication

•    Serve as a data advisor to Analytics, Product, and business leadership

•    Translate business priorities into technical roadmaps

•    Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

•    Prioritize investments based on measurable business impact

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and mentor a team of data engineers responsible for building and maintaining core data models, dashboards, and scalable data products.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and deliver high-quality data solutions that support reporting and decision-making.

  • Design, implement, and optimize performant, well-documented data models that enable self-service analytics and strategic initiatives.

  • Define and champion engineering best practices around code quality, documentation, version control, and testing within analytics workflows.

  • Lead or support ad-hoc data analyses to uncover insights and drive business strategy.

  • Stay up to date on industry trends and new technologies to continuously improve our data architecture, tooling, and processes.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines using Python or similar programming languages.

  • 5+ years of advanced SQL experience working with relational and distributed data systems (e.g., Hive, BigQuery).

  • Hands-on experience with dbt for data transformation and pipeline management.

  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring a team of data or analytics engineers, or owning end-to-end delivery of large-scale data products.

  • Strong leadership and talent-development skills

  • Excellent communication across technical and business audiences

  • Strong prioritization, decision-making, and documentation discipline

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or AWS/GCP.

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Job Title

Manager, Growth Marketing Platforms

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements:

People Inc is seeking a Manager, Growth Marketing Platforms, to support the execution and optimization of the Martech platform that powers the onsite marketing for subscriptions and paid memberships. 

Reporting to the Director, Martech Ops, this role will act as a key platform operator and subject matter contributor, helping  marketing, brand, and product teams  effectively use the platform to drive audience growth, conversions, engagement, and retention.
 

You will support the platform configuration, integrations, experimentation capabilities, and operational processes required to support scalable marketing and subscription growth initiatives. 
 

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in marketing technology and subscription and paid membership experience. This is a highly collaborative, technical role that requires strong attention to detail, ability to work cross functionally in a fast paced environment, comfort managing multiple projects at once, and an agile spirit. 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

This role is part of our centralized Growth and Audience Relationship team, responsible for growing direct relationships between our brands and consumers, operating People Inc. brands' newsletter, notification and lifecycle marketing programs. This role this operates to serve marketing across people inc business and product lines


About The Positions Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  •  Platform Expertise

    • Support day-to-day management and execution within the Martech platform that powers our subscription and paid products

    • Manage platform configuration, campaign build, feature enablement, and ongoing optimization

    • Partner with internal stakeholders to translate marketing, brand and product needs into platform capabilities.

    • Manage execution of new units, triggers, and user flows in partnership with Marketing, Product and Martech platform 

    • Responsible for day to day platform support and technical aspects of campaign set up and QA. 

    • Partner with data and marketing teams to develop data schema within the platform to build user profiles and audience cohorts.

  • Support Subscription and Conversion Optimization

    • Support growth initiatives focused on subscription acquisition and conversion optimization

    • Enable teams to test messaging, offers, and user journeys within platform

    • Implement and manage A/B testing frameworks to improve conversion rates and user engagement.

  • Campaign Operations:

    • Maintain comprehensive documentation for all campaigns.

    • Act as a bridge between technical teams and marketing stakeholders.

  • Governance and Best Practices:

    • Follow standards for platform usage, testing, and campaign management

    • Document processes and maintain operational best practices for platform administration.

    • Support scalable processes that allow teams to leverage the platform effectively.

    • Drive continuous improvement in platform performance and operational efficiency.

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Marketing, Platform Ops, Growth Marketing Operations, Product, or a related field.
 

Experience:

  • 2-3  years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, or growth platforms.

  • Hands-on experience managing technical components of platforms such as Piano, Wunderkind, Digioh, or similar.

  • Strong understanding of subscription funnels, conversion optimization, and lifecycle marketing.

  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks and marketing experimentation.

  • Knowledge of onsite targeting/segmentation and campaign optimization

  • Familiarity with marketing analytics and campaign measurement.

  • Understanding of how data needs to be structured within the Martech tool for executional use

  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, and engineering teams.

  • Proven ability to document processes to enable marketing teams to drive scalable growth.

  • At minimum intermediate experience in HTML/CSS/JS to support campaign implementation, Advanced preferred.

job.title: Security Operations Supervisor
job.description:
Job Title

Security Operations Supervisor

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced Security Operations Supervisor to serve as a visible, hands-on uniformed leader supporting daily enterprise security operations. Reporting to the Manager, Security Operations, this position works alongside in-house and contracted security personnel across reception, patrol, events, incident response, and workplace security operations.

The Supervisor also works closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and operations, coordinate field response, and maintain effective communication and situational awareness during incidents, special events, and periods of increased activity. The ideal candidate leads by example, remains calm under pressure, and is equally comfortable assisting employees, directing security personnel, and coordinating with executives, vendors, and public safety agencies.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

Operational Leadership

  • Provide visible, hands-on operational leadership and work alongside in-house and contracted security personnel during daily operations.

  • Coordinate reception, patrol, event security, contract personnel, and other operational resources during assigned shifts.

  • Ensure post orders, procedures, access-control requirements, and service standards are followed; inspect operations and help correct deficiencies.

Incident and Emergency Response

  • Serve as the senior uniformed operational resource during incidents, emergencies, and critical events until relieved by Security Management.

  • Direct field response, deploy resources, coordinate with the GSOC, and ensure required notifications, incident reports, and after-action documentation are completed.

  • Respond to medical incidents, evacuations, suspicious activity, workplace violence concerns, executive incidents, and other security events; coordinate with law enforcement, fire, EMS, and property management as needed.

GSOC Support and Coordination

  • Work closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and daily operations.

  • Provide operational guidance and support during major incidents, special events, after-hours activity, and periods of elevated demand.

  • Coordinate field operations with GSOC monitoring, communications, incident documentation, enterprise notifications, and situational-awareness functions.

Physical Security and Event Operations

  • Support access control, visitor management, reception, patrol, alarm response, CCTV operations, facility inspections, and other physical security functions.

  • Assist with planning and on-site execution of internal meetings, executive events, corporate venue activities, and major public-facing events.

  • Direct event security staffing and deployment and coordinate with vendors, venue personnel, law enforcement, and emergency responders while maintaining a professional and welcoming environment.

Leadership, Training, and Operational Support

  • Coach and mentor security and GSOC personnel through daily guidance, real-time feedback, onboarding support, drills, and hands-on instruction.

  • Provide Security Management with objective feedback regarding performance, training needs, staffing concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Assist with shift coverage, daily assignments, operational documentation, special projects, audits, and other duties as assigned.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: 

Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, security management, emergency management, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in law enforcement, military service, public safety, corporate security, or a related security environment.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience directing personnel or operations during routine activities, incidents, emergencies, or special events.

  • Ability and willingness to work as a hands-on, uniformed operational leader rather than in a primarily administrative role.

  • Sound judgment and the ability to make timely, defensible decisions under pressure.

  • Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and customer-service skills, with the ability to interact professionally at all levels of the organization.

  • Working knowledge of access control, CCTV, alarm monitoring, incident reporting, and common security operations practices; proficiency with Microsoft Office and related reporting systems.

  • Ability to remain mobile throughout the workday, conduct patrols and inspections, stand or walk for extended periods, and successfully complete required pre-employment screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior supervisory or field leadership experience in law enforcement, corporate security, military service, emergency management, or another operational environment.

  • Retired law enforcement experience, particularly in a supervisory or field leadership capacity.

  • Experience supporting a GSOC, command center, emergency operations center, or similar security environment.

  • Experience coordinating proprietary and contracted security personnel, reception, events, or executive support.

  • CPP, APP, PSP, PCI, FDNY Certificates of Fitness, First Aid, CPR, AED, or similar relevant certifications.
