job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

 

About The Position |

As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit.

 

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate.

 

A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

 

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 

About The Team: |

_______________________________________________________________________________

Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment.

 

We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

About The Positions Contributions:

  • 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling

    Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history.

    25% Experimentation & Measurement

    Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement.

    20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding

    Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products.

    20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization

    Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product.

Education:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring:

  • Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics.

  • Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale.

  • Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role.

  • Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role.

  • Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

  • Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models.

  • Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Nice to have:

  • Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery.

  • Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits.

  • Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work.

  • Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup).

Studio at People Inc. is the in-house native content studio at People Inc. The Senior Producer runs large-scale programs, mentors producers, and ensures campaigns are delivered with authenticity and platform-native thinking.

This role is hands-on in production but elevated in responsibility: Senior Integrated Producers are trusted to own on-set client relationships, guide Integrated Producers, and lead campaigns across video, photo, print, social-first, and experiential formats. They translate bold creative ideas into executable production plans, always balancing creative ambition with operational and financial realities.

About The Position 
As the Senior Manager, Editorial Advertising Operations, you will be responsible for packaging, operationalizing, and executing digital editorial sponsorship offerings on behalf of our advertising partners across iconic brands like Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Allrecipes, People, and more. In collaboration with the Brand Marketing, Account Strategy, and Editorial teams, you'll work across advertiser categories and content spanning video, social, audio, and on-site. This position reports directly to the Director, Editorial Advertising Operations within the Edit Solutions team.  

Hybrid 3x a week (New York, NY or Seattle, WA) 
In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team


Edit Solutions is a centralized, brand-aligned team that supports the packaging, operationalization, and execution of sold digital editorial sponsorships across People Inc.’s Lifestyle and Entertainment portfolio. We partner closely with Brand Marketing, Editorial, Video, Social, Sales, and Client Services to translate sold programs into scalable plans, build the infrastructure required for execution, and deliver clear launch guidance across on-site and off-platform channels. Fast-paced, collaborative, and solutions-oriented, our team plays a critical role in protecting revenue, enabling cross-functional execution, and helping editorial sponsorships come to life across as many as 28 brands.

About The Positions' Contributions:

  

  • Partner with Brand Marketing, Account Strategy and Editorial teams to:
  • Develop new packages and refine existing offerings
  • Define and document editorial packaging details, with a focus on post-sale efficiency 
  • Act as the main point of contact for these teams during the pitch phase to vet opportunities
  • Maintain knowledge of site capabilities, advertiser expectations, and disclosure requirements 
  • Ensure efficient hand-offs of sold editorial packages to the assigned post-sale project manager and assist throughout the lifecycle of the campaign as needed
  • Maintain working knowledge of standard digital ad solutions and organizational policies 
  • Identify and develop solutions for process gaps and inefficiencies, with an eye toward scalability 
  • Project manage campaigns from sale through launch: 
  • Assess contractual obligations and translate them into launch deliverables
  • Coordinate across multiple internal teams (Editorial, Video, Social, Account Strategy, and Sales) to ensure flawless execution of sold editorial sponsorships

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take charge of our data privacy and platform strategy. You will be the point person for balancing our business needs, like audience growth and personalization, with the reality of global privacy regulations. This role is a mix of high-level roadmap planning and deep-in-the-weeds technical problem solving, specifically regarding our Data Subject Request (DSR) platform.

 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

 

About The Team:

At People Inc., we treat reader trust as our most valuable asset. This role is not just building a platform; this role is building the infrastructure that allows our readers to trust us with their data. This team solves hard, "real-world" technical problems that have a tangible impact. 

About The Positions Contributions:

 

Weight % | Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

20% | Own the DSR Platform

  • Our current DSR process needs work. You will lead the roadmap to evolve this from a compliance checkbox into a scalable, automated system that handles access, deletion, and portability requests across all our data silos.

20% | Balance Privacy & Product

  • You’ll define how we manage data and identity. The goal is to stay fully compliant (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) without sacrificing the user experience or our ability to deliver relevant content.

20% | Build the Foundation

  • Partner with engineering to modernize our data architecture. You need to understand our data lineage, governance, and security well enough to guide architectural decisions across different business units.

20% | Make Privacy User-Friendly

  • Stop treating privacy as a legal chore. You will design transparent, user-centric flows that actually help our readers understand their data, which in turn builds long-term brand trust.

20% | Cross-Functional Strategy

  • You’ll be the bridge between Legal, AdTech, and Engineering. You need to be able to explain the technical risk to legal, and the regulatory requirements to our engineering leads.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree is preferred and/or equivalent experience.

 

Experience:

  • 5+ years in product management owning backend platforms. A candidate who has worked in data-heavy environments or managed compliance-related products or identity systems is required. 

 

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • DSR Platform Expertise: Experience developing or expanding DSR systems. You understand the friction involved in verifying identities and synchronizing data across disconnected stacks and have a vision for automation.

  • Technical Authority: Ability to lead technical discussions with engineers. You possess a strong grasp of APIs, data flow, and warehouse environments like BigQuery or Snowflake to guide fundamental architectural choices.

  • Articulate Communication: Skill in distilling complex legal mandates or technical constraints into clear, actionable insights for leadership across Legal, Editorial, and Revenue teams.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Software Engineer, 1

Job Description

About The Team:

People Inc. is looking for a Senior Software Engineer 1 to join our AI/ML Engineering Platform team. As part of the AI/ML Engineering Platform team, you'll be working on widely used components that help users find ways to consume content on our sites. This includes using technologies such as Vertex AI pipeline, KServe, Kafka, Elasticsearch and Vector Database to leverage the power of AI and ML use cases and build capabilities to recommend related articles, and much more!

As a Senior Software Engineer 1, you will collaborate with product owners, Data Science, Platform teams, project managers, and software engineers to create service applications and contribute to the technical roadmap

Schedule Requirements: Hybrid 3x a week

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office in NYC, Des Moines, LA, Seattle, or Chicago, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions  Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results (70%)

You understand how to design and build scalable distributed systems, backend platforms, compatible with AI/ML infrastructure for search, retrieval, ranking, recommendation, and personalization use cases

 

 You will:

  • Design and build systems, manage scalable ML pipelines using Vertex AI Pipelines for training, evaluation and deployment to support ranking, retrieval, and recommendation personalization use cases

  • Develop and maintain data pipelines that support feature generation, model training, and analytics workflows. Own vector generation via Milvus, storage, and retrieval workflows

  • Implement model serving solutions using KServe and build APIs using FastAPI for low latency inference

  • Build observability and monitoring for models and pipelines. Track performance, drift, failures, and data quality issues

  • Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to define and deliver ML driven features

  • Investigate production issues across data pipelines, models, and services. Identify bottlenecks and improve reliability and performance

  • Create and maintain clear documentation for pipelines, models, APIs, and operational processes

  • Develop internal tools and dashboards to provide visibility into data processing and model behavior for stakeholders

  • Contribute to engineering standards, code quality, and best practices across Python-based services and ML systems

  • Stay current with ML infrastructure, MLOps practices, and relevant tools. Bring in improvements where they add clear value

Collaborate with product, data science, and frontend teams to deliver high quality search and feed experiences (30%)

  • Own production systems. Debug issues across indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving layers

  • Create clear documentation for pipelines, models, APIs, and system design

  • Contribute to best practices for Python based ML systems, API design, and scalable infrastructure

  • Stay current with advancements in search, ranking, and recommendation systems. Apply them where they make practical impact

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Experience:

 

You have a strong foundation in modern backend and ML engineering practices and continue to learn and evolve. You bring:

  • 6+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and services

  • 5+ years of experience developing software using object oriented languages, with strong proficiency in Python, Node.js, and TypeScript

  • Hands on experience with ES for search, indexing, and relevance tuning

  • Experience with event driven systems using Apache Kafka for real time data pipelines and processing

  • Strong understanding of version control systems including Git and platforms like Bitbucket

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, and APM

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS and GCP, along with containerization using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes

  • Comfortable deploying, versioning, and monitoring models in production

  • Curiosity to learn new technologies, especially in AI, LLMs, and modern search and recommendation systems, with a focus on applying them in real production use cases.

  • Experience designing and building data pipelines using Apache Beam and Apache Airflow for ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines

  • Familiarity with experimentation and analytics tools such as Jupyter Notebook and Apache Spark to track and reproduce experiments

  • Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, including versioning, documentation, and security practices like OAuth and JWT

  • Good understanding of machine learning concepts including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, and natural language processing, with practical application in ranking, retrieval, and personalization

  • Beginner level experience managing ML pipelines using Vertex AI Pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment workflows

  • Ability to review code, provide clear feedback, and improve overall engineering quality

  • Strong communication skills. Able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders

  • Solid problem solving skills with a data driven approach

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

 

Core Tech Stack

  • Backend and API development using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, and TypeScript

  • Search and indexing using Elasticsearch for relevance, retrieval, and query optimization

  • Event driven architecture and streaming using Apache Kafka

  • Vector search and embeddings infrastructure using vector databases such as Milvus or Pinecone

  • Cloud and infrastructure using Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services with containerization via Docker and orchestration through Kubernetes

job.title: Care Team Specialist I
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

Here's what we're looking for... 

  • Minimum 1 year of hands-on ministry experience required.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience working in a customer service environment required.
  • Previous ministry training required (volunteer, leadership or staff training)
  • Solid understanding of scripture and demonstrate strong knowledge of God's word.
  • Able to demonstrate discernment on spiritual issues and have excellent listening skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong computer skills;  MS Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook), and Social Media platforms, ability to learn new systems.  Keyboarding speed of about 45+ WPM.
  • Ability to multi-task inbound/outbound calls and verbal/written communication with accuracy and excellence.
  • Associates degree (or higher) in biblical studies, theology or equivalent a plus!
  • Bilingual skills a plus!
  • This is an on-site position, so candidates within commute distance of Franklin, TN preferred.
  • Most importantly, someone who is grounded in their faith and passionate about the mission of K-LOVE.  (Our Mission, Values & Beliefs)

 *Must be able to work holidays as needed.

 

Location:   On-site in Franklin, TN 

Available Schedule:   Tuesday - Saturday  2:00pm - 10:30pm or Sunday - Thursday 2:00pm -10:30pm

 

Want to know more? As a Care Team Specialist I, here are a few things you'd be doing...

  • Maintain a commitment to model our Care Team Values in every interaction with our ministry contacts and the rest of the Care Team.
  • Practice the “5Cs” on every call and interaction (where applicable) across all our ministry channels.
  • Answer prayer line calls and screens for appropriate support based on caller communication.
  • Provide professional and personal experience, demonstrating empathy and care about their struggles, needs, and concerns.
  • When necessary, completes prayer edits, and perform other tasks for the ministry.
  • Support additional channels, such as emails, chat, text, multi-language, generation-specific, etc. if necessary.
  • When appropriate, transfer callers to pastors or other departments for additional support. This includes triaging, and appropriately transferring crisis calls.
  • Meet and exceed minimum expectations for work production, quality, and team culture.
  • Maintain command of essential Care Team tasks and an understanding of the Care Team ethos.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in initial Care Team tasks and responsibilities.
  • Proactively respond to inquiries; clearly and positively communicate solutions with exceptional follow through.
  • Collaborate with other departments as appropriate.
  • Assure a high level of accuracy when providing information about K-LOVE.
  • Effectively collaborate and communicate with peers. Model and communicate best practices while maintaining your own spiritual, mental, physical, and relational health.
  • Participate in additional training as necessary to keep skills current.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality with listener information and records.
  • Pastoral Care is a support department and is not closed on holidays. As a result, we generally have a reduced team scheduled on holidays, but it is expected that all team members will share coverage and annual rotations.

 

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Associate Video Editor
job.description:
ESPN Creative Studio is a unit within the Content division of ESPN. Our staff comprises Motion Graphics, Edit, Visual Storytelling, Production Enhancements and Innovations, Creative Operations, and the Music group. Positions within Creative Studio include Video Editors, Post Editors, Producer Editors, Sound Designers, Graphic Designers, Project Managers and Art Directors, etc. We are the go-to destination to conceptualize, develop, and execute content creation across all domestic and international ESPN distribution platforms.

 

The Associate Editor is an entry‑level role within ESPN Creative Studio, supporting Creative Daily Editorial or Creative Post Editorial. This role is focused on developing foundational video editing skills, applying established workflows, and contributing reliably to team-based production in a fast‑paced environment. The Associate Editor performs routine assignments, works within standardized procedures, and builds technical competence through structured, hands-on experience and guidance from more senior video editors.


This role may require you to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Performs routine and structured editing assignments using non‑linear editing software in support of daily or postproduction content needs in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Edits content in accordance with existing procedures, naming conventions, SOPs, and high-quality standards.
  • Conducts basic quality control checks and makes standard corrective adjustments to ensure all created content meets ESPN’s high standards.
  • Communicates clearly with editors, producers, and partners to ensure success of assignments and accomplishments.
  • Works collaboratively within the Edit team and follows direction to meet assigned deadlines and production objectives.
  • Participates in assigned training and development opportunities to build technical skills, workflow knowledge, and creative proficiency.

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of editing or related experience.
  • Working knowledge of non‑linear editing software (Adobe Premiere, Avid, Edius, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite applications (After Effects, Audition, Illustrator, Photoshop).
  • Basic understanding of broadcast video and audio quality standards and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to follow direction and perform effectively within a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven production environment.
  • Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office 365 and Teams.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, holidays, overtime, and adjusted schedules as required by production needs. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of non-linear and social media production workflows.
  • Knowledge of PC and/or Mac operating systems.
  • Bilingual (written and spoken) in both English and Spanish. 

 

Required Education:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

 

Preferred Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Studio Production, Journalism, or related field Vocational School or related experience 

 

 #ESPNMedia

job.title: Chief Steward
job.description:
The Chief Steward ensures seamless behind-the-scenes operations that support world-class events, banquets, and catering functions delivered throughout the Walt Disney World Resort.  This role oversees stewarding teams responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness, food safety, and equipment management while enabling the successful execution of events ranging from intimate gatherings to large-scale conventions and special events.


Be a part of our award-winning Food and Beverage Operations team at the Walt Disney World Resort! In this role, the Chief Steward provides leadership, support and direction for stewarding operations in a fast-paced food & beverage operation. You will lead and inspire a diverse Cast of hourly stewards in partnership with culinary leaders and Cast. You will proactively work to exceed expectations and meet the needs of all food and beverage and catering leaders at the resorts and parks while fostering an environment of cleanliness and operational efficiency as a hallmark for Disney's standards for success. You will report to the Manager- Stewarding & Facilities Operations.

  

What You Will Do


• Ensure dish room areas comply with sanitation and safety standards

• Ensure all equipment and tabletop wares are in good condition and that appropriate inventory levels are maintained

• Maintain and monitor equipment, props and inventory

• May be responsible for operating teams in multiple resort locations

• For large remote functions, set up make-shift workspaces to align with sanitation and operations processes

• Able to foster a positive and safe work environment and practices

• Responsible to take a sincere interest in Cast Members and make them feel included and valued

• Actively listen to the Cast, and quickly follow-up on issues

• Motivate and engage Cast Members through inspirational leadership and storytelling

 

Required Qualifications & Skills 

 

• Possess passion for the food & beverage business and a focus on safety and cleanliness

• Ability to function effectively in a team environment 

• Verbal and written communication skills 

• Ability to deal effectively with conflict

• Organization, multi-tasking and time management skills with attention to detail

• Problem solving and decision-making skills with a focus on continuous improvement

• Ability to be flexible with work schedule, including weekends, variable shifts, and holidays


Preferred Qualifications

 

• Multilingual skills, particularly Creole, Portuguese, Spanish and Vietnamese

• Previous experience as a chief steward, kitchen manager or another food & beverage or culinary leadership role

• Operational Guest service experience and Guest service skills


Preferred Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in food & beverage, hospitality or equivalent


The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $62,200 to $83,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

job.title: Disney Live Entertainment Costume Production Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
About the Role & Program

Through innovative storytelling and a culture of collaboration, Disney Live Entertainment creates, produces, and delivers remarkable and engaging entertainment experiences. From the intimate to the spectacular, our work can be seen at Disney theme parks, resort hotels, cruise ships, and other locations the world over! Our diverse team – representing a wide variety of disciplines and talents from technical directors, writers, and lighting designers to choreographers, cosmetologists, and music producers – brings magical worlds to life through technical expertise, performance excellence, incomparable ingenuity, unparalleled spectacle…and a dash of pixie dust!

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027, located in Anaheim, CA.

What You Will Do

The Costume Production department is responsible for facilitating the manufacturing and maintenance of operational and entertainment costumes across The Walt Disney Company. At Disney, you will partner with Entertainment and Costuming Operations to ensure costume quality and design are consistently maintained.

  • Interface daily with the Workroom Teams, Costumers, Buyers, Designers, and varying levels of management within the Costuming organization
  • Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: CAD/CAM processes, costume construction, technical sketches, and production management.
    Additional responsibilities may include draping, drafting, fittings, size charts, pattern making, millinery, and alterations.
  • Attend possible meetings
  • Observe and assist with fittings

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience using CLO and Gerber/LECTRA (or similar apparel CAD software)

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven knowledge of fabrics with an understanding of their relation to design and construction techniques
  • Experience in the Theater, Film, or Apparel Industry
  • Willingness to learn and work with many different methods of construction that are unique to Creative Costuming

job.title: Paralegal Specialist
job.description:
The Paralegal Specialist position carries out a range of para-professional duties under the supervision of one or more attorneys in ESPN’s Legal department, spending the majority of time handling trademark-related matters. 

This role will be focused mainly on trademark prosecution and enforcement and drafting and reviewing trademark-related contracts, but will also include the drafting, review, and analysis of non-trademark contracts as well, handling the contract drafting process from term sheet through signature. The Paralegal Specialist position will regularly engage with in-house attorneys, outside counsel, and business leads.   

What You Will Do:

  • Maintains ESPN’s global trademark portfolio by filing US and global trademark applications and renewals, including preparation of specimens, first use dates, and identifications of goods and services, working closely with outside counsel in doing so.
  • Reviews watch notices for trademarks and domain names and tracks infringing domain names.
  • Conducts preliminary US and international screening searches via Saegis and the Internet.
  • Analyzes comprehensive screening and search results and drafts reports for internal clients.
  • Prepares cease and desist letters and processes takedowns for online IP infringement.
  • Reviews and edits opposition-related documents and works with business units and outside counsel to collect information and evidence for UDRP and other trademark proceedings.
  • Reviews product, marketing, and other materials for proper trademark use.
  • Tracks trademark deadlines and ensures deadlines are not missed by keeping trademark attorney and clients apprised of such deadlines.
  • Drafts contracts and/or other legal documents, ranging from standard to highly complex, for attorney review and approval, with a high degree of competence, knowledge, legal judgment and drafting skill.  Range of subject matters may include all matters handled within the Legal Department.
  • Conducts legal issue identification and analysis, including regarding intellectual property ownership (e.g., trademark, copyright, name and likeness); legal risk assessment at a high para-professional level. 
  • Conducts research, which may include some higher-level analysis, in areas of focus.
  • Sets up matters in Tracker (billing system), reviews invoices from outside counsel and vendors, and processes quarterly billing reconciliation.
  • May conduct administrative support activities for attorneys and interface with finance function as necessary.
  • Expected to contribute/participate in department oriented initiatives beyond assigned duties on occasion (e.g., legal department intranet site, presentations to client departments).

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of applicable legal experience required.
  • Expertise in all areas of trademark prosecution and enforcement.
  • Expertise in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
  • The ability to consistently solve problems with a high degree of independent decision-making.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management.
  • Demonstrated strong operational expertise.
  • Proven success in judgment in a broad scope of matters.
  • Full knowledge of selected legal procedures, terminology, and contract policies and standards.
  • Ability to handle a high volume of work with minimal supervision while exercising the judgment to appropriately discern when to escalate issues.
  • Superior organization skills with the ability to prioritize workload efficiently and effectively, and excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and must be highly team-oriented.
  • High level of professionalism and ability to maintain absolute confidentiality.
  • Ability to build business acumen and understand core elements of the applicable business area(s).

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • Knowledge of NetDocs and Tracker.
  • Subject matter expertise in trademarks and other categories of agreements in the sports/media/entertainment/music space.

Education:

  • High School Diploma

Preferred Education:

  • Paralegal certification or Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree

job.title: Platform Engineer (Project Hire)
job.description:
The Platform Engineer is a skilled, independent contributor who designs, implements, and supports core platform and infrastructure capabilities that power magical Disney Experiences across parks, resorts, cruises, and consumer products. You will focus on data pipelines, on-prem server architecture, observability, and DevOps automation, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable environments that enable teams to deliver seamless guest and cast experiences.

We are seeking an individual to take full ownership of a large-scale Splunk environment supporting mission-critical operational and engineering systems. This role will be responsible for managing the entire Splunk ecosystem from the infrastructure layer (bare metal) through application-level development, in direct support of software engineering teams responsible for complex physical systems and real-time operations.


This is a hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise across infrastructure, data ingestion, and observability, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, and performance.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will act as a proficient problem-solver and effective partner to engineering and product teams, owning platform components from design through operations while mentoring colleagues and working with minimal guidance. You will emphasize automation, observability, and lifecycle management platforms to improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and support data-driven decisions that enhance Disney Experiences worldwide.

  • Own and manage the full Splunk stack

  • End-to-end responsibility from bare metal infrastructure → OS → Splunk architecture → dashboards and analytics

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Splunk infrastructure

  • Install, configure, and optimize Splunk components (indexers, search heads, forwarders, clustering)

  • Manage both on-premise/physical server environments and hybrid integrations

  • Support real-time operational systems

  • Enable monitoring and observability for high-availability, real-time engineering systems

  • Build dashboards and alerts used by engineering and operations teams

  • Develop data pipelines and ingestion strategies

  • Integrate data from diverse sources (logs, sensors, applications, control systems)

  • Optimize parsing, indexing, and search performance

  • Partner with software engineering leadership

  • Work closely with Software Engineering Managers and system teams

  • Translate operational requirements into scalable Splunk solutions

  • Performance tuning and system reliability

  • Identify bottlenecks across infrastructure and data pipelines

  • Ensure high availability, redundancy, and system resilience

  • Security, governance, and access control

  • Implement role-based access and data governance best practices

  • Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards

  • Continuous improvement

  • Recommend architecture improvements and modernization strategies

  • Evaluate tools within the Splunk ecosystem (e.g., ITSI, ES, Cribl, etc.)

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience with Splunk administration and development

  • Proven experience owning a Splunk environment end-to-end

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Splunk Enterprise architecture (indexers, search heads, clustering)

  • Data ingestion, parsing, and optimization

  • Dashboard and alert development

  • Experience managing on-prem / bare-metal infrastructure

  • Linux administration (preferred)

  • Server provisioning, performance tuning, and system monitoring

  • Experience supporting real-time, high-availability systems

  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering, industrial, or operational technology (OT) environments

  • Familiarity with observability and logging tools beyond Splunk (e.g., Cribl, ELK, Prometheus)

  • Experience with event-driven systems, telemetry data, or IoT/sensor integrations

  • Exposure to high-throughput environments with large-scale data ingestion

  • Splunk certifications (Admin, Architect, or Developer)

Required Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field or relevant work experience

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - ESPN
job.description:
Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.

A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology

  • Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

  • Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.

  • Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news.

Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity.

Job Summary:

ESPN is investing in large‑scale data infrastructure and real‑time processing platforms that power next‑generation personalization and live sports experiences. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will focus on building and operating distributed data and ML infrastructure that supports high‑throughput, low‑latency data processing and real‑time ML use cases.

In this role, you will work closely with senior MLEs, data engineers, platform/SRE, and product teams to develop streaming data pipelines, feature computation systems, and ML‑adjacent services that operate reliably at scale. The role emphasizes hands‑on engineering, strong fundamentals in distributed systems, and practical experience operating production data infrastructure.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

1) Large-Scale Data Processing & Streaming Systems

  • Build and maintain high‑throughput batch and streaming data pipelines to support ML, analytics, and real‑time decisioning use cases.

  • Implement data ingestion, enrichment, aggregation, and transformation workflows using modern distributed data frameworks.

  • Ensure pipelines meet latency, reliability, and data quality requirements for downstream ML and product teams.

2) Real‑Time Data & Feature Infrastructure

  • Develop and operate systems that support real‑time feature computation and delivery for online ML services.

  • Work with feature stores and event‑driven architectures to ensure consistency between offline and online data.

  • Improve data freshness, schema evolution, and backward compatibility in streaming environments.

3) ML-Adjacent infrastructure & Platform Engineering

  • Build and operate ML‑adjacent services such as inference inputs, feature APIs, and data access layers.

  • Contribute to scalable service patterns including autoscaling, rollout strategies, and resiliency mechanisms.

  • Partner with platform/SRE teams to improve system availability, performance, and cost efficiency.

4) Reliability, Observability & Operations

  • Instrument data and ML infrastructure with metrics, logging, and alerting to support production operations.

  • Participate in on‑call rotations and incident response for data and ML platforms.

  • Identify and remediate data pipeline failures, performance regressions, and operational risks.

3)  Collaboration & Engineering Execution

  • Collaborate with applied ML and data science teams to enable production ML workflows through reliable data systems.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.

  • Follow established platform standards and contribute incremental improvements over time

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Basic Qualification:

  • Experience building and operating large‑scale data or ML systems in production.

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and data processing architectures.

  • Hands‑on experience with streaming and batch data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, Flink, or equivalent).

  • Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Java, Scala, Go, or C++.

  • Experience operating systems in cloud‑native environments (AWS, containers, Kubernetes, IaC tools).

  • Familiarity with observability and operational best practices for production systems.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across engineering and data teams

Preferred qualification:

  • Experience supporting real‑time personalization, recommendation, or analytics systems.

  • Familiarity with feature stores, event‑driven architectures, and real‑time ML pipelines.

  • Exposure to ML infrastructure concepts such as inference pipelines, data validation, and model lifecycle tooling.

  • Experience optimizing data systems for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency.

  • Understanding of experimentation platforms and data instrumentation for online systems.

Experience with:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building data‑intensive or ML‑adjacent systems in production

Required Education  

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field

job.title: Promotions Director
job.description:
Promotions Director

Federated Media | Fort Wayne, IN
Stations: 92.3 FM/1190 AM WOWO, 97.3 WMEE, 98.9 The Bear, K105, 1380 The Fan

Position Overview

Federated Media Fort Wayne is seeking a Promotions Director to lead and execute all station promotions, events, contesting, and community engagement initiatives across five market-leading radio brands.

This is a hands-on role focused on planning, coordination, and execution, with additional operational and logistical support provided by a Promotions Coordinator. The Promotions Director owns the full promotions lifecycle from concept, through execution and recap, while providing clear direction, approvals, and oversight across on-air, online, and on-site platforms.

The role serves as the strategic and operational hub connecting Programming, Sales, Digital, on-air staff, and the Promotions Coordinator to ensure promotions are executed at a high level and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Promotions Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, plan, and execute station promotions aligned with each brand’s identity and audience.
  • Serve as the project manager for all promotions across on-air, web, social, email, and live events.
  • Plan and oversee major tentpole events, live broadcasts, charity initiatives, concerts, and station appearances.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with venues, promoters, sponsors, and community partners.


Contesting & Compliance

  • Design and manage contest structures, timelines, rules, and prize fulfillment.
  • Ensure all contesting and promotions are FCC-compliant and follow company guidelines.
  • Oversee ticket inventories, prize distribution, waivers, and winner documentation.


Event & Remote Management

  • Oversee all station events, remotes, and on-site activations from planning to execution.
  • Coordinate logistics including staffing, station vehicles, equipment, signage, and branding.
  • Serve as lead on-site representative at major station events.


Collaboration with Programming & Sales

  • Work closely with Program Directors to ensure promotions align with station strategy and on-air execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop promotions that support client initiatives while protecting station brands.
  • Evaluate promotional proposals to ensure brand fit, execution feasibility, and audience value.


Digital & On-Air Support

  • Oversee promotional messaging across social media, websites, email, and on-air platforms.
  • Write or approve promotional copy including liners, social posts, web content, and text/email messaging.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across all platforms.


Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly supervise and provide direction to the Promotions Coordinator and part-time promotions staff.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks, timelines, and execution details through established workflows.
  • Lead promotions meetings, assign tasks, and manage timelines and expectations.
  • Serve as final approval point for promotional concepts, messaging, and execution plans.


Reporting & Recaps

  • Produce promotional recaps including photos, documentation, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Track execution performance and provide post-promotion summaries to internal teams.


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or related fields is preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple promotions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for events.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to lead promotions for four highly visible radio brands.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving radio environment with strong community presence.
  • Supportive leadership and clear operational structure.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Email resume to Kyle Guderian at kguderian@federatedmedia.com

job.title: Account Executive

WAGA – FOX 5 Atlanta

Do you define yourself as a driven, results-oriented sales professional and a skillful relationship-builder? If so, you belong here. Join a team where critical input and new ideas are essential, all while enjoying the career stability that comes with working for a highly successful, well-known industry leader.

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, we dominate the Atlanta, GA television market by broadcasting the highest volume of local news. Beyond our broadcast dominance, we provide sophisticated, best-in-class Digital offerings designed to be comprehensive marketing solutions, enabling partners to achieve measurable results at every stage of the advertising purchase funnel.

The FOX 5 Sales Team has an amazing opportunity for an experienced Account Executive to generate digital and broadcast advertising revenue for Atlanta’s top local television station.

Why Join Us?

  • Creative Environment: Work in a fast-paced culture where teamwork and ideas are valued.
  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with accomplished media professionals to drive revenue.
  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Operate from our cutting-edge studios in downtown Bethesda.

Job Summary

  • Generate Revenue by selling a suite of cutting-edge digital advertising solutions across our key brands, including FLX, FOX Local, TUBI, FOX Sports, and FOXNEWS.com, as well as unique multi-screen promotional sponsorships.

  • Lead the Sales Process by presenting, negotiating, and developing unique and valuable advertising packages to new and existing clients.

What We’re Looking For

job.title: Accounting Supervisor
job.description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor to join the FOX team in Mexico City. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day general accounting operations, manage AR workflows, and drive the month-end closing process across Mexico and Central America.

Serving as a crucial bridge between operational execution and managerial oversight, you will ensure total financial accuracy, regional tax compliance (including Mexican CFDI 4.0 and local tax/e-invoicing regulations across Central American countries), and strict alignment with US GAAP and local statutory standards.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, expertise in multi-entity regional accounting, and proven experience guiding junior accounting staff within a dynamic, fast-paced multinational environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regional Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting activities across Mexico and Central American entities, including general ledger maintenance, AR operational cycle, accruals, prepaid expenses, and fixed assets.
  • Month-End Close: Lead and streamline monthly, quarterly, and annual closing schedules for regional entities, preparing and reviewing complex journal entries, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Tax Compliance & Invoicing Standards: Ensure strict adherence to local tax regulations across all assigned jurisdictions (including Mexican CFDI 4.0, payment complements, and Central American e-invoicing and tax requirements).
  • Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with shared service centers, corporate finance, regional tax, and treasury teams.
  • Audit & Internal Controls: Maintain and enforce robust internal control policies across regional entities. Assist the Accounting Manager in coordinating internal and external audit deliverables for local and corporate audits.
  • Process Optimization: Actively identify opportunities to standardize and automate accounting processes across countries.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Management: Serve as a key escalation point for complex cross-border customer reconciliations, regional onboarding due diligence, and multi-country operational inquiries.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Experience: 5 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1–2 years supervising or mentoring accounting staff within a multinational corporate environment. Experience managing or supporting Central American entities is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Technical & Tax Expertise: Deep expertise in Mexican electronic invoicing/tax regulations (CFDI 4.0) and working knowledge of Central American tax and statutory requirements. Solid proficiency in local GAAP and working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems. Familiarity with multi-entity financial software and tools such as Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is highly desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Leadership & Analytical Skills: Strong leadership capabilities, attention to detail, and a proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage tight deadlines and multi-country priorities.

job.title: Acquisition Marketing Manager
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Acquisition Marketing Manager to own acquisition marketing operations across FOX One’s paid and owned & operated channels. This role will serve as the central point of organization and communication across campaigns and placements, ensuring creative, timelines, approvals, and execution remain aligned back to the FOX One strategy.

You will manage the day-to-day workflow with our agency partner, keeping paid acquisition campaigns on track from creative specifications through launch. You will also own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements, partnering closely with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi. Across these efforts, you will ensure messaging, assets, and placements are coordinated and consistent while serving as a key resource for campaign status, troubleshooting, and execution.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support media plan development and execution across paid and owned & operated channels to drive subscriber acquisition, keeping multiple concurrent campaigns, creative assets, placements, and deadlines organized and on track
  • Manage the relationship and daily workflow with our outside agency, as well as other vendors and platforms, coordinating campaign specifications, creative assets, timelines, approvals, and deliverables
  • Own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements in partnership with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi
  • Partner with the brand and creative team to request, approve, and traffic assets, and steward creative alignment strategy across campaigns to ensure the right message reaches the right placement and audience
  • Coordinate with agencies, platforms, and vendors on campaign execution and optimization, and serve as a central point of contact providing clear status updates and proactively identifying and resolving execution issues
  • Build and maintain processes and tracking systems, including campaign documentation and trackers, that create visibility across campaigns, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines
  • Conduct competitive and audience research to inform campaign strategy
  • Partner closely with business units and creative teams to ensure assets meet campaign requirements and are delivered on schedule
  • Proactively flag risks, troubleshoot issues, and hold internal and external partners accountable to campaign timelines

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 7+ years of experience in media, ad operations, marketing, or a related area, with demonstrated ownership of campaign strategy or asset creative processes
  • Demonstrated experience stewarding creative alignment, ensuring messaging and assets are seamlessly tailored to and optimized for the right placements and audience touchpoints
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, deliverables, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail
  • Impeccable organizational skills and the ability to build and maintain processes that keep creative and campaigns aligned across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across internal business units, creative teams, and external agency partners
  • Ability to proactively identify and communicate issues, troubleshoot campaign execution challenges, and hold partners accountable to deadlines
  • Occasional flexibility to work evenings and weekends in support of live programming, breaking news, launches, and marquee events.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience working in paid social, CTV, or programmatic campaigns
  • Familiarity with Excel, Airtable, and Figma for campaign tracking, reporting, and workflow management
  • Experience working within a lean team or marketing organization and successfully managing responsibilities across multiple areas

job.title: Director, Media Workflows
job.description:
The Media Workflows department is the connective tissue of FOX Sports’ content operations — an umbrella group spanning post production, live studio playback, workflows from ingest to air for all of FOX Sports’ production and operations teams. FOX Sports produces a wide array of live sports as well as original studio and other programming for air on the FOX Broadcasting Channel, FS1 & FS2, and digital platforms such as FOX One and various social media channels.

As content volume, speed-to-air, and the number of distribution surfaces continue to grow, the department’s mandate is no longer only to keep these workflows running reliably — it is to continuously re-engineer them into a media supply chain that is increasingly software-defined, cloud-enabled, data-rich, and agent-assisted, without compromising the reliability that live production demands.

The Director, Media Workflows carries a deliberate dual mandate: to run today’s post production and live studio workflows and operations with uncompromising reliability, and to lead the transformation of those operations — introducing AI, automation, and orchestration as core, owned outcomes rather than experiments at the edges. This is a single leadership role that both operates the plant and changes it.

Reporting to the Vice President of Media Workflows, the Director oversees all facets of Post Production — managing media teams for post and live productions, technical operation of edit bays, live studio edit/playback systems, and capital projects for improvements across all areas.

Within the first 12–18 months, this Director will have kept live and post production reliably on-air while measurably advancing the department’s transformation: Agents and automation embedded into named workflows with tracked ROI; a metadata and content-as-data foundation in place; a repeatable innovation pipeline moving proofs-of-concept into production; and a workforce actively reskilled for automated/assisted operations. The measure is not that the workflows still run — it is that they are demonstrably faster, more discoverable, more automated, and more resilient than they were.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Production Continuity

  • Oversee workflow practices across technical facilities — hardware, software, and personnel — to meet the creative and operational requirements of all shows and events
  • Architect and maintain content management and workflow systems at an enterprise level, spanning operational requirements for live and post production and administrative management
  • Maintain focus on high-level company objectives while managing the granular, interconnected dependencies of highly visible live production workflows; solves problems appropriately and escalates when necessary
  • Own capital planning and project delivery for improvements across all post production and media workflow areas, sequencing modernization against live-event and craft edit obligations

Automation & Workflow Orchestration

  • Design agentic and human-in-the-loop workflows that embed agents into production, defining where automation acts autonomously and where human review is required, with editorial quality and speed-to-air as the measured outcomes
  • Own the orchestration and automation layer connecting MAM/PAM, playback, and ingest systems —event-driven and API-first — treating these workflows as products with roadmaps rather than facilities to keep alive
  • Accountable for Innovation ROI: define success metrics, tracks adoption and cost-to-value, and retires tools that do not earn their place

Cloud, Hybrid & Distributed Production

  • Accountable for cloud and hybrid media workflows and for remote/distributed post production models, extending edit and playback beyond fixed on-prem facilities, exchanging content anywhere in the world
  • Partner with Engineering to define the reference architecture for where workloads run (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid) based on latency, cost, and reliability

Content Protection & Resilience

  • Accountable for content protection and resilience across a surface widened by cloud services and third-party vendors — partnering with Information Security on vendor and supply-chain risk
  • Ensure automated pipelines fail safely, with monitoring, fallbacks, and recovery paths appropriate to live, no-second-take production

Workforce Transformation & Change Leadership

  • Lead reskilling and role redefinition as automation reshapes media operations, defining how post and live-production roles evolve alongside automated workflows
  • Own management of NABET union freelancers — contract policy, workflow practices, scheduling, budget, and personnel matters — and navigates union relationships thoughtfully through operational and technological change.
  • Serve as change agent for the department, bringing team leads and frontline staff along through transformation with clear communication and prioritized, fluid information

Innovation Pipeline & Strategic Partnerships

  • Run innovation as a repeatable function — structured proofs-of-concept, an emerging-technology evaluation pipeline, and clear graduation criteria from pilot to production — rather than as ad hoc experimentation.
  • Manage strategic cloud, automation, and tooling partnerships, positioning Fox Sports to assert industry leadership in workflow and media-technology advances.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain operational continuity and alignment across Fox Sports — other Operations groups, Production, Engineering, Media Management, technology groups, and Creative Services.
  • Sustain close relationships with production leads to understand evolving workflow needs, and with engineering and technical leaders to align strategy, technology trends, and vendor direction.
  • Further a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, and accountability within post production and, indirectly, across FOX Sports

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 8+ years of professional experience in network-level broadcast and/or post production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud and hybrid media workflows and their operational and cost-governance implications for post-production or broadcast environments.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML into production workflows — not only fluency with tools (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.), but hands-on experience integrating AI services, designing agentic or human-in-the-loop workflows, and evaluating outcomes. Understanding of machine-learning training and implementation
  • Expertise with post production tools across editorial and graphics applications, MAM/PAM solutions, media-centric file-based workflows, and digital file-transfer solutions
  • Strong background in leading technical teams, change management, and enterprise-level business initiatives, with the ability to build consensus and motivate staff across a large landscape
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and documentation skills; proficiency across Google Workspace and collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, Outlook); knowledge of both Mac and PC environments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Education in TV Production, Broadcasting, Engineering, or a related communications field
  • 3+ years of enterprise-level management in a related field; supplemental education in business management
  • Direct or adjacent experience in product development / product management, software engineering, or DevOps — the disciplines behind treating workflows as products and automation as software
  • Familiarity with distributed / HRP (at-home) production models and cloud FinOps
  • Awareness of content-authenticity and provenance standards (e.g., C2PA) and the rights, likeness, and governance considerations around synthetic and AI-modified media

job.title: Director, Product Operations & Delivery
job.description:
El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.

Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:

  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.

Responsabilidades Principales

Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio

  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación

  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras

  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización

  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)

  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación

  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)

  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.
