job.title: Director, Human Resources (FOX Entertainment)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

The FOX Entertainment HR team is seeking a dynamic, business-minded Director of Human Resources to join our HR team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role for an experienced HR leader who can operate with strategic perspective while maintaining a hands-on approach to supporting the business.

Reporting to the EVP, Human Resources of FOX Entertainment, the ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, sound judgment, executive presence, and the ability to build credibility across all levels of the organization.  This individual will be comfortable navigating complexity and change, translating business needs into practical HR solutions, and moving seamlessly between strategic priorities and day-to-day execution.

The Director will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, Learning & Development, and Employee Relations, to deliver an integrated and effective employee experience.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and trusted advisor across the organization, providing guidance on workforce planning, organizational structure, talent strategy, and broader people priorities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the business and proactively identify people opportunities, organizational needs, and scalable HR solutions

  • Partner with leaders on organizational design and change initiatives, helping teams navigate periods of growth, transformation, and evolving business priorities

  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including succession planning, talent reviews, development planning, and performance management

  • Drive employee experience and engagement initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and organizational effectiveness

  • Provide thoughtful, solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on workforce needs, hiring strategies, organizational planning, and competitive offer development

  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, team effectiveness, and management practices

  • Use workforce data, trends, and insights to identify opportunities, influence decisions, and recommend actions

  • Partner across HR functions to ensure programs and practices are effectively implemented and aligned with business needs

  • Support HR initiatives and special projects that advance FOX’s broader people and business strategies

  • Maintain a strong understanding of employment practices, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, preferably in the entertainment industry, supporting complex, fast-paced, or evolving organizations

  • Broad HR expertise across the employee lifecycle, including talent management, organizational design, employee relations, performance management, and workforce planning

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies

  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to navigate complex and sensitive employee matters with discretion

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt effectively to executive, management, and employee audiences

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data and insights to inform recommendations and decisions

  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across HR functions and with stakeholders throughout the organization

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience within media, entertainment, production, digital, or another rapidly evolving industry

job.title: Morning News Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Morning News Anchor/Reporter (Regular Full-Time)

WTTG/WDCA – FOX 5 DC/FOX 5 Plus

If you are an experienced, dynamic, and forward-thinking journalist ready to be a face and voice of morning news in a top-rated market, look no further. FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus, part of the world-leading media brands Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, offers a remarkable opportunity to anchor and report for our dominant morning news team.

Why Join Us?

  • Creative Environment: Work in a fast-paced culture where teamwork and ideas are valued.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with accomplished journalists and media professionals.

  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Operate from our cutting-edge studios in downtown Bethesda.

What You’ll Do

This is a high-impact, dual-role position requiring an agile and creative journalist to contribute to our morning coverage.

  • Anchor Multiple Newscast Blocks: Consistently deliver an engaging, high-energy performance while anchoring and reporting segments of the morning newscasts.

  • Investigative Storytelling: Research, write, and report compelling, impactful stories and features on multiple media platforms against tight deadlines.

  • Live Performance & Ad-Lib: Master the art of the unscripted moment, excelling in live, extended coverage of breaking news and conducting sharp, spontaneous interviews with newsmakers.

  • Source Development: Proactively develop and maintain powerful source networks to generate original, attention-grabbing content.

  • Multiplatform Engagement: Utilize all digital and social media channels to attract, inform, and engage the audience, driving conversations and viewer traffic back to the station.

  • Collaborate for Impact: Work seamlessly with producers, editors, and photographers to ensure captivating, accurate news delivery that connects with viewers and drives ratings.

What We’re Looking For

job.title: Producer/Planner, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re hiring a Producer/Planner to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX Television Stations’ national live-streaming news product. LiveNOW delivers relevant, engaging live news coverage from across the country and around the world, moving seamlessly between breaking stories and major events as they happen. Coverage is live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

 

Based in LiveNOW’s East Coast newsroom at FOX 35 Orlando and reporting to the Executive Producer, the Producer/Planner will research and plan coverage, book live guests, coordinate incoming content, and produce live coverage of breaking news and important events. We’re looking for a resourceful, dependable, highly organized journalist with strong news judgment who can anticipate coverage needs, build relationships, and thrive in a fast-moving newsroom.

 


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research, gather, curate, and produce timely original content, including breaking news and live coverage of major events, for digital, social, streaming, and broadcast platforms nationwide.
  • Help execute the editorial plan and coordinate coverage with FOX owned-and-operated stations and other internal and external partners.
  • Coordinate live video feeds, interviews, reporter hits, and other content for LiveNOW coverage.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across FOX stations and partner organizations.
  • Monitor live video feeds, newsgathering tools, social media, and other sources to identify developing stories, fresh content, and breaking information.
  • Maintain and continuously update the editorial calendar to support short- and long-term coverage planning.
  • Research upcoming events and anticipate coverage and resource needs.
  • Pitch relevant and compelling story ideas.
  • Stay current on breaking news, major stories, and events across the U.S. and internationally.
  • Monitor real-time audience analytics and use insights to inform coverage decisions.
  • Maintain high journalistic and editorial standards.
  • Fill in for Digital Journalists as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3+ years of experience producing news content preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong news judgment and a thorough understanding of journalistic standards.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital news production, including live streaming and video publishing.
  • Proficiency with web-based newsgathering, content creation, and digital analytics tools.
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms and their use in newsgathering and news distribution.
  • Ability to remain composed, accurate, and effective during breaking news and other high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with newsroom teams, FOX stations, and internal and external partners.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and holidays, as required.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience is a plus.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. JOB DESCRIPTION

Come join Southern California’s news leader, FOX Local Los Angeles and KTTV! We are seeking dynamic, adaptable individuals who have a passion for journalism and thrive in front of the camera on broadcast, live hosting, and streaming platforms. We are currently searching for a full-time Streaming Host / Reporter with strong editorial, live interview, and unscripted hosting capabilities. Be part of a winning team in the heart of Los Angeles with a diverse culture that believes in supporting, mentoring, and training our staff.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Successful candidates are versatile newsroom professionals who are curious about the Los Angeles community; creative in sourcing and producing engaging content; and skilled at seamlessly hosting live streams, unscripted breaking news, and field interviews across our digital and broadcast ecosystems.

  • Serve as the on-air face and voice for FOX Local Los Angeles channels, digital platforms, and special coverage.
  • Lead engaging live interviews, host long-form segments, and drive conversational coverage during both breaking news events and scheduled streams.
  • Ditch the script and connect authentically with the audience, driving real-time digital engagement and viewer interaction.

  • Badge Request Processing: Process all badge requests submitted through the Studio ID Portal, meticulously validating photo submissions to ensure they meet mandated requirements, such as being in JPEG format, showing the cardholder only, and featuring a blank or non-distracting background.

job.title: Summer 2027 FOX Entertainment Internship Program - Los Angeles, CA
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

  • Audience Development: Interns will focus on FOX Weather growth initiatives, including projects such as brainstorming and pitching ideas for FOX Weather's growing social media platforms, as well as monitor competitors for areas of opportunity on digital & social
  • Newsgathering: Interns will support and contribute to the daily workflow of Newsgathering Desk by pitching stories, sourcing content, producing live content for FOX Weather and for FOX TV Stations
  • Programming: Interns will support show teams as they drive content development and production for all streaming aspects of FOX Weather. That includes working with the show team, digital and newsgathering to deliver critical weather news and feature compelling weather stories
  • Weather Presentation: Interns will contribute to the daily workflow of Weather Presentation by pitching graphic ideas and working on research related to the various weather stories of the day. job.title: Summer 2027 FOX Sports - Big Ten Network - Internship Program - Chicago, IL
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.


Please note that this internship is an on-site opportunity in Chicago, IL.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program 
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record 
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned Internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Chicago, IL

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and sports media industry

 

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-page resume (PDF preferred) 
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred) 
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest 

 

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SUMMER 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

 

AREAS OF PLACEMENT:
Depending on your area of interest, you’ll have an opportunity to participate in one of the following below. Please include one top area in your cover letter. 


  • Marketing: Hands-on experience working with brand, sports marketing, social media promotion, event planning and to help with its event marketing initiatives; BTN Big 10K, Football Media Days and B1G Tailgate.
  • Sponsorship: Assist the Big Ten Corporate Partnership department in managing select Big Ten partner activations, including pre-event planning, on-site event activation (i.e., Football Media Days), and recap reports. The Intern will also assist in selecting Summer 2026 Partner Events. 
  • Studio Production: The studio production Intern will help us prepare for the upcoming season, as well as assisting with production of B1G Today studio show. Duties will include logging games, finding footage, and researching historical stories. The Intern will also be a part of the planning and production of football and volleyball media days.
  • Broadcast Engineering: Working with the Director of Broadcast Engineering. Engineering Intern will help with installation of new set electronics and performing maintenance on broadcast systems.
  • Digital: The Digital Intern will work closely with the Digital Content, Digital Partnerships, Streaming and Video Operations teams. During the internship, you will have exposure/will be able to support content strategy/social media distribution, video archives, customer relationship management, and digital research.
  • Remote Production: The Intern for the remote production department will work with production staff to help prepare for live game broadcasts on the Big Ten Network and B1G+. This may include working on and preparing for coverage of our fall sports such as football, helping prepare and execute Big Ten Volleyball media days and organizing a variety of production elements and paperwork to get prepared for the upcoming season.
  • Original production: The B1G Network Originals Intern will be responsible for providing production support to our originals team on summer productions. This can range from assisting going through interviews, helping screen and locate footage, helping organize BTN assets, creating player reels and scenic reels, and going on location for Big Ten Football Media Day.

  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives.

job.description:
|Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps|

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

Integrated Media Specialist (Account Executive– Outside Sales)

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Port Huron, MI | Hybrid (Remote + In-territory)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

• Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

• Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

• Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

•  Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

• Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

• Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

• Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

• Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

• Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

• Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

• Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

• Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

• Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update).

• Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

• Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

• Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

• Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

• Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

• Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

• Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

• 401(k) with company match

• Career progression opportunities

• Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

• High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

• Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

• Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

• Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

• Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

• Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

#LI-AM #LI-Remote

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $50,000 and $65,000. $83,333-$108,333 OTE. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a diverse workforce. As such, we will consider all qualified applicants for employment and do not discriminate in connection with employment decisions on the basis of an applicant or employee’s race, color, national origin, ethnicity, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, marital status, personal appearance (including height and weight), sexual orientation, family responsibilities, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), education, genetic characteristics or information, political affiliation, military or veteran status or other classifications protected by applicable federal, state and local laws in the jurisdictions where USA TODAY Co. employs employees. In addition, USA TODAY Co., Inc. will provide applicants who require a reasonable accommodation, as a result of an applicant’s disability or religion, to complete this employment application and/or any other process in connection with an individuals’ application for employment with USA TODAY Co., Inc. Applicants who require such accommodation should contact USA TODAY Co., Inc.’s Recruitment Department at Recruit@usatodayco.com. Applicants must be authorized to work in the applicable location. Applications from outside these regions will be removed from our system after submission.

Inside Sales / Account Advisor – Remote Sales

100% Remote | Full-Cycle Sales | Uncapped Earnings

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: 100% Remote – Work from Anywhere

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help local businesses grow through powerful, data-driven marketing solutions. We bring together marketing expertise, technology, and the reach of a nationally recognized media network to help businesses connect with customers and achieve their goals.

As an Inside Sales / Account Advisor, you’ll work directly with small and mid-sized businesses to understand their needs and connect them with marketing solutions designed to help them grow. You’ll have the opportunity to sell across a broad portfolio of solutions, including SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more.

This is a high-activity sales environment where consistency, resilience, and a willingness to put in the work directly contribute to your success.

About the Role

Our Inside Sales / Account Advisor role is a full-cycle, high-activity sales position for someone who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and owning their results.

You’ll be responsible for developing new business, growing existing accounts, and managing opportunities throughout the sales process. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers through outbound calls and virtual meetings, uncover their marketing needs, and recommend solutions that align with their goals.

This role provides the opportunity to operate with a high level of autonomy while having the support, training, technology, and resources of a nationally recognized organization behind you.

You’ll manage your pipeline in Salesforce, maintain consistent prospecting activity, conduct virtual client meetings, present tailored marketing solutions, and help ensure a smooth transition from sale to campaign launch.

In your first 90 days, you’ll participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales approach, build your pipeline, and develop the habits needed to succeed in a high-activity sales environment. As you ramp, you’ll take increasing ownership of your pipeline, client relationships, and revenue goals.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission, with an expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K and top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee to support you while you ramp

• 100% remote work environment with the flexibility and autonomy to work from wherever you perform best

• Full-cycle sales ownership, from prospecting and discovery through close and post-sale support

• Opportunity to sell an extensive portfolio of digital and traditional marketing solutions

• Contests, incentives, and recognition programs for top performers

• Strong onboarding, training, coaching, and career development

• Career growth opportunities across the organization

• Backed by marketing expertise, Salesforce, and a nationally recognized brand

• Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and more

What You Will Do

• Drive new business and grow existing accounts through 50+ outbound calls per day and consistent prospecting

• Conduct virtual client meetings to uncover business needs, challenges, and growth opportunities

• Build and manage a strong sales pipeline in Salesforce

• Prospect for new business while identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts

• Recommend and sell bundled, multi-channel marketing solutions based on client goals

• Present marketing solutions across areas such as SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more

• Manage opportunities throughout the sales process and consistently work toward revenue goals

• Maintain accurate CRM activity, pipeline information, and follow-up

• Coordinate with internal teams on creative assets and campaign setup to help ensure a successful post-sale experience

• Consistently meet activity expectations and performance goals in a fast-paced, high-activity environment

Qualifications

• 2–5+ years of sales experience, with B2B or high-activity sales strongly preferred

• Confidence with outbound prospecting and engaging new clients

• Ability to manage a pipeline and consistently follow up with prospects and clients

• Strong communication, organization, and follow-through

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and conducting virtual meetings

• Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools is a plus

• Interest or exposure to digital marketing is helpful, but not required

• Ability to work independently and stay motivated in a fully remote environment

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Advisors are consistent, resilient, self-motivated, organized, and driven to succeed. They’re comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new prospects, handling rejection, and staying focused on the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy a fast pace, like having clear goals to work toward, and take ownership of your results. The strongest performers understand that success comes from consistent daily activity, strong follow-through, coachability, and a willingness to keep improving.

You’ll have autonomy in your day-to-day work, but you won’t be on your own. LocaliQ provides the training, coaching, tools, and support needed to help you build your skills and grow your career.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales process, build your pipeline, establish consistent prospecting habits, and ramp toward goal.

6 Months:

Demonstrate strong product knowledge, maintain consistent activity, manage a healthy pipeline, and establish steady sales performance.

12 Months:

Operate at full productivity across multiple products, effectively manage your pipeline and book of business, and consistently deliver against revenue and activity goals.

Benefits

We believe strong performance should be supported through competitive compensation, development, and opportunities to grow.

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission

• Expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K

• Top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee

• 401(k) with company match

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options

• PTO and paid holidays

• 100% remote work environment

• Career progression opportunities

• Ongoing coaching and professional development

• Incentives, contests, and recognition programs

• Access to industry-leading sales and marketing tools

• Training and support from experienced sales leaders

Build Your Future with LocaliQ

If you’re motivated by earning potential, enjoy building relationships, and want the opportunity to own your success, LocaliQ offers a place to build your sales career.

You’ll help local businesses grow, develop valuable sales and marketing expertise, and have the autonomy to make an impact—all while working remotely.

If you’re ready to put your skills to work and grow with a winning team, we encourage you to apply.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation reflects multiple factors, including (but not limited to) geographic market, education, skills, certifications, and experience. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

• Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

• Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

• Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

• Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

• Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

• Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update).

• Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

• Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

• Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

• Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

• Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

• Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

• Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity (first year earnings at Goal $91,666-$100K+)

• 401(k) with company match

• Career progression opportunities

• Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

• High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

• Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

• Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

• Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

• Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

• Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

job.description:

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

Audience Editor, Entertainment

USA TODAY is looking for an innovative, high-energy, data-driven Audience Editor to lead audience engagement strategy for our Entertainment coverage.

As a key member of our reimagined USA TODAY audience team, you will utilize your expertise to enhance audience growth, engagement and revenue generation for USA TODAY Entertainment. This role is right for you if you’re passionate about entertainment, from movies and music to television, celebrity news, books and content creators. You understand how audiences discover and engage with entertainment coverage and continually explore new opportunities across social media, video, newsletters, search and emerging platforms. You combine strong news judgment with audience insights to test new approaches, identify opportunities and turn successful ideas into repeatable strategies.

The ideal candidate is as comfortable interpreting data and platform analytics as they are connecting with audiences on TikTok, Reddit, Instagram or through a newsletter. You understand that the audience is at the heart of everything we do. You will also be expected to monitor trends in the broader creator industry and identify ways to translate relevant tactics into strategies for our newsrooms.

This highly-collaborative role will be accountable for translating broader business and newsroom strategies into actionable steps for the journalists on the Entertainment team. The successful candidate will oversee a small team of content creators to put our best foot forward at every step of the audience journey. As such, you should be comfortable leading through both direct management and influence, building productive relationships with peers and partners throughout the organization.

The right editor will embrace the opportunity to introduce new ideas, improve established practices and help colleagues adapt to a rapidly evolving audience landscape. You will bring energy, resilience and a commitment to turning strategy into measurable action.

This role may require working extended hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly, when news requires it.

This role must be based in New York.

Responsibilities:

• Develop strategies, workflows and best practices to rapidly achieve audience growth on search, social and newsletters in collaboration with the greater USA TODAY audience team and the USA TODAY Entertainment leadership team.

• Monitor analytics for USA TODAY Entertainment both on platform and on social, in newsletters and alerts, translating that data into action steps for journalists on your direct team and on the broader Entertainment team.

• Lead audience planning for major events, tentpoles and breaking news, determining how our journalism should be packaged, distributed and presented at each stage of the audience journey.

• Create, edit or optimize audience-focused content during major events and breaking news when needed.

• Partner with the content monetization team on new efforts to monetize our journalism and grow audience on social media and distributed platform channels.

• Manage a team of content creators charged with ensuring consistent brand strategy, voice and execution across platforms for USA TODAY Entertainment, including social channels, newsletters, section fronts, app alerts and wherever our journalism meets the audience.

• Create and monitor reporting and KPI progress, including metrics for loyalty, engagement, relevance and other business goals.

• Be an innovative, creative thinker that is willing to experiment to support company's goals.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• At least 5 years of newsroom experience, preferably in an audience development role at a digitally-focused media organization with expertise in entertainment.

• Journalism experience and prior management experience are mandatory.

• A proven passion and experience with storytelling via social media, search and newsletters, with expertise in platforms such as Reddit, Discord, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, Threads and more.

• Passion for helping news organizations distribute indispensable journalism and building trusted relationships with readers.

• Proactive leader who can manage their time and prioritize tasks independently.

• Devotion to peer-to-peer training, as both a teacher and student.

Technical specifications:

• Experience using Google Analytics and Parse.ly or similar tools, experience with using AI to analyze data is a plus.

• Expertise in platform-specific data tools such as Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Salesforce is required.

• Experience with third-party distribution tools like Hootsuite, True Anthem and Echobox is preferred.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.

• Familiarity with news products and journalism and understanding of media analytics and ethics.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. Your resume – one to two pages.

2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

3. Examples of at least three projects or strategies that you’re proud of and had a hand in leading in the area of audience engagement. Please include a brief description of the work, your role and any relevant KPIs or results.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

You are comfortable on camera and know how to build a personal connection with audiences through compelling, platform-native storytelling, particularly video, social media and newsletters.

This is not a traditional producer, social media or newsletter management role. Your primary focus will be creating distinctive content and designing a cohesive off-platform audience experience. You will work strategically across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and emerging platforms to reach younger and traditionally underserved audiences, deepen engagement and turn successful ideas into repeatable growth strategies.

This role may require working extended hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly, when news requires it.

This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

• Curate and program the USA TODAY Sports homepage and craft app alerts to showcase timely, relevant, and high-performing content.

• Create engaging social content that reflects USA TODAY’s voice and resonates with USA TODAY Sports audiences, including video.

• Curate and/or write our USA TODAY Sports newsletters, deepening 1:1 connection with our audience.

• Partner with reporters, editors, and audience development teams to amplify coverage and identify promotional opportunities, including live events, comments and AMAs.

• Execute on our user-generated content strategy, packaging this content for use on site and off-platform, in addition to managing influencer outreach and partnerships as needed.

• Assist with optimization of on-site content for discoverability.

• Experiment with emerging platforms and tools to further accelerate our audience growth.

• Help with live coverage for breaking news and tentpole events.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 3+ years of experience, preferably in a digitally-focused news organization. Journalism experience or education is mandatory, as is sports specific experience.

• Experience creating content optimized for social media, newsletters or search and experience with SEO, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok at a minimum.

• Commitment to detail, accuracy and fairness and an understanding of journalistic ethics and best practices.

• Ability to multitask and excel under deadline pressure, using time efficiently.

• Comfort using analytics tools such as Parse.ly, Google Analytics, Google Trends, and social and newsletter engagement insights to make data-informed decisions is also a plus.

Technical Specifications:

• Comfort using analytics tools such as Parse.ly, Google Analytics, Google Trends, and social and newsletter engagement insights to make data-informed decisions is also a plus.

• Expertise creating content on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram is required at a minimum.

• Experience with video editing tools in-app, and third-party tools like Canva, Premiere and more.

• Experience with third-party distribution tools like Hootsuite, True Anthem and Echobox is preferred.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate across teams.

• Familiarity with news products and journalism and understanding of media analytics and ethics.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. Your resume – one to two pages.

2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

3. At least three examples of work that you’re proud of in the area of content creation (These could be social media posts or videos, newsletters, or stories you’ve written with search in mind). At least one video is required.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

Job title: Data Science Manager

Job Location: Virtual, New York, NY

Job Description:

Reachlocal Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of USA TODAY Co.

Lead a team of data scientists/analysts in the design, development, and deployment of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions to address complex business problems. Design and deploy predictive models and machine learning algorithms, ensuring model accuracy, scalability, and seamless integration with enterprise systems through collaboration with data engineering teams on efficient data pipeline architecture. Drive organizational data and strategy and partner with business leaders to deliver actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Establish and enforce data science standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks to maintain data integrity and compliance. Evaluate and implement cutting-edge tools and technologies in AI, machine learning, and big data to maintain a competitive advantage. Coordinate project delivery timelines, resource allocation, and budget management for data science initiatives. Monitor and report on key performance indicators for data analytics programs, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. Supervises 2 direct reports at a Data Scientist level. 100% Telecommuting permitted.

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or a foreign equivalent plus 3 years of post-baccalaureate experience in job offered or any leadership role in data science or analytics.

Requires 3 years of experience in:

1. Applying descriptive statistics and identifying data trends with machine learning algorithms

2. Building and optimizing model performance with R programming and Python

3. Designing and implementing deployment environment, scaling the models and resolving issues using AWS, AZURE, Docker cloud technologies

4. Evaluating data structure and performing data transformation with R, Python and MySQL

5. Preparing analytics reports with ggplot and Rshiny visualization packages to stakeholders and team members to improve KPIs

6. Managing and mentoring a team of data scientists and analysts, setting performance metrics and team goals.

100% Telecommuting permitted.

Salary range: $189,259 – $195,000//year

Office Administrator – Public Notices

Location: Green Bay, WI – Green Bay Press-Gazette

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

Pay: $15.73/hour

Work Arrangement: In-office – off N. Broadway

Ready for a Change From Retail, Restaurants, or Customer Service?

Maybe you're good at working with people, staying busy, and handling multiple things at once but you're ready for a Monday–Friday office job where you can build new skills and have a more consistent routine.

You don't need years of office experience to be successful here.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay team. This is an opportunity to take the skills you've already developed in retail, restaurants, hospitality, customer service, call centers, or other fast-paced environments and put them to work in an office setting.

You'll learn our systems and processes while helping customers, working with internal teams, processing information, and making sure important public notices are handled accurately and on time.

What Your Day Could Look Like

You'll have a mix of responsibilities throughout the day, including:

• Helping customers and sales representatives with questions about public notices

• Responding to emails and phone calls

• Entering information into computer systems

• Reviewing information and proofs for accuracy

• Processing public notices and advertisements

• Keeping track of deadlines and making sure work gets completed on time

• Working with different teams to resolve questions or issues

• Learning new systems and processes through hands-on training

It's a role where being dependable, organized, and willing to learn can go a long way.

What You Bring

You don't need a perfect resume or years of administrative experience.

We're looking for someone who:

• Shows up and can be counted on

• Enjoys helping people

• Is comfortable using a computer

• Pays attention to details

• Can stay organized when there are multiple things happening

• Communicates professionally with customers and coworkers

• Is willing to learn something new

• Takes pride in doing a job correctly

Retail, restaurant, hospitality, call center, receptionist, customer service, or other people-focused experience can translate well into this position.

Previous office or public-notice experience is not required. We'll train you on our systems and processes.

Notary experience isn't required either — we can assist with becoming a notary if needed.

A Different Kind of Workday

If you're ready to take the next step from a customer-facing or fast-paced environment, this is an opportunity to build office, administrative, computer, and customer service experience while working a consistent Monday–Friday schedule.

You'll also have access to:

• Health, Dental & Vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid Time Off

• Company holidays

• Training and development opportunities

• A supportive team environment

If you're ready to trade unpredictable schedules, nights, or weekends for a steady Monday–Friday office opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

The Event Operations Manager is responsible for planning, producing, and executing operational components for assigned endurance events across the Ventures Endurance Events portfolio. This role supports events from initial planning and permitting through onsite execution and post-event closeout, working closely with cross-functional teams, vendors, municipalities, and internal stakeholders.

This role is primarily remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near the Chicago region due to event density, operational needs, and proximity to the Ventures Endurance Events office and warehouse. While day-to-day work may be performed remotely, team members are expected to work from the office and/or warehouse as business needs dictate, including collaboration, planning sessions, event preparation, inventory management, and other operational activities. The Event Operations Manager reports to the Sr. Manager, Event Operations and supports multiple brands and event types across the organization. Travel and weekend work are required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Plan, produce, and execute operational components for assigned events from contract execution through post-event closeout.

• Manage race-related operational elements including timelines, site plans, course layouts, public safety plans, and parking plans.

• Oversee event course and site layout development, load-in/load-out, and onsite execution.

• Manage onsite event inventories including equipment, branding, collateral, registration materials, and volunteer supplies.

• Secure and document required permits and approvals in coordination with internal leadership.

• Prepare and submit accurate documentation, maps, and supporting materials to municipalities, agencies, and partners.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with local jurisdictions, public agencies, and third-party partners.

• Conduct vendor and contractor outreach, quote analysis, negotiation, and management before, during, and after events.

• Track vendor contracts, deliverables, and payments, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

• Support established event budgets and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Volunteer, Customer Service, and other internal teams to ensure consistent participant communication.

• Support marketing and community engagement initiatives, including outreach to run clubs, community groups, and partners.

• Participate in community activations, expos, and promotional events as needed.

• Maintain a database of community and partner contacts and support event amenity programs.

• Provide onsite leadership for assigned events and contribute to long-term event development with a participant-first mindset.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 1–3+ years of event, race, or live event operations experience.

• Experience working outdoor athletic or endurance events preferred.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

• Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

• Demonstrated leadership and ability to work cross-functionally.

• Ability to lift and/or carry up to 50 lbs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL:

• Remote work environment with occasional in-office days, where needed, with travel required.

• Approximately 50% travel throughout the year.

• Weekend and non-traditional work hours required based on event schedules.

• Flexibility in scheduling required to meet event production timelines.

ABOUT VENTURES ENDURANCE EVENTS:

Ventures Endurance Events produces world-class, community-centric endurance events that engage, empower, and celebrate every participant. As part of USA TODAY Network Ventures, we create impactful consumer experiences through events, promotions, and technology that connect communities and partners nationwide.

Inside Sales Representative – Events

Community Choice | Inside Sales | Uncapped Earning Potential

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Brand: Community Choice

Work Arrangement: Inside Sales

About Community Choice

At Community Choice, we connect local businesses with the people and communities they want to reach through exciting events, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.

Powered by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network, we combine local connections with the resources and expertise of a nationally recognized media organization. Our team helps businesses get in front of their ideal customers while creating memorable experiences within their communities.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play a key role in bringing those partnerships to life. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers, uncover their goals, introduce sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and help create partnerships that deliver visibility and value.

If you’re energized by competition, motivated by results, and enjoy the thrill of turning a cold prospect into a new client, this could be the opportunity for you.

About the Role

This is a full-cycle, high-energy sales role where you’ll own the process from the first conversation through the close.

You’ll spend your day prospecting for new business, connecting with small and medium-sized businesses, presenting event sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and building relationships with decision-makers.

You’ll manage your own pipeline, work toward monthly revenue and activity goals, and use Salesforce CRM to stay organized and keep opportunities moving forward.

The role is built for someone who enjoys having clear goals, wants their effort to directly impact their earnings, and thrives in an environment where activity, persistence, and results matter.

With strong training, sales tools, marketing resources, and leadership support behind you, you’ll have the opportunity to build your sales skills while growing your book of business.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $19.24/hour base pay + uncapped commission

• On-Target Earnings of approximately $65K

• Top performers earning $100K+ annually

• Opportunity to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close

• Sell exciting event sponsorships, advertising, and promotional partnerships

• Work with local businesses and help them increase their visibility in the community

• Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing sales development

• Access to Salesforce, marketing resources, lead support, and sales tools

• Clear opportunities for career growth and advancement

• Collaborative, high-energy team environment with strong leadership support

• Backed by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

What You Will Do

• Own the full sales cycle by prospecting, qualifying, presenting, negotiating, and closing new business

• Conduct consistent daily outbound outreach to small and medium-sized businesses

• Build relationships with business owners and key decision-makers

• Identify business goals and recommend event sponsorship and advertising opportunities that align with those needs

• Build, manage, and maintain a strong sales pipeline using Salesforce CRM

• Conduct sales presentations and confidently communicate the value of Community Choice opportunities

• Consistently work toward and exceed monthly revenue and activity goals

• Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional solutions

• Maintain accurate CRM notes, activity tracking, pipeline information, and forecasting

• Stay persistent and engaged throughout the sales process to turn opportunities into new partnerships

Qualifications

• 2–5 years of proven sales experience, with B2B, outbound, or account acquisition experience preferred

• Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales goals or quotas

• Experience with consultative or solution-based selling

• Confident communicator with a strong phone presence

• Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and initiating conversations with new prospects

• Strong closing and negotiation skills

• Highly self-motivated, organized, and competitive

• Comfortable working in a performance-based, commission-driven environment

• Ability to manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up

• Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus

• Bachelor’s degree or media/advertising sales experience is a plus

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, persistent, confident, and motivated by results. They enjoy picking up the phone, starting conversations, overcoming objections, and finding a way to move an opportunity forward.

You don’t need to be an events expert on day one. What matters most is your ability to build relationships, ask good questions, handle rejection, stay organized, and keep pushing toward the next opportunity.

If you enjoy a fast pace, clear goals, and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your own performance, you’ll find plenty of room to grow here.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Complete onboarding and product training, build your prospecting habits, learn the Community Choice event portfolio, and begin developing a strong sales pipeline.

6 Months:

Consistently prospect, manage a healthy pipeline, conduct confident sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue and activity goals.

12 Months:

Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against revenue goals, build a strong book of business, and identify opportunities to expand your impact and earnings.

Benefits & Growth

We want our sales team to have the tools, training, and opportunity to build a successful career.

• $19.24/hour base pay

• Uncapped commission

• ~$65K OTE

• Top performers earning $100K+ annually

• Comprehensive onboarding and sales training

• Ongoing coaching and professional development

• Salesforce and industry-leading sales tools

• Marketing resources and lead support

• Career progression and advancement opportunities

• Collaborative, high-energy sales culture

• Leadership support focused on helping you succeed

Make an Impact. Build Relationships. Get Rewarded.

Community Choice gives you the opportunity to sell something businesses can get excited about—events and experiences that put them directly in front of their communities and customers.

If you’re ready to build relationships, chase big goals, and turn your sales ability into uncapped earning potential, we want to meet you.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

The Merchandise Manager is responsible for owning and executing the financial targets for the RAGBRAI merchandise program. This role drives product mix, planning, and buying strategies to improve product quality, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.

The Merchandise Manager oversees the merchandise program, including management of the Shopify storefront, live events, the RAGBRAI HQ retail space product launches, and online inventory. This role works closely with Marketing and Creative teams to develop compelling merchandise assortments, coordinate product launches, and ensure brand consistency across both online and on-site retail channels.

Merchandise Planning and Financial Management

• Analyze historical sales data, leverage registration trends, and use market insights to set revenue targets and inventory strategy.

• Partner with Event Director to align financial goals by building and managing detailed merchandise budgets and forecasts.

• Manage the purchasing process from order placement through production and delivery timelines.

• Develop analytical and data-driven financial models to track sales performance and refine projections and forecasts.

• Own post-event financial recaps, including SKU-level sales analysis, margin performance, and year-over-year comparisons.

• Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and reduce excess inventory.

• Maintain clean, organized financial documentation for all merchandise orders to support Accounting & Finance processes.

• Develop and manage the annual merchandise calendar, aligning product drops and campaigns with the broader marketing schedule.

Product Sourcing, Development and Buying

• Build product orders and collaborate with the Creative team to develop assortments that align with event brand identity, customer demand, and profitability targets.

• Determine product mix, pricing strategy, and inventory depth, ensuring cost and budget projections are updated as needed.

• Source products that meet desired aesthetic direction, quality standards, trends and cost targets.

• Work with Creative team to develop merchandise concepts, artwork applications, and product specifications.

• Manage product development timelines and production calendars for events and ecommerce program

• Research and source new vendors, and maintain strong relationships with an established vendor base.

Ecommerce & Digital Merchandising

• Manage the online merchandise store through the Shopify platform, including product listings, inventory updates, pricing, and promotions.

• Ensure product pages are optimized with accurate descriptions, size charts, imagery, and inventory availability.

• Coordinate product launches with marketing campaigns and event calendar.

• Monitor ecommerce performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and online sales.

In Person/Retail Events

• Works with Expo Event Ops Coordinator to secure placement in each location

• Responsible for managing a team of contractors or volunteer staff facilitate quick and smooth point-of-sale transactions

• Perform physical duties as required by the role, such as moving equipment or transferring merchandise between locations

• Inventory management, assisting guests with purchases, and overseeing sales transactions while maintaining a positive atmosphere

• Implement dynamic event retail activations and strategies to maximize sales growth and improve customer experience

• Assist with operational tasks and contribute to a positive shopping experience through merchandise upkeep and customer engagement

• Act as a brand ambassador for RAGBRAI, its local sponsors and venues

Merchandise Marketing & Collaboration

• Partner with the Marketing team to promote merchandise through email, social media, and digital campaigns.

• Collaborate with Creative and graphic design teams to develop artwork, product concepts, and branded merchandise collections.

• Support merchandise storytelling and promotional initiatives that drive both online and event-based sales.

• Provide product insights and sales trends to inform future merchandise and marketing strategies.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Worker Characteristics

• 3–4 years of experience in retail merchandising, planning, or buying.

• Experience in revenue optimization, product development, and merchandising strategy.

• Deep understanding of merchandising and marketing strategies within a retail environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.

• Working knowledge of ecommerce platforms such as Shopify.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and external partners.

• Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment in all business interactions.

• Proactive, analytical, and collaborative mindset with strong attention to detail.

• Creative and curious mindset with an interest in fashion, merchandise, and live events.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain effective in high-pressure environments.

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Willingness and ability to travel and work non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends during events.
