USA TODAY is looking for a high-energy, audience-focused Messaging Specialist with journalism experience (required) to monitor and advise on the performance and innovation of USA TODAY’s messaging portfolio – focusing primarily on email newsletters.

The ideal candidate is passionate about preserving the future of news through innovative storytelling and engagement experiences. This role is right for you if you’re constantly monitoring the latest trends in messaging (including email newsletters, SMS, WhatsApp, Discord) and emerging platforms and love to experiment and innovate.

As a key strategic leader on the new USA TODAY audience team, you will combine expertise in newsletter strategy, messaging, data analytics, and platform insights to grow audience and discoverability, deepen engagement, and support new revenue opportunities. You will take a portfolio-wide view of USA TODAY’s newsletter and messaging offerings, translating editorial and business priorities and audience needs into experiences that are timely, relevant, and engaging.

You will also help strengthen audience engagement across the newsroom by coaching journalists on effective newsletter and messaging practices that build trust and loyalty. The successful candidate will be a collaborative, strategic thinker who can work across divisions and translate company-wide priorities into clear, actionable plans for the newsroom.

Help us ensure the future of journalism is strong and that our newsroom continues to evolve to meet the needs of a growing digital audience.

This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

• Lead USA TODAY’s email newsletter and messaging strategy, working with USA TODAY leaders and the broader USA TODAY audience team to assess our portfolio and performance, develop audience journeys and drive innovation.

• Own flagship newsletter and messaging products, partnering with newsroom teams to increase discoverability, audience growth, engagement, retention, and revenue.

• Support SMS, WhatsApp and other messaging initiatives throughout the USA TODAY newsroom and broader USA TODAY Network.

• Monitor performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead experiments in partnership with content strategy.

• Adapt platform strategy in real time to deliver timely, relevant experiences during breaking news and major events.

• Translate data points into actionable insights. The right candidate deeply understands data tools and knows how to apply their analytical mindset to content.

• Partner across divisions to improve newsletter revenue and consumer retention.

• Collaborate with AI leads to test and implement tools that strengthen newsletter and messaging efficiency.

• Coach journalists on newsletter and messaging best practices and lead training for newsletter hosts, audience editors, and curators.

• Balance and execute editorial and business priorities while keeping audience needs and broader organizational goals at the center of every decision.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 5+ years of experience in digital journalism or newsroom leadership, including experience in a digital, print, or television news organization. Journalism experience is mandatory.

• 3-5 years of experience in analytics, with a preference for content analytics.

• Experience curating newsletters, growing newsletter audiences, and developing innovative messaging strategies.

• Strong knowledge of the digital media landscape and the role newsletters and messaging plays in audience engagement, discoverability, retention, and revenue.

• Ability to independently manage priorities and execute across competing demands.

• A collaborative spirit, able to lead not only direct reports but peers across the organization and a passion for coaching others.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to align editorial work with audience and organizational goals.

Technical specifications:

• Experience using AI and automation to enhance journalism, newsletters, or messaging workflows.

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Parse.ly, or similar analytics platforms.

• Experience with messaging and email platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud/ExactTarget, Subtext, and Substack.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.

• Familiarity with news products and journalism and understanding of media analytics and ethics.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

2. Your resume – one to two pages.

3. An example or two of a project or strategy that you’re proud of and had a key hand in leading. Please include a brief description of the work, your role and any relevant results.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

Looking for Something Steady?

Not every job needs to be high-pressure, unpredictable, or constantly changing.

Sometimes you just want a reliable Monday–Friday schedule, a team you can count on, work you can take pride in, and a place where your experience matters.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay team.

In this role, you'll help make sure public and legal notices are processed accurately and on time. You'll work with customers, sales representatives, and internal teams while handling a combination of administrative work, customer service, computer-based tasks, and deadline-driven responsibilities.

This is a great fit for someone who is dependable, organized, experienced in working with people, and looking for a stable office environment.

• Process public notices and advertisements accurately and according to deadlines

• Work with customers and sales representatives to answer questions and coordinate notice placement

• Handle emails, phone calls, reports, proofs, and other administrative tasks

Experience Matters — But It Doesn't Have to Be in Public Notices

• Office administration

• Customer service

• Healthcare

• Reception

• Retail

• Hospitality

A Consistent Monday–Friday Schedule

• A supportive team environment

If you're looking for dependable work with a consistent schedule and a team you can count on, we'd like to meet you.

Build Your Experience in a Stable Monday–Friday Role

Are you someone who is organized, dependable, and good at keeping track of the details? Do you enjoy helping people, working with computers, and having a role where every day has a clear purpose?

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for a Public Notice Coordinator to join our team in Green Bay. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build or grow their experience in administration, customer service, data entry, and office operations.

You'll help customers and internal teams make sure important public and legal notices are processed accurately and published on time. You'll have a variety of responsibilities throughout the day, including working with customers, responding to emails and phone calls, entering information into computer systems, and keeping up with important deadlines.

No previous experience in public notices is required. If you have the right attitude, are comfortable learning new systems, and take pride in doing things correctly, we'll provide the training you need to succeed.

What You'll Do

• Process public notices and advertisements, making sure information is accurate and deadlines are met

• Work with customers and sales representatives to answer questions and coordinate notice placement

• Respond to emails and phone calls and provide friendly, professional customer service

• Enter and maintain information across multiple computer systems

• Review proofs, reports, and other information for accuracy

• Coordinate with internal teams to resolve questions or issues

• Keep track of deadlines and changing priorities throughout the day

• Maintain organized and accurate records

• Learn our systems, processes, and requirements through hands-on training

What We're Looking For

We're more interested in your reliability, attitude, and willingness to learn than having a specific background.

You could be a great fit if you:

• Pay close attention to details and like getting things right

• Are organized and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and coworkers

• Are comfortable using a computer and willing to learn new software

• Have a friendly, helpful approach to customer service

Press Operator II

Gannett Publishing Services

Rockaway, NJ

The Rockaway Facility is looking for a full time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our double wide presses. Under the direction of press management & supervisors—the Press Operator Il is assigned to perform printing related tasks that may include, but are not limited to: working as Primary Ink setting or Folder operator, oversight of plate processing; spotting plates; reel set-up & operation; newsprint staging; roll preparation; CMYK ink setting; advanced press operational controls; equipment maintenance; and specified reporting.

Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success.

The primary objective is to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve & maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety.

Optimum quality of printed products.

Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

Candidate must be proficient in Mitsubishi, Wifag or similar newspaper press operations and functions. Must have knowledge of printing techniques, understanding basic ink/water balance, press quality standards.

Read and layout press diagrams accurately to accommodate color demand while maintaining maximum labor and waste efficiencies. Must understand how to layout press runs, install leads, and switch angle bars.

Must be proficient in all reel room operations and procedures.Must understand all reel functions including tensioning system, roll delivery systems, roll/butt diameter, candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.

Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and meet all deadlines.

Forklift and clamp truck certification a plus.

Must have solid organizational and computer skills including good working knowledge of general business and Microsoft software programs.

You must be able to lift/carry up to 75 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator Il spends most working hours on his/her feet. In addition to extended periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure. Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is Full-time shift work, which will include scheduled nights, weekends, and holidays.

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Advisor, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by managing customer relationships, identifying new opportunities, and recommending advertising strategies that drive results. Our Account Advisor role is designed for energetic, disciplined sales professionals who thrive in a high-volume environment and enjoy balancing customer relationships with new business development.

• Strong communication skills with confidence speaking with business owners over the phone.

• Excellent organization, time management, and multitasking abilities.

• Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.

• Ability to quickly learn CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

• Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.

• Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

High performers in this role are disciplined, resilient, and motivated by activity. They enjoy working in a fast-paced sales environment where consistent effort directly influences results. They stay organized while managing multiple client conversations, maintain a strong sense of urgency, and take ownership of their performance every day.

Successful Marketing Account Advisors are naturally proactive, comfortable making outbound calls, receptive to coaching, and energized by building relationships and uncovering opportunities. They understand that success comes from maintaining consistent daily activity rather than occasional bursts of effort.

USA TODAY is looking for a high-energy, audience-focused Social Media Specialist with journalism experience (required) to monitor and advise on the performance and innovation of USA TODAY’s social media portfolio.

The ideal candidate is passionate about preserving the future of news through innovative storytelling and engagement experiences. This role is right for you if you’re constantly monitoring the latest trends in social media and emerging platforms, including in the creator industry, and love to experiment and innovate.

As a key strategic leader on the new USA TODAY audience team, you will combine expertise in social media strategy, data analytics, and platform insights to grow audience and discoverability, deepen engagement, and support new revenue opportunities. You will lead audience-focused experimentation across social media, testing new approaches, formats, and engagement strategies that drive measurable growth.

We’re looking for someone who can anticipate and respond to shifts in platform trends and audience behavior, continually refining strategy while ensuring the consistency of our brand voice and identity across our portfolio of accounts.

In this role, you will also help strengthen audience engagement across the newsroom by coaching journalists on effective social media practices that build trust and loyalty. The successful candidate will be a collaborative, strategic thinker who can work across divisions and translate company-wide priorities into clear, actionable plans for the newsroom. In addition, you will actively represent USA TODAY in strategic conversations with industry and platform partners.

Help us ensure the future of journalism is strong and that our newsroom continues to evolve to meet the needs of a growing digital audience.

This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

• Lead USA TODAY’s social media strategy, working with USA TODAY leaders and the broader USA TODAY audience team to assess our portfolio and performance, develop audience journeys and drive innovation.

• Help USA TODAY develop a cohesive brand identity/style of our journalism on social media and pair content to meet user needs.

• Develop strategies that encompass the entire audience journey, thinking about every action we want a user to take with us.

• Assist newsroom in troubleshooting social media issues and represent USA TODAY in strategic conversations with industry, influencer and platform partners.

• Monitor performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead experiments in partnership with content strategy.

• Translate data points into actionable insights. The right candidate deeply understands data tools and knows how to apply their analytical mindset to content.

• Adapt platform strategy in real time to deliver timely, relevant experiences during breaking news and major events.

• Partner across divisions to improve social media revenue and consumer retention.

• Collaborate with AI leads to test and implement tools that strengthen workflow efficiency.

• Coach journalists on social media and engagement best practices and lead training for reporters, visuals journalists, and editors.

• Balance and execute editorial and business priorities while keeping audience needs and broader organizational goals at the center of every decision.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 5+ years of experience in digital journalism or newsroom leadership, including experience in a digital, print, or television news organization. Journalism experience is mandatory.

• 3-5 years of experience in analytics, with a preference for content analytics.

• A proven passion and experience with storytelling via social media, with expertise in platforms such as Reddit, Discord, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube, Threads and more.

• Strong knowledge of the digital media and creator landscape and the role social media plays in audience engagement, discoverability, retention, and revenue.

• Ability to independently manage priorities and execute across competing demands.

• A collaborative spirit, able to lead not only direct reports but peers across the organization and a passion for coaching others.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to align editorial work with audience and organizational goals.

Technical specifications:

• Experience using AI and automation to enhance journalism, social media or production workflows.

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Parse.ly, or similar analytics platforms.

• Expertise in platform-specific data tools such as Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, and X is required.

• Experience with third-party distribution tools like Hootsuite, True Anthem or Echobox is preferred.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.

• Familiarity with news products and journalism and understanding of media analytics and ethics.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

2. Your resume – one to two pages.

3. An example or two of a project or strategy that you’re proud of and had a key hand in leading. Please include a brief description of the work, your role and any relevant results.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

Join one of the nation's leading digital marketing organizations and help local businesses grow through SEO, search marketing, social advertising, OTT, websites, reputation management, and more. You'll own your territory, build client relationships, and earn uncapped commissions backed by the trusted reach of the USA TODAY Network.

Territory-Based | Remote | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Indianapolis | Virtual (home office with work in field)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

• Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

• Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

job.title: Digital Account Manager
job.description:
Digital Account Manager

(New York, NY or Atlanta, GA)

ESPN Digital and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Digital Account Manager to join our team, based in New York or Atlanta, supporting our Dallas market. The Digital Account Manager oversees the operational execution of digital advertising campaigns and works closely with Marketing Consultants, partners, and cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, delivered on time, and supported with exceptional service. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced sales environment. 

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Oversee the operational execution of digital campaigns, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely delivery throughout the campaign lifecycle. 
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Consultant by working directly with partners to ensure campaigns are executed accurately and deliver exceptional service. 
  • Coordinate copy and creative assets for multiple partner campaigns.
  • Manage the creation of investment campaign presentations and other sales materials for multiple partnerships in collaboration with Marketing Consultants and the Creative Services team. 
  • Maintain CRM records throughout the pre-sale process, including proposal creation, billing schedules, and account updates. 
  • Interpret campaign delivery reports and communicate key performance insights to partners and internal stakeholders. 
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve campaign execution, reporting, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and overall effectiveness while maintaining quality standards and appropriate human oversight.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Consultants and cross-functional teams to support campaign execution and deliver an exceptional partner experience. 
  • Traffic digital campaigns in the ad server, ensuring campaigns launch accurately and align with approved ad specifications. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to Good Karma’s core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Teamwork, and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Two or more years of experience in the digital advertising industry is required. 
  • Familiarity with Google Ad Manager is preferred but not required. 
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize urgent requests, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. 
  • Ability to interpret campaign reporting and communicate relevant performance insights. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently when needed. 
  • Solution-oriented approach with the ability to identify and resolve campaign-related issues.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented sales environment. 
  • Willingness to accept and provide feedback. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word. 

Pay Transparency 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000 - $74,000 annually for both the New York, NY and Atlanta, GA locations. Actual salary will be determined based on factors including experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, location, and internal and external equity.

This role is eligible for full benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, a 401(k) plan, dependent care benefits, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for salary growth based on increased skills, responsibilities, and achievement of targeted goals. 

Opportunity for Growth 

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company. 

How to Apply 

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 1, 2026. All are encouraged to apply. 

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

In addition to credibility, poise, and personality; we’re looking for an anchor who isn’t afraid to head out into the field and break the big stories. Our next anchor/reporter will enterprise exclusives, tell compelling stories, and execute energetic live shots. We are looking for this market’s next leader who isn’t afraid to ask tough questions and will hold those in power accountable. Our anchors are newsroom leaders who help mentor and grow producers and reporters. Our anchors write and edit scripts with conversational communication in mind. We are looking for someone with an excitement about not only what we’re doing now as first informers, but what’s possible in the future. The ideal candidate excels not only in presenting on TV, but also excels on social media and with multiplatform content. If you are versatile and an enterprising self-starter who is fast, and efficient, works well under tight deadlines, can develop sources, and has excellent live reporting skills; this might be a great fit.   • An ability to summarize information into easy-to-understand components

  • Unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards

  • Appears on behalf of the station at public events

  • In-person attendance is required

 

Requirements:

job.title: Broadcast Operations Technician
job.description:
WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced Broadcast Operations Technician to join our Engineering team. This position is responsible for delivering and monitoring the station’s on-air signals from content acquisition through distribution. The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and manage file-based broadcast workflows, including media preparation, playlist management, recording schedules, and robotic camera shot recall.

  • Provide creative input and work with newscast producers and production crew.

  • Staff the master control room to operate and monitor studio and transmission equipment, including:

    • Broadcast automation systems

    • Robotic cameras

    • Satellite downlinks

    • HD video servers

  • Ensure the accurate execution of on-air playlists, commercial breaks, and programming.

  • Perform floor directing duties during live and recorded productions, communicating effectively with anchors, reporters, and other on-air talent to ensure seamless coordination between the production control room and the studio.

  • Operate and monitor news automation systems to ensure clean technical execution of the newscast.

  • Monitor video and audio quality using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and other quality control equipment to ensure broadcast standards are met.

  • Quickly identify technical issues and communicate equipment problems promptly to Engineering staff to minimize operational disruptions.

  • Support station operations during live broadcasts, special events, and remote productions.

Qualifications

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining 

    exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues and respond effectively under time-sensitive conditions.

  • Highly proficient with computers and comfortable learning new software and broadcast technologies.

  • Understanding of newsroom ENPS and video playback systems.

  • Technical know-how to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live newscasts.

  • Experience with file-based media workflows and modern broadcast automation systems is strongly preferred.

  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

  • Valid Pennsylvania driver’s license and dependable transportation.

  • Able to stand for long periods of time.

  • Able to lift and carry 50 lbs.

Preferred Experience

  • Television control room and studio operations experience.

  • Education or training in Broadcast Communications, Electronics, or a related technical field.

  • Technical School degree, Electronics Certification, and/or Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) Certification.

  • Military technical experience is welcomed and will be considered.

job.title: Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)
job.description:
Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)

 

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) is seeking a Digital Creative Content Strategist to support digital content strategies, creative concepts, and original digital series across HMPG broadcast series, digital originals, and upcoming business opportunities. This individual contributor role has no direct reports, though it may help guide editors, freelancers, producers, and production partners on specific executions.

 

Working closely with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager, this role helps shape content from strategy through execution, including building strategy decks, contributing to platform and channel recommendations, ideating digital activations, supporting digital original production planning, working with talent and creators, and occasionally traveling to shoots to capture content. The role also provides creative guidance to producers and editors through post-production. Final creative approval sits with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager.

 

This position reports to the Digital Content Strategy Manager and is based in Glendale, CA, four days per week.

 

Responsibilities

  • Support the development of content strategies by researching platforms, identifying audience trends, drafting content pillars, and preparing first-pass strategic materials. 
  • Contribute platform-specific recommendations that help define what content belongs on each channel, how it should be formatted, audience fit and how it supports marketing goals. 
  • Work with editors, producers, and creative teams to help define the visual look and feel of original digital content, including pacing, graphics, recurring formats, captions, voice, and platform-native treatments.
  • Support business development by ideating digital activations, social extensions, creator integrations, talent ideas, original formats, audience engagement strategies, and practical production approaches for proposed broadcast and digital productions.
  • Support productions and their planning by gathering inputs related to various production departments and timelines.
  • Assist digital productions by preparing shoot agendas, shoot priorities, run-of-show documents, production notes, and creative briefs. May lead to smaller-scale digital shoots or content captures with oversight.
  • Travel to select shoots to support digital capture, production oversight, talent direction, and real-time creative decision-making; capture behind-the-scenes footage, social-first clips, interviews, talent moments, and supplemental assets when needed.
  • Research and recommend digital creators, influencers, editors, freelancers, and production partners.
  • Provide editors and producers with clear creative direction, pacing guidance, platform formatting direction, and visual references.

 

Internet Fluency and Cultural Judgment

  • Live natively on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram as both a viewer and participant. This person does not need platform behavior explained to them and should bring informed opinions about what is working now, backed by real examples. 
  • Be chronically online in the best sense: consuming a high volume of content, developing strong taste, and knowing how to separate signal from noise. 
  • Bring sharp instincts for what feels current versus dated, forced, or unnecessary trend chasing. Understand creator culture, meme cycles, comment behavior, fandom dynamics, and each platform’s tone. 
  • Apply critical judgment to trends, copy, and strategy. This person should eliminate corporate, algorithmic, or AI-generated language, push back constructively, and flag ideas that may look good in a deck but will not connect with a real audience.

 

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media, entertainment, branded content, social video, digital originals, creator-led production, or broadcast-adjacent content development.
  • Proven ability to create content strategy decks, pitch materials, client-facing presentations, creative proposals, or social content plans.
  • Hands-on background developing or producing digital original content, including short-form and long-form formats.
  • Practical knowledge of production planning, shoot logistics, budgeting, staffing, talent coordination, set workflows, and post-production processes.

  • Experience working with editors, producers, creators, influencers, talent, production teams, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with educational, family-friendly, youth, lifestyle, sports, or mission-driven programming is preferred.

 

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of social platforms, digital video formats, audience behavior, creator culture, and platform-specific creative strategy.
  • Comfortable discussing digital analytics, audience growth, engagement, video performance, retention, content optimization, and platform trends.
  • Strong writing skills, including strategic positioning, captions, tone of voice, creative copy, pitch language, and presentation copy.
  • Ability to guide editors and producers on visual style, pacing, structure, graphics, format, and storytelling approach.
  • Familiarity with digital production equipment and workflows, including DSLR or cinema-style cameras, lighting, sound, lavaliers, and field production tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and time-management skills; able to manage multiple shows, deadlines, priorities, and stakeholders at once.
  • Candidates must possess a valid passport with at least 18 months of remaining validity at the time of hire and must be willing and able to travel as needed.

 

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must provide a portfolio or work samples that demonstrate digital content strategy, social-first creative ideas, campaign examples, writing samples, digital video work, or platform-specific content execution. Link documents or upload PDF with links to samples.

 

Education

  • Related experience and/or training will be considered as well as a combination of education and experience.

  • HMPG is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered. 

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve.

 

Benefits

Eligible employees will have access to enroll in health coverage through our partnership with Entertainment Partners’ EP Cares program. 

  • Medical

  • Dental

  • Vision

  • Emotional Wellness Support

  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

 

The estimated base range for this role is $41.00 to $46.00 per hour. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

 

About Company

Hearst Media Production Group(HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries. Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including “Weekend Adventure,” on ABC stations; “CBS WKND,” on the CBS Network; “The More You Know,” on the NBC Network; “One Magnificent Morning,” on the CW Network; “Mi Telemundo” on the Telemundo Network and “Go Time” on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including the company’s dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel, Rovr Pets, and Lucky Dog Channel, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, and Charlotte. HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
WPTZ/WNNE, Hearst Television’s NBC affiliates serving the Burlington, VT / Plattsburgh, NY market, are seeking a Digital Sales Manager to lead and expand our digital revenue. This is a strategic leadership role for a results-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-evolving, digital-first environment and is passionate about developing teams and driving measurable client outcomes.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen digital revenue in a dynamic market, leveraging Hearst’s industry-leading tools, data, and cross-platform capabilities. You will contribute to sales strategy, mentor team members, and help evolve how we support client success.

About the Burlington–Plattsburgh Market
Burlington, Vermont, located along the shores of Lake Champlain, is a vibrant city known for its thriving arts scene, innovative business community, and exceptional quality of life. Residents enjoy true four-season living, with opportunities for sailing and kayaking in the summer, world-class skiing in the winter, and some of the most beautiful fall foliage in the country. The area offers a more balanced and accessible lifestyle than larger metropolitan areas, with short commute times and easy access to nature.

Plattsburgh, New York, offers a welcoming, close-knit community with a revitalized downtown featuring restaurants, shops, and cultural venues. Located on the western shore of Lake Champlain, Plattsburgh provides convenient access to both Burlington and Montreal, allowing residents to enjoy the benefits of a smaller community with access to a broader mix of cultural and economic experiences. 

Job Responsibilities

Revenue Growth and Client Strategy

  • Identify and support new digital revenue opportunities, including non-traditional and emerging solutions

  • Develop strategic responses to client and agency RFPs, with a focus on driving new and incremental business

Operational Excellence and Accountability

  • Support digital revenue forecasting and maintain visibility into performance

Experience Requirements

  • Ability to create persuasive presentations, respond to RFPs, and align solutions to client goals
  • Knowledge of pricing strategy and inventory management to maximize revenue opportunities
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills with clients, agencies, and internal teams

Partnerships Marketing Specialist

 

Overview

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) is seeking a Partnerships Marketing Specialist to support the development of revenue-generating partnership solutions.  This is a full-time role that will be responsible for developing multi-platform media sales materials and supporting the creation of partnership proposals for prospective partners including brands, non-profits, government organizations, and high-net-worth individuals. The ideal candidate has a passion for creating original, unscripted programming across YouTube, linear, streaming, and other digital channels and can effectively showcase the value of co-creating original, branded content in marketing materials.

 

This position reports to the Partnerships Marketing Manager and is in office four (4) days a week at our Hearst office located in Charlotte, NC.

 

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for creating and updating sales materials (e.g. sizzles, one-sheets, development slate, etc.) and interface with appropriate parties on all deliverables

  • Support Manager in the development and strategy of partnership proposals and client presentations, including but not limited to assistance in deck development, coordinating calls between internal stakeholders, and organization of all supporting materials (e.g., budgets, loglines, etc.)

  • Maintain weekly status report of partnership proposals and corresponding economics

  • Serve as a liaison with Research and Digital teams to regularly update key data used in case studies, marketing materials, prospecting, etc.

  • Identify and research areas of opportunity / prospective clients to support sales cycle

  • Develop and implement outbound sales marketing strategy to support Business Development executives in ongoing communication efforts to keep HMPG top of mind

 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant marketing experience

  • Digital / social agency or media company experience preferred

  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills and the comfort to interact with internal stakeholders across multiple levels and departments

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, handle multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines in a cross functional, collaborative working environment

  • Passion for creative writing, and comfort with translating written ideas into sales materials with clean, compelling design

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly related to project budgets and economics

  • Working knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel a must, expert knowledge a plus

  • Receptive to learning new tools/software that support the sales process (e.g., Winmo, Monday.com, Salesforce, etc.)

 

Education

  • Related experience and/or training considered as well as a combination of education and experience

  • HMPG is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communications, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

 

Benefits

Hearst Television's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst Television employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision

  • 401(k) matching

  • Emotional Wellness Support

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • LGBTQ+ Health Services

  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

 

About Company

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries. Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including “Weekend Adventure,” on ABC stations; “CBS WKND,” on the CBS Network; “The More You Know,” on the NBC Network; “One Magnificent Morning,” on the CW Network; “Mi Telemundo” on the Telemundo Network and “Go Time” on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including the company’s dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel, Rovr Pets, and Lucky Dog Channel, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, and Charlotte. HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Local News Producer

KCCI, the CBS affiliate in Des Moines has an opening for a Local News Producer who knows how to create meaningful and memorable newscasts. You have creative vision and have experience making decisions and communicating the plan. You know how to win the big story, own breaking news and display important weather information. You must be fast and able to play well in a room of same-minded pros. Accuracy is job one! You will report to the News Director. 

Responsibilities

  • Select, research, and write content for live newscasts to make the newscast an "experience" for viewers
  • Coordinate with digital and assignment desk teams to ensure consistent coverage across broadcast and online platforms
  • Work with and guide reporters in story production
  • Coordinate creative vision with team of anchors, reporters, meteorologists, photographers, editors, and production staff
  • Boothing assigned newscasts, breaking news and weather events
  • Live timing newscasts 

Requirements

  • Professional or college producing experience
  • Experience working in a newsroom
  • Have writing and copy-editing skills
  • Coordinate several crews and responsibilities simultaneously
  • Experience summarizing information into easy-to-understand components
  • Creative presentation style, and ability to showcase all resources and elements
  • Have and exhibit the highest journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Must be available to work holidays, shifts including nights, weekends and overnights, and flexible with schedule to be available during breaking news
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • In-person attendance is required

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
Local News Reporter

KCCI the CBS affiliate in Des Moines, IA is looking for a Reporter who can create story ideas, conduct informed interviews, develop sources, build compelling live shots, and tell stories across every platform. You will be a strong, take-charge reporter who hits the ground running every day and understands how to shape reporting for broadcast, digital, social, streaming, and mobile audiences. We value strong enterprise reporting and are looking for someone who finds the stories that lead newscasts while also creating engaging, accurate, and timely content that meets viewers wherever they are. In addition to credibility, poise, and personality, you are not afraid to head out into the field, ask the tough questions and break the big stories. You will be a versatile, enterprising self-starter who is fast, efficient, works well under tight deadlines, can develop sources, and has excellent live reporting skills. You will report to the News Director.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, gather and assemble stories on day-of news or special project assignments
  • Work with or without a photographer to gather and edit compelling video and captivating sound
  • Coordinate with news managers and producers to develop stories that go beyond surface details, that accentuate unique enterprise angles, and have exclusive content
  • Develop a network of sources who provide tips, early access to information, and allow the reporter to break stories of significance
  • Will contribute pictures, video and text updates to mobile platforms throughout the day
  • Work on different stories and projects at once and meeting all deadlines under extraordinary pressure.
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards

Requirements

  • Professional or college reporting experience
  • Experience with enterprise reporting and ability to uncover details
  • Your demo reel is indicative of your everyday work
  • Write clear, correct, compelling copy that supports images gathered
  • Operate mobile transmission devices and use latest technology
  • Can work in all weather conditions
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Have a valid driver's license and a clear driving record
  • Work varied shifts, including overnights and weekends
  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive newscast production
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • In-person attendance is required

job.title: Sales Account Associate
job.description:
WBAL-TV, the NBC affiliate in Baltimore, is looking for a Sales Account Associate. The entry level position is a sales training program geared toward developing candidates into Sales Account Executives. As a Sales Account Associate, your first priority is to learn all facets of local television sales while encouraging your natural sales abilities. All sales team members, led by the Local Sales Manager, will contribute to your training and ultimate success. You will report to the Local Sales Manager. The salary range is $40,000 - $45,000.

Training

  • Comprehensive 9-12-month training, with ongoing career development and opportunities through WBAL-TV
  • Learn industry-leading communication and sales techniques
  • Train with top sales producers
  • Learn software skills such as WideOrbit Traffic and Media Sales, Media Monitors, Dynamics, Media Radar, and other sales platforms
  • Learn and work with Nielsen research data
  • Roleplay and practice presentations regularly

Responsibilities

Tasks listed below are all a part of the training regimen for development to Account Executive

  • Assist the development of sales proposals, advertising packages, and client presentations
  • Create supportive marketing materials for the sales department
  • Prepare proposals based on account executive requests
  • Communicate with our teams (including: sales, production, finance) and external clients on performance and delivery of campaigns
  • Enter and maintain all orders including electronic transfer and maintenance of WOCentral orders to WideOrbit
  • Manage sales database

Requirements

  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive projects
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are necessary
  • Excellent social, intrapersonal, and presentation skills
  • Must be focused and organized
  • Proficient in Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets)
  • Must have an enterprising spirit with a goal of becoming a media sales account executive in 9-12 months 
  • Related military experience will be considered

job.description:

In addition to credibility, poise, and personality; we're looking for an anchor who isn't afraid to head out into the field and break the big stories. We are looking for a versatile, enterprising self-starter who is fast, efficient, works well under tight deadlines, can develop sources, and isn’t afraid to jump into newscast scripts.   • Anchor that connects with viewers, in addition to reporting skills

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join Hearst Connecticut Media Group to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Hearst Connecticut Media Group. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Connecticut area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within Hearst Connecticut Media Group, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.
  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

Join us at Hearst Connecticut Media Group and become part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Apply now to make an impact in the Connecticut advertising market!

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $50,000 - $60,000 base plus commissions with on-target earning potential of $90,000 - $120,000 annualized in the 1st year, based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays. 

About Hearst Connecticut Media Group:

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is the leading news organization in the state, serving readers across all platforms through its news and lifestyle portfolio—including CT Insider, The Connecticut Post, Danbury News-Times, Greenwich Time, New Haven Register, The Middletown Press, The Norwalk Hour, The Register Citizen, Republican-American, Stamford Advocate, and Connecticut Magazine. 
 
With the largest news-gathering team in the state, HCMG is deeply committed to providing local, watchdog, and investigative reporting that informs, educates, and entertains the communities it serves. In addition to its journalism, the organization provides innovative, unique advertising and marketing solutions to help local and regional businesses grow and succeed

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 30 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, The Dallas Morning News, Austin American-Statesman, Connecticut Post and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

Be a part of something bigger–Your Headline Awaits

job.title: Audience Intern
job.description:
Audience Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for a curious and versatile student journalist to join its Audience team for the summer 2027 internship program.

Audience journalists help determine how journalism reaches people — and what makes them want to come back. You’ll work alongside editors, reporters and audience strategists to help shape coverage, craft compelling headlines and social posts, engage readers across platforms and use data to understand what matters to our audience.

You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond. You may help package breaking news, promote enterprise reporting, build newsletters, identify search opportunities, analyze reader behavior and develop new ways to connect with audiences. 

This position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in audience journalism and gain hands-on experience in a major newsroom. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor real-time analytics and identify patterns in what readers are viewing, sharing and returning to

  • Help editors and reporters frame stories for maximum clarity, relevance and impact
  • Write and refine headlines, social copy, push alerts and other promotional language with attention to SEO and news value
  • Create social posts and contribute to strategies for platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and more
  • Assist with newsletter planning, writing and audience-focused story selection
  • Help package stories for the homepage and other digital platforms
  • Research search trends, audience interests and emerging platforms
  • Pitch ideas for reaching new audiences and deepening connections with existing readers

  • Collaborate across the newsroom to translate Chronicle journalism into useful, compelling digital experiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

 

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June and to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour. 
  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands. 
  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

 

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 audience-related clips (social media posts, newsletters, alerts, etc.), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our candidates, if you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or regarding the application process, please contact us by email at hnpemployment@hearst.com.  Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Audience Intern, Summer 2027
job.description:
Audience Intern, Summer 2027

The San Francisco Chronicle is looking for a summer intern to join our team of digital producers and audience editors. In this paid, 12-week summer internship, you will embed with the cross-functional teams who produce our website and app, manage our social channels, multimedia initiatives and newsletters and you will gain wide exposure to how we engage readers, listeners and viewers across platforms. Hourly rate is $20.50/hr. Deadline to apply is October 10, 2026.

Requirements: This position is full-time, based in San Francisco and likely Monday-to-Friday. Weekend, evening and holiday work may be required as news warrants.

 

Duties:

  • Receive training and mentoring from editors and colleagues across departments.
  • Draft social media posts.
  • Create digital-first content: Depending on the candidate’s skills, this may include writing articles, shooting and/or editing digital video, and creating content targeted to specific social media channels like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Overall: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with content ranging from breaking news to food guides to sports. Interest in audience engagement work, especially social media strategy and digital-first content. 
  • Multimedia skills a plus: Video and photo editing experience, or interest in creating graphics, photo or video content for social media.
  • Newsroom experience: Strong college publication experience or previous internships preferred, but not required.

 

About The San Francisco Chronicle: 

The San Francisco Chronicle (www.sfchronicle.com) is the largest newspaper in Northern California and the second largest on the West Coast. Acquired by the Hearst Corporation in 2000, the San Francisco Chronicle was founded in 1865 by Charles and Michael de Young and has been awarded six Pulitzer Prizes for journalistic excellence.

Our award-winning journalists provide insight into the people and events shaping the Bay Area, investigate wrongdoing and waste, and deliver the quickest and most reliable coverage of breaking news in Northern California.

Join our team!

With 2,500 employees across the nation, Hearst Newspapers (HNP) represents a network of 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the Austin American-Statesman, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, San Francisco Chronicle and Times Union (Albany). job.title: Breaking News Intern
job.description:
Reporting Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for an adaptable and detail-oriented student journalist to join its Breaking News team for the summer 2027 internship program

Reporting interns will have the chance to work in one of America’s most exciting news markets, reporting and writing timely stories about the events, issues and trends shaping Houston and Texas. They will gain hands-on experience covering stories on deadline, developing follow-ups, pitching story ideas and collaborating with editors, photographers and audience journalists to deliver accurate, engaging coverage.

Past summer interns were essential contributors to our coverage, including reporting on topics like extreme weather events, the FIFA World Cup, social justice protests and political rallies. Our paid internship opportunities have also propelled several former interns to full-time roles on the Chronicle’s staff.

Responsibilities:

  • Report and write timely, accurate stories

  • Collaborate with editors, photographers and the audience team to deliver coverage that meets high standards for accuracy, speed and engagement
  • Pitch timely news stories, keeping a close eye on local and national news sources, social media and Google Trends to identify topics
  • Conduct interviews with officials, witnesses and community members on deadline
  • Verify information from social media, public records and other sources before publication

  • Contribute to live blogs and enterprise follow-ups as news develops

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026.

job.title: Breaking News Reporting Intern, Summer 2027
job.description:
Breaking News Reporting Intern, Summer 2027

The San Francisco Chronicle is looking for a reporter to join our breaking news team. This paid, 12-week internship will receive training and mentoring but also hit the ground running, covering a variety of stories from the office and in the field. Breaking news is the main focus, but there will be opportunities to pursue projects aimed at engaging our audience and to work closely with our data journalism, developer and audience teams. The ideal candidate will hustle and be quick to a story. We are looking for a reporters who enjoys jumping on any and every story that comes up, whether it’s in the areas of weather, criminal justice or public health. 

All college students are encouraged to apply, with preference given to students who are either studying at or have recently completed a degree at a Bay Area four-year or community college. There are two internships in the fall, one in the summer, and one in the spring. 

Requirements: This position is full-time, based in San Francisco and likely Monday-to-Friday. Weekend, evening and holiday work may be required as news warrants. The hourly rate is $20.50/hr. Deadline to apply is October 10, 2026.

Duties: 

  • Receive training and mentoring from editors and colleagues across departments. 
  • Report and write breaking news articles on tight deadlines Contribute to reader engagement projects 

 

What we’re looking for: 

Overall: Someone eager to find and chase good stories, with an eye for the details, headlines, angles and quotes that will capture readers’ attention. Strong writing skills are important, as is a strict dedication to accuracy, fairness and inclusiveness. 

Newsroom experience: Strong college publication experience or previous internships preferred, but not required.
