job.title: Automotive Consultant
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Are you passionate about the automotive industry and energized by helping dealerships grow?

iHeartMedia Automotive is seeking an experienced Automotive Marketing Consultant who understands the dealership business, thrives in face-to-face client relationships, and knows how to build innovative marketing strategies that drive traffic, leads, and vehicle sales.

We're looking for someone who has spent time in dealerships, around dealerships, or working directly with automotive retailers. The ideal candidate understands the challenges dealers face every day, from inventory fluctuations and market share battles to lead generation and fixed operations growth. They can confidently sit across the table from Dealer Principals, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and agency partners, uncover business opportunities, and recommend solutions that produce measurable results.

This is more than a media sales role. It's an opportunity to become a trusted business advisor backed by the industry's largest audio platform, exclusive automotive advertising solutions, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and industry-leading automotive research resources.

If you love the automotive business, enjoy creating marketing ideas that dealers get excited about, and are driven by helping clients win, we'd love to meet you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Automotive Marketing Consultant with iHeartMedia Automotive, you will help dealerships grow market share, increase showroom traffic, generate leads, and ultimately sell more vehicles.

You will:

  • Develop and grow relationships through consistent in-person dealership visits, networking, prospecting, referrals, and business development activities.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Dealer Operators, Marketing Directors, and agency partners.
  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand dealership objectives, competitive pressures, inventory concerns, fixed operations opportunities, and growth goals.
  • Create customized marketing strategies that help dealers drive awareness, shopper engagement, traffic, leads, sales, and service revenue.
  • Leverage iHeartMedia Automotive's comprehensive automotive marketing stack, including:
    • Broadcast Radio
    • Streaming Audio
    • Podcasts
    • Connected TV (CTV)
    • OTT Video
    • Social Media Solutions
    • Display Advertising
    • Influencer Marketing
    • Proprietary Automotive Audience Targeting
    • Automotive Attribution & Matchback Reporting
    • Dealer Traffic Generation Programs
    • Exclusive Automotive Consumer Insights & Research
    • Proprietary Automotive Advertising Solutions
  • Utilize industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper insights, audience intelligence, and consumer behavior data to identify growth opportunities and build strategic recommendations.
  • Present creative, innovative marketing ideas that dealers love and that help their stores stand out in highly competitive markets.
  • Collaborate with automotive strategists, campaign specialists, creative teams, and product experts to develop integrated programs that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling business presentations supported by market intelligence, automotive data, consumer insights, and performance reporting.
  • Conduct ongoing business reviews and campaign recaps that clearly demonstrate results, ROI, and future growth opportunities.
  • Consistently exceed revenue goals through consultative selling, exceptional client service, and long-term relationship development.

---

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

What You'll Get

· Unlimited earning potential through a highly competitive compensation plan and uncapped commission structure.

· Access to one of the most comprehensive automotive marketing platforms in the industry.

· Exclusive automotive products, data sources, and advertising solutions unavailable through traditional media providers.

· Industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper intelligence, and consumer insights.

· Advanced attribution and reporting capabilities that help prove campaign effectiveness.

· A comprehensive onboarding and training program designed to immerse you in our products, processes, and automotive sales strategies.

· Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.

· Eligibility for iHeartMedia's President's Club and CEO's Club recognition programs.

· Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, company holidays, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs.

· The support of a dedicated team of automotive specialists invested in your success.

---

Envision Your First 30 Days

Week 1

Complete onboarding and training focused on iHeartMedia, our culture, automotive solutions, proprietary products, research resources, sales tools, and processes.

Week 2

Partner closely with your manager and automotive team members to understand expectations, territory opportunities, prospecting priorities, and communication rhythms.

Week 3

Begin conducting dealership outreach, developing prospect lists, participating in client meetings, and building customized marketing recommendations.

Week 4

Start actively managing your pipeline, scheduling dealer meetings, presenting ideas, and establishing your growth plan for the months ahead while participating in a 30-day success review with your manager.

---

Why iHeartMedia Automotive?

At iHeartMedia Automotive, you'll represent one of the most powerful and differentiated automotive marketing platforms in the industry.

You'll have access to exclusive automotive advertising solutions, industry-leading research and consumer intelligence, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and the scale of America's largest audio network.

Most importantly, you'll become a strategic growth partner to dealerships, helping them drive more traffic, sell more vehicles, improve market share, and achieve measurable business results. If you're looking for an opportunity to combine your automotive expertise with best-in-class marketing solutions, we want to hear from you.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments

  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs

  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information

  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

                                                                             

Location:

Phoenix, AZ: 4686 E. Van Buren Street, Suite 400, 85008

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Operate broadcast console and studio equipment during live and pre-recorded shows.

  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.

  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement. 

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in real time and escalate as needed.

  • Record, edit, and load audio content for playback using automation systems. 

  • Maintain logs and documentation for regulatory and internal compliance. 

  • Support remote broadcasts and live events as needed. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with broadcast equipment and automation systems (e.g., NexGen, Adobe Audition). 

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant certifications or coursework a plus. 

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Subject matter expertise to conceive and communicate original ideas
  • A growth mindset with knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team
  • Open communication about a variety of complex ideas to encourage a broad point of view and build a team consensus
  • Strong desire for collaboration between teams
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Commitment to continuous process improvement for overall team effectiveness
  • Advanced problem-solving techniques
  • Loaded block programming
  • Double checking AM station logs

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

job.title: Level 2 Technical Support
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

24/7 resource for troubleshooting software, hardware, technology functions, and broadcasting systems across all RCS products and services, with limited support of third-party products or services that interact or integrate with RCS software.

Provides guidance to ensure efficient end-user and internal support services by troubleshooting issues to determine the underlying cause. Utilizes technical support tools to identify problems and provide solutions for end-user and internal support incidents.

Participates in configuring and maintaining various technology functions, including software infrastructure and maintenance, system installations, configuration, upgrades, and maintenance. Responsibilities may also include application programming and analysis, data security, and disaster recovery.

Works with Product Leads and Management to ensure all L1 escalations are appropriately prioritized and addressed.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

• Perform all RCS L1 responsibilities, including answering incoming calls and emails.
• Determine the priority and severity of escalated issues.
• Follow through on escalations to ensure issues are handled according to their priority and severity.
• Participate in a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

• Strong analytical skills.
• Ability to gather and analyze information quickly and effectively.
• Strong interpersonal skills and effective collaboration across QA and Development departments.
• Ability to learn new systems and technologies quickly.
• Experience with various Windows technologies, including but not limited to SQL, IIS, .NET, and basic networking.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
• Ability to work effectively under pressure, particularly when dealing with tight timeframes and difficult or emotional client situations.
• Ability to multitask and prioritize workload, escalating when necessary. Must be able to recognize when an issue requires additional resources while also knowing when to push back on an escalation.
• Desire to approach problems objectively while looking for better and more efficient ways to troubleshoot our products.
• Ability to read, write, and interpret technical documentation.
• Proven experience and knowledge across various RCS products and services.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate at a detailed technical level while also distilling advanced concepts into basic principles for teammates.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function
  • Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
  • Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
  • Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is seeking a Multiplatform Producer-Board Operator to produce and distribute compelling Spanish-language content across digital and social platforms, podcasts, television/video and broadcast radio.

Digital content production will be a primary focus of this role. The ideal candidate is a strong multimedia producer with solid editorial judgment, live production experience and the ability to work closely with on-air talent and Programming to develop content from concept and preparation through live execution, editing, publishing and distribution.

This position requires a Spanish-language-first editorial approach rooted in Miami and South Florida, with a strong understanding of the region’s news, culture, current events and diverse audiences. The producer must be able to identify the local relevance, cultural context and audience angle of local, national and international stories.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

• Create, edit, package and publish daily content for social media, digital platforms, podcasts and broadcast.

.• Identify compelling moments from the show and turn them into platform-appropriate digital content, including short-form video, audio clips, graphics, posts and articles.


• Produce, edit, package and distribute podcast content and other on-demand audio.


• Write headlines, captions, descriptions, articles and other supporting copy for digital content.


• Create and adapt graphics, photos and visual assets for social media and show promotion.


• Schedule, publish and distribute content across social, web and other digital platforms.


• Exercise editorial judgment in selecting timely, relevant and engaging content for digital distribution.


• Monitor digital and social trends and identify opportunities for timely content.


• Maintain brand and visual consistency across platforms.


• Operate the control board and produce live and recorded radio programming.


• Coordinate show elements, audio, playback, callers and other production elements with on-air talent.


• Record and edit audio and video content for broadcast and digital use.


• Monitor programming and troubleshoot basic studio, audio and production workflow issues.


• Support remote broadcasts, special programming, digital productions and live events as needed.


• Coordinate with Programming, Digital, Engineering and other teams as needed.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

• Professional-level Spanish proficiency required, with excellent speaking, writing, reading comprehension and interpretation skills. Must be able to understand and communicate cultural context, nuance and tone when developing Spanish-language content.

• Minimum 2 years of professional television production experience, with experience at a major television network strongly preferred.

• Working English proficiency required for internal communication and collaboration.

• Strong knowledge of Miami and South Florida news, culture, current events and the interests of the region’s diverse Spanish-speaking audiences.

• Strong research, interview preparation and editorial skills, with the ability to quickly understand a topic, identify the relevant angle and provide talent with accurate context and supporting information.

• Experience booking and coordinating guests and interviews preferred.

• Experience creating and managing rundowns and executing live productions, including timing, cues, transitions, interviews, commercial breaks and real-time adjustments.

• Strong understanding of live television and radio timing, programming benchmarks and audience-focused programming strategies.

• Strong audio and video editing skills and proficiency with professional digital content creation and production tools.

• Experience creating, editing, packaging and publishing short-form and long-form video for major social media and digital platforms.

• Experience producing, editing, packaging and distributing podcasts and other on-demand content.

• Strong Spanish-language writing and copywriting skills for social posts, headlines, descriptions, articles and other digital content.

• Ability to create or adapt graphics, photos and visual assets for digital and social use.

• Strong understanding of how content should be produced and packaged differently for television/video, social media, web, podcasts and broadcast radio.

• Strong editorial judgment and ability to identify timely, relevant and engaging content while maintaining accuracy and appropriate context.

• Experience with broadcast consoles and radio production workflows preferred.

• Ability to work quickly and accurately in live production and fast-moving digital environments and adapt when content, timing or priorities change.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to collaborate closely with on-air talent, Programming, Digital and other production teams.

• Flexibility to work varying schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends and special events when required.

  • Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance

  • Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness

  • Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

This leader will drive ratings growth across broadcast, digital, and live events while ensuring the highest quality standards and protecting station licenses. The OM partners closely with the Market President and VP of Sales to fuel revenue growth, strengthen brand identities, and deliver exceptional audience experiences. This role sets the tone for the market — modeling iHeartMedia’s values, developing talent, and ensuring our programming consistently performs at the highest level.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Lead strategy and execution for all programming
  • Identify, develop, coach, and manage Promotions staff, Digital leads, and On‑Air Talent.
  • Analyze ratings and market research to grow audience, identify risks/opportunities, and drive ratings performance.
  • Monitor competitive activity and develop strategies to outperform the market.
  • Partner with Air Talent, Promotions, and Digital teams to strengthen audience engagement and build brand presence across broadcast, digital, and live events.
  • Ensure ongoing investment in original digital content by working closely with On‑Air Talent and Program Directors.
  • Support the design and execution of live events in the market.
  • Oversee day‑to‑day programming operations, including productivity, cost management, technology, production capabilities, and FCC compliance.
  • Provide visible leadership, clear communication, and development opportunities for all direct reports.
  • Drive results through your team, holding them accountable to business metrics and ensuring alignment with sales efforts.
  • Collaborate with central programming resources and leverage shared expertise to elevate market performance.
  • Actively support the Market President and VP of Sales in driving revenue growth, including joining sales calls to provide brand and product expertise.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Experience in programming and digital brand management.
  • Understanding of the markets, listeners, and competitors to drive optimum ratings growth.
  • Understanding of industry trends and revenue drivers.
  • Ability to create and develop a brand that engages audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and an ability to multi-task.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
  • A strong talent mindset – exceptional people management and team performance/coaching experience.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and execute in a fast-paced environment.
  • An undergraduate degree or appropriate combination of education & experience is required.

  • Demonstrated initiative and achievement-oriented leadership

  • Ability to manage several projects at a time

  • Growth mindset and desire for continued knowledge sharing and learning

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions and decisions of your team

  • Strong business insights that contribute to resolving complex problems

  • Catalyst for new and innovative ideas

  • Ability to identify and support new opportunities for continued improvement across business

  • Ability to interact with individuals of all levels and maintain professional relationships

job.description:

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions.


$40,000 - $50,000

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage the promotion and direction of advertising and marketing activities and campaigns as well as improvement of the Company’s product image, market data and information
  • Collaborate with multiple departments to create and execute promotions such as remotes, events, van hits and other street team activities from start to finish
  • Coordinate and attend client meetings with sellers and sales manager as needed to plan events and event logistics
  • Research program and campaign effectiveness; track and report results to management
  • Drive promotional vehicles
  • Perform basic office administrative functions and updates station website
  • Conduct on-site promotions and handle clients and listeners
  • Set up and run audio and other type of equipment; hangs banners and other staging elements
  • Record events (e.g., photos, videos, audio and social media measures) for studio promotions
  • Set up, break down and transport promotion event equipment as required
  • Prepare contest rules, waivers and release forms for on-air, digital, social media and other contests
  • Supervise prize inventory
  • Coordinate and oversee on-site appearances, remotes and events
  • Responsible for all winner prize fulfillment and release forms
  • Manage the day-to-day execution of station promotions from initial concept through completion.
  • Keep multiple promotions, contests, events and sponsorships organized and moving forward simultaneously.
  • ​Meet all established deadlines
  • Execute programming and sales campaigns.
  • Write station copy
  • Communicate weekly with station talent
  • Coordinate with programming and talent on contesting themes and promotional opportunities.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Significant previous experience in outdoor promotions and/or marketing and/or customer service

  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, Photoshop and social media platforms

  • Excellent organizational skills; ability to prioritize and effectively manage time

  • High work standards and attention to detail

  • Project management from start to finish; assume responsibility and accountability for assignments and tasks

  • Actively listening skills; clearly and effectively conveys information; demonstrate effective business writing skills; show excellent grasp of grammar

  • Exhibit good interpersonal skills; collaborates with others; maintains composure when faced with difficult situations and personalities

  • Physical ability to stand for multiple hours and lift or move 40-pound objects

  • Valid state driver’s license and proof of insurability; excellent driving record

  • Four-year college degree (emphasis in Communications, Advertising and Marketing) or equivalent work experience

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong organizational and project-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively with Sales, Programming, talent, digital teams and Street Team staff
  • Strong creative instincts
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to adapt quickly
  • Experience with social media platforms and digital content management.
  • Radio, media, promotions, event marketing or related experience preferred.

What We Need:

The Research Analyst provides quantitative and qualitative research insights to support our sales and marketing teams. Working within a multi-functional team, the position offers the ability to work within a fast-paced, exciting company that is at the forefront of the growing audio landscape, including radio, streaming audio, digital and podcasting. This position provides opportunities to further develop and learn new skills across all facets of marketing and media research, including syndicated research, primary research projects, and advertising effectiveness studies, working across a mix of categories and brands. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants a chance to be at the forefront of measurement in a rapidly evolving industry.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Utilize primary and syndicated research tools to provide quantitative and qualitative data for prospective and current advertisers

  • Create insightful data driven presentations that meet the needs and objectives of internal sales teams, agencies, and clients

  • Fulfill ad-hoc sales research requests across a variety of data types, including audience metrics, consumer insights, competitive advertising spend, targeting, and overall marketplace trends

  • Help with strategy and execution of custom ad effectiveness projects for a large portfolio of accounts in a variety of categories, including, but not limited to, auto, travel, and entertainment/media

  • Handle brand lift studies, including methodology design, survey development, data analysis, and presenting results

  • Utilize attribution measurement tools to evaluate and optimize campaign performance

  • Educate and partner with marketing and sales staff on how best to utilize the quantitative and qualitative analytics provided

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Experience with media research and software programs, including Nielsen Audio, Scarborough, MRI-Simmons, ACT 1, Media Monitors, Media Radar, and comScore is desired

  • Knowledge in custom study process including project methodology, questionnaire development, sample collection, and data analysis

  • Prior exposure to vendors such as DISQO, Dynata, and Nielsen

  • Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint is a must

  • Proficiency with other statistics and analytics resources is a plus

  • Strong combination of analytical aptitude and creative problem-solving skills

  • Excellent interpersonal skills

  • Ability to articulate our “story” across assets, platforms, and audiences

  • Strong versatility and ability to handle multiple types of assignments

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Ability to work with ambiguity, changing priorities, and a continual sense of urgency

  • A passion for research and interest in developing research career

  • Bachelor's degree or above

While New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles are preferred locations, we will consider other cities where iHeartMedia has offices/operations. This position is hybrid requiring 2-3 times per week in an office location.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Business insight and ability to apply general knowledge of business
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion using instruction, guidance, and direction
  • Skills to solve problems within standardized procedures and practices
  • Ability to communicate straightforward information in a digestible manner and an understanding of when to ask questions in order to validate understanding
  • Understanding of impact of own decisions
  • General understanding of business principles

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent to strengthen the team’s bench and elevate performance.

  • Represent iHeartMedia at industry events, community initiatives, and high visibility client engagements.

As a member of the team, you’ll be at the heart of this mission—bringing our stations, talent, and clients to life through unforgettable experiences.

  • Engage with listeners and clients to create memorable brand interactions and gather feedback. 

  • Maintain promotional inventory and ensure all materials are prepped and transported as needed.

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

  • Strong problem solving skills

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Operate broadcast console and studio equipment during live and pre-recorded shows.

  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.

  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement. 

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in real time and escalate as needed.

  • Record, edit, and load audio content for playback using automation systems. 

  • Maintain logs and documentation for regulatory and internal compliance. 

  • Support remote broadcasts and live events as needed.

  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with broadcast equipment and automation systems (e.g., NexGen, Adobe Audition). 

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant certifications or coursework a plus. 

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

The Board Operator works closely with on-air talent, producers, and newsroom staff to support daily operations, troubleshoot technical issues, and maintain compliance with FCC regulations. Strong attention to detail, multitasking abilities, and familiarity with broadcast automation systems are essential for success in this role.

  • Strong organization with excellent communication skills.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) a plus.

  • Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures

job.title: Safety Supervisor
job.description:
Title: Safety Supervisor

Reports to: Safety Director

Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

The Safety Supervisor will be responsible for training and administer Train and administer the Company safety, health and accident prevention program and ensure all employees have a safe environment in which to work.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Administer the Company safety program; implement and coordinate safety and health activities.  

²  Able to conduct safety training classes; safety certification classes and maintain all related records. 

²  Monitor and evaluate training program’s effectiveness, success and periodically report on them.

²  Able to review accidents and incidents, take corrective action as needed and make recommendations to prevent future occurrences.

²  Analyze inspection findings to determine the need for employee safety training. 

²  Recommend safety equipment to be used or worn; coordinate with safety committees and the purchasing departments concerning the purchase, storage and issuance of approved safety equipment and products for employees.

²  Able to coordinate fleet safety programs; keep current on new trends and methods in accident prevention field; keep current on OSHA reports and standards.

²  Able to analyze all loss data to determine causes of injuries; develop trend analysis and statistical summary of accidents and injuries.

²  Conduct studies concerning the interest and need for safety training programs; administer safety awareness awards program.

²  Able to attend and participate in professional safety organization projects.

²  Able to supervise and administer safety, first aid and rescue squad activities including work assignments, personnel administration, staffing, training, etc.

²  Able to review documentation to insure all required records and reports are complete, accurate and submitted per established procedures, and implement appropriate corrective action as required.

²  Perform additional duties as assigned by the Safety Director.

 

Qualifications:

²  Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Industrial Hygiene or related discipline or a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge.

²  Minimum 3 years safety related experience or field related experience in the underground construction industry.  

²  OSHA 30 Construction required.

²  Possession of a valid class A or C California driver's license

²  Thorough understanding of and ability to enforce federal, state, local and company regulations.

²  Ability to recognize hazardous situations and implement corrective measures.

²  Good interpersonal and communication skills required.

²  Must have extensive knowledge of applicable safety regulations, regulatory requirement and industry standards for construction and general industry; knowledge of EPA, DOT and NEPA standards.

²  Experience in high voltage utility construction a plus

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Sports Account Executive
job.description:
Turn Your Passion for Sports into a Career

Do you live for game day? Do you follow the biggest matchups, support your favorite teams and make time for live sports all year long? Turn that passion into a rewarding career.

News 8 Now, CBS Sports and Phase 3 Digital are looking for an ambitious, consultative Sports Account Executive to help businesses connect with highly engaged fans through the live teams, events and programming they care about most. This is an opportunity to sell more than advertising—you’ll create powerful, results-focused marketing solutions built around the energy and impact of live sports.

Sell the Power of Live Sports

You’ll bring advertisers into the action across traditional television, digital and Connected TV (CTV), with opportunities spanning the NFL—the No. 1 programming on television—Big Ten football, Wisconsin Badgers athletics, Green Bay Packers coverage, the NBA and Milwaukee Bucks, the WNBA, March Madness and NCAA basketball, Major League Baseball and Milwaukee Brewers, UEFA professional soccer, WIAA sports coverage, WIAC athletics, Wisconsin Huddle, CBS Sports, PGA Tour golf and more.

Why This Role Is Exciting

At News 8 Now and Phase 3 Digital, we are transforming how local businesses connect with customers through high-impact digital advertising and Connected TV solutions. As a Sports Account Executive, you will build innovative, data-driven campaigns that combine the unmatched impact of live sports with OTT, CTV, programmatic display, streaming audio, paid social and traditional television.

You’ll be a trusted marketing partner to local businesses—helping them turn attention into action, build their brands and drive measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect, develop and grow new business relationships with local and regional advertisers.
  • Create customized, multi-platform campaigns featuring sports, CTV, OTT, streaming audio, paid social and programmatic advertising.
  • Present clear, compelling marketing strategies that align with each client’s goals, audience and budget.
  • Partner with creative, digital strategy and analytics teams to launch, optimize and report on campaigns.
  • Use campaign insights and performance data to make informed recommendations and earn long-term client partnerships.
  • Stay current on sports media, digital advertising, streaming and emerging technology trends.
  • Meet and exceed new-business and revenue goals, with uncapped commission potential.

What You’ll Bring

  • Genuine enthusiasm for sports and an understanding of the connection fans have with live events and local teams.
  • An entrepreneurial, self-motivated approach to finding opportunities and helping clients succeed.
  • Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
  • A consultative sales mindset and the ability to translate client objectives into effective marketing solutions.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission potential.
  • Unlimited earning opportunity; top sales performers can exceed $150,000 annually.
  • Monthly cell phone allowance and mileage reimbursement.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision and life insurance benefits.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Ongoing training, professional development and meaningful career-growth opportunities.

Position Summary

The Game Production Supervisor, Local Media, is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the planning and execution of live NBA game broadcasts and related programming across assigned Local Media productions. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role translates overall production strategy and editorial direction into consistent, high-quality game broadcasts, providing day-to-day production leadership from pre-production through live event execution and post-production review. Working closely with internal production teams, team and local broadcast partners, Studio Teams, Event Teams, Production Technology, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, Graphics, Programming, Distribution, Content Planning, and third-party vendors, the Game Production Supervisor ensures assigned productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, operational, and financial expectations. This role serves as a leader for assigned games and markets, with primary responsibility for editorial execution, production quality, budget and schedule oversight, and effective coordination among internal and external partners, while escalating broader strategic, stakeholder, or resource decisions to the Game Production Lead as appropriate.

Major Responsibilities

Oversee assigned live NBA game broadcasts and related programming from pre-production through live event execution and post-production, ensuring productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, and operational standards. Execute production strategy and editorial priorities established by the Game Production Lead and Local Media leadership, translating direction into actionable game plans, rundowns, schedules, staffing needs, and production workflows. Provide editorial leadership for assigned productions, coordinating storylines, content priorities, talent needs, graphics, replay, sponsored elements, and other game presentation components with internal and external production teams. Lead day-to-day communication with studio teams and other production partners regarding content and talent availability, daily schedules, production requirements, and special requests. Advance in-game storytelling and broadcast presentation through effective use of production tools, emerging technology, alternate production approaches, and new workflows consistent with Local Media strategy. job.title: Account Executive (Local Ad Sales), The California Post
job.description:
Job Description :

California Post is a brand-new digital-first news organization backed by the trusted legacy of the New York Post. Our mission is to deliver breaking news, compelling storytelling, and innovative content to readers across the West Coast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing team, shape the future of a newsroom, and help advertisers connect with a highly engaged audience.

We are looking for a hungry, results-driven local Ad Sales Account Executive to join our Los Angeles team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business, managing client relationships, and delivering revenue growth for California Post, with a strong focus on local and regional advertisers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in media sales, deep local market knowledge, and understands how to prospect, negotiate, and close deals in a competitive marketplace.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to drive revenue growth across digital advertising, sponsorships, and brand partnerships, with an emphasis on local and regional accounts.
     

  • Identify, prospect, and secure new clients across key local verticals, including Tier 2 automotive, casinos and gaming, real estate, hospitals and healthcare systems, legal services, and other local service-based businesses.
     

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, and key regional stakeholders.
     

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and editorial, to craft integrated, custom advertising solutions tailored to local market needs.
     

  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, RFP responses, contract negotiations, and post-sale account management.
     

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipelines, and CRM data.
     

  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities to effectively advise clients and position California Post as a trusted local media partner.
     

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of advertising sales experience, preferably within media or digital news organizations.
     

  • Demonstrated success selling to local or regional advertisers, ideally across verticals such as automotive, gaming, real estate, healthcare, or professional services.
     

  • Proven ability to prospect, close deals, and consistently exceed revenue targets.
     

  • Strong network of media and advertising contacts in the Los Angeles market.
     

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
     

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
     

  • Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail.
     

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed.
     

Note: This role is primarily based in our Los Angeles office. Occasional remote work may be permitted, with the expectation of on-site presence for core team collaboration and client-facing activities, excluding external sales meetings or required travel.

Compensation: $100,000 - $125,000 Base + commission/sales bonus plan. A final decision on the successful candidate's starting salary will be based on a number of factors, including but not limited to competitive market practice, internal equity, experience, tenure, and essential skills.

At The New York Post Media Group we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, our ranges reflect our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

In addition to compensation, the company provides eligible employees a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including “elective” benefits employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce.

job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce.


The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed.


This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network.


What You’ll Do:
● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output.
● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance.
● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice.
● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages
(Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership.
● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue.
● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards.
● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage.

How We Measure Success:
● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs.
● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene.

● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces.
● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets.

What You’ll Bring:
● Professional experience commensurate with an associate-level role in features, news or commerce writing, backed by a portfolio of strong clips and early experience (or a demonstrated aptitude) for editing.
● Obsession with the commerce landscape, reader value and producing service-oriented content with a commercial focus.
● Command of the iconic NY Post voice and a proven track record of writing crisp, authoritative headlines.
● Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO, plus social media best practices.
● Comfort reading dashboards (Search Console, GA4, Looker or similar) and using data to pivot quickly to trends or live news without losing accuracy.
● CMS fluency and sharp attention to detail, including mastery of AP style and
FTC-compliant disclosures.
● A collaborative, growth-oriented mindset – highly organized, adaptable and ready to take on coaching responsibilities.

Nice to Have
● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools.
● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value.
● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews.
● Newsletter experience.

Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. job.title: Associate Producer - Schein Daily Sports Video Show
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the nation’s oldest newspaper with the youngest, most ambitious video department. We want to make our mark in digital video and create memorable work and new watching habits among our audience. The legacy of the great headlines conveys the attributes of our videos: bold, irreverent, judgmental, confident and clever. We want to make videos that surprise viewers. We seek someone who appreciates serious and quirky stories. Let’s talk! 

The New York Post video team is seeking an Associate Producer for “Schein Time” with Adam Schein, a new daily live sports show that is national in scope. This AP will play a key role in assisting all aspects of the daily production process and be responsible for creating compelling, shareable videos and disseminating the show across social platforms. These clips will help drive in tune-in and be content worth watching. 

The candidate we seek has deep knowledge of and interest in a wide range of sports, including NFL, MLB, NBA/WNBA, College Sports, NHL, emerging sports, gambling, fantasy, and current New York/California sports news.
  
Per our publication’s mantra, you agree that news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones.  

This is an opportunity to join an iconic media brand as it continues exponential digital growth. The New York Post has garnered more than a billion video views across various platforms in the past year. 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in all aspects of daily production for a nationally distributed live sports show

  • Produce compelling, shareable short-form video clips to drive tune-in and audience engagement

  • Lead the creation of thumbnails, headlines, and other visual/packaging elements optimized for digital and social platforms

  • Manage and execute interactive promotion of show content across social media channels

  • Socialize show clips strategically to maximize reach, viewership, and engagement

  • Ensure smooth day-to-day production workflows while juggling multiple simultaneous tasks

  • Collaborate with producers and team members to generate ideas and contribute to daily show brainstorming

  • Support the production of digitally native video content tailored to platform-specific audiences

  • Apply deep knowledge of sports—including major leagues, emerging sports, gambling, esports, and fantasy—to content creation and promotion

  • Identify and help elevate unconventional, entertaining, and newsworthy sports stories in line with the publication’s brand voice

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  •  Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital/sports newsroom environment

  • Encyclopedic sports knowledge including upstart sports, fantasy, and esports. 

  • Ability to pitch, produce, and script

  • Ability to polish on camera talent

  • Ability to work closely with internal stakeholders and reporters. 

  • Excellent communication and people skills

  • Experience creating video for social platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, X and more a plus 

  • Strong news judgment, track record of successful video production

  • Implement best practices for video metadata, thumbnails, and discovery on all videos

  • Fluency with key tools in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) also a plus. 

  • Familiarity with the New York Post and our writing style

  • Use web analytics to monitor audience engagement with our videos and strategize for growth on various platforms

  • Excited about new types of multimedia storytelling

  • Must enjoy working collaboratively and accurately in a fast paced but fun environment

  • Strong news judgment and attention to detail and journalistic values a must

job.description:

The Audience Development Specialist will play a key role in driving multi-platform discoverability, ensuring our journalism reaches the widest possible audience across search, video, social, and emerging AI-driven platforms.

job.description:
Job Description :

We are seeking a Director, Business Development & Distribution to lead strategic partnerships that expand the reach, audience, and revenue of our content.

This role is responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing distribution and partnership opportunities across media platforms, publishers, and brand partners.

You will play a key role in ensuring our content is effectively distributed in new and existing channels, while supporting sustainable audience and revenue growth through high-impact partnerships.

Strategic Distribution Partnerships
● Identify and develop distribution partnerships with third-party platforms (e.g., news aggregators, content platforms, and digital distribution partners)
● Negotiate syndication agreements to expand content reach and audience acquisition

Audience Development Partnerships
● Develop and manage partnerships focused on subscriber growth and audience expansion
● Structure co-marketing initiatives such as newsletter cross-promotions, co-registration programs, and audience exchange opportunities

engagements

job.title: Commerce Business Analyst
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers the best in News, Sports, Entertainment and Pop Culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

New York Post Data Labs is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Commerce Business Analyst to join our Data Science and Analytics team. In this role, you will be the dedicated analytics partner for the New York Post Commerce department. You will be responsible for providing insights that drive business growth by analyzing performance metrics, identifying trends, and optimizing our Commerce strategies. This is a crucial position for someone who is passionate about data and its power to inform strategic business decisions in a fast-paced media & Commerce environment.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all affiliate marketing campaigns, including clicks, conversions, commission, and return on investment (ROI).

  • Data Reporting: Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools to provide clear visibility into performance for stakeholders.

  • Strategic Insights: Proactively identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in data to provide actionable recommendations for improving affiliate program efficiency and profitability.

  • Forecasting & Modeling: Assist in building and maintaining models and forecasts to project future performance needs.

  • A/B Testing & Optimization: Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests to optimize landing pages, offers, and partner performance.

  • Data Partnership: Serve as a dedicated data partner to the Commerce Team, working closely with leadership to translate business goals into data strategy and deliver clear, actionable insights.

  • Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy and reliability of all data sources, reporting, and analysis.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics within a publishing environment or affiliate marketing organization (publisher-focused experience strongly preferred).

  • Experience with a business intelligence platform (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Familiarity with affiliate tracking & Commerce business models, platforms and tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Business, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth analysis, draw conclusions, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with languages like Python & SQL for data manipulation and statistical analysis.

  • Proven experience working with large, complex datasets.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking: You're a problem-solver who can turn raw data into a compelling story.

  • Communication Skills: You can clearly and concisely explain complex data concepts to a variety of audiences.

  • Attention to Detail: You have an eye for precision and are committed to data accuracy.

  • Collaboration: You're a team player who can build strong relationships with stakeholders.

  • Proactive & Curious: You love to dig into data and are always looking for ways to improve performance.

job.description:

Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The New York Post is seeking an experienced Account Executive to lead advertising and partnership efforts in Washington, DC. This individual contributor role reports directly to the COO and offers the opportunity to drive revenue, build strategic relationships, and expand the Post’s commercial presence in a key market. The ideal candidate will bring a built-in network, a proven book of business, and experience selling advertising solutions across political, advocacy, and B2B channels.

In this role, you will lead political advertising campaigns including midterms, general fundraising, and election cycles while also identifying new opportunities with corporate and B2B clients. You will serve as the primary point of contact in DC, cultivating and maintaining relationships with clients, agencies, and organizations seeking to reach influential audiences. The right candidate thrives operating independently, is excited about representing an iconic and influential brand, and has a track record of translating networks and market knowledge into measurable revenue and strategic growth.

  • Drive partnerships with corporations, associations, agencies, and organizations seeking to reach influential audiences and decision-makers

  • Leverage an existing DC-based network and book of business to generate immediate impact while expanding relationships with direct clients and agencies

  • Contribute to the commercialization of new initiatives, helping shape offerings, products, and positioning as the DC franchise grows

  • Operate autonomously as a senior individual contributor, managing the full sales cycle from prospecting through close and renewal
