job.title: Director of Engineering
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. 


You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. 


Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.


Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.
  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. 
  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. 
  • Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. 
  • Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. 
  • Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. 
  • Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.
  • Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. 
  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
  • Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Organize architecture discussions. 
  • Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. 

Qualifications:

Must-Haves 

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
  • 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. 
  • Agile best practices. 
  • Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.
  • Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . 
  • Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. 
  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
  • Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. 
  • Strong troubleshooting skills 
  • Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. 
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. 
  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.
  • Personalization and recommendation systems. 
  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
  • Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. 
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) 
  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) 

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

job.title: Director, Paid Social
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment  – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The New York Post is seeking a full-time Director, Paid Social to help lead the paid social strategy and play a pivotal role in growing the business. You will collaborate closely with video, design, marketing, and product teams to ensure a cohesive and engaging experience for our followers.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Social Media, you will have a significant impact on the success of brand partnerships, sponsorship opportunities and paid social across the business. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the paid social strategy across The New York Post's portfolio, serving as the internal subject matter expert across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and emerging opportunities.

  • Lead and mentor a team of paid social professionals, providing direction and coaching while establishing scalable workflows, processes, and best practices.

  • Develop and execute end-to-end paid social strategies that grow audience, engagement, traffic, content reach, and revenue, while aligning with broader company objectives.

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X, staying ahead of platform updates, new products, and emerging capabilities.

  • Partner with the Senior Director of Social Media, editorial, and social teams to connect paid and organic strategy, identify high-potential content, and drive audience growth and monetization.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Brand Partnerships, marketing, product, design, and video teams to develop cohesive paid-social campaigns, sponsorship solutions, and advertiser programs.

  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, using platform expertise, audience insights, performance data, and reporting to make recommendations and drive optimization.

  • Build and maintain performance dashboards, reporting frameworks, and KPIs while monitoring campaign pacing and identifying opportunities to improve results.

  • Identify and test new platforms, formats, targeting strategies, tools, and optimization techniques, acting as an internal trend spotter across the evolving social ecosystem.

  • Educate stakeholders on paid social capabilities and best practices while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment. 

What We’re Looking For: 

  • 4+ years of experience in paid social, paid media, digital media, or a related field, with significant hands-on campaign management and optimization experience.

  • 1–2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading a team.

  • Deep knowledge of paid social platforms, including Meta/Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing paid social strategies across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of paid social fundamentals, including audience development, campaign structure, bidding, pacing, budget management, creative formats, targeting, and optimization.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, including experience building dashboards and reporting to senior stakeholders.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience partnering across editorial, sales, marketing, product, design, video, and social teams.

  • Experience in a publisher, media company, agency, entertainment organization, or other fast-paced digital environment is highly valued, along with an understanding of the relationship between content, audience growth, paid media, and revenue.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and identify opportunities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with photo/video editing, social content creation, writing, or copy-editing is a plus.

  • Must be flexible around occasional weekend and holiday work based on the needs of a 24/7 media organization.

Note: This role will be on-site five days per week in our New York newsroom. The schedule for this role is Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm EST.

job.title: Editorial Page Assistant Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers the best in News, Sports, Entertainment and Pop Culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Post’s Editorial Page is where bold ideas meet razor-sharp commentary. As one of the country’s most recognized opinion sections, our team tackles the most pressing local, national, and global issues — delivering sharp, fearless takes in the distinct voice that defines the Post. From holding public officials accountable to weighing in on global conflicts, we cut through the noise with clarity, wit, and purpose.


We’re looking for a nimble, thoughtful, and fast-moving Editorial Page Assistant Editor to join our Opinion team. This writer will contribute impactful editorials daily — helping shape the voice of our institutional stance — while also crafting occasional bylined opinion columns. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the Post’s signature tone: smart, punchy, skeptical of orthodoxy, and unafraid to challenge both sides of the aisle. This role is key to helping our readers make sense of a fast-changing world and will contribute to both our print and digital platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Write timely, engaging, and factually sound unsigned editorials under tight deadlines, aligned with the Post’s voice and editorial stance
  • Occasionally contribute bylined opinion columns on topics of expertise or general interest
  • As our video products develop, contribute on-camera opinion on topics of expertise or general interest
  • Pitch compelling editorial ideas that respond to breaking news or trends in politics, policy, and culture
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team to shape daily and long-term coverage priorities
  • Monitor current events across a wide range of topics including New York City and state politics, national affairs, foreign policy and broader cultural issues
  • Join in team preparation of copy for both digital publication (using WordPress and other CMS tools) and print.
  • Help amplify opinion content’s reach (including via social media) with sharp headlines and an eye toward engagement
  • Represent the editorial board externally as needed, including occasional interviews, panels, or media appearances

  • At least 3 years of experience in political commentary, editorial writing, or a related field
  • Deep understanding of New York politics and national political dynamics
  • Exceptional writing skills: clear, direct, and persuasive prose under deadline

  • Comfort with delivering on-camera content, preferably non-teleprompter
  • Comfort with WordPress or similar content management systems

job.description:
Job Description :

We are looking for Part-Time News Reporters (~24 hours per week) to join the California Post team.

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, the General Assignment News Reporter will have a focus on breaking exclusive stories and covering major events unfolding in Los Angeles and beyond. From delivering exclusive, engaging, agenda setting stories to covering wildfires, celebrity scandals, local politics, crime, courts and viral moments, this reporter will be on the front line of our coverage in one of the country’s most dynamic and newsworthy cities.

  • Spot stories that resonate nationally, especially ones with viral or exclusive potential

  • Develop sources across city agencies, emergency services, and local communities to get the inside track on stories

  • Monitor court filings, public records, and social media for scoops and trending topics

job.title: Page Six Video Lead Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Page Six video team is seeking a Lead Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about celebrities, and fashion - subjects that are the mainstay of the nation’s most iconic gossip column. You should love celebrity journalism and possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, trends, feuds, and hookups. You should live and breathe celebrity lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse.

You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit

production targets and goals. You’ll be the lead editor for the most important Page Six video series, both the audience favorites and the branded content as well. You’ll help create sizzles and other marketing assets as needed. You’ll supervise the rest of the editors, giving them creative notes, video editing workflow best practices, troubleshooting problems and overall quality control. You’ll coordinate media backups with our production management team. And work with our team and creative director to have graphic guidelines as well as create custom graphics and thumbnails to help click through rates. You must edit fast and with a flourish. Expertise with key products in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) as well as Adobe graphic templates. You’ll edit videos for digital platforms using a mix of original footage, stock footage and social media content.


Along with editing digitally-native video, you will help generate our content, pitching video ideas daily and contributing to the team brainstorming. We seek a candidate who is excited about new types of multimedia storytelling and has a track record of creating digital video in a fast-paced news organization. Must be aware of the latest formats and trends in digital video as a distinct form of content versus television.


This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking.


Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones.


This is an opportunity to work with an iconic media brand as it experiences exponential digital growth. New York Post and Page Six videos have received more than a billion views in the past few years.


Responsibilities:
● Lead the editing and post-production of high-priority Page Six video series,
branded content, and celebrity-focused digital features optimized for social and
web platforms.
● Supervise and mentor video editors by providing creative direction, workflow
guidance, troubleshooting support, and overall quality control in a fast-paced
newsroom environment.
● Edit compelling, digitally native videos using original footage, stock assets, and social media content while maintaining Page Six’s signature voice, tone, and style.
● Collaborate with producers, creative leadership, and production management to develop graphics packages, thumbnails, sizzle reels, and promotional assets that drive audience engagement and click-through rates.
● Pitch timely celebrity, fashion, and entertainment video concepts daily,
contributing innovative storytelling ideas aligned with trending topics and
audience interests.
● Manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines, ensuring efficient turnaround, media organization, backups, and adherence to production
schedules.
● Apply advanced post-production techniques including color correction, audio
mixing, multi-cam editing, and vertical video formatting using Adobe Creative
Suite tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop.


The ideal candidate will have:

● 5-10 years experience editing celebrity videos for digital outlets
● Expertise with Adobe Creative Suite, specifically Premiere
● Knowledge of studio and control room operations
● Ability to color correct and mix audio.
● Ability to create vertical videos for various social platforms
● Be able to work very quickly under pressure
● Pitch video ideas daily and contribute to team brainstorming.
● Experience with multicam editing
● Motion graphics experience a plus as is simple animation, but not necessary
● Ability to select and use music to match the tone and style of the story
● Must be organized, work well in a fast-paced environment and be a team-player.
● Can-do attitude is key: someone who believes news doesn’t have to be boring
and who appreciates the odd and unconventional stories as well as important
ones.
● Open to working evenings and weekends, on rare cases if required
● Experience working autonomously in a fast-paced newsroom environment on
weekly deadlines
 

Note: This role is expected to be on-site in the New York metro area five days per week.


NEEDS:

Resume, link to editing reel and cover letter.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

job.title: PT Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice.


The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos.


The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice.


The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines.


Qualifications:
● Bachelor’s degree or higher

● A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom

● Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print

● A keen understanding of the voice of the Post

● A knack for finding stories our readers crave

● A critical eye for facts and tone

● Broad knowledge base

● Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists


Note: The New York Post adheres to a hybrid work model. As a part-time editor, you will work an 8-to-10-hour Saturday shift in the office, with the possibility of working additional hours on Thursday and Friday.

job.description:

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Growth & Lifecyle Marketing to lead audience growth, engagement, and retention strategies across our newsletter portfolio, free membership offerings, and suite of mobile applications.

This role will be responsible for driving subscriber acquisition and lifecycle marketing initiatives that scale high-quality audiences while maintaining strong engagement and retention performance. You will partner closely with editorial, creative, product, analytics, and external partners to execute data-informed growth strategies across paid, owned, earned, and partnership channels.

The ideal candidate combines performance marketing expertise, strong analytical capabilities, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a passion for media, audience growth, and consumer engagement.

Growth Strategy & Audience Acquisition

● Manage a balanced channel mix across paid and organic acquisition tactics, including
digital advertising, owned platforms, partnerships, and referral programs
● Identify new opportunities to scale qualified audiences while maintaining efficiency and engagement quality

● Plan, execute, and optimize acquisition campaigns across channels such as Meta, LinkedIn, search engine marketing, sponsored newsletters, and other relevant platforms

job.title: Sports Account Executive, Ad Sales
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the Best Sports in Town.

From the voices fans know and trust to the stories you won’t find anywhere else, the New York Post brings sports to life with insider access both on and off the field. And we’re just getting started. Our sports business continues to grow across Post Sports, Post Action, Post Sports+ and original sports video, creating new and exciting ways for brands to connect with passionate, highly engaged audiences.


We’re looking for an Account Executive, Sports Ad Sales who knows how to sell, loves the thrill of the pitch and closing a deal, and genuinely lives and breathes sports. This is a great opportunity for a relationship driven, strategic seller who wants to build meaningful partnerships around some of the biggest sports stories, personalities and moments in New York.


You’ll bring a strong network across agencies and direct clients, a proven track record of opening doors and growing business, and the confidence to take a partnership from first conversation to close.


The ideal candidate has approximately 4 to 6 years of omni channel media sales experience in a major market, with experience working directly with clients and media agencies. Most importantly, you’re a smart, energetic seller who understands where sports, culture, media and brands intersect and knows how to turn that intersection into revenue.


This New York based role reports to the NYP Sports Ad Sales Director and will play a key role across the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to closing, growing and retaining client partnerships.


What You’ll Do


  • Identify, prospect and develop new business opportunities across agencies and direct clients, turning conversations into meaningful, long term partnerships.
  • Leverage our sports content, audience, talent, platforms and premium opportunities to create compelling solutions for advertisers.
  • Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through pitch, negotiation, close and ongoing partnership management.
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop creative, strategic and integrated solutions that help clients achieve their business goals.
  • Deliver compelling sales presentations and confidently communicate why the New York Post is the right partner for a brand.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients and agency partners, providing responsive, thoughtful communication and an exceptional buyer experience.
  • Preserve and expand the existing customer base while consistently identifying opportunities for upsell, cross sell and deeper partnerships.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed established revenue goals with a proactive, results oriented approach.
  • Stay close to competitors, category trends, advertiser activity and the evolving sports and media landscape to uncover new opportunities.
  • Use research, prospecting tools and your own network to consistently build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

What We’re Looking For


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in media sales, digital advertising or a similar client facing sales environment, preferably in a major market.
  • A proven track record of prospecting, winning new business and growing client relationships.
  • Strong agency and/or direct client relationships within the digital media and advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience selling omni channel or integrated media solutions across multiple platforms.
  • A genuine passion for sports and an understanding of the sports media landscape. You don’t have to be able to name every backup quarterback in the league, but you should be excited by sports, know what fans care about and understand why brands want to be part of the conversation.
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial sales mentality. You enjoy the chase, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone and get energized by opening new doors.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently pitch ideas and build relationships at all levels.
  • Familiarity with market research and prospecting tools such as MediaRadar, WINMO and similar platforms.
  • Highly organized, self motivated and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities at once.
  • A fast learner who can adapt to a constantly evolving media, sports and advertising landscape.
  • Results driven, enthusiastic and collaborative, with the confidence and personality to represent the New York Post in the marketplace.

The Bottom Line

If you love sports, love selling and love the idea of building partnerships around some of the biggest moments in sports, we want to hear from you.


Note: This role will adhere to a hybrid work model (4 days per week in our NYC office), subject to change as business needs evolve.


Compensation: Base salary of $80,000–$100,000, plus a sales bonus/commission plan. On-target earnings (OTE) of $140,000–$175,000 are based on achieving 100% of sales goals.


Note: Our sales compensation plan rewards strong performance, with incentive multipliers for exceeding sales targets and additional earning potential for top performers.


Pay-for-performance is a key element in our strategy to attract, engage, and motivate talented people to do their best work. Accordingly, offers extended for this role will include an annual bonus target typically expressed as percentage of salary. Similarly to salary, set annual incentive bonus targets are based on a variety of factors including competitive market practice, experience, tenure, and essential skills.

job.title: Video Editor, PageSix.com (Virtual Reali-Tea)
job.description:
Job Description :

Page Six provides readers with the best in Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 25 million unique viewers a month. For the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Page Six video team is seeking an in-office Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about reality TV: the shows, the personalities, the characters. Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. You should possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, feuds, scandals and hookups. You should live and breathe reality TV lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse.


This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You will assist on dozens of videos throughout the day, taking lead from the producers and studio technical director.


Responsibilities:

  • Edit high quality, engaging short form videos focused on celebrity news, reality television, entertainment, and pop culture for digital and social media platforms.

  • Transform original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content into compelling, shareable video content.

  • Collaborate closely with producers and the Studio Technical Director to execute a high volume of daily video productions while consistently meeting tight deadlines.

  • Maintain exceptional speed and accuracy in video editing without compromising creativity or editorial quality.

  • Create visually dynamic content using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Adobe Motion Graphics templates.

  • Generate and pitch fresh video concepts daily that align with trending celebrity news, reality TV, and audience interests.

  • Participate in editorial meetings and brainstorming sessions to develop innovative multimedia storytelling ideas.

  • Monitor celebrity news, entertainment, reality television, fashion, social media, and digital trends to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ensure all content aligns with Page Six's editorial voice, brand standards, and quality expectations.

  • Stay current on emerging digital video formats, platform best practices, and audience engagement trends to continuously improve content performance.

  • Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously while remaining highly organized in a fast paced newsroom environment.

  • Collaborate with cross functional editorial and production teams to deliver timely, accurate, and engaging video content.

  • Contribute to production goals by supporting the efficient execution of daily publishing schedules across digital platforms.

  • Exercise strong editorial judgment when selecting footage, pacing stories, and crafting narratives that resonate with digital audiences.

  • Help evolve existing video franchises while identifying opportunities to develop new recurring series and formats.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience editing high volume, digital first video content in a fast paced newsroom, entertainment, or media environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects and Photoshop strongly preferred.

  • Experience editing with a combination of original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content.

  • Ability to create engaging horizontal and vertical videos optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other digital platforms.

  • Strong understanding of platform specific video formats, audience behaviors, and emerging digital video trends.

  • Deep knowledge of celebrity news, reality television, pop culture, entertainment, and social media, with the ability to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ability to edit quickly and efficiently while maintaining exceptional editorial judgment, creativity, and attention to detail under tight deadlines.

  • Experience with multicamera editing, color correction, audio mixing, and pacing content for maximum audience engagement.

  • Motion graphics, basic animation, and experience using Adobe Motion Graphics templates are a plus.

  • Strong instinct for selecting music and sound design that enhances storytelling and complements the tone of each video.

  • Ability to generate, pitch, and develop fresh video concepts daily while contributing meaningfully to editorial brainstorming sessions.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with Executive Producers, Producers, Studio Technical Directors, social teams, and cross functional newsroom partners.

  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing competing deadlines, planning for contingencies, and adapting quickly in a rapidly changing news environment.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and self motivated, with the ability to work independently while thriving as part of a collaborative team.

  • Positive, solutions oriented attitude with a passion for creative storytelling and a belief that news can be engaging, entertaining, and shareable.

  • Ability to make sound editorial decisions and maintain accuracy while working under pressure.

  • Flexibility to work a nontraditional schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and major news or entertainment events as needed.

job.title: Washington Correspondent
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority, averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce.

Politics is core to who we are — and nobody covers it like The Post. We break big stories, stir the pot, and shine a light on what’s really going on in the nation’s capital. From policy drama and power grabs to scandals and backstabbing, we’re looking for someone who gets the whole DC circus and can help lead the way in breaking news.

The New York Post is seeking an enterprising DC-based Washington Correspondent to join our growing DC team and cover the fast-moving world of Washington politics. This reporter will break exclusive stories, expose what’s happening behind the scenes in government, and bring readers sharp, authoritative coverage of how decisions in the capital shape the nation.

  • Cover legislative battles, policy shifts, elections, and key political figures.

  • Break exclusive stories and find fresh angles on widely covered issues that others will chase

  • Build and maintain a strong network of sources, from lawmakers and lobbyists to administration and campaign officials. 

  • Stay on top of political developments in real time and file timely, accurate copy.

  • Use public records, FOIA requests, and social media to surface and verify stories.

  • Work closely with editors and colleagues to produce fast, engaging coverage across digital and social platforms.

  • Proven ability to break news, cultivate sources, and deliver original, high-impact reporting

  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills under tight deadlines.

  • Experience using digital tools, FOIA, and open-source reporting techniques.

job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
ABC4 Utah is seeking a dynamic and motivated Content Producer to help drive content across television, digital, social media, and streaming platforms. This hybrid role combines the responsibilities of a newscast producer, digital news producer, assignment editor, and streaming content creator, making it ideal for a news-driven storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

 

The Content Producer will oversee daily news gathering, coordinate coverage with reporters and photojournalists, monitor breaking news, and help generate original content for News4Utah+, ABC4’s streaming platform. They will also be trained as a traditional newscast producer to help back up the production of newscasts. They will also contribute to the creation of compelling, audience-focused content for broadcast, digital, and social media. This position is also responsible for developing and producing original video, podcast, and streaming content from concept to completion.

Key Responsibilities

 

·         Strive to be #1 on ABC4's television newscasts, digital and streaming platforms 24 hours/day

·         Report news quickly and accurately

·         Be able to craft original content that stands out from competition

·         Must be able to independently produce a television newscast to air on ABC4 news following training

·         Program News4Utah+, ABC4's streaming app for Roku, Apple TV, Samsung TV and Fire TV

·         Coordinate daily newsroom coverage and assignments across television, streaming, and digital platforms.

·         Book guests, schedule interviews, and maintain relationships with local sources and public information officers.

·         Ability to host streaming shows on varied topics

·         Write articles, breaking news updates, and digital content that drives audience engagement.

·         Develop, produce, and manage original video series for News4Utah+.

·         Oversee content calendars, production timelines, and distribution strategies.

·         Create and execute social media campaigns to grow audience reach and engagement.

·         Ensure all content meets ABC4’s editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and production quality expectations.

 

Qualifications 

 

·         Strong news judgment and ability to work under tight deadlines. 

·         Experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Audition, or similar platforms. 

·         Knowledge of social media strategy, SEO, audience analytics, and AP Style. 

·         Comfortable conducting interviews and appearing on camera when needed. 

·         Creative thinker with a finger on the pulse of entertainment, internet culture, and streaming trends. 

·         Excellent communication, organization, and multitasking skills. 

·         Enjoys working in teams and is a strong communicator 

·         Ability to adapt quickly to breaking news and changing priorities. 

·         Proficiency in MS Office a must; HTML, CSS and Photoshop experience a plus 

·         Seeks out new technology in a fast-evolving industry 

·         Work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends 

 

This position requires creativity, flexibility, and a passion for producing compelling content that informs and engages audiences across all ABC4 platforms. Evening, weekend, and holiday work may be required.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
The Digital Content Producer will use data to make decisions about audience interest trends. The DCP will be able to reach out to contacts, source the web and find information on social media to build stories that will be high performing across multiple websites. While the producer will largely work from a single space, the ability to take photos and create video is a plus. A strong knowledge of social media platforms is expected.

  • Be the first to report breaking news stories; monitor analytic tools, RSS feeds, social media, alerts, all regional media for interesting and/or trending stories 
  • Write daily “flip” stories (avg. 3-5 stories+/day) that are packaged in a way that grows pages per session and time on page while utilizing SEO best practices to grow website search traffic 
  • Constantly monitor competition to ensure no “flip” stories across the DMA are missed
  • Post, package, and promote stories from third-party feed partners (Nexstar, AP, NBC, etc.) 
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar, and punctuation, following prescribed editorial AP style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

 

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:  

  • Proficiency in AP Style writing and SEO best practices 
  • Clever headline writer that gets readers to click 
  • Works with urgency, minimum 60 words-per-minute typing speed  
  • Ability to generate high engagement social media posts with link click-throughs 
  • Familiar with Google Analytics, Chartbeat, Social Flow, and WordPress 
  • Excels in fast-paced, sometimes high-pressure, work environment with accurate, visual, in-depth, digital coverage 
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Comfortable with cold calling to develop stories 
  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent judgment 
  • Ability to multi-task; flexible with schedule in times of breaking news, severe weather, etc. 
  • High digital aptitude in respect to latest CMS and social media updates and trends 
  • Takes initiative to seek out and understand new digital news applications and resources 
  • Possesses journalistic integrity and understanding of viewer needs and expectations 
  • Can communicate, coordinate, and collaborate with other members of the office
  • Maintain positive work environment through active team participation and cooperation with co-workers in all departments
  • Responds positively to feedback

 

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Two years of experience in digital or print newsroom. Achieved a Bachelor's Degree in Communication, Marketing, Journalism. Equivalent experience may substitute. 

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: High stress, high energy environment with deadline pressures. Some travel may be required on rare occasions. 


#LI-ONSITE

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
PIX11 News is looking for a full-time digital first journalist who is passionate, talented and hard-working to help manage PIX11.com and its social platforms. 


This digital producer role will be focused on creating at least two vertical videos a day for our social platforms and news apps. They will also be responsible for writing articles for our PIX11.com website.  The ideal candidate will have a knack for finding stories that align with our content pillars as a news organization. They will also have a general knowledge of the area including all of NYC and New Jersey. 


He/she ll be an expert in SEO and vertical video content creation as well. While creating content that performs well is ideal - we are more focused on locating a candidate who is well-versed in adapting news stories for social media consumption that focus on integrity, service and reliability. 

The candidate for this role will be able to produce fast, compelling and accurate content, and help take PIX11.com to the next level as an important source for news and video with a strong local focus. This role will include morning, evening and weekend shifts.


The position’s chief responsibilities require that the producer:

·         Be able to work in a fast-paced environment. Digital producers are expected to write multiple stories per day, shoot/edit two vertical videos a day and pivot to breaking news stories as needed.

·         Be proficient in creating vertical videos and have knowledge of programs like Adobe Premiere and CapCut. 

·         Be proactive in content discovery, identify social media content that our audiences will want and keep abreast of breaking local news.

·         Have knowledge of SEO best practices and website optimization. The ability to write strong headlines is essential.

·         Be familiar with website and social media analytics, and how to use these metrics to inform future editorial decisions, grow our digital audience and drive traffic. 

·         Create vertical video content and write compelling social media copies for Facebook, TikTok, X and Instagram. 

·         Create engaging mobile app and desktop pushes using language that drives pageview traffic.

·         Copy and edit stories and video graphics, keeping in mind both grammar and AP style.

·         Clip and publish video segments from newscasts. Be prepared for possible assistance with assignment desk newsgathering and answering phones. 

Requirements and skills

  • Minimum of 2-3 years of news reporting or writing experience in a digital space.
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience gathering in a linear or broadcast space. 
  • Ability to work professionally with station staff to put out the best possible digital product. Applicants should be able to work independently and as part of a larger team, including fellow digital producers, assignment editors, reporters and TV producers.
  • Passion for the news, digital presentation and a commitment to fairness and accuracy.
  • Curiosity about the latest digital tools and a willingness to experiment with new ways to tell stories and reach a wider audience.
  • Knowledge of the following tools is a plus: WordPress, Google Trends, Chartbeat, Meta Insights, CapCut, Adobe Premiere and Social News Desk.  

At the time of your application, please be prepared to show at least five writing samples published within the last two years.

Hourly rate: $29 +

job.title: Digital Producer
job.description:

job.title: Director of Sales
job.description:
WFRV, Local 5 is looking for a decisive, creative, curious and inspirational leader for our sales team in Northeast Wisconsin.  We have a great team of sellers with a strong mix of experience and skills. 

Our main studios are in beautiful Green Bay, which was U.S. News and World Report’s 2023-24 “Best Place to Live”.  Our city by the bay is affordable, has great quality of life, access to excellent schools, quality health care, low crime rates, short commutes and defines “Mid-West Nice”. 

It is also home to the world-famous Green Bay Packers and a short drive from Door County, one of the most beautiful and scenic areas in the country.  There is hiking, boating, fishing, hunting, great restaurants, shopping and the area offers urban, suburban and country living environments.


The Director of Sales oversees all aspects of the Sales Department, including staff management, advertising inventory throughout all channels, revenue goal setting and achievement, and budgeting.  The Director of Sales also has direct responsibility for national sales efforts and direct political negotiation and management.  The DOS will report directly to the VP/General Manager.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:                                                                

·         Provides leadership for the digital/broadcast sales teams

·         Makes decisions regarding hiring, evaluation, promotion and termination of employees

·         Develops and executes sales strategies which result in exceeding revenue targets across all platforms in digital, local, national, political and new product revenue

·         Drives new business development

·         Create unique and customized media plans for high profile clients leveraging Nexstar Digital’s full suite of products including OTT, video, social, data, addressable and more.

·         Work cooperatively with other department heads to advance our staff, product and revenue.

·         Fluency in ad technology and video advertising with strong presentation skills

·         Stay current in the rapidly developing technology and environment of media and advertising, specifically digital!

·         Network and develop relationships with key community and advertising partners.

·         Manages inventory and revenue forecasting

·         Manages recruitment and development of talented sales professionals

·         Prepares budgets and approves budget expenditures

·         Resolves customer complaints regarding sales and service including overseeing political cease and desist complaints

·         Plans and directs staffing, training, and performance evaluations to develop and control sales and service programs

·         Determines inventory, pricing and rate structures

·         Creates and reviews operational records and reports to project sales and determine profitability

·         Directs the Accounts Receivable efforts of the Sales Department

·         Performs other duties as assigned


Requirements & Skills:

·         Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising or Mass Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience

·         Fluency in English

·         Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

·         Minimum five years’ experience in media sales

·         Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

·         Experience leading, directing and motivating subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance

·         Experience establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them

·         Ability to identify the developmental needs of others and to coach, mentor or otherwise help others to improve their knowledge or skills

·         Proficiency with the computers, software, traffic systems, Apps, CRM’s, etc., associated with broadcasting.

 

Physical Demands & Work Environment:
The Director of Sales must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use e-mail, write letters and memos, travel, drive distances, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work in close proximity to others, work outdoors in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.

 

WFRV-TV and Nexstar Media Inc. are an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: IT Technician
job.description:
The IT Technician provides frontline and intermediate technical support for broadcast, production, and business technology systems. This role serves as a bridge between traditional IT support and broadcast engineering, ensuring reliable operation of computers, software, networks, media workflows, and broadcast-related technologies.  The specialist troubleshoots user issues, supports critical production systems, and works closely with News, Production and Sales departments.


Key Responsibilities:


Technical Support

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for broadcast and corporate technology systems.
  • Respond to and resolve support requests through ticketing systems, phone, email, and in-person assistance.
  • Troubleshoot workstation, software, printer, mobile device, and peripheral issues.
  • Configure, deploy, and maintain desktops, laptops, monitors, and user hardware.

Network & Infrastructure Support

  • Perform basic network troubleshooting for wired and wireless systems.
  • Support IP-based broadcast and production technologies.
  • Identify connectivity and performance issues affecting broadcast operations.
  • Coordinate with engineering team to resolve infrastructure issues.

Operational Support

  • Assist with software deployment, updates, and patch management.
  • Assist with equipment installation, testing, and system upgrades.
  • Create and manage user accounts, permissions, and group memberships.
  • Maintain documentation of issues, resolutions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain asset inventory and technology documentation.
  • Monitor system health and escalate issues to Broadcast Engineers when necessary.
  • Participate in after-hours support and on-call rotations as required.
  • Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.

Required Qualifications

  • Technical degree in Information Systems, Digital Electronics, Broadcasting or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience supporting Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and Wi-Fi.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.
  • Fluency in English
  • Strong troubleshooting and customer service skills.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in television, radio, media, production, or broadcast environments.
  • Familiarity with broadcast systems such as:
    • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS)
    • Media Asset Management (MAM)
    • Video servers and playout systems
    • Non-linear editing systems
    • IP video and audio transport technologies

Key Competencies

  • Customer Focus
  • Technical Troubleshooting
  • Communication Skills
  • Problem Solving
  • Time Management
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Attention to Detail

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office and broadcast facility environment.
  • May require lifting equipment up to 50 pounds.
  • Occasional evening, weekend, holiday, and on-call support.
  • Support of business-critical and live broadcast operations where rapid response is required.

#LI-Onsite

job.title: Multi Media Account Executive (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)
job.description:
MULTI-MEDIA ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)

Ready to help shape the future of media? At WAVY-TV, WVBT FOX43, and CW Hampton Roads, we do more than sell TV—we help local businesses grow with creative marketing solutions across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. We're looking for a driven, motivated Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and helping clients connect with their audiences through the power of multi-platform media.

About the Role:

As an Account Executive at WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads, you'll serve as a consultative partner to local and regional businesses—developing custom advertising strategies across our robust multimedia portfolio. You’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values creativity, integrity, and performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospect and secure new business through networking, referrals, and outreach.
  • Manage and grow a book of active clients, cultivating long-term partnerships.
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns that include linear TV, streaming (OTT/CTV), digital display, social, and branded content.
  • Work cross-functionally with production, creative, promotions, and digital teams to bring campaigns to life.
  • Deliver clear, data-backed proposals and recommendations to clients.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual revenue goals and quarterly targets.
  • Stay current on media trends, competitive insights, and emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A creative, proactive problem solver who thrives on helping clients succeed.
  • A persuasive storyteller who can connect business challenges to tailored media solutions.
  • A self-starter with strong time management and follow-through skills.
  • A confident communicator—written, verbal, and in client-facing presentations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 2-5 years of proven success in media, marketing, or B2B sales.
  • Knowledge of digital advertising platforms (e.g., OTT, SEO/SEM, etc.).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; CRM experience is a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Why WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads?

  • We're part of Nexstar Media Group, the nation’s largest local media company.
  • Our reach includes NFL, college football, Hampton Roads Show, and trusted news coverage.
  • Access to advanced tools, strong leadership, and hands-on sales training.
  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k) & monthly phone allowance provided.

To be considered for this job you must apply online at https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar. 

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Commission based

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

job.title: Multi-Media Account Executive, Entry Level
job.description:
MULTI-MEDIA ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - ENTRY LEVEL 
 
Stop just working a job and build your career today with WUTR/WFXV-TV! We are looking for great Salespeople in Utica, New York. As a large DMA geographically located in the heart of Utica; we have all the excitement and attractions you would expect in our area with all the activities and relaxation in our Rural area.


So, what are you waiting for? Are you a great Salesperson looking for a REAL Sales CAREER, then Utica, New York is it! 
 
The Nexstar Media Group in Utica is comprised of two Broadcast television stations ABC and FOX; plus our Nexstar Digital Agency Services selling ads on streaming TV & apps, along with retargeting ads across all devices & websites. 
 
To be successful you must fully embrace our consultative approach that uses a multimedia strategy to help our clients grow their business. If you are an overachiever who likes wild growth, then keep reading... 


  • In this position, you will develop and increase sales volume for both TV and digital revenue. 
  • Prospect, qualify, close and grow NEW business. 
  • Continue to learn and implement new strategies and products. 
  • Responsible for order entry, contracts, follow-up and collections 
  • Play a role in the production of client's creative elements. 
  • Be an advocate for our products and programs. 
  • Implement strategies to consistently grow revenue and exceed revenue goals. 
  • Establish credible relationships within our business community. 
  • Sales experience is preferred. 
  • Prepare and deliver sales presentations to clients. 
  • Proficient with popular social media and digital platforms 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, & Outlook 
  • Educate customers on the variety of available TV and Digital products to most effectively promote their products and/or services. 
  • Work with clients and station personnel to develop advertising and promotional campaigns. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

 
 
REQUIREMENTS 
 
Employment requires a Pre-employment criminal and driving background check, and a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record, strong oral and written communication skills. 
 
Full sales training provided. 
 
BENEFITS 
 
Salary Range: $40,000 - $60,000 
 
Salary Guarantee, plus ability to earn commission. 
 
We recognize their efforts by offering a competitive compensation plan and an array of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist/Anchor
job.description:
The MMJ/Anchor creates and presents original news and other interesting content across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging, and meaningful to consumers.

The successful candidate is an enterprising storyteller who can develop story ideas, report, write, shoot, edit, publish, and present content that connects with audiences wherever they consume information.

This position combines strong on-air presentation skills with the ability to create compelling content that informs, engages, and serves the communities we cover.

 

Responsibilities:

• Creates original news, feature, lifestyle, consumer, and other interesting content through enterprise reporting, research, interviews, and community engagement.

• Anchors live and recorded programming across broadcast and streaming platforms.

• Develops original story ideas and content that inform, engage, and grow audiences across multiple platforms.

• Produces original content for CW39+, including live streams, interviews, feature stories, special projects, and audience-focused programming.

• Shoots, writes, edits, publishes, and presents content independently as assigned.

• Creates content for digital and social platforms, including articles, videos, live streams, and audience engagement initiatives.

• Identifies trends, issues, people, and stories that matter to local audiences and develops compelling content around them.

• Collaborates with producers, reporters, photographers, and digital teams to create impactful multi-platform coverage.

• Writes and delivers content in a clear, conversational, authentic, and audience-focused manner.

• Conducts interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, subject matter experts, and members of the public.

• Responds to breaking news and other urgent newsroom situations as required.

• Participates in promotional activities, community events, and public appearances.

• Engages with viewers and users through social media and other digital platforms.

• Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity, accuracy, and production quality.

• Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements & Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

• Fluency in English.

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to ad lib when required.

• Minimum five years' experience in reporting, anchoring, multimedia journalism, or content creation for news and media platforms.

• Superior on-air presence and live presentation skills.

• Strong storytelling abilities across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to develop original story ideas and create enterprise content.

• Experience shooting, writing, editing, and publishing content across multiple platforms.

• News judgment with a strong understanding of current events, issues, and community interests.

• Ability to create content that informs, engages, and connects with diverse audiences.

• Strong social media and audience engagement skills.

• Ability to work independently while managing multiple deadlines and priorities.

• Ability to effectively listen, understand challenges, and collaborate with a team to shape solutions.

• Proficiency with newsroom, editing, streaming, and digital publishing technologies.

• Valid driver's license with a good driving record.

• Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: NewsNation - Associate Director - Part-time
job.description:
NewsNation is seeking an experienced Associate Director to support live and pre-recorded productions from our New York Bureau. This role is a critical member of the control room team, responsible for maintaining show timing, managing rundown elements, cueing video, and coordinating closely with Master Control to ensure smooth and accurate broadcasts.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced breaking news environment, communicates clearly under pressure, and works seamlessly with Directors, Producers, and technical teams to keep productions on track.

What You'll Do

· Partner with the Director to execute live and pre-recorded broadcasts.

· Maintain accurate show timing and track all production elements throughout the broadcast.

· Manage video, graphics, and other production assets within newsroom and playout systems.

· Cue and roll video elements using Bit Central and other production systems.

· Coordinate with Master Control regarding commercial breaks, timing adjustments, and live operational changes.

· Work closely with Producers and control room staff to ensure shows remain on schedule.

· Support breaking news coverage by adapting quickly to evolving editorial and operational needs.

· Collaborate with teams in New York, Chicago, and Washington, DC to support network-wide production execution.

What Success Looks Like

· Broadcasts run smoothly and accurately, even during fast-changing news situations.

· Timing, video playback, and rundown elements are executed with precision.

· Communication between the control room, production teams, and Master Control is clear and effective.

· Breaking news adjustments are handled calmly and efficiently without disrupting production.

· Directors and Producers can rely on accurate timing and operational support throughout every show.

Qualifications

· 2+ years of experience in a broadcast control room, production environment, or network news operation.

· Experience timing live broadcasts and managing rundown elements.

· Familiarity with newsroom computer systems such as iNews or ENPS.

· Experience with automated production and video playout systems preferred.

· Strong communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.

· Ability to remain calm and detail-oriented in a fast-paced live production environment.

· Availability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during major news events.

· DGA membership in good standing required.

Compensation

$65.00-$75.00 per hour, commensurate with experience.

 

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more.   Part time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans.  Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

About NewsNation: NewsNation is a national news network owned by Nexstar Media Group and dedicated to delivering fact-based, unbiased journalism for all Americans. Reaching audiences nationwide across cable, digital, and mobile platforms, NewsNation combines a national newsroom with the strength of more than 6,000 journalists in 110 local newsrooms across the country.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
Strategic Account Manager

 

KOIN 6 and Portland’s CW is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to help lead the growth of our digital and cross-platform advertising business in the Portland, OR market. This is a sales-focused, consultative leadership role for someone who understands that successful digital selling is about more than presenting products. The Strategic Account Manager will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Managers, and clients to uncover business challenges, develop compelling marketing strategies, and build solutions that drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, strong communicator, curious problem solver, and confident sales partner who can help transform complex digital marketing opportunities into simple, compelling solutions for local businesses. You will serve as a digital and cross-platform subject matter expert, helping the sales team identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, win new business, and grow existing accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Digital Revenue Growth
  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Managers to identify, develop, and close digital and cross-platform revenue opportunities.
  • Develop strategies to grow both new and existing digital business.
  • Identify high-potential accounts and verticals and create targeted sales strategies to penetrate those opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations as a strategic marketing and digital subject matter expert.
  • Help sales teams increase the value of client relationships by expanding marketing solutions beyond traditional television.
  • Become a Strategic Sales Partner
  • Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales process—from prospecting and discovery through presentation, closing, and campaign strategy.
  • Help sellers prepare for meetings through research, business intelligence, and development of a clear client-focused point of view.
  • Coach and collaborate with sellers on digital strategy, positioning, objection handling, and solution development.
  • Bring creativity and a challenger-style, consultative approach to client conversations.
  • Help simplify complex digital marketing concepts and translate them into clear business outcomes.
  • Develop Client-Centric Marketing Solutions
  • Conduct research to understand a client's business, competitive environment, target audience, and marketing objectives.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover client needs and opportunities rather than relying on a product-first sales approach.
  • Develop customized marketing strategies designed to increase awareness, generate leads, drive conversions, and grow market share.
  • Present recommendations with a focus on business outcomes, audience strategy, measurement, and return on investment.
  • Build trusted relationships with local businesses and advertising agencies by serving as a marketing resource and strategic advisor.
  • Lead Digital Sales Enablement
  • Keep the sales organization informed about new products, capabilities, industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities.

 

What We're Looking For

  • The ideal candidate will have:
  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, marketing, advertising technology, or a related field.
  • Strong consultative and solution-based sales skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to develop relationships with clients and uncover business needs.
  • Experience presenting marketing strategies and recommendations to business owners, executives, and/or advertising agencies.
  • A strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and current marketing trends.
  • The ability to translate complex marketing concepts, data, and technology into simple business solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive, competitive, and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to understand how marketing impacts revenue and growth.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with salespeople while also taking ownership of revenue opportunities.
  • A willingness to continually learn and adapt in a rapidly changing media and advertising landscape.

 

What Success Looks Like


Success in this role goes beyond selling digital products.

The successful Strategic Account Manager will:


  • Grow digital revenue.
  • Help Account Executives win more business and larger opportunities.
  • Create stronger, more strategic client relationships.
  • Turn client business challenges into compelling marketing solutions.
  • Increase adoption of cross-platform solutions.
  • Elevate the digital expertise of the entire sales organization.
  • Become a trusted strategic resource for both clients and sellers.

This is an opportunity for a sales-minded marketing strategist who wants to have a direct impact on revenue, client success, and the evolution of a modern local media organization.


NOTE: This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.


TO APPLY: Please visit the Work for us page at KOIN.com: http://bit.ly/2IsKviW or at the Nexstar Website at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar  to complete the application process.


ABOUT US: Broadcasting since 1953, KOIN-TV is Portland’s CBS affiliate, providing exceptional local news content on air and online (koin.com), CBS Network programming and syndicated entertainment to viewers across Oregon and SW Washington. KOIN News is Watching Out for You with 51 hours of local news broadcasts each week, featuring award-winning, in-depth investigations, news, weather, traffic, KOIN News AM-Extra and Game-On!  KOIN-TV is a Nexstar Media Group, Inc. television station serving Oregon and SW Washington from its studios in downtown Portland, OR. Nexstar is the largest local television broadcast and digital media company in the nation with 200 broadcast stations (including partner stations) in 116 markets reaching approximately 68% of US television households. Today, as one of the most powerful and trusted voices in America, Nexstar remains true to its mission to uphold the public interest principles of localism, diversity, and trustworthy, unbiased broadcast journalism. At the same time, the company continues to simultaneously raise its commitment to support the evolving needs and interests of the local viewers, hometown businesses and community organizations that it proudly serves each day.


If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us.


 **** EOE/MINORITIES/FEMALES/VETERANS/DISABLED****

KOIN is an equal opportunity employer that seeks diversity in our workforce. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

KOIN values the contribution of its employees. We recognize their efforts by offering a competitive compensation plan and an array of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more. We are committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. Any job offer is conditional upon satisfactorily completing a background and DMV check.
