job.title: 2027 NFL Rotational Program
job.description:
The NFL's highly selective and competitive Rotational Program provides participants with an unparalleled opportunity to contribute to the organization's success through a series of challenging project work assignments, League events, and networking opportunities across various departments.

Consideration will be given to current undergraduate seniors, including those completing a fifth consecutive year, with a GPA of 3.0 or above who will graduate in Winter 2026 or Spring 2027. This is a full-time opportunity, and participants must be available to begin the program in July 2027.

Only fully completed eligible applications will be considered, that includes an updated resume.

Deadline: Applications will close at 11:59pm ET on Wednesday, September 30.

Responsibilities

Program participants may complete up to four rotations over a two-year period in any one of the following offices or locations: NFL League Office (NY), NFL Media (CA), NFL Government Affairs Office (Washington, DC), or NFL Films (NJ). During each rotation, participants are placed in a department with project-based assignments. Specific department rotations will be determined based on actual business need. Departments that have participated in the program previously include, but not limited to; Communications & Public Affairs, Events Strategy, Finance, Football Operations, International, Marketing & Sales, Broadcasting, Labor Operations, and Media.

Placement opportunities within the NFL are based on existing business needs, the participant's performance, and previous work experience. Upon completion of the program, participants may opt to pursue internal opportunities, further education, opportunities at NFL Clubs and partner organizations, or opportunities outside the NFL. While this is a full-time two-year rotational program, continued employment beyond the scheduled end date is not guaranteed. 

Required Qualifications

  • Consideration will be given to currently enrolled undergraduate students in their senior year (including students completing their 5th consecutive year), graduating between Winter 2026 and Spring 2027 with an overall GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • If selected for the program, participants must be available for the start of the full-time, two-year program in July 2027 in the New York League Office. 
  • Applicants must be legally permitted to work in the United States and international students must have all visas and US employment authorizations prior to the start of the program.
  • Applicants must be willing to relocate to any NFL League office for a rotation at any point during the two-year period, depending on rotation placement.
  • Applicants must have strong internship/prior work experience.
  • Demonstrated interest in gaining a diverse set of experiences working in professional sports
  • Advanced Experience with Microsoft Office Suite: Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • Flexibility to adapt and thrive in a variety of work environments with various leadership styles and teams
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Proven independent thinking skills
  • Demonstrated relationship management
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams

Travel

  • Occasional travel may be required, depending on rotation placement

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

 

Salary $72,000—$72,000 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

This role will support the NFL’s departmental leads (three Senior Vice Presidents) with a focus on daily administrative and core operational support across these core functions of the League, in order to drive efficiency and optimize the productivity of these teams and leaders.

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls

job.title: Associate, Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting supports day-to-day accounting operations to ensure accurate financial reporting processing, adherence to technical accounting standards, and timely close activities. This role assists with journal entry preparation, reconciliations, and compliance with accounting standards. The Associate collaborates with management to maintain internal controls and deliver consistent, high-quality financial reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Assists with researching and planning the implementation of new accounting pronouncements.
  • Collaborate with the team to establish accounting memos supporting US and International accounting conclusions and coordinate with external auditors to ensure conclusions are appropriate.
  • Assist in the preparation of financial reports and play a support role in audit requests
  • Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) and internal management reports
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, corporate policies, and relevant accounting standards (e.g., GAAP/IFRS), implementing best practices to test and monitor those controls.
  • Work closely with Manager of Technical Accounting and Compliance to build and monitor internal control program.
  • Assist with maintaining documentation for accounting policies, reconciliations, and technical accounting memos.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of accounting experience, preferably in financial reporting or technical accounting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Foundational understanding of GAAP/IFRS and external financial reporting processes.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proactive approach to learning.
  • Oracle Cloud ERP or similar experience a plus.

job.title: Associate, Graphics Producer - Global Creative Marketing (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Graphics Producer to join the Global Creative Marketing team. This role will be responsible for managing workflow and assigning resources for design, animation, & graphics production requests for use in on-air commercials, social content, and digital marketing assets. Projects will support all areas of the NFL business, including tentpole events, social-first projects and series, various integrated marketing campaigns for the League, cause initiatives, and NFL media products.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day workload of in-house designers, illustrators, and animators, ensuring efficient process and delivery of all motion and static graphic elements produced by the team.
  • Collaborate with creative directors, campaign producers, editors, and other internal stakeholders to intake and prioritize design, illustration, and animation requests for the in-house team.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive deliverables lists, schedules, and Asana intake requests for and produced by the in-house teams.
  • Establish and maintain technical standards, processes, and workflows for external partners who produce and deliver graphic elements and toolkits for various campaigns.
  • Work cross functionally with IT, Engineering, Facilities, and other groups to ensure all designers and animators have the appropriate systems, tools, software, and processes in place to execute their work as efficiently as possible.
  • Provide high level quality control to ensure all graphic assets are delivered to the appropriate creative standards and technical specifications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 5+ years of experience

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working with project management software, preferably Asana.
  • Expert knowledge of workflow, formats, and specs for TV commercial production, social content, and digital marketing assets. Primary software: Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere.
  • Knowledge of the NFL, players, events, and storylines is preferred.
  • Extensive experience working in fast-paced creative environments.
  • Ability to multi-task, manage simultaneous creative requests and deadlines, and perform in high pressure situations.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to problem solve and troubleshoot in high pressure environments with limited time to do so.
  • This person has a strategic and creative mindset who is self-starting and manages projects and initiatives with minimal direction.
  • Possess excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Promote a culture of positivity, collaboration, creativity, innovation, and enthusiasm of work.
  • Most importantly, this person needs to be organized, efficient and eager to go the extra mile on
    every initiative.

job.title: Associate, HR Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities. 
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    1+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Associate, Marketing Science & Strategy- (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL Marketing Strategy & Insights team serves as the voice and advocate of NFL fans, leveraging diverse data sources to generate actionable insights that help inform League-wide business decisions and optimization. The Associate, Marketing Science and Strategy will support research and analysis across media, marketing, and key fan development priorities. This role is ideal for a curious, flexible, and detail-oriented professional who can help design and execute research, analyze syndicated and proprietary data, and translate findings into clear, strategic insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of primary research projects for the NFL.
  • Manage research initiatives by coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors to help ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget.
  • Create story-driven reports that translate research findings into strategic insights for teams across NFL Media, Marketing, Sponsorship, Club and other key areas.
  • Serve as a research resource and voice of the fan by supporting study development, methodology selection, survey design, data weighting, and reporting recommendations.
  • Use research tools and platforms, including MarketSight, Sports Poll, YouGov, and AceMetrix, to pull, analyze, and interpret data.
  • Provide support across Consumer Insights projects, including ad hoc analyses and custom research studies throughout the year.
  • Ensure research and insights work reflects best-in-class diversity, equity, and inclusion practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, analytics, consumer behavior, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of quantitative research, including the ability to write surveys aligned to business questions and research objectives.
  • Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, creative, and insightful reports for a diverse business audience.
  • Strong project management, relationship-building, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience with a range of research methods preferred.

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.

job.description:
The Coordinator, Accounting for Global Media supports accounting operations within the Global Media division, ensuring timely and accurate processing of financial transactions in accordance with accounting policies and procedures. This role assists with journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close activities to maintain accurate financial records. The position collaborates with Finance and business partners to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency across media-related accounting activities.

  • Support monthly close activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established deadlines.
  • Provide timely close variance explanations to Finance team.
  • Maintain compliance with accounting policies, US GAAP standards, and internal control requirements.
  • Collect and validate financial data to support management reporting and analysis.
  • Coordinate with Finance and business partners to resolve accounting discrepancies and ensure consistent reporting.
  • Assist with audit requests by providing accurate schedules and supporting documentation.

job.title: Director, Event Partnership Strategy & Development
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Event Partnership Strategy & Development to help drive the growth, innovation, and commercial success of the League's Events & International portfolio. Working closely with senior leadership, this role will lead strategic partnership initiatives, manage critical League commercial relationships, and identify new opportunities to expand revenue, enhance fan engagement, and strengthen the NFL's event platforms. 

The Director will serve as a key connector across Events, International, Sponsorship, Media, Consumer Products, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and the 32 Clubs. The role will develop business strategies, evaluate growth opportunities, and execute high-impact initiatives across major NFL tentpole events, including the Super Bowl, NFL Draft, NFL Scouting Combine, Kickoff, NFL Flag Championships, and International Games. 

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, relationship leadership, analytical rigor, and execution excellence. This individual will be comfortable moving between long-range strategy and day-to-day partner management, translating insights into clear recommendations and measurable business results. 

Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Commercial Management 

  • Serve as the day-to-day business lead for select League commercial partnerships, including On Location and event retail partners, managing relationships that drive meaningful revenue, fan engagement, operational performance, and long-term strategic value. 
  • Develop and execute growth plans that maximize commercial performance and identify opportunities to expand assets, activation platforms, audience reach, and partner value. 
  • Establish clear objectives, governance, performance expectations, and issue-escalation paths with partners to ensure consistent delivery against contractual and strategic commitments. 
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives across partner organizations, serving as a strategic advisor and solution-oriented representative of the League. 
  • Support the development, negotiation, renewal, and implementation of strategic commercial agreements in partnership with Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders. 

Strategic Growth & Business Development 

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and advancement of new revenue opportunities, business models, partnership structures, and growth initiatives across the NFL's Major Events & International portfolio. 
  • Help shape the long-term business strategy for key NFL event platforms, defining future commercial opportunities, fan experiences, and growth priorities that support broader League objectives. 
  • Develop business cases, strategic frameworks, and executive recommendations to evaluate potential investments, partnerships, new platforms, and other commercial opportunities. 
  • Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, emerging technologies, and competitive activity across sports, entertainment, media, hospitality, and live events to identify opportunities that strengthen the NFL's business position. 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution 

  • Lead cross-functional teams through the end-to-end development and execution of strategic initiatives, establishing clear objectives, workplans, decision points, responsibilities, and measures of success. 
  • Collaborate across Events, International, Sponsorship, Finance, Media, Consumer Products, Legal, Club Business Development, and other League functions to develop integrated business solutions and drive alignment. 
  • Oversee concurrent workstreams from concept through implementation, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with League priorities and partner commitments. 
  • Anticipate risks, identify challenges and interdependencies, and proactively develop recommendations that support successful execution and sustainable business outcomes. 

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Prepare and present business cases, strategic recommendations, partnership updates, and performance assessments for senior leadership, ownership committees, Clubs, and external partners. 
  • Develop post-event and post-initiative assessments that capture business performance, key learnings, growth opportunities, and recommendations for future improvement.  
  • Establish performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting tools that provide clear visibility into commercial results, partner delivery, and areas for future growth. 
  • Translate complex business issues, research, and financial information into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior leadership and other decision-makers. 

People & Team Leadership 

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development for assigned team members and project resources, setting clear priorities and reinforcing accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution. 
  • Help allocate resources across partnership management, business development, analytical work, and strategic initiatives to ensure the team remains focused on the highest-impact priorities. 
  • Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive team culture that values commercial curiosity, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and shared success. 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in business, finance, strategy, or a related field is a plus. 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sports, media, entertainment, live events, hospitality, consulting, financial services, or another commercially oriented business environment. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing business cases, partnership strategies, revenue growth initiatives, or new business opportunities. 
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience evaluating revenue models, forecasts, investments, and performance metrics. 
  • Proven ability to manage complex partner relationships and influence senior internal and external stakeholders without direct authority. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional executive communication, writing, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to distill complex issues into clear recommendations. 
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including experience developing executive-level presentations and data-driven analyses. 
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and highly organized, with sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a matrixed organization.

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets. 
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

Travel

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking a highly skilled Director, Stadium Network Architecture to serve as the senior technical authority for the design, implementation, operation, and evolution of the Football Technology network infrastructure supporting NFL stadiums, clubs, corporate locations, and international events.

This role is ideal for a hands-on Senior Network Architect with deep expertise in networking, routing and switching, network design, troubleshooting, and large-scale infrastructure operations. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across complex network environments while remaining actively involved in architecture, implementation, escalation support, and operational excellence.

The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.  

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.  

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.  

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of Football Technology network services considering performance, redundancy, scalability, and security. 
    • Document standards and guidelines for best practice stadium network and wireless architecture as they align to industry standards and best practices.
    • Develop and present comprehensive network design proposals to stakeholders, addressing business requirements and technical specifications.
    • Assist in the research, design and documentation for upgrades and adoption of new network technologies.
    • Provide hands on configuration and escalation support for all stadium network technologies.
  • Responsible for the installation, operation, administration, and maintenance of wired and wireless networks at stadiums and corporate offices.
    • Provide dedicated support for on-site stadium network and Wi-Fi technicians during NFL game days throughout the NFL season.
    • Responsible for managing and maintaining network diagrams, configurations, support, and training documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including operations, security, Events, and others to align network strategies with business goals.
    • Responds to technical escalations for wired and wireless service issues, working with product support teams, IT staff and business groups to ensure resolution.
    • Provide reports for network KPIs to show service levels, capacity analysis, performance, troubleshooting, and areas for improvement in network infrastructure.
    • Provide technical support to various activities and internal infrastructure within the Football Technology segment.
    • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
    • Establish and adhere to set project plans and release dates.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior network engineers, sharing expertise and knowledge.
  • Remain on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art network technologies, participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations
  • Maintain and publish Football Stadium DAS and Wi-Fi Guidelines
    • Review and plan DAS and Wi-Fi updates for NFL Tentpole Events.
    • Lead audits of Cellular and DAS Performance around NFL stadiums to adhere to NFL guidelines.
    • Collaborate with Cellular Vendors on stadium enhancements, and testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field preferred, with 10+ years of experience or equivalent military service.
  • Extensive hands-on experience exceeding 10 years in network implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Demonstrated leadership with over 5 years in network architecture roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience in wireless design, implementation, and support for large networks, including spectrum analysis and stadium DAS design.
  • Proficient in network administration, particularly Cisco products, with expertise in controllers, access points, routers, and switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, STP, NAT, IPSEC, GRE, VPC/VSS, etc.)
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts and principles, including but not limited to routing static/dynamic (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, & BGP) and multi-layer switching (standard and private VLANs, VTP, Spanning Tree, etc.)

 Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting networking device drivers and client system issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting video and voice performance over wired and wireless networks.
  • Capability to research and evaluate new network technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in creating and updating detailed infrastructure topologies using MS Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine and DNA.

Travel

30% - 50%, domestic and international.

job.title: Manager, Football Business Strategy
job.description:
The Manager, Football Business Strategy will plan, implement, and execute initiatives that support Football Operations strategic priorities. The role will lead the research, testing, and development required to evaluate and implement innovations across Future of Football workstreams, while managing a portfolio of high- impact projects. This role will also address a diverse set of football business challenges by partnering regularly with internal departments, clubs, vendors, sponsors and other external stakeholders. The Manager, Football Business Strategy may also oversee interns, rotational analysts, coordinators, or project-based contributors supporting Football Business Strategy and Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, execution, and oversight of strategic initiatives that support Football Operations priorities, including football innovation, game operations and policy, international growth, and long-range organizational planning.
  • Manage the League’s Future of Football portfolio, including technology evaluations, pilot programs, stakeholder alignment, testing plans, implementation support, and performance reporting for Football Operations leadership and club stakeholders.
  • Support Football Operations business planning, budget development, forecasting, enterprise risk management, KPI reporting, and strategic decision-making through financial, operational, and scenario analysis.
  • Serve as the project manager for football technology and data initiatives, including club analytics devices, data-sharing programs, operational technology deployments, game day support, and vendor-supported innovation efforts.
  • Develop executive-level presentations, recommendations, memoranda, and reporting for senior leadership, the Competition Committee, Future of Football Committee, Technology Committee, and other key stakeholder groups.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, procurement, contract administration, payment tracking, and RFP processes across assigned workstreams, including technology platforms, football operations services, and innovation partnerships.
  • Partner with internal and external partners to identify opportunities to improve football operations through emerging technologies, automation, data, and artificial intelligence.
  • Support international football development initiatives programs that strengthen football ecosystems, expand participation pathways, and support the long-term growth of the game globally.
  • Coordinate complex cross-functional projects and stakeholder engagement efforts, ensuring alignment across clubs, League departments, vendors, and external football organizations while delivering against established timelines and strategic objectives.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, decision logs, budgets, and status reporting for assigned initiatives.
  • Provide support across League tentpole events, football technology testing, and other Football Operations priorities.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in addressing ad hoc projects and evolving organizational needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5-7+ years of experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in football operations, sports technology, data, and AI, with familiarity across emerging technologies, integration, and adoption workflows.
  • Experience managing strategic, operational, technology, or consulting projects with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, vendor management, procurement, contracting, or RFP processes preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, judgment, and follow-
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for executive, club, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with project management and collaboration tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business, technical, and operational information into clear recommendations and executive-ready materials.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  •  Collaborative relationship-builder who can work effectively across a small team and lead cross- functional stakeholder groups.
  • Proactive, adaptable self-starter who can manage ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and drive work to completion.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Ability to support game day, evening, weekend, and tentpole-event responsibilities when required by assigned projects.
  • Approximately 25% travel, including travel to League and club events, meetings, technology tests, and other Football Operations activities.

job.title: Manager, International Growth
job.description:
The Manager, International Growth is a critical strategic leader responsible for helping to shape the future of the NFL’s global business. This high-impact role is a thought partner to senior leadership, driving the evaluation, development, and execution of initiatives that accelerate the League’s expansion and deepen its influence in international markets.

This position is essential in identifying growth opportunities, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and advancing the NFL’s strategic priorities across global territories. The ideal candidate combines sharp strategic thinking and a collaborative mindset to help unlock long-term business value on the world stage.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, refinement, and execution of international growth strategies that generate long-term enterprise value for the League, balancing financial return, strategic positioning, operational feasibility, and partnership alignment.
  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor by identifying new market opportunities and developing clear, data-backed recommendations for global business expansion.
  • Serve as end-to-end project lead for high-profile initiatives: developing business cases, building execution frameworks, managing cross-functional collaboration, and delivering post-launch analysis to senior leadership.
  • Own the financial modeling, KPI development, and ongoing performance monitoring of international growth initiatives.
  • Cultivate strong partnerships across key NFL departments, including Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Media, Football Development, Events, Club Business Development, Legal, Finance, and Marketing, ensuring seamless integration of global strategies.
  • Drive cross-regional collaboration and knowledge sharing between NFL territory offices and League headquarters, facilitating operational excellence and strategic alignment.
  • Develop polished, executive-ready presentations and strategic materials for senior stakeholders and NFL leadership.
  • Support the International and Events leadership teams in annual business planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in strategy, business development, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to global sports, media, or entertainment industries.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from ideation through execution in fast-paced, matrixed environments.
  • Advanced capabilities in financial modeling, business case development, and strategic storytelling (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency required).
  • Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building abilities, with sensitivity to diverse cultural and geographic nuances.
  • Creative thinker with a passion for solving business problems and unlocking new opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in international business strategy, sports management, or global brand expansion.
  • Track record of success in management consulting or a growth-focused strategic function within a global organization.

job.title: Manager, Revenue & Strategy
job.description:
The NFL’s Club Business Development department (Club BD) supports the 32 clubs in delivering direct local value and best-in-class fan experiences via data-driven insights and innovation. The team utilizes its robust sports business expertise to develop 'next practices' and facilitates the sharing of 'best practices' between clubs.  In addition to working with the clubs, Club BD works cross-functionally to drive key strategic initiatives at a League level, including the sales, marketing, strategic planning, and operations behind the League’s domestic and international tentpole events.

The Manager, Revenue & Strategy, will support two main initiatives: A cross-functional program developed and led by Club BD that identifies opportunities to optimize club revenue and drive sustainable, local business improvements and the sales, strategy, management, and operations of the NFL’s Super Bowl Suites. Both initiatives require collaboration with internal NFL teams, the 32 clubs, and third parties at all levels of seniority.

This role is at the unique intersection of strategy, analytics, consulting, and business development. Candidates with mastery in one or multiple of these skill sets, as well as generalists, will be considered. A self-starter with strong skills in data analysis, problem-solving, project management, and organization is most preferred.

The individual in this role will also have the opportunity to support critical strategic initiatives both within the Club Business Development group as well as cross-organizational groups that inform club revenue, fan engagement, and gameday experience strategies, among others.

Responsibilities

  • Support local business optimization initiative across League and clubs, collaborating with League and club stakeholders, and external vendors
  • Support the ongoing management of the data model that identifies the revenue opportunities across the 32 NFL clubs and lead project management across the program
  • Support all phases of the Super Bowl Suite sales process including strategic planning, pricing, inventory management, sales, reporting, and driving operational execution and backend administrative management.
  • Drive local business analysis to inform actionable insights and strategic recommendations in coordination with Club Business Development’s club consulting team
  • Support analysis and reporting across Club BD initiatives on an ad-hoc basis, mainly executive League meetings and End of Season reporting materials.
  • Develop strong, respectful relationships and build credibility with Club and League Office business contacts

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 years of experience in management consulting, strategy & analytics, project management, business development, or related fields

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent communication, project management, and interpersonal skills
  • Self-starter who can think critically and individually find solutions
  • Strong analytical skills, including ability to derive insights from complex data, analytics, and research; visualize those findings; and present to all levels of an organization
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Problem solving and issue resolution skills, strong ability to “keep the ball moving forward”
  • Ability to navigate a matrixed, cross-organizational landscape successfully, fostering strong relationships along the way
  • Unwavering commitment to honest and ethical business interactions
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, good time management and organizational skills
  • Sports business experience a plus but not required
  • Candidate should be ambitious, self-sufficient, a critical and creative thinker, a problem solver, and results and detail-oriented

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Expected Travel 25% of the time

job.title: Part-Time Coordinator, Real-Time Systems
job.description:
The Part-Time Coordinator, Real-Time Systems provides operational support for digital graphics workflows that support FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other NFL Media productions. This role assists with the preparation, monitoring, quality control, and execution of real-time graphics, ticker content, and Viz-based workflows while supporting day-to-day RTS operations.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation, validation, and execution of graphics workflows supporting digital media productions, FAST channels, NFL+, and RedZone programming.
  • Review and validate ticker content, L-Bar playlists, sponsorship elements, and graphics content to help ensure accuracy and consistency across platforms.
  • Support the setup, testing, and quality control of Viz graphics, templates, page generation tools, and associated production assets.
  • Monitor graphics systems, applications, and data feeds before and during productions and escalate issues to senior RTS staff when needed.
  • Work with production, graphics, engineering, and operations teams to facilitate workflow readiness and execution for scheduled productions and special events.
  • Update operational documentation, tracking sheets, system inventories, and event support records to support RTS operational readiness.
  • Support testing, rehearsal, and setup activities for major NFL events and digital productions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Up to 3 years of experience in media operations, digital production, broadcast operations, graphics support, or related fields.
  • Basic understanding of digital production environments and live content workflows.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and production documentation.
  • Ability to learn technical production and graphics systems quickly.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Team-oriented and collaborative.
  • Reliable and dependable under deadline pressure.
  • Strong time-management and prioritization skills.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in production and office environments.
  • Ability to occasionally move equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel or minimal travel expected, which would potentially include support for special events or remote productions.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time position working fewer than 29 hours per week. 
  • Flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on production needs.
  • Additional hours may be available during peak production periods.
  • This position is anticipated to last up to six months based on business needs. 

Salary / Pay Range

job.title: Part-Time Digital Video Editor
job.description:
The NFL Media Group is seeking a versatile digital video editor with advanced skills in Adobe Premiere and After Effects. The Digital Video Editor is responsible for executing weekly deliverables for all NFL Media platforms. The editor can work autonomously or with a story producer on feature stories or elements. This position is responsible for editing, post producing and finishing features while working with post Supervisors and researchers for support.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, and tailored to our digital audience.
  • Exhibit knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud Suite, including advanced skills in using Premiere and After Effects.
  • Design various graphics and elements for NFL digital platforms.
  • Involved in all aspects of daily and weekly post-production delivery of Original Content for Digital and Social platforms.
  • Works closely with Original Content Group directors and decision-makers on a daily basis in terms of concepts/ideas, storylines, and post-production.
  • Post-Produces feature stories from start to finish; Including research, edit and delivery.
  • Formulates and develops storylines during post-production in collaboration with producers, writers and other departments.
  • Post-production of high-end features, YouTube shorts, and cross-platform elements.
  • Communicates with all parties involved in post-production process from researchers to producers to ensure quality storytelling and timely delivery of features.
  • Adheres to established post-production workflows, and schedules in order to meet deadlines and follow best practices as set forth by the department.
  • A creative team attitude is mandatory in all tasks requested from the smallest to largest project assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, broadcast media, web production or related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in production environment working with digital/ social media platforms.
  • Experience editing high-end content for social/ digital platforms.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must have strong knowledge of NFL history, including notable teams, players and games.
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League associated events and current storylines.
  • Must be able to take complex stories and concisely tell them to our fans.
  • Experience editing content for YouTube.
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines.
  • High level of attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of CMS platforms.
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time position working fewer than 29 hours per week.

Salary / Pay Range

job.title: Part-Time Media Design Group Designer/Animator
job.description:
The NFL Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to create high-quality graphics, motion design, and visual storytelling assets that support shows, live events, special programming, and emerging platforms. This role combines concept development, design execution, and animation, requiring creativity, technical expertise, and a strong attention to detail.

Working closely with Art Directors and Creative Producers, the Designer/Animator will develop original concepts, iterate on creative solutions, and deliver polished motion graphics that meet the highest production standards.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize, design, and animate high-production-value graphics for a variety of NFL Media projects.
  • Create original visual concepts and translate them into compelling motion design solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Art Directors to ensure creative alignment and execution excellence.
  • Develop scalable, repeatable animation systems and templates that can be shared across internal teams, editors, and external vendors.
  • Maintain organized project files and adhere to established workflows and production standards.
  • Partner with Creative Producers to establish realistic timelines and manage design, revision, and delivery schedules.
  • Balance multiple assignments while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Execute projects efficiently, including those with accelerated turnaround times, by leveraging existing toolkits, templates, and custom assets.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in design, motion graphics, or animation.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects (including Scripting and Mogrts), Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience using Figma, UI/UX design
  • Knowledge of Cinema 4D (C4D)
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations from original concepts, style guides, existing graphic packages, and creative references.
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, visual storytelling, and production workflows.
  • Ability to follow established file naming conventions, organizational standards, and production processes.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to perform in a highly collaborative setting. 
  • Confidence in a fast-paced environment 
  • Flexibility when faced with new information, needs or challenges 
  • Ability to ask questions and communicate with art directors and creative producers when uncertain a current assignment or when ready for the next one. 
  • Willingness to invest in understanding the business of the NFL to better support and enhance how the League serves our clubs and engages our fans.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours per week
  • Flexibility to work non-standard hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as production schedules require.

Salary / Pay Range

job.title: Seasonal Bilingual Video Editor, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a bilingual (Spanish/English) seasonal video editor adept in the Adobe Creative Suite who will help bring to life imaginative video content. This position will be executing a variety of projects and campaigns, including support for owned & operated social channels, player social media support, original content series, marketing campaigns and more. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of and experience with creating social video.

Essential Functions:

  • Pitch and create video optimized for social platforms
  • Embrace new and innovative ways to tell stories across the NFL’s social channels
  • Identify opportunities to create new and fresh video content by utilizing new trends and tools
  • Ensure logical sequencing through organizing and trimming footage segments
  • Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
  • Handle critical deadlines and short turnarounds in a fast-paced environment

Required Education and Experience:

  • Fluency in English and Spanish mandatory; working proficiency in Portuguese a bonus
  • 2-4+ years of proven editing experience (sports editing preferred, but not required) for social and digital platforms
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong emphasis in Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, and Media Encoder
  • Strong audio and music editing skills
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
  • Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness
  • Working knowledge of video and audio encoding, standards and formats
  • Familiarity with special effects, 3D and compositing are a plus

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred in film studies, cinematography or related fields

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must demonstrate exceptional problem-solving skills

  • May be opportunities for overtime
  • Up to 7 months position based on business need

job.title: Seasonal Designer, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
Summary/Objective:

The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a bilingual (Spanish/English) seasonal designer adept in the Adobe Creative Suite for the NFL's official social platforms, as well as other NFL-affiliated channels, teams, and players with a focus on supporting our international Spanish speaking channels. The right candidate has a passion for football, social media and storytelling, and has a drive to create new and innovative original content. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of and experience with social design.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and animate various graphics and other creative needs for the NFL's official social platforms and other NFL-affiliated social platforms, teams, and players.
  • Work with large creative team made up of designers, illustrators, editors, and copywriters to conceive and executive multiple daily projects.
  • Pitch and conceptualize original content ideas and franchises for NFL social media platforms.
  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, snackable and true to the content
  • Identify important storylines from around the NFL and know how to best tell them to our audience

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 2-5 years of relevant experience in graphic design and animation
  • Must have prior experience building and animating assets on social and/or digital platforms
  • Must have a Design portfolio containing various examples of relevant work
  • Strong ability with Photoshop, After Effects, and Illustrator are must-have’s.
  • Video Editing experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must be willing to work early mornings, nights, and weekends due to the nature of the NFL schedule
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Knowledge of football and the NFL audience is a major plus
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to take creative direction and incorporate feedback into revised work
  • Must be able to handle concept changes and accept creative feedback

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends

Opportunities for overtime.

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. job.title: Seasonal Graphics Designer/Animator
job.description:
The Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to design and animate graphics and other design-based assets supporting shows, events, special programming or emerging platforms. This work involves a combination of creating unique designs and animations and iterating and expanding on existing style guides and toolkits, under the direction of a team of an Art Director and Creative Producer. 

Responsibilities

  • Design and animate content for the various groups serviced by NFL Creative LA. 
  • Be able to work with deadlines that can be as short as same-day, leveraging existing toolkits or unique assets, with the guidance of the project’s art director and creative producer, to deliver on time. 
  • Design show key art for partners using existing style guides as well as creating evergreen assets.
  • Resize existing assets to fit partner guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience working in the design-animation field. 
  • Proficient knowledge Adobe After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • A working knowledge of C4D (preferably Octane render engine) proficiency may be required, based on the job placement.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Audio 2
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is looking for an A2 Audio Mixer. This role will provide supplemental audio production services by coordinating, mixing, and delivering support audio for live news/sports and key show programming. Production services will be located at our State-of-the-Art NFL Media Studios in Inglewood, CA. 

Responsibilities

  • Mix live and recorded show format productions with heavy emphasis on remotes and server playback.
  • Test and verify equipment: Networked audio consoles, intercoms, multiple audio and video servers, EVS Playback audio.
  • Required experience working with cart playback systems such as Ovation or 360systems. Must work with system templates and Music logging files.
  • Extensive knowledge and proper setup protocol of communication panels (i.e. Riedel) required.
  • Work with A1, show director and production teams on the proper audio requirements for each show.
  • Must display a strong sense of team with the audio group and all levels of staff.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high pressure environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned such as A3 functions. 

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience mixing linear and IP content in a television studio environment, including live and non-live productions.
  • Experience mixing with SSL audio boards (specifically S500) preferred.
  • Experience in Stereo and 5.1. surround mixing formats required.
  • Understanding of IP Networked audio devices, specifically AES67 with Dante knowledge or certifications a plus. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must possess superior interpersonal communication and organizational skills. 
  • Detail oriented/multi-tasker with ability to work independently or in teams. 
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple, File management, Email, Slack, MS Teams, ENPS). 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible hours including holidays, nights, and weekends.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking an experienced Audio 1 (A1) to lead audio production for live and recorded programming across NFL Media platforms. This position serves as the primary audio lead responsible for the planning, execution, mixing, and overall quality of audio elements supporting studio, remote, and special event productions. 

The ideal candidate possesses extensive live broadcast audio experience, strong technical expertise in modern IP-based audio environments, and a proven ability to perform in fast-paced, high-profile sports production settings. Production services will be based at NFL Media's state-of-the-art broadcast facility in Inglewood, California. 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead audio mixer for live and recorded productions, ensuring the highest level of audio quality and operational excellence.
  • Design, configure, and execute complex audio workflows for studio shows, remote broadcasts, special events, and digital productions.
  • Operate and mix live productions utilizing broadcast audio consoles, playback systems, communication systems, and IP-based audio infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, technical directors, engineering teams, and production personnel to deliver consistent and impactful audio experiences.
  • Develop and maintain show-specific audio configurations, routing strategies, and operational workflows.
  • Lead audio planning for remote productions, transmission paths, venue integration, and signal management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical audio issues in real time while maintaining on-air continuity.
  • Oversee proper setup, operation, and optimization of communications systems, including Riedel intercom platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with broadcast audio standards and best practices across stereo, surround sound, and emerging audio formats.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and operational direction to A2 and A3 personnel and freelance audio staff as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in emerging broadcast technologies, IP networking standards, and audio production workflows.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional broadcast audio experience, including significant experience mixing live sports and studio productions.
  • Proven experience serving as an Audio 1 (A1) or senior-level broadcast audio mixer in a professional television, streaming, or live event environment.
  • Advanced experience operating SSL audio consoles; experience with SSL System T and S500 platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in stereo, 5.1 surround, and multi-channel broadcast audio mixing.
  • Extensive knowledge of IP-based audio infrastructures, including AES67, Dante, SMPTE 2110, and related broadcast networking technologies.
  • Experience supporting complex remote productions, transmission workflows, and large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, routing, communications systems, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Proficiency with playback systems, audio servers, and broadcast production technologies.
  • Experience working with Riedel communications systems and networked intercom environments preferred. 

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting national sports broadcasts and large-scale live events.
  • Dante Certification or equivalent IP audio networking credentials.
  • Experience with EVS audio workflows and replay systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based or remote production environments.
  • CTS, Dante, or other relevant industry certifications. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple competing demands while maintaining production quality.
  • Strong technical proficiency with broadcast systems, production software, and collaboration tools. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.
  • Ability to support remote productions and occasional travel as business needs require.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule to include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.
