job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities. 

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Utility
job.description:

Under supervision of the Stage Manager, Director, and Operations team, Utilities work with technical staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped, and automated programming.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations   

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments

job.title: Seasonal Product Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media group seeks a dynamic Product Operations Coordinator to provide crucial support across various platforms including NFL.com, the NFL app, NFL Fantasy, and Club Sites. This role will be integral in coordinating operational activities and ensuring seamless execution. Reporting directly to the Senior Product Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in optimizing digital product performance.

Responsibilities

  • Support Product Operations projects across NFL.com, the NFL app, Club Sites, and other owned and operated digital platforms.
  • Assist with operational readiness for new products, features, and seasonal initiatives by helping create and maintain runbooks, training materials, documentation, workflows, and escalation paths.
  • Support digital content programming and site operations through approved administrative tools and content management systems.
  • Assist with tracking project deliverables, open issues, launch readiness items, stakeholder updates, and post-launch follow-up
  • Partner with Product Operations, Content Operations, Product Management, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to support day-to-day digital platform operations.
  • Help document business rules, operational processes, and support procedures to improve team readiness and consistency.
  • Provide operational support for NFL-owned and operated digital platforms on NFL gamedays, preseason games, tentpole events, and other live event windows.
  • Assist with live streaming operations across applicable platforms, including web, mobile web, mobile app, tablet, and CTV.
  • Support live game and event monitoring by validating stream availability, content presentation, platform behavior, and user-facing experiences.
  • Report, prioritize, and escalate issues in real time to minimize disruption during live events.
  • Partner with Game Day Operations, Clubs, Engineering, Product, and Support teams to track issues through resolution.
  • Assist with post-event documentation, issue recaps, and follow-up items to improve future event coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Rapid ability to learn new systems and programs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards driving positive change.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with teams.
  • Capacity to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Availability to work on all NFL Game Days, including Preseason, Regular Season, and Playoffs, in-office, as well as holidays such as Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve, and New Year's.
  • Sound knowledge of sports and digital sports products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science or Arts degree in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field is preferred
  • 1-3 years’ experience coordinating and supporting digital products in a sports entertainment, digital, media or related industry
  • Prior experience with Live event support
  • Prior experience with Content Management Systems (CMS)
  • Prior experience in operational support of a web and mobile based applications

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to comprehend and document business rules effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills.
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football.

  • Seasonal, 7-month role
  • Must be flexible to work weekends (specifically Sundays in-season)

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

Travel

  • No regular travel expected.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time, non-exempt position requiring 40 hours per week.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on production needs.
  • Seasonal position up to 7 months 

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Senior Coordinator, International Growth
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, International Growth, is focused on helping shape and articulate the strategic direction of the NFL’s international business. This position will also help to develop and evaluate new initiatives that drive growth across various aspects of the business.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of strategies to drive long-term strategic value for the League in the international market, balancing financial, strategic, operational, and partnership consideration
  • Research, design, develop, and recommend data-informed concepts and solutions across international
  • Project manage specific initiatives from beginning to end, including preliminary business case analysis, execution plan development, cross-functional communication, and post-project impact assessments
  • Own financial analysis, KPI development, and other data tracking associated with ongoing projects and initiatives
  • Partner with key NFL departments, including: Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Media, Football Development, Events, Club BD, Legal, Finance, Marketing, among others
  • Manage day-to-day coordination across territory offices and the League office with a focus on cross-functional information sharing and collaboration
  • Create documents and presentation materials for executive-level audiences
  • Coordinate and track various components of the Global Markets Program, in collaboration with Club Business Development
  • Support the International and Events teams with annual and long-term business planning

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2-3 years strategy experience, preferably with a management consulting or sports/events background
  • Excellent project management skills and ability to deliver against deadlines while simultaneously managing multiple projects
  • Strong abilities in presentation design and financial modeling/analysis (requires proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Adept communicator with the ability to create, nurture, and sustain key relationships across many different areas of businesses (with various time zones and cultural nuances)
  • Problem-solver, solution-oriented, a strategic and creative thinker

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in an international role at a sports management organization
  • Proven success in consulting, sports management, and/or international business

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Analytics
job.description:
Fan Engagement Data Science turns fan behavior into the strategies that shape how millions of fans experience the NFL. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that work, partnering with our NYC team and stakeholders across Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights, while leading a distributed offshore delivery team to turn ambiguous ideas into sharp, high-impact analytics. You’ll work end-to-end, from framing the right question to presenting the answer to Director- and VP-level leaders, on a fast-moving team delivering against one of the NFL's biggest fan engagement programs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights stakeholders into scoped, high-impact analytical work.
  • Lead and coach a distributed offshore delivery team, keeping quality, pace, and prioritization on track across a compressed daily overlap window.
  • Own your work end-to-end — from framing a hypothesis to presenting recommendations directly to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across marketing, technology, BI, and data engineering as a trusted analytics voice in the room.
  • Design segmentation, predictive models, and experiments (A/B tests) that convert fan behavior into targeted, actionable marketing strategies.
  • Apply GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics tools, within governed workflows, to move faster from data to insight.
  • Define and manage KPIs for fan engagement, partnering with the BI Center of Excellence to expand access to insight across the org.
  • Champion data quality and integrity across every initiative you touch

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in customer or fan data analytics, with a strong track record of translating data into marketing strategy.
  • Experience turning ambiguous business questions into scoped, delivery-ready analytical work.
  • Experience leading or closely partnering with distributed or offshore teams.
  • A confident, clear communicator — comfortable presenting directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL and Python; working knowledge of ML frameworks and GenAI/LLM-based analytics tools.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Understanding of data management principles, including identity resolution and marketing consent.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer data platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with PII management and data privacy practices.
  • Experience with governed AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (e.g., Monte Carlo, Atlan).

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Bias to Ownership: Treats an ambiguous or stalled workstream as something to unblock and drive forward, not something to report status on and wait for direction.
  • Leadership Excellence: Strong leadership skills with a history of managing diverse, distributed, and cross-functional teams effectively.
  • Communication Mastery: Excellent ability to simplify complex data insights into strategic actions and communicate these clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, including in contested or high-pressure settings.

job.title: Senior Manager, Global Event Production
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Senior Manager of Event Production to support the delivery and management of the NFL’s U.S.-based tentpole events as well as Latin America, Australia, and Asia, with a primary focus on fan experiences. This role will contribute to event planning, operational execution, and fan engagement initiatives, helping deliver high-quality experiences that align with broader business, commercial, marketing, and international market objectives.

Responsibilities

Event Management

  • Proven experience supporting the planning and delivery of both large and small-scale events across the U.S. and internationally
  • Operational experience across sport and fan/public events
  • Working knowledge of key event components, including security operations, health and safety, local authority coordination, programming, community engagement, scheduling, branding/creative, and procurement
  • Ability to create reporting to relevant stakeholders, including post mortems

Fan Event Delivery

  • Support the planning and execution of events supporting Super Bowl, Draft, Combine, NFL FLAG (domestic tentpole events)S, as well as year-round activities in collaboration with local international offices and key business functions
  • Assist in delivering gameday and non-gameday fan experiences, kickoff events, watch parties, local market activations internationally, NFL club activations, community initiatives, partner integration, and lead generation activities
  • Conduit to the NFL OnePass app (event companion app) content and engagement

Budgeting

  • Support the tracking and management of fan event budgets in the U.S. and internationally
  • Assist in monitoring costs to ensure delivery within agreed targets, highlighting risks and opportunities
  • Contribute to building event budgets in line with event plans and League procurement processes

Agency Management

  • Support the day-to-day management of event agencies across fan events
  • Assist with RFP processes and onboarding of vendors where required
  • Maintain strong working relationships with agency partners

Team & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support successful event delivery
  • Contribute to cross-functional working groups globally
  • Assist in coordinating with external partners, including city/host authorities, local organizing committees, government sports bodies, and stadium/team partners

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years’ experience in the events and/or hospitality industry
  • Some prior experience in team leadership or mentoring
  • Strong knowledge of delivering large-scale fan or public events
  • Experience managing or supporting event budgets
  • Experience working with multiple partners and agencies
  • Strong stakeholder management skills
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to support revenue-generating initiatives
  • Interest in or understanding of American Football is a plus

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Highly organized with strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Effective problem-solver with sound judgment and decision-making ability
  • Confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across teams
  • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Builds positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Proactive, enthusiastic, and committed to high standards

Management Expectations

  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior team members
  • Ability to contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment
  • Willingness to learn and develop management capabilities

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (30%)
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as required

job.title: Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship is part of the Global Partnerships team that manages and executes League sponsorship deals and relationships. Key duties include managing day-to-day relationships with League partners, including activations, strategy, planning, creative, and work across the League to support partner initiatives. This role serves as the project leader across key NFL events and tentpoles. The Senior Manager will also lead international territory activations at international games, working closely with global offices. The position also requires sales skills and asset creation/development with execution. 

Responsibilities

  • Manage the relationship with 7-9 NFL domestic and global partners; responsible for strategic planning of season-long activation programs, day-to-day partner activations, and contractual deliverables
  • Lead weekly status calls with partner and agency teams, while also organizing and tracking internal account team tasks for partner deliverables
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (including Marketing, Events, Community Relations, Media, PR, Brand, Legal etc.) to align partner programs and League initiatives
  • Responsible for partner upsell opportunities, including asset development, sales pitch, and program execution
  • Manage account Coordinators
  • Support the Sponsorship Director on renewals, contractual deliverables, and overall business planning
  • Act as the on-site activation lead at NFL events, including oversight of experiential activations and partner experiences
  • Lead international game territory and closely collaborate with global General Managers and activation teams
  • Lead international hospitality program for dedicated territory and ensure partner activations for territory are delivered
  • Serve as cross-departmental project manager lead on specific projects to secure and execute partner deliverables (Flag Championships, Draft, Kickoff, etc)
  • Lead weekly Manager meetings to discuss priorities, partner needs, and project management
  • Build and develop relationships with partner contacts, including client hosting at NFL events
  • All responsibilities include supporting Global business of the NFL

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8-10 years of experience in sports or with agency

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Sports Sponsorship background
  • League or Club experience
  • Client management experience
  • Sales/Revenue generation
  • Additional language proficiency preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Self-starter with strong work ethic
  • Team player
  • Strong communication skills
  • Problem solver
  • Creative thinker
  • Good with time management
  • Organized

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Work will exceed 40 hours per week
  • Planning and execution of events
  • Some weekend/global travel work for hosting clients
  • Travel around planning and executing events…25% of time

job.title: Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 6 - 8+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6 - 8+ years of progressive experience in data strategy, product management, data governance, or technology leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading complex data and analytics programs, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, consent management, and responsible data practices.
  • Experience supporting fan, customer, or consumer-centric organizations, with knowledge of engagement strategies, audience development, and lifecycle marketing preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging enterprise data and marketing technology platforms, including AWS Redshift, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, drive alignment across business and technology teams, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, and scale processes, capabilities, and teams to support evolving business needs.
  • Strong strategic and operational mindset, with experience establishing governance models, prioritizing competing demands, managing risks, and delivering results in fast-paced environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields preferred

  • Limited Travel

job.title: VP, Product & Design
job.description:
The VP (Vice President), Product & Design will lead product experience and roadmap development across the NFL’s portfolio of digital products and platforms, translating vision and strategy into scalable execution. As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own the product roadmap for the NFL’s fan-facing product portfolio across web, app, CTV, identity, and subscription experiences
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate enterprise priorities and agreed business objectives into product roadmap decisions, prioritization, sequencing, and execution plans
  • Lead short-term, seasonal, and multi-year product roadmap planning and sequencing, aligned to the broader long-range business plan and agreed investment priorities
  • Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

Product Delivery & Performance

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for product roadmap execution, sequencing, delivery excellence, experience quality, product operating cadence, and post-launch value optimization across the digital portfolio
  • Translate agreed strategic priorities into delivered product outcomes that support business goals
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to define KPI frameworks, measurement processes, and post-launch evaluation methodologies
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation, learning, and iteration

Fan Experience & Design Leadership

  • Lead the Product and Design organizations responsible for creating engaging and intuitive fan experiences
  • Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys
  • Ensure consistency and quality across all fan-facing experiences

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Technology to align product roadmaps with technical feasibility, platform architecture, capacity management, and release planning
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate agreed business objectives, priority fan segments, value propositions, and desired outcomes into product experiences
  • Partner with Content and Marketing to ensure product experiences, content value, and marketing execution reinforce the broader strategy
  • Build strong executive partnerships that improve decision making and organizational coordination
  • Communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Product and Design organization
  • Build team capabilities through coaching, succession planning, and talent development
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and product excellence

Required Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of product management experience, including leadership roles in digital media, streaming, sports, technology, or subscription-based businesses
  • Experience leading product organizations responsible for large-scale consumer digital platforms
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex product roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams within highly matrixed environments
  • Strong understanding of digital consumer experiences, content ecosystems, subscription products, and engagement platforms
  • Experience leading Product, UX/UI, Design, or adjacent digital experience functions

Leadership Profile:

  • Proven track record collaboratively shaping and delivering product roadmaps that drive business outcomes across large-scale consumer digital platforms
  • Demonstrated success delivering product roadmaps that support acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization objectives within DTC or subscription-led businesses
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to collaborate effectively with Strategy leaders on revenue, customer value, and growth opportunities
  • Strong experience operating in complex organizations and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that meet both business objectives and fan needs
  • Executive communicator capable of translating priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and performance into clear narratives tied to business goals
  • Strong product judgment, creative instincts, and operational discipline, with a passion for delivering exceptional consumer experiences

Travel:

This position will require travel to key NFL meetings and events, including occasional nights and weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

Intro to Position

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with DMU.

The Brand Designer (Video) creates compelling visual stories that bring the NPR brand to life.

This role develops, produces, and edits existing video assets, as well as shooting original video content that supports NPR's communications, fundraising, executive communications, recruitment, employee engagement, events, and strategic initiatives. Working closely with creative, communications and marketing colleagues, the Brand Designer (Video) helps tell the story of NPR through thoughtful, audience-centered visual storytelling, and supports the objectives of marketing campaigns.

The ideal candidate is an experienced producer with strong creative instincts, excellent technical skills, and a passion for telling authentic stories. They are equally comfortable developing a concept, interviewing subjects, directing a shoot, editing the final piece, and collaborating with colleagues across the organization to produce work that reflects the quality and integrity of the NPR brand.

Responsibilities

Lead video storytelling

  • Develop original video concepts that communicate NPR's mission, impact, and institutional priorities.
  • Produce videos that support fundraising, executive communications, recruitment, internal communications, events, member station engagement, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Identify stories that highlight the people, partnerships, and work behind NPR's public service mission.
  • Collaborate with the creative team to translate organizational priorities into compelling visual stories.
  • Recommend creative approaches that strengthen audience engagement and understanding.

Manage productions from concept to completion

  • Lead every stage of the production process.
  • Develop concepts, scripts, interview approaches, production plans, and schedules.
  • Produce and direct interviews and field productions.
  • Capture high-quality video and audio in studio and on location.
  • Edit, color correct, mix audio, and deliver finished content optimized for multiple platforms.
  • Manage graphics, captions, music licensing, and other post-production elements.

Elevate the NPR brand through visual storytelling

  • Help establish a distinctive visual style for non-editorial video that reflects NPR's values and creative standards.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, tone, pacing, and storytelling across projects.
  • Experiment with new formats and production techniques while ensuring every piece serves a clear communications objective.
  • Balance creativity with accessibility and audience needs.

Manage production operations

  • Plan and coordinate multiple productions simultaneously.
  • Manage production schedules and logistics.
  • Coordinate freelancers, vendors, talent, and production partners when needed.
  • Maintain production equipment and recommend future investments.
  • Organize footage and production assets to support efficient collaboration and reuse.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on Friday, October 2nd, 2026.

Application Instructions

In addition to a resume, please submit:

  • Instead of a traditional cover letter, provide a brief statement outlining your approach to creative leadership, team mentorship, and how you balance artistic innovation with organizational goals.

Intro to Position

NPR is one of the country’s most trusted brands, but its reputation was built in a media landscape that no longer exists. Audiences have scattered across owned platforms, social video, and a dozen competitors fighting for the same attention. The organizations winning that fight are the ones willing to look and sound different, not just distribute more. This role exists to help NPR make that shift real.

This is, and is not, a caretaker role for an established brand. It's a build and evolution role: new formats, new visual language, a creative team stood up for video at a scale the organization hasn't operated in before. 

You'll report to the SVP of Brand & Communications and work closely with Product, Audience Insights, Marketing, and Editorial to shift a beloved legacy brand into one that can compete with new creators and challengers.

Responsibilities

Drive a more distinctive cohesive brand in a saturated market

  • Establish technical brand standards, visual principles, and digital design systems that make NPR’s visual expression instantly recognizable across direct-to-audience platforms. 
  • Build platform-native video formats and visual frameworks that drive industry-leading differentiation, compelling audiences to choose NPR over thousands of alternative journalism and entertainment options 
  • Push beyond generic institutional and media-industry conventions to create work with greater personality, clarity, emotion, and cultural relevance.
  • Translate organizational values, editorial priorities, and public service mission into standardized motion assets, video packages, and platform-native visual frameworks. 
  • Analyze market landscapes and digital competitor trends to ensure NPR’s video and motion visual language remains distinct, modern, and culturally relevant. 

Build creative capacity for an owned-and-operated future

  • Define the technical visual frameworks and motion standards required to integrate video seamlessly across NPR’s owned digital ecosystem (websites, mobile apps, newsletters, and membership portals). 
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Editorial teams to establish a cohesive UI/UX and motion experience across owned platform touchpoints. 
  • Build modular, scalable design systems and template kits that enable teams across the organization to independently publish brand-aligned digital content. 
  • Ensure that creative work supports a deeper direct relationship with audiences rather than treating owned platforms simply as distribution channels.
  • Help develop the visual and verbal conventions that make the organization’s digital experiences feel distinctive, intentional, and connected.
  • Identify opportunities to use design, storytelling, video, motion, and other creative tools to increase engagement with owned experiences.
  • Utilize audience analytics and engagement data to continuously optimize digital assets and direct-to-audience visual experiences. 

Build a modern video and motion capability

  • Establish production standards, camera/lighting guidelines, motion graphic templates, and editing signatures for short-form, social, explanatory, and talent-led video formats. 
  • Procure, maintain, and manage specialized video studio hardware, camera packages, lighting setups, field audio gear, and editing suites 
  • Partner with Editorial and other teams to determine where technical brand video and motion graphics complement editorial production.
  • Develop recognizable approaches to motion, editing, typography, graphics, sound, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ensure that video is treated as a core creative medium rather than an adaptation of work conceived for print or static digital formats.
  • Supervise a dedicated, technical video and motion production squad (2 direct reports), managing daily project allocations, post-production workflows, and technical skill development 

Drive creative excellence

  • Establish operational SLAs, resource management models, and quality-assurance protocols to scale high-volume video publishing efficiently. 
  • Lead the creative development of campaigns, executive communications, fundraising materials, events, presentations, reports, digital experiences, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure creative work is aligned with organizational priorities, audience needs, accessibility standards, and brand guidelines.
  • Encourage experimentation while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Enforce strict compliance with federal digital accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1, closed captioning, color contrast, screen-reader compatibility) across all motion and video deliverables. 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of progressive creative leadership experience specializing in digital media, video production, or motion systems architecture within an in-house team or agency environment. 
  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating advanced technical mastery  conceptual thinking, creative direction, visual sophistication, and digital product visual identity across multi-platform ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience helping a brand evolve, modernize, or become more differentiated.
  • Deep technical proficiency in industry-standard video and motion software suites (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma design systems) and the changing ways audiences discover, consume, and engage with media.
  • Meaningful experience developing or directing video and motion work.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence cross-functional partners, and navigate complex organizational structures.
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and creative budgets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with a media, technology, cultural, entertainment, consumer, nonprofit, or mission-driven brand undergoing significant transformation.
  • Experience helping an established or legacy brand evolve for new audiences or platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer, subscription, membership, or other owned-and-operated digital strategies.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal video, motion, or multimedia creative capability.
  • Experience developing enterprise design systems or brand governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with audience research, brand measurement, accessibility standards, and emerging creative technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing technical creative personnel, such as video editors, motion designers, and digital production leads. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong technical storytelling instincts across motion, video, and platform-native digital formats. 
  • Fluency in visual systems, digital motion design, video production workflows, and digital brand expression. 
  • Deep curiosity about media, culture, design technology, motion trends, and changing audience behavior on owned digital platforms.
  • Strong people leadership, technical team management, coaching, and talent-development skills.
  • Comfort leading creative/digital visual transformation within and systems integration within an established organization.
  • An ability to respect the equity of a legacy brand without being constrained by its history when building new platform formats.
  • Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross functional teams.
  • An ability to communicate the strategic, technical, and architectural reasoning behind creative choices.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, organizational complexity, and competing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills.
  • A commitment to accessibility, inclusion, and creating work for a broad and diverse public.

Education Requirements

  • Equivalent hands-on experience, in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. or New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also be in commuting distance to Washington, D.C or New York City.

Job Type

Compensation

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Intro to Position

We are seeking a strategic, deal-driven SVP of Content Strategy & Business Development to lead the strategic expansion of our editorial reach and enterprise distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer, this executive will serve as the primary architect and operator of our external partnership strategy. You will bridge the gap between our content production and revenue growth—identifying, negotiating, and executing strategic alliances with digital platforms, streaming networks, audio networks, and mission-aligned distribution partners.

In addition to structuring external partnerships, you will collaborate closely with enterprise stakeholders across the organization to standardize operational frameworks, direct the division’s OKR planning, and align resource allocation directly with Content’s overarching strategic objectives.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Monetization

  • Drive Partnership Revenue: Pitch, negotiate, and close high-value content distribution, co-production, and IP licensing deals for network content across platforms.
  • Expand Distribution Channels: Identify and secure deal structures with major digital news aggregators, streaming platforms, newsletter networks, and public media systems to scale audience reach and maximize revenue.
  • Innovate Business Models: Work alongside the CCO to design business models (e.g., enterprise member subscriptions, content licensing, revenue-share frameworks) that bring financial sustainability to NPR and the Network.

Partner Management & Strategic Alliances

  • Co-Production & Joint Ventures: Structure operational agreements for collaborative, multi-newsroom reporting initiatives to ensure partner alignment while protecting editorial standards.
  • Cross-Sector Alignment: Collaborate with executive leadership to identify grant-funded or corporate-sponsored distribution initiatives that support the organization's broader mission.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • CCO & Newsroom Partnership: Partner with the Chief Content Officer and network editorial leads to ensure business development strategies protect editorial standards and elevate network priorities.
  • Deal Structuring & IP Oversight: Manage the contract lifecycle, intellectual property rights, licensing terms, and revenue-sharing mechanisms in collaboration with legal counsel.
  • Metrics & Strategy Iteration: Track partnership performance, audience expansion, and net revenue to regularly present actionable pipeline insights to the CCO and executive team.  

  Business Operations

  • Operational Excellence: Refine cross-departmental Content workflows to streamline project delivery and execution.
  • Financial Oversight & Governance: Partner with Finance to direct divisional budgets, track CapEx, and forecast resource needs to maintain fiscal discipline.
  • Workforce Strategy & Resource Allocation: Collaborate with People Team and Content leaders to drive organizational design, headcount planning and resource optimization.
  • Strategy Stewardship: Lead the definition, tracking, and execution of divisional OKRs to align daily operations with overarching company goals.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media business development, content licensing, distribution, or syndication within news or digital publishing.
  • Proven history of initiating, negotiating, and closing complex, revenue-generating content distribution and licensing partnerships.
  • An active network of media executives, syndicators, platform leads, and distribution decision-makers across digital and legacy media.
  • Deep appreciation for independent journalism and a strong understanding of how to balance revenue goals with editorial integrity.
  • Direct experience structuring IP licensing, copyright agreements, syndication contracts, and revenue-share models.
  • Deep familiarity with IP licensing, copyright frameworks, syndication contracts, and revenue-sharing mechanisms for collective/networked content.
  • Strong negotiation skills, analytical capability, and clear communication style when representing the organization externally.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with senior journalists, newsroom leadership, and legal teams to construct commercial partnerships that rigorously protect editorial independence.

job.title: Temporary Video Producer III, Planet Money
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions or Deadline: 

Application Deadline: Wednesday, September 30th at 12pm ET.

Materials to Submit:

  • A cover letter detailing your creative approach to explanatory journalism on video, your vision for adapting audio reporting to social platforms, and how you foster collaborative learning environments for colleagues new to video production.
  • Links to three short-form videos you conceived, shot, or edited that best illustrate your storytelling technique, editorial judgment, and technical execution. Please provide brief contextual notes on your specific role in each project within your cover letter.

Intro to Position

We’re looking for an experienced video maker to help us transition into a new era of video at Planet Money. The role is part creator, part strategist, part trainer.

Maybe you are a creator ready to join a team. Maybe you are a visual journalist who likes to build systems and start things. Maybe you’ve managed social channels and want to apply that to public media journalism. Maybe something else we haven’t thought of. In any case, here’s the job. 

First, you’ll work with the existing podcast/audio teams at Planet Money and The Indicator to pilot different types of social video or different processes for making them. Then together we will assess what works, what’s worth doing, and what’s not, and you’ll help us update our social video strategy and build sustainable workflows based on what we learn. By the end of your assignment, we hope to have a few new ways to represent our audio journalism on new platforms that our existing staff can sustainably carry on. 

A big part of the job will be helping our audio producers become comfortable creating more video on their own. You’ll help the audio team learn new video tools, analyze metrics and make smart choices about what to adapt to video and what not to. 

There’s wide latitude for experimentation, and an excellent team of creative, smart, fun journalists to collaborate with, including our existing video team. You’ll have lots of support and material to work with, and you’ll be a full part of the Planet Money and Indicator teams, with all the access to the podcast and reporting processes you need to make this work, including collaborating with our existing video colleagues. 

This is a temporary role with a specific mission: help a talented podcast team get a sustainable social video operation up and running and set them up to carry it forward after the assignment ends. There may also be some opportunities to pilot longer-form video, but our first priority is getting short-form systems working well. 

A little background may help you decide if this role is right for you:

Planet Money is like a little economics-themed media outlet within NPR. We explain how economics works and how it affects everyone’s life. We use stories to make the explanations memorable. We do this across media: two podcasts, Planet Money and The Indicator; regular segments on Morning Edition and All Things Considered; two newsletters; a nationally distributed weekend broadcast radio hour with How I Built This; a bestselling book; a board game; and, of course, video.

We’re extremely proud of our video presence, which has gone through several eras, beginning with our T-shirt project in 2013, to a series of live-action shorts in 2019, to a runaway TikTok channel starting in 2020. Now we’re ready to experiment more broadly with how Planet Money and The Indicator show up on video, and how we can do it more consistently and more frequently.

We are not replacing or ending our current short video approach. We couldn’t be more proud of that work! 

Our goal is to build on the excellent social videos our video team is already making. We love what we’re making there, and it works! We want to add more frequent videos that are more closely connected to the reporting we’re doing on the podcast and newsletters. To do that, we need more members of our team participating (maybe on camera and maybe in editing, that’s for you to help us answer). We want to find more opportunities to capture video and new processes that make all of that possible in intelligent, thoughtful and creative ways. Then we will know how to invest in our expanded video future. 

That’s where this role comes in. If you think you can help us build it, please apply.

 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Work with Planet Money leadership, video creators and NPR visual and social teams to refine and implement Planet Money’s video strategy, gathering and using audience and performance data to inform decisions. 
  • Lead experimentation with different forms of video journalism, assess results and help determine which approaches Planet Money should focus on. 
  • Collaborate with Planet Money and The Indicator editors, producers and hosts to conceive, produce, shoot, edit and publish video for NPR’s platforms and social media.
  • Train and coach some of our audio producers in video production and visual storytelling, video tools and interpreting performance metrics.
  • Develop short-form social video and other visual projects that extend Planet Money and The Indicator’s journalism to new and existing audiences.
  • Write and edit social video posts, captions, stories and other supporting copy and contribute to community engagement alongside other members of the team.
  • Coordinate production, publication and assessment of programming for visual platforms in collaboration with NPR’s visual and social teams.
  • Establish sustainable video production workflows that the podcast teams can continue on their own. 
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least four years of experience regularly making videos regularly in a journalistic, explanatory or comparable editorial setting. Please send us samples. 
  • At least two years of experience managing or creating video for social and digital platforms, with demonstrated experience using audience and performance data to inform editorial or creative decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of and interest in the topics Planet Money and The Indicator cover
  • Experience managing social media channels for a news or media organization, publisher or other editorial brand.
  • Experience helping journalists or other content creators develop video production and visual storytelling skills.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud programs related to video, photo and design. (Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere).
  • Advanced skill and experience with video podcasting tools such as Riverside, Descript and comparable platforms. 
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other relevant social media platforms, including experience using platform analytics and data for audience growth. 
  • Strong visual storytelling skills and editorial judgment across short-form and social video.
  • Ability to contribute to and execute a comprehensive, cross-platform video and social strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to coach colleagues with varying levels of video experience.
  • Strong understanding of copyright, journalistic ethics and editorial standards.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and to consistently work well with others and as part of a team, demonstrating at all times respect for the diverse constituencies at NPR and within the public radio system.
  • Must be able to lift video equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts as needed.

Education Requirements

  • While we value formal education, especially if you’ve studied the topic areas we cover, we do not believe that any specific degree is needed to perform this job successfully.

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in the New York City area.

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success.
