Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Executive Talent Relationship Management: Serve as the primary executive liaison and trusted advisor to high-profile journalists, hosts, and creative contributors, cultivating sustainable career pathways and retention strategies in close collaboration with the CCO.
  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of progressive executive leadership in talent management, talent relations, media recruiting, or creative talent strategy within news, podcasting, digital media, or broadcast entertainment.
  • Demonstrated, active network of professional relationships with journalists, creators, literary and talent agencies, management firms, and digital-first storytellers.
  • Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex, multi-party talent contracts, intellectual property rights, and compensation agreements in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Demonstrated success building and sustaining diverse, multi-perspective talent rosters that engage cross-generational and culturally diverse audiences.
  • Substantive experience acting as a trusted mediator in high-stakes creative environments, resolving interpersonal, contractual, or operational friction with discretion and high emotional intelligence.
  • Unwavering commitment to editorial independence, high-integrity journalism, and the civic mission of public media.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience navigating talent relations within a federated, public service, or non-profit media network operating alongside union collective bargaining agreements (e.g., SAG-AFTRA).
  • Proven experience executing creator-led co-productions, live podcast tours, or multi-platform distribution partnerships.
  • Familiarity with the commercial and sponsorship frameworks unique to digital audio, podcast monetization, and multi-market station networks.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional diplomatic presence with the proven ability to build trust quickly with high-profile personalities, agents, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Contractual & Negotiation Acumen: Strong fluency with creative intellectual property rights, talent deal points, non-disclosure terms, and talent contract structuring.
  • Audience & Format Vision: Forward-looking creative perspective capable of identifying how emerging digital storytellers can translate their voices to public radio and multimedia platforms.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional alignments involving Legal, Finance, People, and creative stakeholders without friction.
  • Crisis Management & Discretion: Exceptional judgment, confidentiality, and composure when navigating sensitive personnel or creative matters under public or time pressure.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $243,000 - $290,000 plus benefits. The displayed range reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to offer new hires for the position across all U.S. locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Assistente de Operações - Suporte
job.description:
Sobre a ONErpm

A ONErpm busca garantir seu legado como uma marca global com impacto na comunidade artística, nos negócios da música e na sociedade em geral. Somos uma empresa de inovação, música e tecnologia que valoriza a colaboração, o respeito mútuo e a diversidade de perspectivas como impulsionadores da inovação e do crescimento.

Nossa trajetória nos consolidou como uma das principais empresas de música digital do mundo, com operações em diversos países e presença global por meio de mais de 45 escritórios distribuídos em 35 países.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar no suporte operacional e técnico aos clientes e Heads da área, garantindo atendimento ágil e eficiente para esclarecimento de dúvidas e resolução de demandas relacionadas ao acesso às plataformas, distribuição de conteúdos musicais e utilização dos serviços da ONErpm.

Responsabilidades

  • Atender tickets relacionados a textos e atualizações de álbuns;
  • Dar suporte de forma remota a clientes de acordo com as metas diárias estabelecidas;
  • Orientar os clientes sobre documentação, acessos e contratos;
  • Atender tickets de artistas, verificando cada solicitação conforme o tipo e as regras aplicáveis;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos conteúdos dos clientes;
  • Prestar suporte em questões administrativas, contábeis, financeiras e de marketing;
  • Contribuir para a confiabilidade das operações, identificando e reportando falhas e situações críticas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento, preferencialmente em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em atendimento ao cliente, gestão de tickets ou suporte operacional;
  • Organização e capacidade de priorizar e gerenciar diferentes demandas, metas e prazos;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, responsável e atento aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Capacidade de analisar solicitações, seguir procedimentos e identificar possíveis falhas operacionais;
  • Familiaridade com documentação, acessos, contratos e processos administrativos;
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver profissionalmente;
  • Interesse e afinidade com o mercado da música.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência de seis meses a um ano em atendimento, suporte operacional ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento sobre gestão de tickets, metas e SLAs;
  • Conhecimento sobre Album Updates e regras e políticas operacionais;
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol.

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Plano de Saúde 
  • Plano Dental
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Totalpass
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Regime de trabalho híbrido para candidatos residentes no Rio de Janeiro e remoto para candidatos de outras localidades.

job.title: ONErpm Brasil | BU Lead - NNE
job.description:
Sobre a ONErpm

A ONErpm busca garantir seu legado como uma marca global com impacto na comunidade artística, nos negócios da música e na sociedade em geral – somos uma empresa inclusiva de inovação, música e tecnologia. Assim, defendemos o respeito mútuo e sabemos que diferentes perspectivas impulsionam a inovação, aceleram o crescimento e levam a decisões e resultados mais sustentáveis.Se você se juntar a nós, independentemente de onde ou em qual posição, iremos apoiá-lo para entregar o seu melhor e seu máximo potencial.

Nossa empresa pioneira que, em menos de 16 anos, conseguiu conquistar mais de 20% do mercado de música digital no Brasil e atualmente tem operações no México, Estados Unidos, Colômbia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Jamaica, Espanha, Nigéria, Vietnã e mais.

Em 2026, a ONErpm tem mais de 45 escritórios em 35 países em praticamente todos os continentes ao redor do mundo.

Sobre a vaga

Na ONErpm, nossas Business Units são verdadeiros hubs criativos, reunindo talentos de A&R, Project Managers e Operações, organizados por culturas musicais como Samba, Funk, HipHop e muito mais. Como BU Lead de NNE (norte e nordeste), você será peça-chave no desenvolvimento de projetos inovadores, lançamentos e catálogos, conectando artistas, selos e o mercado.

O Que Esperamos de Você

  • Liderança estratégica: Participar da criação de estratégias junto à diretoria e transformar planos em ações que aceleram o crescimento da unidade.
  • Gestão multidisciplinar: Supervisionar e inspirar equipes diversas, garantindo entregas de alto impacto e prazos cumpridos.
  • Promover o branding da ONErpm em comunidades artísticas e na indústria.
  • Visão de negócios: Identificar oportunidades, analisar tendências, criar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho.
  • Relacionamento: Manter e fortalecer parcerias com clientes, artistas, associações e mídia, representando a ONErpm em eventos e conferências.
  • Mentoria: Desenvolver talentos, promovendo feedbacks construtivos e crescimento do time.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Pesquisar o mercado e mapear oportunidades de expansão;
  • Elaborar e implementar estratégias para o crescimento da BU NNE;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time, acompanhando performance, promovendo o desenvolvimento das pessoas e garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos da BU;
  • Medir resultados, interpretar dados e apresentar relatórios claros;
  • Coordenar insights de negócios, marketing e tendências musicais;
  • Suportar A&Rs e Label Managers em negociações, marketing e comunicação;
  • Garantir recursos e operações eficientes para o time;
  • Manter relacionamentos próximos com clientes e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a ONErpm em eventos do setor musical;
  • Assegurar conformidade com diretrizes jurídicas.

O Que Procuramos

  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas, com capacidade de desenvolver, engajar e direcionar o time;
  • Conhecimento do mercado musical brasileiro, principalmente da região norte e nordeste, e de suas principais tendências e oportunidades;
  • Conhecimento de marketing musical, estratégias de lançamento, posicionamento e desenvolvimento de artistas;
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, com boas habilidades de negociação e comunicação;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões estratégicas baseadas em dados, utilizando indicadores para identificar oportunidades e direcionar ações;
  • Perfil empreendedor, proativo e com visão de negócio.

Habilidades Técnicas

  • Domínio de estratégias de negócios e crescimento de market share (streams/faturamento).
  • Proficiência em análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).
  • Conhecimento em processos de liberação de fonogramas/obras.
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento em inglês e/ou espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação em Gestão de Projetos.

O que oferecemos:

  • VR
  • VT
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (sem coparticipação)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio creche
  • Sistema de trabalho híbrido

job.title: Regional APAC Digital Marketing Manager (Malaysia)
job.description:
About ONErpm:

Founded in 2010, ONErpm business model revolves around artist discovery and development and offers three levels of service to meet the needs of creators at any stage of their career. As a global music solutions company with 45 offices and studios in +35 countries, ONErpm encompasses distribution, label solutions, content production, publishing, and an innovative marketing group that includes in-house advertising and influencer agencies. ONErpm currently has approximately 600 colleagues across the world, with significant presence in Brazil, the U.S, South America and other markets.

About The Role

The APAC Digital Marketing Manager (GL3) is responsible for leading regional digital strategy and execution, driving audience growth, artist visibility, and commercial performance through innovative strategic partnerships, and data-driven marketing initiatives. 

The digital team operates across six core pillars: Digital Partnerships, Creative Strategy, Content, Community, Resourcing, and Best Practices.

The regional Digital Hub Lead reports to the CMO and the Marketing Director.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversees digital marketing execution for ONErpm across Asia, and drives decisions on the allocation of the digital marketing budget and team resources to maximize impact.

  • Lead full service integration and delegation of regional digital team and resources ; this will include training, and professional growth of the regional team, ensuring high retention and performance. The hub lead will direct the team towards business goals, set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals.

  • Implements the workflows, tools, and reporting structures that the entire digital team utilizes

  • Focus on digital priority artist projects

  • Owns relationships with high-level platform partners and new media partners

  • Distills data into actionable insights for the wider team, identifying macro-trends in video and music consumption

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 - 5 years of experience in a marketing role development within the music, entertainment, or media industry.
  • Expertise in digital platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, and major DSPs. 
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing large-scale digital marketing campaigns with measurable results. 
  • Deep understanding of music marketing, streaming ecosystems, audience growth strategies, and fan engagement. 
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects and collaborating with artists, managers, labels, agencies, and platform partners. 
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting campaign performance data, KPIs, and ROI metrics. 
  • Experience overseeing budgets, forecasting, and campaign optimization across multiple markets. 
  • Knowledge of influencer marketing, social media trends, and emerging digital platforms. 
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience with CRM, audience data collection, and fan acquisition strategies including email, SMS, and retargeting. 
  • Ability to work effectively across diverse cultures, teams, and international markets. 
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities with a results-driven mindset.

job.title: 403(g) Maintenance Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

In This Role You'll:


Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

•    3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment.
•    Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing.
•    In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059).
•    Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure.
•    Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation.
•    Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities.
•    Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting.
•    Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces.

 

Bonus Skills:

 

•    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred.
•    Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment.
•    Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration.
•    Experience with virtualized and cloud-based media systems, including container management.
•    Familiarity with NMOS control/discovery frameworks in an IP media environment.
•    Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus.

 

 

#LI-TG1

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $31.10 - 65.52. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.   

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

 

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) including disability/vet.

 

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. Paramount is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status.

 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.paramount.com/careers as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212.846.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.

job.title: 403(g) Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic consumer brands, its portfolio includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. The company delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, Paramount provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution, and advertising solutions for partners on five continents. The Paramount Technology department supports our global content company through the delivery of a high-quality viewing experience, system infrastructure support, and creating innovative ways for our employees to collaborate. If you are interested in a strategy that has growth, transformation, and on-going innovation where you can help “reinvent the broadcasting wheel” Paramount Tech has a role for you…

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

 

· 10 years' experience in a broadcast audio environment. Ability to operate, troubleshoot, and expertly navigate all audio components of Entertainment TV programming.

· Calrec Console experience is required, LAWO console experience a plus.

· Advanced knowledge of broadcast audio equipment and high-level audio concepts- examples include but are not limited to: Consoles; Lavalier, Handheld and Boom Microphones; Audio Routing; AES, Madi, & Analog workflows.

· Proven experience operating (in live production environments) and programming RTS ADAM/ ODIN comms systems, including AZ Edit configuration and troubleshooting

· Working with Audio Assists (A2’s) on the floor and other audio mixers to check mics, PA, Monitors, on a daily basis in preparation for rehearsal and taping of show.

· Demonstrated understanding of IP-based intercom and audio infrastructure, including RVON, trucking, and networked comms workflows.

· QC of all incoming footage and media for show, ability to relay issues in a timely manner and work with production and technical teams to resolve for use on live to air tapings.

 

Required Skills:

job.title: 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.
As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.
You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will deliver results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Think multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Be a marketer first. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business goals, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent CBS Pittsburgh at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable history of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid Drivers License

 

Preferred:

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficient in Wide Orbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.title: Account Executive, Advanced Advertising
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


Paramount Advertising is seeking a highly motivated, consultative sales professional to drive growth across Paramount’s vast portfolio through the integration of streaming, programmatic, advanced advertising, data, and convergent media solutions. The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of today’s evolving media landscape and excels at translating Paramount’s full range of capabilities into integrated solutions that deliver against advertisers’ business objectives—moving beyond traditional demo guarantees and delivery metrics.


As an Account Executive on the Advanced Advertising Team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to agencies and advertisers, helping them navigate and capitalize on the convergence of linear TV, streaming, digital video, programmatic, and data-driven advertising. You will leverage Paramount’s suite of audience, identity, optimization, attribution, measurement, programmatic, and advanced advertising solutions to develop holistic, outcome-oriented media strategies.


The ideal candidate understands how programmatic buying and activation intersect with premium streaming and traditional television, and can articulate the value of bringing these channels together through a unified approach. You will be expected to identify opportunities to expand relationships, drive incremental revenue, and position Paramount as a leading partner for clients seeking greater scale, precision, flexibility, and measurable business outcomes across the entire video ecosystem.


Success in this role requires a balance of revenue generation, executive presence, convergent selling expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with agency investment and strategy teams, programmatic and digital leads, data and analytics partners, and Paramount’s broader sales organization to develop integrated solutions and unlock new sources of growth.


You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, are comfortable selling complex technology and data-enabled solutions, and can move fluidly between high-level business strategy and the details of media activation. You are equally effective influencing senior clients, educating agencies on emerging capabilities, partnering across internal teams, and turning sophisticated media solutions into measurable business results.

 

Results Driven 

  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis.
  • Proven capability to sell data-driven and optimized executions across linear and streaming.
  • Manage a Hold Co aligned Advanced Advertising sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
  •  Identify and cultivate new Advanced Advertising opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Leverage campaign performance, audience insights, and measurement outputs to uncover incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with internal stakeholders and clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.

A Consultative Sales Executive

  • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including linear, streaming, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for both clients and internal counterparts.
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and return on advertising investment.

Multi-platform Proficient

  • Understand the complementary value and nuance of representing all platforms and buy types, including programmatic, across a portfolio to execute a unified advertising strategy. 
  • Stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
  • Confidently articulate the role of audience-first planning, cross-platform activation, and performance measurement in today's fragmented media landscape.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Advanced Advertising ecosystem and competitive marketplace.

 A Leader by Example

  • In partnership with AA Management, work closely with and mentor your Account Manager(s) to develop into future sales leadersCreate meaningful opportunities for Account Managers to participate in client-facing sales efforts and strategic conversations.
  • Deliver best-in-class client service throughout the campaign lifecycle, including onboarding, stewardship, optimization recommendations, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Planning, Data Solutions, Measurement, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales or agency experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how data flows throughout the ecosystem, and is applied in planning, execution, and measurement

 

Additional Qualifications: 

  • Strong relationship building skills and a collaborative nature.
  • High initiative, problem solving, adaptability and a growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex technical and data concepts into compelling client narratives.
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate a command of our business, offerings and client needs.
  •  Ability to manage stress well, and balance multiple priorities at once.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness.   Overview We are the Global Marketing Analytics team supporting Paramount Streaming. The Analyst, Marketing Data Operations will provide day-to-day operational support for the marketing data ecosystem, with a primary focus on monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines that ingest and transform performance data from paid media platforms such as Meta, Google, and TikTok. This role is well-suited for an analytically minded, technically curious individual who is keen to develop hands-on experience across modern data tools and infrastructure. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, forward-thinking in resolving data issues, and enthusiastic about integrating AI-assisted tools into their daily workflow to work smarter and transition faster. A comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and a willingness to learn on the job will be key ingredients for success.   Responsibilities
  • Support the identification, investigation, and resolution of data discrepancies across marketing platform data sources including Meta, Google, TikTok, and others
  • Monitor data pipelines for anomalies, failures, and latency issues; escalate and help address incidents in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain SQL-based queries and transformation logic to support consistent marketing data across reporting layers
  • Assist with orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, including helping to diagnose DAG failures and flag scheduling issues
  • Develop and maintain Python scripts to support data quality checks, recurring ingestion processes, and operational automation
  • Use GitHub for version control and collaborate with teammates on code reviews and deployment of data logic updates
  • Work within development environments including Visual Studio Code and Cursor to build, test, and iterate on data and automation workflows
  • Actively incorporate and help develop AI-assisted workflows leveraging tools like Claude to support day-to-day tasks: writing and debugging code, drafting documentation, and accelerating data investigations
  • Support broader AI initiatives and projects across the team as needs evolve
  • Maintain clear documentation of pipelines, data definitions, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity
  • Partner with marketing analysts and reporting teams to understand data needs and surface issues that may impact downstream reporting
  • Support ad hoc data investigations and analyses as needed

 

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, marketing analytics, or data operations role
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency — comfortable writing complex queries, joining and transforming datasets, and debugging transformation logic
  • Foundational knowledge of Python for data tasks, automation, or scripting
  • Robust attention to detail and a methodical approach to diagnosing data issues
  • Experience using GitHub or other version control systems for code management and collaboration
  • Comfort working in modern development environments such as Visual Studio Code or Cursor
  • Experience integrating AI tools, including large language models like Claude, into daily work for tasks like code generation, debugging, documentation, and analysis
  • Exposure to or curiosity about workflow orchestration concepts; awareness with tools like Apache Airflow is a plus but not required

 

 

Additional Qualifications
  • Exposure to Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery
  • Comprehension with paid media platforms (eg Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok for Business) and their data structures
  • Experience with Tableau or other BI and visualization tools
  • Insight with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve personal development efficiency
  • Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Confluence
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical teammates

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. job.title: Analyst TandE (Fixed Term Contract)
job.description:
Are you detail-oriented, analytical and interested in working with Travel & Expense processes in an international environment?

As a T&E Analyst / Auditor, you will play an important role in reviewing and analyzing employee expense reports processed through Concur Travel & Expense and Oracle Fusion Expenses. You will help ensure that expenses are accurate, compliant with company policies and properly supported, while also identifying opportunities to strengthen controls and improve the overall expense management process.

The role combines audit, analysis, stakeholder communication and process improvement, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data while also supporting employees and business stakeholders.

 

This role is initially offered as a 1-year fixed-term contract, with potential for extension.

 

 

What you'll do

 

  • Review and audit employee travel and expense reports to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
  • Verify the accuracy, completeness and validity of expense claims and supporting documentation
  • Identify and investigate non-compliant, duplicate, fraudulent or excessive expense claims
  • Assess risks and prioritize audit findings and exceptions
  • Ensure expenses comply with internal controls, accounting standards, tax regulations and corporate guidelines
  • Process expense reports within agreed service levels and quality standards
  • Communicate audit findings and policy violations to employees, managers and relevant stakeholders
  • Work directly with employees to explain T&E policies and help prevent future policy violations
  • Provide guidance and support to employees using Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses
  • Monitor high-risk transactions and spending trends to identify potential control weaknesses and improvement opportunities
  • Prepare management reporting on T&E policy findings, compliance issues and trends
  • Analyze expense data to identify spending patterns, cost-saving opportunities and areas for improvement
  • Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and responding to audit requests
  • Maintain accurate audit records and ensure appropriate documentation retention
  • Recommend and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, compliance and user experience
  • Support expense management system administration, testing and process enhancements
  • Escalate exceptions, potential fraud cases and control breaches to management
  • Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses for Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses
  • Participate in special projects and other initiatives as required

 

 

 

What we're looking for

 

  • 2+ years of experience with Concur or Oracle, with experience in Oracle Fusion Expenses being an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Concur, Oracle Fusion Expenses, Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • A solutions-oriented, proactive and self-motivated approach
  • Ability to communicate quantitative and qualitative information clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organization
  • Strong internal customer focus and a service-oriented mindset
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to interact confidently with employees and stakeholders at all levels

 

 

It would be a plus if you have

 

  • Experience working with SAP, Oracle Fusion or other ERP systems
  • Knowledge of finance, procurement/sourcing or information technology processes
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams throughout a project lifecycle
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Experience identifying process improvement and control enhancement opportunities

 

 

Why join us?

We believe you will enjoy working with us because:

 

  • Our private health insurance program provides access to private clinics with a screening package
  • Our monthly cafeteria package includes SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support
  • We have a dog-friendly office, so you can bring your furry friend to work
  • Every week, we offer fresh fruit days for our employees
  • We provide eyewear support to help with the cost of glasses
  • After the probation period, you can take advantage of language courses

 

 

 

Paramount Networks International, is comprised of many of the world's most popular multimedia entertainment brands, including MTV, MTV LIVE HD, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Comedy Central, Paramount Channel, BET and more. Paramount brands reach more than 3.8 billion cumulative subscribers in 180+ countries and territories via more than 200 locally programmed and operated TV channels and more than 550 digital media and mobile TV properties, in 40 languages.

job.title: Analyst, Strategy and Insights
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Come join the Strategy and Insights team at Paramount Pictures and be part of a dynamic group who work across the entire lifecycle of the theatrical movie experience! Unlike traditional marketing, our insights team is involved from concept to release, ensuring the consumer’s voice is at the heart of every decision from brand development to fan engagement, to the actual movie in its final editorial stage, to identifying messaging for creative marketing materials that truly resonate. The Insights team drives impactful, data-driven decisions through audience surveys, focus groups, ethnographies, and screenings. Our global insights inform production and tailor marketing campaigns that excite moviegoers worldwide. This is an onsite hourly based full-time role requiring (5) days in office based out of the Paramount Pictures Studio Lot. 


This role works collaboratively to support the entire department. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver tangible value to a wide range of creative stakeholders and collaborators across the studio.


Responsibilities Overview
We're looking for a curious, driven individual with a love of movies and an aptitude for business strategy, psychology, sociology, and/or storytelling to join our team. If you're a natural problem-solver who thrives on understanding people and uncovering the ''why'' behind their behaviors, we want you. The ideal candidate is not only analytical and skilled at working with large datasets, but also a good communicator who loves translating insights into actionable strategies creative people can understand. If you’re excited by the idea of diving deep into consumer behavior, market trends, and how movie content connects with worldwide audiences –this is the role for you!

  • In partnership with Research teammates, respond to relevant trends, developing storylines and noteworthy performances prior to and during live game action.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Overview and Responsibilities:

As part of our broader Consumer Products legal team, this attorney role provides strategic legal counsel and services to support Paramount Global Publishing’s mission to deliver diverse, high-quality storytelling across print, digital, and audio platforms. The position focuses on enabling content that spans multiple genres and engages audiences of all ages—from children and families to adult readers.

 

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a strategic legal business partner to the Paramount Publishing team, supporting the launch and ongoing operations of a new publishing imprint developing franchise‑based and original literary IP.
  • Negotiate, draft, and review a broad range of publishing agreements, including rights acquisitions, author and illustrator agreements, collaborations and co‑author agreements, adaptations, inbound and outbound licensing agreements, distribution agreements, and vendor/production services agreements.
  • Advise on intellectual property matters related to publishing, including copyright ownership, rights, chain‑of‑title, derivative works, and exploitation across formats and platforms.
  • Initiate and support complex rights negotiations to unlock frozen and/or restricted rights.
  • Support publishing initiatives inspired by Paramount’s iconic brands and franchises, ensuring alignment with franchise management, brand protection and long‑term IP strategy.
  • Provide legal guidance on royalty structures, profit participation, accounting provisions, audit rights, advances and recoupment models customary in the book and digital publishing industries.
  • Collaborate closely with Consumer Products, Franchise, Marketing, Labor Relations and Business Affairs teams to enable timely development, launch and commercialization of publishing projects.
  • Identify and manage legal risks associated with publishing, manufacturing and distributing content, including defamation, privacy, publicity rights, trademark usage and fair use issues.
  • Oversee and coordinate with outside counsel as needed on specialized publishing or IP matters while maintaining internal ownership of core legal strategy.
  • Support the development and maintenance of legal templates, deal forms and best practices to enable efficient growth of the publishing business.

 

 Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of legal experience, with a combination of law firm and/or in‑house experience preferred.
  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to practice law in New York or California.
  • In-depth knowledge of publishing, media, entertainment, or consumer products businesses, with strong familiarity with publishing industry agreements and customs.
  • Substantial experience negotiating intellectual property‑driven commercial agreements.
  • Working knowledge of guild and labor issues.

 

 Additional Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in book publishing (print and/or digital), media, entertainment or brand licensing environments preferred.
  • Strong understanding of how publishing content intersects with broader entertainment ecosystems, including film, television, consumer products and digital platforms.
  • Experience advising creative, editorial and business teams in fast‑moving, entrepreneurial environments.
  • Proven ability to balance legal risk with business objectives and provide practical, solutions‑oriented counsel.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

job.title: Data Engineer Self Service Analytics and Real Time Data Platforms
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview

The Data Engineering team is seeking a Data Engineer – Self-Service Analytics & Real-Time Data Platforms. In this role, you will help build scalable data products, semantic layers, and real-time data platforms. These platforms enable trusted, governed, and self-service access to data. You will develop solutions that power BI, analytics, experimentation, AI applications, agents, and conversational analytics experiences.


Key Responsibilities

Self-Service Analytics & Real-Time Data Platforms

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch (ETL/ELT) and near real-time streaming data pipelines. These pipelines will process large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Design and maintain semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and curated data products.
  • Enable self-service analytics through governed and reusable business data models.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, and operational best practices.
  • Develop governed data access patterns for AI, conversational analytics, and MCP-based applications.
  • Build AI-ready data products that support machine learning, GenAI, AI agents, and chatbot applications.
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, BI, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver trusted data solutions.

Data Modeling & Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable data models optimized for analytics, real-time reporting, and AI use cases.
  • Develop reusable semantic and transformation layers that provide consistent business definitions.
  • Drive best practices for data quality, governance, metadata, and discoverability.

 

Required Technical Skills

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

  • 2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.
  • Proven experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts.
  • SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML
  • Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.
  • Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.
  • Proven experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

  • Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.
  • Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.
  • Experience integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent. This includes model training, batch/online inference, and pipeline orchestration.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

job.description:

Data Engineering Manager


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, delivery, and operational excellence of large-scale batch and real-time data platforms. This role will oversee high-performance data engineering teams that power analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will guide the design and execution of distributed data systems. This includes ETL and ELT pipelines. It also includes streaming platforms, warehouse ecosystems, and cloud-native infrastructure. As a manager, you will shape technical direction, develop engineering talent, and ensure production-grade reliability, scalability, and operational rigor across data platforms.

This role requires expertise in modern data architectures and distributed systems. You should also have knowledge of cloud-native engineering. It is essential to have proven experience in leading high-performing engineering teams. 


Key Responsibilities


Lead & Scale Data Engineering Teams
● Manage and develop a team of data engineers responsible for batch and streaming data systems.
● Drive technical execution across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving layers.
● Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and architectural review processes.
● Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, performance optimization, and production reliability.


Architect Scalable Data Platforms
● Ensure scalable data modeling standards and efficient query performance across analytical workloads.
● Guide decisions about architecture. This includes orchestration and schema evolution. It also covers partitioning strategies and storage optimization. 
● Partner with streaming engineers to align batch and real-time data patterns into cohesive platform designs. 


Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner closely with Data Product Management to align roadmap priorities, SLAs, and platform KPIs.
● Collaborate with software engineers to integrate streaming systems, APIs, and microservices into the broader data ecosystem.
● Clearly communicate architectural tradeoffs to stakeholders. Share delivery risks and operational constraints as well. 


Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural reviews and drive long-term platform strategy.
● Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.

 


Required Skills & Experience


Modern Data Architecture
● Strong expertise in data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
● Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration platforms, and distributed data processing systems.
● Solid understanding of Kafka-based architectures and event-driven data patterns.

 

Team Development & Coaching
● Proven experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining high-performing engineers across varying seniority levels.
● Commitment to building an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.

 

Execution & Delivery Leadership
● Strong sprint planning, capacity modeling, and roadmap sequencing skills.
● Ability to manage competing priorities across reliability, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction.
● Experience establishing engineering KPIs such as reliability, latency, throughput, and deployment frequency.

 


Qualifications


● Proven experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale production data platforms.
● Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering and cloud-native architecture.
● You should have great communication skills. You also need to collaborate with different teams. 
● You should be self-motivated. Focus on quality. A commitment to engineering excellence and operational discipline is essential.

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?  


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Are curious, with a desire to learn and the ambition to quickly become a self-reliant, top-notch software engineer,  

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,   

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 3+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Comfortable coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Good knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and/or Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce 

  

We keep our technologies up-to-date, and have a major impact on the tool set: 

  • CI/CD & Automation: Horde, Jenkins, ArgoCD 

  • Infrastructure & Platform: OCI, Terraform, Ansible 

  • Containers & Virtualization: Kubernetes, Podman, Proxmox, KVM 

  • Observability & Reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic 

  • Game Development: Unreal Engine 

  • Source Control Management: Perforce, Git 

  • Operating Systems: Linux, Windows 

 

We offer: 

  • Employment contract, 

  • Multisport card + private medical care, 

  • Access to e-learning and self-development platforms, 

  • Office library, 

  • English and Polish language lessons, 

  • We participate in and speak at conferences, also join/ run public meet-ups, 

  • In-house activities: tech talks, hackathons, 

  • You can use 10% of your working time to pursue your personal development, and side projects, 

  • Active global inclusion and CSR groups, 

  • Well located, modern office with lots of amenities – adjustable desks, electronics toolkit, 3D printer ready for you to use, pool table, console, table tennis, massage chair. 

 

Vimn Poland Sp. z o.o. has introduced a procedure for reporting violations of law and taking follow-up actions aimed at, among other things, protecting whistleblowers. You could find more information here:  https://eng-whistleblower.paramount.com

CBS News Minnesota is looking for a Digital Line Producer to work on WCCO's live stream and linear newscasts, WCCO.com and other digital/social outlets, managing and creating content for audiences! The content producer will work with a digital team to manage, optimize, and time live and on-demand video content for mobile, desktop and OTT platforms. The content producer works in coordination with News Managers and Broadcast Line Producers during live news programs, and takes on other responsibilities such as writing headlines, publishing and updating articles, editing and publishing video, conducting interviews, and optimizing SEO, discoverability and shareability of all content.

 

 


RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED, TO:


· Leading all aspects of content on CBS News Minnesota by building show rundowns and segments, editing video and scripts whenever needed.

· Aggressively manage and publish updated news stories and video segments, concentrating on developing stories and breaking news.

· Tracking news and events; coordinating coverage with managers and line producers.

· Constantly updating news content in the stream and producing breaking news and other updates as they happen instead of waiting for a scheduled newscast.

· Anticipating the needs of CBS News Minnesota for video, graphics, scripts and other elements.

· Coding/stacking rundown content regarding video, graphics, scripts and other elements.

· Writing memorable headlines, scripts and segments. Optimize headlines, captions, and video titles for in-platform search (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram) in addition to traditional web SEO.

· Working with managers and the entire digital team to develop and produce special content applying the resources and storytelling of the entire WCCO Newsroom.

· Conducting interviews in the field or over web camera, shooting video, producing content, and editing video for audiences on digital and social media platforms.

· Demonstrating expertise in timing in a control room environment.

· Build videos for multiple platforms, including WCCO.com, YouTube, and WCCO’s social media channels, with an emphasis on verticals and social reels.

· Other duties as assigned.

 

 


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Multiplatform fluency, with day-to-day focus on managing and timing live video opportunities, but able to flex into social content, web publishing, and broadcast/linear producing support.

· Proven experience in crafting and publishing digital news stories and video content.

· Proven success operating in a fast-paced news environment, a field that often requires pivots to new technological realities and tools.

· Ability to prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines to write headlines, publish articles, and edit video for live digital publishing/broadcast.

· Familiarity with non-linear editing systems such as Edius/Stratus, Final Cut, Adobe Premiere required.

· Familiarity with iNews and Crispin Rapid Play preferred.

· Available for early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

· Strong ability to write accurate and compelling copy for both broadcast and web.

· Knowledge of Associated Press style and journalism ethics and standards.

· Knowledge of social media and the competitive digital news environment.

· Understanding of multi-platform discovery — Google Discover, AI Overviews, and in-platform search on TikTok/YouTube/Instagram — in addition to traditional SEO and Google Trends.

CBS Stations is hiring a part-time digital producer to create compelling, relevant content for CBS Baltimore’s digital platforms. This role is responsible for overseeing local digital breaking news coverage, writing and editing stories across a wide range of topics, clipping and optimizing video on CBSNews.com and on YouTube, and executing on growth initiatives across platforms.

We are looking for someone with strong news judgment who can write and edit clear, accurate, fact-driven copy and craft compelling headlines on deadline in a fast-paced environment. Scrupulous attention to detail, a cool head under pressure, and excellent communication skills are essential.

 

Your day-to-day:

  • Coordinate, produce and update web coverage of news stories, gathering the latest information from a variety of sources, always being mindful of WJZ and CBS News standards
  • React quickly to breaking news, writing and publishing articles and running live blogs as appropriate

  • Manage the WJZ homepage to present the best of the journalism we produce
  • Work with reporters and producers to publish the best of WJZ to our website
  • Proactively plan content around key news events and tentpoles
  • Track content performance and share content insights across WJZ to help inform story selection across platforms
  • Send push alerts on breaking news, weather and other high-interest stories

  • You have 1+ years of experience in a digital breaking news environment and a proven ability to react quickly as news develops
  • You are a skilled writer who can produce quality copy on deadline
  • You have a deep understanding of SEO strategies
