job.title: Director, Acquisitions (Paramount Pics)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

If you thrive at the intersection of dealmaking, financial analysis, and creative judgment, this role is for you. We’re hiring a Director, Acquisitions to help shape Paramount Picture’s film slate. This role sits at the center of the studio’s acquisitions strategy, structuring and negotiating deals while partnering closely with finance and legal to evaluate opportunities across the global marketplace. You’ll build deep familiarity with the studio’s output and licensing deals, and use that knowledge to identify commercial opportunities that align with our broader strategy.   You will be the studio’s presence at major festivals and markets, including Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, and AFM, leading internal prep, briefing the EVP, and representing Paramount directly in conversations with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents. Beyond the deal, you’ll stay involved through post-production, offering creative feedback on cuts, and you’ll drive cross-departmental coordination through mastering, marketing, distribution, and publicity to ensure a successful launch.   This role requires someone who can move fluidly between financial rigor and creative instinct, with the relationships and market fluency to spot opportunities.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Structure, negotiate, and execute acquisitions deals, utilizing financial analysis and strategic insight in partnership with finance and legal teams
  • Lead financial evaluation of acquisition opportunities, partnering with finance to build and analyze P&L models to inform valuation and overall deal strategy
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the studio’s global output and licensing deals and leveraging them effectively in the evaluation of acquisition opportunities worldwide
  • Lead sourcing, tracking, and evaluation of packages across the global marketplace, identifying commercial opportunities aligned with the overall acquisition strategy
  • Maintain and cultivate strong relationships across agencies, financiers, filmmakers, producers, and international sales companies to gain access to high-level acquisition opportunities
  • Lead internal preparation for major film festivals and markets (e.g., Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, AFM), including identifying priority titles, coordinating team coverage, and preparing the EVP with relevant materials and market intelligence to align internal stakeholders around acquisition targets
  • Represent the studio in market-facing conversations at festivals and markets, attending screenings and meetings with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents to evaluate opportunities and communicate the studio’s acquisition priorities
  • Provide strategic guidance and creative feedback to filmmakers and producers on acquired projects, including reviewing cuts during post-production and collaborating with creative stakeholders to help shape the final film
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the domestic and international sales landscape, sourcing market intelligence on upcoming projects and monitoring buyer sentiment
  • Oversee the lifecycle of acquired titles from acquisition through release, driving cross-departmental coordination across mastering, marketing, distribution, publicity, and legal to ensure timely delivery, optimal windowing strategy, and successful launch
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in film, Business, Media, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in film acquisitions, distribution, or sales, preferably with a major studio or agency

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling literacy, with the ability to interpret P&L projections and apply financial insights to acquisition decision-making
  • Established industry relationships across the creative and sales communities
  • Strong understanding of the global film marketplace and distribution landscape
  • Proven ability to evaluate material, talent packages, and market dynamics through both a creative and commercial lens
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with senior leadership as well as external partners

 


Founded in 1912, Paramount Pictures works with talented filmmakers to produce and distribute entertainment around the world. The film studio’s iconic logo has opened some of the most successful and beloved films in cinematic history, including timeless classics such as The Godfather, Chinatown, Forrest Gump and Titanic; and blockbuster franchises such as Star Trek, Transformers, Mission: Impossible and Sonic the Hedgehog. Recent, innovative, break-out films such as The Wolf of Wall Street, Arrival, Rocketman, and A Quiet Place have added to Paramount’s film legacy. With a beautiful 65-acre lot in the heart of Hollywood, a worldwide network of offices and a culture of engagement, Paramount Pictures’ passionate employees ensure the studio continues to deliver creativity and innovation to a dynamic industry. Paramount Pictures controls a collection of some of the most powerful brands in filmed entertainment, including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Animation, and Paramount Players. PPC operations also include Paramount Home Entertainment, Paramount Pictures International, Paramount Licensing Inc., and Paramount Studio Group. Paramount Pictures is a subsidiary of Paramount, which connects with billions of people worldwide through its global brands including MTV, CBS, Paramount Network, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET and streaming service Paramount+.

job.title: Director, Content Operations
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing. 
  • Partner with Programming and Content Partnerships to ensure content scheduling, delivery forecasts, and launch timelines are aligned with platform and partner expectations. 
  • Maintain deep expertise in Pluto TV’s evolving deliverable specifications (video, audio, captions, artwork, metadata, UUID’s, ad markers, localization assets etc.). 
  • Support localization pipelines and delivery of multi-language assets across global markets. 
  • Document, maintain, and continuously refine operational workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and cross-functional 
    communication processes. 

 

Team Leadership & Performance Management 

 

  • Coach and grow a skilled team with clear goals.
  • Plan capacity, coverage, and top tasks.
  • Build a good culture that adapts fast.

 

Partner & Vendor Management 

 

  • Manage daily communication with content partners, labs and preferred vendors. 
  • Oversee vendor bidding, cost analysis, rate negotiations, and operational performance reviews. 
  • Ensure partner expectations are met regarding deadlines, technical requirements, and quality standards. 

 

Cross-Regional Collaboration

 

  • Align U.S. Operations with LatAm/Brazil/Canada and European Content Operations leads on standards, tooling, vendor usage, quality baselines, and global workflows. 
  • Drive consistency across regions while supporting local market nuances (content regulations, ratings practices, localization requirements, etc.). 
  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 7+ years in streaming operations, or content supply-chain management. 
  • Leadership experience managing a team of 10+ members.
  • Strong understanding of digital video encoding, UHD, HDR Dolby Vision and acceptance workflows.
  • Experience in defining content systems requirements and working within MAM and CMS’s and scheduling systems. 
  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats. 
  • Expertise in operational documentation, workflow design, and project management. 
  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools. 
  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in TV/Film, Media Operations, Digital Production, or related field. 
  • Experience in FAST, AVOD, SVOD, or other streaming environments. 
  • Familiarity with global content operations and regional compliance considerations.

Overview

The Director, CPG Food Categories is a high-impact leadership role in charge of spearheading the commercial success of Paramount’s iconic IP within the North American food and beverage landscape. You will lead the end-to-end business strategy for CPG, transforming fan-favorite franchises into tangible products on grocery and retail shelves. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, financial rigor, and expert negotiation skills to manage a portfolio of licensees while identifying new market opportunities for long-term growth.

 

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Planning & Market Expansion

    • Define and execute the long-term growth strategy for North American food categories, ensuring alignment with broader franchise goals

    • Monitor industry trends, consumer behavior, and retail shifts to keep the portfolio competitive and innovative

  • Partnership & Deal Negotiation

    • Lead the end-to-end licensing lifecycle: sourcing, vetting, and negotiating complex commercial terms for global and regional CPG partners

    • Manage a diverse licensee portfolio, resolving operational issues and ensuring high levels of partner performance and satisfaction

    • Maintain full commercial accountability for assigned categories, including building annual revenue forecasts

    • Track and assess royalty forecasts, delivering detailed quarterly performance reports and budget reconciliations to senior executive leadership

    • Drive category business vision by setting clear revenue targets and growth objectives for the team

  • Brand Stewardship & Product Development

    • Oversee the licensing of Paramount franchises across all food product categories to ensure they meet Paramount’s high-quality standards and relevant safety standards

    • Collaborate with franchise, creative and product development teams to review and approve product submissions, ensuring they resonate with the target demographic

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Partner with Retail teams to support licensees with retail sell-in

    • Serve as the primary liaison between Legal, Finance, Franchise Management, Creative, and Product Development to advance licensed products from concept to shelf proficiently

job.title: Director, Creative Music (Paramount Pics)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with directors, producers, and Paramount Pictures creative executives to shape and execute the musical vision for assigned theatrical films.
  • Engage in projects early in development to provide creative guidance on score, source music, and overall music strategy.
  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.
  • Support soundtrack, marketing, publicity, and awards initiatives tied to Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in music supervision, film music, or creative music roles within a theatrical film or studio environment.
  • Proven experience supervising music for feature films from development through post-production.
  • Strong creative instincts with deep knowledge of film scoring and source music.
  • Established relationships with composers, filmmakers, artists, and music industry partners.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple films simultaneously across a theatrical slate.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Prior in-house studio experience at a major theatrical studio.
  • Experience working directly with high-profile filmmakers and talent.
  • Working knowledge of music licensing, clearance, and music budgeting.
  • Filmmaker-first mindset
  • Collaborative and solution-oriented
  • Strong creative judgment and taste
  • Passion for theatrical storytelling and music

We are a branded content division of Paramount, committed to developing and implementing marketing solutions that position our brand partners at the center of culture. We offer full-service marketing capabilities, delivering custom content and creative solutions that drive value for our partners and dedication with our fans across our Paramount channels (CBS, CBS Sports, CBS News, Paramount+, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, CMT), platforms and experiences. Simply put, we build brand-driven content tailored to our partners' needs and preferences.

At Paramount Media Labs (PML), we value diversity of thought, and we think your hobbies and unique viewpoints are just as important as your previous work experience. We view the world not only from our offices (though the views are pretty sweet), but also via immersive experiences that inspire us, keep us at the forefront of the ever-changing cultural landscape, and, with any luck, make us better marketers.

 

Overview:

Activation is a group dedicated to campaign development and execution across Paramount’s Ad Solutions. We partner with the Pitch and Creative teams to develop integrated marketing solutions that drive upfront and scatter budgets. Then, lead the activation of custom partner programs across all Paramount screens and networks (except BET), in collaboration with channel constituents. In addition, we manage all campaign work regarding Upfront Advertisers with sold marketing and an identified property, from pitch through activation.

Reporting to the VP, as Director, you will manage client-facing activation of linear, digital and social media marketing programs for the Kids & Family and Influence Group. You will interact with cross-disciplinary teams including clients, media agencies, Ad Solutions, creative, production, social media, editorial, legal, standards,and external vendors.

Directors work with the Ad Sales team to identify areas of opportunity and troubleshooting approaches to reach company and client goals in addition to acting as a team point person for all aspects of ideation, creation, activation and fulfillment of marketing programs. You are responsible for managing specific processes, such as vetting ideas with key stakeholder departments, securing partner materials/assets, building social media promotional strategies, and supervising the production of custom content across all platforms.

  • Serve as the main contact for RFP responses, including leading creative briefings and collaborations

  • Develop and package proactive marketing opportunities tied to show IP and cultural events utilizing insights, research, and social platform expertise

  • Lead all aspects of your assigned marketing programs after they are approved, including managing agency and client partners

    • Collaborate with Creative and channel teams on producing and delivering content

    • Own timeline management to keep concepts and deliverables on schedule

    • Develop pre-pro materials and representing client needs on set

    • Lead campaign launch efforts from planning through execution

    • Collaborate with media activation and cultural intelligence teams on reporting

  • Be the main contact for assigned properties and events. Work with the channel teams to keep up with production plans and requirements. Collaborate on sponsor opportunities during the show and at other times. Show points then help prepare sales materials to pitch these opportunities

  • 8 + years’ experience in in Media/Tech, Ad Sales, Integrated Marketing and/or agency experience

  • Fierce attention to detail, superb organization, project & time management skills

  • Collaborative spirit and a proactive mindset is a must

  • Robust knowledge of Google Workspace, including Drive, Sheets, Slides and Docs, as well as Photoshop with top-notch presentation design skills

  • Excellent task ownership, problem-solving and research skills

  • Interest in social media, digital platforms, and the larger media landscape

  • Ability to manage both up and down

  • Comfortable using AI regularly for tasks and projects

  • Impeccably high standards for quality work

job.title: Director, Media Solutions
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Is this the role for you?

Channel 5 is looking for a Media Solutions Engineer to design and protect the broadcast and streaming workflows that power our linear, VOD, FAST and OTT platforms. This is a hands-on architecture and subject matter expert role, sitting at the intersection of engineering, compliance and revenue protection — you'll shape how content, metadata and monetisation systems work together across the business.

What will you be doing?

  • Design end-to-end solutions across linear broadcast, VOD, FAST, OTT and metadata workflows, keeping streaming and linear platforms consistent
  • Document technical architectures for playout, MAM, scheduling, ad-tech and compliance systems
  • Act as senior subject matter expert on linear and VOD broadcasting, advising on system behaviour, integration constraints and risk
  • Provide specialist 3rd-line support during incidents affecting revenue, ad-tech performance or contractual obligations
  • Diagnose issues affecting ad classification, insertion, platform matching and monetisation
  • Partner with operations, ad-sales and technology teams to find inefficiencies and design improvements
  • Lead or contribute to proofs-of-concept, testing new approaches before wider rollout
  • Support delivery teams through testing, go-live and hyper-care
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders through diagrams, impact assessments and documentation

What are we looking for?

Essential

  • Significant experience as a linear broadcasting subject matter expert, ideally across global and public service broadcaster environments, with deep knowledge of Broadcast Management Systems and complex content/metadata workflows
  • 10+ years in VOD/OTT technology, including ad-supported delivery (AVOD/BVOD)
  • Strong background in solution architecture, systems integration (including APIs) and change delivery
  • Solid understanding of PSB constraints and regulatory obligations, with the ability to protect revenue-critical workflows
  • Track record of resolving complex, high-pressure operational issues quickly and accurately
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to flex your style across audiences
  • A collaborative, practical and detail-focused approach, with sound judgement on technical trade-offs

Desirable

  • Experience with broadcast management applications (e.g. Mediagenix WhatsOn) and MAM, compliance or playout systems
  • Comfortable using AI tools to boost productivity
  • Experience defining cross-platform workflows that treat streaming and linear equally

Director Oracle Fusion Project & Portfolio Management (PPM)   Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Oracle Fusion PPM Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join our Enterprise Solutions team. In this critical role, you will be the ultimate authority on our Oracle Fusion Project and Portfolio Management and and its deep integration with the Fixed Assets and Oracle EPM Project Financials Planning modules.   You will lead the functional design, configuration, optimization, and continuous improvement of the Oracle PPM suite. The ideal candidate has expertise in Project Financial Management. This includes Costing, Billing, and Contracts. They also have experience in Project Financial Planning Management, which covers Budget and Forecast. Additionally, they are informed about Capital Projects, such as CIP and Depreciation. They must also understand how PPM integrates with core Financials, Procurement, and HCM.   Key Responsibilities System Configuration & Design
  • Act as the lead functional architect and configurator for Oracle Cloud PPM modules. Your responsibilities include Project Costing. You will also oversee Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control, Project Management, and Project Resource Management.
  • Translate complex business requirements from the PMO and Finance teams into scalable, efficient system configurations using the Functional Setup Manager (FSM).
  • Lead the design of Project/Task hierarchies, cost breakdown structures, capitalization rules, and complex project billing/revenue recognition rules.
  • Design and set up the financial planning processes for projects in EPM. This involves project approvals. It also includes budgeting based on key drivers, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
  • Translate complex business requirements from the PMO, FP&A, and Finance teams into scalable system configurations using the Functional Setup Manager (FSM) and EPM workspace.
  • Manage the configuration of Capital Projects. This includes setting up rules for asset generation and capitalization (CIP). You will also handle retirement costs and set up Fixed Assets, including Asset Books, Categories, and Depreciation Methods.
  • Manage the configuration of Capital Projects. This includes setting up rules for asset generation and capitalization (CIP). You will also oversee retirement costs and Fixed Assets. This involves managing Asset Books, Categories, and Depreciation Methods.
  Cross-Functional Integration
  • Design and troubleshoot critical integrations between PPM and other Oracle Cloud modules, specifically Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA), Procurement (PO, Requisitions), and HCM (Oracle Time & Labor - OTL).
  • Manage the technical and functional data pipeline across the project ecosystem: pushing budgets from EPM to PPM, feeding actuals from PPM back to EPM, and transferring capitalized project costs from PPM to Fixed Assets.
  • Ensure seamless data flow for project-related expenses, timecards, supplier invoices, and accounting lines.
  • Manage data migrations, mass updates, and project conversions using File-Based Data Import (FBDI) and ADFdi.
  Business Partnership & Advisory
  • Partner closely with project managers, project accountants, and finance leadership to establish best practices for project tracking, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Conduct workshops and gather requirements. Identify process bottlenecks. Suggest solutions using Oracle.
  • Drive user adoption by creating functional documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and delivering targeted training to end-users.
  Support, Testing & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and rollout phases.
  • Evaluate Oracle’s quarterly patch updates, test new PPM features in lower environments, and advise the business on adopting new capabilities to drive efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain custom project reports and dashboards using OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence) and BI Publisher.
  Required Qualifications Experience & Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience working with Oracle ERP systems, with a minimum of 3-5 years specifically focused on Oracle Fusion PPM.
  • Proven track record of acting as the primary functional lead or SME on at least one (1) full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud PPM implementation.
  Technical & Functional Skills
  • Deep, hands-on configuration expertise across the entire Oracle Fusion PPM suite (Project Financials and Project Execution).
  • A strong understanding of project accounting principles is essential. You must know about revenue recognition, capitalization (CIP), cross-charge setups, and overhead allocations.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Subledger Accounting (SLA) as it pertains to project transactions.
  • Proficiency in building reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher.
  • Familiarity with Agile project methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for system dependencies and data integrity.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate complex system mechanics to non-technical business leaders.
  • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  Preferred Qualifications
  • Active Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud Implementation Professional certification.

Director, Product Management
247Sports

Location: Nashville, TN (on-site)

About 247Sports:
247Sports is a leading destination for college sports recruiting coverage, player rankings, and team-focused fan communities. We combine deep evaluation data and expert analysis with a premium VIP subscription experience for the most dedicated fans in college sports.
Position summary


247Sports is hiring a Director of Product Management to own the product strategy and roadmap for our web and data experiences. This is a results-driven leadership role centered on turning the deep evaluation data 247Sports collects into premium, subscriber-facing products that make our VIP membership materially more valuable. The Director will lead product development across the recruiting database (RDB), scouting and evaluation tooling, and subscriber growth, and will partner closely with editorial, scouting, engineering, and site publishers to drive measurable results.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in our Nashville office. We are open to discussing relocation timing for the right candidate.


Key responsibilities:


Product strategy & VIP subscriber value
●    Own the product vision and roadmap for 247Sports web and data products, with a focus on driving VIP subscription value, retention, and acquisition.
●    Lead the flagship initiative to productize proprietary evaluation data, including scouting reports, verified and unverified measurables, track times, and cross-sport intel, into front-facing content and interactive tools that show subscribers how and why players are ranked.
●    Define and prioritize premium features such as player evaluation profiles, searchable and sortable measurables and testing data, cross-sport intel, and scout-grade comparison tools.


Scouting & recruiting product partnership
●    Partner with the scouting and recruiting teams to build and expand the internal evaluation tooling they rely on day to day, including the scouting-information repository, evaluation tracking, and rankings workflows.
●    Lead development of depth charts and impact ratings, connecting scouting data directly to consumer-facing products.


Recruiting database (RDB)
●    Own the roadmap to elevate the RDB product experience and establish it as the primary destination for premium evaluation data.


Product marketing & growth
●    Partner with site publishers on strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and subscriptions.
●    Tie data-driven product initiatives directly to measurable subscriber acquisition and retention outcomes.


Cross-functional leadership
●    Lead product initiatives across engineering, editorial, scouting, and design, setting direction, prioritizing the roadmap, and driving execution.
●    Provide QA, project management, and site-production oversight as needed across product areas.
●    Support the 247Sports app roadmap, contributing on the web, backend, and data components that feed it, including Player Rankings.


Qualifications


Required
●    10+ years of product management experience, including roadmap ownership.
●    Demonstrated track record of building and shipping complex, data-driven products from the ground up.
●    Proven ability to translate large or complex data sets into consumer-facing products and tools.
●    Strong background in subscription or membership products, with a focus on driving retention and growth.
●    Experience leading cross-functional teams and partnering with editorial, engineering, and business stakeholders.
●    Excellent product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills.


Preferred
●    Deep familiarity with college sports, recruiting, and player evaluation.
●    Experience founding or leading a product or business built on sports data or recruiting tools.
●    Background working directly with scouting or evaluation data and the teams that produce it.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Overview:

If you're excited by the idea of influencing how some of the world's biggest movies are created and launched, then look no further. We're hiring a Director of Strategy and Insights to join us at Paramount Pictures!

 

At Paramount, our Strategy and Insights team sits at the intersection of consumer insights and creative strategy, shaping how upcoming releases are made, marketed, and distributed. This role offers rare exposure to the entire film slate, from original titles to iconic franchises like Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Sonic the Hedgehog, and A Quiet Place.

 

Within the studio, this team serves as the voice of the audience, understanding how moviegoers feel about our films and brands and translating those perspectives into strategies that help us tell stories that connect authentically. This role requires someone who can balance analytical rigor with creative intuition, and who can build genuine trust and influence with creative and marketing leaders — not just deliver findings to them.

 

As Director, you'll help drive how insights guide strategy for all Paramount Motion Picture releases and play a key role in designing and implementing the research that shapes creative direction. You'll report to the Senior Vice President of Global Strategy and Insights and work closely with teams across the studio.

 

Apply now and join us!


Responsibilities:

  • Drive research findings into actionable strategies that guide Paramount’s full slate of releases
  • Lead the division in developing qualitative and quantitative research to tackle key questions and challenges
  • Manage research planning and delivery, including vendor management, questionnaire development, and reporting
  • Design clear, dynamic visual documents that communicate research findings and data effectively
  • Present research insights regularly at marketing strategy and management meetings, acting as a trusted, consultative partner to creative and marketing leadership
  • Actively supply ideas and feedback in meetings, presentations, and brainstorming sessions
  • Assess each motion picture’s target audience, opportunities, and challenges
  • Monitor research trends and guidelines to implement innovative approaches across the studio, including evaluating competitive campaigns, expanding statistical analysis, and advancing AI use in research


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 8+ years in marketing, content, or audience research
  • MBA or comparable advanced degree in social sciences, business, statistics, marketing, or a related field preferred, but not required where seniority and impact are clearly established
  • Entertainment or related market research experience preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex research into a clear point of view for non-research stakeholders, and to build trust and influence with senior creative and marketing leaders
  • Excellent communication, presentation, professional writing, and problem-solving skills
  • Shown project management and organizational skills


Additional Qualifications: 

  • Experience with data visualization tools and software
  • Strong knowledge of movies and a passion for entertainment

 


Founded in 1912, Paramount Pictures works with talented filmmakers to produce and distribute entertainment around the world. The film studio’s iconic logo has opened some of the most successful and beloved films in cinematic history, including timeless classics such as The Godfather, Chinatown, Forrest Gump and Titanic; and blockbuster franchises such as Star Trek, Transformers, Mission: Impossible and Sonic the Hedgehog. Recent, innovative, break-out films such as The Wolf of Wall Street, Arrival, Rocketman, and A Quiet Place have added to Paramount’s film legacy. With a beautiful 65-acre lot in the heart of Hollywood, a worldwide network of offices and a culture of engagement, Paramount Pictures’ passionate employees ensure the studio continues to deliver creativity and innovation to a dynamic industry. Paramount Pictures controls a collection of some of the most powerful brands in filmed entertainment, including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Animation, and Paramount Players. PPC operations also include Paramount Home Entertainment, Paramount Pictures International, Paramount Licensing Inc., and Paramount Studio Group. job.description:

CBS Sports Golazo Network is seeking an Editorial Researcher to support coverage across its growing portfolio of soccer properties. Based in Stamford, CT, this role will combine research, editorial, and production responsibilities to support live match coverage, studio programming, news gathering, and original content initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses deep soccer knowledge, strong editorial instincts, excellent writing skills, and the ability to identify and develop compelling storylines in a fast-paced environment. Working closely with producers, talent, news editors, and fellow researchers, this person will help shape coverage through research, scriptwriting, editorial planning, and real-time support for live events. The position requires a deep understanding of the global soccer landscape, including women's and men’s competitions, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

Candidates must be available to work full-time hours in the Stamford, CT, office. Nights, holidays and weekends are to be expected. The pay range is $24-28 per hour, equivalent to approximately $49,920 - 58,240 annually.

Responsibilities:

  • Support editorial coverage across all CBS Sports Golazo Network soccer properties, including live matches, studio programming and digital platforms.
  • Monitor breaking news, social media, press conferences, and industry reporting to identify emerging storylines, trends, and developments across the global soccer landscape.
  • Develop and deliver editorial packets, talent notes, and production materials that feature statistical research, analytical context, storylines, profiles, historical perspectives, and key match information.
  • Write scripts, teasers, headlines, talking points, and other editorial content for studio shows, live events, and soccer news programming.
  • Collaborate with producers, talent, news editors, and fellow researchers to identify, prioritize, and develop compelling stories for coverage.
  • Support live match and studio productions by providing real-time editorial guidance, research, statistical support, and breaking news updates.
  • Anticipate and develop storylines before and during live events, identifying trends, notable performances, and key discussion points for on-air coverage.
  • Generate creative ideas for graphics, video elements, rankings, explainers, and other editorial content that enhance storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Curate and create content for digital and FAST platforms, including countdowns, rankings, feature concepts, and news-driven programming.
  • Research and synthesize information from statistical databases, league and team resources, social media platforms, press conferences, and news outlets to support accurate and timely storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with producers, talent, graphics teams, video teams, and other content creators to ensure editorial alignment across productions.
  • Utilize advanced metrics, data, and historical research to develop unique angles and provide deeper context around teams, players, competitions, and storylines.
  • Contribute to coverage planning for major soccer events and tentpole properties, including men's and women's competitions at the domestic and international levels.
  • Help shape editorial priorities and coverage strategies by exercising strong news judgment and identifying stories that resonate with CBS Sports audiences. Work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, creativity, and attention to detail.

 

Qualifications:

  • Excellent knowledge of soccer is highly desired.
  • Minimum 1 year of research experience (strong internships considered).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience covering or following women's and men’s soccer and international club competitions.
  • Proven ability to operate as both a researcher and an editorial contributor, capable of developing storylines, writing content, supporting coverage decisions, and thriving in a fast-paced live production environment
  • Experience supporting live sports productions, studio programming, or other broadcast environments with tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of advanced soccer metrics, analytics, and statistical tools.
  • Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated news judgment and an ability to identify timely, relevant, and impactful storylines.
  • Familiarity with social media monitoring, news gathering, and real-time editorial decision-making.
  • Passion for storytelling and identifying unique angles that enhance sports coverage.
  • Must be able to work nights, weekends and flexible hours.

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

RTR Expert – Fixed Assets & Leases Accounting

Location: Budapest Finance Hub | Paramount

At Paramount, we bring stories to audiences around the world through iconic brands, cutting-edge streaming platforms, and unforgettable global entertainment experiences. Behind the scenes of our world-class entertainment is our Budapest Finance Hub—the engine supporting our international operations.

We’re looking for a sharp, experienced RTR Expert (Fixed Assets & Leases Accounting) to take ownership of key financial operations, bring deep accounting expertise to the table, and step into a natural leadership role within our Record-to-Report (RTR) team.

The Team & Work Culture

You’ll be joining a dynamic, close-knit, and youthful team that truly has each other’s backs. Everyone here is open, friendly, and always ready to support one another.

  • Team Structure: Including this role, our team is made up of 2 Managers, 3 Experts, 4 Analysts, and 5 Interns. As an Expert, you’ll play a pivotal role in guiding junior colleagues and keeping operations running smoothly.

  • Global Exposure: We report directly to the US, giving you high visibility, direct international collaboration, and key exposure to global financial operations.

How You’ll Make an Impact

In this role, you’ll drive the accurate and timely accounting of global fixed assets and lease transactions. Beyond day-to-day operations, you will serve as an operational focal point, elevate process efficiency, and ensure robust internal controls across Paramount’s international footprint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Core Accounting: Manage global fixed asset and lease accounting activities, prepare high-quality journal entries, and handle account reconciliations.

  • Asset & Lease Ownership: Oversee asset master data, project setups, purchase orders for lease agreements, and monthly amortization in SAP.

  • Specialized Financial Operations: Execute asset disposals, impairments, reclassifications, and support statutory audit processes.

  • Key User Responsibilities: Act as the main contact point for Lease Accelerator in Budapest.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify process bottlenecks and drive initiatives to streamline team workflows.

  • Team Guidance & Mentorship: Support and coach junior team members, acting as operational backup for the Line Manager when needed.

  • Compliance: Safeguard financial integrity by adhering to internal controls and SOX requirements.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Experience: 4–5 years of relevant accounting experience, with hands-on expertise in fixed assets, leases, journal entries, and reconciliations.

  • Technical Mastery: Strong grounding in US GAAP and/or IFRS, alongside advanced Excel and MS Office skills.

  • System Savvy: Experience with ERP systems (such as SAP or Lease Accelerator) is a plus.

  • Problem-Solver Mindset: Proactive approach to continuous improvement and financial process optimization.

  • Soft Skills: Confident communicator with solid stakeholder management skills and fluent/advanced English.

  • Leadership Potential: Prior experience mentoring colleagues or stepping into informal leadership roles is a big advantage!

Why You’ll Love Working Here

🎬 Unmatched Entertainment Perks: Enjoy exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings before they hit the general public.

🐾 Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your four-legged companion to work with you!

🏥 Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private health insurance (including screening packages) plus eyewear support.

We are looking for a Senior Expert to manage cash operations. You will reconcile bank accounts, prepare accurate reports, and manage monthly cash-flow reporting. Stakeholders will trust you to deliver correct and timely information.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Reconcile bank accounts every day and every month, across all entities
  • Prepare and reconcile the actual cash-flow report
  • Manage FX revaluation and translation each month, from start to finish
  • Find ways to improve processes and make the team more efficient
  • Support and guide less experienced team members
  • Work with internal and external auditors on SOX compliance

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Accounting or Finance
  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Good knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS
  • Experience with JDE or SAP
  • A proactive approach — you notice problems and find solutions
  • Confidence to share your opinion and support it with facts
  • Strong English and strong Excel skills
  • Attention to risk and process control

Why join us:
You will work within a large Global Business Services team, with high standards and real responsibility. You will reconcile accounts for some of the world's best-known entertainment brands. This is technical work with visible impact. There is a clear path to grow into roles with more responsibility, and a team that will support your development.

  Overview & Responsibilities
The Financial Analyst will support the CBS News, Stations, and CBS Media Venture(CMV) Digital division and report to the Director, FP&A. The Analyst will assist in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of forecasts and budgets, tracking performance, managing monthly operating expenses, and using analysis to drive informed decision-making.  This position offers the right candidate an exemplary opportunity within a successful and growing global media organization to gain wide-ranging exposure to the evolving streaming platforms. The Financial Analyst (News, Stations & CBS Media Venture) will help contribute by spearheading quantitative and qualitative analyses to optimize financial performance.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:  
  • Budgeting/Forecasting: Work on business models to manage forecasting of the monthly P&L and drive the annual budget and financial plans for CBS News, Stations, and CMV Digital Properties
  • Work with Accounting in preparation for monthly close
  • Manage month-end accruals, contracts, and invoices
  • Expense management, risk analysis, and mitigation
  • Actively monitor expense levers and cost controls required to maintain profitability and achieve budgeted profit targets
  • Collaborate closely with the following teams: Inventory & Pricing, Business Intelligence, Business Development, and Production. Gain insight and knowledge that may impact the forecast

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Free Press is looking for a Growth Marketer to help drive subscriber acquisition and retention across our fastest-growing channels. We're looking for a hands-on marketing tactician: someone who can plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid and owned channels, while using data to know what's working and why. You'll blend creative instinct with a rigorous, test-and-learn mindset to help scale The Free Press's subscriber base. Our ideal candidate is also passionate about using emerging AI tools to move faster, building campaigns, analyzing performance, exploring agentic tools, and automating repetitive work so the team can experiment more and ship more.

 

Please note submitting a cover letter is required.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across channels, including paid social, search, video, and O&O, to drive subscriber acquisition.
  • Manage and grow email and on-platform marketing efforts in support of subscriber growth and engagement.
  • Own campaign performance: monitor results, run tests, and adjust tactics in real time to maximize ROI.
  • Build and execute a testing roadmap for offers, creative, and messaging to improve acquisition and retention.
  • Use audience segmentation and subscriber data to tailor campaigns and messaging to different reader groups.
  • Support paywall, pricing, and promotional strategy by helping design and run experiments.
  • Collaborate with editorial, audio, video, and events teams to bring cohesive, on-brand marketing campaigns to life.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate campaign builds, reporting, and workflow automation across the growth function.
  • Help set and track growth and retention goals.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing for a consumer subscription product. In media or at a startup is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience running paid social, search, and video campaigns.
  • Comfortable working in email marketing platforms and CRM/subscription management tools.
  • Strong understanding of the subscriber funnel, from anonymous visitor to registered user to paid subscriber, and what moves people through it.
  • Deep comfort and fluency using AI tools for campaign execution, analysis, and workflow automation, with a proactive mindset toward finding new ways AI can drive growth.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Data-savvy: comfortable using analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance and translate results into next steps. SQL or Excel fluency is a plus.
  • Creative thinker with a strategic mindset and a results-oriented, test-and-learn approach.
  • Exemplary writing and communication skills, with the ability to adapt The Free Press's voice across channels and audiences.
  • Thorough understanding of (or strong interest in) the independent media and news landscape. Interest in and familiarity with The Free Press is a plus.
  • Highly autonomous, curious, and proactive, comfortable in a scrappy, fast-moving environment.
  • Desire to partner cross-functionally with editorial, product, creative, and data teams.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

We now have a rare opportunity for a talented HR Operations specialist with a passion for process and data to join our HR Ops team here in our Sydney office (Pyrmont).  
 
Enough about us! What you’ll do in this role:
 
This role involves providing HR analysis and support to employees in APAC by addressing queries related to HR processes across the employee life cycle. It serves as a point of escalation for issue resolution, leveraging ServiceNow and other tools to track and manage employee concerns while coordinating with various teams across Paramount. 
  
Functions will also include:  

  • Addressing employee queries and resolving complex HR-related issues with expertise, serving as a secondary escalation point for employee matters leveraging in-depth HR knowledge.
  • Tracking SLAs and managing employee concerns through ServiceNow, ensuring timely resolution and follow-up.
  • Providing the HR team with reports and data analysis on a recurring basis, plus upon request.
  • Completing regular internal audits on HR systems while supporting ad-hoc external audits through in-depth data analysis.
  • Providing recommendations on how to fix identified issues in HR systems (currently SuccessFactors/ADP) and working with internal teams and system providers to resolve them.  
  • Overseeing the coordination of key employee transitions (e.g. onboarding) and cyclical processes across the employee life cycle, ensuring a seamless integration experience.
  • Ownership of the time and absence system (ADP Workforce Manager [WFM]), including overseeing submissions and providing advanced support for payroll queries.
  • Analysing ServiceNow data to identify trends and implement strategies for enhancing efficiency and employee satisfaction.
  • Closely supporting the Director of HR Operations APAC in various projects and stepping in to push key initiatives forward if necessary.
  • Assisting with driving initiatives set as part of HR Operations’ roadmap/priorities at Paramount.
  • Coaching coordinators to uplift capability in process/knowledge while keeping process documentation current to improve information retention in the team. 

 

What are we looking for in an HR Operations Specialist? What’s important? 

  • We need someone who is focused and highly skilled in HR Operations, working with HR data, reporting & analysis, improving systems & processes, and providing great support to people across the business
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, Business, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience (3-5 years ideally) in HR Operations with tasks involving analytics, ER, comp & bens, etc
  • Solid payroll exposure including knowledge of payroll processing and addressing payroll-related queries - our HR Ops team handle all payroll-related enquiries
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office suite, with key focus on Excel to an advanced level
  • Experience with core HR systems such as SuccessFactors, ADP WFM, including identifying and troubleshooting system issues
  • Strong knowledge of Australian employment law and experience interpreting Enterprise Agreements
  • Proven experience in analysing HR data and presenting findings in a clear and engaging manner
  • Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees, management and external stakeholders
  • High level of attention to detail and handling confidential information
  • Ability to calmly and confidently multi-task, prioritise responsibilities and meet deadlines
  • Ability to play well with others and enjoy a collaborative team environment
  • Proactive and curious in identifying HR-related issues and opportunities for improvements

For our Budapest office we are currently recruiting a full-time:


Human Resources Business Partner (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)


Is this the role for you?

Role Overview


The Human Resources Business Partner supports a defined business population by partnering directly with people managers on day to day and complex HR matters.

 

The role focuses on practical guidance, consistent application of HR policies, and timely execution of core people's processes to support team performance, compliance, and an inclusive employee experience.

 

The role reports to the Human Resources Director for Hungary & Czech Republic and works closely with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Compensation & Benefits, Talent Acquisition, and HR Operations.

 

What will you be doing?
Key Responsibilities

  • Support managers on hiring, promotions, compensation changes, leave and employee relations matters.

  • Provide HR guidance on sensitive or complex situations, applying policy and local labor law, and escalating when risk or precedent is required.

  • Support managers during performance cycles, including goal setting, feedback conversations, performance improvement actions, and documentation.

  • Prepare and review HR data and reports (e.g. headcount, attrition, leave, performance inputs) to support decision-making processes.

  • Execute core HR processes and transactions in the HR system in partnership with HR.

  • Take an active role in HR projects and cross-functional initiatives, gaining exposure to different areas of Human Resources and supporting the continuous improvement of people processes.

 

Role Level Descriptors


Scope

  • Supports people leader population in the Budapest office.

  • Works within established HR policies, tools, and frameworks.

Autonomy

  • Supports day-to-day HR matters independently within guidelines.

  • Escalates legal, high risk, or precedent setting cases appropriately.

Impact

  • Improves manager effectiveness through timely, accurate HR guidance.

  • Contributes to consistent employee experience across the supported population.

Decision-Making

  • Recommends people actions based on policy, data, and case context.

  • Decisions primarily affect individual employees or teams.

Stakeholder Interaction

  • Regular, direct interaction with people managers and Onsite Leader for Hungary.

  • Ongoing collaboration with HR Operations and HR COE teams.

 

What are we looking for?
Experience & Capabilities

  • 3+ years of experience in Human Resources.

  • Experience partnering with people leaders to provide strategic guidance and deliver people solutions that support business priorities.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple HR cases simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Practical experience across performance management, employee relations, compensation processes, hiring support, workforce planning, and leave management.

  • Working knowledge of local employment legislation.

  • Clear, professional communication skills and a collaborative working style.

  • High standards of confidentiality, integrity, and inclusion.

  • Fluent in English and Hungarian.

 

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.title: Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
Personalization & Recommendation Systems


Overview
We’re hiring a Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational excellence, observability, reliability, and governance layer around our personalization and recommendation ML systems. 

Our recommendation models retrain and deploy frequently. You will define how we detect model behavior changes, diagnose issues quickly, and prevent bad deployments from reaching customers.


This is a lead-level IC role: you’ll set technical direction and drive adoption across ML Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product.


Sitting within ML Platform and Infrastructure, you’ll partner closely with ML engineers who own model development. You’re not expected to build infrastructure from scratch, but you’ll define what good looks like, evaluate tooling, and own the day-to-day operational layer.


What You’ll Do

Own ML production reliability strategy

  • Define and lead the operational strategy for production ML systems, including monitoring, traceability, deployment safety, incident response, and post-deployment validation.

  • Set the standards ML teams use to assess model health, performance, and trustworthiness in production.

Own model traceability and governance

  • Ensure every production model has clear lineage (data, features, code, artifacts, validation, deployment history) and drive adoption of model registry and metadata tooling across ML teams.

Build end-to-end ML observability

  • Design and implement monitoring across the full ML signal path: data arrival, feature freshness, distribution stability, candidate generation, ranking behavior, model metrics, serving latency, and SLA performance.

Define production health metrics

  • Partner with ML, data, product, and business stakeholders to define post-deployment metrics covering model quality, system reliability, business guardrails, and degradation indicators.

Detect drift and degradation proactively

  • Detect data drift, feature drift, model behavior changes, and silent failures before they impact customers via thresholding, alerting, anomaly detection, and release-over-release monitoring.

Lead diagnostic tooling and root-cause analysis

  • Build dashboards, logs, and diagnostic workflows that progress quickly from “recommendations look off” to root cause, with context captured across candidates, features, scores, ranking decisions, and downstream outcomes.

Own ML deployment safety

  • Define and operate automated gates that prevent bad models or bad data from being promoted to production. Partner with MLEs to establish validation checks, rollback criteria, canary strategies, shadow testing, and release health reviews.

Lead ML incident response

  • Own incident response practices for ML systems, including rollback playbooks, hotfix strategies, severity definitions, tradeoff frameworks, communications, and post-mortems. Drive closure of systemic gaps after incidents rather than only resolving the immediate issue.

Partner across ML Platform, Data, and ML

  • Partner with DevOps/Platform on infrastructure and observability needs; with Data Engineering on data quality, drift, and freshness; and with ML Engineering to embed operational requirements into development and deployment workflows.

Set standards and mentor others

  • Act as the technical lead for ML operations: establish reusable patterns, playbooks, and standards, and mentor engineers on reliability, observability, and operational rigor.


Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, ML platform, applied ML, MLOps, data platform, reliability engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Demonstrated experience operating production ML systems, including monitoring, deployment, incident response, model validation, data quality, or reliability ownership.

  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams, especially where success required influencing architecture, tooling, standards, or adoption.

  • Hands-on experience with model registries, feature stores, ML metadata systems, production monitoring, model deployment pipelines, or ML observability platforms.

  • Solid knowledge of end-to-end ML systems, including training data, features, model artifacts, offline validation, online serving, post-deployment metrics, and business outcome measurement.

  • Ability to reason about ML operational failure modes: stale features, distribution shift, training-serving skew, delayed labels, and offline-online metric gaps.

  • Solid SQL skills and comfort investigating data quality, feature distributions, model outputs, pipeline behavior, and production anomalies.

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Platform, Data, and ML Engineering to deliver production-grade operational capabilities.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain ML system health, risks, incidents, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation, personalization, ranking, search, ads, content discovery, or marketplace ML systems at scale.

  • Experience with real-time or near-real-time model serving systems.

  • Experience with feature stores, model registries, metadata stores, experiment tracking, data quality tools, lineage systems, or observability platforms.

  • Experience designing automated validation gates, canary deployments, rollback strategies, shadow deployments, or progressive delivery workflows for ML systems.

  • Experience with A/B testing, experiment guardrails, counterfactual evaluation, or offline-to-online metric alignment.

  • Experience with cloud-native production environments, distributed data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, or streaming systems.

  • Experience leading incident reviews, post-mortems, reliability programs, or operational excellence initiatives.

  • Experience defining standards, playbooks, or governance frameworks for production ML systems.


What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first 90 days, you will have assessed the current production ML operational landscape, identified the highest-risk gaps, and established a prioritized roadmap for observability, traceability, deployment safety, and incident response.

  • Within six months, our production recommendation systems will have clearer model lineage, stronger monitoring coverage, better diagnostic workflows, and more reliable deployment gates.

  • Within one year, ML operations will be a repeatable, trusted function: teams will know what is running, why it was promoted, how it is performing, when something is wrong, and how to recover quickly.

 

Leveling Signal
The right candidate defines strategy, leads cross-functional execution, and sets engineering standards while staying hands-on enough to investigate production issues directly.
