You will also drive AI-augmented development and testing practices using GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Automation Framework Architecture • Enhance and extend our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Establish scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. Quality Engineering Technical Leadership • Define technical strategy for automated testing across services, microservices, UIs, mobile apps, and OTT/CTV applications leveraging the departmental framework. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns. • Lead the evaluation and adoption of modern automation technologies and quality platforms.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 7+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional automation initiatives. • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Technical leadership – ability to guide teams and evolve automation coverage. • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – knowledge of distributed systems and complex media pipelines. • Ownership – ability to drive initiatives end-to-end with autonomy.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams

job.description:

The role will be end-to-end from understanding the goals and roadmaps of the product and engineering teams, through design and architecture of any solution and the delivery and maintenance of those platforms once in place.   This role involves engineering for the Android platform and developing AI. You will use AI agents and coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot daily. You will also collaborate with ML and data science teams on features for clients.   We are seeking someone who will participate in the definition of product requirements, being able to articulate how the engineering effort will align to those requirements and provide accurate estimates of the effort. You will also be involved in platform architectural discussions and initiatives paving the way for optimizations and performance alongside.   You will also be working with a team of engineers through the development process, including implementing standards around code, tooling, metrics, progress reporting and interactions with the QE team to ensure a quality first approach to any work.     Responsibilities   Technical Leadership:
  • Drive the architectural direction and design of Android applications
  • Establish best practices for coding, testing, and deployment
  • Evangelize new tools, frameworks, and processes for continued innovation and development efficiency
  • Prepare architectural diagrams and technical specifications for the engineering team to deliver high quality, maintainable software
  • Lead architectural discussions around feature development and software development best practice
  • Involvement in performance and playback optimizations, overall app stability and profiling
  Application Development:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices
  • Ensure robust performance, responsiveness, and quality of applications, troubleshooting and debugging as needed
  AI-Integrated Development:
  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring
  • Partner with technical leadership to establish and optimize safe, high-impact practices for utilizing AI tools within the development team
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to integrate LLM and ML capabilities into product features, such as advanced search, discovery, and personalized content understanding
  Mentorship:
  • Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers, sharing technical expertise and guiding professional growth
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency across the team
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements
  • Coordinate with backend services and APIs to ensure seamless integration and feature delivery
  Process Improvement:
  • Enhance software development processes and policies, driving continuous improvement in code quality, development speed, and overall team productivity
  • Stay current with emerging Android technologies, libraries, and trends, recommending their adoption where beneficial
  Ownership and Accountability:
  • Partner closely with the Android Engineering Manager on development strategies
  • Ensure the application is highly responsive and performant
  • Safeguard against production incidents
  • Enable engineers to deliver mission-critical features and enhancements
  • Identify technical risks and potential bottlenecks, proposing solutions to mitigate them
    Skills Expertise in Android Development:
  • Proficient in Kotlin and Java, with a solid understanding of the Android SDK and different Android versions
  • Deep knowledge of Architecture Patterns and Material Design (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Compose UI)
  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns
  System Design & Architecture:
  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries
  Testing and Quality Assurance:
  • Solid experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  Performance Optimization:
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)
  Leadership and Communication:
  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams
    Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • You should have strong interpersonal skills. You will need to facilitate conversations with business partners. This includes discussions during project definition, business requirements definition, and functional design sessions.
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements
    Desired Qualifications
  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience in creating accessible front-end designs. This includes using TalkBack properties in XML, like labelFor and contentDescription. It also involves making TalkBack announcements, scaling text dynamically, and ensuring responsive design.
  AI Literacy
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase
  • Working understanding of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, and prompt engineering, enough to design client integrations and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes
  • You should have useful experience in shipping or prototyping at least one product feature that uses machine learning (ML) or large language models (LLM). This could include features such as search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, or in-app assistants.
  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required
  Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)
  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)
  • Experience working with ExoPlayer
  • Widevine DRM knowledge

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

For our Milan office (Corso Europa) we are currently recruiting for a full-time:

 

Lead Software Test Engineer

 

Is this the role for you?

POSITION SUMMARY:

Paramount Global is looking for a passionate, self-motivated lead software test engineer to handle all aspects of testing (functional, performance, load, security, etc) across a large multiplatform environment.  This individual will be partnering with various teams (product, engineering, and quality) by assisting with the development of processes and tools that allow the organization to excel in its continuous software development initiatives.  As code is being delivered multiple times per day, test coverage and automation is crucial in allowing products to deliver quickly to market while maintaining the high level of quality our consumers deserve across our many diverse platforms. 

 

What will you be doing?
PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical quality leadership and guidance to the projects and resources that are assigned by implementing testing best practices 

  • Work on product/project teams developing test plans, test cases and test execution 

  • Partner with software engineering to design and develop tools and to assist in continuous development initiatives 

  • Conduct technical assessment of process and teams 

  • Perform load / performance testing where applicable 

  • Work alongside and mentor other test engineers to continuously improve process and provide input into our internal training bootcamps 

  • Contribute to and help maintain the testing framework for various types of testing (functional, load/performance, security) on multiple platforms (web, iOS/Android, emerging platforms) 

  • Operate in an agile software delivery methodology focused on testing new features within an iteration and providing near immediate feedback to engineers through test automation 

  • Perform exploratory testing where necessary in addition to regression testing 

  • Effectively communicate complex and/or difficult information to both technical and non-technical audiences 

  • Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment supporting many products on varied release cycles 

  • Oversee activities of other QE Engineers contractors

  • Design and architect end-to-end test frameworks and strategy from the ground up for large-scale, multiplatform streaming applications, applying appropriate design patterns without over-engineering 

  • Lead the adoption of AI-augmented quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted test generation and review, evaluation of AI/LLM feature outputs, and establishing safeguards and data-governance practices (e.g. anonymization) for AI tool usage 

  • Perform hands-on code and test-design review (spotting logic bugs, flaky-prone patterns and bad practices), and hold the line on quality standards across the team 

  • Own test-suite health: prioritize test maintenance, identify and resolve flaky tests in CI, and drive risk-based and requirements-based coverage decisions 

  • Document processes and testing knowledge continuously to reduce key-person risk and support knowledge transfer across the team.

 

What are we looking for?

JOB SKILLS:

  • Deep understanding of software quality best practices, with a passion for learning and adopting emerging technologies and methodologies
  • Solid software development expertise and technical architecture capabilities
  • Strong object-oriented programming background, with a focus on building scalable, reliable, and reusable solutions
  • Hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience in one or more of C#, PHP, or Java
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, SVN, and Stash
  • Experience with automation and testing tools, including Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, TestNG, Appium, and Cypress
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and build automation tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo
  • Experience using performance testing tools, including JMeter and LoadRunner
  • Experience working within Agile development and testing environments
  • Understanding of web video playback, encoding, live streaming, and related technologies
  • Knowledge of network analysis and proxy tools such as Charles, Fiddler, and HttpWatch
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, content delivery networks (CDNs), database fundamentals, and caching strategies
  • Experience with TDD and BDD methodologies is a plus
  • Strong coding and analytical problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience writing and debugging unit tests
  • Good understanding of test design patterns and the ability to apply them pragmatically when appropriate
  • Practical experience leveraging AI within quality engineering, including AI-assisted test generation, prompt engineering, and evaluation of AI/LLM outputs, combined with an awareness of data governance and safety considerations
  • Experience designing and building test automation frameworks and architectures from the ground up
  • A proactive, self-motivated professional who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team

 

EXPERIENCE:

The ideal candidate should have a background in software engineering and is seasoned in software quality best practices.  Additionally, the candidate should have: 

  • 5+ years of designing and working with test automation frameworks and developing automated test scripts (web, mobile & OTT) specifically object-oriented frameworks 

  • 5+ years working and testing with various online research and analytics tools 

  • 3+ years working with and leading offshore resources 

  • Demonstrated experience designing (not only maintaining) a test automation framework from scratch, including architecture and technology choices 

  • Experience with online streaming video experiences (web, mobile & emerging technologies) a plus 

 

 

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related discipline. The combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.

 

Does it sound like you? Apply now and become part of our team!

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: €55,000–€65,000

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to Italy. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. The benefits available for this position include lunch vouchers; Cancer Prevention Centres ("Centri Prevenzioni LILT");  Parents Package ("Pacchetto Genitori"); Employee Discount Program; Tax Assistance; Business Travel Accident Insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); Well-being programmes, and applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement benefits.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.  

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity available for an up-and-coming lawyer who is excited by the appeal of gaining broad media law experience in a role that will allow you to develop skills in both commercial and clearance & litigation matters.  

 

We’re looking for a collaborative and friendly team player who is eager to learn and is flexible to adapt in the fast pace and changing needs of a dynamic media business.  

 

Enough about us! What you’ll do as a Legal Counsel:  

  

This role has dual functions, comprising both the commercial function for the negotiation, preparation, review and finalisation of agreements relating to the development, production and acquisition of media content, as well as a clearance & litigation function for the clearance of content for broadcast against the various laws and regulations applying to Australian media.  

   

Functions will include:  

  • Assisting with drafting, negotiating and reviewing principal contracts including program acquisition, production and licence, development, format, distribution, funding, ancillary, talent and other production and intellectual property licences and agreements.  
  • Assuming direct responsibility for drafting and negotiating foundational agreements such as non-disclosure agreements, standard program licences, location agreements/filming permits for productions/promos, waivers, talent/participant releases, photography releases, program partnership/sponsorship agreements, event sponsorship agreements, footage licences  
  • Advising on intellectual property matters  
  • Providing general commercial legal advice, such as interpreting contracts  
  • Clearance of 10 News, social posts and general news legal clearance  
  • Clearance of non-news programs including Have You Been Paying Attention?, Gogglebox, Cheap Seats and Sam Pang.  
  • Assisting with the preparation of Cease-and-Desist letters  
  • Advertising and commercial integration clearance, including betting and gambling legislation  
  • Assisting senior lawyers with litigation and dispute resolution  
  • Assisting in preparing Legal training materials and updating Legal team internal guidance notes  

 

What are we looking for in a Legal Counsel? What’s important?     

  • A qualified lawyer holding, or eligible to hold, a practising certificate in NSW or Victoria  
  • 2-4 years of relevant post qualification experience in a top tier law firm or highly regarded in-house legal team  
  • Enthusiasm, passion and the willingness to learn and develop new skills and expertise  
  • Experience advising on media and/or intellectual property issues, and/or a good result in relevant university subject(s) in this area  
  • Commercial aptitude, including the ability to advise within the framework of Ten’s business objectives and risk profile  
  • Deep technical proficiency in contract and intellectual property laws  
  • An interest in content production and the media industry  
  • Exceptional attention to detail  
  • Excellent and effective interpersonal, written and communication skills, including an ability to adapt to and communicate with all types of people internally and externally  
  • Ability to work collaboratively and effectively as a team member  
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to perform a variety of tasks  

 

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.  

 

We’re honoured to have been named on Diversity Council Australia’s annual list of Inclusive Employers in 2023-24 and 2024-25. This acknowledgement highlights our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and supported. 

 

Paramount acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as Australia's original storytellers and the first peoples of the lands where we create, broadcast and connect. We pay our respects to their timeless stories that continue to shape Country and culture.

job.title: Manager, Account Management
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

The CBS Stations' Local Ad Sales team is responsible for driving all local revenue growth across all Paramount Global streaming & digital assets, as well as the 27 owned & operated CBS Television Stations. This team collaborates across Paramount Global and CBS Stations divisions, providing thought leadership that drives the local sales GTM strategy, innovation opportunities, training & development, and revenue generation.


Position Overview:


We are looking for exceptional candidates for the Manager, Account Management role, who will train and develop Account Managers to drive client and campaign excellence across our portfolio of digital & streaming assets, inclusive of Paramount+, CBS, Pluto TV, and more. The candidate will also work closely and collaborate with sales teams, clients, and internal Paramount teams.


Role Details:

 

The Manager, Account Management sits between individual-contributor account management and regional sales leadership, providing the day-to-day client and campaign management, coaching, and quality control that the Account Manager team needs to deliver sales performance. While the Account Managers roll up into their Directors, the Manager, Account Management works in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) and Local Sales Management to translate revenue goals and priorities into clear direction for the team.

 

The Manager, Account Management, will work directly with Account Managers on account sales strategy, campaign specifics, and client escalations. This role is also the primary point of contact for the internal teams that power local sales delivery -- including Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, and Ad Systems -- building and maintaining the workflows the Local team relies on to execute successfully. The ideal candidate is a proactive, organized communicator who is energized by developing people, driving excellence, and building a strong culture.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Directly develop the Account Manager team, including workload distribution, coaching, and sales performance feedback
  • Work in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) to lead the Account Manager team through the full sales cycle for all clients
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, Ad Systems, and other internal teams to deliver the best-in-class client experience
  • Partner with Directors and Sales Leadership to ensure Account Managers have the tools, training, and support needed to execute digital & streaming campaigns and become a future account executive
  • Identify workflow gaps between Local Sales and internal partner teams, and drive process improvements that drive revenue growth
  • Report team & client performance, and development progress to the Regional Digital Sales Director

 

Qualifications:
What you bring to the team:

 

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in advertising/media account management, sales or sales support, with digital, streaming and/or linear experience preferred
  • Prior experience mentoring, training, or informally leading other account management or sales staff
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams (e.g. Ad Operations, Yield, Data, Marketing, Research) to solve workflow and process challenges on behalf of the sales team
  • Excels in communication, organizational and time management
  • Team-first mentality
  • Dedicated and driven work ethic

 

You might also have:

  • BS / BA degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • Understanding of the following applications is a plus: Salesforce, Operative, GAM, Google Analytics, FreeWheel, WideOrbit, Google Suite or other web related applications


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. The Paramount Skydance Corporate Development Group is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, executing, and integrating/separating the company’s strategic acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and joint ventures. The Manager role will work with team members and senior leadership throughout the Paramount Skydance business units to assess and execute external transaction opportunities and internal business-building opportunities. The Group has a process that governs the organization’s M&A activities. Within that framework, the individual is expected to work and make decisions with some level of independence. For unresolved issues, the individual is expected to recommend a course of action for discussion. The individual will have the opportunity to develop close working relationships with key leaders at and beyond Paramount Skydance, and as such will need to exercise good judgment and quick thinking.

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring

  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations

  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations

  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards

  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities
  • Assess audit and operational risks, design effective analytics procedures, identify control gaps, and manage multiple engagements in a dynamic environment
  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline

  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Media Coordinator
Location: New York, NY (1515 Broadway)
Reports To: Director, Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Operations
Supports: U.S. and global production workflows

Overview
Paramount: A Skydance Corporation is seeking a Media Coordinator to join the Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Management & Archives team within Production Technology and Operations. This role is responsible for executing media management workflows supporting high-volume, multi-brand production environments across Paramount's global ecosystem. Based in New York, this position partners closely with production, editorial, and technology teams to ensure media is proficiently ingested, organized, transferred, prepared, and archived across both on-premises and cloud-based environments as well as live streaming production systems.


Responsibilities
•    Coordinate with teams across multiple productions and facilities
•    Enforce standards for media ingest, organization, directory structures, and workflows
•    Oversee media preparation for editorial, including syncing, grouping, and proxy/mezzanine creation
•    Manage media transfers across internal and external environments using approved enterprise tools
•    Partner with production teams to plan workflows, storage strategies, and delivery requirements
•    Drive adoption of AI-powered metadata workflows to improve search, discoverability, and automation
•    Support live and near-live production workflows including streaming ingest and rapid-turn deliverables
•    Oversee review and approval workflows and ensure efficient collaboration across teams
•    Provide guidance and escalation support for technical issues impacting media workflows
•    Collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize performance and scalability
•    Support on-site productions and events, including setup of DIT environments, live stream implementation, and field workflows


Qualifications
•    2-5 years of experience in media management, post-production operations, live stream tech, or related roles
•    Strong communication skills in dynamic production environments
•    Expertise in editorial workflows and media formats/codecs
•    Experience with Avid, Adobe Premiere, and/or other professional editing platforms
•    Familiarity with cloud storage platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI) and file transfer systems (Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera)
•    Experience with MAM/DAM systems and digital archive workflows
•    Working knowledge of AI-driven metadata tools and workflow automation
•    Ability to manage multiple productions and priorities simultaneously
•    Willingness to travel and support on-site production workflows as needed and to cover off-hours needs

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $42,400.00 - 63,600.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

WBZ-TV is looking for a dynamic, experienced, full-time meteorologist to join our NEXT Weather team.

 

Responsibilities:
•    Create daily forecasts in alignment with the NEXT Weather brand
•    Produce clean, creative graphics
•    Contribute to severe weather coverage from the studio or reporting in the field
•    Report on climate change and the impact across the Boston area
•    Boldly present weather changes with the NEXT Weather team across WBZ-TV, CBSBoston.com and CBS News Boston
•    Analyze, produce, and deliver accurate forecasts utilizing all tools and computer software
•    Own breaking weather coverage moments by delivering vital information that helps families plan, prepare and stay safe
•    Zero in on what matters most to our community and audience by targeting impacts and lifestyle weather
•    Demonstrate the ability to talk about what you know as well as what you don’t know about upcoming weather scenarios
•    Embrace the great outdoors by tracking weather outside in the elements LIVE as comfortably as the green screen
•    Originate, research, investigate, write, narrate, produce, and report stories for newscasts
•    Be flexible to jumping into action whenever severe weather happens, knowing the weather team is stronger when it works together 
•    Be the master communicator that helps to keep the weather team on the same page as well as helps managers plan for big content opportunities
•    Collaborate with all parts of the station, including news, promotion, production, community affairs, engineering, and IT
•    Participate in Community Events, visit local schools

 

Requirements:
•    Must be a certified AMS meteorologist
•    Must be skilled with telling a comprehensive and clear weather story
•    Must be skilled at posting weather-related information on social media channels
•    Must have a valid driver’s license
•    Must have 5+ years of related experience

 

Preferred skills:
•    Ability to shoot, write and edit reports
•    Experience presenting news in addition to forecasting

•    Knowledge of the New England area

 

 

This will be a union-represented position.

OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Other duties include producing weather content, working with a team of meteorologists, including the Chief Meteorologist, and implementing station strategy. Writing/preparing forecasts; producing graphics to tell the weather story across multiple platforms, strong social media presence. The candidate will also be required to periodically write and report weather-related content for newscasts. We want good communicators who are team-focused.

•    On-air weather casting experience within a TV Station
•    A degree in meteorology or related science
•    Strong writing skills for broadcast and digital platforms
•    Ideal candidate needs to have strong social media skills
•    Ability to use augmented reality in weather segments is a bonus
•    Ability to provide continuous live severe weather coverage across all programs
•    Write daily weather blog and post weather content on social media platforms.
•    Passionate about being a brand ambassador for CBS Sacramento and the communities we serve

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:  
•    B.S. Degree or equivalent experience in Meteorology or Earth Sciences preferred
•    Proficient in weather graphics production
•    Knowledge of weather patterns and microclimates across Northern California and the Western U.S.
•    Ability to live field report and write packages
•    Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record in order to operate a company vehicle

CBS Colorado is seeking a talented and driven Reporter to join our Mountain Bureau. If your passion is serving your community through great journalism, then we are the newsroom for you. The ideal candidate has a passion for storytelling, thrives in dynamic environments, and can operate independently in the field - often in challenging weather conditions.
Enjoy the beauty and lifestyle of Summit County while doing impactful journalism in the community. 

 

Key Responsibilities
-    Shoot, write and edit packages for daily newscasts
-    Strong live shot skills a must
-    Generate story ideas and participate in editorial meetings/Produce content for social media and streaming service.
-    Report scripted and unscripted, with clarity, accuracy, and confidence/cover breaking news with a sense of urgency
-    Conduct compelling in person interviews 
-    Collaborate effectively with a wide range of personnel to create compelling content/ Develop and execute enterprise content on a consistent basis
-    Maintain a steadfast commitment to accuracy and fairness
-    Write clearly and interestingly and use video and graphics to illustrate facts and ideas 
-    Appear at public and station events, as required/Establish and maintain relationships/sources in the community

 

Qualifications & Requirements
-    Three years' experience on air 
-    College Degree required or equivalent experience
-    Must be able to work independently with a high degree of accuracy and have the ability to solve problems quickly
-    Must have a very strong social media skills and able to contribute on all platforms
-    Demonstrated experience as a professional journalist with strong technical and storytelling skills
-    Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
-    Strong communication and collaboration skills
-    Must be able to work a flexible schedule including early mornings, holidays & ON CALL shifts
-    Residency and or relocation to Summit County required

job.description:

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.    

 

 

 

 

We now have a leave-cover contract role available for a National Digital Sales Partner to work closely with our Sales team to deliver revenue growth by providing expert knowledge of the digital media landscape, focusing on Paramount’s digital ecosystem and the ongoing transformation and capability uplift of the Sales team.    

  

Key responsibilities of the role include:    

  • Oversight of national digital revenue targets across 10 Streaming, Paramount+, and premium video distribution channels 
  • Reporting to the National Digital Sales Director and collaborating closely with GM Ad Sales, Sales Directors and Group Client Partners, on high-level pitches, client negotiations, and senior agency engagements to increase investment and market share.  
  • Driving digital capabilities across the national Sales team through training on digital trading, premium video positioning, commercial frameworks, digital storytelling, and proposal excellence. 
  • Strengthen consistency, standards, and sales team effectiveness through operating rhythms, best practice digital workflows and maintaining forecasting discipline 
  • Revenue initiatives and commercial packaging, partnering with Commercial Strategy and Digital Revenue teams to build scalable trading packages to drive growth across streaming. 
  • Managing client relationships including Digital Agency leads and other stakeholders 
  • Partnering with Paramount Brand Studios and Sport Sales in developing digital sponsorship packages 

 

What are we looking for in a National Digital Sales Partner? What’s important?   

  • 10+ years of experience in media and digital advertising with strong experience in video and CTV 
  • Proven success driving revenue a an ‘individual contributor’ in senior media roles 
  • Customer focused and commercially minded approach to meeting client expectations and business objectives 
  • Highly analytical with the ability and judgement to translate data and market signals in a dynamic, fast-paced environment 
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, able to influence decision makers and turn a strategic narrative into a compelling sales proposition 
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills: strong leadership, building trust with internal and external stakeholders, collaborating with cross-functional teams across the business

PHOTOJOURNALIST/EDITOR FOR KPIX TV

 

Description of duties:

  • Photographer/Editor duties include the shooting and editing of News stories.
  • The Photographer/Editor is expected to have a comprehensive knowledge of contemporary lighting techniques and fully understand the use of professional audio equipment commonly used in ENG work.
  • Being a full member of the Agile team, you will take part in all regular meetings and planning. You will work both independently and together with the other partners on assigned tasks and projects that will fit your skills and abilities. On the video operations team, you will monitor on-demand and live-streaming assets, and prioritize any issues.
  • Must be acquainted with Frontline vans and ENG vans.
  • Candidates must have a solid grasp of local and wide area computer networks, their components and be able to resolve issues quickly. Availability for supporting our 24x7 operation.
  • Additionally, the Photojournalist/Editor must be able to monitor/perform basic vehicle maintenance.
  • A positive approach to problem-solving will be necessary for success.
  • Candidate must be willing to work a flexible work schedule that may include early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Must be able to edit a 2-minute news package in 30 minutes or less.
  • Photographer/Editor must be a self-starter and willing to generate content on all CBS platforms using all equipment at your disposal.
  • Must have excellent verbal communication skills and documentation skills to maintain workflows and dashboard functionality.
  • The ability to produce Nat packages is a plus.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • B.A. degree or equivalent experience in a related field is preferred.
  • Three to five years of Photography/Editing experience in a major market is required
  • An Extensive knowledge of the Bay Area is preferred.
  • At least 5 years in Live TV or a Live Streaming role, with an emphasis on live sporting events.
  • Knowledge of nonlinear editing techniques, cloud-based Media Asset Management systems, audio mixing, general knowledge of legacy formats, animated graphics, etc.
  • Satellite uplink truck experiences are a plus.
  • Must maintain a Valid Dirver's License in good standing.

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Photographer/Editor will work in a variety of environmental conditions including, but not limited to intense noise, utmost temperature, weather, fumes/odors, dust, chemicals, smoke, and extreme heights.

  • May be required to wear a bulletproof vest.
  • Ability to lift 35 pounds of computer equipment, carry, and set-up is required
  • Must be able to multi-task under pressure, lead a varied, high-volume workload efficiently and smoothly, and operate autonomously within corporate parameters.
  • Must be able to work overnight and day shifts.
  • A passion for industry-leading Entertainment, News, and Sports content.

KDKA-TV is seeking a strong, adaptable News Producer to lead daily newscasts in one of the country’s most established and respected local newsrooms. This role is responsible for editorial leadership, content execution, and real-time decision-making across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms.

 

The ideal candidate understands the responsibility that comes with producing for a CBS O&O station, has solid news judgment, and is ready to grow with the evolving demands of modern local news.

 


Core Responsibilities

Newscast Leadership & Editorial Judgment

· Produce daily KDKA newscasts by determining story selection, order, pacing, and tone

· Make clear, confident editorial decisions that reflect KDKA’s standards of accuracy, balance, and transparency

· Respond quickly and responsibly to breaking news, severe weather, and major local events

· Ensure all content meets legal, ethical, and CBS News & Stations editorial standards

 

Writing & Storytelling

· Write and edit clear, compelling copy for anchors, teases, and live situations

· Edit scripts for accuracy, flow, and conversational delivery

· Work closely with reporters and photographers to sharpen story focus and visuals

· Maintain consistency in writing style across newscasts and platforms

 

Live Show Execution

· Build and execute rundowns using newsroom systems

· Communicate decisively with directors, anchors, and control room staff during live broadcasts

· Manage live shots, timing changes, and last-minute adjustments with composure

· Lead the show through fast-moving and high-pressure situations

 

Editing, Streaming & Digital Integration

· Possess a working understanding of video editing workflows; editing experience preferred

· Collaborate effectively with editors and understand fundamentals of video storytelling

· Willingness to learn and support KDKA’s streaming and digital newscasts

· Adapt news content for streaming, mobile, and digital platforms when needed

· Contribute to a multi-platform news strategy that serves viewers on TV, OTT, and online

 

Collaboration & Newsroom Culture

· Work closely with the assignment desk, managing editors, reporters, and photojournalists

· Participate in daily editorial meetings and enterprise planning

· Contribute story ideas that reflect Pittsburgh and the communities KDKA serves

· Support extended coverage during breaking news and special events

 

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent professional experience

· Minimum 2–5 years of newsroom production experience (level dependent)

· Strong writing, editing, and organizational skills

· Proven ability to work under aggressive deadlines

· Excellent communication and leadership abilities

· Willingness to work flexible shifts, including early mornings, nights, weekends, holidays, and breaking news

 

Preferred Experience

· Producing experience in a large-market or CBS O&O newsroom

· Video editing experience or familiarity with non-linear editing systems

· Experience contributing to streaming or digital newscasts

· Strong understanding of local journalism and public-service reporting

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

Product Management, Merchandising (International)

 

Job Summary
Paramount+ is seeking a Product Manager, Merchandising (International) to own how audiences across international markets discover and engage with content on our streaming platform. This role is responsible for defining and spearheading the international merchandising strategy and execution model, ensuring content is positioned effectively across regions while scaling through data‑driven workflows and automation.

Operating at the intersection of Product, Programming, Applied Machine Learning, Marketing, Design, and Operations, this role translates global and regional content priorities into clear merchandising strategies, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating mechanisms. The Product Manager will balance global consistency with local relevance, ensuring international discovery experiences are intuitive, compliant, and optimized for engagement and retention.

Key Responsibilities
●    Define and drive the international on‑platform merchandising operations, including content positioning, prioritization, and lifecycle management across markets.
●    Establish consistent merchandising principles for international markets while enabling regional flexibility where audience needs or regulatory requirements differ.

●    Partner with Product and Engineering teams to inform platform capabilities, tooling improvements, and roadmap decisions that enable scalable merchandising execution.
●    Ensure merchandising workflows are designed to support global scale while minimizing manual intervention through automation and data-driven decision making.
●    Partner closely with Programming teams to align on content intent, timing, and regional considerations.

●    Champion experimentation across international markets, ensuring merchandising strategies are testable and supported by solid metadata, creative, and operational foundations.
●    Oversee monitoring and reporting to evaluate merchandising performance and surface insights that drive continuous optimization across markets.

 

Basic Qualifications
●    3+ years in product management, content merchandising, or content discovery for consumer facing digital products at scale.
●    Proven track record owning complex, cross‑functional initiatives in a global environment, with accountability for measurable outcomes. 

●    Bachelor’s degree required; technical or quantitative discipline preferred. 
●    Strong applied knowledge of data-driven methodologies, including behavioral analytics and segmentation, to inform merchandising decisions and drive subscriber level outcomes.
●    Experience defining content architecture and curation strategy across platforms, with working knowledge of how platform dependencies and metadata quality affect the consumer experience. 
●    Demonstrated ability to partner substantively with ML and engineering teams on personalization and recommendation systems, including evaluating outputs and defining constraints that reflect merchandising intent. 
●    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across product, technical, and creative teams.


Preferred Qualifications
●    Experience supporting international or regional discovery strategies for a global streaming or media platform.
●    Proficiency with analytics and data science tooling (such as Adobe Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Python, or SQL)
●    Working knowledge of how personalization and ranking systems are built, with experience contributing to the signals and inputs that shape content recommendations. 
●    Proven track record designing and interpreting experimentation programs, including A/B and multivariate testing, to drive merchandising optimization. 
●    Experience working across multiple time zones and cultural contexts.

job.title: Production Assistant (Project Based)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Entertainment Tonight is looking for a sharp, pop-culture-obsessed Production Assistant to join our news desk. This is an entry-level role built for someone who's ready to work hard, learn fast, and grow inside the #1 entertainment news brand in the world.  

Overview:

The core of this role is news desk support. Most days, that means building folders — ingesting footage, pulling assets, and organizing everything a producer needs to write a piece. But the best PAs bring editorial instincts to that work. If you're deep in a folder on a breaking story and you spot a vault clip that just became gold, we need you to recognize it and flag it. That awareness is what separates a good PA from a great one.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You'll be assigned to the ET news desk, where you'll be the link between raw footage and finished stories.
  • Media management — ingest shoot footage, log and label assets, and build organized folders that segment producers can write directly from
  • Transcription — turn celebrity interviews and field shoots into accurate, usable transcripts on deadline
  • Asset coordination — pull b-roll, photos, social clips, and archival material; track rights and credits
  • Producer support — research, fact checks, and content prep across broadcast, digital, and social
  • Rundown meeting prep — pull and assemble daily photo docs with pap and social images to support editorial planning
  • Field and studio assistance — crew support, errands, and on-the-ground help when shoots need an extra set of hands
  • Cross-department coverage — pitch in where the show needs you

 

Qualifications:

  • You live and breathe pop culture — you can name every famous face in a crowded shot
  • You're fast, accurate, and organized under pressure
  • You communicate clearly and work well with a team
  • You have sharp editorial instincts — you know the difference between a great sound bite and a throwaway line
  • Degree or internship in TV, film, or a related field is a plus, not a requirement
  • Must pass a short celebrity knowledge quiz

 

CBS Media Ventures is the preeminent company in television syndication. job.title: Production Coordinator
job.description:
We are MTVE International Creative, Paramount's award-winning in-house creative team working on the iconic MTV and Comedy Central brands. Our passionate, collaborative team creates bold, innovative work for audiences worldwide. As the international hub for these brands, we handle campaigns, promos, and branding for the UK, international regions, and global feeds.



Is this role for you?

You'll work closely with the Production Manager, bringing projects and productions to life for the creative team from initial concept through to completion, helping ensure budget, schedule, and creative requirements are met while delivering on creative excellence. Your work will range from booking voiceovers to supporting high-profile campaigns, so strong multi-tasking skills will serve you well. You'll also team up with the production management team on day-to-day tasks, helping keep the department running smoothly.


What you will be doing?

Finance:

  • You'll raise Purchase Order requisitions for music clearances, post-production sessions, agency fees, shoot production, and voiceovers.

  • You'll liaise with the creative team to maintain accurate budgets for each project.

  • You'll monitor daily spends by project using departmental purchasing systems and cost managers.

  • You'll set up new suppliers and help ensure correct invoicing guidelines and deadlines are met.

  • You'll follow company guidelines on production spend, expenses, and T&E.

  • You'll maintain and update records of production activity and spend, overseeing departmental filing and Excel records.

  • You'll work with accounts payable and payroll to help ensure timely payment to external suppliers, freelancers, and casual employees.

  • You'll support the Production Management team with cost management and reporting.

 

Legal:

  • You'll raise all contracts and make sure completed contracts are returned to legal.

  • You'll negotiate simple contract terms and fees for collaborating production companies, creative agencies, and freelancers.

  • You'll liaise with legal, HR, and finance on contracts, NDAs, vendor selection, capex, and payments, and help roll out new company policies effectively.

  • You'll update contract logs, contact files, and freelance contract files.

  • You'll make sure relevant legal paperwork is completed for all bookings and voiceovers.

Campaign Production:

  • You'll support the production management team with campaign production, including booking crew, freelancers, and organizing reviews.

  • You'll create call sheets for filming and get to know crew rates and overtime policies.

  • You'll engage freelancers and negotiate rates and payments.

  • You'll build knowledge of different freelancer/casual contract types and payment terms.

  • You'll advise on best practices to achieve creative excellence using the latest technologies and equipment.

  • You'll support Risk Assessment forms and Health and Safety procedures.

Department:

  • You'll help the Production Manager organize the creative team's daily diaries and production workflow.

  • You'll help ensure all projects are produced cost- and time-effectively while staying true to creative ideals.

  • You'll flag any project overages to the Production Manager.

  • You'll plan and book external post sessions, including daily audio bookings.

  • You'll liaise daily with Voice Over artist agencies to book relevant talent and ensure clearances.

  • You'll maintain departmental edit schedules and calendars.

  • You'll monitor and help ensure all promos and designs are delivered as requested.

 

What are we looking for?

Administrative and Organizational Skills:

  • Strong administration and organizational abilities.

  • Experience in shoot preparation and admin tasks.

  • Ability to build project schedules and maintain departmental edit schedules.

Financial Management:

  • Ability to budget and forecast accurately.

  • Experience keeping accurate budgetary records, reconciling budgets, and using purchasing systems.

  • Knowledge of different freelancer/casual contract types and payment terms.

 

Legal and Compliance:

  • Knowledge of Risk Assessment forms and Health and Safety procedures.

  • Experience raising contracts and ensuring legal compliance.

Communication and Interpersonal Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfortable working as part of a team, helping the department reach its goals.

  • A personable manner, able to communicate effectively with people at every level, from crew to talent.

  • A second native or fluent language alongside English is a bonus.

 

Adaptability and Problem-Solving:

  • Energetic, enthusiastic, adaptable, resourceful, and solution-focused.

  • Experience working in a high-turnover, short-form creative department.



 

 

MTV is the leading global youth media brand in 180 countries,  reaching 450 million households in nearly 30 different languages across every platform. MTV is the world's premier youth entertainment brand,  the cultural home of the millennial generation and a pioneer in creating innovative programming for young people. MTV reflects pop culture with award-winning content built around compelling storytelling,  music discovery and activism across TV,  the internet and other platforms. A unit of Paramount Global,  MTV operations span cable and mobile networks,  live events,  theatrical films and MTV Studios.

What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.    

 

 

 

 

We now have a permanent full-time role available in Sydney for an experienced Programmatic Operations Executive, working closely with our Ad Sales team and utilizing your deep understanding of programmatic revenue generation and data-based audience solutions. This role is responsible for driving Programmatic monetization of CTV video inventory across the AU market. 

   

Functions will include:    

  • Aid in the direction of open exchange, private exchange & Programmatic Guaranteed / Automated Guaranteed commercial strategy for video, display and mobile inventory.  
  • Identify, prioritise and translate key Programmatic business requirements into operational projects with the goal of increasing revenue, improving efficiency, reducing risk and improving inventory performance across multiple platforms.  
  • Cultivate an extensive understanding of Network 10 brands, products & commercial intelligence systems in order to provide the best sales solution to Programmatic buyers and their clients.  
  • Focused development of all Trading Desk / DSP/ client relationships to optimise revenue across all brands within the 10 network.  
  • Organisation & integration of all Programmatic platform’s / monetisation partners across the AU market e.g. various SSPs / Exchanges

  • Delivery of education & training on the use of Programmatic platforms, data-based opportunities & Programmatic strategy to internal stakeholders.  
  • Display organisational and leadership capabilities to track progress, execution and consistency of trading desk sales programs.  
  • Meet and exceed Programmatic revenue targets, contributing to Paramount’s overall performance and revenue targets across the AU market, with a core focus on Sydney-based business.  

 

What are we looking for in a Programmatic Operations Executive? What’s important?     

  • A solid 4+ years of experience in digital media 
  • Strong understanding of the Programmatic advertising space, specifically ad exchanges, RTB and Programmatic trading

job.description:
Closing date: 2nd October 2026 

Are you a full-time student ready to put your accounting fundamentals to work? If you've got the basics down — reading a P&L, understanding a balance sheet, and knowing your way around debit and credit entries — and you're looking for real hands-on experience in a global media company, this internship is for you.

About the Role

Join our Record-to-Report (RTR) team and work on projects that directly support content acquisitions and financial operations for a global entertainment business. You'll apply what you've learned in the classroom to real transactions, real vendors, and real deadlines — with an experienced team backing you up.

Responsibilities

  • Support the accounting process for acquired films and series, from initial recognition through to retirement
  • Raise purchase orders to meet obligations under license agreements
  • Prepare and organize journal entries — putting your debit/credit knowledge into practice
  • Help maintain strong vendor relationships by managing Purchase Orders (POs)
  • Gain hands-on experience with SAP, spreadsheets, and reporting tools

Qualifications

  • Ongoing BSc/MSc studies in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals: you can read and explain a profit & loss statement and balance sheet, and understand double-entry bookkeeping (debits and credits)
  • Strong English communication skills, spoken and written (B1 or above)
  • Proficiency with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
  • SAP knowledge is a plus
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a sense of ownership over your work
  • Confidence communicating in a group setting

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Be part of a multicultural team in a dynamic, friendly workplace
  • Work independently, with support from experienced colleagues whenever you need it
  • Gain real-world experience and make a genuine contribution to our projects
