Overview:

CBS News is looking for a Senior Digital Producer. The ideal candidate is a skilled writer and content creator comfortable developing and editing videos for YouTube and other platforms, creating original, repeatable concepts, maintaining content calendars and drafting news alerts.   This is a creative, hands-on role for someone who can take an idea from concept to finished product—developing the story, writing the script, shooting/packaging the content and editing the final video. The ideal candidate can manage multiple projects and deadlines while also pivoting to respond to breaking news when needed. This position is covered by the WGA East and is onsite Monday through Friday 10 am - 6 pm ET.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Creates and publishes original videos – news-of-day videos, long-form thematic content, marathons, archive content and short-form slips, and other content as requested. 
  • Clips and publishes video segments, writes SEO-friendly and compelling headlines/descriptions, chooses and crops thumbnails.  
  • Ensures all necessary video content gets uploaded to CBSNews.com, YouTube and Paramount+ (& other partners) and follows guidelines by Rights & Clearance, Standards and Law; helps facilitate fixes, replacements and other changes as required. 
  • Publishes original video content, including thematic episodes and marathons, made for CBSNews.com and YouTube and maintains a content calendar with future ideas – ensures all original content is cleared by the show(s), Rights & Clearances and any other necessary parties.  
  • Maintains, curates and updates assigned CBS News brand YouTube channels. 
  • Requests and sets up YouTube live streams as needed, managing slates and OTT presence.
  • Coordinate with talent, correspondents and producers, etc. on booking, shooting and producing longform content that can be repurposed for YouTube (such as podcast shoots, on-set shoots, etc.).
  • Draft and send breaking news and segmented push alerts across platforms, including app, desktop, OTT, email, text and instant messages and for partner platforms. 
  • Helps coordinate detailed rollout plans across departments for specials, documentaries and other major news events, creating and executing a promotional plan (crafting push copy, prewriting articles and video heds/deks, etc.).  
  • Helps maintain a content calendar and contributes to planning meetings, working with the SEO team on coverage plans as needed.

job.title: Sr. Product Designer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

job.title: SVP, Finance Innovation
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

As a member of the Paramount+ Content Systems Product team, you will help shape the automation strategy for our tools and systems. These are the systems that power our global streaming experiences. What an exciting place to be! Your mission is to learn the manual, hands-on challenges of our partner teams. Then you build the right solutions to solve the right problems at the right time.

 

You will play a key role in keeping Paramount+ running efficiently. We are growing to millions of new subscribers around the world! This team cares about solving problems and improving workflows for the people we work with each day. Together, we build forward-looking tools that scale right along with our business.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Operational Excellence: Partner with Video and Content Operations to learn where the gaps are in our content supply chain. Then turn those needs into a clear automation plan we can act on.
  • Systems Mapping: Map how our content systems connect from end to end - data flows, handoffs, and dependencies. Then use that picture to find where and how to automate.
  • Process Automation: Guide the product development of our Content Systems. This includes rights, title, and media asset management. Your sharp focus: automate manual, high-touch workflows!
  • AI & Innovation: Find and roll out AI-driven solutions that help our operations teams work more effectively. Think automated metadata extraction, AI-assisted QC, and auto-created localized assets!
  • Technical Documentation: Share a clear vision for technical work. Write up scope, use cases, workflows, and sequence diagrams.
  • Agile Execution: Lead scrum team activities such as grooming, planning, and setting priorities. That way, our development teams always have what they need to succeed.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Bring partners in product, tech, and operations together on delivery scope. Then get set for exciting global launches!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Experience: 2-4 years in software product management. You know how to put business value first and weigh trade-offs.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map and visualize how complex, interconnected systems work together end-to-end - understanding not just individual tools but the relationships between them - in order to identify where and how to automate across the workflow.
  • Automation Mindset: A proven passion for building workflow tools. You want them to be a "joy to use" for internal teams!
  • Technical Depth: Deep comfort with complex technical workflow systems. Engineering experience or a background in AI/ML is a big plus.
  • Domain Knowledge: A strong interest in the streaming media world and the content supply chain.
  • Collaboration: You build caring, trusting relationships across teams. This helps product work run smoothly, even in a complex space.
  • Agile Expertise: Lots of hands-on Agile experience. You also have excellent communication skills.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview: 

Vice President, Office of the CFO, Analytics and Special Projects is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role within the Paramount Finance organization, serving as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the CFO. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, ensuring the CFO’s organization runs with discipline, clarity, and focus and also leading high-priority finance special projects.   The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen with exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills, equally comfortable leading a complex analytical workstream as running a leadership town hall. This person will act as a proxy and trusted extension of the CFO across the finance leadership team and key cross-functional partners, while also protecting the CFO’s time and ensuring the right priorities get the right attention.   This is designed to serve as a launch pad into a senior finance leadership role within the organization. The Vice President will gain direct exposure to enterprise-level strategy, financial operations, and executive decision-making, while building the relationships and credibility needed to step into a broader finance leadership position at the conclusion of the program.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Leadership & Special Projects
  • Lead and manage high-priority finance special projects on behalf of the CFO, including strategic initiatives, cross-functional analyses, and transformation efforts.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CFO on key business decisions, synthesizing complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Drive follow-through on strategic priorities across the finance leadership team, ensuring alignment and accountability against commitments.
  • Prepare board and executive-level briefing materials, presentations, and talking points for the CFO.
  • Support earnings, investor day, and board-related content development in partnership with Investor Relations and Corporate Finance.
Priority & Time Management
  • Serve as a gatekeeper and air-traffic controller for the CFO’s time, triaging incoming requests and ensuring the CFO’s bandwidth is focused on the highest-value priorities.
  • Exercise independent judgment on what does and does not require the CFO’s direct attention, resolving issues on his behalf where appropriate.
  • Anticipate needs and potential issues before they escalate, proactively coordinating with stakeholders to keep initiatives on track.
Organizational Leadership & Communications
  • Plan and execute finance organization town halls, all-hands meetings, and leadership offsites, including content development and logistics.
  • Own the CFO’s staff meeting cadence, setting agendas, leading follow-ups, and tracking action items to closure.
  • Serve as a central point of contact between the CFO’s office and the broader finance leadership team, as well as cross-functional partners.
  • Shape internal communications strategy for the finance organization, ensuring consistent and clear messaging.
  • Represent and speak on behalf of the CFO in select internal forums where his direct presence is not required.
Operating Rhythm & Team Effectiveness
  • Partner with the CFO’s direct reports to coordinate priorities, surface issues early, and remove roadblocks.
  • Manage the CFO’s key operating mechanisms (staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles) and maintain a scorecard of strategic priorities.
  • Partner with the CFO and Human Resources on finance organization design, headcount planning, and leadership succession considerations.
  • Work closely with Human Resources to help build and maintain a healthy team culture within the finance leadership organization.
  • Coordinate the finance organization’s initial response to urgent or sensitive issues (e.g., control matters, audit findings) in partnership with the relevant functional leaders.
  • Build relationships with Chiefs of Staff across the C-suite to keep the CFO’s agenda aligned with company-wide priorities.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10 -15 years of experience in finance, strategy, investment banking, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong foundation in financial analysis, corporate finance, or FP&A experience with financial planning processes preferred.
  • Prior chief of staff, strategy, or similar experience supporting a senior executive strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting board or investor-facing materials is a plus.
  • Strong technical fluency, including hands-on proficiency in SQL and familiarity with AI/automation tools and their application to finance workflows.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • High emotional intelligence and discretion; ability to build trust and exercise sound judgment across all levels of the organization.
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and representing the CFO’s perspective in his absence.

Overview and Responsibilities
This role leads Paramount Consumer Products' relationship with Amazon and the club channel. Amazon is North Americas most significant e-commerce and marketplace partner. The Vice President will create and implement a detailed strategy for the Paramount Products & Experiences business. This involves working with Amazon's Vendor Central, Seller Central, and the third-party marketplace ecosystem. As a key pillar in the overall market strategy, this role is integral to the success of the larger organization. Therefore, there is a premium on strategic thinking, direct and indirect team guidance, collaboration, and use of data to drive business growth with this key retail partner.

 

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Customer strategy & business planning - lead the team and play an active role in creating the strategic framework for the multi-year and annual business plans for Amazon.
  • Leverage and help improve the Joint Business Planning process to improve customer relationships, and to achieve/exceed revenue goals.
  • Outline strategies and actions to grow revenue by supporting licensees in developing meaningful presence and experiences for Paramount's brands on Amazon, working across the buying, marketing, and retail media functions to maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Data curiosity - hands on and data driven approach to account team guidance, with curiosity serving as the central tenet.
  • Track performance to understand drivers and detractors, using this information to inform guidance, guide the team's direction and drive solid retailer dialogues.
  • Lead the account's digital shelf strategy. This involves managing detail page content, optimizing search and discovery, creating A+ content, and ensuring catalog health. You will collaborate with licensees and internal content teams to improve conversion and increase search visibility.
  • Promotional & retail media investment - this role manages funding for promotional and retail media. You will work with Amazon to find the best ways to use these funds. This includes Amazon Advertising, Amazon DSP, and other retail media placements. The focus will be on increasing sales and improving the return on ad spend.
  • Relationship management and elevation - develop and maintain close collaboration with the buying, planning, and marketing teams.
  • Specifically, the strategic partnership with senior management within Amazon is a key responsibility.
  • Licensee relationships - collaborate with the sales teams of major licensees to ensure a fully integrated collaboration with Amazon.

  • P&L responsibility - establishing and managing budgets and forecasts for Amazon, maintaining annual and quarterly revenue and expense detail.
  • Work within a matrixed team representing Amazon on cross-functional senior teams.

  • Significant knowledge of the unique environment of warehouse clubs.
  • Bachelors degree; MBA preferred.
  • Extensive experience with Amazon's platforms such as Vendor Central and Seller Central.
  • Knowledge of retail media offerings and omni-channel partners.
  • Experienced people leader with a successful track record of working with executive team guidance, both external and internal.
  • Deep knowledge and proven success in creating and executing multi-million dollar integrated retail plans that include a broad range of vehicles including merchandising, POS materials, PR, promotions and events.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
     

Additional Qualifications

  • World class interpersonal skills including meeting facilitation/presentation, and solid verbal and writing skills.
  • Important strengths needed to succeed on a sales team: participation in guidance forums, negotiation skills, strategic thinking, analytical skills, decision-making, communication skills, teamwork and integrity.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, fulfillment models, including FBA and digital merchandising.

Overview: 

CBS News Streaming is seeking a New York-based WGA Line Producer to join our 24/7 news coverage team. This role is ideal for a collaborative, editorially driven producer who thrives in a fast-paced, live news environment. The successful candidate will have exemplary news judgment, well-developed organizational skills, and a passion for visual storytelling. They will play a key role in producing live coverage, making sound editorial decisions under deadline, and partnering with teams across the newsroom to deliver accurate, compelling content. This role is represented by the WGA East.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with the executive producer & supervising producer in a fast-paced, demanding environment, handling breaking news and news-of-day demands for a 24-hour digital news channel
  • Line produce editorial news content, shape show flow and stack elements in the rundown
  • Work from the control room to guide shows in and out of breaks and to navigate both live and recorded content, including helping to determine when it will run in future hours
  • Partner with assignment desk and booking team to request correspondents and live interview guests
  • Order informative graphics and utilize compelling video to create engaging news programs
  • Distribute assignments and direct a team of writers, associate producers and digital associates to build original content as well as edit and repurpose content from broadcast and other content partners
  • Write teases, headlines, opening package and readers for live programming, including story slugs and lower-third banners
  • Generate story ideas for future coverage
  • Assign and record swap content for automated software wheel
  • Monitor and take newsworthy live events to air in the control room
  • Communicate with anchors, correspondents and control room team ahead of and during live shows, exhibiting a calm and professional demeanor in high pressure situations
  • Serve as a mentor to junior writers
  • Coordinate with sales department to implement accurate ad loads in rundowns
  • May also perform the responsibilities of content producers, producers, and associates producers and digital associates, as needed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing and writing copy for a national broadcast, cable or streaming network, or equivalent local TV news experience in a major market Command of AP style and broadcast writing with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple assignments for regular programming as well as rolling breaking news coverage
  • Superior news judgment & critical thinking skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in journalism or related field
  • Fluency using ENPS is a must
  • Deep knowledge of news standards, rights and clearances and fact-checking practices
  • Must pass comprehensive CBS News Digital writing test
  • Must be available to work all shifts — early morning, dayside, nights, weekends and holidays — sometimes on short notice or as coverage, scheduling and news events warrant, as this is a 24-hour news organization
  • This position is based in New York and requires working in-person at the CBS Broadcast Center
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Well-developed communication skills and ability to train and advise associate producers, production assistants and junior staff in writing and editing broadcast copy
  • Deep knowledge of editorial production, including control room experience, with well-developed writing and copy-editing skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to work in dynamic environment, deal with intense deadlines and continually react to breaking news with factual programming and creative storytelling
  • Broad knowledge of top stories driving the news cycle, including political news, and a knack for identifying lesser-known angles that resonate with audiences

job.title: Championship Digital Product Manager
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Championship Digital Product Manager leads the development, execution, and optimization of digital fan experiences for PGA of America’s premier Championships, including the PGA Championship, KPMG Women’s PGA Championship, and Ryder Cup. This role oversees product updates, vendor partnerships, and live event support, ensuring digital platforms engage fans both onsite and around the world. The manager leads efforts in product testing, analytics, and gamification, continually enhancing the quality and impact of our digital offerings during Championship events.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

Lead the year-round planning, design, business requirements, and testing for PGA of America’s championship web and app experiences; be the primary internal advocate for product development updates.

Collaborate with the Director, Technical Product and Event Operations to set the annual roadmap, allocate development hours, and drive prioritization of new feature development.

Oversee vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and management, for key digital products, ensuring effective program oversight throughout each championship cycle.

Implement analytics tools and practices for effective reporting and impactful data-driven decision making surrounding digital products and platforms.

Regularly meet with revenue operations, partners and content teams, as well as other critical internal stakeholders, to align on short and long-term product priorities and to ensure that our digital products are consistently meeting organization-wide objectives.

Work with internal stakeholders to optimize product concepts and features so they will have impactful commercial value and properly showcase the world-class brands that the PGA of America partners with.

Serve as product owner for the championship CMS, coordinating enhancements, maintenance, best practices, stakeholder training, and vendor management.

Lead the end-to-end delivery, execution, and quality of digital products during event weeks, ensuring outstanding digital experiences for fans and partners.

Proactively explore, propose, and test innovative new products, features, and digital enhancements for PGA events.

Stay current with evolving sports digital product trends and foster collaborative relationships within PGA Digital and across the industry.

Elevate the digital presence of pga.com and Member-focused platforms/channels, especially during championships and via Member events.

Oversee and mentor seasonal interns, assigning impactful product-focused tasks and maximizing their development and contributions.

Maintain, elevate, and analyze user feedback and internal testing efforts to inform ongoing product improvements.

Lead digital product optimizations for key platforms (web, iOS, and Android) by analyzing opportunities and user data to drive improvements.

INCLUSION:

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 

SHARED VALUES: 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing. 

SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities. 

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Assist with department program budget management including budget tracking for specific vendors, and input into the budget system.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s Degree (B.S.) in Marketing, Business, Media, Communications, Sport Management, or related field or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Four years of experience in digital sports media, with a background working for an organization such as a league, team, governing body, collegiate athletic department, brand, manufacturer, sports media outlet, or content creator.

Proven expertise in managing digital platforms, including responsibilities in product management and ownership, vendor coordination, and content management.

Product management training (i.e. Scrum, CAPM or PMP certification) preferred.

Experience in the digital product lifecycle and golf preferred.

job.description:

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

  • Manage a multi-year sales timeline, sequencing outreach and conversion milestones to maximize early commitment and revenue certainty.
  • Package multi-event opportunities and develop brand-specific narratives that drive commercial interest and position the Premium Experiences Program as a cornerstone of partner marketing strategies.
  • Maintain detailed internal outreach trackers, pipeline reports, and sales roadmaps across the full Premium Experiences prospect universe.

Program Architecture and Financial Modeling

  • Work with the National Sales Director to coordinate with Ryder Cup Europe for the unified program in the US and Europe.  
  • Lead the operational execution, sales initiatives, and prospecting strategy for the Wanamaker Club Premium Experiences Program at the PGA Championship.

  • Develop the full Premium Experiences Program structure for 2029 and beyond, defining package tiers, guest capacities, pricing strategy, and exclusive entitlements from the ground up.
  • Build comprehensive pro-forma financial models for each tier: projecting revenue targets, cost structures, margin analysis, and ROI to present to senior executive leadership for approval and budget allocation.
  • Create detailed investment frameworks and event budgets encompassing transportation, accommodations, dining, gifting, venue production, staffing, and ancillary costs. 
  • Apply forward-looking financial discipline to maximize luxury standards while optimizing cost efficiency.
  • Benchmark against competitive global luxury programs to position the PGA Premium Experiences Program as the premier offering in sports hospitality.

Package Design and Tiered Experience Development

  • Develop and define Premium Experiences package tiers, from founding ultra-premium offerings to aspirational entry-level experiences. 
  • Develop strategic proposals, creative decks, and investment frameworks tailored to each tier, creating customized experiences. 
  • Curate bespoke, money-can't-buy elements for each tier. 
  • Source, negotiate, and contract hospitality vendors, including luxury hotels, Michelin-caliber restaurants, private aviation providers, transportation companies, and event production specialists.
  • Manage hotel room blocks, accommodation allocations, and booking logistics for the full Premium Experiences guest cohort.
  • Oversee dining reservations to include private dinner programming and curated culinary experiences aligned with each package tier.

Client Lifecycle and Experience Management

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all Premium Experiences guests across contracting, payment collection, communications, pre-event planning, and on-site experience delivery.
  • Design and manage all guest communications: welcome experiences, pre-event briefings, custom itineraries, and post-event follow-up.
  • Coordinate credentialing, access management, and arrival logistics for the full Premium Experiences cohort.
  • Deliver personalized, concierge-level service throughout the guest journey — ensuring every detail anticipates and exceeds expectations befitting the most exclusive offering in PGA history.

Operational Execution and Logistics

  • Direct full-scale logistical execution across all Premium Experiences touchpoints to include private transportation, credential distribution, exclusive venue environments, dining and gifting. 
  • Oversee on-site operations during Ryder Cup week, personally managing the guest experience from arrival to departure.
  • Develop and maintain detailed program trackers covering guest data, accommodations, transportation manifests, dining bookings, gifting inventory, and event schedules.
  • Attending and hosting key events such as dinners and receptions to promote the program.

Team Leadership

  • Recruit, hire, train, and manage a dedicated Premium Experiences hospitality staff team for on-site execution.
  • Build team operating protocols and service standards that reflect the prestige and exclusivity of the program.
  • Lead briefings, pre-event rehearsals, and on-site team management to ensure seamless, consistent delivery.

job.title: Audio and Operations Specialist
job.description:
About the Position:

The duties of the Audio and Operations Specialist span a wide cross-section of small station life, including operations, programming, audio production, traffic, and community outreach. This position is responsible for recording and producing audio at live events, managing live broadcasts, and capturing field sounds in addition to working in the station’s studios. In addition to production duties, the Audio and Operations Specialist is one of two people responsible for managing traffic and automation logs, troubleshooting off-air problems, and providing audio technical support for staff.

About You:

We seek a sharp, hard-working, team-oriented person who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep technical infrastructure at the station running smoothly and our audio sounding great. You have a great ear for audio and are dedicated to helping others make their audio recordings and productions sound their best. You like to record, produce, and broadcast community voices and sounds. You are an excellent communicator with strong active listening skills. You enjoy collaboration and have experience working with others to support their audio recording and production. You have a high standard of service that you provide to others, and see public radio as an essential community service.

Primary Duties:

  • Manage the production of audio for station promos, daily program promos, fundraising spots and testimonials, station imaging campaigns, and legal IDs
  • Assist with traffic management by scheduling spots and publishing daily traffic/automation logs
  • Assist with operations by managing Zetta automation system and troubleshooting automation and off-air problems
  • Voice station promos, IDs, and underwriting spots
  • Troubleshoot studio problems, including studio consoles, microphones, audio and automation workstations, IP codecs, and phone devices
  • Field recording for special audio projects, including our Sonic ID Initiative
  • Record lectures and events held around the valley by Aspen Public Radio and partner organizations, and post-produce event audio for broadcast and website
  • Serve as a live sound engineer for Aspen Public Radio events as needed, including interview, panel discussion, and town hall-style events
  • Coordinate and engineer live broadcasts, including sound engineering of the live feed using IP codec and support of the live hosting of these events back in the studio
  • Record and produce station membership and marketing promos scripted and voiced by non-technical staff
  • Other job duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience with audio equipment, including studio consoles, mixers, and microphones
  • Experience with audio production, preferably Adobe Audition
  • Able to work non-standard hours for live events, field recording, and to be on-call for broadcast emergencies
  • Ability to stay calm, think clearly, act strategically, and prioritize tasks during live events, when on broadcast deadlines, and during off-air emergencies
  • Experience supporting others in audio production or training others in audio production or other broadcast skills
  • Must have adequate hearing to make audio quality determinations, adequate vision to read user-access panels on broadcast electronic components, and physical mobility and dexterity to access electronic devices and wiring in studios, server racks, and in sound booths at event sites
  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 pounds
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or high school diploma and significant radio technical support and audio production experience

Additional Desired Skills and Attributes:

  • Previous public radio experience
  • Understanding of public radio programming and the sound of public radio
  • Familiarity with radio automation systems and other audio/broadcast software
  • Experience with live sound engineering
  • Experience scripting and producing public radio station interstitial audio, including promos and imaging spots
  • Knowledge of sources and best practices for legally obtaining music for public radio broadcast production
  • Experience voicing scripts for audio production

How To Apply:

Please send a cover letter, resume, three references, and examples of audio you have produced to jobs@aspenpublicradio.org with “Audio and Operations Specialist” in the subject line. For the audio samples you submit, please explain in your cover letter what they are and how they illustrate your skills and experience.

Application review begins Wednesday, October 7. The position will remain open until filled. No phone calls, please. This is a full-time salaried position that reports to the Operations Manager and requires availability for day, evening, weekend, and holiday shifts.

Aspen Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer. This employee must be a year-round resident in the Roaring Fork or Colorado River Valleys within the station’s broadcast footprint. Aspen Public Radio offers full-time staff benefits, including 100% employer-paid health insurance, paid vacation, and a 403(b) match. Ski pass financing and rapid transit bus pass financing are available. Salary is $61,000-$67,000, with relocation expenses available.

job.title: Career-track clinical or teaching professor (digital reporting and editing)
job.description:
Career-track clinical or teaching professor (digital reporting and editing)

Description

The Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication at Arizona State University seeks an experienced and innovative professional to teach and lead a team of advanced undergraduate and graduate students in reporting, writing, editing and publishing digital content for Cronkite News—the school's student-staffed, faculty-led news outlet—and in related Cronkite courses.

This role combines editorial leadership, mentorship and teaching, ensuring students develop professional-level skills in digital journalism while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, fairness and thoroughness. Success in this role is measured by the success of students and their ability to synthesize skills and knowledge from earlier courses inside a working newsroom environment.

The successful candidate will be a journalist of the highest caliber with strong digital news experience, a creative thinker who is comfortable in a highly energized news environment, and a student-first instructor inspired by the future of news. The candidate demonstrates a commitment to accuracy, fairness and collaboration; possesses the skills to inspire, support and instruct a team of student journalists; and delivers clear direction and feedback.

As a member of the faculty, the professor will have teaching and service responsibilities with the Cronkite School. In this role, there are no research or creative activity responsibilities. Teaching assignments are made on a semester-to-semester basis. Assignments may include a combination of editing within the Cronkite News capstone course and other media courses.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, 9-month (academic year) appointment on ASU's Downtown Phoenix campus. It is not a tenure-track appointment. The professor will hold the rank of assistant, associate or full clinical professor, or assistant, associate or full teaching professor.

Essential Responsibilities

● Leading, editing, teaching and mentoring a team of upper-level undergraduate and graduate journalism students in a full-time, daily news environment (typical hours are approximately 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Thursday)
● Teaching lower-, upper- and graduate-division courses in media skills
● Coaching students through the ideation and reporting of compelling, meaningful stories, cultivating beats and sources, and executing day-turn and enterprise stories
● Managing daily story assignments together with fellow Cronkite News faculty, and collaboratively planning, managing and producing innovative and professional news content
● Editing written student work and related multimedia elements for publication on the Cronkite News website, social media channels, as well as for distribution to more than 150 clients across the country
● Fostering a culture of innovation by harnessing fresh ideas and experimenting with new tools, technologies and techniques that enhance digital and social media storytelling in ethical and responsible ways.
● Leading experimentation with AI tools in reporting and/or storytelling
● Collaborating with other newsroom faculty, students and staff
● Performing service both internally (e.g., committee assignments, student recruitment) and externally (e.g. professional workshops, contest judging)
● Performing other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications:

• Candidates pursuing a clinical professor rank must have a master's degree at the time of appointment, and at least 7 years professional experience in journalism, or equivalent specialized experience.
• Candidates pursuing a teaching professor rank must have a terminal degree at the time of appointment, and at least 7 years professional/teaching experience in journalism or equivalent specialized experience.

Desired Qualifications

● Experience leading, managing and editing a team of journalists, particularly early-career journalists
● Mastery of AP Style
● Measurable success in engaging audiences around news content, including through digital and social media storytelling
● Experience developing a news beat
● Experience developing and producing deeply reported enterprise journalism
● Ability to create audio, photo, graphics, interactives, video and/or broadcast storytelling to complement written reporting
● Experience teaching journalism or related topics at the university level
● Demonstrated proficiency in new and emerging multimedia storytelling tools and platforms
● Ability to report and edit Spanish-language journalism
● Familiarity with communities and newsmakers in Arizona

About Cronkite News

https://cronkitenews.azpbs.org/ is a multi-platform daily news operation that produces daily and enterprise news coverage of critical issues on Arizona PBS and digital, audio and social platforms. The newsroom serves more than 1.8 million households with its nightly broadcast and Arizona and national audiences with its digital content, regularly published by more than 100 media outlets. Cronkite News also serves as an immersive and innovative learning laboratory for students, who create content under the guidance of award-winning, experienced professionals. Cronkite News is anchored inside a state-of-the-art newsroom located on ASU's Downtown Phoenix campus in the nation's 11th-largest media market, with additional bureaus in Washington, D.C., and Los Angeles.


About the Cronkite School

The Cronkite School is widely recognized as the nation's premier mass communication school, ranked No. 1 by the Broadcast Education Association for three consecutive years. Rooted in the time-honored values that characterize its namesake—accuracy, responsibility, integrity—the school fosters excellence and ethics among students as they master the professional skills required to succeed in the digital media world of today and tomorrow.

Based on ASU's Downtown Phoenix campus in the heart of the nation's fifth-largest city, the School is known for its hands-on, “teaching hospital” approach to learning led by a faculty composed of Pulitzer Prize-winning professional journalists, strategic communications leaders and world-class media scholars. More than 2,500 undergraduate, master's and doctoral students regularly lead the country in national competitions as they prepare for careers in journalism, PR, marketing, strategic media and related communication fields.

About Arizona State University

Arizona State University, ranked No. 1 “Most Innovative School” in the nation by U.S. News & World Report for 11 years in succession, has forged the model for a New American University. Repeatedly ranked No. 1, ASU has topped more than 30 lists in the last three years: No. 1 in the U.S. for global impact (Times Higher Education) and No. 1 in the U.S. for sustainable practices (Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education).

ASU is a comprehensive public research institution, measured not by whom it excludes, but by whom it includes and how they succeed; advancing research and discovery of public value; and assuming fundamental responsibility for the economic, social, cultural and overall health of the communities it serves. ASU operates on the principles that learning is a personal and original journey for each student; that they thrive on experience and that the process of discovery cannot be bound by traditional academic disciplines. Through innovation and a commitment to accessibility, ASU has drawn pioneering researchers to its faculty even as it expands opportunities for qualified students, attracting some of the highest-quality students from all 50 states and more than 130 nations


Application Instructions

Applicants will be asked to create or use an existing Interfolio Dossier to submit the following:

1. A cover letter stating qualifications
2. Curriculum vitae or resume
3. Contact information (name, address, email, telephone number) for three professional references

Successful candidates will demonstrate throughout their materials how their teaching, research, and service will contribute to the fulfillment of the https://newamericanuniversity.asu.edu/about/asu-charter-mission-and-goals.

The applicant's name should appear in each uploaded file name. Cover letters may be addressed to the Search Committee Chair, Assistant Dean Melanie Asp Alvarez. Questions about the position should be directed to the search committee chair at mailto:melanie.alvarez@asu.edu


Application deadline is October 17, 2026. Applications will continue to be accepted on a rolling basis for a reserve pool. Applications in the reserve pool may then be reviewed in the order in which they were received until the position is filled.

Apply here: https://apptrkr.com/9839695


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. A background check is required for employment. Arizona State University is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor and an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

job.title: Creative Content Producer
job.description:
ONSITE ON LOCATION - Clearwater, Florida

Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00AM - 6:00PM

This is a full-time, in-office position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.


PLEASE INCLUDE A PORTFOLIO OR DEMO REELSHOWCASING YOUR PREVIOUS WORK WITH YOUR APPLICATION.


Valor Real Estate Development is a boutique luxury developer creating community-transforming real estate icons in emerging cities. Our portfolio is anchored by prestigious brand partnerships, including Aston Martin and Roche Bobois, with additional luxury collaborations planned as our company continues to grow. 


We are looking for a Creative Content Producer to join our team. If you're the type of creative who naturally shifts from filming with a gimbal, to editing in Premiere Pro, to designing in InDesign, to brainstorming the next social campaign, you'll fit right in. Industry professionals sometimes call this a "Preditor" meaning a producer, videographer, photographer, and editor wrapped into one versatile creative professional.


You'll work directly alongside our Deputy Marketing & Promotion Manager and collaborate with executive leadership on projects that define the public image of our company. From luxury property launches and exclusive events to cinematic marketing films and digital campaigns, your work will help shape how thousands of people experience the Valor brand.


If you're passionate about storytelling, obsessed with quality, embrace AI as a creative force multiplier, and want to build work you're genuinely proud to put your name on, we'd love to meet you.


Primary Responsibilities

As a Creative Content Producer, you'll help create the visual identity of Valor Real Estate Development across every stage of our marketing efforts. This is a production role requiring versatility, creativity, and a passion for producing work that reflects the quality of our luxury brand.


Video Production & Post-Production (Primary Focus)

  • Assist in planning, filming, and producing cinematic marketing videos, property walkthroughs, promotional campaigns, and event coverage.
  • Operate professional camera systems, gimbals, lighting, and audio equipment during productions.
  • Edit short and long-form video content using Adobe Premiere Pro, including color correction, audio mixing, motion graphics, and final delivery.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on high-end marketing films and brand storytelling.
  • Organize, archive, and manage digital media libraries, project files, and production assets.
  • Export and optimize video content for social media, websites, presentations, digital advertising, and broadcast applications.
  • Continue developing the skills necessary to independently plan, film, and produce complete marketing projects from concept to final delivery.

Photography & Visual Content

  • Capture professional photography for luxury properties, events, construction milestones, executive profiles, and marketing campaigns.
  • Photograph interiors, architecture, amenities, lifestyle imagery, and brand experiences.
  • Perform professional image selection, retouching, and color correction.
  • Maintain organized photo libraries and digital asset management.
  • Assist with drone productions as ground crew or second camera operator. FAA Part 107 certification is highly desirable.

Social Media & Digital Content

  • Create engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Plan, schedule, and publish content while maintaining a consistent luxury brand voice.
  • Produce reels, stories, carousels, and other platform-specific content.
  • Repurpose photography and long-form video into engaging digital content.
  • Monitor engagement metrics and recommend improvements based on performance analytics.

Graphic Design & Brand Development

  • Design premium marketing collateral including brochures, presentations, invitations, signage, advertisements, sales materials, and digital assets.
  • Produce graphics for social media, email marketing, presentations, websites, and events.
  • Prepare artwork for professional print production and vendor delivery.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Valor's luxury brand standards and those of our strategic partners, including Aston Martin, Roche Bobois, and future collaborations.

Content Writing & Marketing Communications

  • Write compelling copy for websites, email campaigns, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and social media.
  • Assist with scripting marketing videos and planning production storyboards.
  • Utilize modern AI tools to enhance content development, creative workflows, and production efficiency.
  • Support long-form marketing initiatives that strengthen Valor's reputation and brand authority.

Digital Marketing Support

  • Update company websites with new content, imagery, property information, and campaign assets.
  • Build and maintain landing pages for new developments, events, and marketing campaigns.
  • Design and distribute email marketing campaigns while maintaining mailing lists and reporting.
  • Assist with basic HTML email template updates and digital asset optimization.

Events, Production & Vendor Coordination

  • Support luxury sales events, grand openings, project launches, media events, and promotional campaigns.
  • Capture creative content during live events while coordinating with vendors and production partners.
  • Assist with print vendors, promotional suppliers, signage, mailing campaigns, and production logistics.
  • Track purchase orders, vendor invoices, marketing budgets, and project timelines.
  • Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, and creative vendors to ensure projects are delivered on schedule and to Valor's standards.


Technical Qualifications

Applicants should possess strong working knowledge of most of the following:

  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe InDesign
  • Professional photography and camera operation
  • Professional video production and post-production
  • Color grading and audio editing
  • Social media content production and management
  • Copywriting and brand storytelling
  • AI-powered creative tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, Claude, and similar platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • • 4+ years of experience in creative marketing, content production, multimedia production, or comparable role.
  • •A portfolio or demo reel demonstrating exceptional video production, photography, and creative design work.
  • Excellent visual judgment and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Passion for luxury brands, architecture, design, hospitality, or premium lifestyle marketing.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends and digital storytelling.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Comfortable receiving creative direction while also contributing original ideas and innovative solutions.
  • Enthusiastic about adopting emerging technologies, including AI powered creative workflows, to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Professional camera experience required.
  • FAA Part 107 Drone License preferred
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Occasional evenings and weekends required (for launches and events)
  • Ability to lift and transport camera equipment 25–40 lbs.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary ranges for this position vary by experience and role, typically starting from $60,000 and scaling based on qualifications up to $70,000. We proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as paid time off. Please note: Valor Real Estate Development is conducting this search internally and is not partnering with recruiting agencies, staffing firms, headhunters, or independent subcontractors for this position. Unsolicited candidate submissions, recruiting services, or sales solicitations will not be reviewed or considered. By submitting your resume, you acknowledge that your application is voluntary and does not constitute a binding agreement or obligation on behalf of either party.


Valor Real Estate Development provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

job.title: Program Director
job.description:
Program Director


R0153633
University of Nevada, Reno - Main Campus

The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu.

Job Description

Reporting to the General Manager of KUNR/KNCJ Public Radio, the Program Director provides strategic and day-to-day leadership for the broadcast programming and on-air operations of KUNR Public Radio, KNCJ Nevada's Classical and Jazz, and KNCC Elko. This position plays a central role in shaping the station's sound, programming strategy, audience experience, and overall broadcast quality while ensuring that programming meets professional public media standards and FCC requirements. The Program Director leads, coaches, and develops KUNR's full-time and part-time on-air talent and works closely with newsroom and station leadership to strengthen local programming and storytelling across platforms. The position oversees programming systems, broadcast automation, program schedules, network content, and technical audio quality to ensure reliable and seamless service to listeners. The Program Director also serves as an on-air host and participates in fundraising, community events, and other activities that advance KUNR's mission and connection with its audience. This position is well suited for a public media professional who combines strong editorial and programming judgment with leadership, technical aptitude, journalistic integrity, creativity, and a passion for developing people and serving audiences.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:
• Shape KUNR's sound and programming strategy while balancing local storytelling with high-quality national public media content.
• Develop and mentor on-air talent, helping broadcasters grow professionally and strengthening the overall quality of the station.
• Champion local programming and help identify opportunities for new programs, podcasts, partnerships, and content distribution.
• Work across departments with newsroom, engineering, development, and station leadership to advance KUNR's mission.
• Engage with the community through events, partnerships, interviews, and public media initiatives.
• Help guide the station's future, using audience information, emerging technologies, and evolving public media practices to improve the listener experience.
• Be part of a university environment that connects public media, journalism, education, and service to the Northern Nevada community.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and four years of professional work experience; OR a Master's Degree and two years of professional work experience

Related experience: On-air broadcasting, news collection, reporting, radio programming, or a closely related media field.

Schedule



- Regular schedule will generally be Monday through Friday and will be determined in part by assigned on-air programming. Current anticipated schedules may include approximately 6:00 a.m.-2:00 p.m. or 10:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.

- The position requires occasional evening and weekend work for station events, special programming, emergency news coverage, and other operational needs.



Compensation Grade

Administrative Faculty - C

To view the salary schedule for this position, please visit: https://www.unr.edu/hr/compensation-evaluation/compensation/salary-schedules and select Administrative Faculty by Grade. Salary is competitive and commensurate with related education and experience.

Remarkable Retirement

Our retirement plan is beyond compare. Your 19.25% contribution is generously matched by the University. With the faculty retirement plan, you are 100% vested your first day. Sit back and watch your retirement dollars grow! All permanent employees on an annual "A" or "B" contract who are employed at least 50% full-time are eligible to participate in the NSHE retirement program unless they are members of PERS of Nevada.

Perks of Working at UNR



- Health insurance options including dental and vision - https://www.unr.edu/bcn-nshe/benefits/insurance

- Generous annual and sick leave and life insurance - https://www.unr.edu/hr/benefits/leave-and-time-off/faculty

- E. L. Wiegand Fitness Center offers annual or semester memberships and spouse/domestic partner membership options. https://www.unr.edu/fitness/memberships

- Reno is proud to be a University town! Many local businesses offer discounts to WolfCard holders

- https://www.mountaineap.com/ supports employees (and eligible dependents) through life's difficult moments. Mountain EAP is located in Reno and specializes in counseling and advising services for personal or interpersonal issues.

- Faculty Senate is the principal representing body for faculty. Its membership includes representatives from each academic and administrative major unit of the University. https://www.unr.edu/faculty-senate

- No state income tax!



Grants-in-Aid for Faculty Employees

The University is proud to provide a reduced-rate tuition benefit to faculty and qualified dependents. Faculty can take up to six credits per semester at a reduced rate. Dependents of faculty have unlimited credits, but in order to be eligible children must be unmarried and under the age of 24 and must receive at least 50% of their financial support from the employee and/or employee's spouse or domestic partner. https://www.unr.edu/hr/benefits/educational-benefits/faculty

Faculty Dual Career Assistance Program

The University of Nevada, Reno recognizes the importance of addressing dual-career couples' professional needs. We offer a dual career assistance program to newly hired faculty spouses/partners that provides resources and assists them to identify career opportunities in Northern Nevada. https://www.unr.edu/hr/jobs/dual-career-program

Department Information

For more information about KUNR, please visit: https://www.kunr.org/

Contact Information

Sheryl Gann - mailto:sgann@kunr.org

Exempt

Yes

Full-Time Equivalent

100.0%

Required Attachment(s)

Please note, once you submit your application the only attachment/s viewable to you will be the attachment/s to the resume/CV section of the application. Any additional required attachment/s to the cover letter, references, additional documents sections of the application, will not be viewable to you after you submit your application. All uploaded attachment/s will be on the application for the committee to review. To request updates to attachments, prior to the committee review of applications, please contact the candidate helpdesk at mailto:jobs@unr.edu.

Please attach the following documents to your application

1) Resume/CV

2) Cover Letter

3) Contact information for three professional references

This posting is open until filled

Qualified individuals are encouraged to apply immediately. This search will close without notice when a sufficient number of applications are received or a hiring decision has been made.

Posting Close Date

Note to Applicant

A background check will be conducted on the candidate(s) selected for hire.

HR will attempt to verify academic credentials upon receipt of hiring documents. If the academic credentials cannot be verified, HR will notify the faculty member that an official transcript of their highest degree must be submitted within thirty days of the faculty member's first day of employment.

References will be contacted at the appropriate phase of the recruitment process.

Applicants hired on a federal contract may be subject to E-Verify.

As part of the hiring process, applicants for positions in the Nevada System of Higher Education may be required to demonstrate the ability to perform job-related tasks.

For positions that require driving, evidence of a valid driver's license will be required at the time of employment and as a condition of continued employment.

Schedules are subject to change based on organizational needs.

The University of Nevada, Reno is committed to providing a place of work and learning free of discrimination on the basis of a person's age (40 or older), disability, whether actual or perceived by others (including service-connected disabilities), gender (including pregnancy related conditions), military status or military obligations, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, race (including hair texture and protected hairstyles such as natural hairstyles, afros, bantu knots, curls, braids, locks and twists), color, or religion (protected classes).

About Us

The University of Nevada, Reno is a leading public research university committed to the promise of a future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada's original land-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries.

Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 ("Very High Research") university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News & World Report among the "Best National Universities" and "Best National Public Universities." It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times' "Top Colleges for Economic Diversity."

Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada's first medical school - the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics.

The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University's physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as "University Village," to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty.

Collaborating with world-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google's TechWise initiate is an 18-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry-level software engineers by graduation.

In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce's Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada - led by the University of Nevada, Reno - was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada's Tech Hub will strengthen America's lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state.

Through its commitment to high-impact education, world-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that's transforming Nevada's communities and businesses, the University continues its 150-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world.

The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience.

Today, the University delivers on its original land-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students' cognitive growth and academic achievement - all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education.

For more information, please visit the http://www.unr.edu/.

University of Nevada, Reno
