job.title: Account Executive, KMVT - Twin Falls
job.description:
Are you a driven sales professional ready to help local businesses thrive? KMVT, the CBS affiliate serving Twin Falls, Idaho, is seeking an Account Executive who will partner with businesses to deliver powerful advertising solutions that drive real results. This is your opportunity to combine strategic thinking with creative problem-solving while building lasting relationships in a community that values hard work and authenticity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)


WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Twin Falls, Idaho offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Magic Valley. This vibrant community of approximately 50,000 residents combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The area is famous for the stunning Shoshone Falls, often called the "Niagara of the West," which plunges 212 feet into the Snake River Canyon—actually taller than Niagara Falls itself.

Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless recreation opportunities, from hiking and mountain biking along the canyon rim to world-class fly fishing, kayaking, and BASE jumping at the Perrine Bridge. The region's high desert climate delivers 300 days of sunshine annually, with four distinct seasons that include mild winters and warm, dry summers.

Twin Falls boasts a thriving local economy anchored by agriculture, food processing, and growing tech sectors. The downtown area features locally-owned restaurants, breweries, shops, and a vibrant farmers market. The College of Southern Idaho adds cultural and educational opportunities to the community. With affordable housing, excellent schools, and a strong sense of community, Twin Falls offers the perfect balance for professionals seeking both career growth and an outstanding lifestyle. Plus, you're just a few hours from Boise, Sun Valley, and some of the West's most spectacular national parks and wilderness areas.

KMGH is a trusted news leader serving one of the nation's most competitive and exciting media markets. job.title: Lead Studio Engineer
job.description:
Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who thrives in the fast-paced world of broadcast television? We're looking for a Lead Studio Engineer to join our team in Atlanta, GA. In this critical role, you'll be the technical backbone of our operations, ensuring our broadcasting systems run flawlessly while leveraging your expertise in IP networks, studio operations, and cutting-edge broadcast technology. If you're passionate about keeping live television on the air and love diving deep into complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Installs, maintains, and repairs critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency.

  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment.

  • Relies on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully.

  • Collaborates with technology suppliers on setup, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.

  • Programs/customizes equipment software functionality.

  • Tracks and assists users with equipment issues.

  • When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution.

  • Works with the Network Ops leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision-making regarding technical matters.

  • Provides input and recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Makes recommendations for products and service enhancements.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree or equivalent work experience

  • 1-3 years of previous IT and/or broadcast engineering experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Experience with vendor support relations is highly desirable.

  • Previous television engineering experience preferred

  • Experience with live television production.

  • Must have thorough knowledge of Digital audio/video workflows and distribution.

  • C/Ku band satellite uplink and downlink systems.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY

Atlanta, Georgia, is a vibrant, dynamic city that perfectly blends Southern charm with big-city energy. As the capital of Georgia and a major hub for business, culture, and entertainment, Atlanta offers endless opportunities for professional growth and personal enjoyment. From world-class dining and thriving arts scenes to professional sports teams and beautiful outdoor spaces like Piedmont Park and the Atlanta BeltLine, there's always something to explore. The city's rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and welcoming community make it an exciting place to build your career and your life.

job.title: Master Control Hub Operator
job.description:
Are you ready to be at the heart of television broadcasting? The Scripps Master Control Hub in Indianapolis is seeking a skilled Master Control Hub Operator to manage and monitor multiple programming sources while providing critical master control support. In this essential role, you'll be the technical expert ensuring seamless programming delivery across our television stations, making split-second decisions that keep our content flowing flawlessly to viewers across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Monitor several programming sources simultaneously, manage and switch sources for local television station programming, remotely from the Hub.

  • Monitor various levels and signals from multiple television sites.

  • Manage several live program logs and ensure accuracy.

  • Ensure the correct spots are aired during programming and note any discrepancies.

  • Solve problems and make judgment calls with business implications in mind regarding programming changes, commercials, special reports, and technical difficulties; this includes evaluating clock/timing to consider options with regard to programming as well as deciding when to escalate issues.

  • Make decisions and consult with internal customers regarding local transmitter parameters and operation.

  • Routinely collaborate with media prep technicians and traffic personnel to manage daily operations. Collaborate with other local news personnel as needed during breaking news situations.

  • Interact both verbally and in writing with internal Hub client stations in a manner that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience. This includes sending alerts, responses to inquiries, collaboration on problem-solving, documentation, and/or resolution of issues.

  • Work with networks and live program providers, where required, to problem-solve issues.

  • Maintain current knowledge of and preparedness to execute disaster recovery procedures.

  • Perform quality assurance checks as required.

  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in a related field is preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to problem solve and quickly take corrective action as necessary

  • High sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work

  • Strong organization skills

  • Highly detail-oriented

  • Quick mathematical skills, especially concerning timekeeping

  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment

  • Working knowledge of transmitter parameters and operations

  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television master control

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:
 

Indianapolis is a thriving Midwestern city that offers the perfect blend of urban amenities and hometown hospitality. Known as the "Crossroads of America," Indianapolis boasts a revitalized downtown featuring world-class museums like the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway, and a vibrant Mass Ave cultural district filled with theaters, galleries, and locally-owned restaurants. The city's Canal Walk provides a scenic escape in the heart of downtown, while neighborhoods like Broad

Ripple and Fountain Square offer eclectic shopping, live music venues, and craft breweries.

Sports enthusiasts will love cheering on the Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium and the Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, while the city's extensive greenway system and Eagle Creek Park offer abundant outdoor recreation opportunities. Indianapolis combines big-city career opportunities with an affordable cost of living, no traffic nightmares, and genuine Hoosier hospitality. With a growing tech sector, excellent healthcare systems, and a thriving food scene that goes far beyond racing day traditions, Indianapolis offers an exceptional quality of life where you can truly make an impact in your community.

job.title: Meteorologist, KOAA
job.description:

Scripps NBC affiliate in Colorado Springs as a Meteorologist and become a trusted source of weather information for our community across television, digital, radio, and social platforms. We're looking for an experienced communicator who can deliver accurate, compelling forecasts, provide critical coverage during severe weather events, and create content that helps audiences stay informed and safe. If you're passionate about storytelling, thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, and enjoy connecting with viewers across multiple platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

job.title: Morning Anchor/MMJ, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN, we believe local journalism makes a difference in people's lives every day. We're looking for a Morning Anchor who is much more than a presenter behind the desk. You'll be a storyteller, a reporter, and a visible presence in the Tucson community, helping our audience start their day informed and connected. This role is ideal for a journalist who loves uncovering original stories, building relationships, and being where the news is happening. If you're passionate about meaningful reporting and committed to journalism that serves the community, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Anchor weekday morning newscasts with accuracy, urgency, and authenticity.
  • Report and deliver live coverage from breaking news scenes, major events, and community gatherings.
  • Research, gather, write, and develop compelling news content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Cultivate sources and generate original story ideas that impact Southern Arizona viewers.
  • Produce enterprise journalism that goes beyond reading a teleprompter and drives meaningful conversations in the community.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, photographers, and newsroom leadership to deliver impactful coverage.
  • Conduct interviews and field reporting that provide context, accountability, and storytelling depth.
  • Represent the station at community events, charitable initiatives, and public appearances.
  • Serve as a master of ceremonies or host for station-sponsored and community-focused events.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support newsroom operations and audience engagement.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of on-camera news experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the community to report stories and cover news events.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • A strong on-camera presence with the ability to connect with viewers and communicate with urgency when news demands it.
  • Demonstrated passion for reporting, storytelling, and enterprise journalism.
  • Ability to cultivate sources, uncover original stories, and continuously develop meaningful content ideas.
  • Strong news judgment and sound editorial decision-making skills.
  • Knowledge of newsroom computer systems, digital publishing tools, and news databases preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, accuracy standards, and libel law.
  • Clear, concise, and confident verbal communication skills.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to serving the community through trusted journalism.

OUR TEAM:


At KGUN, you'll join a passionate team of journalists who care deeply about storytelling, accountability, and community impact. We value curiosity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, and we believe the strongest journalism comes from people who are engaged with the communities they serve. Our newsroom is energetic, supportive, and committed to producing content that informs, empowers, and connects viewers across Southern Arizona.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Tucson offers an exceptional blend of natural beauty, culture, and adventure. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and blessed with more than 300 days of sunshine each year, the city provides endless opportunities for hiking, cycling, golfing, and exploring the outdoors.


Beyond its scenic landscapes, Tucson is known for its vibrant arts scene, rich multicultural heritage, award-winning food, and welcoming community atmosphere. Whether you're discovering local festivals, enjoying world-class cuisine, or exploring nearby national parks, Tucson offers a unique lifestyle that makes it an exciting place to build both a career and a home.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KRTV
job.description:
At KRTV, we tell the stories that matter most to the communities we serve. As a Multimedia Journalist, you'll research, report, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling local news content across multiple platforms. You'll be at the center of breaking news, community events, and impactful storytelling, helping viewers stay informed and connected.


This role offers the opportunity to build strong relationships throughout the Great Falls community while developing engaging content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Research, develop, and pitch story ideas from news leads, tips, and community sources.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, and independent research.
  • Write clear, accurate, and engaging stories that meet broadcast and digital editorial standards.
  • Capture high-quality video and still photography to support storytelling efforts.
  • Edit video content for television broadcasts, websites, social media channels, and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news, community events, and special coverage.
  • Appear on-air for interviews, narrations, and news presentations.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and newsroom colleagues to create compelling content.
  • Assist producers with newscast preparation and content development.
  • Partner with digital teams to publish and promote stories across multiple platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of journalism, reporting, multimedia, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company requirements.
  • Ability to travel locally for assignments and drive company or personal vehicles as needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong broadcast writing skills with knowledge of AP Style.
  • Experience with videography and non-linear editing systems preferred.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Experience editing video using Final Cut Pro or similar editing platforms.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and digital publishing tools.
  • Ability to post and manage content across websites and digital platforms.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:


At KRTV, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, content creators, and community advocates dedicated to delivering trusted local news. We value collaboration, curiosity, innovation, and integrity. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who share a commitment to serving viewers and making a meaningful impact across north-central Montana.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Great Falls offers an exceptional quality of life with easy access to some of the most breathtaking landscapes in the American West. Situated along the Missouri River and surrounded by Montana's natural beauty, the area provides endless opportunities for outdoor recreation, including hiking, fishing, camping, skiing, and wildlife exploration.


Whether you're enjoying local restaurants, exploring nearby state parks, visiting cultural attractions, or taking in panoramic mountain views, Great Falls combines small-town friendliness with big outdoor adventure. It's an ideal place for journalists who enjoy connecting with their communities while experiencing all that Montana has to offer.

job.title: Producer, KIVI (Part Time)
job.description:
KIVI, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Boise, ID, is seeking a creative, motivated Part Time Producer who will craft engaging stories that connect with our community. This position offers a unique opportunity to produce content for multiple platforms and make a real impact in one of the fastest-growing markets in the nation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs.
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcast and up to the minute editorial decisions.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's websites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Avid local news consumer: knows daily news, events, trends and happenings on a local level
  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator
  • Extraordinarily passionate about writing; courageous and creative storyteller with attention to even tiny details - choosing the perfect words, grammar, spelling
  • Highly organized
  • Highly adaptable - fast paced, deadline driven environment
  • Strong self-motivation
  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws and strong editorial judgement
  • Able to use web analytics
  • Proficient with newsroom computer systems, MS Office a plus
  • Flexible work hours may be required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life in one of America's most dynamic and fastest-growing cities. Nestled in the Treasure Valley along the Boise River and backed by the stunning Boise Foothills, this vibrant capital city perfectly balances urban sophistication with outdoor adventure. Downtown Boise features a thriving food and craft brewery scene, local boutiques, and a walkable city center, while the famous Boise Greenbelt provides 25 miles of scenic pathways for biking, running, and recreation.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless opportunities year-round, from world-class skiing at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown to hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in the nearby foothills. The Boise River offers excellent fishing, rafting, and kayaking, while multiple nearby reservoirs provide boating and water sports. With over 300 days of sunshine annually, mild seasons, and easy access to wilderness areas, Boise delivers the perfect blend of city amenities and natural beauty.


The city's growing economy, strong sense of community, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and family-friendly atmosphere have made Boise one of the most desirable places to live in the United States. Whether you're catching a Boise State Broncos game, exploring the vibrant arts district, or hitting the trails after work, Boise offers an exceptional lifestyle that's hard to match.

job.title: Reporter/MMJ, Mornings, KTNV
job.description:
KTNV, the ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, NV, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a creative and driven Multimedia Journalist.


The Multimedia Journalist is responsible for researching, writing, capturing visual content, and editing stories for multiple platforms. You would be joining a strong team of talented journalists with exceptional leadership. This position is ideal for an MMJ with some experience who wants to grow and excel in a dynamic, competitive market. Bring your dedication to solid journalism and your motivation to uncover stories that matter to our community and make viewers want to watch.


Las Vegas is one of the most exciting and fast-growing cities in the country, known for its world-class entertainment, thriving sports scene, diverse communities, and vibrant economy. From major events and tourism to significant local stories that impact Southern Nevada residents every day, Las Vegas offers journalists a unique opportunity to cover meaningful and memorable news. Join a team that's making a difference.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live and pre-recorded stories.
  • Work cooperatively with the photographer assigned to the story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producers in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist digital staff in preparing multimedia stories and online content.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems.
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment.
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills.
  • Proficient at posting content to various digital and social media platforms.
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

job.title: Sales Support Assistant - DR
job.description:
Are you a detail-oriented, customer-focused professional who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment? We're looking for a Sales Support Assistant – Direct Response to provide comprehensive support to the Direct Response Sales team, ensuring seamless campaign execution, accurate order processing, and exceptional client service while supporting Scripps Networks’ strategic sales objectives.

If you're organized, proactive, and passionate about delivering outstanding support, this is your opportunity to join our passionate team where your contributions fuel the stories that matter and the connections that count.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Process direct response advertising orders with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Collaborate with internal departments to ensure flawless post-sale execution of advertising deals across multiple endpoints
  • Facilitate clients’ brand allocations, flighting requirements, shifts, commercial instructions, content constraints, and ad hoc requests
  • Communicate with Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations and Pricing and Inventory teams to execute sponsorship opportunities
  • Troubleshoot creative issues/requests and delivery of traffic instructions to facilitate campaigns air by clients’ start date

New York City is the ultimate destination for ambitious professionals seeking endless opportunities and unmatched energy. From world-class dining and Broadway shows to iconic landmarks like Central Park and the Brooklyn Bridge, the city provides an exciting backdrop for both work and play. job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Salt Lake City
job.description:
Are you ready to bring the excitement of sports to life through innovative advertising solutions? Scripps Sports is seeking a dynamic Scripps Sports Partnership Lead in Salt Lake City who will drive revenue growth by selling linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions across our acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory. You'll work with regional and national accounts to create customized advertising packages that connect brands with passionate sports fans.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City offers an unbeatable combination of urban sophistication and outdoor adventure. Nestled against the stunning Wasatch Mountains, you'll have world-class skiing and snowboarding at resorts like Park City, Alta, and Snowbird just 30-45 minutes from downtown. In warmer months, enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in Big and Little Cottonwood Canyons, or explore the unique landscape of the Great Salt Lake.

The city itself boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant arts scene including the Utah Symphony, Ballet West, and numerous galleries. Temple Square and the historic neighborhoods showcase the city's rich heritage, while the growing tech sector has earned Salt Lake City recognition as the "Silicon Slopes." With 300 days of sunshine annually, a lower cost of living than many major metros, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Salt Lake City provides an exceptional quality of life.

Sports fans will love being home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake (MLS), and Utah Hockey Club (NHL), plus easy access to outdoor recreation that rivals anywhere in the country. The city's central location also makes it a convenient hub for exploring Utah's "Mighty Five" national parks and other Western destinations.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, WSFL
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Florida Panthers TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's premier franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Panthers-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Florida TV Panthers partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Florida Panthers brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Florida Panthers and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.

job.title: Senior Director of News, KTNV
job.description:
Senior Director of News, KTNV


Are you a proven news leader ready to elevate one of the most dynamic newsrooms in the West? KTNV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, Nevada, is seeking an experienced Senior Director of News to lead our newsroom and drive continued audience growth and journalistic excellence. This is your opportunity to lead a talented team of journalists committed to delivering critical community journalism that serves Las Vegas and Southern Nevada.


We're looking for a visionary leader who can inspire compelling storytelling, foster innovation, and navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape. If you're passionate about quality local journalism, digital innovation, developing great people, and building a positive, hard-charging newsroom culture, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth and newsroom operations.
  • Develop and implement measurable strategies for audience growth while effectively managing news content delivered across multiple platforms.
  • Communicate a compelling and inspired vision consistent with company strategy.
  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry and DMA.
  • Approve all newsroom personnel decisions.
  • Develop and control the annual budget in compliance with station guidelines.
  • Build and maintain key relationships to foster a positive news image within the Las Vegas community.
  • Monitor all on-air and online products for compliance with federal, state and local laws as well as First and Fourteenth Amendment requirements.
  • Work closely with other members of the station management team to develop and attain departmental and station goals.
  • Maintain knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Adapt current resources to emerging technology.
  • Supervise and provide regular feedback and yearly performance appraisals for direct reports, with ultimate responsibility for all newsroom personnel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • At least 5 years of news management experience is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communication or a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated ability to track and select trending news stories.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to lead and make sound decisions in a rapid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Ability to create tactics and strategies to increase audience performance in key target areas across multiple platforms.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Effectiveness in a variety of formal presentation settings, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Proven and effective leadership skills, including fostering open dialogue, empowering others, and addressing conflict quickly and directly.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Las Vegas, Nevada offers far more than the world-famous Las Vegas Strip. The region combines the energy and entertainment of a major destination city with year-round outdoor recreation, a growing local community and easy access to some of the most striking landscapes in the Southwest.


Beyond the restaurants, entertainment and attractions that draw visitors from around the world, Las Vegas offers professional sports, arts and culture, and outdoor adventures throughout Southern Nevada. From exploring Red Rock Canyon and nearby desert landscapes to taking in major sporting events, concerts and entertainment, Las Vegas provides a unique blend of big-city excitement and Western outdoor living.


For a news leader, Las Vegas also offers the opportunity to serve a distinctive and active community. At KTNV, you'll lead a newsroom focused on delivering important local journalism to viewers across Las Vegas and Southern Nevada while helping shape how that journalism reaches audiences across platforms. KTNV is Scripps' ABC affiliate in Las Vegas.

job.title: Senior Manager, IT Audit (Hybrid - Cincinnati)
job.description:
Join Scripps as a Senior Manager, IT Audit and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our technology infrastructure while driving continuous improvement across the organization. In this critical position, you'll oversee all aspects of the IT control audits. In addition, this position will manage compliance efforts related to the company's IT general controls and assist in the identification and execution of value-adding projects. If you're a strategic thinker with deep expertise in IT controls and a passion for enhancing organizational effectiveness, we want to hear from you!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Manage the planning and execution of audits of IT general controls and automated business applications.
  • Manage the planning and execution of value-adding consulting projects for corporate and operating unit management.
  • Perform reviews of IT audit reports to ensure accuracy and completeness of issues.
  • Assist in identifying and developing value-adding projects within the company.
  • Assist with developing and conducting compliance training programs related to IT internal controls and Sarbanes-Oxley.
  • In collaboration with corporate IT, reevaluate existing control designs and related efficiencies and make recommendations to corporate IT for improvements and efficiencies.
  • Review remediation plans related to IT control audit findings.
  • Participate in the selection and implementation of new or replacement business systems and upgrades across the company to ensure information technology control issues are properly addressed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • CISA certification or equivalent  preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity principles preferred
  • Understand internal control concepts and experience in applying them to document, plan, perform and report on the evaluation of business processes, areas and functions
  • Understand internal auditing standards, COSO, risk assessment practices, and high-level technical aspects of accounting and financial reporting
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on IT general controls and related control concept
  • Demonstrated expertise of information technology and/or information technology-focused audit and reporting practices
  • Ability to plan and execute complex projects, including defining scope, timelines, resources, deliverables, and related risks
  • Strong analytical, interpersonal, and written/verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team on multiple projects

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response
job.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the intersection of media innovation and client success? Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.
  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze campaign and account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, and develop client-facing reports, campaign recaps, recommendations, and strategic insights.
  • Coordinate the campaign lifecycle from proposal through order entry, trafficking, scheduling, optimization, reporting, makegoods, and reconciliation while maintaining accurate account, campaign, and revenue information in applicable systems.
  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated understanding of national advertising landscapes, agency structures, and enterprise-level client requirements preferred
  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment
  • Proficiency in CRM, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office with strong organizational skills to prioritize competing demands in fast-paced environments

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY


New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. As the nation's largest media market, NYC offers unparalleled access to leading agencies, brands, and industry events. Beyond work, the city pulses with world-class dining, arts, culture, and entertainment. From Broadway shows to rooftop bars, Central Park to Brooklyn's vibrant neighborhoods, you'll find endless ways to explore and be inspired. With excellent public transportation and a hybrid work model, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of professional growth and urban living at its finest.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Digital Partnerships
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Digital Partnerships to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.

If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.title: Customer Service Representative - CCLI (Eastbourne)
job.description:
At CCLI (Christian Copyright Licensing International), we're passionate about helping churches focus on what matters most: worship and ministry. As a leading provider of church copyright licensing and worship solutions, we deliver innovative tools, trusted resources, and industry-leading services that enable churches to access and use worship content legally and confidently. Combining purpose-driven work with technology and creativity, CCLI supports worship communities around the world and empowers teams to serve with excellence.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

As a Customer Service Representative, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experience by responding to enquiries, supporting customers with licensing and product solutions, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships. You will proactively engage customers through renewal and sales activities, process new and renewing licence applications across multiple channels, and maintain accurate customer records. Through every interaction, you will help churches and ministry organisations access the services they need while ensuring professional, efficient, and customer-focused experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email, and written correspondence in a timely, professional, and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of CCLI's products, services, and licensing solutions through ongoing training, team meetings, and self-development.
  • Provide accurate, clear, and helpful information to customers regarding products, services, policies, and procedures, ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer interactions, account updates, transactions, and feedback within the company's CRM and communication systems.
  • Proactively contact prospective customers to introduce CCLI's products and services, identify customer needs, and promote appropriate solutions.
  • Support the onboarding of new customers through telephone and video consultations, including delivering product demonstrations and guidance where required.
  • Provide customer support through telephone and video calls, troubleshooting issues, resolving queries efficiently, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, promoting engagement, retention, and long-term loyalty through proactive and responsive service.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the business to resolve customer issues, share feedback, and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  • Provide training, guidance, and support to colleagues as required, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance team capability.
  • Undertake additional duties and responsibilities consistent with the nature and level of the role, as required by the business.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of customers.
  • A customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for delivering outstanding service and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and high standards of work.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and deliver practical, effective solutions.
  • Confidence in handling customer conversations via telephone, email, and video calls in a professional and engaging manner.
  • A willingness to learn new systems, products, and processes, and to continuously develop knowledge and skills.
  • An interest in, and general understanding of, Christian music, worship, and church culture, with an appreciation of the needs of churches and ministry organisations.

WHY JOIN CCLI?

  • Purpose-driven work that supports churches, ministries, and worship communities.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • A customer-focused culture that values initiative, service, and continuous improvement.
  • The chance to work with industry-leading products and solutions that make a difference.

We welcome applications from candidates who are excited to be part of a collaborative, office-based team and able to work from our Eastbourne office five days a week. In return, we offer a competitive salary of up to £28,500, alongside a benefits package and leave policies that support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

job.title: Office Manager - Audio Network (France)
job.description:
AUDIO NETWORK EST UNE SOCIÉTÉ INTERNATIONALE SPÉCIALISÉE DANS LA MUSIQUE, PROPOSANT DES CATALOGUES MUSICAUX DE CLASSE PREMIUM ET DES SOLUTIONS DE LICENCE SIMPLES POUR LES DIFFUSEURS, LES MARQUES, LES PRODUCTEURS DE FILMS ET LES CRÉATEURS DE CONTENU DANS LE MONDE ENTIER.

NOUS COLLABORONS AVEC DES COMPOSITEURS, ARTISTES ET PRODUCTEURS DE TALENT AFIN DE CRÉER UNE MUSIQUE EXCEPTIONNELLE QUI DONNE VIE AUX HISTOIRES LES PLUS INSPIRANTES.

NOTRE CULTURE REPOSE SUR LA CRÉATIVITÉ, LA COLLABORATION, L'EXCELLENCE, L'INNOVATION ET L'ENGAGEMENT À OFFRIR UN SERVICE REMARQUABLE À NOS CLIENTS.
 

L'OPPORTUNITÉ:

En tant que Office Manager, France, vous assurerez le bon fonctionnement de notre bureau parisien.Vous superviserez l'administration financière, la coordination de la paie, l'administration des ressources humaines, la gestion des prestataires ainsi que les opérations quotidiennes du bureau.

Véritable partenaire de confiance du Directeur Général et du siège international, vous contribuerez à garantir la conformité locale, l'efficacité opérationnelle et une expérience collaborateur de qualité pour notre équipe en France.

Ce poste offre une grande autonomie et requiert d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles, une attention particulière aux détails et la capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément dans un environnement international et dynamique du secteur musical.

LA MISSION:

Administration Financière

  • Coordonner les activités de comptabilité fournisseurs et clients, y compris la gestion des factures, le suivi des paiements et les relances, en partenariat avec les cabinets comptables externes et le siège.
  • Superviser les rapports mensuels de dépenses, les rapprochements bancaires et le suivi des dépenses de l'équipe.

Paie et Administration du Personnel

  • Coordonner les éléments mensuels de paie avec le cabinet comptable externe.
  • Assurer le suivi des congés et des absences.
  • Assurer l'administration des avantages sociaux des collaborateurs (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, abonnement mobilité, etc.).

Conformité Sociale et Réglementaire

  • Effectuer les déclarations obligatoires auprès des organismes compétents (URSSAF, AFDAS/OPCO).
  • Veiller au respect des obligations en matière de santé au travail et de conformité sociale.

Gestion des Fournisseurs et Contrats

  • Assurer le suivi des contrats fournisseurs.
  • Valider l'ouverture de nouveaux comptes clients.
  • Maintenir à jour la documentation administrative des fournisseurs (coordonnées bancaires, extrait Kbis, etc.).

Coordination des Parties Prenantes

  • Agir comme principal point de contact opérationnel entre le bureau de Paris, le siège international, les partenaires comptables externes, les prestataires de paie et les organismes administratifs.
  • Garantir une circulation efficace de l'information et la résolution rapide des sujets administratifs.

Gestion du Bureau de Paris

job.title: AI Product & Delivery Coordinator
job.description:
About The Role

Sinclair is building a practical AI Product and Delivery function that makes AI tools and solutions useful in the real world. The team owns the employee-facing AI product experience and supports the AI product strategy: listening to what employees need, developing the right signals into a focused product portfolio, and moving priority work through execution, delivery, launch, and improvement.

The AI Product and Delivery Coordinator is a hands-on product and delivery partner to the Director, AI Product. You will help run the day-to-day product experience for ChatGPT Enterprise and other AI tools, keep the backlog and roadmap well informed, and help move priority work from a real employee or business problem to a delivered and supported solution.

This is an early-career role for someone who likes turning ambiguity into momentum. You will not be expected to write code or carry out technical administration. You will be expected to walk into conversations with people across the company, ask good questions, understand what matters, and help the group leave with a clear next step. We are looking for judgment, confidence, follow-through, and the ability to be a positive business partner as much as we are looking for a conventional product background.

What You Will Do

Employee Requests And Product Support

  • Manage the day-to-day flow of employee questions, requests, access needs, change requests, and support signals for approved AI tools.

  • Talk with employees to understand the need behind a request; provide timely guidance when a question can be resolved directly and route actionable work to the right administrative, support, or delivery partner.

  • Keep requests moving and employees informed, making sure ownership, context, and next steps are clear across the teams involved.

  • Identify patterns in employee needs, recurring friction, and requests that should become a product improvement, a release consideration, or a new product opportunity.

AI Tool Releases And Employee Education

  • Help plan and coordinate the release of new features, functions, and AI tools, including the intended audience, timing, access and provisioning needs, product messaging, and learning materials.

  • Create clear, useful employee-facing guidance that explains what is new, why it matters, and how to use it responsibly and effectively.

  • Work with enablement, communications, training, and administrative partners to make releases understandable, well-supported, and ready for employees.

  • Collect early feedback and issues after a release, then turn that input into improvements, updated guidance, or follow-up product work.

Product Discovery Backlog And Roadmap

  • Help maintain the AI product backlog and portfolio, with clear opportunity records, status, owners, business context, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes.

  • Support discovery with business partners and employees to understand users, workflows, pain points, constraints, and the value a solution needs to create.

  • Turn problems, requests, ideas, and other signals into concise product briefs, requirements, user stories, workflow documentation, and recommended next steps.

  • Prepare the product and workflow context that helps technology partners evaluate solution options and delivery paths.

  • Support the Director in preparing roadmap recommendations and portfolio priority decisions with current business context, delivery information, and clear documentation.

Solution Delivery And Product Improvement

  • Coordinate priority product work from approved concept through build, pilot, release, and ongoing support with internal and external delivery partners.

  • Maintain delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and readiness activities; surface issues early and help keep the work moving.

  • Translate approved product direction into clear documentation and requirements for technology, administrative, implementation, and business partners.

  • Manage post-launch follow-through for selected solutions, including feedback collection, change needs, release-material updates, adoption signals, and enhancement backlog items.

  • Synthesize product usage, employee feedback, requests, and delivery learnings into clear updates and practical recommendations for the Director and cross-functional partners.

How You Work

  • Build productive working relationships with AI Technology Strategy, AI Operations and Enablement, IT, Engineering, Security, Legal, Communications, and business teams.

  • Bring the right people together at the right time, recognize when specialized review or implementation is needed, and make sure each partner has the context to move the work forward.

  • Be a thoughtful, credible representative of the AI Product team with everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.

Who You Are

  • Two to four years of experience in product operations, product management, project or program delivery, strategy and operations, consulting, transformation, or a comparable cross-functional role.

  • A confident, clear communicator who can have a useful conversation with anyone in the organization, from a frontline employee to an executive leader.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand a team’s priorities, ask the right questions, and communicate a credible point of view.

  • A natural instinct for getting work done: you can turn a conversation into a plan, keep commitments visible, and follow through without damaging relationships.

  • Product instincts: you can understand users and workflows, distinguish a request from the underlying problem, write clearly, and think about adoption and success measures.

  • Strong organization and comfort managing a high volume of requests, details, handoffs, and competing priorities without losing the human side of the work.

  • A collaborative, positive working style. You know how to manage competing priorities, bring people along, and be direct without being difficult.

  • Comfort learning new technology, including generative AI tools, and applying practical judgment without needing to be the technical implementer.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: AVP, Finance Transformation
job.description:
This position is On-site at our Hunt Valley, MD headquarters.

Sinclair is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Assistant Vice President, Finance Transformation to lead initiatives that modernize finance operations, improve business processes, and increase the value delivered by the company’s technology investments.

This role will partner closely with business leaders, department heads, Finance, and IT to identify opportunities to simplify, redesign, and standardize processes. The AVP will help shape practical solutions using Oracle Cloud Fusion, artificial intelligence tools such as ChatGPT, automation, analytics, and other enabling technologies. The ideal candidate combines strong finance and operational judgment with a collaborative approach to change leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the finance transformation agenda, aligning initiatives with Sinclair’s strategic, operational, and financial priorities.
  • Partner with business leaders and department heads to assess current processes, identify pain points, and redesign workflows for greater efficiency, control, and service.
  • Establish a roadmap for process standardization, automation, systems optimization, and adoption of emerging technologies.
  • Work closely with IT to maximize the value, usability, and effectiveness of Oracle Cloud Fusion and related finance tools.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for AI, including generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, to improve analysis, reporting, documentation, workflow execution, and decision support.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, business cases, process designs, and implementation priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional transformation projects from opportunity assessment through implementation, adoption, and benefits realization.
  • Develop performance measures to track process efficiency, adoption, service levels, controls, and financial impact.
  • Partner with the Technology group to promote strong governance, data quality, internal controls, security, and appropriate use of AI and automation technologies.
  • Build change-management plans that prepare teams for new processes and tools, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and post-launch support.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on finance operating-model improvements and technology-enabled transformation opportunities.
  • Stay current on finance technology, AI capabilities, and leading practices; bring pragmatic recommendations to Sinclair.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CMA, or relevant transformation certification preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in finance, finance operations, transformation, consulting, enterprise systems, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional process redesign or finance transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of core finance processes, including planning, reporting, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and/or financial controls.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Fusion or comparable enterprise finance platforms strongly preferred.
  • Practical knowledge of automation, analytics, AI, and generative AI applications in a business or finance environment.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with executive leaders, business stakeholders, finance teams, and IT organizations.
  • Strong program-management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and drive measurable results in a changing environment.

 

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with a practical, execution-oriented mindset.
  • Collaborative and approachable partner who builds trust across functions.
  • Comfortable challenging existing practices constructively and guiding teams through change.
  • Strong judgment regarding risk, controls, data privacy, and responsible AI use.
  • Able to translate technical capabilities into clear business value.

 

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by improved process efficiency and effectiveness, increased adoption and value from Oracle Cloud Fusion and other technology investments, stronger business partnership, measurable automation and productivity gains, and sustained improvements in the way Finance supports Sinclair’s business leaders.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $225,000 - $240,000, plus eligibility for a performance based annual bonus. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, and alignment with the company’s strategic objectives. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

  • Provide budget information to support the implementation of new systems
  • Provide technical support to operational users
  • Consult and communicate with engineering management and other engineers on technical issues as required
  • Provide specific engineering signal flow diagrams for CAD documentation on all work performed on technical systems

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • Experience working with microwaves, transmitters and satellites is preferred
  • Self-motivated and the ability to work efficiently without direct supervision
