job.title: Director, Enterprise SaaS Delivery
job.description:
The Director Enterprise SaaS Delivery leads technical delivery and demand-shaping activities for assigned enterprise SaaS applications. The role supervises a Technical Delivery Manager and a Technical Product Owner for SaaS solutions, ensuring vendor releases, integrations, technical dependencies, and operational readiness are managed with discipline. The Director also partners with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, and Technical Business Management to define and analyze new requests before they enter the delivery pipeline, helping the business confirm the problem, high-level requirements, process impacts, and expected value needed for a sound business case.

Essential Responsibilities

Leadership and Delivery Governance

  • Lead, coach, and evaluate the Technical Delivery Manager and Technical Owner; establish clear accountabilities, operating rhythms, priorities, and development plans.
  • Set the delivery governance for assigned SaaS applications, including release planning, dependency management, risk escalation, technical readiness, deployment coordination, and post-release review.
  • Review vendor roadmaps, release calendars, lifecycle notices, and implementation plans; align timing with product priorities, business operating periods, and change-management needs.
  • Provide leadership visibility into delivery performance, key technical risks, vendor commitments, operational trends, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Ensure technical delivery work follows applicable SDLC, change-management, security, architecture, and production-readiness standards.

Business Analysis and Demand Shaping

  • Partner with Product Management, Architecture, and Technical Business Management to assess new project and enhancement requests before commitment to a delivery roadmap.
  • Lead or direct high-level business analysis, including current and future-state process modeling, stakeholder analysis, problem definition, process impacts, assumptions, constraints, and dependency identification.
  • Guide development of epics, use cases, and high-level business requirements that give the business a sufficiently clear basis for scope, estimates, options, and business-case decisions.
  • Challenge incomplete requests constructively and help sponsors resolve gaps in objectives, process ownership, value, feasibility, data needs, integration needs, security considerations, and change impacts.
  • Coordinate technical discovery across product teams and shared technology functions so estimates and business cases reflect credible technical scope and dependencies.

SaaS Application and Vendor Oversight

  • Provide senior oversight for third-party SaaS vendors, including delivery commitments, technical documentation, escalation management, release quality, support responsiveness, and roadmap alignment.
  • Ensure the Sales SaaS Technical Owner maintains a reliable technical operating model for the application, including integrations, environments, access, monitoring, release readiness, documentation, and vendor coordination.
  • Work with Product Management to ensure technical delivery activities support product roadmaps and business outcomes without duplicating product ownership of prioritization, functional requirements, or value realization.
  • Partner with infrastructure, network, security, identity, data and integration, and service desk functions to address cross-functional dependencies and recurring operational issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Review release outcomes, incidents, and operational trends; direct corrective actions that improve application reliability, supportability, and user experience.
  • Establish practical measures for delivery reliability, release success, dependency readiness, incident escalation, vendor performance, and documentation quality.
  • Ensure Tier 2 product teams retain ownership for application support coordination, including vendor support where applicable, while the director provides governance and escalated operational oversight.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, computer science, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise application delivery, technical program management, SaaS delivery, systems integration, business analysis, or technology operations, including at least three years leading people or teams.
  • Experience working with third-party SaaS vendors and coordinating complex releases, integrations, and cross-functional technical dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into process models, epics, use cases, and high-level requirements that support decision making and business cases.
  • Strong judgment, stakeholder management, written communication, facilitation, and executive-level reporting skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting sales technology, CRM, revenue operations, advertising, media, or other commercially critical SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, and enterprise architecture or process-modeling methods.
  • PMP, ITIL, Scrum, SAFe, CBAP, or comparable certification.

 

Role Boundaries

The Director is accountable for technical delivery leadership, upstream analysis, vendor and dependency governance, and operational oversight for the assigned SaaS portfolio. Product Management remains accountable for product strategy, prioritization, functional requirements, and value realization. Technical Business Management retains financial and portfolio-management responsibilities, including application budgets. Product teams retain Tier 2 application support responsibilities. Infrastructure, security, service desk, and engineering teams remain accountable for their specialized technical services.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $140,000 to $190,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.

 

o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.

 

o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.

 

o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 

o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with an edge, and use strong storytelling and TV production to make it impactful and memorable. The ideal candidate is an aggressive reporter with deep curiosity and unrelenting commitment to get to the bottom of an issue and hold individuals accountable.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch investigative angles to big daily news stories
  • Work closely with Producer and Executive Producer to refine investigative pitches and story scripts
  • Develop a network of sources and experts to generate investigative stories on a regular basis
  • Write online versions of investigative reports and work with Digital Investigative Producer on "web extra" content for each investigation
  • Maintain an active social media presence to build your brand and solicit original story ideas
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • Must be able to develop and maintain sources
  • Dynamic live television and storytelling skills are a must
  • Strong social media skillset for both research and promoting stories as well as gathering viewer input
  • Knowledge of the FOAI (Freedom of Information Act) process, computer-assisted reporting, and data-driven reporting along with familiarity of legal issues related to investigative television news reporting are essential
  • Strong writing skills and knowledge of current events
  • (insert years of experience needed) of investigative reporting experience preferred
  • History of award-winning investigative journalism preferred

While applying please provide an online portfolio / reel link for review.

job.title: Manager, AI Enablement
job.description:
About The Role

Are you a curious, collaborative self-starter who enjoys building relationships, connecting ideas, and getting to the root of how things really work? Are you the kind of person who spots friction that has quietly become part of the routine and understands that the best solution starts with a well-understood problem? Are you excited about the possibilities of AI and interested in helping an organization turn those possibilities into practical solutions? If so, we want to hear from you.

Sinclair is hiring a Manager, AI Enablement to help identify, understand, and clearly frame the operational problems facing our teams and the business. This highly visible role works across every business function to surface AI opportunities and regularly informs C-suite discussions.

AI Enablement owns the AI opportunity pipeline at Sinclair: capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing opportunities across the business, and deciding which become approved-for-build projects. This role helps run that pipeline day to day and translates approved-for-build opportunities to the AI Product and Delivery team. Through ongoing conversations with employees and leaders, you will uncover pain points, examine processes closely, and contribute your judgment on whether an opportunity calls for AI, process improvement, or another solution. We do not layer AI on top of broken processes.

We are looking for a thoughtful, natural connector who listens closely, recognizes patterns in what people say and do, and sees potential value before the numbers are fully developed. You do not need to be a technical AI expert. You do need to be able to walk into any part of the business with curiosity, ask great questions, earn trust quickly, and leave with a sharper picture of what is possible.

What You Will Do

Business Discovery and Relationship Building

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with employees and leaders across departments to surface opportunities and support AI adoption.
  • Engage with business teams across the organization to observe how work happens, ask questions that surface friction and inefficiency, and identify problems worth solving.
  • Understand the problem first, then examine the underlying process. Only when the process is sound should the question of AI come into play.

Pipeline, Prioritization, and Translation

  • Manage the intake path for AI-related opportunities from every source: the Champions Program, direct conversations, business partner requests, and escalations. Keep requesters informed of status and next steps.
  • Help run the AI Enablement opportunity pipeline: capture, evaluate, prioritize, and scope opportunities across Sinclair, and support the decision on which are ready to hand off as approved-for-build projects to AI Product and Delivery. 
  • Partner on business case development for opportunities as they move through the pipeline.
  • Translate approved-for-build opportunities into clear project briefs that carry the problem framing, the current state, open decisions, and the people involved, with sources for the facts so the receiving team can build with confidence.
  • Stay connected through evaluation, build, and delivery as an ongoing point of contact for the business partner. Answer questions, correct misunderstandings, maintain momentum, and keep the work anchored to the original business need.
  • Partner with AI Product and Delivery through the handoff and into build, so the problem framing, current state, and stakeholder context stay with the work as it moves to the technical partners who build it.
  • Partner with department leaders during opportunity evaluation, so technology fit, feasibility, and solution design shape an opportunity before it becomes an approved project.

AI Enablement and Adoption

  • Help run the ChatGPT Champions Program: working sessions, ongoing engagement, recognition, follow-through, and connecting champions with the resources and support they need.
  • Help employees understand practical ways AI can support their work by sharing successful use cases and supporting training, demonstrations, and other enablement activities.
  • Use AI actively in your own work and build working fluency through experimentation. You are not expected to be an expert; you are learning alongside our employees, and that shared experience is what makes you credible with them.
  • Stay current on what available AI tools can and cannot do so you can recognize relevant opportunities and provide practical guidance. Over time, use that fluency to help others prototype and improve workflows.

Reporting, Impact, and Communications

  • Analyze AI usage and engagement data, identify trends, and work with business teams to document time savings, productivity improvements, and other evidence of impact.
  • Prepare and contribute to briefings, reports, dashboards, Quarterly Business Reviews, and monthly updates that show what the AI Enablement function is finding, where value is showing up, and where the portfolio is headed.
  • Surface meaningful workflow patterns, employee stories, and progress through the Champions Dashboard and other leadership reporting.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications by providing the content, context, and examples needed to develop clear and accurate employee-facing messaging about AI initiatives.

 

What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months

  • You have built trusted relationships with champions and key business leaders across every division at Sinclair, and you are the person they call when something on their team is worth a closer look.
  • You have moved a first set of opportunities through the pipeline to approved-for-build, with clean project briefs handed off to the AI Product and Delivery team.
  • You have contributed to a Quarterly Business Review and a monthly leadership update, with material that showed the AI Enablement function's findings and where value is showing up.
  • You have built at least one AI agent or small solution to strengthen your own work, and you use AI actively enough to speak credibly with the champions you support.
  • You have supported the Champions Program's operating rhythm through multiple working sessions, and you have been the ongoing point of contact for at least one project moving through build.

 

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience within a large, complex organization.
  • Intellectual curiosity that keeps you learning, questioning, and connecting ideas.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and a willingness to shape unclear problems rather than wait for them to clarify.
  • Track record of building trusted relationships across functions and levels, from individual contributors to senior leaders.
  • Strong writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain unfamiliar or complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders without dropping threads.
  • Proficiency in Excel and general data literacy, including the ability to organize data, identify trends, and explain the story behind the information.
  • Understanding of how business operations translate into value. You do not need to build financial models.
  • Comfort learning new technology and developing fluency independently.

Preferred

  • Foundational familiarity with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools, along with a working sense of what they can and cannot do.
  • Experience supporting a champions network, community of practice, peer adoption program, or similar engagement model.
  • Experience with technology adoption, organizational change, process improvement, or cross-functional program work.
  • Prior experience in broadcast, media, or a similarly distributed, multi-site organization.
  • Experience with opportunity discovery, intake and triage, or project pipeline management.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in El Paso, TX. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Master Control Supervisor
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We are driven by innovation and a passion for connecting audiences with the best local news and sports content. As we expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing new technologies—including cloud-first solutions and artificial intelligence—to support a rapidly changing media environment.

As a Master Control Supervisor, you will support the playout and origination of 30+ CW, MeTV, MyNet, and independent television stations from our cloud-based Master Control platform. You will provide leadership, guidance, and development for a team of 20+ Master Control Operators, with a strong focus on training, skills development, operational consistency, and performance management.

Major Responsibilities

  • Supervise the day-to-day operations of the Media Operations Center.
  • Lead, train, and mentor new Master Control Operators, ensuring they are fully prepared to perform their responsibilities independently and consistently.
  • Provide ongoing training, refresher training, and skills development for current Master Control Operators.
  • Support the team during live local newscasts, breaking news, and local or network sports events.
  • Assist the Senior Manager of the Media Operations Center with developing, implementing, and training staff on new processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
  • Monitor operator performance and provide timely coaching, feedback, and corrective guidance when necessary.
  • Ensure completion of daily operational tasks and adherence to established workflows, policies, and procedures.
  • Serve as a liaison between the Media Operations Center and internal or external partners, including Station General Managers, Traffic, On-Air Promotion, Programming, Engineering, News, and other operational teams.
  • Perform Master Control Operator duties when operational needs require.
  • Assist with incident review, root-cause analysis, documentation, and corrective-action plans.
  • Support staffing needs, including attendance management, call-ins, shift coverage, and unscheduled absences.
  • Prepare and participate in employee performance evaluations and annual reviews.
  • Promote positive employee relations and maintain a professional, respectful, and accountable work environment.
  • Assist with special projects, reporting, and operational improvement initiatives as needed.
  • Approach operations, staffing, and process improvement with an agile and lean mindset.

 

Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience as a Master Control Operator, Master Control Technician, or in a comparable role within television, media, or content operations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, coaching, training, or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Experience with on-air Master Control automation systems.
  • Experience with cloud-based playout systems; AMAGI CLOUDPORT experience is a plus.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to create and maintain technical operating procedures. This is required.
  • Experience troubleshooting operational issues involving playout, media, closed captioning, and related broadcast systems.
  • Experience with digital workflows and digital video technologies.
  • Experience with content ingest, playout, distribution systems, and related hardware.
  • Experience switching live local newscasts and sporting events. This is required.
  • Experience supporting local television station operations.
  • Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 operation, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Strong organizational, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to remain calm, focused, and effective in a fast-paced live broadcast environment.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
WJAC is looking for a Meteorologist to present the weather forecast. As our Meteorologist, you are responsible for the content of the weather cast on-air and on our digital platforms.

The main day to day responsibilities of the role will include…

  • Forecasting, Producing and Presenting clear and concise weather casts, which tell a story and connect with viewers
  • Issue warnings and alerts, produce graphics and maps, and report live during weather events
  • Utilize social media during severe weather, as well as write weather stories
  • Make public appearances on behalf of the station
  • Pitching story ideas, developing contacts and reporting 3 days a week
  • Work with producers to determine relevant weather content in breaking and everyday situations

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • Ability to tell memorable and meaningful stories, we value visual and compelling storytelling
  • Ability to demonstrate experience with active and visual live shots
  • In Depth Knowledge of forecasting
  • Sharp news judgement and exceptional writing skills
  • Ability to multitask while meeting deadlines and prioritizing tasks
  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • 1+ years’ experience in weather presentation and reporting preferred

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel.

job.title: Morning Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
KMPH is looking for a Morning Multi-Media Journalist to join our team in Central California. We are live for 5 hours every weekday morning from 5am-10am.

Join us and hone the skills you need to take your career where you want to go! We are looking for a candidate who thinks outside the box and elevates their storytelling with enhanced content on our digital and social platforms. Candidate must be willing to work weekday mornings and fill-in as an anchor as needed.

Your responsibilities as an MMJ will include reporting, shooting and editing news stories, enterprising story ideas, developing contacts, and contributing content to KMPH's digital and social platforms.

Skills and Experience:
• Sharp news judgment
• The ability to tell an NPPA style story
• Excellent technical skills
• The ability to work well independently
• Strong writer with the ability to learn how to produce newscasts to work as a fill-in as needed.
• Must have and maintain a valid license and a good driving record

Requirements and Qualifications:
• A minimum of (1) year reporting experience is required
• Experience with live shots is required
• Experience with Live-U is a plus

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
KOMO News is seeking an energetic, enterprise-driven Multimedia Journalist to expand our sports coverage across broadcast, digital, social, streaming and audio platforms.

This journalist will help lead coverage of the mega-successful sports brands that define Seattle, including the Seahawks, Mariners and Seattle Storm. The position will play an important role in maximizing KOMO’s partnerships while delivering smart, visual and original coverage that connects with fans throughout Western Washington.

The successful candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can report, shoot, write, edit and publish compelling sports content independently and collaborate closely with KOMO’s Sports Director, newsroom, digital and sales teams to grow audience and create sponsorship opportunities.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Report, shoot, write and edit original sports stories for KOMO newscasts, KOMO News.com, social platforms, streaming and podcasts.
  • Cover breaking news, games, major events, athlete features and enterprise stories involving the Seahawks, Mariners, Seattle Storm and other key Pacific Northwest teams.
  • Help maximize KOMO’s Seattle Storm partnership through distinctive reporting, features, digital content and promotional opportunities.
  • Develop stories that go beyond scores and highlights, bringing perspective, accountability and strong local relevance to sports coverage.
  • Create digital-first video, articles and social content that reaches fans throughout the day.
  • Work with the Sports Director and newsroom producers to ensure sports stories are positioned prominently when they are meaningful to the broader community.
  • Contribute to and help grow KOMO sports franchises, podcasts and special-event coverage, including sponsored content opportunities where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain relationships with teams, athletes, coaches, community leaders and fans.
  • Represent KOMO professionally at games, events and in the community.
  • Meet daily deadlines while maintaining strong editorial judgment, accuracy and fairness.
  • Work a flexible schedule that includes nights, weekends, holidays and travel as sports coverage requires.
  • Assist with general news coverage and other newsroom assignments on an occasional, as-needed basis.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least two years of reporting, shooting and editing experience preferred; sports reporting experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to tell memorable stories on television, digital and social platforms.
  • Strong writing, live reporting, interviewing and editorial judgment.
  • Proficiency with non-linear editing, mobile journalism tools, content-management systems and social publishing.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Deep knowledge of Seattle and Pacific Northwest sports culture is preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and a good driving record required.

 

KOMO News is an equal opportunity employer.

The hourly compensation range for this role is $33.51 to $35.51. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. job.title: News Intern (Fall 2026)
job.description:
WPEC Fall News Intern

Step inside the newsroom where stories break, voices matter, and information moves at the speed of now.

We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and driven News Intern to join our team for Fall 2026. As part of a forward-thinking media organization, you won’t just observe—you’ll actively contribute to the storytelling that informs and connects our community across platforms.

From breaking news to digital-first storytelling, this is your opportunity to experience what modern journalism really looks like.

What You’ll Do

This is a fast-paced, real newsroom—no two days are the same.

  • Create & Contribute: Assist in researching, writing, and producing news stories for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Be Where the Action Is: Work alongside reporters, anchors, producers, and photographers—both in the newsroom and out in the field
  • Pitch Ideas: Bring fresh story ideas to the table and help shape coverage that matters to our audience
  • Get Hands-On: Learn how to shoot video, frame compelling visuals, and understand what makes a story stand out
  • Behind the Scenes: Gain exposure to control room operations and how live broadcasts come together in real time

 

What You’ll Gain

This internship is designed to build real skills—not just fill a line on your résumé.

  • Hands-on experience in modern, multi-platform journalism
  • A deeper understanding of how today’s newsrooms operate—from broadcast to digital and social
  • Opportunities to build a professional portfolio with published or produced work
  • Mentorship from experienced journalists who know the industry inside and out
  • Valuable connections to jumpstart your career in media

 

To be considered, candidates must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, or a recent graduate
  • Be at least a sophomore at an accredited college/university
  • Be eligible to work in the United States
  • Be available to work on-site at WPEC in West Palm Beach, FL approximately 15 hours per week for 10 weeks
  • Be able to start between August 24th - September 14th 
  • Have reliable transportation (housing/relocation is not provided)
  • Be passionate about local news, storytelling, and community impact
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

All candidates must apply through our careers portal and complete pre-employment requirements.

Why Join Us

Because journalism in 2026 is more dynamic than ever—and this is your chance to be part of it.

Join a team that values accuracy, creativity, and impact. Help tell stories that matter, develop skills that translate across platforms, and take your first step into a career in news.

  • The ability to execute news strategies and goals in daily newscasts

job.title: Product Designer II
job.description:
Sinclair Digital is seeking a Product Designer II to join the team! 

Major Goals:

Take ownership of assigned product experiences from discovery through implementation and iteration. Build a strong understanding of users, business goals, technology, and product performance. Collaborate with product, engineering, research, analytics, and stakeholders to create thoughtful, accessible solutions. Use Figma, research, data, and approved AI tools such as ChatGPT and Codex to improve design efficiency, quality, and outcomes. Share work early, communicate decisions clearly, and contribute to the growth of the Product Design team.

Key Result Areas:

Visual Design

• Demonstrates strong knowledge of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and platform

conventions.

• Creates polished experiences that support Sinclair's brand and meet user, product, and business needs.

• Produces accessible, inclusive designs with enough detail to guide implementation across platforms and screen sizes.

 

UX Design

• Creates clear information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction specifications.

• Considers the complete journey, including loading, empty, error, success, permission, and edge-case states.

• Uses research, analytics, feedback, and testing to understand problems, support decisions, and validate solutions.

 

Patterns

• Uses established design-system components and patterns to create consistent, intuitive, and scalable experiences.

• Balances shared patterns with platform conventions and the needs of each product and audience.

• Identifies gaps and helps improve, extend, and document reusable patterns across Sinclair products.

 

Product Thinking

• Understands the vision, audience, business goals, success measures, and constraints for the assigned product area.

• Connects design decisions to user needs, product objectives, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes.

• Works with partners to clarify requirements and scope, then uses post-launch data to identify improvements.

 

Process

• Participates in discovery, exploration, validation, delivery, design QA, and post-launch evaluation.

• Explores multiple approaches, explains key decisions, and independently manages assigned work while

communicating risks and dependencies.

• Uses approved AI tools for appropriate tasks such as research synthesis, ideation, rapid prototyping,

documentation, and quality review.

• Validates AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, brand alignment, bias, and technical feasibility.

• Supports implementation through organized files, clear specifications, developer walkthroughs, collaboration, and design QA.

 

Toolkit

• Demonstrates strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variables, prototypes, shared libraries, and

developer handoff.

• Uses ChatGPT and approved AI tools to support research, ideation, writing, accessibility reviews, and

documentation.

• Uses Codex and similar tools to build functional prototypes, explore feasibility, strengthen handoff, and support design QA.

• Verifies AI-generated work, maintains ownership of final decisions, and follows company requirements for privacy,

security, intellectual property, and responsible AI use.

 

Transparency

• Shares work early and regularly with design, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders.

• Communicates assumptions, unresolved questions, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps.

• Invites constructive feedback, documents important decisions, and keeps partners informed of changes.

 

Fluency

• Communicates effectively with product, engineering, research, analytics, editorial, and business partners.

• Understands different disciplines' priorities and constraints and accounts for them when developing solutions.

• Builds trust and works through scope and technical challenges while protecting the core user experience.

 

Communication

• Demonstrates strong written, verbal, visual, and presentation skills.

• Explains complex ideas and design decisions clearly, using relevant context and evidence.

• Keeps discussions focused, remains open to other perspectives, and communicates actionable next steps.

 

Mentorship

• Provides thoughtful, direct, and respectful feedback during critiques and project reviews.

• Supports less-experienced designers by sharing knowledge and constructive guidance when appropriate.

• Seeks coaching from Senior and Lead Designers to strengthen product thinking, craft, communication, and technical fluency.

 

Culture

• Identifies and supports design-led improvements within the assigned product area.

• Participates in critiques, workshops, team initiatives, and shared learning opportunities.

• Shares useful findings, patterns, templates, and AI-assisted workflows with curiosity, respect, and accountability.

 

Above the Line:

• Authentic Communication. Listen carefully, communicate directly and respectfully, and confirm shared

understanding.

• Constructive Negotiation. Address disagreements and tradeoffs collaboratively to move work forward.

• Impeccable Coordination. Keep key partners aligned on decisions, responsibilities, progress, risks, and changes.

 

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
At Sinclair, the Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value, reliability, and continuous improvement of established SaaS platform(s) used by internal teams. The role balances product enhancements with production stability, incident-driven priorities, technical health, vendor coordination, and evolving user needs. Working closely with business stakeholders, support, operations, and external providers, the Product Owner establishes clear product goals, orders the backlog, evaluates outcomes, and ensures that changes deliver measurable value.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of Product Ownership experience, including Agile Scrum practices.

Demonstrated ability to:

  • Lead through influence, facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities, and align business, technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders.
  • Analyze complex software behavior, reproduce issues, assess business impact, and coordinate diagnosis and resolution with technical, support, and vendor teams.
  • Create clear, appropriately scaled product artifacts, including goals, roadmap outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, defects, operational improvements, and decision records.
  • Prioritize and organize customer feedback, product data, support cases, incident trends, and operational metrics to guide product and service performance.
  • Customer-focused mindset with empathy, curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and effective when working through ambiguity, change, and deadline pressure.


Responsibilities:

Business Intake and Prioritization:

  • Build relationships across departments to understand business processes, user needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.
  • Gather and clarify requirements with stakeholders, end users, and subject matter experts; organize requests for prioritization based on business value, user impact, risk, dependencies, and organizational objectives.

Backlog and Roadmap Management:

  • Maintain a clear backlog and roadmap covering enhancements, defects, operational improvements, and support-driven needs.
  • Communicate priorities, requirements, constraints, and expected outcomes to stakeholders and vendor(s).

Vendor Governance, Delivery, and Validation:

  • Review vendor solutions, plans, estimates, dependencies, delivery progress, commitments, and service-level obligations; escalate gaps and risks.
  • Coordinate QA and UAT for release readiness, including defect resolution, business impacts, communications, training, and support readiness

Production Health and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor service performance, incidents, recurring defects, user feedback, and operational metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Review major incidents, root causes, corrective actions, and delivered outcomes with support, operations, and the vendor.

Product Knowledge and Documentation:

  • Maintain product knowledge and essential documentation, including goals, requirements, decisions, roadmap outcomes, and release notes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $85,000 to $105,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

job.title: Senior Information Security Engineer
job.description:
The Senior Information Security Engineer will support an enterprise security program including conducting deep-dive Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, developing and delivering security awareness training campaigns, identifying, tracking, and coordinating vulnerability remediations based on threat intelligence feeds, performing litigation support and investigations, establishing policy enforcement processes, and engineering automations to improve time to deliver using Artificial Intelligence (AI) or automation platforms.

The applicant must have prior experience engineering security solutions with successful deployments in complex commercial enterprise environments. The candidate should have prior experience in a security operations or engineering role, with expertise conducting third-party, software, and vendor risk assessments. Additional required skills are, developing and enhancing security policies and standards, and hands-on knowledge of cloud (SaaS) and hybrid network infrastructure environments, establishing automations to improve accuracy and speed of outcomes, and performing disaster recovery (DR) /Continuity of Operations (COOP) assessments. The candidate will possess strong and polished communication skills, willingness and ability to present security topics to internal and external customers and thrive in a highly visible and fast-paced role. 

Responsibilities:

Process & Execution

  • Conduct high-quality and timely third-party/vendor/service provider/software risk assessments, with the ability to meet SLAs and communicate effectively with all stakeholders.
  • Contributes to the creation and maturation of information security policies and processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes and successfully engineers and delivers on process improvements according to assigned timelines.
  • Develops and delivers Disaster Recovery and Continuity of Operations risk assessments to business units successfully establishing resiliency plans for the company. 
  • Assist with the governance of the enterprise Policy Exception process including stakeholder engagement, driving completion with internal teams, and providing balanced reports that will be visible to senior leaders.
  • Create, adapt, and enhance weekly metrics to measure program effectiveness.
  • Evaluate security architectures including the ability to identify risks, compensating controls, and mitigation plans.
  • Develop custom security awareness and phishing campaigns to elevate employee knowledge of current trends and threats to Sinclair.
  • Perform, and maintain litigation and data retention holds using eDiscovery and other actions to support Sinclair Legal requests.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and remain organized with simultaneous assignments while remaining flexible and resilient. 
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and integrity with the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Ability to think strategically, plan methodically, and execute tactically.
  • Take ownership of personal and professional development needed to excel in the role.

Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Apply excellent communication skills to efficiently collaborate with company stakeholders and business partners.
  • Ability and prior experience delivering live training sessions to diverse audiences.
  • Evaluate and recommend new products, maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, and maximize value from existing tool sets to ensure return on investment. 
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills by identifying gaps or issues and clearly formulating solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with Sinclair policies and standards by communicating requirements to internal stakeholders.
  • Proactively respond to information security tickets and requests according to team SLA.
  • Collaborate with third parties to remediate risks to effectively minimize attack surface.
  • Operating with a strong sense of teamwork and personal accountability.

Performance Improvement

  • Identify areas of improvement within the security team to maintain a level of excellence.
  • Design, document, and implement procedures for analyzing and evaluating risk. 
  • Proactively and effectively look for ways to improve and optimize processes and techniques. 
  • Research emerging technologies and provide options to leadership for problem solving. 
  • Champion collaboration amongst teams, quality execution on assignments, and take personal accountability for deliverables.
  • Thrive within fast-paced operational environment requiring priority adjustments, multi-tasking, and a high-level of communication skills.
  • Ability to self-motivate and go the extra mile to ensure team success. 
  • Maintain a positive and customer-oriented approach to daily operations.         
  • Comfortable working directly with other teams such as Legal, Privacy, and IT.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
  • 7 years of relevant work experience or a combined background in the following areas: third-party risk management, security operations, security engineering, risk management, vulnerability management.
  • Experience with enterprise threat intelligence and third-party risk management platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and automation tools to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enhance decision-making.
  • Understanding of SOC-2, ISO-27001, and NIST SP 800 “series” frameworks with the ability to identify and mitigate control gaps.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with an ability to present complex information to audiences of varying subject knowledge. 
  • Solid technical background with the ability to understand network and systems architectures. 
  • Prior experience working in commercial multi-cloud provider environments.
  • Industry certification required in one of the following areas: (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Security+, CISA, or equivalent).
  • Basic knowledge of current data privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).
  • Prior experience in the broadcast/media entertainment industries preferred.
  • Experience conducting litigation holds, retention requests, and eDiscovery is a big plus.
  • Commercial enterprise experience is required. 

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair:

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

 About the Team

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $93,000 to $124,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: SVP, Sports Podcast Revenue
job.description:
AMP Sports is seeking a visionary, commercially minded Senior Vice President of Sports Podcast Revenue to lead revenue strategy, advertiser partnerships, sponsorship development, and commercial performance across its growing sports podcast portfolio. This executive will identify, develop, and scale high-value revenue opportunities across podcasts, digital video, social-first programming, talent-led franchises, and multi-platform sports experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the sales strategy, client growth plan, and revenue performance for AMP Sports’ podcast and audio portfolio.
  • Develop and grow direct advertiser, agency, sponsorship, branded-content and strategic-partnership revenue opportunities.
  • Identify high-potential sports franchises, talent-led properties, audience segments, and cultural moments that can be transformed into scalable commercial offerings.
  • Partner with AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions to create compelling sales narratives, sponsorship packages, integrated marketing programs, and advertiser solutions.
  • Work alongside Sports Partnerships & Activations to develop premium partnership opportunities involving athletes, teams, leagues, live events, and brand activations.
  • Establish revenue targets, forecasts, pipeline discipline, pricing strategy, inventory models, and performance reporting for the business.
  • Build commercially viable packaging across podcast, video, social, digital, live, broadcast, and other relevant Sinclair platforms.
  • Develop relationships with senior brand marketers, agencies, media buyers, sports partners, platforms, talent representatives, and other strategic partners.
  • Identify new revenue streams, including branded content, custom programs, affiliate opportunities, licensing, commerce, events, subscriptions, and emerging platform monetization.
  • Partner with content, audience, analytics, legal, finance, and business affairs teams to ensure commercial opportunities are executable, brand-safe, and aligned with rights obligations.
  • Use audience data, market intelligence, advertiser feedback, and revenue performance to inform commercial strategy, product development, and investment priorities.
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing commercial team with clear accountability, strong collaboration, and a results-oriented culture.

  • Represent AMP Sports externally with clients, agencies, platforms, partners, and industry leaders.

     

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports media, podcasting, audio, digital media, advertising, sponsorship, partnerships, or a related commercial media business.
  • 8+ years leading senior sales, revenue, partnerships, business development, or commercial strategy teams.
  • Demonstrated success growing revenue for sports, audio, podcast, video, social, streaming, television, or talent-led media properties.

job.title: VP, General Manager
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, building a culture where people feel connected, inspired, and proud of the work they do.  We grow here, and we enjoy it here.

We're searching for a visionary leader — a driven, talented VP, General Manager to lead one or more of our local content centers and monetization and marketing teams. In this role, you'll be the architect of strategy, the champion of growth, a steward of culture and the heartbeat of operational excellence. If you're energized by leading high-performing teams, driving revenue, and making a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Sounds Like the Right Fit? Check Out the Checklist Below and if it sounds like you, hit “Apply Now” and let’s chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Help Us Thrive
You’ll lead the charge in amplifying our market presence, ensuring every team — from content creation to sales — is aligned with our strategic goals and delivering results.

Results-Driven
Maximize share of wallet across all media platforms in your marketplace. You’ll guide sales and marketing teams to hit revenue targets, grow audience engagement, and build lasting client relationships.

Strategic Planning
Develop and implement innovative business plans across departments. You’ll identify growth opportunities, analyze market trends, and ensure every team is set up for success.

Team Development
Mentor and inspire cross-functional teams while actively shaping a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture. You’ll model our values, foster collaboration, reinforce accountability, and create an environment where people feel engaged, supported, and motivated to do their best work. Your leadership will develop future leaders and strengthen team cohesion. 

Market Analysis
Dive deep into competitive landscapes and audience data. Your insights will fuel expansion strategies and keep us ahead of the curve.

Authentic Relationships
Build strong relationships with clients, advertisers, community leaders, and industry partners. Internally and externally, you’ll be a visible culture carrier and the  face of AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions in your market, amplifying our reputation and impact.

What We're Looking For

✔ Proven Leadership
Experience in senior management level roles, ideally in media, digital or broadcasting. You’ve led diverse teams and driven measurable success.

✔ Strategic Visionary
You see the big picture and know how to get there. You’re comfortable with P&L ownership, financial planning, and operational excellence.

✔ Regulatory Savvy
You understand broadcasting regulations, content guidelines, and compliance standards — and you know how to navigate them with confidence.

✔ Financial Acumen
You’re skilled in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. You know how to drive profitability while managing expenses.

✔ Relationship Builder
You’re a natural communicator and connector. You build trust, foster loyalty, and amplify client satisfaction. You inspire and motivate your team.

✔ Digital First
You bring strong digital acumen and understand how to leverage emerging technologies — including AI — to drive innovation and revenue growth. You’re not just tech-aware; you’re tech-forward.

✔ Growth Mindset
You thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change, and believe culture is a leadership responsibility. You’re always learning, adapting, and pushing boundaries – for yourself and your team.

The Practical Stuff

  • A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients and teams in your community.
  • Willingness and ability to travel when necessary.

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions?

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People
Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun. We celebrate wins and support each other every step of the way.

The Compensation Package
Competitive base salary + results-based bonus structure. Plus, a benefits package our people love.

We Make a Real Difference
We help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our team isn’t just selling ads — we’re building communities.

Career Growth Opportunities
We invest in you. Training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities are all part of the package. Whether you grow locally or join another AMP team, your future is bright.

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: VP, Sports Podcast Revenue
job.description:
AMP Sports is seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial Vice President of Activation Revenue to lead the growth, development, and execution of high-impact partnerships at the intersection of sports, media, talent, and culture. This executive will set the partnership and activation strategy, lead and develop the team, personally drive the organization’s most important brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships, and turn AMP Sports’ podcasts, digital video, social reach, creators, original storytelling, live experiences, and Sinclair scale into distinctive programs for partners and fans. The VP will be both a builder and an operator: someone who can create the commercial vision, sell the idea, and ensure the activation delivers from concept through measurement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own AMP Sports’ sports-partnership and activation strategy, annual revenue plan, sales targets, pipeline health, forecasting, and performance accountability.
  • Build a differentiated portfolio of integrated programs across podcasts and audio, digital video, social, talent and creator partnerships, branded content, sponsorships, live events, fan experiences, and other experiential opportunities.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing partnerships and activations team; establish clear expectations, account priorities, operating rhythms, and a culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and hands-on seller for the largest opportunities, building trusted relationships with senior brand marketers, agency executives, leagues, teams, talent representatives, rights holders, and other sports-industry partners.
  • Create activation platforms around tentpole events, sports seasons, original franchises, talent, cultural moments, and audience passions that can scale across brands and distribution channels.
  • Lead the full activation lifecycle—from insight, concept, packaging, and pitch through contracting, production, launch, on-site or digital execution, measurement, renewal, and expansion.
  • Partner with content, production, marketing, social, research, ad operations, experiential, finance, legal, and corporate sales teams to ensure programs are creative, executable, brand-safe, rights-compliant, and financially sound.
  • Guide packaging, pricing, sponsorship architecture, inventory strategy, activation budgets, and commercial policies to support revenue growth, market competitiveness, and healthy margins.
  • Lead executive-level proposal development and negotiations for complex, high-value agreements, balancing client objectives, fan experience, creative ambition, talent and usage rights, operational requirements, risk, and profitability.
  • Establish clear activation governance, ownership, timelines, approval processes, and cross-functional handoffs to deliver every partner commitment at a high standard.
  • Create a measurement approach that connects audience reach and engagement with brand objectives, activation performance, client satisfaction, renewal, and account growth.
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities involving events, hospitality, commerce, licensing, creators, talent, distribution, and emerging sports or fan-engagement platforms.
  • Represent AMP Sports at client meetings, agency summits, sports and advertising conferences, live events, and other major marketplace moments.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports partnerships, sponsorships, experiential marketing, branded content, sports media, integrated sales, or a related field.
  • 5+ years leading and developing sales, partnerships, sponsorship, experiential, or activation teams, with a record of setting strategy and improving performance.
  • A sustained track record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue goals and personally closing complex, high-value, multi-platform sports partnerships.
  • Demonstrated experience taking major activations from concept through execution, including management of stakeholders, budgets, timelines, talent or rights considerations, and measurement.
  • Deep relationships and executive credibility with major brands, agencies, leagues, teams, rights holders, talent organizations, and relevant sports-industry partners.
  • Strong understanding of sports audiences, fandom, live and digital experiences, branded entertainment, podcast and creator monetization, social platforms, and integrated measurement.
  • Executive-level commercial and operational judgment, including fluency in pricing, forecasting, activation budgets, deal structure, margins, and revenue operations.
  • Ability to connect business strategy, consumer insight, creative storytelling, live experiences, and platform capabilities into an actionable partnership plan.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling a sports-partnership or activation function, launching a new commercial offering, or repositioning a sports media portfolio in the market.
  • Experience working directly with sports talent, creators, leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, live events, or original sports programming.
  • Experience with seven-figure-plus partnerships, multi-year agreements, custom content production, live activations, hospitality, and complex rights or usage structures.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Achievement of annual revenue, profitability, pipeline coverage, and forecast-accuracy goals.
  • Growth and diversification of AMP Sports’ brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships.
  • Development of distinctive, scalable sports partnerships and activation platforms.
  • On-time, on-budget, brand-safe delivery of activation commitments and strong fan engagement.
  • Performance, engagement, and development of the partnerships and activations team.
  • Partner retention, renewal, expansion, and executive-level satisfaction.
  • Effective collaboration across AMP Sports and Sinclair from concept through execution and measurement.

About AMP Sports

AMP Sports brings together sports, culture, storytelling, and fandom across podcasts, digital video, social platforms, creator-led content, and live or experiential opportunities. As part of Sinclair, AMP Sports can pair the agility and authenticity of emerging media with the reach, relationships, and resources of a diversified media company. We build ideas with brands—not simply placements—creating partnerships that feel relevant to audiences and deliver meaningful business results for advertisers.
