job.title: Audio Editor, DC Sports Newsroom (Part-Time)
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.
 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment, and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Stitcher, Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics, and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization, and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through Sirius XM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Audio Editor, DC Sports Newsroom (Part-Time) will coordinate feeds, acquire and edit sports sound, and operate broadcast and editing software. Work will include evenings, weekends, and holidays.

What you’ll do:

  • Edit live interviews/press conferences and identify and pull relevant soundbytes for updates/show use.
  • Edit live sports games, identify and pull relevant highlights for updates/show use.
  • Monitor the sports news cycle throughout the shift and bring relevant audio to support top sports stories.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree or relevant experience.
  • 1-year experience with sound editing and sports newsroom operation in a fast-paced news-gathering atmosphere.
  • Deep understanding and knowledge of sports news across all major sports.
  • Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and work under shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Night/Weekend/Holiday availability is REQUIRED.
  • Experience with digital editing.
  • Experience with Adobe Audition, Zetta, and Galaxy a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be $20/hour and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

job.title: Director, Creative Services
job.description:
Who We Are:


SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Stitcher, Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through Sirius XM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

We are seeking a Director of Creative Services to lead the operations, and execution of best-in-class creative across both the SiriusXM and Pandora brands. They will oversee a multidisciplinary internal creative team and external agency partners. This person will be responsible for supporting and optimizing an operating model that includes AI tools to help our creative teams move faster, produce smarter, and deliver work across all consumer-facing touch points and internal communications.


This role is accountable for the Creative Services department operating model and translates senior management priorities into multi-year departmental plans, operating objectives, budgets, staffing strategies, resource allocation decisions, and measurable performance outcomes.


The ideal candidate is both a creative partner and an operational architect: someone who understands how bold ideas are made, how creative organizations scale, and how to balance craft, speed, efficiency, and business impact. This person will lead creative services across campaign development, resource planning, production, agency management, creative workflows, budget governance, team effectiveness, and cross-functional delivery.


The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative leader with deep experience managing high-performing teams in media, entertainment, audio, streaming, technology, or consumer subscription businesses. This person brings a strong creative point of view, operational discipline, leadership presence, and the ability to translate business objectives into distinctive, effective creative work.


What you’ll do:

Creative Leadership & Brand Stewardship

  • Lead the creative direction for SiriusXM and Pandora across brand campaigns, performance marketing, lifecycle communications, social content, sales materials, event marketing and experiential activations.
  • Ensure all creative work is strategically grounded, culturally relevant, audience-focused, and consistent with SiriusXM’s and Pandora’s brand identity.
  • Establish departmental creative services objectives and operating standards that align with broader marketing and company strategy, and make final administrative and operational decisions within the function.

Production and Workflow Efficiency

  • Oversee the transition of legacy production workflows into agile, AI-assisted operations to drastically reduce turnarounds for creative assets and communications.
  • Drive creative modularity and personalization strategies that allow marketing communications to be easily adapted by audience segments and behaviors.
  • Provide oversight of the creative Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, ensuring assets are properly organized, tagged, rights-cleared, version-controlled, searchable, reusable, and integrated into AI-enabled creative workflows.
  • Own a multi-year creative operations and technology roadmap, proactively identifying improvements and charting the course for implementation across the Creative Services department.

Team & Agency Management

  • Lead an internal and external (agency partner) creative services team that includes creative directors, art directors, designers, copywriters, producers, editors and motion designers.
  • Lead the Creative Services department through people managers and creative leaders who are accountable for their own teams, disciplines, and delivery outcomes.
  • Manage relationships with creative agencies, production partners, freelancers, and vendors. Determine when to leverage internal resources versus external partners, ensuring high-quality output, cost efficiency, and brand alignment.
  • Establish clear roles, workflows, standards, and growth paths while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and creatively ambitious culture.
  • Own department planning, staffing, budgeting, expense priorities, resource allocation, and changes to operating methods, balancing business demand, creative quality, and financial discipline.
  • Develop future leaders through coaching, succession planning, purposeful feedback, and expanded leadership opportunities for managers and senior creative talent.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted creative advisor to leaders and cross-functional partners across the company. Present creative concepts, campaign strategies, and performance learnings with clarity and confidence.
  • Influence senior leaders on matters significant to the organization, translating strategic priorities into departmental plans and gaining alignment on resources, operating approaches, and creative direction.
  • Balance business needs, stakeholder input, brand standards, and creative excellence.

Innovation & Cultural Relevance

  • Stay ahead of trends in entertainment, audio, streaming, design, technology, social media, fan culture, and consumer behavior. Bring fresh ideas that help SiriusXM and Pandora connect with existing and emerging audiences in distinctive ways.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree with focus on design, marketing or related field, or equivalent, relevant experience.
  • Typically has 10 or more years of experience with 5 or more years of management experience.
  • Experience with tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Workfront, Airtable, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Figma, Frame.io, Bynder, Aprimo, Contentful, generative AI platforms, DAM/MAM systems, and creative analytics tools.
  • Deep experience operating within large-scale media, entertainment, audio, streaming, technology, advertising, consumer subscription, or digital content businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience managing AI, automation, creative technology, DAM/MAM systems, workflow platforms, or production transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of generative AI capabilities and risks across text, audio, voice, image, video, personalization, and campaign optimization.
  • Strong financial and resource management skills, including budget ownership, production planning, vendor management, and capacity forecasting.
  • Able to define a long-term creative operations and AI transformation vision while delivering near-term business results.
  • Focus on clarity, prioritization, process, measurement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrate excellent attention to detail, time management skills, and an ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a highly fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS-Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $110,000 to $212,950 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

The Principal Architect for Subscriber Management System (SMS) will lead the architecture, design, development, and delivery of core subscriber management, billing, and business feature initiatives supporting SiriusXM’s satellite and streaming subscription services. This role serves as a technical leader responsible for defining architecture strategy, guiding enterprise solution delivery, and enabling scalable business capabilities across the SMS ecosystem. This role exercises wide latitude in determining objectives, technical approaches, and architecture standards for critical SMS initiatives with broad organizational visibility. This role will drive modernization, scalability, performance optimization, and integration initiatives across Oracle BRM and related enterprise systems while partnering closely with engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver strategic enterprise solutions. The role creates formal technical networks with key decision makers across Technology, Product, Finance, Operations, and business teams to align architecture decisions with subscriber lifecycle reliability, billing accuracy, revenue enablement, customer experience, compliance, and operational resilience.


SMS is the enterprise platform supporting subscriber management, billing, provisioning, payment processing, and revenue management for SiriusXM’s satellite and streaming subscription services. The SMS engineering team collaborates with cross-functional partners to extend and customize Oracle BRM through custom business logic, pricing and rating configurations, and integrations with upstream and downstream enterprise systems. The team participates across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, Agile development, deployment, and production support. As the principal architecture authority for SMS, this role anticipates internal business, technology, and regulatory challenges and recommends product, platform, process, and service improvements that advance future-state subscription capabilities.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of Subscriber Management System (SMS) applications and services across critical, enterprise-scale programs with broad visibility and material impact to subscription, billing, payment, provisioning, and revenue operations.
  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance solutions using Oracle BRM and related technologies, while defining architecture patterns, technical principles, and modernization roadmaps for the SMS ecosystem.
  • Develop and enhance custom opcodes, policy opcodes, pricing configurations, and real-time rating solutions.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, DevOps, Finance, and Operations to deliver enterprise-scale solutions and influence senior decision makers on architecture tradeoffs, delivery risks, and long-term platform strategy.
  • Drive integration initiatives with upstream and downstream systems, including payment gateways, taxation systems, provisioning systems, and customer platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams while promoting engineering best practices. Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across SMS and adjacent enterprise technology teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, performance tuning, and troubleshooting production issues.
  • Lead technical estimation, solution planning, and Agile delivery activities for short- and mid-term outcomes that require independent judgment, creativity, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Ensure system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security compliance.
  • Support production deployments, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish and lead SMS architecture governance, design review forums, and reusable engineering standards that improve consistency, reliability, performance, and maintainability across the platform.
  • Evaluate future concepts, products, and technologies for subscriber management, billing, rating, payments, provisioning, cloud modernization, and enterprise integration, and translate recommendations into actionable architecture strategies.
  • Serve as a recognized technical authority for SMS architecture in executive-level discussions, roadmap planning, and high-impact issue resolution.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of enterprise software development and architecture experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle BRM including real-time rating, pricing configuration, billing and invoicing, policy opcode modification, and custom opcode development.
  • Demonstrated expertise in opcode development following best practices for memory management and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, enterprise integrations, and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, containerization, Kubernetes, or modernization initiatives is a plus.
  • Strong software development skills in C, SQL, Python, and Java within Unix/Linux environments.
  • Experience integrating with payment processors/gateways such as Paymentech or Worldpay.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise applications in production environments.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and coding assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex CLI.
  • Expert ability to resolve critical technical issues and broad design matters across complex enterprise platforms, with deep SMS and Oracle BRM expertise and broad knowledge of adjacent enterprise disciplines.
  • Proven ability to exercise independent judgment and creativity in ambiguous, high-impact assignments where architecture decisions affect customer experience, billing accuracy, revenue operations, compliance, and platform resilience.
  • Demonstrated ability to build formal networks with key technical and business decision makers and influence architecture strategy across multiple teams or functions.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.

  • Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.

  • Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.

  • Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.

  • Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.

  • Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.

  • Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.

  • Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.

  • Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.

  • Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.

  • Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.

  • Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.

  • Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.

  • Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.

  • Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.

  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.

  • Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.

  • Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.

  • People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.

  • Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.

  • Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

job.title: Senior Staff Portfolio Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

The Senior Staff Portfolio Manager is a senior individual contributor on the Planning & Portfolio team, responsible for the operational integrity and strategic governance of SiriusXM's technology portfolio. This role owns executive reporting, financial data governance, program tooling, and cross-functional coordination across Lisa Garnett-Willis's engineering and technology organization. The role requires strong financial acumen, deep familiarity with portfolio tooling and data infrastructure, and the ability to partner directly with Finance, Engineering leadership, and senior TPM leads. In addition, this role defines and continuously improves portfolio governance standards (cadences, controls, and success metrics) that drive portfolio transparency, audit readiness, and delivery accountability across the organization.


What you’ll do:

  • Own quarterly capitalization and FP&A coordination, ensuring timesheet data and project classifications are accurate and audit-ready at the organizational level. This includes establishing classification standards, resolving ambiguous cases with Finance and Engineering leadership, and proactively surfacing capitalization risk and remediation actions.
  • Maintain and evolve the Team Resource Manager (TRM), EOS, and related portfolio data infrastructure by improving data models, integrations, and controls to ensure a trusted, scalable single source of truth for portfolio and financial reporting.
  • Drive executive reporting cycles including WBR inputs, OK2 gate review documentation, and exec dashboard maintenance and translate insights into clear decision-ready narratives, recommendations, and follow-through on actions.
  • Partner with TPM and Engineering leads on SDLC governance, initiative tracking, and Jira hierarchy compliance by defining standards, enabling adoption, and running periodic compliance/quality checks to ensure portfolio health is visible and actionable.
  • Manage 3P vendor SOWs and Jira Cloud migration deliverables in coordination with Legal and Engineering including scope governance, milestone tracking, vendor performance management, and risk/issue escalation.
  • Own portfolio documentation and process standards; ensure team knowledge is captured and scalable through playbooks, templates, and training that increase consistency and reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.
  • Provide senior portfolio management support for complex, cross-functional programs including escalation tracking and stakeholder reporting by driving alignment on scope, milestones, dependencies, and executive communications across multiple teams.
  • Help define and mature portfolio governance practices across the organization including the operating model for portfolio reviews, gates, and metrics, and the continuous improvement roadmap based on stakeholder feedback and data.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 7 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Strong financial acumen; direct experience with capitalization, CapEx tracking, or FP&A processes required
  • Vendor Management experience including SOW governance and delivery/financial performance management.
  • Proficiency with Jira, EOS or similar enterprise portfolio tooling, and Google Workspace with ability to define standards and improve data quality at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment in ambiguous environments with competing priorities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and high bar for data quality and process rigor (controls, auditability, and repeatable operating cadences).
  • Experience shaping or maturing governance practices at the organizational level preferred
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $156,200 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

  • Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.

  • Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.

  • Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

  • Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.

  • Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

  • Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.

  • Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

  • Demonstrated experience owning Enterprise program strategy — including multi-year roadmap partnership, portfolio-level decision support, and org-wide process improvement — not just execution.

  • Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.

  • Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.

  • Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.

  • Proven ability to drive delivery across tightly coupled, interdependent systems at scale.

  • Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.

The Vice President, Consumer Strategy will be responsible for developing a clear, actionable understanding of our consumers and translating that understanding into strategic direction for the business. The role is designed to move us beyond individual research findings and data points to a cohesive point of view on the consumer and what it means for our business. This leader will work closely with Commercial Analytics & Data Science, Consumer & Brand Marketing, Engagement Strategy, Product, Programming and other partners to ensure consumer understanding informs strategic decisions across the organization. The role requires a unique combination of consumer intuition, strategic synthesis, structured thinking and commercial judgment, along with the ability to turn complex and sometimes conflicting information into clear priorities and compelling strategic narratives.

Dafür schaffen wir ein angenehmes, offenes und inspirierendes Umfeld, das Produktivität und Kreativität fördert.

Das Team von The Orchard trifft sich von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro. Freitags wird in der Regel im Homeoffice gearbeitet.

Was du tun wirst:

  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertriebsverträgen mit Labels und Künstler:innen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Musikverlags- und Merchandising-Verträgen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertragsänderungen, Abtretungen und Kündigungen nach Bedarf.
  • Unterstützung bei Mergers & Acquisitions im deutschen Markt.
  • Beratung der Business- und globalen Legal-Teams zu Fragestellungen des deutschen Rechts und der hiesigen Praxis.
  • Mitarbeit im globalen Legal-Team, um Stakeholder:innen vor Ort rechtlich zu beraten.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung, Optimierung und Aktualisierung von Standardvertragsmustern.
  • Mitverantwortung für die Bearbeitung und Beilegung rechtlicher Ansprüche.

 Wer du bist:

  • Juristischer Abschluss und 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position und Branche.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Musikrechts.
  • Erfahrung mit Vertriebsverträgen.
  • Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in der Vertragsgestaltung.
  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in allen Facetten des Musikgeschäfts.
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent mit der Fähigkeit, eine Vielzahl von Projekten im Blick zu behalten, zu priorisieren und sich auf wechselnde Prioritäten einzustellen.
  • Ausgeprägt selbstständige Arbeitsweise und nachweisliche Erfahrung im erfolgreichen Abschluss von Deals.

  

English Translation:

The Orchard has an immediate opening in Business and Legal Affairs at our Berlin office. As a qualified lawyer, you will support the day-to-day legal needs and requirements of our Business and Legal Affairs team.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution and artist services company headquartered in New York and operating in 45 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Bad Bunny, Gorillaz, and Raye. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, we partner with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world.

A passion for music and the music industry is a must. Your professional and confident approach will enable you to build and maintain strong relationships with your colleagues and external clients. In turn, we provide a comfortable, social, and engaging environment that encourages productivity and creativity.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising label and artist distribution agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising music publishing and merchandising agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising amendments, assignments, and terminations as needed.
  • Assistance with mergers and acquisitions in the German market.
  • Advising the business and global legal teams on issues particular to German law and practice.
  • Working within the global legal team to provide in-territory legal advice to stakeholders.
  • Assisting to create, refine, and update standard contract forms.
  • Co-managing legal claim resolution processes.

Who You Are:

  • Law Degree and 2-4 years of experience in a similar position and industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of German music law.
  • Experience with distribution contracts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Specialised knowledge throughout all facets of the music business.

job.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Coordinator is a key support role within the Digital Marketing & Audience Development team, providing hands-on assistance across artist and label campaigns. The role will work closely with Digital, Marketing, Social & Content, Influencer and wider label teams to support domestic and international artist campaigns across paid, owned and earned digital channels. The Coordinator will build and deliver email communications, support database growth and segmentation, and maintain CRM best practice. Alongside this, they will gain broad experience across digital marketing, including social media, content, creator campaigns, digital platforms, reporting and campaign coordination.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is highly organised, digitally savvy, creative and passionate about music and internet culture, and who is looking to develop a broad career in digital marketing.

What you'll do:

Digital Campaign Support

  • Serve as a key contact for the digital marketing team, collaborating with internal managers, artists, labels, and external partners to deliver domestic and international campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day project workflows, including campaign timelines, tracking documents, asset folders, release links, and general digital housekeeping.
  • Support paid media execution, creator and influencer activations, fan acquisition pages, competitions, and pre-save campaigns

Social, Content & Owned Channels

  • Support the delivery and scheduling of social media plans across label-owned platforms, including TikTok and Instagram, while contributing to overall channel strategy.
  • Capture mobile-first content at live shows, events, and artist shoots, performing basic short-form video editing like cutting clips, subtitling, and adding trending audio.
  • Identify strategic opportunities across social channels and campaign touchpoints to convert social followers into owned channel audiences.

CRM & Audience Development

  • Build, schedule, and execute targeted email and SMS CRM campaigns for artist and label accounts, maintaining the master CRM calendar.
  • Grow first-party fan databases by managing data capture across websites, pre-saves, and competitions while maintaining CRM data hygiene and privacy compliance.
  • Develop, test, and optimise automated fan journeys, sign-up flows, and lifecycle messaging to improve overall campaign conversion.

Reporting & Insights

  • Collect and analyse campaign metrics across social, CRM, paid media, and UGC activity using internal and external reporting tools.
  • Consolidate performance data into regular reports and share actionable insights to inform future marketing strategy and campaign optimization.

Trends, Innovation & Team Development

  • Monitor emerging digital trends, platform updates, streaming features, and internet culture to identify creative opportunities for artists.
  • Prepare internal presentations, case studies, and educational updates for the broader marketing team and assist in key digital partner meetings

Who you are:

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time. 

What you'll do 

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

job.title: Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, Argentina - The Orchard
job.description:
ABOUT THE ORCHARD

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, your role is crucial in driving the success of our clients' releases through innovative marketing plans and strategies, and data-driven campaigns. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for labels and artists leading discussions around marketing strategies, campaign planning, data collection, and ongoing performance evaluation.
  • Conceptualize and execute creative marketing campaigns in order to remain at the forefront of marketing and audience development.
  • Oversee and manage marketing campaigns for high-priority releases, focusing on specific artist and label initiatives within a given team. Drive informed decisions based on data and performance metrics.
  • Analyze the impact of campaigns and the value of various fan and audience segments, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to optimize both pre- and post-release strategies.
  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of platforms and tools to build audiences, engage fanbases, and drive demand.
  • Provide regular reports and key insights to team and regional leads regarding campaign success and areas for improvement.
  • Seek out opportunities for the development of the artist and label roster through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts.
  • Work with multiple departments and teams to bring innovative marketing activations to life, both digitally and in the real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives.
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of standard processes, with the ability to act with urgency and strategic vision.

Who you are:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in strategy marketing
  • Experience in music marketing is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Passionate about music, a regular attendee of live shows, interested in discovering new music, trend-savvy, and curious.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines
  • A strong passion for music, creativity and marketing trends
  • Proven track record of success in developing marketing plans and strategies
  • Proficiency in Spanish and English is required
  • Extensive knowledge of the music industry, including trends, challenges, and opportunities
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with artists, labels, and other key partners
  • Creative thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing and promotional campaigns

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.description:

En Sony Music Entertainment, impulsamos el viaje creativo. Asegurar que todos los lanzamientos de fonogramas de SONY MUSIC sean acreditados dentro de las sociedades de gestión colectiva para garantizar el recaudo de estos usos en los establecimientos públicos y apoyar la operación del área financiera en ciertas actividades puntuales.

job.title: Manager, Campaign Operations - RCA Records
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Campaign Operations to join a newly established function at RCA Records. Campaign Operations is the connective tissue between departments — tracking, surfacing, and flagging cross-departmental activity across the full roster to ensure that when a decision gets made in one room, every other team knows what it means for them.

Reporting to the Campaign Operations Lead and sitting within the SVP Commercial Partnerships organization, this role will own the day-to-day operational relationship with a cluster of departments, monitoring their workflows, lead times, and deliverables across every active artist campaign. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of how to work cross-functionally between departments, thrives in ambiguity, and brings the kind of diplomatic, low-ego energy that builds trust without creating friction.

What you'll do:

  • Department Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day operational relationship with an assigned cluster of departments. Learn their workflows, lead times, tools, and pain points. Become the person they trust to represent their status accurately.
  • Release Readiness Monitoring: Track workability status across all active releases. Surface gaps in clearances, masters, artwork, agreements, and delivery timelines before they become blockers.
  • Budget Visibility & Tracking: Monitor campaign spend against approved budgets across the roster. Surface divergence, flag overages, and track budget status in real time so that the people who own those decisions have full information. Campaign Ops does not approve or deny spend — it ensures the numbers are visible and accurate.
  • Cross-Department Flagging: Identify when an issue in one department affects another. Surface the connection, prompt the teams involved, and track resolution.
  • Meeting Support: Contribute to cross-department meeting preparation, transcript processing, and action item tracking. Help produce Goal Briefs and meeting notes for distribution.
  • Artist Briefing Support: Assist in producing artist briefings and prep packages for new signings and key roster moments. Compile information from multiple departments into a single, clear picture.
  • Data Layer Maintenance: Keep shared operational data current and accurate across Airtable and internal dashboards. Ensure department status is reflected in real time.
  • Escalation: When an issue cannot be resolved at the department level, route to the Campaign Operations Lead for consolidation. The team speaks as a unit.
  • Tool & System Awareness: Stay current on internal tools, Sony enterprise systems, and department-specific platforms. Surface what exists, who uses it, and where there are gaps or duplication.

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 3 years in the music industry, entertainment, media, or a similar field, with previous experience working collaboratively across various teams and departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities across a large roster.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams. You can translate technical or operational information into clear, concise language for varied audiences.
  • Familiarity with project management or operational tracking tools (Airtable, Asana, Monday, or similar). Willingness to learn new systems quickly.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Comfortable tracking dozens of open items across multiple workstreams without losing threads.
  • Diplomatic and low-ego. This role requires navigating departmental sensitivities without creating friction. You amplify other teams’ work — you don’t add oversight.
  • Curiosity about how systems work and why they break. Interest in process improvement, data visibility, and operational design.
  • You are a motivated self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

California based applicants have certain rights under California law. Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details.

job.title: Show Accountant - Senbla
job.description:
Senbla is a leading live entertainment promoter and producer, presenting over 600 shows annually across the UK and internationally. We specialise in premium touring productions, orchestral concerts, contemporary pop and rock performances, theatrical and performing arts, and immersive, experiential events. Our work spans indoor and outdoor settings and includes family entertainment, unique live experiences, and collaborations with world-class artists, orchestras, and IP partners. As part of the Sony Music Masterworks family, Senbla delivers distinctive, high-quality shows that combine artistic integrity with professional production excellence. 
 
We are looking for a Show Accountant to join the finance department of Senbla and Luna Entertainment Group. The main purpose of the role is to provide specialised support in managing and processing venue settlements and bookkeeping for all shows across the UK, working directly under the supervision of the Finance Director. 
 
This is an ideal opportunity for someone with at least 2 years’ experience in concert promotions, event management or music industry finance who is looking to deepen their experience in the operational and financial side of live events within a dynamic and growing company. 

The Show Accountant will support the management and processing of venue settlements and bookkeeping activities across the business, working closely with the Finance Director to ensure accurate and timely financial processing, reconciliations and reporting. 

What you'll do:

Bookkeeping 

  • Processing supplier invoices and weekly BACS payments and setting up new supplier accounts
  • Raise customer sales invoices and chase debtors
  • Processing monthly credit card spends and Revolut spends, ensuring all receipts are saved
  • Monitoring and reconciling supplier statements, credit cards and show floats
  • Monitoring supplier and debtor month-end positions
  • Performing bank reconciliations across multiple bank accounts
  • Overseeing the Accounts inbox and responding to finance-related queries from suppliers and budget holders
  • Supporting year-end audits 

Show Settlement Accounting 

  • Chase final venue settlements for all previous night shows each morning
  • Liaise with promoters and budget holders when queries arise during the settlement process
  • Review venue settlements upon receipt and post to the Xero accounting system
  • Maintain accurate records of settlement status and processing progress
  • Ensure all venue settlements are processed by month-end
  • Provide monthly status reports on settlement processing to the Finance Director
  • Maintain a clear audit trail of settlement activities and approvals
  • Assist the Finance Director and Operations team with updates to show P&Ls
  • Support the Finance Director with preliminary show reconciliations
  • Identification and resolution of issues as they arise
  • Apply a continuous improvement mindset to support robust and efficient processes and system improvements
  • Develop strong relationships within finance and the wider business  

Who you are:

  • At least 2 years’ experience in concert promotions, event management or music industry finance.
  • Excellent numeracy skills with strong attention to detail and intermediate level Excel proficiency
  • Good understanding of VAT treatments
  • Understanding of FEU taxation and withholding tax
  • Studying towards a finance qualification such as AAT, CIMA or ACCA 
  • Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage daily deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work methodically through high-volume processing tasks
  • Excellent understanding of financial processes and reconciliation principles

job.description:
The Orchard (a wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment) is a leading music distribution company operating in over 40 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Ozuna, Skepta, Jorja Smith, and Kelsea Ballerini. With cutting edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world. At The Orchard, the focus is to provide a comfortable, social and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The Solutions Associate Manager (Korea) acts as the primary client-facing operational and administrative liaison between local partners and The Orchard’s global Legal, Finance, Operations and Rights Management teams. Moving away from traditional standalone label support, this role owns the full end-to-end client onboarding, supports digital release logistics, handles financial/administrative escalations, and delivers actionable performance analytics. The ideal candidate is a corss-functional problem solver with a strict “see-it-through” mindset, dedicated to eliminating operational friction, safeguarding royalty flows, and supporting roster growth.

 

What you'll do:

End-to-End Client Onboarding & Back-Office Integration

  • Oversee the complete operational and administrative onboarding lifecycle of new Korean artists and labels, from the account set up to payment readiness, and catalog ingestion, working in close partnership with the Relationship Management Team.
  • Guide clients through the onboarding process, conduct platform demonstrations, and ensure seamless system adoption.
  • Resolve payment blockers by gathering, verifying, and processing financial/banking documentations in coordination with global Finance and Contract Admin teams. 
  • Manage administrative catalog transitions, including payee changes (LOD, assignments, entity name changes), payment holds, and client offboarding workflows, as needed

Release Operations & Product Logistics Support

  • Autonomously manage complex digital release setups (eg. timed releases), and advanced metadata updates in collaboration with the Relationship Management Team
  • Act as the local escalation point for product blocks or copyright/compliance flags, with Content Review Team
  • Coordinate with centralized Operations to process catalog adjustments, remaps, takedowns, transfers, and store whitelisting

Domestic Client Support

  • Deliver release schedules and metadata updates seamlessly to major domestic DSPs
  • Compile, update and optimize master release lists of key local titles, tracking placement updates and providing feedback loops to partners and internal stakeholders. 

Data Analytics & Performance Reporting 

  • Establish and manage a structured data reporting routine across release cycles (Day 1, Daily, Weekly, Monthly) to monitor streaming trends, algorithmic pick-ups, and market performance. 
  • Analyze listener demographics, geographic consumption spikes, and playlist performance to provide actionable insights for localized commercial and marketing campaigns. 
  • Utilize internal BI tools (eg. Looker) to monitor monthly client revenue fluctuations, identifying growth opportunities or investigating underlying operational causes behind revenue drops

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Global Alignment

  • Investigate and resolve day-to-day administrative, financial, and operational client inquiries with end-to-end ownership, ensuring a streamlined and positive partner experience.
  • Collaborate with Rights Management, Legal and Claims teams to safeguard content integrity (eg. ownership disputes, asset remaps, rights conflicts)
  • Maintain internal system fluency (including proprietary back-end applications (eg. Zendesk), and obtain necessary industry certifications/standards.

 

Who you are:

  • Minimum 5+ years of total professional experience in digital operations, client administration, or content distribution (including at least 2+ years of direct experience within music distribution, record label, or digital media platforms sectors)
  • A strong advantage in digital media, content, music or platform-based businesses
  • Solid understanding of digital supply chain workflows, metadata standards, and streaming platform mechanics. Proficiency with platform tools (eg. Spotify for Artists, iTunes Connect, or YouTube CMS) and proprietary backend content system.
  • Proactive problem solver with a strong financial/contractual baseline. Highly advanced organizational skills with the ability to multi-task, prioritize under tight deadlines, and maintain a strict “see-it-through” problem-solving mindset.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Korean is required (written and spoken).

job.title: Strategic Partnerships Coordinator - Ceremony Of Roses
job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership

The Strategic Partnerships Coordinator is the organization engine focused on product research, account support, invoicing and supply partnerships.

Invoice Administration:

Product & Shipping Diligence:

  • Run product diligence: specs, quality, compliance before goods go into production.
  • Run shipping diligence: tracking, timelines, delivery confirmation — to keep supply-only and VIP orders on schedule.

Cross-Team Support:

  • Support the New Business & Strategy team and Account Management team with administrative and operational work, so each can stay focused on prospecting and account growth.

Who you are:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented — comfortable owning diligence and invoicing work where small mistakes have real financial consequences.
  • Strong follow-through; can track many open items — invoices, shipments, deals — at once without dropping any.

What we give you:

job.title: Director - Accounting
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Accounting, someone with a passion for numbers, to join our great finance team. Joining our Accounting & Tax department in Berlin, you will serve as the senior accounting leader locally  and directly to the VP Group Controller. As an ambitious and driven team member, you bring enthusiasm to make a significant impact across multiple areas. You will hold genuine accountability from day one, with the autonomy to elevate our financial group reporting standard.

You will take full ownership of group consolidation, IFRS financial reporting, German local statutory reporting (HGB), intercompany accounts, and technical accounting positions. Additionally, you will guide the annual audit process and direct the local accounting team and serve as a counterpart to the Berlin-Based Tax Team.

This position combines strategic enhancement with core stewardship. While financial consolidation currently relies on Oracle Fusion and spreadsheets, you will lead the selection and roll-out of a dedicated platform. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders across US accounting leadership, Treasury, Tax, and external partners.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare consolidated IFRS financial statements and related Notes
  • Manage monthly consolidated reporting packages
  • Oversee German HGB statutory financial filings and directing local audits
  • Drive end-to-end management, reconciliation, and settlement of intercompany activity across all subsidiaries
  • Evaluate complex technical accounting developments under IFRS, drafting technical memorandums, and offering guidance across business functions
  • Serve as primary liaison for external auditors during annual group audits, ensuring high-quality audit deliverables and prompt issue resolution
  • Mentor and expand the local Berlin accounting team, overseeing AP, procurement operations and reconciliation of VAT/Sales Tax accounts in cooperation with the Tax Team
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of a new software solution for group financial consolidation
  • Partner closely with US finance leadership to align accounting policies and improve group-wide close efficiency

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience within top-tier audit firms or corporate group accounting environments
  • Fully certified professional credentials (such as CPA, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer, ACCA, or an equivalent designation)
  • Practical, hands-on background in IFRS multi-entity consolidation, with demonstrated experience preparing or auditing full consolidated statements and disclosures across foreign currencies
  • Solid understanding of German HGB statutory framework, local compliance, and tax audit procedures
  • Proven supervisory leadership, managing and nurturing the professional development of accounting personnel
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and German, paired with strong, constructive interpersonal skills
  • Advanced capabilities in Excel and familiarity navigating modern systems across ERP, financial close, and procurement technologies
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, high self-motivation, and a collaborative mindset
  • Thriving in a dynamic, high-growth environment focused on high performance and tangible impact
  • Prior involvement in implementing financial consolidation platforms is a plus
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion tools is preferred
  • Background in tech, digital media, music, or subscription businesses, including specialized royalty and intellectual property accounting, is desirable

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Not located in Berlin? No worries, we offer extensive relocation support including allowances, one way flights, temporary accommodation and, by partnering with Startcon, on the ground support on arrival
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • We offer free German courses at beginning, intermediate and advanced
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.
