job.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Artist Success
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Artist Success team. You will take technical ownership of the tools that help artists understand their audiences, grow their careers, and help the music industry discover its next stars. You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences
  • Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum
  • Work as a peer to Product Managers and Designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way
  • Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase
  • Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

Experience and Background:

  • 4-6+ years of experience with React and modern frontend development, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and drive best practices; experience with native iOS or Android applications is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL
  • Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI and agentic tools to improve quality and velocity, while applying sound judgment around when human expertise is essential and maintaining code quality, product standards, maintainability, and user experience

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. | Miami, Florida

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Position Overview

Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. (“SBS”), a leading Hispanic media and entertainment company, is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer to lead the Company’s finance organization and serve as a strategic partner to senior management.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the CFO will oversee the Company’s financial strategy and operations, including accounting and financial reporting, treasury, budgeting and forecasting, financial planning and analysis, internal controls, audit, tax oversight, and financial systems.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, commercially minded finance executive with strong leadership skills and experience operating in a complex, multi-market organization.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the Company’s overall finance and accounting functions.
  • Partner with executive leadership on financial strategy, business planning and operational performance.
  • Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash management, treasury and working capital.
  • Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting and maintain strong accounting and internal-control processes.
  • Lead financial planning and analysis, including performance reporting, variance analysis and key financial and operating metrics.
  • Oversee external audit, tax and other financial compliance matters.
  • Provide financial analysis and support for strategic initiatives, investments and business opportunities.
  • Partner with operating leadership to evaluate performance across markets, products and business lines.
  • Lead, develop and strengthen the finance organization, promoting accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting, automation and business processes.
  • Support corporate finance, banking, capital markets and transactional activities, as appropriate.
  • Provide clear and effective financial reporting and analysis to senior management and the Board of Directors.
Qualifications
  • Significant progressive finance leadership experience, ideally as a CFO, divisional CFO or senior finance executive.
  • Strong experience in accounting, financial reporting, FP&A, treasury, budgeting, forecasting and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated experience leading finance functions in a complex, multi-entity or multi-location organization.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
  • Experience working with senior executives, Boards, auditors, banks and other external partners.
  • Experience with financial systems, automation and process improvement.
  • Media, broadcasting, digital media, advertising, entertainment or related industry experience is preferred.
  • Public-company experience is preferred.
  • M&A, financing and capital markets experience is a plus.
  • CPA and/or advanced degree preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is highly desirable.
Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a hands-on, strategic and collaborative leader who combines strong financial discipline with a practical understanding of business operations. The individual should be comfortable operating in a dynamic environment, developing high-performing teams, improving processes and partnering across functions to support growth and long-term value creation.

Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Lead Corporate Security Engineer
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the role

The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors. You’ll be building from 0 → 1 in some places and 1 → 10 in others. What we don't have yet is someone who owns corporate security as a domain — who decides what the bar is, sequences the work to get there, and sees the next problem before it becomes a fire drill. That's this role. You'll own the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. Our senior IT engineers run the platforms day to day and are your closest partners — you make their work better, not harder. How this role works with IT Ownership splits by layer, not by system. Our senior IT engineers own the run; you own the standard and the direction. You own the corporate security roadmap. What we secure, in what order, to what bar. You bring it to IT leadership and the CISO aligned, not for arbitration IT engineering owns platform operations. Okta, Lumos, Kandji, and the wider SaaS portfolio are administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce You raise the bar around you. You make your reasoning explicit so IT engineers make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path You're accountable for the outcome, not just the proposal. You decide, you communicate the tradeoff, and you own what happens next The people who do well here get their plans stronger by exposing them to the people who run the systems, and they carry the room without needing the org chart to settle it. job.title: Motion Designer, Paid Social (Contract)
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage. This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them. If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you. Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

What You’ll Do

Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok. Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion. Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage. Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing. Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed. Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board. Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance. Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working.

What You’ll Need

A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work. Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts. A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks. Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality. A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked. Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance. Nice-to-Haves

Experience

at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand. Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly. Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets. Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster. A love of music and an eye for culture. Compensation This is a contract role paying $70 to $90 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. About The Role

For most people, making music has always felt out of reach. Suno is changing that, and mobile is where that change will happen for the majority of people. We are looking for a Senior Qualitative UX Researcher to own the deepest questions about the people we haven't reached yet. Not the users who already know what a stem is, but the ones who open the app with no idea what's possible and no vocabulary for what they want. Understanding how creative confidence gets built, across a very wide range of ages and levels of experience, is one of the highest-leverage research problems at the company right now. You'll be the research partner to the PM and designer leading mobile create and working alongside them to address shared product questions. You’ll also collaborate with the researcher focused on rapid mobile evaluation, ensuring that usability insights and foundational research inform one another. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership. Decide what's worth studying, and say no to what won't change a decision. Go where the creating happens - Lead in-person and in-field research, including in-home sessions and sessions with more than one participant at once, such as household and family settings. Some of the most important behavior here will never show up in a remote unmoderated test. Be a true partner, not a service desk - Sit with the mobile create PM, designer, and engineers as decisions are being made. Bring user signal early enough to change the shape of the work, not late enough to only validate it. Turn findings into things the org keeps using - Segmentations, journey and jobs-to-be-done frameworks, opportunity maps, design principles that outlive any single launch and get cited in rooms you're not in. running in-person research with families, including in-home and in-context sessions, sessions with more than one participant at a time, and the consent and assent workflows that come with them Rigorous methodological judgment and the range to match method to question rather than reaching for the same study every time Sound instincts about ethics and participant comfort with people who are not professional research subjects Fluency with quantitative data. job.title: Trust & Safety Operations Manager
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/bWZ30M98bvirsCPq The role You will own the operating floor of Trust & Safety at Suno: review queues, vendor capacity, quality programs, SLAs, and escalation workflows. Our enforcement system blends automated decisioning with human judgment, and your job is to make the human side of that system fast, accurate, and worth every dollar it costs. You will report to our Trust & Safety lead and work closely with Product, Eng, Legal, Comms, and the broader Operations team.

What you'll do

Run day-to-day enforcement operations: queue health, latency, SLA attainment and escalation handling across all content categories. Own vendor and BPO performance: capacity forecasting, quality enforcement, contract performance and site management. Build and run the training, QA, and calibration program that keeps decision quality measurable and improving. Manage capacity planning against rapid volume growth, including the tradeoffs between headcount, vendor spend, and automation. Define tooling requirements for reviewer workflows and partner with Engineering to ship them. Support reviewer wellness and resilience programs for the teams doing the hardest work on the platform. What you'll bring 5+ years in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or CX operations, including 2+ years directly managing reviewers or vendor teams. Ownership of operational metrics you can speak to concretely: SLA attainment, queue latency, QA scores, cost per decision, reviewer utilization. Hands-on vendor or BPO management with real performance accountability, not just relationship handling.

Experience

building or running a QA and calibration program with measurable decision-quality outcomes. Nice to have Operating

experience

alongside ML-assisted enforcement: queue routing on model scores, human-in-the-loop workflows. Reviewer wellness and resilience program exposure. UGC or generative AI platform background. Perks &

job.title: Activations Technician
job.description:
Univision Local Media in Miami, Florida is currently seeking an Activations Technician who is sociable, organized and motivated. The successful candidate will be assertive, customer service oriented and bilingual. The Activations Coordinator will be responsible for implementing station promotions, contesting and interacting with clients, listeners and general public during off site promotional activities. Candidate will also have radio and television production knowledge and the ability to adapt to multiple positions during the week all under the multimedia production environment.

 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in organization and execution of all station promotions, events, and community support activities.
  • Execute the documentation process of all on-air contests, including creating winner forms, distributing forms to appropriate control rooms, making prizes available for winners in an efficient manner for front desk pick up.
  • Ensure complete integrity of prize distribution process, maintain winner files, and keep these records.
  • Assist with writing Official Rules for all contests to be distributed to Program Directors, Air Talent, Reception, and Sales Management
  • Create and maintain records of performance for all remotes, station events, promotional and liner announcements, and other station activities in the specific Promotional File
  • Copy writing of promotional spots and translation of documents such as commercial copy, letters, as needed
  • Assist with on-site Promotional activities including set up, tables, banner placement, inflatables, tents, P.A. systems and other promotional displays
  • Maintain, organize, and perform routine inventory of all promotional remote and station equipment.
  • Ability to create basic presentations and proposals for sales and promotions
  • Will aid in the development and production of promotional content in Spanish for news and commercials including TV, radio, digital and local events.
  • Production knowledge desired - ability to provide technical production and promotional support for live broadcasts, news and commercials productions including TV, radio, digital and local events.
  • Most importantly, the perfect candidate should have good attitude, be proactive and work well in a fast-paced deadline driven environment.
  • Other duties as deemed necessary.

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Must be able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Ability to implement station promotions
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and able to learn project specific software
  • Must have excellent organizational skills and able to work with tight deadlines
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish - written and spoken)
  • Must be able to drive and have a valid Florida driver’s license with a good driving record

 

DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School Diploma or GED and Prior Experience in similar position desired
  • Basic Knowledge of Adobe CC Suite and studio/field production environment experience
  • Knowledge of social media, posting applications
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and on multiple tasks simultaneously

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.   Must be able to drive a Company vehicle.

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Employment/education will be verified.
  • Must be willing to work from locations in FL, fully onsite, remote, and/or hybrid.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

 

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Analista Order to Cash para integrarse a la Direccion de Servicios de Compra a Pago GBS       .

El área de Revenue Recognition es responsable de validar, analizar y registrar oportunamente el reconocimiento de ingresos derivados de los servicios prestados, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas contables, controles internos y lineamientos corporativos establecidos.


Sobre ti

Eres una persona analítica, organizada y orientada al detalle, con capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información y detectar variaciones o inconsistencias en los datos. Te distingues por tu capacidad para estructurar información, interpretar resultados y proponer mejoras que contribuyan a la eficiencia de los procesos.


Tu día a día

  • Analizar y validar información relacionada con el reconocimiento de ingresos de acuerdo con las politicas y lineamientos establecidos.

  • Realizar conciliaciones y revisiones de información finandiera para asegurar la integridad y precisión de los registros.

  • Elaborar reportes y análisis mediante el uso de herramientas de Excel.

  • Identificar diferencias, variaciones o incidencias en la información y dar seguimiento hasta su resolución.

  • Mantener controles y evidencia documental que soporten el reconocimiento de ingresos.

  • Atender solicitudes de información de clientes internos, auditoria interna y auditoria externa.

  • Participar activamente en iniciativas de mejora continua y automatización de procesos.

  • Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para asegurar la correcta interpretación y registro de la información oeprativa y financiera.

Tu deberías de tener

  • Licenciatura trunca o terminada en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración o carrera afín.

  • Manejo intermedioavanzado de Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)

  • Experiencia en el uso de tablas dinamicas, formulas y analisis de información.

  • Capacidad analitica y orientación al detalle.

  • Habilidad para trabajar con grandes volumenes de datos.

  • Comunicación efectiva y facilidad para trabajar en equipo.

  • Deseable experiencia en procesos administrativos, financieros o contables.

  • Modalidad de trabajo: Hibrido

Disponibilidad de tiempo completo para laborar en un horario de 9 a 7 con dos horas de comida de 2 a 4

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented and driven Assignment Desk Editor based in Miami to join its news team. The ideal candidate will bring strong editorial judgment, production experience, and a passion for breaking news. This role is responsible for coordinating story development, securing high-profile guests, booking interviews, field producing, and ensuring coverage is compelling and relevant across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. The successful candidate will manage story assignments, coordinate logistics, support field crews, and follow up on daily newsroom workflows across multiple news programs and platforms. This individual must be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Constantly monitor and respond to breaking news and developing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Monitor news wires, social media, scanners, broadcasts, and online sources to quickly identify breaking news opportunities.
  • Generate, research, verify, plan, and develop story ideas for newscasts, digital platforms, and special coverage.
  • Coordinate daily story production with reporters, photographers, and multimedia journalists by gathering visual elements, securing video feeds, and arranging interviews relevant to assignments.
  • Secure high-profile guests, newsmakers, public figures, and subject matter experts.
  • Coordinate and manage live remotes, video feeds, live shots, and interview logistics under tight deadlines.
  • Coordinate field crews throughout the news gathering and production process, including scheduling interviews and providing accurate logistical information.
  • Continuously update stories with the latest developments and information.
  • Maintain the iNews system updated with crew locations, assignments, and timelines.
  • Monitor law enforcement, fire communications, scanners, wires, and beat checks for breaking news and spot coverage opportunities.
  • Assist writers, producers, editors, and digital teams with information gathering and story updates.
  • Arrange, download, and supervise incoming video feeds.
  • Participate in editorial meetings and communicate daily coverage plans and developments.
  • Assist with news production and special projects as assigned.
  • Field produce and travel as needed for major news coverage and special assignments.
  • Stay informed on national and international current events, legal developments, and culturally relevant topics.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing breaking news situations and adapting quickly to changes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines independently.
  • Be available to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news and continuous coverage situations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • BS/BA or MA in Communications, Journalism, New Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Minimum of 2 years of newsroom experience required.
  • At least 1 year of experience as a Producer and/or Assignment Editor preferred.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of current affairs.
  • Highly motivated, creative, assertive, detail-oriented, and organized.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience managing multiple social media platforms.
  • Basic video editing knowledge.
  • Ability to monitor and record multiple video feeds simultaneously.
  • Experience working with non-linear editing and archive systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, iNews, Avid, live feed systems, and social media platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of city agencies, public safety operations, and key newsmakers preferred.
  • Must be willing to work onsite in Miami, FL.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, reach, and sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Employment and education verification required.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work full-time in the United States.

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario. 

Ubicación:  Ciudad de México (Protele), Insurgentes. 

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio. 

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente. 

Dirigido a estudiantes que desean cumplir con sus prácticas profesionales o servicio social en un entorno corporativo, esta experiencia representa una excelente oportunidad para aplicar tus conocimientos en la práctica. 

Esta experiencia formativa no contempla compensación económica, pero brinda acceso a procesos reales y acompañamiento profesional por parte de un equipo altamente capacitado. 

¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico! 

Acerca del puesto y equipo 

 

Formarás parte del equipo de Cumplimiento Publicitario. El Departamento de Cumplimiento Publicitario es responsable de revisar y aprobar contenido publicitario para televisión, radio y plataformas digitales, garantizando el cumplimiento de las leyes, regulaciones, políticas corporativas y estándares de la industria. El equipo trabaja en estrecha colaboración con áreas comerciales, legales, producción y operaciones para identificar riesgos regulatorios, de propiedad intelectual, derechos de terceros y reclamaciones publicitarias, contribuyendo a la protección de la empresa y sus audiencias. 

 

Como parte de una iniciativa de transformación digital, el área está impulsando proyectos de automatización e Inteligencia Artificial orientados a optimizar sus procesos, reducir tiempos de procesamiento, fortalecer los controles de calidad y mejorar la gestión del conocimiento dentro de la organización. 

 

 

 

 

Sobre ti 

Como Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario, participarás en proyectos enfocados en la mejora continua de procesos mediante Inteligencia Artificial, automatización, organización de información y desarrollo de entornos de prueba. 

Trabajarás junto con especialistas de Cumplimiento Publicitario y colaborarás con diversas áreas de la empresa para diseñar, probar y documentar soluciones que permitan incrementar la eficiencia operativa y la calidad de las revisiones realizadas por el área. 

Tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia práctica en la creación de repositorios de conocimiento, validación de herramientas de IA, pruebas de procesos automatizados y gestión de proyectos de innovación aplicados a entornos reales de negocio. 

 

 

Tu día a día incluirá: 

  • Apoyar en el análisis, documentación y mejora de los procesos de revisión de anuncios publicitarios.  

  • Colaborar en el diseño y organización de repositorios de información, bases de conocimiento y documentación operativa que sirvan como insumo para herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.  

  • Estructurar, clasificar y administrar datos, ejemplos, criterios de revisión y otros insumos necesarios para el desarrollo y validación de soluciones automatizadas.  

  • Participar en la creación y mantenimiento de entornos tipo sandbox para pruebas, experimentación y validación de modelos, automatizaciones y herramientas basadas en IA.  

  • Ejecutar pruebas funcionales y de calidad sobre herramientas de automatización, documentando hallazgos y recomendaciones de mejora.  

  • Apoyar en la generación, organización y optimización de instrucciones (prompts), flujos de trabajo y casos de prueba para sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial.  

  • Dar seguimiento a iniciativas de innovación y colaborar con distintos departamentos para recopilar información y coordinar actividades relacionadas con los proyectos asignados.  

  • Elaborar documentación técnica, reportes, métricas, presentaciones ejecutivas y materiales de capacitación relacionados con los proyectos de mejora.  

  • Contribuir a la identificación de oportunidades para reducir tiempos de procesamiento, eliminar actividades manuales y aumentar la eficiencia operativa del área.  

  • Participar en la validación de resultados generados por herramientas de IA para asegurar su alineación con los criterios de cumplimiento publicitario y calidad establecidos por la organización. 

 

Requisitos 

  • Estudiante activo de Licenciatura en Administración, Mercadotecnia o Publicidad, Negocios Internacionales, Licenciatura en Informática o afin. 

  • Manejo de paquetería Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). 

  • Actitud proactiva, disposición para aprender y buenas habilidades de comunicación. 

  • Interés en automatización de procesos, Inteligencia Artificial, análisis de datos y transformación digital. 

  • Alta capacidad analítica y atención al detalle. 

  •   Habilidades de organización, documentación y seguimiento de proyectos.  

  •   Interés en colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios y participar en iniciativas de innovación tecnológica. 

  • Disponibilidad para realizar tu servicio social o prácticas profesionales de manera presencial en Protele. 

 

Lo que te ofrecemos: 
Experiencia práctica en una empresa líder en medios y entretenimiento 
Experiencia práctica en procesos reales de adquisición de talento. 
Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y profesional 
Oportunidad de desarrollo y aprendizaje continuo 

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

job.title: Camera Operator, Hard
job.description:
Production Operations at Televisa Univision is looking for a Camera Operator, Hard to join our team!


Responsible for the building, operation, and general maintenance of studio hard cameras. This operator must provide creative, fluid movement of the camera on multi-camera productions for News, Sports and Entertainment (studio) shows. 

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Create smooth fluid movements of the camera to enhance the production value of each program. Must be able to pan and tilt camera as well as truck the camera through spaces. 
  • Setup, balance, troubleshoot, and maintain camera and associated equipment. 
  • Operator controls zoom and focus of lens. Good sense of visual composition. 
  • Take direction well and work as a team player. 
  • Operate in a safe and controlled manner to minimize injury to self or others as well as any damage to equipment or property. 
  • Ability to follow a rundown.


YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in television production or equivalent work experience
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with Windows operating systems
  • 3-5 years of experience in control room broadcast facility
  • Experience with Vinten studio pedestals that include balancing, builds and maintenance 
  • Experience with studio config cameras, box lenses and peripherals that include building, troubleshooting and maintenance 
  • Physical ability to truck full size camera pedestal in studio as well as on location shoots 
  • Perform well under pressure and breaking news situations
  • Physical ability to lift camera equipment, lenses and counterweights 
  • Agility to move at a rapid pace as production needs may require 
  • Provide creative input, e.g., assists the Director/ Producer in creating the look of a show, including set design; suggests alternate shots; etc
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) preferred
  • As this position supports 24x7 operation, candidate must, in addition to being able to work regular hours, have on-call availability, and flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.  Additionally, candidate may be required to work on site for extended periods of time to provide coverage in special circumstances, such as, during tropical storm/hurricane.

OUR BENEFITS:

  • TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a data-driven, solutions-oriented Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team in Miami, FL.  This position is responsible for participating in the strategy, trafficking, implementation, optimization and reporting of paid media campaigns across digital & social platforms. Primary campaign goals, (but are not limited to) increased awareness, engagement and conversion to linear tune-in.

The successful candidate will understand how to build a winning campaign and launch from start to end. This individual must have great attention to detail, be proactive, a self-starter, and a collaborator willing to learn and share ideas.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop digital media plans and strategy for TelevisaUnivision property launches; collaborate with internal depts. to find synergies and research data to support and amplify tactics.
  • Lead campaign execution: trafficking, implementation, optimization, and reporting of paid media campaigns across self-serve platforms (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, DV360 programmatic, Spotify ads etc.) and lead communication for digital media buys (LG Ads, Vizio, etc.) and influencer campaigns.
  • Track and interpret results as it relates to main KPIs, making real-time optimizations to increase the effectiveness of campaigns as well as all campaigns that have tune-in study measurement appended to them.
  • Collaborate with creative team and update creative deliverables documents to communicate deadlines and creative needs.
  • Implement A/B tests, learn processes to improve efficiency and drive growth; including, but not limited to ad copy, audiences, keywords, bid strategies, and creative testing.
  • Create VPAID, VAST and 1x1 tags within Google Campaign Manager to track all paid media campaigns with appropriate UTM parameters.
  • Aid in daily reporting and campaign presentations, leveraging in-house business intelligence tools
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders and external vendors
  • Update trackers in real-time and track pacing of all campaign spend and performance

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2-3 years of proven hands-on experience in full execution of digital media planning and buying
  • Hands on experience with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads manager, Google Ads, DV360 or similar programmatic partner. Google Campaign Manager or similar Ad Server
  • Basic understanding of Google Analytics
  • Proficient with MS Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, story-telling and problem-solving skills
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

Desired Skills

  • Knowledge of digital research tools such as comScore, Nielsen, etc. to inform media planning
  • Experience with DOMO or similar business intelligence tools
  • Passion for social media and current social trends 
  • Experience with tracking and onboarding tune-in study measurement campaigns (Videoamp, SambaTV etc)
  • Experience working with social media and activating paid social campaigns
  • Meta Certification or TikTok Certification (Media Planning or Media Buying) is a plus. 
  • Bonus: Working knowledge of one or more social analytics, listening and/or insights tools i.e. Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprout Social, ListenFirst, Tubular, Creator IQ, Comscore Shareablee 
  • Strong Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, with the capability to derive actionable insights from Data  
  • Ability to leverage company-approved AI tools to enhance productivity, improve operational efficiency, and support data-driven problem-solving and decision-making.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be willing to work from office in Doral, FL
  • Employment/education will be verified
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Director, Strategy & Audience Intelligence
job.description:
ABOUT YOU:

  • Audience-first strategic thinker with a strong understanding of consumer behavior, media, and marketing.
  • Able to translate complex research, data, and marketplace intelligence into clear, actionable strategies.
  • Structured thinker who can connect business priorities with audience opportunities.
  • Collaborative leader who can influence across teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Curious and forward-looking, with a strong understanding of evolving consumer and media behaviors.
  • Comfortable working across the U.S. and Mexico while recognizing the unique needs of each market.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Lead strategic planning and audience strategy across the U.S. and Mexico, aligning business priorities with audience and marketplace opportunities.
  • Establish standardized planning frameworks, strategic playbooks, and best practices across marketing campaigns.
  • Develop campaign strategies by connecting business objectives, audience insights, marketplace dynamics, historical learnings, and media opportunities.
  • Build audience architecture, personas, segmentation, and media consumption profiles to inform audience-first marketing and media planning.
  • Partner with Research and Audience Insights to translate consumer behavior, cultural trends, and research into actionable strategies and audience growth opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive activity, consumer behavior, and evolving media trends to identify opportunities and inform strategic recommendations.
  • Establish planning parameters and investment guidelines to help inform marketing priorities and resource allocation.
  • Partner with Marketing Analytics to establish KPIs, learning agendas, and measurement frameworks, translating campaign results into actionable learnings for future planning.
  • Provide strategic direction across the U.S. and Mexico while balancing global priorities with local market needs.
  • Serve as a strategic center of excellence for Marketing, bringing an audience-first perspective to cross-functional planning.
  • Develop and present clear strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, Media, Research, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in marketing strategy, media strategy, audience strategy, consumer insights, communications planning, or a related discipline.
  • Strong strategic planning experience with a demonstrated ability to translate business objectives, consumer insights, and data into actionable strategies.
  • Experience developing audience segmentation, personas, consumer journeys, and other audience frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of the media landscape across linear television, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience with consumer research, audience measurement, media measurement, and business intelligence tools such as Nielsen, MRI-Simmons, Comscore, VideoAmp, Domo, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of campaign measurement, KPIs, learning agendas, reach and frequency, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. Hispanic audiences and the broader multicultural marketplace; Mexico market experience highly preferred.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, storytelling, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred.
  • Proficient with MS Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Must be willing to work from the office in Doral, FL.

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Editor - Temp
job.description:

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented Editor to support news shows . The editor works closely with assigned show producers to ensure material is ready for air.  The responsibilities of the position include following strategies and standard operating procedures established for the group. This individual must be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborator willing to learn and share ideas.

  • Responsible for editing all different types of videos for all network news shows.
  • Edit short form and long form pieces.
  • Ensure all material is delivered in a timely manner (tight deadlines)

  • Expert knowledge editing on Avid Media Composer
  • Knowledge I-news rundown
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) required
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize 
  • Perform well in a fast-paced environment and breaking news situations.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.

job.title: Finance Manager, Digital, Record to Report
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Record to Report (Digital) to support the Digital Finance organization. This role is responsible for overseeing key accounting activities related to the monthly close process, general ledger management, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for the Digital business. The position partners closely with Digital Finance leadership to ensure accurate and timely financial results while driving process improvements, maintaining strong internal controls, and leading a team of accounting professionals. The position reports to the Vice President, Record to Report.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a collaborative and detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at managing competing priorities, solving complex problems, and partnering with leaders across the organization to deliver accurate financial results, strengthen internal controls, and drive continuous process improvements. You are an effective communicator and team player who can build strong relationships and lead accounting professionals to achieve shared goals.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and approve journal entries, ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and close calendar deadlines.
  • Review account reconciliations and ensure they are prepared, reviewed, and certified in accordance with company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Prepare and review quarterly flux analysis packages, providing meaningful explanations of financial results and variances.
  • Partner with the Digital CFO and Finance team to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements.

Accounting and General Ledger Management

  • Manage day-to-day general ledger activities for the Digital business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee accounting for specialized contractual arrangements and obligations.
  • Review accounting treatment related to digital content licensing, produced content, programming rights, obligations, and related cash flow schedules.
  • Interpret and analyze contracts to determine appropriate accounting treatment and financial impact.
  • Lead Oracle ERP Record-to-Report processes, including financial consolidations, allocations, data interfaces, journal posting, period open/close activities, foreign currency exchange rate maintenance, revaluation and translation processes, cash management, subledger-to-ledger reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and governance of cross-validation rules to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Lead, develop, and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance and service levels, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant issues, disputes, and risks to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and enhance accounting procedures, process documentation, and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and implement process and system improvements.

Audit and Compliance

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely delivery of required documentation and analysis.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with SOX and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Projects and Initiatives

  • Support system implementations, integrations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in special projects and ad hoc analyses as requested by Finance leadership.
  • Drive automation and standardization efforts to improve the efficiency of Record-to-Report processes.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 5+ yrs. accounting experience
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Ability to speak/write/understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as there will be work weeks that require more than 40 hours to ensure the Company’s reporting requirements are met.

New Jersey Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000.Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Manager, Payments
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision es la compañía líder de medios en español a nivel mundial! Estamos invirtiendo en nuestro contenido, nuestra gente y nuestras plataformas digitales, de streaming, sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos impulsando el crecimiento de nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, ofrecer experiencias de pago confiables y sin fricciones es fundamental para respaldar nuestro negocio de suscripciones y la experiencia de nuestros usuarios.

 

El equipo de ViX está buscando un Gerente de Pagos responsable de gestionar las relaciones con proveedores de pago, monitorear el desempeño de pagos y apoyar la optimización continua de nuestro ecosistema de pagos digitales.

 

Esta posición trabajará de manera cercana con los equipos de Producto, Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar integraciones de pago, prevención de fraude, optimización de flujos transaccionales y las operaciones diarias relacionadas con pagos. El Gerente de Pagos monitoreará indicadores clave de desempeño, identificará problemas y oportunidades, y trabajará con equipos internos y socios externos para incrementar las tasas de aprobación y reducir la fricción en la experiencia del usuario.

 

TU DÍA A DÍA: (Responsabilidades)

·      Gestionar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores de servicios de pago, adquirentes, procesadores y otros socios de pago.

·      Monitorear el desempeño de pagos, incluyendo tasas de aprobación, disponibilidad, fraude, costos, contracargos y otros KPIs relevantes.

·      Identificar proactivamente problemas y oportunidades relacionados con el desempeño de pagos y coordinar las acciones correctivas correspondientes.

·      Escalar y resolver incidencias operativas con proveedores de pago, minimizando el impacto para los usuarios y el negocio.

·      Participar en la evaluación de nuevos proveedores, tecnologías y soluciones de pago de acuerdo con las necesidades del negocio.

·      Supervisar disputas y contracargos, coordinando con proveedores de pago y equipos internos para minimizar su impacto.

·      Preparar y presentar reportes periódicos sobre el desempeño de pagos e información relevante a stakeholders internos.

·      Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología para apoyar integraciones e iniciativas de pago.

·      Revisar las reglas de prevención de fraude junto con Producto y realizar los ajustes correspondientes cuando sea necesario.

·      Apoyar la optimización continua de los flujos transaccionales, incluyendo checkout, reintentos de pago y enrutamiento de transacciones, para maximizar las tasas de aprobación y minimizar la fricción para el usuario.

·      Colaborar con Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar los requerimientos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Asegurar que los contratos con proveedores de pago y las certificaciones regulatorias aplicables se mantengan actualizados.

·      Identificar oportunidades para mejorar procesos, herramientas y flujos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Desarrollar y apoyar iniciativas enfocadas en incrementar las tasas de aprobación y mejorar la experiencia de pago del usuario.

·      Mantener actualizada la documentación de los principales procesos y procedimientos relacionados con pagos.

 

TÚ TIENES: (Habilidades, Calificaciones y Experiencia Requeridas)

·      Más de 8 años de experiencia en pagos, fintech, e-commerce, medios digitales, streaming o áreas relacionadas, idealmente incluyendo al menos 2 años en posiciones de liderazgo.

·      Experiencia comprobada gestionando relaciones con proveedores de servicios de pago (PSPs), adquirentes y procesadores.

·      Experiencia trabajando estrechamente con equipos de Producto y Tecnología en integraciones de pago e iniciativas de prevención de fraude.

·      Sólido conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos digitales, incluyendo tarjetas, métodos alternativos de pago, wallets digitales y métodos de pago locales en Latinoamérica.

·      Conocimiento sólido de métricas clave de pagos, incluyendo tasa de aprobación, tasa de contracargos, tasa de fraude y costo por transacción.

·      Fuertes habilidades analíticas y capacidad para interpretar datos, identificar tendencias y problemas, y traducir los hallazgos en acciones concretas.

·      Fuertes habilidades de negociación y gestión de relaciones con terceros.

·      Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para presentar resultados y recomendaciones a diferentes niveles de la organización.

·      Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, asumir responsabilidad y adaptarse rápidamente a procesos y sistemas existentes.

·      Experiencia en streaming, servicios de suscripción o modelos de pagos recurrentes es deseable.

·      Inglés avanzado requerido.

 

REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

·      Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.

·      Se verificará la experiencia laboral y educación.

job.title: News Assignment Editor and Producer-Temp
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented Assignment Editor/Producer to support the News team. This position is responsible for monitoring breaking news, developing story ideas, coordinating field coverage, and managing the logistics of live crews and daily news assignments.

The Assignment Editor/Producer works closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom managers to identify and prioritize stories, gather information and video elements, and ensure timely and accurate coverage of developing and scheduled news events.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Monitor local, national, and international news for developing and breaking news stories.
  • Research, develop, and pitch daily story ideas for news broadcasts.
  • Assign stories and provide reporters and field crews with the necessary information and resources.
  • Coordinate interviews, live shots, and field coverage for breaking news and planned events.
  • Maintain constant communication with reporters, producers, photographers, field crews, and external news agencies.
  • Verify information from multiple sources and assist in gathering video, feeds, and other elements needed for coverage.
  • Monitor social media and other digital platforms for potential news stories and breaking developments.
  • Work with reporters and producers to develop story concepts and coordinate the execution of news packages.
  • Assist with troubleshooting video feeds and other field-production needs.
  • Collaborate with other Assignment Editors and newsroom managers to prioritize coverage and allocate resources.
  • Support special news coverage and live programming as needed.

YOU HAVE

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working in an Assignment Desk, newsroom, or similar news environment.
  • Strong knowledge of current events, local news, and breaking news coverage.
  • Proven experience sourcing and sharing news content through social media and digital platforms.
  • Strong communication, organization, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Fluency in Spanish, including reading and writing.
  • Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, and sit for extended periods, up to 8 hours.

job.title: On Air Personality & Content Creator
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a creative and engaging On-Air Personality & Digital Content Creator to join one of our premier Regional Mexican radio brands.

This role combines exceptional on-air performance with digital content creation across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, social media, and live events. The ideal candidate is a storyteller, influencer, and content creator who understands how audiences consume media and can develop compelling, platform-first content that grows engagement and extends the station's Regional Mexican brand beyond traditional radio.

ABOUT YOU:

You are an energetic, interactive, and social media savvy media personality who understands that today's talent represents the station both on and off the air. You are equally comfortable entertaining listeners on the radio, engaging audiences on social media, creating digital first content, and helping shape the sound and strategy of a growing multimedia brand. You embrace emerging technologies and understand how to build meaningful audience connections across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, websites, mobile apps, video platforms, and social media.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Create engaging, audience-focused content across broadcast, digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media.
  • Build authentic audience relationships through compelling storytelling, creativity, and consistent brand representation.
  • Leverage audience insights, analytics, and emerging trends to optimize content performance and audience growth.
  • Collaborate across Programming, Digital, Promotions, Sales, Marketing, Production, and other internal teams to execute multi-platform initiatives.
  • Embrace new technologies, evolving platforms, and changing audience behaviors while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and compliance.
  • Host and contribute to on-air programming while creating engaging content across digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media platforms.
  • Develop, produce, edit, and publish original multimedia content, including interviews, recurring series, promotions, livestreams, branded content, and audience engagement initiatives.
  • Serve as an on-camera personality representing the station across broadcast, digital platforms, community events, remote broadcasts, concerts, and promotional activations.
  • Cover local events, artists, entertainment, and cultural moments by creating timely, platform-specific content that drives audience engagement.
  • Write scripts, copy, interview questions, captions, voice-overs, promotional assets, sponsorship integrations, and other creative content supporting station initiatives.

  • Monitor social trends, audience insights, and performance analytics to identify content opportunities and optimize audience growth.
  • Collaborate with Programming, Promotions, Digital, Marketing, Sales, and Production teams to execute integrated content strategies and station campaigns.
  • Operate production equipment and content creation tools while maintaining compliance with FCC regulations, company policies, and broadcast standards.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

YOU HAVE:

  • Experience as an on-air personality, digital content creator, influencer, or multimedia storyteller.
  • Be familiar with the Regional Mexican music format, as well as the groups or singers within the genre.
  • Strong storytelling, interviewing, writing, communication, and on-camera presentation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging content across broadcast, podcasts, streaming, video, and social media platforms.
  • Strong understanding of audience development, digital content strategy, social platforms, and emerging trends.
  • Experience shooting, editing, publishing, and optimizing video and multimedia content using mobile and professional production tools.
  • Ability to interpret audience insights and analytics to improve content performance and audience engagement.
  • Strong organizational, collaboration, project management, and time management skills.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish preferred.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, remote broadcasts, community events, and other schedules as business needs require.
  • Reliable transportation required.

job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to support Noticias 24/7, a News streaming channel on our streaming service, VIX. This position plays an essential role in ensuring the integrity of the streaming service to deliver viewer satisfaction.

The Scheduling Coordinator will accurately schedule content playlists, maintain program calendars, oversee playout, and manage all program data. Additionally, this role contributes to the execution of scheduling strategies and operations, including collaboration in the development of promotional materials, coordinating deliverables between multiple departments, and participating in the evaluation and implementation of workflows and systems.

ABOUT YOU:

The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented and deadline-driven, as well as very comfortable learning and using program scheduling and playout systems both on-site and remotely. As this is a 24-hour a day news service, this individual would be on-call to support breaking news or off-hour playlist changes as needed.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Schedule all long-form programming for streaming news service based on strategic direction from supervisor.
  • Develop fluency in using the scheduling software and executing workflows for a flawless on-air experience.
  • Create, capture, and edit all content metadata in systems as needed.
  • Generate and maintain schedule grids (24 hour and weekly) for internal distribution and on Sharepoint.
  • Help prepare and distribute weekly programming notifications, such as premieres, TV listings and updates.
  • Maintain internal and external distribution lists for programming department.
  • Create, maintain, and set program formats on the grid level as well as live or server events. Review formats on a quarterly basis and make recommendations for revisions as needed to support business objectives.
  • Cutting clips from the programs to create segments for program reruns and preparing clips for social media distribution.
  • Monitor the Network Playout and adjust as needed for breaking news and content issues.
  • Be available on call after hours and weekends as necessary to revise playlist, trigger breaking news or support News team needs.
  • Produce work orders for promotional materials that communicate strategy, objectives and deadlines.
  • Schedule all short form elements including promos, graphics, news briefs and crawls.
  • Execute and track promotional and advertising campaigns for internal and external clients and generate reports (AS-RUNS).
  • Partner with News Production, Art Department, Ad Sales, Marketing, Business Affairs and Content Management.
  • Perform ad-hoc assignments as needed.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a broadcast/cable television or digital environment.
  • Minimum 3 years of Program Scheduling, Playlist Management, Media Planning, Promo Scheduling or similar experience
  • Self-starter, resourceful, adaptable and able to work well under pressure and on multiple projects at the same time.
  • Ability to be on-call after regular business hours and weekends.

job.title: Ad Solutions & Campaign Management Intern
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management Intern to join the team. As an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management intern, you will support the post-sale creative production, trafficking, delivery and reporting of digital campaigns across The New York Times portfolio. You will work closely with Campaign Managers and Producers to ensure that advertiser creatives align with client expectations and that campaigns are set up accurately, deliver on schedule and meet our quality standards.


About The Role

This internship is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and training in digital creative production and ad operations within a global, premium publisher environment. This is a hybrid role based in our Paris headquarters, reporting to the Director, Ad Solutions & Operations. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week. The position will start from September for a duration of 6 months, based in Paris. Candidates must have the right to work in France for the full duration of the internship.

  • This internship is intended for students or recent graduates who meet the legal requirements for an internship (stage) in France with a mandatory “Convention de stage”.
  • To apply, please submit:
    • Your CV
    • A short cover letter explaining your interest in digital advertising and this specific role

Responsibilities:

  • Support Ad Solutions in the creative production process:
    • Helping compile specs and example executions for clients based on signed media plans
    • Reviewing assets for technical specification compliancy
    • Customising units according to client guidelines using CSS3
    • Testing ads across browsers, screen sizes and devices
  • Support Campaign Managers with the end-to-end setup of digital campaigns, including:
    • Collecting and validating creative assets and tracking tags
    • Trafficking campaigns in GAM, AdSwizz and LiveIntent 
  • Assist in monitoring live campaigns:
    • Reviewing pacing and delivery reports
    • Flagging under-delivery or issues to the Campaign Manager in a timely manner
    • Supporting optimisations based on performance and client objectives
  • Contribute to campaign reporting:
    • Pulling performance data from ad servers and other platforms
    • Assisting in the preparation of client-facing reports and post-campaign summaries
  • Support day-to-day operations:
    • Collaborating with Sales, Planning and other internal stakeholders on campaign-related tasks
    • Maintaining internal dashboards and trackers as required
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Interest in digital advertising
  • Experience working with numbers and spreadsheets (e.g. basic formulas, filtering and pivot tables in Excel/Google Sheets)

job.title: Audience Editor, NYT Wirecutter
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

Wirecutter is seeking an editor to lead programming and personalization for our ecommerce initiatives, with a particular emphasis on the Wirecutter Store. You will be the editorial lead for how we talk about the Store — crafting language, frameworks, and campaigns that invite readers in, explain what the Store is, and bring them back during major editorial moments throughout the year.

As audience editor for ecommerce, programming, and personalization, you will focus on three core areas: messaging, copy, and alignment with stakeholders around big editorial moments; audience strategy, lifecycle flows, and personalization rooted in our standards; and editorial programming and email support that tightly links our journalism to new platforms.

As an audience editor, you will report to Wirecutter's deputy director of newsletters and programming, and collaborate closely with colleagues across newsletters and programming, audience at large, Wirecutter's newsroom, as well as our commerce, marketing, product, and analytics teams.

You will drive the editorial voice of Store-related messaging, build and maintain a unified promo calendar, and design tests and experiments to deepen engagement while valuing Wirecutter's standards for independence and trust.

You'll bring thoughtful editorial judgment, comfort working with data, and a sense of how lifecycle messaging, personalization, and on-site experiences can work together to serve readers.

This role has the potential to be remote, though New York City–based applicants are preferred.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the voice and editorial quality of Wirecutter Store-related messaging across channels: Write and line-edit copy for newsletters, lifecycle flows, push, SMS, on-site promos, and Wirecutter Store entry points with deep editorial rigor and collaboration across partner teams.
  • Support the editorial quality of product detail pages (PDPs) on the Wirecutter Store:
  • Create messaging frameworks for major Store moments (launches, tentpoles, seasonal pushes) so readers understand what the Store is and why they should trust it.
  • Partner with marketing to ensure users are engaged at every touchpoint in the lifecycle, from acquisition campaigns to transactional emails and targeted promos.
  • Create and maintain a Store messaging style guide that aligns with Wirecutter's voice and company-wide Store goals, including guidelines for CTAs, subject lines, and promotional framing.
  • Contribute to overall Wirecutter newsletters and programming responsibilities — especially during major moments where it connects to the Store (i.e. gifting season; deal events).
  • Work closely with product and data to understand how we are engaging readers across surfaces, and design editorial experiments to better reach and engage with them based on behaviors — particularly in inboxes
  • Continuously test and optimize messaging (subject lines, CTAs, timing, sequencing) to improve engagement while staying rooted in our standards and reporting.
  • Maintain a unified Store messaging and promo calendar that's integrated with Wirecutter's broader editorial, promotional, and major deal events strategy, rather than running on a separate track.
  • Work closely with edit leadership and in collaboration with cross-functional teams like marketing and product to design reader journeys that connect journalism to the Store to follow-ups in a way that feels personal, useful, and closely connected to overall editorial reader journeys.
  • Perform related work as assigned.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Deputy Director, Newsletters and Programming, NYT Wirecutter.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a newsroom, audience, or editorial marketing role with substantial experience in writing, editing, or programming for digital audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with email newsletters, lifecycle or CRM programs, or other audience-led messaging channels; familiarity with ecommerce or product-focused journalism.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, line-editing skills, and a strong sense of how to translate rigorous reporting into clear, compelling, and trustworthy copy.
  • Proven ability to use analytics, A/B testing, and audience insights to inform messaging decisions and iterate on subject lines, CTAs, timing, and personalization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, marketing, commerce, data, and creative partners, and an ability to advocate for reader-first, journalism-informed decisions.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, including experience maintaining calendars, managing complex campaigns, and keeping multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • A deep interest in Wirecutter's mission and a commitment to upholding our standards for independence, rigor, and service journalism in all Store-related communications.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.
