job.title: Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans – empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first – disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator to join UnitedMasters! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote.

The Role

As a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator, you will help make sure our artists’ music lands in front of the right audiences and their physical product reaches the fans who want it. You will support the Commerce team as the day-to-day connective tissue between UnitedMasters and our DSPs: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and others — keeping pitch calendars, release grids and editorial follow-ups running on time, and tracking what placements actually delivered. Alongside that, you will help coordinate physical products: vinyl, CDs and special collector formats, from manufacturing timelines through inventory and retail distribution.

Beyond the commerce remit, you will serve as a coordination point for the broader Music team — running the logistics behind our recurring team and leadership meetings, supporting our Artist Management team on high-priority administrative needs, and helping bring our label events and partner presentations to life. This is a role for someone who is energized by being the person who keeps a lot of moving parts on the rails.

This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to learn the commercial engine of the music business from the inside while working directly alongside our artist management and label leadership. You will sit close to the decisions that determine how an independent release performs, and the relationships and instincts you build here with DSP partners and our artist-facing teams are the foundation of a career in music.

What You’ll Do

Commerce & DSP

  • Prepare and maintain the DSP pitch calendar for upcoming releases, ensuring every priority release is submitted on time and with complete, compelling supporting materials.
  • Assemble release assets, artist context and performance data for editorial submissions across Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and emerging platforms, and draft supporting pitch copy in partnership with the Commerce lead.
  • Track playlist adds, editorial placements and store features across all DSP partners, and maintain a shared record the Commerce and Artist Marketing teams can rely on.
  • Pull and format weekly and post-release performance reporting from DSP partner portals, flagging trends, wins and misses to the Commerce lead.
  • Support partner meetings and DSP check-ins by building agendas and one-sheets, taking thorough notes, and driving follow-up items to completion.
  • Maintain a monthly roundup of DSP product changes, new pitch tools and editorial priorities for the broader team.

Physical Product

  • Coordinate physical product timelines for vinyl, CD and special collector formats — tracking manufacturing milestones, test pressings, approvals and in-stock dates against release dates.
  • Support inventory and retail distribution tracking, surfacing stock, reorder and sell-through issues to the Commerce lead and our manufacturing and distribution partners.

Music Team Coordination

  • Coordinate the Music team’s recurring meetings — including the weekly Artist Marketing meeting and the full Music Team meeting — owning agenda and deck preparation, notes, and follow-up to completion.
  • Provide administrative support to the Artist Management team for our highest-priority artists, including payment requests, contracting workflow and travel coordination.
  • Keep Brand Partnerships and Sync current on artist marketing activity through shared calendars, decks and marketing collateral.
  • Support the planning and execution of UnitedMasters label events and partner presentations, from run-of-show through day-of logistics.

Across Both

  • Set up vendors, process invoices and keep budget trackers current for DSP campaigns, physical product runs and artist management requests.
  • Partner with Artist Marketing, Creative and Artist Relations to align commerce moments with release and campaign plans.
  • Organize, catalog and distribute release assets and metadata so partners always have what they need, when they need it.

Who You Are

  • A genuine fan of music with real curiosity about how releases actually perform. You follow charts, playlists and drops because you want to.
  • Entry-level familiarity with the music streaming landscape and how DSPs surface and program music.
  • Comfortable in DSP partner portals — Spotify for Artists, Apple Music for Artists, Amazon Music for Artists — or able to get up to speed on them quickly.
  • Solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: you can build and maintain a tracker, use basic formulas, and turn a raw export into something readable.
  • Experience with project management tools or clear aptitude for keeping many moving deadlines organized in one system.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the discipline to hold a calendar of dates that cannot slip.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write a clear, persuasive pitch.
  • Strong meeting craft — you can build a clean agenda, capture what actually mattered, and chase follow-ups until they are closed.
  • Genuine comfort with high-touch administrative work in service of senior stakeholders and top-priority artists.
  • Discretion and sound judgment. You will be close to artist contracts, payments and travel, and to leadership-level conversations.
  • A self-starter who can own weekly recurring tasks independently while taking direction from multiple stakeholders across Commerce, Artist Marketing and Artist Management — and who is comfortable asking which priority wins when two deadlines collide.
  • A team player who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and known as the resourceful, positive person others want to work with.
  • Interest in the operational and commercial mechanics of a music release, from editorial pitching to what it takes to get vinyl into a fan’s hands.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don’t Know We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don’t.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $29-34/ hr (~$60 - 70k)

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. Additionally, UnitedMasters will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to TA@unitedmasters.com.

job.title: Creative Operations Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Creative Operations Lead to join Translation!

What You'll Do

The Creative Operations Lead is a critical operational leader at Translation, responsible for ensuring the right people are on the right work at the right time across every active account and initiative. This role sits at the center of the agency's capacity ecosystem, partnering closely with the Program Management team to keep delivery on track, talent balanced, and the business protected.

As Translation scales its resource planning capabilities — including the rollout of a new, intuitive staffing and capacity platform, this lead will serve as both the operational owner of that tool and the strategic steward of how people are planned, protected, and prioritized across billable and non-billable work.

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Own and manage staffing allocations across all active client accounts, ensuring people are planned accurately and updated in real time.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing adoption of Translation's new resource management platform, serving as the primary administrator and internal champion.
  • Surface capacity conflicts, volume pressure points, and over-allocation risks proactively — before they become delivery problems.
  • Partner daily with the PM team to align headcount plans with project timelines, scope changes, and shifting client demands.
  • Develop and maintain clear visibility into who is available, who is over-committed, and where gaps exist across all functions.
  • Track talent skills and passions.

Workload Balancing & Prioritization

  • Balance competing demands across billable client work, proactive creative opportunities, new business pitches, and internal initiatives.
  • Make and communicate clear recommendations on when and how to pull staff from non-billable work in service of billable priorities.
  • Establish and enforce workload thresholds that protect talent from burnout while maintaining agency output and quality.
  • Build frameworks for how to triage competing requests, ensuring leadership has the right information to make fast, informed staffing calls.

Freelancer Management

  • Proactively source and pipeline freelance talent in advance of high-volume periods, ensuring the agency is never caught flat-footed when capacity spikes.
  • Manage first holds on preferred freelancers across disciplines, maintaining relationships so Translation has priority access when demand peaks.
  • Negotiate freelance rates with an eye toward engagement length securing better terms for longer commitments while staying within agency margin thresholds.
  • Vet new freelancers in partnership with relevant discipline leads and key creative, strategy, and production leaders before adding them to the approved roster.
  • Own and maintain a current, organized freelancer database including rates, availability windows, past project history, and performance notes  so the agency can move quickly when a need arises.

Awards & Case Study Management

  • Own the end-to-end process for awards submissions tracking eligible work, managing timelines, coordinating materials, and submitting entries across relevant shows.
  • Build and maintain a living library of agency case studies, ensuring work is documented accurately and kept current across accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development, Business Leadership, Strategy, and Creative to capture the story behind Translation's best work in a format ready for new business, press, and agency promotion.
  • Develop a calendar and workflow for proactive awards planning to avoid last-minute scrambles.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the PM team, creating tight alignment between resource plans and delivery commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Leadership and Client Engagement teams on capacity and staffing strategy, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with People Operations on headcount planning, open role identification, and freelance needs driven by capacity gaps.
  • Represent resource management in agency planning conversations, including scoping, new business, and organizational design discussions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account staffing in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • Strong command of resource management tools and platforms; experience leading a tool rollout or system migration is a plus.
  • Experience managing or willing to learn managing awards submissions and/or case study development, with a clear understanding of how agency recognition supports business development.
  • A systems thinker who is equally comfortable in the weeds of a staffing grid and in a strategic conversation about organizational design.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can translate operational complexity into simple, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and maintains it under pressure.
  • High integrity around people data: this role has visibility into utilization and performance-adjacent information and must handle it with discretion.                                                                             

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in resource management, project management, creative operations, or a related function within a creative agency or marketing organization.
  • Deep understanding of how creative agencies work, the rhythms of production, the difference between billable and non-billable time, and how to protect both.
  • Freelance recruiting experience and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and enhancing a product or platform.
  • A strong network of freelance talent relationships.

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.

  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

job.title: Sr. Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Sr. Business Director to join Translation and lead one of our most visible and consequential client partnerships. The Sr. Business Director is a senior client and business leader responsible for the success, growth, and health of a significant, complex account. This person has already demonstrated success at the Business Director level and brings greater executive influence, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership. They will serve as a strategic advisor to senior clients, lead integrated teams, and remain close to the work while actively shaping and pushing clients forward in culture.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall health, performance, growth, and senior client relationships for a flagship national account.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Director-level stakeholders, shaping agendas, influencing decisions, and constructively challenging clients with a clear point of view.
  • Translate complex business, consumer, category, and cultural dynamics into clear strategic direction and stronger creative work.
  • Lead integrated teams across Business Leadership, Strategy, Context, Creative, Program Management, Production, Analytics, and Partner Agencies, creating clarity around objectives, priorities, roles, and decisions.
  • Ensure work meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative ambition, cultural excellence, and client readiness before presentation.
  • Develop and drive the organic growth strategy, identifying and converting opportunities across stakeholders, business units, audiences, and workstreams.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, including revenue, profitability, staffing, forecasting, scope performance, and investment recommendations.
  • Anticipate relationship, delivery, and commercial risks, intervening before they affect the client partnership, the quality of the work, team health, or profitability.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Contribute to agency leadership through new business, recruiting, shaping departmental standards, cross-functional improvements, and the development of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional business judgment and the ability to connect marketing decisions to broader client goals, organizational dynamics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to read complex rooms, tailor counsel to different stakeholders, and navigate sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Strong strategic fluency and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear, actionable direction without prescribing the creative solution.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing models, forecasting, profitability, and investment decisions.
  • Ability to lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, resolve tension constructively, and create accountability without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • A growth mindset, with the curiosity and proactivity to identify unmet client needs and translate them into meaningful opportunities.
  • Cultural fluency and a strong understanding of how contemporary culture, audiences, and communities influence brands and business.
  • Sound prioritization and decision-making skills in a high-volume, fast-moving, and highly visible client environment.
  • A coaching orientation and the ability to raise the performance, confidence, and judgment of other leaders.
  • Ability to balance client needs, creative ambition, executional feasibility, team sustainability, and financial health

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience leading integrated client relationships within a creative, marketing, or communications agency, including demonstrated success operating at the Business Director or equivalent level.
  • Proven experience owning senior client relationships, complex integrated campaigns, organic growth, account economics, and cross-functional team leadership for a major consumer brand.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and developing account leadership talent while independently navigating high-stakes client and business decisions.      

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a large, complex, or matrixed national account across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
  • Experience in QSR, retail, CPG, telecom, financial services, sports, entertainment, or another high-velocity consumer category.
  • Experience working within/leading an integrated agency team or multi-agency ecosystem.
  • Experience leading culturally specific or multicultural marketing while connecting the work to a broader brand and business strategy.
  • Track record of identifying and converting organic growth opportunities.
  • Experience leading scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Experience supporting new business pitches, agency initiatives, recruiting, or talent development.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. job.title: 3D Motion Specialist
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists and fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. Across artist storefronts, ecommerce experiences, campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement platforms, the Design & Direction team is responsible for bringing artist brands to life through compelling and innovative creative experiences.

As digital experiences continue to evolve, motion, animation, and immersive visual storytelling play an increasingly important role in how audiences discover, engage with, and connect to artists and brands. The 3D Motion Specialist helps shape these experiences by transforming creative concepts into dynamic visual content that elevates storytelling, enhances engagement, and pushes creative boundaries.

How You’ll CREATE

The 3D Motion Specialist is responsible for designing and creating high-quality motion graphics, 3D visualizations, animations, and digital content experiences across artist campaigns, e-commerce initiatives, content productions, and branded experiences. Working closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Content Production teams, and Developers, this role translates creative vision into visually compelling motion-based experiences that support artist storytelling, product presentation, fan engagement, and brand expression.

Combining technical expertise with strong creative instincts, the 3D Motion Specialist contributes throughout the creative process, from concept development and visual exploration through final execution and delivery. This role plays a key part in evolving the visual capabilities of the Design & Direction team and exploring new ways to engage audiences through motion and interactive storytelling.

Motion Design & Animation

  • Create high-quality motion graphics and animation assets across digital campaigns, e-commerce experiences, social content, and artist initiatives

  • Develop engaging visual narratives through motion, timing, composition, and storytelling principles

  • Translate creative concepts into compelling animated content and motion systems

  • Create animated assets that support artist storytelling, product launches, and audience engagement initiatives

  • Develop title sequences, transitions, promotional assets, and branded motion content

3D Design & Visualization

  • Create 3D environments, product visualizations, digital assets, and immersive content experiences

  • Develop realistic and stylized renderings that support campaign and brand objectives

  • Produce 3D assets for digital experiences, content production, ecommerce initiatives, and promotional campaigns

  • Explore innovative approaches to dimensional storytelling and digital expression

  • Contribute to the development of future-facing content formats and emerging creative technologies

Creative Development

  • Partner with Creative Directors to explore visual concepts and creative approaches

  • Participate in concept development, brainstorming sessions, and creative workshops

  • Contribute visual ideas, mood boards, references, and prototypes during project development

  • Support the evolution of creative frameworks and visual storytelling standards

  • Collaborate with Design teams to ensure consistency across visual systems and brand experiences

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Designers, Developers, Content Producers, Editors, and Creative Directors throughout project lifecycles

  • Support content production teams through animation, visual effects, and motion-based storytelling solutions

  • Prepare assets for delivery across multiple channels and platforms

  • Ensure motion and 3D deliverables meet technical specifications and performance requirements

  • Collaborate on interactive and emerging digital experiences where motion enhances user engagement

Innovation & Craft Development

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, motion design trends, visual techniques, and creative tools

  • Explore opportunities to introduce new creative capabilities, workflows, and technologies

  • Contribute to the growth of motion design and 3D capabilities within the Design & Direction team

  • Continuously develop technical skills across motion graphics, animation, rendering, simulation, and interactive content

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3-6 years experience in motion design, animation, 3D design, visual effects, digital design, or related creative disciplines

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in motion graphics, animation, and 3D content creation

  • Advanced proficiency in Cinema 4D, Blender, After Effects, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools

  • Understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography, design systems, and animation principles

  • Experience working across digital campaigns, branded content, ecommerce, entertainment, music, or agency environments

  • Strong creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

  • Passion for music, culture, digital experiences, and emerging technologies

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

Success Looks Like

  • Motion and 3D content consistently elevates the quality of creative output across the organization

  • Creative concepts are enhanced through innovative visual storytelling and animation

  • Artists, products, and brands are represented through engaging and memorable digital experiences

  • Motion assets perform effectively across channels and platforms

  • New creative approaches and technologies continue to expand team capabilities

  • Creative teams trust your expertise and seek your input throughout concept development

  • Work helps establish Digital Creative Services as a leader in innovative digital experiences

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. How we LEAD:

We are currently seeking an Application Security Engineer to join UMG's global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the Manager, Security Engineering and Vulnerability, this role is responsible for improving the security of internally developed applications and cloud services by partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Application Security Engineer will serve as a trusted technical advisor, performing application security assessments, supporting secure software development practices, and helping engineering teams identify and address security risks early in the development process. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with collaboration across development and security teams to strengthen UMG's application security posture while enabling innovation.

The ideal candidate has experience in application security, secure software development, cloud-native technologies, and developer enablement, along with strong communication skills and a passion for building secure software.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Perform application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure design reviews for internally developed and third-party applications.

  • Conduct application security testing using static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), API security testing, and manual validation techniques.

  • Review source code and provide secure coding guidance based on OWASP best practices and secure development principles.

  • Partner with software engineering teams to identify security risks and recommend practical remediation strategies throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate application security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows.

  • Provide security architecture guidance for new applications, APIs, cloud-native services, and technology integrations.

  • Support implementation of modern authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and other identity standards.

  • Evaluate, implement, and maintain application security tools and help improve security testing coverage across the development lifecycle.

  • Develop automation and scripting to improve application security testing, reporting, and engineering workflows.

  • Participate in security reviews for new technologies, cloud services, and third-party applications.

  • Support investigation and remediation of application-layer security incidents and vulnerabilities when required.

  • Create reusable security guidance, reference architectures, and technical documentation to improve secure development practices across engineering teams.

  • Deliver secure coding guidance and developer education to promote security-by-design principles.

  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and identity teams to continuously improve enterprise application security capabilities.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Application Security, Security Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a security focus.

  • Experience performing application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure architecture reviews.

  • Strong understanding of secure coding principles and common application vulnerabilities, including the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.

  • Experience with application security testing technologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing methodologies.

  • Experience working with modern application architectures, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.

  • Experience working within AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.

  • Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization technologies including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and JWT.

  • Understanding of security frameworks and standards including OWASP, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and ISO 27001.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices within Agile development environments.

  • Experience with application security platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Checkmarx, Veracode, Burp Suite, Semgrep, or similar tools.

  • Experience with container security, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code security.

  • Experience developing automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.

  • Experience performing security assessments of cloud-native applications and APIs.

  • Professional certifications such as CSSLP, GIAC GWEB, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Security+, CISSP, or equivalent.

  • Experience working within large global enterprise environments.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or similarly distributed global organizations.

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

Famehouse is seeking a Creative Director within our Digital Creative Services team. This role will sit at the forefront of connecting artists with their fans across all digital touchpoints, leading brand expression, art direction, and UX/UI across artist merchandising and e-commerce experiences. This role is responsible for shaping how artist brands translate into best-in-class digital storefronts, campaigns, and commerce ecosystems, connecting visual identity, content, and user experience into a cohesive, artist-led narrative.

We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Expereince, exceptional content starts with exceptional execution. Across artist campaigns, e-commerce experiences, product launches, social content, and brand storytelling initiatives, our Content & Experience team creates visual experiences that connect artists, brands, and audiences around the world.

As content production continues to evolve, the importance of technical excellence, workflow consistency, and media integrity has never been greater. The Digital Imaging Technician plays a critical role in ensuring productions operate efficiently, assets are captured and managed correctly, and creative teams can move confidently from production through post-production without compromise.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, production, and creative execution, helping ensure every production is built on a foundation of reliability, quality, and operational excellence.

How You’ll CREATE

The Digital Imaging Technician is responsible for managing technical production workflows, media handling, imaging integrity, and on-set technical operations across Content & Experience productions.

Working closely with Directors of Photography, Producers, Editors, Photographers, Camera Operators, and Post Production teams, this role ensures assets are captured, processed, backed up, organized, and delivered according to established technical standards and production requirements.

Beyond supporting individual productions, the Digital Imaging Technician contributes to the development of scalable production workflows, technology standards, and technical best practices that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across the organization.

This role combines deep technical expertise with strong operational discipline and problem-solving skills, serving as a trusted technical partner throughout the production lifecycle.

Technical Production Operations

  • Lead technical workflow management across video, photography, and hybrid productions

  • Establish and maintain media management standards throughout production activities

  • Configure and manage camera, monitoring, recording, and data systems

  • Ensure technical consistency across production environments and projects

  • Support Directors of Photography and camera teams with technical setup and troubleshooting

  • Monitor image quality, color accuracy, exposure consistency, and recording integrity throughout productions

  • Ensure production assets meet technical specifications and quality requirements

Media Management & Asset Integrity

  • Manage ingestion, verification, organization, and backup of production assets

  • Maintain secure and reliable media management workflows

  • Ensure all footage, photography, and production assets are correctly archived and documented

  • Establish redundancy and backup procedures that protect asset integrity

  • Coordinate asset handoff processes between production and post-production teams

  • Maintain file naming, metadata, and organizational standards

Workflow Development

  • Develop and improve production-to-post-production workflows

  • Establish technical standards and best practices across content production

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability

  • Support implementation of new production technologies and systems

  • Collaborate with Editors and Post Production teams to optimize delivery workflows

  • Ensure production pipelines support evolving business and creative requirements

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the primary technical resource on production sets and studio environments

  • Troubleshoot equipment, workflow, and technical issues during production

  • Provide guidance on formats, codecs, color workflows, and media management practices

  • Support training and onboarding related to production technology and workflows

  • Partner with Grip & Equipment, Production, and Creative teams to ensure operational readiness

  • Contribute to future planning around production technology investments and capabilities

Bring Your VIBE

  • 4-8 years experience in digital imaging, technical production, post-production workflows, broadcast operations, or related production environments

  • Strong understanding of camera systems, recording formats, codecs, color management, and digital imaging workflows

  • Experience supporting video, photography, ecommerce, campaign, and content productions

  • Knowledge of media management, backup systems, storage solutions, and asset workflows

  • Experience working with post-production teams and editorial pipelines

  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities

  • Exceptional attention to detail and process discipline

  • Ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in fast-paced production environments

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Passion for technology, production, innovation, and content creation

Success Looks Like

  • Production assets are consistently secure, organized, and technically accurate

  • Productions operate efficiently with minimal technical disruption

  • Camera and production teams trust technical guidance and workflow support

  • Asset handoffs between production and post-production are seamless

  • Technical standards are maintained across all productions

  • Workflow improvements drive efficiency, consistency, and scalability

  • Content quality is protected through strong technical leadership and operational excellence

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in merchandise & D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers merch and D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How We Lead:

Famehouse is seeking an experienced merch Account/Brand Manager to join our team in Los Angeles as a Director, Artist & Label Services, focusing on artists across the Capitol roster.

In this role, you’ll serve as the strategic lead across a portfolio of artists, owning the long-term direction of their merchandise and D2C businesses. You’ll shape merch & D2C strategies that align with the artist’s creative vision to deliver strong commercial results across both merch and music, developing long-term (rolling 12mo+) calendar plans across all revenue channels and guiding the strategy behind every campaign, product launch, and fan experience.

This role requires a strong ability to sell ideas and inspire confidence with artist and label teams, bringing clarity & thoughtful storytelling to every campaign discussion to help artists understand D2C & merch’s impact in building fandom. It requires exceptional taste, deep cultural fluency, and an intuitive understanding of artist brand, aesthetic direction, and creative identity.

Success in this role also requires exceptional collaborative leadership, working closely with many teams and disciplines, both internally and with partners. Candidates must lead with positivity, respect, and a team-first mindset, ensuring strong partnerships across the organization and consistently delivering great outcomes for artists.

How You’ll Create:

  • Serve as the relationship lead for Capitol Music Group and their artists, building trusted relationships with artist managers, label teams, and creative partners.
     
  • Lead holistic, cross-channel merchandise strategy across D2C, tour, retail, and licensing, including for physical music on d2c, exclusives, and fan engagement moments.
     
  • Develop rolling 12-month calendar plans across all channels, including D2C, tour & VIP, retail, and licensing initiatives, working closely with the artist team, label marketing and creative.
     
  • Bring infectious energy, enthusiasm, and storytelling to all pitch, proposal, and planning conversations — inspiring clients to adopt innovative D2C and merch ideas that drive growth.
     
  • Lead development and presentation of artist proposals, calendar plans, and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring buy-in from clients and stakeholders.
     
  • Partner closely with Campaign Managers to ensure all campaigns and initiatives remain on track to achieve artist and label goals, proactively identifying opportunities to optimize performance.
     
  • Lead Artist & Label Business Reviews, presenting insights, growth opportunities, and long-term strategic recommendations.
     
  • Manage artist and label feedback and ensure all executions are aligned with client expectations and artist brand standards, including leading all business and product approvals.
     
  • Serve as a collaborative, trusted partner inside the organization — working closely with a wide range of teams, operating with positivity, respect, and a solutions-focused mindset.
     
  • Maintain strong client satisfaction by ensuring artist teams feel supported, informed, and excited about their partnership with Famehouse.
     

Bring Your Vibe:

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, artist relations, marketing, or eCommerce within music, entertainment, or merchandise.
     
  • Demonstrated success managing artist relationships in fast-paced environments.
     
  • Strong understanding of the label, artist, and merchandise ecosystem, ideally with prior label-side, artist commerce, or D2C experience.
     
  • A passion for the music & culture of Capitol’s roster is a must. Candidates should bring dedication in serving the artist community and delivering exceptional experiences for their fans.
     
  • Strong understanding of D2C commerce, merchandise strategy, and fan engagement.
     
  • Excellent communicator and presenter with the ability to sell ideas and strategies in compelling ways. High degree of comfort communicating with sr. leaders, artist managers, and their teams.
     
  • Strong creative instincts and taste level aligned with artist brands and cultural trends.
     
  • Positive, collaborative leader who works well across many teams and builds trust easily.
     
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple campaigns, clients, and priorities simultaneously.
     
  • Passion for music, fan culture, and building meaningful artist-to-fan experiences.
     
  • Commitment to teamwork and respect for every function is required; must be willing to set personal ego aside for the good of the team and delivering for our artists and partners.

The Director, Catalog Visual Creative will spearhead the creative direction, evolution, and execution of visual media supporting Capitol’s iconic catalog and legacy artists. This includes reissues, deluxe/anniversary campaigns, remastered artwork, archival storytelling, long-form content, catalog brand identity systems, and global creative toolkits.

This role requires a global mindset, ensuring that visuals resonate not only within the U.S. but across key international markets. You will collaborate with marketing and digital core teams, as well as relevant departments across the label based on project needs to craft universally compelling creative. As a Director, you will uphold artistic integrity and historical authenticity while shaping forward-thinking creative expressions that scale worldwide.

Creative Leadership & Global Strategic Vision

  • Drive the overarching creative vision for catalog artists with a strong understanding of global audiences, cultural nuances, and international market dynamics.
  • Develop creative that is rooted in artist legacy but strategically positioned for global relevance across regions and platforms.

High-Level Concept Development

  • Oversee creation of artist project visual assets (ex. music video / press & DSP photos / concept cover art) – lead process of ideation with artist and management team, execution, and trafficking and obtaining approvals internally and externally.
  • Lead concepting of refreshed packaging, campaign assets, deluxe editions, and multi-territory brand systems.
  • Craft visual narratives that communicate legacy and heritage in ways that resonate across continents and generations.

Stewardship of Archival Assets

  • Oversee creative use of archival materials in ways that respect historical provenance.
  • Collaborate with international teams to rediscover, adapt, and contextualize archival assets for different cultural markets.
  • Maintain best practices for preservation, delivery, metadata, and global accessibility of catalog visual assets.

Cross-Departmental Creative Partnership

  • Partner with Creative Leadership to develop brand bibles and mood boards with international considerations baked into the visual identity system.
  • Build strong working relationships with catalog and core label teams to ensure cohesive execution.

Talent Direction & Creative Resourcing

  • Identify high-caliber creative partners — photographers, directors, designers, editors, restoration specialists.

Production Oversight

  • Drafting production agreements for art / photo / music video / misc. content.
  • Oversee distribution of approved creative assets internally to respective departments.
  • Approve vendor bids, negotiate contracts, and supervise multi-market deliveries.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple high-volume projects with international timelines, partners, and sensitive estate-driven workflows.

  • Ability to work across time zones, travel when necessary, and maintain strong cross-cultural diplomatic skills.

  • Strong ability to communicate creative direction and feedback on assets to/from artist/mgmt. and external creative partners (vice versa).
  • Deep understanding of how global music, design, fashion, art, and cultural trends shape visual storytelling.

How we LEAD:

The Director, Digital Commercial Partnerships drives strategic growth across key digital service providers (DSPs) and high-impact partners, leading initiatives that increase streaming consumption, audience engagement, and revenue. This role owns partner strategy, go-to-market execution, and commercial innovation across priority accounts. You will operate at the intersection of music, data, marketing, and technology, shaping how repertoire is positioned and monetized in a rapidly evolving digital ecosystem The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader and relationship builder with deep expertise in streaming platforms, digital marketing, and commercial partnerships.

How you’ll CREATE:

Partner Strategy & Growth

  • Own and lead business strategy for priority DSPs, driving streaming growth, revenue, and market share
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between UMG labels and digital partners, aligning release priorities with platform opportunities
  • Identify and execute revenue-driving initiatives, including marketing campaigns, advertising strategies, and new monetization models
  • Pitch and position new releases, catalog campaigns, and artist initiatives to secure prominent editorial, playlisting, and promotional support
  • Develop innovative go-to-market strategies that maximize visibility and fan engagement across platforms

Data, Insights & Performance

  • Leverage streaming analytics, consumer insights, and market data to inform commercial decisions and optimize performance
  • Track and deliver on revenue targets and KPIs, identifying opportunities for incremental growth
  • Produce weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting on streaming trends, sales performance, and partner activity
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for label teams and senior stakeholders
  • Analyze campaign and release performance to continuously refine strategy

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a strategic advisor to internal stakeholders, sharing DSP best practices, audience insights, and market trends
  • Collaborate with marketing, analytics, operations, and label teams to align on priorities and execution
  • Lead business reviews and executive presentations with internal teams and external partners
  • Drive internal alignment by communicating partner updates across product, marketing, and technology

Operations & Execution

  • Ensure seamless content delivery and metadata accuracy across platforms
  • Troubleshoot partner and system issues to maintain high-quality releases and reporting integrity
  • Build and optimize scalable processes and workflows to improve efficiency and execution
  • Establish and enforce best practices, standards, and operational frameworks across partners

Bring your VIBE:

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital partnerships, business operations, sales, marketing, or commercial strategy within music, media, digital content, or a related industry
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of the digital streaming ecosystem (DSPs), music industry landscape, and evolving consumer behavior
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and performance metrics to inform strategy and drive decision-making
  • Proven track record of delivering revenue growth, audience engagement, and successful digital campaigns
  • Solid understanding of commercial drivers and financial fundamentals (e.g., P&L, forecasting, ROI analysis)
  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders and leading executive-level discussions
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

job.title: Director, Commercial Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Capitol Christian Music Group is seeking a strategic, commercially minded music business professional to drive catalog growth and deepen relationships with artists, managers, and distribution partners. Sitting at the intersection of Commercial and Marketing, this role will be responsible for maximizing the value of CCMG’s catalog assets while serving as a trusted partner to artists and external stakeholders.

 

This role combines catalog expertise, marketing strategy, project management, and business development. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of music catalog monetization, a strong professional presence, and the ability to articulate why CCMG is uniquely positioned to steward, market, and grow an artist’s catalog better than anyone else in the industry.

 

Working across Commercial, Distribution Partners, Marketing, A&R, Audience Development, and Creative teams, this role will develop catalog growth strategies that drive streaming, consumption, fan engagement, and long-term revenue. Ensuring CCMG's catalog remains culturally relevant, commercially impactful, and positioned for sustained growth.

 

 

How you’ll CREATE:

Catalog Growth & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop and execute catalog growth strategies designed to maximize consumption, engagement, and revenue across CCMG’s catalog.

  • Identify high-potential catalog opportunities and create plans to unlock incremental value through marketing, partnerships, content, product development, and commercial initiatives.

  • Monitor catalog performance, market trends, and consumer behavior to identify growth opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to align catalog priorities with broader business objectives.

 

Project Management

  • Serve as the lead project manager for key catalog initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and flawless execution.

  • Build and oversee integrated marketing plans for priority catalog campaigns, anniversaries, milestones, reissues, and artist-focused initiatives.

  • Coordinate efforts across audience development, creative, media, commercial partnerships, and artist teams.

  • Establish clear objectives, timelines, KPIs, and post-campaign performance analyses.

 

Artist & Distribution Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with artists, managers, distribution partners, and other external stakeholders.

  • Support artist, management, and partner conversations by providing strategic catalog insights, performance updates, and growth opportunities.

  • Develop data-driven presentations and growth plans that communicate catalog performance, opportunities, and strategic recommendations.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for strategic catalog-related opportunities and partner discussions.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Commercial, Revenue, Sync, Audience Development, and Creative teams to ensure alignment around catalog priorities.

  • Advocate for catalog initiatives internally and externally, driving organizational focus and investment where appropriate.

  • Lead cross-functional working groups to advance key catalog projects and long-term growth strategies.

 

Analytics & Business Insights

  • Analyze streaming, sales, social, and audience data to evaluate performance and guide decision-making.

  • Develop recommendations based on consumption trends, audience behavior, and revenue opportunities.

  • Create high-level reporting and presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders.

 

Bring your VIBE:

 

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in music, entertainment, catalog management, marketing, commercial strategy, or related fields.

  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through catalog marketing, commercial initiatives, or artist development strategies.

  • Strong understanding of music catalog economics, streaming platforms, consumption trends, rights management, and revenue drivers.

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects from strategy through execution.

  • Proven track record managing external relationships with artists, managers, or business partners.

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong professional presence with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts and analytical capabilities.

  • Highly organized project manager who can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Relationship builder with the ability to establish credibility across both internal and external constituencies.

  • Collaborative work style with a bias toward action and results.

  • Deep understanding of streaming platforms, playlist ecosystems, audience development strategies, and digital consumption behaviors.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within recorded music, artist management, music publishing, or catalog-focused businesses.

  • Familiarity with Christian and Gospel music audiences, artists, and marketplace dynamics.

  • Experience developing business cases and growth strategies for artist catalogs and legacy assets.

 

Why This Role Matters

This role plays a critical part in growing the reach, relevance, and revenue of CCMG's catalog. By combining commercial expertise, streaming strategy, content optimization, and cross-functional execution, this individual will help unlock new opportunities for catalog consumption while ensuring our artists' music continues to connect with audiences for years to come.

job.title: Globe Sync Agent (Advertising) - New York, New York
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Globe 

Who we are  

Globe is the award-winning creative and partnerships division of Universal Music Group in the UK. We work together with our artists and labels, operating at the intersection of music, film, television, brands and creative partners. 

We specialise in placing music to picture across film, TV, advertising, gaming and streaming alongside crafting standout brand partnerships and original content. Our work sits at the heart of an artist’s marketing strategy, driving cultural relevance, audience reach and long-term impact. 

Our team  

Globe is made up of passionate and knowledgeable experts who thrive on collaboration and creativity. We work closely with artists from the moment they sign, helping shape their journey across all stages of their career. Our team approaches every campaign with pace and precision, moving fast like an F1 pit crew, but with the deep creative care of the engineers behind the scenes. 

We’re building a new sync presence on the ground in the USA, and we’re looking for dynamic self-starters who can identify and unlock opportunities others might miss. We believe in the power of teamwork, cultural fluency, and mutual respect and we’re united by our love of music. 

Our impact  

Globe plays a key role in the long-term success of our artists. We secure impactful placements that elevate an artist’s profile and fanbase, whether it’s a global film franchise, a soundtrack moment in a streaming hit, or a culture-shaping ad campaign. Each sync is a chance to deepen engagement, build brand value, and create timeless connections between music and audience. 

Our work helps shape perception and drive discovery. We create opportunities that align with artist narratives and bring a new level of visibility to Universal Music Group’s UK world-class repertoire. 

The Role  

A day in the life of  

As Sync Agent, Globe USA (Advertising – East Coast), you’ll lead Globe’s advertising-focused sync strategy from New York. Your remit will centre on identifying, developing and executing licensing opportunities that maximise the commercial and creative impact of Universal Music UK’s frontline and catalogue repertoire. 

You’ll work with advertising agencies, music supervisors, brands and creative partners to build long-lasting relationships and drive new and repeat business. Working closely with our UK labels and A&R teams, you’ll curate and deliver music responses that cut through creatively and deliver commercially. 

On any given day you could be: 

  • Pitching music to advertising agencies, brands, and creative studios for upcoming campaigns 

  • Collaborating with A&R to develop custom or tailored musical responses to client briefs 

  • Meeting with key contacts in the advertising industry to deepen relationships and understand trends 

  • Negotiating sync deals, overseeing licensing, clearances and financial tracking 

  • Monitoring campaign performance and sync usage to inform future activity 

  • Attending brand showcases, award shows, and industry events to grow Globe’s US network 

  • Working closely with colleagues in the UK to align sync activity with artist campaigns and priorities 

Your impact in role 

You will play a critical role in helping UK artists break into the US advertising sync market. Your placements will provide meaningful profile and commercial wins for our artists, increase catalogue performance, and expand our footprint in the creative industries. 

By maintaining strong relationships and securing high-value opportunities, you’ll directly support the growth of Universal Music UK’s presence in the US sync space, particularly within the influential advertising and branding sectors. 

This role is ideal for you if 

  • You are deeply connected within the advertising sync and music supervision space 

  • You have a strong understanding of how music, brands and storytelling intersect 

  • You’re confident balancing creative ambition with commercial delivery 

  • You enjoy spotting new opportunities and shaping long-term client relationships 

  • You’re excited by building something new and being part of a fast-moving, collaborative team 

  • You’re adaptable, solutions-focused, and thrive on delivering impactful results 

Key responsibilities  

  • Lead Globe NY’s sync strategy, focused on advertising-driven opportunities 

  • Work to accountable commercial targets and KPIs, aligned with artist and label goals 

  • Cultivate, grow and maintain relationships with brands, agencies and music supervision teams 

  • Respond creatively and commercially to sync briefs, pitching music from our full repertoire 

  • Negotiate, close and execute sync deals including clearance, licensing and payments 

  • Collaborate with UK labels and A&R to develop bespoke creative responses 

  • Deliver artist showcases, client engagement moments and in-market activations 

  • Track sync activity and catalogue performance to provide actionable insights to internal teams 

  • Stay ahead of sync, advertising and content trends to identify new revenue opportunities 

Our ideal candidate  

  • 8+ years’ experience in creative sync, advertising music supervision, or licensing 

  • Extensive network of advertising industry contacts and creative agency partners 

  • Proven success in pitching and closing advertising sync deals 

  • Strong understanding of music copyright, licensing and legal frameworks 

  • Commercially astute with excellent negotiation and communication skills 

  • Organised, strategic and able to manage multiple priorities and client needs 

  • Familiarity with key platforms including Microsoft Office, Salesforce, DISCO and music analytics tools 

  • Based in the New York area with the ability to travel as required 

  • A passion for music across all genres, and an appreciation of UK repertoire, is a plus 

Why join Globe  

  • Be part of a pioneering new sync expansion in the USA 

  • Play a central role in breaking UK artists globally 

  • Represent one of the most exciting catalogues in music, from emerging icons to legendary acts 

  • Work within a collaborative, inclusive and values-driven creative team 

  • Help shape the future of sync in one of the world’s most important media markets 

  • Make a lasting impact on artists, on culture, and on the business 

Reward and Benefits 

  • Be part of an entrepreneurial, global organization that values authenticity, drive, creativity, relationships, and a competitive spirit 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA options, as well as: 

  • 100% coverage for out-patient mental health services 

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) 

  • A lifetime fertility support allowance of $30,000 to plan participants 

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement 

  • 100% immediately vested 401(k) match on the first 5% of your contribution on eligible compensation 

  • Variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including: 

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees 

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees 

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break 

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) 

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) 

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent
