job.title: Identity Access Management (IAM) Engineer – Identity Governance and Administration
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary 

We are currently seeking an Identity & Access Management Engineer with specialization in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) to join UMG’s global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the VP, Tech Security & Identity, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise IGA capabilities across a complex, global environment. 

This engineer will play a critical role in governing digital identities, access entitlements, and lifecycle processes for employees, contractors, and non-employee populations. The role emphasizes strong engineering execution, automation, and operational discipline, partnering closely with security, HR, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure access is provisioned appropriately, reviewed regularly, and removed in a timely manner. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with modern IGA platforms, strong understanding of access governance controls, and the ability to operate at scale in a regulated enterprise. 

Job Functions 

Design, engineer, deploy, and operate Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the enterprise. 

Implement and manage identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows for employees and non-employee identities. 

Engineer and maintain access request, approval, and provisioning workflows integrated with HR systems, directories, and enterprise applications. 

Design and operate access governance controls including role models, entitlement catalogs, access certifications, and periodic access reviews. 

Partner with application owners and platform teams to onboard applications into IGA and remediate access governance gaps. 

Develop and maintain automation and integrations for IGA workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., PowerShell, Python). 

Support segregation of duties (SoD) controls, access policy enforcement, and audit readiness activities. 

Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity lifecycle, provisioning, and access-related issues across integrated systems. 

Collaborate with Security, HR, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure identity governance controls align with security policies and regulatory requirements. 

Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks to support scalable and repeatable IGA operations. 

Continuously identify opportunities to improve access governance maturity, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation and platform enhancements. 

Job Requirements 

Essential Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering roles, with a strong focus on Identity Governance & Administration. 

Demonstrated experience implementing and operating enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent). 

Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and entitlement governance. 

Hands-on experience designing and supporting access certification campaigns and remediation processes. 

Experience integrating IGA solutions with HR systems, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise applications. 

Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. 

Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) with IAM integrations. 

Ability to independently own complex technical deliverables while collaborating effectively within a global organization. 

Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. 

Desirable Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Experience with advanced IGA capabilities such as role mining, access analytics, or policy-based provisioning. 

Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, or similar. 

Professional certifications such as Saviynt Certified Professional, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, Security+, or CISSP. 

Experience operating IAM or identity governance platforms within a large, global, or highly regulated enterprise environment.

job.title: Lead Motion Designer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists and fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. Across artist storefronts, e-commerce experiences, campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement platforms, the Design & Direction team is responsible for bringing artist brands to life through innovative and meaningful creative experiences.

Motion plays an increasingly important role in how audiences experience digital content. Whether enhancing artist storytelling, elevating product launches, creating immersive campaign moments, or bringing digital experiences to life, motion has the power to create emotion, drive engagement, and strengthen audience connection.

The Lead Motion Designer is responsible for advancing the motion design capabilities of the organization while ensuring motion remains a meaningful and integrated part of the creative process.

How You’ll CREATE

The Lead Motion Designer is responsible for defining and leading motion design execution across Digital Creative Services. Working at the intersection of design, storytelling, technology, and creative innovation, this role develops motion systems, animation approaches, and visual experiences that elevate artist brands, campaigns, and digital products.

Partnering closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Content Production teams, Developers, and Client stakeholders, the Lead Motion Designer translates creative vision into compelling motion-led experiences while establishing standards, workflows, and best practices that improve consistency and creative quality across the organization.

This role combines hands-on creative execution with creative leadership, serving as both a motion specialist and a trusted creative partner throughout the concept.

Motion Design Leadership

  • Lead motion design execution across campaigns, e-commerce experiences, content initiatives, and digital products

  • Define motion design principles, animation standards, and creative approaches across the organization

  • Establish scalable motion systems that support artist storytelling and brand expression

  • Ensure motion design enhances user experience, engagement, and creative effectiveness

  • Champion the role of motion throughout the creative development process

Creative Development

  • Partner with Creative Directors during concept development and experience design phases

  • Contribute motion-first thinking to creative briefs, presentations, and campaign development

  • Develop storyboards, motion explorations, prototypes, and visual concepts

  • Translate static creative concepts into engaging motion-based experiences

  • Explore innovative approaches to storytelling through animation and movement

Motion & Visual Execution

  • Create high-quality motion graphics, animations, and visual content across multiple channels and platforms

  • Develop content for artist campaigns, ecommerce experiences, social content, product launches, and branded storytelling initiatives

  • Lead the creation of motion assets ranging from micro-interactions and promotional content through to large-scale campaign experiences

  • Utilize 2D, 3D, compositing, visual effects, and emerging technologies where appropriate

  • Ensure all motion deliverables meet the highest creative and technical standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Content Producers, Developers, Editors, and Creative Directors

  • Support Development teams in implementing motion experiences across digital products and platforms

  • Partner with Content Production teams to integrate motion into content ecosystems and storytelling initiatives

  • Ensure motion execution aligns with project objectives, timelines, and technical requirements

  • Act as a motion design subject matter expert across the organization

Innovation & Capability Development

  • Drive the evolution of motion design capabilities within Digital Creative Services

  • Research emerging technologies, tools, platforms, and creative opportunities

  • Explore AI, real-time rendering, interactive motion, 3D, and immersive experience technologies

  • Mentor designers and creatives looking to strengthen motion capabilities

  • Contribute to the development of creative standards, workflows, and best practices

Bring Your VIBE

  • 5-8 years experience in motion design, animation, visual design, digital experiences, or related creative disciplines

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating motion-led storytelling and creative problem solving

  • Advanced proficiency across After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and relevant motion tools

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, visual storytelling, design systems, and user experience

  • Experience working across campaigns, ecommerce, content production, digital products, or entertainment environments

  • Ability to move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills

  • Passion for music, culture, design, emerging technology, and creative innovation

Success Looks Like

  • Motion consistently elevates the quality and impact of creative work

  • Motion principles and standards are adopted across the organization

  • Creative concepts are strengthened through thoughtful animation and movement

  • Artists, brands, and campaigns benefit from distinctive and memorable motion experiences

  • Teams seek out motion expertise throughout the creative development process

  • New technologies and techniques continue to evolve the organization's creative capabilities

  • Digital Creative Services is recognized for best-in-class motion-led creative experiences

job.title: Manager, Catalog Creator
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD
The Manager, Creator Catalog supports creator, influencer, and content marketing initiatives across Capitol Records’ Pop/Rock and Urban (Hip-Hop & R&B) catalog artists. This role brings iconic eras, anniversaries, archival moments, reissues, and culturally defining stories to life through strategic, authentic creator partnerships.


Working closely with Digital Marketing leadership and cross-functional teams, the Manager ensures creator content reflects each artist’s legacy while driving discovery and engagement among both long-standing fans and new generations. Managing Pop/Rock and Urban catalogs requires an understanding that creator strategies differ by genre—from storytelling style and platform behavior to cultural context and creator communities—while still laddering up to a cohesive catalog vision.


A general global awareness is important, ensuring creator strategies can scale across markets when appropriate without losing cultural authenticity.


How You’ll CREATE


Creator, Influencer & Content Strategy

  • Lead day-to-day execution of creator and influencer marketing across Pop/Rock and Urban catalog campaigns.
  • Identify and source creators whose content aligns organically with each genre—ranging from nostalgia-driven and performance-based storytelling in Pop/Rock to culturally rooted commentary, dance, lifestyle, fashion, education, and production-focused creators in Urban.
  • Apply genre-aware thinking when recommending creators, formats, and platforms—recognizing that Pop/Rock and Urban audiences engage with content differently.
  • Recommend creators for key territories when campaigns require international amplification.
  • Support initiatives tied to anniversaries, classic albums, reissues, remasters, box sets, archival releases, and cultural milestones.

Campaign Development & Execution

  • Manage creator sourcing, outreach, briefings, deliverable tracking, approvals, and ongoing communication.
  • Maintain clear, professional communication between creators, internal teams, artist partners, and estates.
  • Activate creator content around key release moments, platform trends, cultural conversations, and genre-specific cycles.
  • Ensure all creator output aligns with campaign objectives, artist legacy, and broader catalog strategy.

Insights, Data & Optimization

  • Use platform analytics, cultural trends, and genre knowledge to identify creators who feel authentic to each campaign.
  • Track creator performance across platforms and compile insights for internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to scale high-performing content or optimize underperforming activations.
  • Incorporate cross-market insights when evaluating creator effectiveness and reach.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Catalog and Core label teams across Marketing, Digital, Creative, A&R Research, Production, Revenue, and Commercial to support catalog priorities.
  • Support integration of Capitol Records’ broader creator and content networks across Pop/Rock and Urban initiatives.
  • Ensure creator content reinforces artist brand, campaign narrative, and long-term catalog positioning.
  • Stay aligned with Digital Marketing leadership to ensure execution reflects overall strategy and priorities.

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3+ years of creator or influencer marketing experience within music, digital media, or adjacent cultural spaces
  • Experience working with Pop/Rock and/or Urban (Hip-Hop & R&B) creators strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of creator ecosystems, platform trends, and fan behavior across genres
  • Comfort managing relationships with creators, artist teams, estates, and internal partners
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple catalog campaigns simultaneously
  • Strategic thinker who understands the balance between paid and organic creator programs
  • Passion for music history and interest in how legacy content connects with modern and global audiences

job.title: Manager, eCommerce Marketing
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more. 
 
How we LEAD: 


Merchandise and commerce are part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. 


The Manager, Site Marketing turns traffic, campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into high-impact storefront strategies that drive conversion, sell-through, fan engagement, and revenue growth. This role owns the non-creative site strategy across merchandising, product placement, promotional planning, campaign destinations, homepage, and collection strategy, PDP optimization, key shopping moments, and alignment with CRM, paid media, and other acquisition channels. 


Core responsibilities of this role include: 

  •  Lead on-site marketing programming across the sites, including promotions, to achieve store revenue and conversion goals. 
  •  Optimize fan journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, and purchase. 
  • Align cross-channel execution with paid media, email, CRM, social, label, and artist teams. 
  • Merchandise and prioritize products, collections, campaigns, and offers on the storefront to drive engagement, conversion, and revenue. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve site performance through testing, merchandising adjustments, landing page optimization, offer strategy, and improved shopping paths. 
  • Translate artist priorities, label needs, inventory considerations, product performance, and commercial goals into an actionable site plan. 

This role requires a strategic, commercially minded, highly collaborative manager who can balance long-term planning with fast-moving priorities. The ideal candidate understands how fans shop, how campaigns translate across ecommerce storefronts, and how product performance should inform merchandising, promotional, and customer journey decisions. They should be comfortable leading workstreams, making clear recommendations, building alignment across cross-functional partners, and bringing structure, judgment, and momentum to a high-volume environment. 


How you'll CREATE: 
 
Site Marketing Strategy & Commercial Planning 

  • Own site marketing strategy for a portfolio of artist stores, ensuring storefront activity aligns to commercial priorities, artist moments, fan demand, and revenue goals. 
  • Build and manage site marketing calendars that coordinate releases, product drops, promotions, tour moments, seasonal opportunities, CRM pushes, paid media campaigns, and evergreen selling periods. 
  • Prioritize the highest-value opportunities across stores and campaigns, balancing business impact, artist priorities, product performance, traffic drivers, and operational feasibility. 
  • Translate campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into clear storefront plans that define what should show up, where it should appear, when it should launch, and how it should support conversion. 
  • Lead planning conversations with cross-functional partners to ensure site strategy is proactive, commercially grounded, and clearly connected to broader marketing and revenue goals. 

 
On-Site Campaigns, Promotions & Merchandising 

  • Lead planning and execution of on-site marketing campaigns that support new releases, product launches, catalog moments, artist exclusives, preorders, restocks, tour activity, limited-edition drops, and seasonal moments. 
  • Own merchandising recommendations across homepages, collections, product pages, campaign destinations, navigation paths, cart moments, and other key storefront placements. 
  • Determine how products, collections, campaigns, and offers are surfaced, sequenced, and prioritized to improve product discovery, fan engagement, conversion, average order value, and sell-through. 
  • Develop promotional strategies across sitewide and artist-specific moments, including offer placement, messaging, landing page strategy, timing, and coordination with CRM, paid media, and other marketing channels. 
  • Use proven ecommerce levers such as discounts, bundles, free shipping, gift-with-purchase, exclusives, presale access, urgency messaging, and limited-time moments to support demand capture and conversion. 
  • Ensure storefront plans reflect artist brand, campaign strategy, customer needs, and commercial opportunity while making it easy for fans to discover and purchase priority products. 

 
Fan Journey & Storefront Optimization  

  • Shape customer journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, purchase, and repeat engagement. 
  • Develop landing page and campaign destination strategies, including product hierarchy, content flow, collection logic, module placement, CTA strategy, and shopping paths. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve site flow, content clarity, product visibility, merchandising logic, and conversion paths across priority stores and campaigns. 
  • Partner with CRM, paid media, and label marketing teams to ensure traffic-driving efforts connect to the right site destinations, messaging, products, and commercial priorities. 
  • Recommend updates before, during, and after key campaigns based on fan behavior, business performance, and real-time opportunities. 

 
Performance, Insights & Optimization 

  • Monitor store, campaign, product, and customer journey performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, sell-through, average order value, engagement, and revenue. 
  • Partner with Insights and other Commercial teams to understand product trends, inventory opportunities, pricing sensitivity, conversion behavior, and underperforming SKUs. 
  • Translate performance insights into actionable site marketing recommendations, including merchandising updates, campaign pivots, promotional tests, product recirculation, landing page adjustments, and shopping path improvements. 
  • Develop clear readouts and next-step recommendations that connect site performance to commercial outcomes. 
  • Support testing opportunities across promotional mechanics, merchandising approaches, landing page structures, product sequencing, content placement, and conversion paths. 

 
Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment 

  • Act as a strategic connector across Commercial, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product Performance, Analytics, Operations, labels, artist teams, and storefront/site partners. 
  • Ensure campaigns are aligned across site strategy, traffic-driving channels, product priorities, promotional timing, creative needs, messaging, and business goals. 
  • Lead cross-functional planning conversations, bringing clarity to priorities, timelines, dependencies, owners, and next steps. 
  • Proactively surface risks, blockers, tradeoffs, and opportunities, while helping teams move toward practical, commercially sound decisions. 
  • Build trust with partners by communicating clearly, following through consistently, and balancing strategic thinking with operational discipline. 

 
Manager-Level Ownership & Judgement 

  • Bring structure, prioritization, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment with multiple stores, campaigns, stakeholders, and competing priorities. 
  • Make informed recommendations with confidence, using commercial context, customer behavior, product performance, and business goals to guide decisions. 
  • Exercise strong judgment when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational realities, and timing considerations. 
  • Build alignment with cross-functional partners, using clear rationale, data, and strong relationship-building. 
  • Anticipate needs before they become blockers and help create a more proactive, strategic, and performance-focused site marketing function. 
  • Operate with ownership, accountability, curiosity, and a solutions-oriented mindset, while remaining adaptable as priorities evolve. 

Bring your VIBE: 

  • 5+ years of experience in site/D2C marketing, ecommerce, digital marketing, site merchandising, campaign marketing, promotional strategy, or a related field. 
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce strategy, storefront merchandising, promotional planning, customer journeys, conversion optimization, and performance-driven growth. 
  • Proven ability to translate commercial priorities, campaign goals, product performance, and customer behavior into clear site marketing strategies and actionable plans. 
  • Experience managing multiple campaigns, calendars, launches, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-moving ecommerce or digital environment. 
  • Comfortable using performance data to identify insights, make recommendations, influence decisions, and optimize campaigns before, during, and after launch. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex inputs into clear briefs, recaps, recommendations, and next steps. 
  • Excellent judgment and prioritization skills, especially when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational constraints, and competing deadlines. 
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow-through and the ability to keep workstreams moving without constant direction. 
  • Confident leading cross-functional conversations, aligning stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities, timing, dependencies, and ownership. 
  • Strong relationship-builder who can earn trust across teams, influence without authority, and bring partners along through clear rationale and collaborative problem-solving. 
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate risks, surface tradeoffs, and recommend practical paths forward. 
  • Curious about fan behavior, artist culture, digital commerce, and how storefronts can deepen the fan-to-artist connection while driving measurable business results. 
  • Strong instincts as an online shopper and a clear point of view on what makes a storefront compelling, easy to shop, and commercially effective. 
  • Balanced leadership style with confidence, humility, adaptability, and a no-ego approach to collaboration. 
  • Familiarity with email/CRM, paid media, social commerce, affiliate, or other acquisition channels. 
  • Experience with site merchandising, CMS tools, landing page strategy, PDP optimization, cart strategy, or frontend QA. 

 
A plus, but not required: 

  • Experience in music, entertainment, fashion, streetwear, consumer products, artist merchandising, or fan commerce. 
  • Experience with Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms. 
  • Understanding of UX principles, consumer behavior, analytics, A/B testing, or conversion rate optimization. 
  • Project management experience or experience leading complex workstreams across multiple teams.

job.title: Manager, Fan Engagement FONO
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are currently seeking a Manager, Fan Engagement (Mexican Music) on our team. The Manager will be responsible for providing qualitative fan insights of an artist ecosystem. This role requires a deep understanding of social media trends, community engagement, and content creation tailored to the unique culture of mexican music fans. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of building and growing fan or genre accounts with significant followings and engagement. You will focus on building sustainable fan growth, deepening fan relationships, and creating connected digital ecosystems that support our artists and projects.

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Fan Sentiment Monitoring and Social Listening: To be able to track conversations on social media towards artists on the genre on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, Reddit and translate them into actionable strategies for fan engagement.
  • Genre culture Engagement and fan network building: Build and maintain relations with Mexican music fans, and drive collections of artists, memes, and short-form subcultures for engagement and fostering community.
  • Community Engagement and content ideation: Analyze existing artist fan communities to develop content strategies that resonate with fans and encourage engagement. Also, to develop ideas to maintain a steady flow of fan engaging content to drive new audiences to an artist project.
  • Artist Analysis and Strategy: Monitor and analyze an artist network to understand their fandom, culture, drivers and be able to build an archetype to strategize upon.
  • Fan Acquisition and customer journey: Help to design customer journeys, fan clubs, and VIP experiences to maximize engagement.
  • Trend Monitoring: Stay updated on trends, tools, and best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working alongside marketing, A&R, e-commerce teams, and artist management to ensure strategy success.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Experience: +3 years in digital marketing, community management, or CRM within the music or entertainment industry. Deep knowledge of viral trends, platform best practices (TikTok, Instagram, etc.), and direct-to-fan ecosystems.
  • Skills: Strong understanding of social and blogging platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, vlogs, etc) and their respective algorithms and analytics tools. Strong data analytics and analysis skills.
  • Creativity: Ability to ideate compelling ideas of shareable content that resonates with Mexican music fans and that connects with an artist audience.
  • Community Insight: Deep knowledge of Mexican music culture, fan communities, and current trends, and be able to differentiate all those audiences.
  • Analytical Ability: Proficiency in analyzing social media metrics and adjusting strategies accordingly.
  • Networking: Experience in building and maintaining networks of fans to enhance content reach and engagement.
  • Communication:  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish (fluency on both expected).

Passion and Drive:

  • Passion for staying on top of every new digital trend, meme, and platform.
  • An unquenchable thirst for innovation, experimentation, and reinvention.
  • Ability to deliver reporting and insights, feedback con fan engagement and strategy effectiveness through a variety of internal stakeholders.
  • Ambitious, self-starter requiring minimal direction. Must thrive in a team environment but be able to take initiative and work independently.
  • Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. How we LEAD:

UMG is seeking an experienced Network Engineer – Firewall Security to join our Global Network Infrastructure team. This role plays a critical part in UMG’s Global Security and Cybersecurity strategy by designing, standardizing, and operating enterprise firewall and perimeter security platforms.

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewall technologies, a strong focus on security standardization, and the ability to partner closely with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams in a global enterprise environment.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Design, deploy, and support enterprise firewall and perimeter security solutions
  • Build, implement and maintain security controls aligned with Zero Trust and least-privilege principles
  • Lead standardization efforts across firewall platforms and configurations
  • Define and maintain Network Access Control (NAC) strategy, standards, and architectures (Cisco ISE) to support secure enterprise access.
  • Design, implement, and operationalize NAC policy including authentication/authorization, device profiling, and identity-based segmentation enforcement.
  • Own network security logging and telemetry strategy for firewall and NAC controls, including log scope, retention, access controls, and audit readiness.
  • Design and implement logging methods and systems (e.g., syslog, API-based ingestion, cloud-native logging) to onboard network security events into the enterprise SIEM for monitoring and incident response.
  • Partner with the SOC to define alerts, dashboards, and investigation workflows based on firewall and NAC security logs.
  • Perform security assessments and contribute to risk reduction initiatives
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex firewall and network security issues
  • Maintain network security standards documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks
  • Participate in technology evaluations and security architecture reviews
  • Ensure adherence to change, incident, and problem management processes

Bring Your VIBE:

Required:

  • 5+ years of overall IT experience
  • 3+ years in firewall or network security engineering roles
  • Experience with firewall concepts and implementations, preferably Palo Alto Networks firewalls.
  • Experience with Network Access Control (NAC) concepts and implementations, preferably Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Working knowledge of AAA and secure access methods including 802.1X and RADIUS/EAP; familiarity with certificate-based authentication and PKI dependencies.
  • Experience designing and operating security logging for network security controls, including log source onboarding, normalization, retention, and integration with SIEM platforms.
  • Solid understanding of IP networking, routing, and security fundamentals
  • Experience working in large, global, or regulated environments
  • Strong communication and documentation skills

Preferred:

  • Security certifications such as CCNP Security, PCNSE, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, network segmentation, and security governance frameworks
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance, or regulatory requirements

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists with fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. From artist storefronts and ecommerce experiences to campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement programs, the Design & Direction team is responsible for defining the creative vision that brings artist brands to life across every digital touchpoint.

The Creative Direction team establishes the creative frameworks, visual identities, and experience principles that guide how work is conceived, developed, and executed. Working closely with Design, Content Production, Development, Project Management, and Client teams, we ensure every experience balances artistic expression, audience engagement, and business performance.

Role Overview

The Senior Coordinator, Content Strategy is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of content placement across UMG's eCommerce experiences. Working closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Development, and Project Management teams, this role owns the creation and oversight of eCommerce placement plans, ensuring every product is accurately represented from planning through launch.

Serving as the central source of truth for product assets and placement requirements, this role is responsible for maintaining the integrity of content across our eCommerce storefronts. Through rigorous quality control, they ensure all products, imagery, copy, and associated assets align with approved placement plans prior to photography and publication, helping deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience.

The Senior Coordinator plays a critical role in connecting cross-functional teams, maintaining visibility across content readiness, and ensuring assets, documentation, and placement standards remain accurate, organized, and accessible throughout the campaign lifecycle. They proactively identify content gaps, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational consistency to support successful product launches.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about eCommerce operations, digital merchandising, and content excellence. They thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy building structure through process, and take pride in ensuring every customer-facing experience is executed with accuracy and consistency.

How You'll CREATE:

eCommerce Content Strategy & Placement

  • Own the creation, maintenance, and execution of eCommerce placement plans across artist and label storefronts.

  • Develop merchandising placement strategies that ensure products, collections, and campaigns are accurately represented across all digital storefronts.

  • Partner with Creative, Merchandising, Client Services, and Production teams to align placement plans with campaign objectives and commercial priorities.

  • Translate campaign requirements into clear content placement documentation that serves as the single source of truth for execution.

  • Continuously review and optimize placement standards to improve consistency, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

Content Quality Control & Asset Governance

  • Lead quality control reviews of all products and associated assets against approved placement plans prior to photography and site publication.

  • Validate that products, imagery, copy, collections, variants, and metadata are complete, accurate, and aligned to merchandising requirements.

  • Identify and resolve content discrepancies before they impact downstream production or customer-facing experiences.

  • Maintain ownership of content accuracy across eCommerce platforms, ensuring consistency across all artist storefronts.

  • Act as the central source of truth for product assets, ensuring all approved creative and content is current, accessible, and properly version controlled.

Content Operations & Coordination

  • Coordinate content readiness across Creative, Production, Merchandising, Development, and Project Management teams.

  • Manage content timelines, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure assets are available ahead of key campaign milestones.

  • Support product launches by ensuring all required assets, approvals, and placement documentation are complete.

  • Maintain content documentation, placement guides, and operational standards across multiple concurrent projects.

  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, or gaps that may impact content readiness or launch timelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for content placement and asset management across cross-functional teams.

  • Partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Client Services, and eCommerce Operations to ensure seamless execution.

  • Facilitate communication around content changes, asset updates, and placement requirements throughout campaign lifecycles.

  • Support continuous improvement of content workflows, documentation, and governance processes.

  • Champion consistency and best practices across all eCommerce content operations.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • 3–5 years' experience in eCommerce, digital content, merchandising, content operations, or project coordination.

  • Strong understanding of digital merchandising principles and online customer experiences.

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple launches, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a passion for content accuracy and quality.

  • Experience managing digital assets, product information, or content management systems.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across creative, commercial, and technical teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

  • Passion for music, eCommerce, digital retail, and fan experiences.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities.

  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for creating scalable processes and operational excellence.

What Success Looks Like:

  • eCommerce placement plans are accurate, complete, and delivered on time for every campaign.

  • Products consistently pass quality control before photography and launch, minimizing downstream issues and rework.

  • Asset libraries remain organized, accurate, and trusted as the single source of truth across the business.

  • Cross-functional teams have clear visibility into placement plans, content status, and launch readiness.

  • Product launches are executed with a high degree of accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Content governance standards continue to evolve, improving quality, scalability, and execution across all eCommerce experiences.

job.description:

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – Streaming & Social within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how artists are discovered, audiences are understood, and content performance is optimized; trusted consumption data becomes a strategic enterprise asset. In this role, you will ensure UMG's streaming and social data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume music consumption data at enterprise scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable data-driven decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise data products and domain-specific data marts that serve as the authoritative source of truth for music consumption and streaming/social engagement across UMG. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent audience insights, artist development, repertoire strategy, marketing effectiveness, forecasting, and executive decision-making. By establishing trusted, governed, and semantically rich data products, you will help create the enterprise data foundation that enables AI-driven insights and intelligent decision-support across UMG.

You will partner closely with Global Insights, Commercial Strategy, Digital Business, Marketing, Label Analytics, Data Engineering, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring consumption & social data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, observability, documentation, and governance are embedded into every streaming and social data product.

  • Standardize business definitions for metrics, including streams, listeners, followers, saves, playlist reach, engagement, audience growth, chart performance, market share, and consumption trends.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with internal and external consumption data providers to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of consumption data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve business outcomes by applying AI to music consumption, audience behavior, and content performance while maintaining strong governance and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of the digital music ecosystem, including streaming platforms, social media platforms, audience measurement, and music consumption trends.
  • Experience working with music consumption datasets, including streaming activity, artist performance, release performance, audience engagement, playlists, social signals, and chart data.
  • Familiarity with industry data providers and platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, TikTok, Meta, Luminate, Chartmetric, SoundCloud, Pandora, or similar consumption and audience analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of artist lifecycle analytics, audience development, catalog performance, playlisting, fan engagement, and commercial music performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.

In this role, you will ensure UMG's eCommerce data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, well-documented, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume enterprise data at scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise eCommerce data products and data marts that serve as authoritative sources of truth for digital commerce performance. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making across UMG’s direct-to-consumer ecosystem.

You will partner closely with eCommerce business leaders, Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring eCommerce data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, documentation, observability, and governance are embedded into every data product.
  • Ensure enterprise data products are designed to support emerging AI capabilities, including semantic retrieval, intelligent agents, recommendation systems, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Partner with eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and Analytics stakeholders to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and data definitions.
  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers that support entities such as sales, orders, customers, products, subscriptions, marketing attribution, fulfillment, and customer lifecycle reporting.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for digital commerce performance across brands, labels, and regions.
  • Partner with enterprise tech & business teams to standardize the global data layer for digital ecommerce
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, and AI teams to identify opportunities where trusted consumption data products can enable artist forecasting, audience segmentation, fan engagement, trend detection, catalog optimization, and intelligent decision-support.
  • Drive standardization of business definitions for metrics such as revenue, orders, conversion, customer acquisition, repeat purchase, AOV, LTV, refunds, subscriptions, and marketing performance.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with upstream commerce platforms and source systems to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of eCommerce data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve data product usability and business outcomes through AI-enabled capabilities while maintaining strong governance, privacy, and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience supporting enterprise eCommerce, direct-to-consumer (D2C), retail, or digital commerce organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of common eCommerce business processes, including product catalog, pricing, promotions, customer lifecycle, order management, fulfillment, subscriptions, and returns.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or other modern commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, BigCommerce, or custom commerce ecosystems.
  • Shopify experience Preferred
  • Experience working with customer, order, product, marketing, and transactional datasets.
  • Understanding of digital marketing and attribution concepts, including paid media, email, CRM, customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.
  • Experience in establishing and managing data contracts and cross-functional data ownership models.
  • Strong SQL proficiency preferred, with the ability to independently validate requirements and investigate data issues.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and stakeholder value.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.
  • Strong systems thinker with a customer-centric product mindset.
  • Knowledge of the music and label business is a plus.

Bring your VIBE:

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Affairs Administration
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

As a member of the Business & Legal Affairs team, you'll play a key role in helping bring new music and video releases to market by managing rights clearances and licensing activities across a diverse roster of artists. You'll partner with teams across Business & Legal Affairs, A&R, Marketing, Production, Revenue, Licensing, Artist Management, and external rights holders to ensure releases move forward efficiently while mitigating legal and business risks.

This role is ideal for a highly organized, solutions-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex rights issues, and is passionate about the music industry. The successful candidate will have 3-5 years of music licensing, legal, or business affairs experience and be eager to expand their expertise in artist, sample, synchronization, and content clearances.

How you'll CREATE:

Rights Clearance & Release Support

  • Coordinate and manage music and video clearances by working with third-party labels, publishers, licensors, clearance agencies, artist management, and internal stakeholders to secure all required approvals for commercial releases.
  • Manage the end-to-end clearance process, tracking requests, monitoring timelines, and helping resolve complex rights issues that could impact release schedules.
  • Advise internal teams on clearance requirements, ownership splits, and licensing considerations for samples, side artists, compilations, soundtrack projects, and synchronization opportunities.

Contract Drafting & Administration

  • Draft, review, and administer a variety of music agreements, including Sample Agreements, Side Artist Agreements, Label Waivers (including Profit Split arrangements), and Soundtrack and Synchronization License Agreements.
  • Manage agreement execution, maintain accurate contract records, distribute finalized agreements to appropriate stakeholders, and coordinate supporting documentation for payment processing.

Risk Assessment & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Review music video treatments and final content to identify potential copyright, trademark, publicity, and reputational risks, partnering with Legal executives to resolve issues before release.
  • Collaborate closely with Business & Legal Affairs, A&R, Marketing, Production, Revenue, Licensing, Artist Management, and Legal teams to support artist releases and commercial licensing initiatives.
  • Partner with synchronization and catalog licensing teams to facilitate soundtrack placements and other licensing opportunities.

Process Management

  • Maintain organized tracking systems and documentation to ensure visibility into project status, contractual obligations, and clearance milestones.
  • Recommend and support process improvements that increase operational efficiency and enhance cross-functional collaboration.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 3-5 years of experience in music industry licensing, business affairs, legal administration, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of music copyright, licensing, publishing, and recording agreements.
  • Experience drafting and administering music-related agreements is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and sound judgment when navigating complex rights issues.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with UMG systems is a plus.
  • Passion for music and the evolving entertainment landscape.

System Reliability & Performance 

Design, build, and maintain the availability, scalability, and performance of critical services.

Solid understanding of networking, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative& Experience, we create content that connects artists with fans across every touchpoint of the digital experience. From artist stores and ecommerce experiences to campaigns, social content, product launches, and brand storytelling initiatives, our Content Production team is responsible for bringing creative concepts to life through compelling visual experiences.

The Stylist plays a critical role in shaping how products, artists, and brands are represented through content.   • Support product preparation and presentation for ecommerce and merchandising content

  • Identify opportunities to elevate visual quality and improve content effectiveness

  • Stay informed on fashion, music, cultural, and visual trends that influence artist and consumer behavior

  • Ensure all styling elements are prepared, maintained, and executed to the highest standard

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating styling work across photography, video, ecommerce, or campaign content

  • Deep understanding of visual storytelling, styling principles, and brand expression

  • Experience working with products, talent, artists, and creative teams

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Ability to manage multiple productions and deadlines simultaneously

  • Exceptional attention to detail and visual consistency

job.title: UX/UI Designer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to design and optimize direct-to-consumer (D2C) online stores for some of the world’s leading artists and labels. You’ll help shape the way fans experience, interact and purchase from their favorite artists through beautifully crafted, high-performing e-commerce experiences. You’ll be responsible for elevating the artists’ worlds, thinking like a superfan but with razor sharp digital design skills — translating music culture, brand identity, and merchandising into seamless, emotionally engaging online stores that drive sales and fan loyalty. You’ll work closely with the wider design/motion teams to build out the ultimate fan experience and collaborate with store front developers and back end systems teams to push our sites and stores into better experience for our artist and consumers.

How You’ll CREATE
• Design and iterate on e-commerce experiences — from landing pages and product detail pages
to checkout and campaign microsites — that bring artist brands to life.
• Be able to present your ideas clearly and advocate for good interface and experience.
• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that balance storytelling,
usability, and conversion.
• Collaborate with developers, merchandisers, and marketing teams to ensure pixel-perfect
implementation and an exceptional end-to-end customer journey.
• Use insights from analytics, A/B testing, and fan feedback to refine and optimize store
performance.
• Translate brand and album aesthetics into cohesive digital experiences aligned with campaign
visuals and creative direction.
• Advocate for best-in-class UX practices, accessibility, and responsive design across all digital
touchpoints.
• Work closely with developers to ensure the feasibility and implementation of design solutions.

Bring your VIBE
• 3+ years of experience in UI/UX design, ideally in e-commerce, entertainment, or consumer
brands.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating responsive design, visual design systems, and UX problemsolving.
• Excellent proficiency in Figma/prototyping tools and Adobe Creative Suite
• Good working knowledge of Shopify and/or other D2C e-commerce platforms
• Understanding of digital merchandising, conversion optimization, and checkout flow best
practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, campaign-driven environment with shifting priorities.
Nice to Have
• Experience designing for music artists, record labels, or fan-focused digital products.
• Familiarity with HTML5, JS, CSS.
• Passion for music, culture, and innovation.

OVERVIEW: 

The Radio One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Forty-five years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are an urban media empire, spanning multiple media platforms. We are in your ears with Reach Media/Radio One, on your televisions with TV One, and may even be the name behind your favorite website, with our digital platform Interactive One. Information is power, and our mission here at Radio One, Inc. is simple – to be the most trusted media source in the African American community. At Radio One, we pride ourselves on hiring people who are dedicated and continue to challenge the norm, while embracing a corporate culture built on creativity and passion. We are our employees’ biggest fans, and it is our daily mission to attract, develop, and retain the brightest stars in the business.

 

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 

  • Airs live and pre-recorded shows
  • Completes traffic logs and fixes logging discrepancies
  • Airs emergency alert system tests as indicated
  • Engineers’ remote broadcasts and follows station procedures. 
  • Regulates timing of programs, operates syndicated programming, and plays commercials and promotions as scheduled
  • Off-air support of commercial production, dubbing music to hard disk and programming automation computers
  • Monitors and updates weather, traffic, and news reports into automation equipment

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time, and lift/move up to 50 lbs

job.title: Analyst, Deals Office
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

A little bit about our team:

The deals office drives the evaluation and structure of all recorded music and music publishing deals to enable long-term growth. We partner with closely with global business leaders to assess opportunities that balance creativity with commercial value strengthening our market position and shareholder value

Your role:

As an Analyst on the Deals Office’s Reporting & Analysis team, you’ll play a key role in delivering the insights and analysis that power our content investment decisions across Recorded Music and Music Publishing. This role requires a highly analytical mentality that’s equally comfortable with high-level strategy and granular data analysis. The right candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume financial environment, with experience communicating results to senior collaborators and using AI tools to improve efficiency.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Query, transform, and analyze large financial datasets related to WMG’s artists and songwriters, synthesizing insights and strategic recommendations for senior collaborators.

  • Create reports, dashboards, and other intelligence tools to support financial decisions and deal valuation modeling.

  • Maintain data standards in WMG’s internal deal intelligence platform and give to analytics feature development.

  • Monitor and manage WMG’s global deal pipeline, ensuring compliance with all governance and due diligence requirements.

  • Leverage generative and agentic AI to improve the speed and efficiency of our insights and reporting workflows.

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Sciences, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • 3-5 years of experience in investment banking, consulting, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.

  • Knowledge of artist and songwriter monetization channels, royalties, and other music industry financial processes is highly preferred.

  • Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, transforming, and wrangling large financial datasets.

  • Familiarity with data visualization and dashboarding tools (Tableau, Streamlit, Plotly Dash, etc); you know how to build a dashboard that recommends a solution instead of just describing the problem.

  • Excellent strategic and business acumen, with the ability to communicate clear recommendations to stakeholders

  • Experience leveraging generative and agentic AI tools to boost productivity in financial settings

  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheet (Excel / Google Sheets) and presentation (PowerPoint / Google Slides) tools.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience conducting data analysis with Python

  • Knowledge of / experience with advanced statistical analysis (regression, hypothesis testing, causal inference, etc.)

  • Passion for music and knowledge of industry trends

About Us:

Before the fans and fame, the soundtracks and syncs, there is the song. And before the song comes the songwriter - the heart of an art form that defines generations, and the soul of our business. Songwriters are our inspiration; we are their partners, collaborators, and crusaders. Songwriters shape culture; and here at Warner Chappell Music we help hone their craft, build their careers, and protect their legacies. We value curiosity, collaboration, and commitment – which helps set us apart and helps us in our commitment and global service to our songwriters. We are Warner Chappell Music - where songwriters are heard.

As part of the larger Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $89,000 to $110,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

Job Title: Coordinator, Business and Legal Affairs 

  

A little bit about our team: 

WMG Global Catalog/Rhino Entertainment is the catalog division of Warner Music Group responsible for advancing the legacy of Warner’s iconic artists and optimizing the performance of Warner’s recorded music catalog, including that of legacy artists and current superstars. Rhino’s dynamic Business and Legal Affairs team shares a passion for music, values hard work, and brings a creative, problem-solving mindset. We focus on innovative deals with and for WMG artists across recorded music, brand licensing, and ancillary exploitation. We work cross-functionally with A&R, marketing, fan engagement, commerce, and finance to structure deals and further strengthen relationships with our artists. We also field inquiries regarding the U.S. catalog repertoire, handle pre-litigation claims and litigation in coordination with WMG’s corporate litigation in-house counsel, and implement WMG’s rights in connection with the same.
