Job Title: Manager, Marketing (Warner Classics)

A little bit about our team:

Warner Classics and its sister label, Erato, represent many of today’s most renowned and vibrant artists, such as Sir Antonio Pappano, Abel Selaocoe, Joyce DiDonato, Gautier Capuçon, Fatma Said, RIOPY, and Jakub Jozef Orliński. Our labels boast a deep and historic legacy with legendary figures like Maria Callas, Herbert von Karajan, Yehudi Menuhin, Itzhak Perlman, and Mstislav Rostropovich who redefined musical excellence.

The Global Classics Marketing team focuses on growing audience reach, increasing brand awareness, and achieving commercial success for a varied roster of frontline artists and their releases. They are also engaged in crafting new opportunities to expand engagement and monetization of our extensive catalog, one of the world’s largest. Based worldwide, the label consists of teams specializing in A&R, Finance, Operations, Commerce, and Legal Affairs. Additionally, shared service teams cover Tech, Digital, Sync, Licensing, Audience, and Business Intelligence.

Your role:

Your primary focus as Marketing Manager is the development and execution of high-level global campaigns for a dedicated roster of classical artists. Acting as the main marketing point-of-contact, you’ll bridge the gap between our artists, their collaborators, and colleagues worldwide. The role also involves coordinating local marketing for priority releases—both frontline and catalog—while managing campaign budgets and key supplier relationships.

Working closely with your manager, you'll set and achieve clear objectives, whether that’s boosting weekly streams, driving social growth, scoring a chart no. 1, or partnering with commercial colleagues to secure DSP features. While no two days are the same, creativity and a genuine love of music remain at the heart of everything we do.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Be responsible for “always on” campaigns for priority artists and frontline releases. Agree on important metrics and budgets with the Head of Department to drive commercial results across digital and physical formats.

  • Complete local campaigns for priority artists and catalog products. Lead the US Classics marketing budget to ensure all investments deliver high value and meet defined objectives.

  • Architect multi-product campaigns and negotiate bulk media buys with key trade partners to improve brand reputation.

  • Build coherent, compelling, and authentic artist brands that are reflected consistently across visual assets, socials, and DSPs or equivalent experience.

  • Collaborate with artists alongside their partners to broaden audience reach through dynamic short-form content developed both around and between releases.

  • Function as a key marketing collaborator within a cross-functional team, collaborating closely with A&R, Commerce, Finance, and Business Affairs.

  • Collaborate with US-wide in-house teams and our creative network to build multi-pronged campaigns for artists and catalogue, developing high-impact assets that resonate with target audiences and artist brands.

  • Coordinate with international affiliates and maintain vital relationships with artists, managers, DSPs, and PR agencies.

  • Represent the label at concerts and industry events, facilitating grassroots growth through tour signings and promo activity.

  • Analyze performance metrics against industry benchmarks to advise strategy and measure commercial impact. Proactively generate ideas for A&R, sync licensing, and commercial partnerships, embracing creative risk-taking to move the business forward.

About you:

  • A professional who balances a visionary approach with a focus on commercial results, capable of working autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experienced in developing creative briefs and conceptualizing brand identities, with a particular curiosity about short-form storytelling and digital-first content.

  • A great teammate who thrives in multinational environments and can work effectively with remote teams and diverse internal departments.

  • Digital Marketing authority who is deeply knowledgeable in how owned, earned, and paid media intersect to grow audiences, specifically within the digital and social platforms driving modern consumption.

  • Passionate Classical music advocate, with a strong working knowledge of classical repertoire and contemporary artists.

  • Skilled at interpreting complex data to guide both the qualitative and quantitative aspects of a campaign.

  • Outstanding written and verbal English skills; additional proficiency in French or German is an advantage.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience working with artists and their collaborators.

  • Expertise in paid media, particularly social media marketing.

  • An understanding of CRM and audience-building guidelines.

  • A familiarity with the US classical and arts music scene and the US earned-media landscape (digital, editorial and broadcast).

  • A track record of managing budgets and negotiating deal terms with suppliers.

  • A passion for musical theatre repertoire.

  • Experience working in the record industry, music marketing or a related field.

Your role:

Reporting to the Senior Director, the Senior Manager of Corporate Finance will play a leadership role on the team responsible for global finance oversight. This is an autonomous, hands-on role where you will oversee controllership across a broad, multi-department portfolio of centrally managed departments while remaining actively involved in the day-to-day execution of month-end close, forecasting, and operational finance tasks. You will collaborate with senior leadership across numerous departments, regional finance leads globally, Corporate Finance, and Regional Offices to drive strategic alignment and financial accountability. 

Here you’ll get to:

  • Fully own the budget across a broad portfolio of centrally managed departments, building an effective forecasting process and ensuring we hit budget by understanding the numbers, identifying risks early, and proactively partnering with senior department heads to implement cost-mitigation or reallocation strategies, not just reporting. 

  • Lead monthly financial close and reporting processes for centrally managed departments, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with corporate reporting standards. 

  • Lead the consolidated review of centrally managed departments’ P&L—personally building detailed Excel variance models and summaries—while synthesizing complex data into both department-level and consolidated executive-ready summaries of spend vs. budget and progress to targets for senior leadership across multiple departments. 

  • Establish advanced tracking, risk identification, and solution recommendations with enough lead time to act, producing clean, accurate, and actionable financial visibility. 

  • Oversee headcount, payroll, and bonus-related expense reviews, ensuring appropriate accruals, allocations, cost tracking and reporting across an expanded scope of global departments. 

  • Act as a senior finance business partner and strategic advisor to global stakeholders across numerous departments (e.g., A&R, Marketing, Sync, Catalog, Finance/Executive, and other centrally managed functions), providing actionable insights through regular actuals and forecast review discussions. 

  • Facilitate cross-affiliate recharges for central marketing campaigns and funds, as well as maintenance and facilitation of ad-hoc central funding pools. 

  • Remain deeply hands-on with operational finance execution, partnering cross-functionally with Finance SSC and Procurement teams to directly handle and oversee journal entries troubleshooting, PO approvals, invoice coding, and issue resolution, bridging the gap between finance and the wider business. 

  • Own and maintain complex global reporting schedules, including but not limited to department overhead spend performance, M&A legal fee tracking, and SG&A savings initiatives. 

  • Support internal and external audit requirements, including local statutory audit deliverables and documentation readiness. 

  • Drive continuous improvement of reporting processes by enhancing templates, streamlining workflows, and improving forecasting/actuals review efficiency. 

  • Lead and hands-on build the financial modeling and detailed buildup for the annual Budget and 3-Year Plan across a broad portfolio of centrally managed departments, partnering directly with executive leadership to align resources with long-term strategic goals.

job.description:

Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

A little bit about our team:

The People Team sits at the heart of Warner Music Group and is focused on attracting, retaining and developing exceptional people. As part of the People team, our dynamic and diverse Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding and hiring the best talent for the business, and partnering with our business leaders on their talent attraction strategies.

Your role:

At WMG, you will immerse yourself in a vibrant, creative environment, turning your passion for connecting people and music into a rewarding career.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will drive our end-to-end talent acquisition strategy, identifying and engaging high-caliber, diverse talent across the business. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will work with executive collaborators and hiring managers. You will craft proactive sourcing strategies and carry them out to meet business needs now and in the future. Beyond managing complex searches, you will lead strategic TA initiatives, champion our employer brand, and oversee key talent programs and projects. This is a high-impact role requiring strategic foresight, strong business insight, and a consultative approach.   

Here you’ll get to:

- Own the full lifecycle recruitment for assigned roles, delivering an outstanding candidate experience from initial briefing to negotiation and onboarding.   Although the role is west-coast based, you will recruit for positions in other locations and time zones, as well.

- Serve as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders, using labor market insights, industry trends, and data to build hiring strategies and influence talent decisions.

- Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to build robust, diverse talent pipelines for immediate hires and long-term organizational growth.

- Lead key talent acquisition projects aimed at enhancing candidate experience, optimizing recruitment processes, and embedding best practices across the organization.

- Manage agency partner relationships, evaluating vendor performance and ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and SLAs.

- Represent the Warner Music organization as an employer brand ambassador at industry panels, networking events, and campus programs.

- Partner seamlessly with the broader People team (People Partners, Total Rewards, etc.) to deliver cohesive, business-aligned talent solutions.

- Drive recruitment initiatives, establishing strategic partnerships and talent channels to continually diversify our pipeline.

- Mentor and guide hiring managers on interview guidelines, candidate assessment, and competitive market dynamics.
 

About you:

- 5-7 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally combining agency and in-house environments, with a proven track record of filling complex and senior-level positions.

- Proven talent strategist with expert-level knowledge of proactive sourcing methods (LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, niche networks, and competitive intelligence).

- Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using modern ATS platforms (Workday preferred) and sourcing technologies.

- Consultative approach with the confidence and executive presence to challenge, advise, and influence collaborators at all levels.

- Strong business insight, with the ability to quickly grasp industry dynamics and translate strategic objectives into effective talent strategies.

- Demonstrated project management capability, with experience leading TA initiatives, process improvements, or early-career programs.

- Ability to be flexible and nimble in an ever-evolving business environment.

- Data-informed approach, comfortable applying recruitment metrics to evaluate pipeline health and sourcing efficiency.

- Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, capable of fostering collaboration across global and cross-functional teams.

- Outstanding organizational skills and process driven orientation.

  • Assist in preparing Cash Forecasts for significant revenue streams associated with our industry in partnership with FP&A

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Vice President, Strategy


A little bit about our team:


The Global Strategy team is a cross-functional group working across Recorded Music and Music Publishing, sitting at the intersection of creative and corporate operations. The team serves as a trusted partner to senior leadership at WMG, focusing on high-impact strategic projects, data analysis, and execution.

 

We partner closely with senior leadership, label teams, and the central finance organization to shape the long-term direction of the business. This role will directly support the EVP, Global Head of Strategy, helping build the organization's strategic capabilities and ensuring commercial decisions are grounded in rigorous analysis and a deep understanding of the music industry landscape.


Your role:

Serve as a key member of the Global Strategy team, partnering with the EVP, Global Head of Strategy and senior leaders across Warner Music Group to drive the successful execution of company-wide strategic priorities and transformations.


Lead high-impact enterprise strategic initiatives that enhance business performance, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. This role involves collaborating with diverse departments globally and in multiple countries to build strategic direction. It ensures initiatives are accomplished and integrated across the organization. The position translates vision into actionable plans supported by clear decision frameworks, data-driven insights, and important metrics.


Success in this role requires exceptional analytical capabilities, robust program management skills, and outstanding communication. The ideal candidate will build trusted relationships, influence senior collaborators, secure agreement from business operators, and translate complex business challenges into practical, actionable solutions.


Here you’ll get to:


Have Strategic Impact

  • Partner with executive management to assist in the development and execution of Warner Music Group’s global strategic priorities.
  • Lead strategic analysis to evaluate business opportunities, organisational efficiency, organizational frameworks, and long-term growth initiatives.
  • Convert complex business challenges into clear, data-driven recommendations and arguments that support executive decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic programmes from planning through implementation, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish effective programme governance, delivery plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and success measures.
  • Design and evaluate target operating models, including organisational structures, functional design, role scoping and span-and-layer analysis, to support sustainable growth and organisational effectiveness.
  • Build alignment across global functions and international markets, influencing collaborators and securing agreement to ensure the effective implementation of pivotal initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted strategic partner, providing insight, challenge and recommendations to the highest levels of management.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Drive an effective operating cadence across strategic initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance, accountability, and timely decision-making.
  • Support the development, tracking and reporting of strategic objectives, OKRs, KPIs and programme performance measures.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence, Finance and other functional teams to ensure reporting provides meaningful, actionable insights that support business decisions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure central initiatives are delivered efficiently and effectively.
  • Find opportunities to improve business processes, governance, operating models and overall organisational efficiency, enabling greater scalability across the organisation.
  • Promote consistency, collaboration and continuous improvement across project development and programme execution.



About you:

  • Have at least 8 years of relevant experience within a leading management consulting firm and/or a corporate strategy, strategic transformation, or business operations function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs within large, global, matrixed organizations.
  • Outstanding analytical and structured problem-solving skills, demonstrated through the ability to simplify complexity and translate insights into practical business recommendations.
  • Outstanding program management capabilities, with experience delivering multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience preparing executive-level presentations and communicating complex concepts to senior audiences.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and partner management skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders, establish reliable connections and build consensus across diverse business groups.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience in music, media, entertainment, or another content-driven industry.
  • Familiarity with the music industry's commercial models and competitive landscape.
  • Familiarity with building AI tooling and automation


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $230,000 to $245,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. job.title: Weather Producer
job.description:
Position Summary

The Weather Producer has editorial and meteorological responsibility and accountability for all weather content included in one of TWCs programs or
dayparts. They will ensure that each show covers relevant weather events through compelling stories and that those stories are told in the proper order
with visual components that are both accurate and meet (or exceed) TWC standards and style. The weather producer will work closely with on-camera
meteorologists to ensure that their weather storytelling is well-organized, well-prepared, and includes language that connects most effectively with our
target television audience(s). The Weather Producer will also be responsible for creating and updating daily weather graphics to support
TWC programming.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conceive of and create new weather and science-based stories for the assigned program or day part
  • Stay aware of current meteorological pattern and contribute stories to the weather-content editorial process
  • Drive the inclusion and prioritization of weather stories in the assigned program or day part, creates graphics, and /or commissions the creation and/or acquisition of supporting visual content.
  • Mine all available resources, including social media, for possible weather story ideas & content
  • Coordinate with show producers and fellow weather producers to assure continuity in weather storytelling
  • Prepare content using multiple graphic platforms including TruVu Max, Google Earth, Vizrt, and Gibson Ridge
  • Produce weather blocks that are well-organized, well prepared and targets a television audience
  • Maintain proficiency with software changes to TruVu Max and other graphics systems. Ensure that TWC is first-to-air visually and verbally with all breaking weather information
  • Support coverage of significant weather events, including working extra hours and days outside of normally scheduled shifts
  • Create weather graphics that are meteorologically correct and tell an engaging weather story.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, design, or a related field
  • 3 years of meteorological experience to include 3 years of television or graphics building experience
  • 1 year experience using TruVu Max weather systems

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge and understanding of TruVu Max weather systems
  • Thorough comprehension of numerical models 
  • Strong ability to communicate orally and verbally.  Ability to disseminate complex meteorological information in a useable and understandable manner
  • Possesses exceptional interpersonal and teamwork skills
  • Knowledge of social media and its role in the information and content gathering process
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, involving cross-functional teams, in an efficient manner
  • Exhibits creative problem solving skills and unique resourcefulness in order to complete tasks
  • Quickly learns and applies new technologies
  • Customer focused, innovative, and self-motivated
  • Receives feedback constructively and incorporates that feedback into work products and performance
  • Good multitasking and trouble-shooting skills
  • Displays strong collaborative skills and works effectively through conflict
  • Maintains high standards for product, performance, and ethics
  • Effectively contributes to team goals within a highly interactive, and at times, stressful environment
  • Dependable and flexible in a 24x7 operational environment
  • Experience using augmented reality production pipelines a plus
  • Experience using Photoshop, AfterEffects, and 3D modeling software is a plus

job.title: CMMS Administrator – Facilities Operations
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Location: Stamford, CT – WWE Headquarters (Onsite)
Department: Facilities
Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

WWE is seeking a highly organized and technically driven CMMS Administrator – Facilities Operations to support our state-of-the-art global headquarters in Stamford, CT. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role within one of Connecticut’s most advanced and high-profile corporate facilities environments, leveraging cutting-edge building technology, smart systems, and world-class operations infrastructure.

This is not a traditional facilities role. The position sits at the intersection of facilities operations, smart building technology, maintenance planning, asset management, and systems administration. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary subject matter expert for the CMMS/IWMS platform, helping ensure efficient operation, reporting, planning, and continuous improvement of our facilities maintenance programs.

Working closely with maintenance leadership, engineers, technicians, vendors, and technology partners, this role will play a key part in supporting one of the most advanced and high-profile facilities environments in the region.

Key Responsibilities

CMMS / Systems Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for the CMMS/IWMS platform
  • Manage system configuration, workflows, asset data integrity, and user support
  • Ensure integrations with Smart Building and related operational systems function properly
  • Troubleshoot CMMS issues and coordinate escalation with internal technology teams or external vendors when needed
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to maintenance systems and operational efficiency

Work Order & Maintenance Management

  • Oversee work order lifecycle management including creation, assignment, tracking, updates, and closure
  • Maintain and optimize preventative maintenance schedules and programs
  • Support maintenance planning and coordination activities across the facility
  • Assist with vendor scheduling and contractor coordination

Asset & Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate asset records and equipment data within the CMMS
  • Assist with spare parts inventory management and tracking
  • Support asset lifecycle documentation and reporting initiatives

Reporting & Operational Analytics

  • Generate CMMS reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking metrics
  • Assist facilities leadership with maintenance performance reporting and operational insights
  • Identify trends and opportunities for process improvement

Training & Collaboration

  • Train and support internal users on CMMS best practices and workflows
  • Partner cross-functionally with facilities, engineering, operations, and vendors to improve system adoption and operational execution

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, Facilities Management, or related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience working with CMMS, IWMS, EAM, or related maintenance management systems
    • Systems like IBM Maximo, ServiceNow Facilities, Archibus, Corrigo, FM:Systems and similar
  • Experience supporting facilities operations, maintenance planning, asset management, or building systems environments
  • Familiarity with preventative maintenance programs and work order management
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams
  • Experience within smart buildings, commercial facilities, manufacturing, broadcast/media, or large campus environments is a plus

TKO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment. TKO makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities. job.title: Director, App Security
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Director, Application Security Engineering to strengthen our cybersecurity posture and partner directly with teams building software across web, mobile, data, and AI-enabled workflows. This role will embed security into delivery practices, improve how we prevent and remediate risk, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This Director will work across software engineering, platform, DevOps, architecture, QA, infrastructure, compliance, and security teams to mature secure SDLC (i.e., SSDLC) practices, expand developer-friendly guardrails, and improve application and agent security. They should be comfortable moving between code review, tooling configuration, threat modeling, vulnerability management, automation, security enablement, and emerging AI security considerations.  This is a hybrid role (3 days/week in-office). Preference given to candidates near a TKO office, including NYC, Stamford, Orlando, Austin, or Las Vegas.

The Role and What You’ll Do

The Director, Application Security Engineering will:

  • Own and evolve application security practices across the SSDLC, emphasizing scalable, developer-aligned, shift-left controls
  • Operate and improve SAST, SCA, secret scanning, code scanning, repository protections, and related controls across repositories and CI/CD pipelines
  • Develop secure development enablement for citizen developers, vibe coding, and AI-assisted development, including practical guidance for tooling, code assurance, identity, observability, and enterprise standards
  • Review application and code-level vulnerabilities, validate findings, reduce noise, and drive risk-based remediation plans
  • Conduct threat modeling and security design reviews for new systems, major changes, integrations, APIs, and high-risk workflows
  • Advise teams on secure coding, authentication and authorization, session management, secrets handling, logging, encryption, dependency hygiene, and data protection
  • Improve security guardrails for build pipelines, containers, APIs, third-party components, and deployment practices across modern and legacy environments
  • Mature risk-based vulnerability management across intake, validation, prioritization, remediation guidance, exception handling, and reporting
  • Support secure adoption of AI-assisted development and agentic systems by assessing trust boundaries, data exposure paths, prompt and tool-invocation risks, and misuse scenarios
  • Develop pragmatic standards, playbooks, reference architectures, documentation, and office-hour support that improve consistency without slowing teams down unnecessarily
  • Track recurring weaknesses, recommend structural fixes, and help leadership understand where engineering investment will reduce risk most effectively
  • Use AI productively and responsibly to accelerate analysis, triage, documentation, coding support, and security review while maintaining strong human judgment

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, DevSecOps, and security engineering or a closely related software security role
  • Proven experience working directly with engineering teams in fast-moving delivery environments
  • Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing SAST, SCA, and related tooling such as SonarQube, Dependabot, GitHub, GitHub Advanced Security, or comparable platforms
  • Ability to interpret and reason about code, identify meaningful risk, and provide specific, implementable remediation guidance to engineers
  • Practical experience with SSDLC and shift-left practices, including automated code review support, threat modeling, security design review, and vulnerability management
  • Strong understanding of application and API security, including common software weaknesses, authN/authZ, secrets handling, dependency risk, injection, deserialization, and data protection
  • Experience integrating reliable, scalable, and minimally disruptive security controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud and modern software delivery patterns, including containers, IaC, and Git-based workflows
  • Strong judgment in vulnerability triage, balancing severity, exploitability, business impact, and engineering realities
  • Ability to write clear guidance, standards, and technical documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bias toward automation, simplification, and scalable solutions over manual heroics
  • Broad DevSecOps mindset across code, pipelines, dependencies, platforms, deployment, and operations
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly to improve engineering and security outcomes

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience securing AI agents, LLM-enabled applications, copilots, or agentic workflows in production or near-production environments
  • Experience with DAST, API security testing, penetration testing coordination, red-team support, or adversarial testing of application and AI systems
  • Experience with policy-as-code, IaC scanning, container/image security, software supply-chain security, SBOMs, provenance, attestation, and secrets management
  • Familiarity with cloud security across AWS and/or GCP and the application-layer implications of cloud-native architectures
  • Experience in regulated, audit-sensitive, or event-critical environments where evidence, controls, and operational rigor matter
  • Experience building metrics, dashboards, or reporting that show AppSec posture and remediation progress
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing secure engineering culture without direct people management responsibility

What Good Looks Like in This Role

  • Engineering teams get faster, clearer, and more actionable security guidance as well as assistance with implementation and mechanics for a "teach a person to fish" approach
  • Security tooling produces more trustworthy signals and leads to better adoption, not just more alerts
  • Teams catch and remediate issues earlier in design and development rather than late in release cycles
  • Application and agent-security risks are surfaced in practical terms with concrete mitigation paths
  • Standards, playbooks, and tooling make secure delivery easier and more consistent

job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. The Role and What You’ll Do:

TKO Global Partnerships is looking for a driven, relationship-first sales executive to join one of the most dynamic commercial teams in sports and entertainment. As a Director of Sales, you will own new business development across UFC and/or WWE — two of the most recognized and emotionally powerful properties on the planet — delivering partnership and sponsorship solutions that create genuine value for brands, their agencies, and their customers.

This is a role for a closer who thrives in a consultative environment, builds trust quickly at the executive level, and knows how to turn a first conversation into a multi-year, seven-figure partnership. You will be on the front lines of revenue generation for TKO, prospecting aggressively, presenting compellingly, and delivering results that consistently exceed targets.

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of qualified brand and agency prospects large enough to meet — and beat — your financial goals
  • Drive new business revenue through the sale of UFC and WWE media, sponsorship, and integrated partnership assets
  • Leverage deep knowledge of and relationships across the brand and agency landscape to identify and accelerate revenue opportunities
  • Understand client marketing objectives inside and out, and translate those needs into tailored UFC and WWE partnership solutions with clear, compelling value propositions
  • Guide clients from initial pitch through contract close, onboarding, and long-term strategic account growth
  • Host clients and prospects at UFC and WWE live events, creating immersive brand experiences that deepen relationships and accelerate deal cycles
  • Explore creative packaging and upsell opportunities, including co-sell structures with TKO's media distribution partners
  • Accurately forecast revenue, proactively identify risks, and bring solutions — not just problems
  • Contribute ideas that elevate the broader team's performance and reinforce TKO Global Partnerships as the premier destination for brand investment in sports and entertainment 

You Have These:

  • 10+ years of revenue development experience with a focus on partnership and sponsorship sales, ideally in sports, media, or entertainment
  • Proven track record closing six- and seven-figure deals with Fortune 500 brands and/or senior agency decision makers
  • Deep understanding of the sports sponsorship and media landscape — the players, the trends, the terminology, and the deals that matter
  • A hunter's mentality paired with a relationship-builder's instincts — you're equally comfortable cold-opening a C-suite conversation and deepening a decade-long partnership
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build custom solutions, not just pitch off a rate card
  • Robust analytical capability, including market strategy development and value-based selling
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you present with authority and follow up with precision
  • Highly organized with sharp attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Advanced negotiation skills and the confidence to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Motivated by a rewarding, performance-based compensation structure
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as dictated by the live event calendar
  • Ability to be based in or work across New York City and Stamford, CT

Role Summary

The Facilities Coordinator performs hands-on maintenance and supports day-to-day facilities operations at WWE's corporate headquarters in Stamford, CT. Reporting to the Facilities Senior Director, this role keeps building systems, office spaces, and on-site amenities running safely and to a high standard, and delivers responsive, white-glove support to staff and executives. This is an on-site, hourly position that requires 24x7 on-call availability and occasional after-hours and weekend work.

Reports to: Facilities Senior Director

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on corporate headquarters building systems—including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and life-safety equipment—troubleshooting and repairing MEP systems to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Handle general repairs and finishes—including drywall, painting, and carpentry—using hand and power tools.

  • Conduct routine inspections of offices, conference rooms, common areas, and building equipment to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns.

  • Maintain and upkeep the on-site state-of-the-art gym.

  • Perform office reconfigurations, furniture moves, and workstation setups, manage occasional TV installations, and provide event support for executive meetings and corporate functions.

  • Assist the Facilities Director and team with building projects, furniture installations, and space-planning projects (employee adds, moves, and changes), including updating floor and seating charts in AutoCAD.

  • Maintain general supply orders and support inventory management by monitoring maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment—including medical, cleaning, and special-request items—to ensure operational readiness.

  • Manage the maintenance log and CMMS / work-order system, responding promptly to facility service requests in a fast-paced corporate environment while maintaining high standards for professionalism, safety, and customer service.

  • Read and work from blueprints and coordinate with architects and engineers as needed.

  • Coordinate with outside vendors and contractors for scheduled maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facility improvement projects.

  • Provide 24x7 emergency-response support for situations such as power outages, water leaks, and HVAC failures, including after-hours building issues and events.

  • Support and monitor records management and retention

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of corporate or commercial facilities maintenance experience (broadcast/media environment a plus).

  • High school diploma or GED; trade-school training or relevant certifications a plus.

  • Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems.

  • Valid driver's license.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel.

  • Clear communication skills—able to communicate effectively with executives, peers, and team members.

  • Strong customer-service orientation, with the ability to deliver an outstanding client experience.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to problem-solve and work both independently and as part of a team with minimal supervision, while maintaining accurate documentation.

  • Availability for 24x7 on-call, extra hours, and weekend/after-hours work as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, generators, and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

  • Experience maintaining security panels and alarms and life-safety systems (fire panel and sprinkler systems) and supporting fire drills.

  • Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) or work-order platform.

  • Experience in a broadcast, media, or entertainment corporate environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift 50+ pounds.

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, bend, kneel, and work in various positions for extended periods.

Position Title: Manager, Membership Growth

Location: Los Angeles, CA (onsite)

I. Position Summary:

Manager of Membership Growth to help launch and scale a new digital membership product. This role will focus on converting a broad fan audience and large and growing waitlist into a paid membership base. The ideal candidate can build lifecycle campaigns, segment audiences, test messaging and offers, analyze performance, and coordinate cross-functionally to drive membership growth. This is primarily an owned-channel growth role, rather than a paid media role. Previous experience in subscription, membership, ecommerce, loyalty, ticketing, sports, media, entertainment, or consumer products is a plus. 2–5 years of relevant experience preferred, but open based on fit.

II. Core Responsibilities:

  • Own paid member growth for the digital membership product, with responsibility for converting waitlist users and owned fan audiences into new paid members

  • Build and manage lifecycle campaigns across email, SMS, web, app, landing pages, and other owned channels to support launch and ongoing membership growth

  • Partner with CRM and Data teams to segment audiences based on fan behavior, engagement, purchase history, geography, event interest, and stated preferences

  • Support launch planning and execution, including campaign calendars, audience sequencing, and testing plans

  • A/B test and optimize campaign messaging, subject lines, CTAs, offers, timing, landing pages, and conversion flows

  • Work closely with Product to identify and improve key funnel moments from waitlist sign-up to paid membership conversion

  • Collaborate with Creative and Marketing teams to develop campaign assets that clearly communicate membership benefits and drive action

  • Coordinate with Ticketing, Ecommerce, Social, Content, and CRM teams to maximize owned-channel promotion and conversion opportunities across digital touchpoints

  • Partner with Events, Marketing, and on-site teams to plan and execute live event activations that drive waitlist growth, paid member sign-ups, and fan engagement

  • Track funnel performance and prepare weekly readouts covering waitlist growth, email engagement, click-through rate, landing page conversion, checkout completion, paid member conversion, revenue, retention, key learnings, and next steps

  • Help establish repeatable growth processes for future membership campaigns, renewals, benefit drops, event pushes, and seasonal moments

Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the flow of creative work from intake through final delivery across a high-volume, fast-paced environment supporting the AAA brand. This role coordinates creative requests, licensing submission support, merchandise initiatives, talent-related projects, logo development, and related brand deliverables across internal teams and external partners.


This position serves as a key operational partner to Creative, helping projects move efficiently from concept through completion while ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, approvals, budgets, and deliverable requirements. The Project Manager works closely with designers, creative leads, licensing, merchandise, talent, marketing, production partners, and other stakeholders to keep work organized, on track, and executed to a high standard.


Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships across AAA and related business functions, including Creative, Licensing, Consumer Products, Merchandise, Talent, Marketing, Communications, Digital, Production, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage projects through all phases of the creative, approval, licensing, and production process to ensure timelines, budget requirements, and job specifications are met.
  • Coordinate project intake, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and approvals across multiple concurrent assignments, ensuring clear communication and accountability at every stage.
  • Partner closely with designers and creative leads to define project scope, deliverable requirements, production approaches, and workflow needs.
  • Maintain clear project documentation, status updates, schedules, and action items so stakeholders have visibility into priorities, next steps, risks, and dependencies.
  • Keep current with AAA programming, talent, events, brand priorities, merchandise needs, and business objectives to support informed planning and effective project coordination.

AAA Creative & Brand Support

  • Manage the intake and coordination of creative requests supporting the AAA brand across marketing, digital, social, events, merchandise, talent, licensing, and other business needs.
  • Help translate stakeholder requests into clear creative briefs, project plans, timelines, and deliverable lists.
  • Coordinate the development and review of AAA brand assets, including campaign creative, promotional materials, merchandise graphics, talent-related creative, logos, and other visual applications.
  • Partner with creative leads to ensure work is aligned with approved brand direction, usage requirements, project scope, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Track feedback and approvals, consolidate comments, and help drive timely decisions across internal teams and external partners.
  • Identify potential creative, operational, or approval issues early and help develop practical solutions that protect quality and delivery timelines.

Licensing Submission Support

  • Coordinate the preparation, organization, and routing of creative materials required for licensing submissions and approvals.
  • Maintain submission trackers, deadlines, asset requirements, status updates, and approval records for active licensing projects.
  • Partner with Licensing, Creative, Merchandise, Legal, and other stakeholders to confirm that submissions are complete, accurate, properly formatted, and delivered on time.
  • Help manage revisions, comments, and follow-up requests throughout the licensing review process.
  • Maintain organized records of approved assets, supporting materials, and final submission files.

Merchandise, Talent & Logo Development

  • Support project management for AAA merchandise initiatives from initial request through concept development, review, approval, production, and final delivery.
  • Coordinate creative needs related to talent, including asset requests, approvals, usage considerations, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Help organize and manage logo development projects, including creative briefs, exploratory concepts, review rounds, approvals, final files, and usage documentation.
  • Coordinate with designers, merchandise partners, talent representatives, licensing stakeholders, and vendors to keep projects moving and expectations aligned.
  • Track project-specific requirements, including artwork specifications, product applications, talent or partner approvals, production deadlines, and final deliverables.

Production Support & Execution

  • Obtain estimates and help secure vendors based on quality, cost, service, and turnaround time when outside production support is needed.
  • Interface with external vendors and production partners, staying current with industry practices and helping resolve production-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Coordinate print, digital, merchandise, event, and other production deliverables as assigned.
  • Address potential production or execution issues before they impact delivery, helping teams stay ahead of risks and maintain momentum.
  • Help ensure final deliverables are produced accurately, on brand, on time, and within scope across a range of creative applications.

Workflow Optimization & AI-Enabled Organization

  • Use AI tools and workflow systems in practical ways to improve request intake, job organization, task tracking, status visibility, and overall project efficiency across the team.
  • Help the team adopt new tools and ways of working that improve project tracking, communication, and operational clarity without disrupting creative quality or delivery.
  • Support stronger visibility into project progress, next steps, approvals, and resource needs by maintaining accurate timelines, updates, and tracking systems.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify recurring processes, improve documentation, and create greater consistency across AAA creative workflows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish is required.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in project management within an agency, in-house creative department, design studio, entertainment company, sports property, consumer products organization, licensing environment, or related fast-paced creative setting.
  • Thorough knowledge of creative project and production management principles and practices, with working knowledge of print, digital, merchandise, and brand asset workflows.
  • Proven experience establishing and maintaining schedules, budgets, approvals, and deliverables for multiple concurrent, deadline-driven projects through all phases of design, review, licensing, and production.
  • Experience supporting licensing submissions, merchandise creative, talent-related projects, logo development, or other brand asset development is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and project tracking or workflow management tools; familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with a wide range of internal and external partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, stay detail-oriented, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Reliable, punctual, self-directed, and flexible in responding to changing priorities and business needs.
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and a strong interest in supporting the AAA brand through thoughtful, organized, and high-quality creative execution.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Intellectual Property
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Working Conditions:

  • Stamford based role

  • Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm

About the Role

WWE is seeking a skilled and proactive Corporate Counsel to join our Business & Legal Affairs team and report into the WWE - Senior Vice President, Deputy General Counsel and TKO - Head of Intellectual Property and Licensing. The ideal candidate will have approximately 6-8 years of legal experience, focused on intellectual property clearance, prosecution, enforcement and protection as well as drafting and negotiating corporate agreements. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of law, business strategy, and entertainment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive clearance searches and provide risk assessments for new brands, products, character names, corporate logos, and apparel slogans.

  • Monitor and enforce the company’s intellectual property portfolio (trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets), including drafting and sending cease-and-desist letters, managing takedowns, filing UDRP actions, managing third party enforcement vendors and supporting litigation if necessary.

  • Develop and institute best practices for IP enforcement and protection for infringements, counterfeit and video piracy strategies.

  • Advise on copyright, domain name and related brand protection issues.

  • Support IP enforcement, including monitoring, cease and desist letters, opposition and related disputes. 

  • Collaborate with external counsel and IP offices globally on enforcement.  Work closely with internal business units on a wide variety of intellectual property related matters.

  • Stay current on relevant legal developments, including changes in IP law and technology affecting brand owners’ ability to monitor and enforce proactively.

  • Draft a broad range of contracts relating to sports and entertainment, including intellectual property settlement and coexistence agreements, license agreements, product placement agreements, independent contractor agreements and NDAs.

  • Work closely, collaboratively and enthusiastically with other members of the Business & Legal Affairs team of WWE, WWE affiliates, as well as corresponding business clients.

  • Provide comprehensive legal advice and counsel to internal business units.

  • Provide real-time analysis and advice on business and legal issues, including questions of contract interpretation and enforcement.

  • Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to at least one U.S. state bar, and the ability to register as Connecticut authorized in-house counsel.

  • Strong background in trademark clearance, prosecution and enforcement.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating corporate contracts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Knowledge or willingness to watch current and historical WWE programming.

Required Skills

  • Working and recent knowledge and experience with clearance search work as well as U.S. trademark prosecution (including all filings with the U.S. Trademark Office).

  • Familiarity with domestic and international IP enforcement strategies.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure

  • Equity/stock options (if applicable)

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

job.title: VP, Recruiting
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

TKO Group Holdings | Stamford, CT

ABOUT TKO

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns and operates UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization, WWE, the recognized global leader in sports entertainment, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), the world’s premier bull riding organization, IMG, a global leader in sports, events, media, and fashion, and On Location, a premium experiential hospitality business. Together, these brands and businesses produce hundreds of live events annually, serve partners across the globe, and reach hundreds of millions of fans worldwide.

POSITION SUMMARY

TKO is looking for a VP, Recruiting to lead talent acquisition for UFC, WWE, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), and Zuffa Boxing. Reporting to the SVP, Global Recruiting and based in Stamford, CT, this leader will manage a team of three recruiters, oversee strategic search as well as TKO’s early careers internship program.

This is a role for someone who takes immense pride in their work, brings high standards, and earns a reputation as a trusted partner across the business. The VP, Recruiting will be just as comfortable building relationships on the floor of a live event as they are driving process and strategy from their desk. Presence and proximity to the businesses matter here. This person will be in Stamford 3–4 days per week, visit the NYC office frequently, and travel regularly to Las Vegas and Fort Worth to stay immersed in each business, know its leaders and employees, and maintain a pulse on the candidate market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the team. Manage, develop, and inspire a team of three. Set high standards. Create an environment where the team does their best work, holds themselves accountable, and takes pride in the quality and consistency of what they deliver.

  • Set recruiting strategy. Develop and deliver recruiting strategies that align with the priorities of each business. Translate what UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing need to grow into a clear, actionable talent plan. Revisit and adapt that plan as business needs evolve.

  • Partner with the business. Serve as the primary recruiting partner for UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Build strong, trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders. Stay connected to each business’s culture, priorities, and talent needs. Show up, be present, and be known.

  • Drive results. Manage a high volume of searches without sacrificing quality. Fill roles efficiently, with the right candidates, and deliver a consistent hiring manager and candidate experience. Be measured by client feedback and satisfaction, and by the success of the people you place once they are in the building.

  • Build programs that scale. Lead the development and adoption of a referral program across UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Drive meaningful usage of AI recruiting tools including Findem and Paradox. Strengthen TKO’s employer brand externally and internally.

  • Develop talent pipelines. Know the candidate market. Build and maintain relationships with top talent before the need arises. Think ahead of the business, not behind it.

  • Lead early careers. Oversee TKO’s early careers internship program with the same rigor and client-service mindset applied to all other recruiting activity.

  • Recruit for senior roles. In addition to leading the team, personally lead searches for senior and critical positions across the portfolio.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, with a proven track record leading teams and managing full-cycle searches across multiple business units or brands

  • A client-service mentality. You are responsive, proactive, and treat every hiring manager interaction as an opportunity to build trust and deliver value

  • Strong follow-up and follow-through. You close loops, update stakeholders without being asked, and never let things fall through the cracks

  • A reputation builder. The way you work and the quality of your output speak for themselves

  • Genuine curiosity about the businesses you support. You want to understand how UFC, WWE, PBR, Zuffa Boxing operate, who makes them run, and what talent they need to grow

  • Experience building or significantly scaling referral programs

  • Hands-on experience with AI recruiting tools and a drive to lead adoption across your team and business partners (experience with Findem and/or Paradox a plus)

  • A creative problem-solving approach. You find solutions, not obstacles

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment without letting quality slip

  • Comfort with regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX

  • A bias toward presence. You understand that relationships are built in person and you show up accordingly

LOCATION

Stamford, CT (3–4 days per week in office), with frequent visits to the NYC office and regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX.
